rows.output: Ṣugbọn ijọba UK tun ti n mura lati koju abajade ti ko ba si adehun.
rows.reference: Ṣùgbọ́n Ìjọba UK tí ń tẹ̀síwájú nínú ìgbaradì rẹ̀ fún pé kí irúfẹ́ àdéhùn ìṣòwò má ṣeéṣe.

rows.source: I know this must be a very unsettling time for all of you.
rows.output: Mo mọ̀ pé àkókò yìí gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ ìdààmú ńlá fún gbogbo yín.
rows.reference: Mo mọ̀ pé èyí gbọ́dọ̀ jẹ́ àsìkò tí kò rọrùn fún gbogbo yín.

rows.source: That is why I wanted to reiterate now how much I value the contribution of every member of staff, regardless of their nationality.
rows.output: Iyẹn ni idi ti mo fi fẹ lati tun sọ ni bayi bi mo ṣe bọwọ fun ẹbun gbogbo oṣiṣẹ, laibikita orilẹ-ede wọn.
rows.reference: Ìdí nìyí tí mo fi fẹ́ tẹnumọ́ bí mo ṣe mọ rírì òṣìṣẹ́ ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan, láì kà ẹ̀yà kláìbìkítà irúfẹ́ ẹ̀yà.

rows.source: Colleagues from across the EU, and beyond, bring valuable experience and skills that strengthen and improve the work of the health service, and benefit the patients and communities we serve.
rows.output: Àwọn ẹlẹgbẹ́ láti gbogbo ìpínlẹ̀ EU, àti láti òdìkejì, mú ìrírí tó ṣe pàtàkì àti ọgbọ́n tó mú kí iṣẹ́ ìlera túbọ̀ lágbára sí i, ó sì dára jù, ó sì ń ṣèrànwọ́ fún àwọn aláìsàn àti àwùjọ tí a ń ṣèrànwọ́.
rows.reference: Àwọn akẹgbẹ́ láti gbogbo EU, àti agbègbè reẹ̀, ló mú ìrírí tó níye lórím àti ọgbọ́n àtinúdá tí ó mú kí ìpèsè ilera dàgbà kí ó sì dára síi, kí ó jẹ́ àǹfààní fúnàwọn olùgbàwòsàn àti àwùjọtí á ń sìn.

rows.source: Scotland is absolutely your home and we very much want you to stay here."
rows.output: "Ìsọ̀lẹ̀ ní Scotland jẹ́ ti ẹ̀yin gan-an, a sì fẹ́ràn yín gan-an láti wà níbí."
rows.reference: Scotland jẹ́ ilegèé rẹ gan an tí a ó sì wú wà kí ó dúró níbẹ̀."

rows.source: Christion Abercrombie Undergoes Emergency Surgery After Suffering Head Injury
rows.output: Christion Abercrombie ṣe iṣẹ abẹ pajawiri lẹhin ipalara ori
rows.reference: Christion Abercrombie lọ fún Iṣẹ́ Abẹ Pàjáwìrì Lẹ̀yìn Ìpalára Ìforígbà

rows.source: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie underwent emergency surgery after suffering a head injury in Saturday's 31-27 defeat to the Vanderbilt Commodores, the Tennessean's Mike Organ reported.
rows.output: Ìyípadà Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie ní ìṣègùn pajawiri lẹ́yìn tí ó farapa ìfarapa orí ní Satidee 31-27 tí wọ́n ṣẹ́gun Commodores Vanderbilt, Tennessean Mike Organ ròyìn.
rows.reference: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie ṣe iṣẹ́-abẹ pàjáwìrì nígbàtí ó fi orí-ṣèṣe ní Satide tí wọ́n fìdí rẹmi pẹ̀lú 31-27 sí akẹgbẹ́ wọn Vanderbilt Commodores. Gẹ́gẹ́ bí Mike Organ ti Tennessean ṣe sọ.

rows.source: Tennessee State head coach Rod Reed told reporters the injury happened shortly before halftime.
rows.output: Oluṣakoso Rod Reed ti Ipinle Tennessee sọ fun awọn oniroyin pe ipalara naa ṣẹlẹ ni iṣẹju diẹ ṣaaju idaji.
rows.reference: Olórí Akọ́ni ìpínlẹ̀ Tennessee sọ fún àwọn oníròyìn pé ìpalára náà wáyé ní ó kù díẹ̀ kí wọ́n dé ìdajì eré ìdárayá.

rows.source: "He came to the sideline and just kind of collapsed there," Reed said.
rows.output: Ó dé etí pápá náà, ó sì kan ṣoṣo kó sùn níbẹ̀, Reed sọ.
rows.reference: "Ó wá sí ẹ̀gbẹ̀ pápá ìṣeré ó ṣì subú lulẹ̀ síbẹ̀,” Reed sọbẹ́ẹ̀.

rows.source: Trainers and medical personnel gave Abercrombie oxygen on the sideline before placing him on a stretcher and taking him back for further evaluation.
rows.output: Awọn olukọni ati oṣiṣẹ iṣoogun fun Abercrombie ni atẹgun lori ẹgbẹ ṣaaju gbigbe e sori ibusun gbigbe ati gbigbe e pada fun iṣiro siwaju.
rows.reference: Àwọn Akọni àti òṣìṣẹ́ ìlera fún Abercrombie ní afẹ́fẹ́ oxygen lẹ́gbẹ̀é pápá ìṣere kí wọ́n tó gbé e lé orí kẹ́kẹ́-ìwòsàn lọ fún àyẹ̀wò míràn.

rows.source: An official from Tennessee State told Chris Harris of WSMV in Nashville, Tennessee, that Abercrombie was out of surgery at Vanderbilt Medical Center.
rows.output: Ọ̀kan lára àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìjọba ní Tennessee State sọ fún Chris Harris ti WSMV ní Nashville, Tennessee pé Abercrombie ti jáde kúrò ní ilé ìwòsàn Vanderbilt Medical Center.
rows.reference: Òṣìṣẹ́ ìjọba láti ìpínlẹ̀ Tennessee sọ fún Harris ti WSMV ni Nashville, Tennessee, pé Abercrombie kò sí ní abala iṣẹ́ abẹ́ mọ́ ní Ilé Ìwòsàn Vanderbilt.

rows.source: Harris added that there are "no details on type/extent of injury yet" and Tennessee State is trying to figure out when the injury occurred.
rows.output: Harris fi kun pe “ko si alaye lori iru/ibiti ipalara naa ti wa sibẹsibẹ” ati pe Tennessee State n gbiyanju lati pinnu nigbati ipalara naa waye.
rows.reference: Harris fi kún pé kò sí ẹ̀kúnrẹ́rẹ àlàyé lórí irú/bí ìpalara náà ṣe pọ̀ sí” àtipé Ìpínlẹ̀ Tennessee ń gbìyànjú láti mọ ìgbàtí ìpalara náà ti ṣẹlẹ̀.

rows.source: Abercrombie, a redshirt sophomore, is in his first season with Tennessee State after transferring from Illinois.
rows.output: Abercrombie, ọmọ ọdún kejì ni, wọ aṣọ pupa, ni akoko àkọ́kọ́ rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú Ipinlẹ̀ Tennessee lẹ́yìn tí ó ti yá sí Illinois.
rows.reference: Abercrombie, aláṣọpúpa akẹ́kọ̀ ọlọ́dún kejì ní sáa rẹ àkọ́kọ́ pẹ̀lú Ìpínlẹ̀ Tennessee lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n gbé e lọ sí Illinois.

rows.source: He had five total tackles Saturday before exiting the game, which brought his season total to 18 tackles.
rows.output: Ó ṣe àtúnṣe márùn-ún ní ọjọ́ ìsinmi, ó sì jáde nínú eré náà, èyí tó mú kí àkópọ̀ àkókò rẹ̀ lọ sí méjìdínlógún.
rows.reference: ó ní àpapọ̀ tákù marùn ún ní Sátidé kí ó tí jáde kúrò nínú eré ìdárayá náà, èyí tí ó mú kí sáà rẹ̀ wá sí àpapọ̀ táku 18.

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK
rows.output: Àwọn tó ń ra ilẹ̀ òkèèrè yóò san owó ìdámẹ́wàá tó ga jù lọ nígbà tí wọ́n bá ra ilẹ̀ ní UK
rows.reference: Àwọn olùrajà tó bá jẹ́ àrè máa san owó orí òǹtẹ̀ nígbàtí wọ́n bá ra ohun iní ní UK

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK with the extra cash used to help the homeless under new Tory plans
rows.output: Àwọn tó ń ra ilẹ̀ òkèèrè yóò san owó ìdánilójú tó ga jù lọ nígbà tí wọ́n bá ra ilẹ̀ ní UK, owó tó pọ̀ sí i yóò sì ràn àwọn aláìní ilé lọ́wọ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn ọmọ ìjọba tó ń fọwọ́ sowọ́ pọ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn olùrajà tó bá jẹ́ àrè máa san owó orí òǹtẹ̀ nígbàtí wọ́n bá ra ohun iní ní UK pẹ̀lú àníkún tí wọ́n lò láti ran àwọn aláìnílélórí lábẹ̀ ètò Tory tuntun

rows.source: The move will neutralise the success of Corbyn's drive to attract young voters
rows.output: Iṣipopada naa yoo fọwọsi aṣeyọri ti igbiyanju Corbyn lati fa awọn oludibo ọdọ
rows.reference: Ìgbéṣẹ̀ náà máa fagilé àṣeyọrí ìkónimọ́ra Corbyn láti fa àwọn ọ̀dọ́ olùdìbò mọ́ra.

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on those who are not paying tax in the UK
rows.output: Ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ yóò wáyé lórí àwọn tí kò san owó orí ní UK
rows.reference: Owó orí olńtẹ̀ ní àwọn tí kò san owó orí ní Uk máa san

rows.source: The Treasury expects it raise up to £120 million a year- to help the homeless
rows.output: Ile-iṣẹ Iṣura nireti pe yoo gbe soke si £ 120 milionu ni ọdun kan - lati ṣe iranlọwọ fun awọn alaini ile
rows.reference: Ẹ̀ka ìtọ́júowo ń retí láti pa owó tó tó £120 million lọ́dún kan - láti ran àwọn aláìnílélórí lọ́wọ̀.

rows.source: Foreign buyers are set to be charged a higher stamp duty rate when they buy property in the UK - with the extra cash used to help the homeless, Theresa May will announce today.
rows.output: Àwọn tó ń ra ilẹ̀ òkèèrè yóò san owó ìdámẹ́wàá tó ga ju bí wọ́n ṣe ń ṣe tẹ́lẹ̀ nígbà tí wọ́n bá ra ilẹ̀ ní UK, pẹ̀lú owó tó pọ̀ sí i tí a ó fi ràn àwọn aláìní ilé lọ́wọ́, Theresa May yóò kede lónìí.
rows.reference: Àwọn olùrajà tó bá jẹ́ àrè máa san owó orí òǹtẹ̀ nígbàtí wọ́n bá ra ohun iní ní UK pẹ̀lú àníkún tí wọ́n lò láti ran àwọn aláìnílélórí lábẹ̀, Therasa May máa kéde lónìí.

rows.source: The move will be seen as an attempt to neutralise the success of Jeremy Corbyn's drive to attract young voters with pledges to provide more affordable housing and target high earners.
rows.output: Ìgbésẹ̀ náà yóò jẹ́ bí ìsapá láti fòpin sí ìṣeyọrí Jeremy Corbyn nínú fífani lọ́kàn àwọn ọ̀dọ́ láti kópa nínú ìdìbò pẹ̀lú ìlérí láti pèsè ilé tí ó rọrùn láti rí àti láti dojú kọ àwọn tó ń rí owó gbà.
rows.reference: Ìgbéṣẹ́ náa máa rí bíi ìgbìyànjú láti fagilé àṣeyọrí ìkónimọ́ra Corbyn láti fa àwọn ọ̀dọ́ olùdìbò mọ́ra pẹ̀lú ìlérí láti pèsè ilégbèé tí kò wọ́n tí wọ́n sì ní àfojúsun àwọn tí wọ́n ń gba owó tó pọ̀.

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on individuals and firms not paying tax in the UK, with the extra money boosting the Government's drive to combat rough sleeping.
rows.output: Ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ ìdájọ́ yóò wáyé lórí àwọn ènìyàn àti àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ tí kò san owó orí ní UK, pẹ̀lú owó tí ó pọ̀ sí i tí ń ṣèrànwọ́ fún ìjọba láti gbógun ti ìsùn àwọn aláìnílé.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀kúnwó owó orí olóǹtẹ̀ ní ó máa jẹ́ sísan fún ẹnìkọ̀ọ̀kan tàbí àwọn ile iṣẹ́ tí kò san owó orí ní UK, pẹ̀lú àníkún owó tí ó ń ṣe ìgbélárugẹ ìgbìyànjú ìjọba láti gbogun ti àìrílégbé.

rows.source: The surcharge - which is in addition to the present stamp duty, including the higher levels introduced two years ago on second homes and buy-to-lets - could be as much as three per cent.
rows.output: Ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ náà - èyí tí ó wà lórí ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́, títí kan àwọn ìpele tó ga jù lọ tí wọ́n ṣe ní ọdún méjì sẹ́yìn lórí ilé kejì àti àwọn tó ń ra ilé láti gbé - lè jẹ́ ìdá mẹ́ta.
rows.reference: Àlékún - tí ó jẹ́ àlékún owó sí owó orí olóǹtẹ̀, pẹ̀lú àwọn ìpele gíga tí wọ́n wáyé ní bí ọdún méjì ṣẹ́hìn lórí ilé kejì àti rà-kóo- tà - lẹ̀ tó bíi mẹ́ta nínú ìdá ọgọ́rùn ún.

rows.source: The Treasury expects the move to raise up to £120 million a year.
rows.output: Ìjọba ìnáwó ń retí pé ìgbésẹ̀ náà yóò mú kí wọ́n ní ìdá 120 mílíọ̀nù poun lọ́dọọdún.
rows.reference: Ẹ̀ka ìpawówọlé náà ń retí ìgbéṣẹ̀ náa láti ṣàlékún £120 million ní ọdún kan.

rows.source: An estimated 13 per cent of new-build London properties are bought by non-UK residents, driving up prices and making it harder for first-time buyers to get a foot on the housing ladder.
rows.output: Iwọn 13 ogorun ti awọn ohun-ini tuntun London ti ra nipasẹ awọn ara ilu ti kii ṣe UK, ti n mu awọn idiyele pọ si ati ki o jẹ ki o nira fun awọn oniwun ile akọkọ lati gba ẹsẹ kan lori ila-oorun ile.
rows.reference: Àfojúbù ìdá 13 nínú ọgọ́rùn ún àwọn ilé tuntun ní London ní àwọn tí kìíṣe ọmọ UK rà, tí wọ́n sì ń jẹ́ kí wọ́n gbówó lórí ju bí ó ṣe yẹ lọ tí ó sì ń mú nǹkan le fún olùralé fún ìgbà àkọ̀kọ̀ láti rí ẹsẹ̀ walẹ̀ ní ìdí ọ̀rọ̀ ilé.

rows.source: Many wealthy areas of the country - particularly in the capital - have become "ghost towns" because of the high number of foreign buyers who spend most of their time out of the country.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn àgbègbè ọlọ́rọ̀ ní orílẹ̀-èdè náà, pàápàá jùlọ ní olú ìlú, ti di “àwọn abúlé ẹ̀mí” nítorí pé àwọn oníbàárà ilé káàkiri àgbáyé ti máa ń lo àkókò púpọ̀ níta orílẹ̀-èdè náà.
rows.reference: Àmọye ilé láàrin orílẹ̀ èdè - ní pàtàkì olú ìlú - ti di “ahoro” nítorí iye àwọn onràjà tí wọ́n jẹ́ àrè tí wọ́n sì ń lo àsìkò wọn ní ẹ̀yìn odi.

rows.source: The new policy comes just weeks after Boris Johnson called for a stamp duty cut to help more young people own their first home.
rows.output: Ìṣòro tuntun náà wáyé ní ọ̀sẹ̀ diẹ lẹ́yìn tí Boris Johnson pe fún dídín oṣuwọn owó orí láti ran àwọn ọ̀dọ́ diẹ̀ lọ́wọ́ láti ní ilé àkọ́kọ́ wọn.
rows.reference: Ìlànà tuntun yìí dé ní bíi ọ̀ṣẹ díẹ̀ lẹ́yìn tí Boris Johnson pè fún àdínkù owó orí olóǹtẹ̀ láti ṣèrànwọ́ fún ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn ọ̀dọ̀ kí wọ́n le ní ilé àkọ̀kọ̀ tiwọ́n.

rows.source: He accused big construction firms of keeping property prices high by snapping up land but not using it, and urged Mrs May to abandon quotas on affordable homes to fix Britain's "housing disgrace."
rows.output: Ó fi ẹ̀sùn kan àwọn ilé-iṣẹ́ ìkọ́lé ńláǹlà pé wọ́n ń pa àwọn owó ilé mọ́lẹ̀ nípa gbígbìyànjú láti ra ilẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n kò lò ó, ó sì rọ Ọ̀gbẹ́ni May láti dá àwọn ìlànà sílẹ̀ lórí ilé ológbòfò láti tún ṣe “ìyàjẹ́ ilé Gẹ̀ẹ́sì.”
rows.reference: Ó fi ẹ̀sùn kan àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ akọ́létà pé wọ́n ń gba ilẹ̀ sílẹ̀ lái lò wọ̀n, tí ó sí rọ ìyáàfin May láti pa ìlànà ìpín lórí àwọn ilégbèé tí kò wọ́n jù láti yanjú “ìtìjú àìrílégbé.” ní Bírítéénì

rows.source: Mr Corbyn has announced an eye-catching series of proposed housing reforms, including rent controls and an end to "no-fault" evictions.
rows.output: Ọgbẹni Corbyn ti kede jara awọn atunṣe ile ti o ni oju, pẹlu iṣakoso owo-owo ati opin si “awọn ijiya laisi ẹbi”.
rows.reference: Mr Corbyn ṣe ìkéde èto ilé-gbígbé tí owó rẹ̀ kò ní ga ènìyàn lára, tí yóó sì fí òpin sí à ń lé ayálégbé járe láìtọ́.

rows.source: He also wants to give councils greater powers to build new homes.
rows.output: Ó tún fẹ́ fún àwọn ìgbìmọ̀ agbègbè ní agbára tó pọ̀ sí i láti kọ́ ilé tuntun.
rows.reference: Ó tún fẹ́ fún Kánsù ní agbára ńlá láti kọ́ ilé tuntun.

rows.source: Mrs May said: "Last year I said I would dedicate my premiership to restoring the British dream - that life should be better for each new generation.
rows.output: Ọgbẹni May sọ pé: “Ọdún tó kọjá, mo sọ pé èmi yóò fi gbogbo agbára mi ṣe àṣeyọrí àṣeyọrí mi láti tún àlá Gẹ̀ẹ́sì ṣe—kí ìyè tó dára jù lọ fún ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan àwọn ìran tó ń bọ̀.
rows.reference: Ìyáàfin May sọ wípé: "Ní ọdún tó kọjá mo sọ pé mo má fí àmì ẹ̀yẹ mi ṣàdápadà ìfojúsùn Bírítéènì - pé ìgbésí ayé gbọ́dọ̀ rọrùn fún ọ̀kọ̀ọ̀kan túntun ìran tó ń bọ̀ lẹ́yìn.

rows.source: And that means fixing our broken housing market.
rows.output: Ati pe iyẹn tumọ si atunṣe ọjà ile ti o fọ.
rows.reference: Àtipé ìyẹn túms sí yíyanjú àwọn ọjà ilégèé tó ti dárú.

rows.source: Britain will always be open to people who want to live, work and build a life here.
rows.output: Bírítì yóò máa ṣí sílẹ̀ fún àwọn tó fẹ́ gbé, ṣiṣẹ́, kí wọ́n sì kọ́ ìgbésí ayé níbí.
rows.reference: Bírítéènì máa sábà wà ní ṣíṣí sílẹ̀ fún gbogbo ènìyàn tó bá fẹ́ gbé, ṣiṣẹ́ àti láti to ìgbésí ayé wọn.

rows.source: However, it cannot be right that it is as easy for individuals who don't live in the UK, as well as foreign-based companies, to buy homes as hard-working British residents.
rows.output: Ṣùgbọ́n, kò lè tọ́ nígbà tí ó bá rọrùn fún àwọn tí kò gbé ní UK, àti fún àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ òkèèrè láti ra ilé, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn ará ilé UK ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́ kára?
rows.reference: Ṣíbẹ̀síbẹ̀, kò le jẹ́ wípé ó máa yẹ kí ó rọrùn fún ẹnití kò gbé ní UK, àti bí àwọn ilé iṣẹ́ òkèèrè, láti ra ilé bí àwọn tó tẹpamọ́ṣe tí wọ̀n ṣì jẹ́ olúgbẹ ní Brítèènì.

rows.source: For too many people the dream of home ownership has become all too distant, and the indignity of rough sleeping remains all too real."
rows.output: Fun ọpọlọpọ eniyan, ala ti nini ile ti di jinna pupọ, ati ẹgan ti sùn lori opopona wa ni otitọ.
rows.reference: Fún ogunlọ́gọ̀ ènìyàn, alá níní ilé lórí ti di ohun tí ó jìnnà sí wọn, àtipé àbùkù sísùn kiri jẹ́ ohún tí ó farahàn jùlọ."

rows.source: Jack Ross: 'My ultimate ambition is to manage Scotland'
rows.output: Jack Ross: 'Ìfẹ́ mi tó ga jù lọ ni láti ṣàkóso Scotland'
rows.reference: Jack Ross: “Ohun tí ó jẹ́ àfojúsùn mi gan an ni láti ṣàkóso Scotland’

rows.source: Sunderland boss Jack Ross says his "ultimate ambition" is to become the Scotland manager at some stage.
rows.output: Olùkọ́ni Sunderland Jack Ross sọ pé “àfojúsùn ikẹhin rẹ̀ ni láti di olùkópa ilẹ̀ Scotland ní àkókò kan.”
rows.reference: Ọ̀gá Sunderland, Jack Ross sọ pé “ohun àfojúsùn tó ṣe pàtàkì jú” òun ní láti di alákòóso Scotland ni àwọn àkókò kan.

rows.source: The Scot, 42, is relishing the challenge of reviving the North-East club, who currently sit third place in League One, three points off the top.
rows.output: Ẹ̀ṣọ́ kan tó jẹ́ ọmọ ọdún mẹ́rìnlélógójì [42], ń gbádùn ìpèníjà rẹ̀ láti mú kí ẹgbẹ́ ìdárayá ìhà àríwá-ìlà-oòrùn túbọ̀ lágbára, tí wọ́n wà ní ipò kẹta lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ ní Àpejọ́ Ọkan, mẹ́ta péré lókè àkọ́kọ́.
rows.reference: Awọn Scot, 42, n gbero iṣagbende ẹgbẹ Ariwa-Ila oorun, eyi ti o wa nipo kẹta ninu liigi Akọkọ, koko kẹta ninu atẹ.

rows.source: He moved to the Stadium of Light this summer after guiding St Mirren back to the Scottish Premiership last season.
rows.output: Ó lọ sí Ilé Ìmọ́lẹ̀ ní ìgbà ẹ̀ẹ̀rùn yìí lẹ́yìn tí ó ṣe ìdarí St Mirren padà sí Àkókò Scotland Premiership ní ìgbà tó kọjá.
rows.reference: O lọsi papa iṣere Imọlẹ ni akoko igba oru lẹhin ti o ran St Mirren pada si Premiership ti Scot ni saa to kọja.

rows.source: "I wanted to play for my country as a player.
rows.output: Mo fẹ́ ṣeré fún orílẹ̀-èdè mi gẹ́gẹ́ bí agbábọ́ọ̀lù.
rows.reference: "mo fẹ́ gba bọọlu fún orílẹ̀ èdè mí gẹ́gẹ́ bí eléré ìdárayá.

rows.source: I got a B cap and that was it," Ross told BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
rows.output: Mo gba B fila ati pe iyẹn ni.
rows.reference: Mo gba fila B eyi nikan sini, ‘’Ross sọ fun Sportsound Ilu Scotland ti BBC.

rows.source: "But I grew up watching Scotland at Hampden a lot with my dad as a kid, and it is always something that has drawn me back.
rows.output: Ṣugbọn mo dàgbà tí mo ń wo ilẹ̀ Scotland ní Hampden pẹ̀lú bàbá mi gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọmọdé, ó sì jẹ́ ohun kan tí ó ti fa mi padà nígbà gbogbo.
rows.reference: ’’Ṣugbọn mo dagba ni wiwo ilu Scotland ati Hampden ni ọpọ igba pẹlu baba mi ni kekere mi, ati wi pe eyi jẹ ohun ti o fa mi sẹhin.

rows.source: That opportunity would only come, though, if I am successful in club management."
rows.output: Iyẹn yoo ṣẹlẹ nikan, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé, tí mo bá ṣàṣeyọrí ní iṣakoso ẹgbẹ́.
rows.reference: Iru anfaani bẹẹ yoo waye, bi o tilẹ jẹ pe, bi mo ba yege ninu iṣakoso ẹgbẹ.’’

rows.source: Ross's predecessors as Sunderland manager include Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet and Paulo Di Canio.
rows.output: Awọn baba rẹ ti o ti ṣaju ni olukọni ti Sunderland pẹlu Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet ati Paulo Di Canio.
rows.reference: Awọn aṣaaju Ross gẹgẹbi alakoso Sunderland ni a ti ri Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet ati Paulo Di Canio.

rows.source: The former Alloa Athletic boss says he felt no trepidation in following such established names at such a big club, having previously rejected overtures from Barnsley and Ipswich Town.
rows.output: Ọgbẹni Alloa Athletic tẹlẹ sọ pé kò ní ìbànújẹ́ kankan ní títẹ̀lé orúkọ tó gbajúmọ̀ bẹ́ẹ̀ ní ẹgbẹ́ bọ́ọ̀lù tó tóbi bẹ́ẹ̀, lẹ́yìn tí wọ́n ti kọ̀wé sílẹ̀ fún Barnsley àti Ipswich Town.
rows.reference: Olori Alloa Athletic tẹlẹ ni o sọ pe oun ko ro nipa ifoya nipa titẹle irufẹ awọn orukọ ti o lẹsẹ nilẹ bii awọn ẹgbẹ nla, nigba ti oun ti kọ irufẹ ifimọ nla bẹe tẹlẹ lati Barnsley ati Ilu ipswich.

rows.source: "Success for me at the moment will be gauged by 'can I return this club to the Premier League?'
rows.output: "Ìyọnu fún mi ní báyìí ni láti mọ̀ bóyá mo lè padà sípò àgbàlá?"
rows.reference: ’’Aṣeyọri fun mi ni akoko yii ni a o mọ nipa ‘idapada ẹgbẹ yii si Premier League?’

rows.source: Because of the structure and facilities at this club, it undoubtedly belongs in the Premier League," he said.
rows.output: Nítorí ìṣètò àti àwọn ohun èlò ní ẹgbẹ́ yìí, ó ṣe kedere pé ó yẹ nínú Premier League,” ó sọ.
rows.reference: Nitori agbekalẹ ati awọn ohun elo ni ẹgbẹ yii, laini ariyanjiyan o wa Premier league,’’o wi bẹẹ.

rows.source: "It is not an easy task to get it there, but I would probably only view myself as being successful here if I can get the club back there."
rows.output: "Kò rọrùn fún un láti dé ibẹ̀, ṣùgbọ́n mo máa ń wo ara mi gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹni tí ó ṣeyebíye níbẹ̀ tí mo bá lè dé ẹgbẹ́ náà padà síbẹ̀."
rows.reference: ’’kiiṣe ohun ti o rọrun lati gba nibẹ, ṣugbọn maa kan wo ara mi bi alaṣeyori nibi bi mo bale mu ẹgbẹ pada sibẹ.’’

rows.source: Ross is only three years into his management career, after a period as assistant boss at Dumbarton and a 15-month spell on Hearts' coaching staff.
rows.output: Ross jẹ́ ọdún mẹ́ta nínú iṣẹ́ ìṣàkóso rẹ̀, lẹ́yìn àkókò kan gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀gá àgbà ní Dumbarton àti ọdún mẹ́ẹ̀ẹ́dógún lórí ẹgbẹ́ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ Hearts.
rows.reference: Ọdun mẹta pere ni Ross ṣi ni ni ẹnu iṣẹ iṣakoso rẹ, lehin igba ti o jẹ amugbalẹgbẹ ọga ni Dumbarton ati oṣu marundinlogun gedegbe gẹgẹbi oṣiṣẹ olukọni ni Hearts.

rows.source: He then helped Alloa recover from relegation to the third tier, and transformed St Mirren from the brink of relegation to Championship title winners the following season.
rows.output: Lẹ́yìn náà, ó ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ láti gba ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ kúrò ní ìpele kẹta, ó sì yí St Mirren ká láti etí ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ sí àwọn olùborí àtẹ́lẹwọ́ ní ìgbà tó tẹ̀ lé e.
rows.reference: O wa ran Alloa lọwọ lati kuro ni irẹsilẹ si ipele kẹta wọn, ati imugboro St Mirren kuro ni ipele irẹsilẹ lọsi oye Olubori ni saa ti o tẹle.

rows.source: And Ross says he feels more comfortable now than he ever did during his playing career at Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren and Hamilton Academical.
rows.output: Àti Ross sọ pé inú rẹ̀ dùn báyìí ju bí ó ti rí lọ nígbà tó ń ṣeré fún Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren àti Hamilton Academical.
rows.reference: Bayii Ross ni oun ni ifọkanbalẹ ju tẹlẹ ti oun n gba bọọlu ni Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren ati Hamilton Academical.

rows.source: "It was probably a real crossroads," he recalled, of taking charge of Alloa.
rows.output: "Ó ṣeé ṣe kí ó jẹ́ àkókò pàtàkì," ó rò pé, nípa gbígba àṣẹ fún Alloa.
rows.reference: ’’O jẹ akoko ikorita gan,’’ bi o ti ranti, ti o gba iṣakoso ni Alloa.

rows.source: "I genuinely did believe management was the right fit for me, more so than playing.
rows.output: Mo gbagbọ gidigidi pé iṣakoso ni ìyàtọ̀ tó tọ́ fún mi, ju kí n ṣeré lọ.
rows.reference: ’’Mo gbagbọ pe iṣakoso ni ohun ti o yẹ mi, ju gbigba bọọlu lọ.

rows.source: It sounds bizarre because I did okay, made a reasonable living out of it, and enjoyed some reasonable highs.
rows.output: Ó dà bíi pé kì í ṣe òtítọ́ nítorí pé mo ṣe dáadáa, mo sì ń gbé ìgbé ayé tó tó, mo sì ń gbádùn àwọn òkè tó tó.
rows.reference: O ruju nitori mo ṣe daradara, Kò dùn ùn gbọ́ létí, Mo ṣe dáadáa, mó gbádùn ìgbésí ayé mi nínú rẹ̀, mo si de ipele ti o lapẹrẹ.

rows.source: But playing can be tough.
rows.output: Ṣugbọn ere le nira.
rows.reference: Ṣugbọn bọolu gbígbá nira gan.

rows.source: There are a lot of things you have to get through on a weekly basis.
rows.output: Àwọn nǹkan púpọ̀ ni yóò máa kọjá lọ ní ọ̀sẹ̀ kan.
rows.reference: Ohun pupọ ni o gbọdọ muse ni gbogbo ọsẹ.

rows.source: I still go through that in terms of the stresses and pressure of the job but management just feels right.
rows.output: Mo tun n lọ nipasẹ iyẹn ni awọn ofin ti wahala ati titẹ iṣẹ ṣugbọn iṣakoso kan ni o kan tọ.
rows.reference: Mo ṣi n la awọn ohun wọnyii kọja ni ti irora ati inira ti iṣẹ naa ṣugbọn iṣakoso ni o tọ.

rows.source: I always wanted to manage and now I am doing it, it feels the most comfortable I have been in my own skin throughout my entire adult life."
rows.output: Mo ti fẹ́ràn láti ṣe àkóso, báyìí sì ni mo ń ṣe é, ó máa ń dùn mí gẹ́gẹ́ bí ẹni pé mo wà ní ìtùnú jù lọ nínú aṣọ ara mi ní gbogbo ìgbésí ayé mi gẹ́gẹ́ bí agbalagba.
rows.reference: Mo ti n fẹ lati ṣakoso ṣugbọn bayii mo nṣe bẹẹ, o dun mọ mi bi ẹni pe mo wa ninu awọ mi ni gbogbo igba aye agba mi.’’

rows.source: You can listen to the full interview on Sportsound on Sunday, 30 September, on Radio Scotland between 12:00 and 13:00 BST
rows.output: O le gbọ gbogbo ifọrọwanilẹnuwo naa lori Sportsound ni ọjọ Sundee, 30 Oṣu Kẹsan, lori Redio Scotland laarin 12:00 ati 13:00 BST
rows.reference: O le tẹti si gbogbo ifọrọwanilẹnuwo naa ni kikun ni Sportsound ni ọjọ aiku, 30 oṣu kẹsan, ni Redio Scotland laarin ago 12:00 ati 13:00 BST

rows.source: Perfect time for a pint is 5.30pm on a Saturday, survey finds
rows.output: Àkókò tó péye láti mu pọ́ọ̀tì kan ni 5.30 ìrọ̀lẹ́ ní ọjọ́ Satidee, ìwádìí rí
rows.reference: Akoko ti o daraju lọgan ni 5:30 ọsan ni ọjọ abamẹta, iwaadi ṣawari

rows.source: The summer heatwave has boosted takings for Britain's struggling pubs but heaped more pressure on restaurant chains.
rows.output: Ooru ti o gbona ti mu ki owo ti n wọle pọ si fun awọn ile-ọti ti o n tiraka ni Ilu Gẹẹsi, ṣugbọn o ti fi agbara diẹ sii si awọn pq ounjẹ.
rows.reference: Akoko oru sọma ti ṣe iwuri fun ilakaka Briteni ṣugbọn ti o ko inira pupọ ba isopọ ile ounjẹ.

rows.source: Pub and bar groups saw sales rise 2.7 per cent in July - but takings in restaurants were down 4.8 per cent, figures revealed.
rows.output: Ìfowópamọ́ àti ẹgbẹ́ àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ rí i pé owó wọn pọ̀ sí i ní 2.7 ogorun ní July, ṣùgbọ́n, àwọn ìṣàpẹẹrẹ ní àwọn ilé oúnjẹ dín kù ní 4.8 ogorun, àwọn ìwádìí fi hàn.
rows.reference: Ibi igbafẹ ati ile ọti ni o ri imugbooro itaja ni ida 2.7 ọgọrun ni oṣu keje - ṣugbọn gbigba ti ile ounjẹ ni o walẹ ni ida 4.8 ọgorun, nọmba ni o ṣafihan rẹ.

rows.source: Peter Martin, of business consultancy CGA, which compiled the figures, said: "Continued sunshine and England's longer than expected participation in the World Cup meant July followed a similar pattern to the previous month of June, when pubs were up 2.8 per cent, except that restaurants were hit even harder.
rows.output: Pétérù Mártìnì, tó jẹ́ olùkọ́ni ìṣòwò ní CGA, tó kó àwọn ìṣirò náà jọ, sọ pé: “Ìmọ́lẹ̀ oòrùn tó ń bá a lọ, àti ìkópa Gẹ̀ẹ́sì pẹ́ ju àkókò tó yẹ lọ nínú ìdíje àgbáyé, jẹ́ kí oṣù Keje tẹ̀lé àpẹẹrẹ oṣù kẹfà, nígbà tí ilé oúnjẹ gò
rows.reference: Peter Martin, ti Olugbanilamọran okowo CGA, ti o ṣakopọ afihan naa, sọpe: "Àídáwọ́dúró ìtàná òórùn àti ìkópa England nínú ìdíje Ife Àgbáyé tú gùn ju bí a ti ṣe lérò lọ túmọ̀ sípé Oṣè keje tẹ̀lé ìlànà kanáà bíì ti Oṣù kẹfà tó kọjá lọ, nígbàtí àwọn ilé ìgbafẹ́ lọ sókè dé ìda 2.8 nínú ọgọ́ọ̀rún, àyàfi pé ìkọlù ti àwọn ilé óùnjẹ tún wá pọ̀ jọjọ.

rows.source: The fall of 1.8 per cent in restaurant trading in June just got worse in July.
rows.output: Ìsúnniṣe 1.8 ní oṣù kẹfà ti dín kù ní July.
rows.reference: Ìjáwálẹ̀ ti ìdá 1.8 nínú ọgọ́ọ̀rún nínú ìṣòwò ti ilé óùnjẹ ní Oṣù Kẹfà bẹ̀rẹ̀ síì burú jọjọ síì ní Oṣù keje.

rows.source: Drink-led pubs and bars performed by far the strongest with like-for-likes up more than restaurants were down.
rows.output: Àwọn ilé ìtura àti ilé ìṣeré tí ń ta ọtí ni wọ́n ṣe dáadáa jùlọ, pẹ̀lú àwọn tó jọra tí wọ́n ń pọ̀ sí i ju àwọn ilé ìtura tí wọ́n sọ pé wọ́n ti lọ sílẹ̀.
rows.reference: Àwọn ilé ìgbafẹ́ àti àwọn ilé ọtí fún ohun-mímu ṣe dáradára jùlọ pẹ̀lu bí àfiwé àbájáàde ìṣòwò ṣe ju bí àwọn ilé óùnjẹ ṣe wá lọ.

rows.source: Food-led pubs also suffered in the sun, although not as dramatically as the restaurant operators.
rows.output: Àwọn pápá ìpamọ́ tí wọ́n ń gbé oúnjẹ jáde tún ní ìṣòro ní ìsàlẹ̀ oòrùn, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kì í ṣe bí àwọn tó ń ṣiṣẹ́ oúnjẹ.
rows.reference: Àwọn ilé ìgbafẹ́ ti ohun-jíjẹ náà tún jìyà nínú òórùn, bótilèjẹ́pé kò ṣe pabanbarì tó ti àwọn oníṣòwò ilé itájà.

rows.source: It seems people just wanted to go out for a drink.
rows.output: Ó dà bíi pé àwọn èèyàn kan fẹ́ lọ jáde láti mu ọtí.
rows.reference: Ó dàbí wípé àwọn ènìyàn kàn fẹ́ láti jáde lọ mu nkan ni.

rows.source: Across managed pubs and bars drink sales were up 6.6 per cent for the month, with food down three per cent."

rows.source: Eilidh Doyle will be "voice for athletes" on Scottish Athletics board

rows.source: Eilidh Doyle has been elected to the board of Scottish Athletics as a non-executive director at the governing body's annual general meeting.
rows.output: Eilidh Doyle ti yan si igbimọ ti Scottish Athletics gẹgẹbi oludari ti ko ni ipa ni ipade gbogbogbo lododun ti ara ilu.
rows.reference: Eilidh Doyle ni wọn ti yan si ajọ Awọn Elere Idaraya Scott gẹgẹbi alabojuto ti kiiṣe alaṣẹ ni ipade ọlọdọọdun ẹgbẹ igbimọ.

rows.source: Doyle is Scotland's most decorated track and field athlete and chairman Ian Beattie described the move as a great opportunity for those guiding the sport to benefit from her wide-ranging experience at international level over the past decade.
rows.output: Doyle ni elere idaraya ti o ni ami-ẹri julọ ni Ilu Scotland, ati pe alaga Ian Beattie ṣapejuwe gbigbe naa gẹgẹbi aye nla fun awọn ti n dari ere idaraya lati ni anfani lati iriri rẹ ti o gbooro ni ipele agbaye ni ọdun mẹwa sẹhin.
rows.reference: Doyle jẹ òpòpò ati pápàá idáráyá ti réwá júlọ no ilú Scotland ati wipe alaga ti nse lan Beattie ti se apejuwé rẹ gẹgẹ bi anfaani ńla ńlá fun awọn ton se olutọni sọna fun èrè daraya lati se amulo anfaani iriri ti o tobi julọ ni Ipele agbaye lati bi ọdin mẹwa to koja.

rows.source: "Eilidh has massive respect across the Scottish, UK and world athletics community and we are sure athletics in Scotland would benefit hugely by bringing her on to the board," Beattie said.
rows.output: "Eilidh ní ọlá ńlá kọ́ọ̀kan ní gbogbo ilẹ̀ Scotland, UK àti àwọn ará ayé, àti pé a gbà pé eré ìdárayá ní Scotland yóò túbọ̀ fún un nípa kíkó ọ́ sínú igbimọ̀.”
rows.reference: "Eilidh ni ọlá ti o tobi ni oju ilu Scotland, UK ati awọn awujọ ere-idaraya agbaye ati pe a ni idaniloju pe awọn ere-idaraya ni Scotland yoo ni anfani julọ nipa gbigbe rẹ si igbimọ," Beattie sọ.

rows.source: Doyle said: "I am keen to act as a voice for athletes and I am hoping I can really contribute and help guide the sport in Scotland."
rows.output: Doyle sọ pé: “Mo fẹ́ràn láti ṣiṣẹ́ gẹ́gẹ́ bí ohùn àwọn eléré ìdárayá, mo sì ń retí pé mo lè ṣàkóso dáadáa, kí n sì ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́ láti tọ́jú eré ìdárayá ní Scotland.”

rows.source: However, the advert, which has been published on the firm's Facebook page, has caused controversy online.
rows.output: Báwo ló ṣe rí lára ​​àwọn èèyàn, ìpolówó náà, èyí tí wọ́n ti tẹ̀ jáde lórí ojú-ìwé Facebook ilé iṣẹ́ náà, ti fa ìforígbárí lórí Íńtánẹ́ẹ̀tì.
rows.reference: Sibẹsibẹ, ipolongo naa, eyi ti a ti gbejade lori oju ewe Facebook ti ile-iṣẹ, ti mu ki ariyanjiyan wa ni ayelujara.

rows.source: With 77,000 views and hundreds of comments, the video has received mixed reactions from viewers, with many saying it makes light of the "horrors" of the dairy industry.
rows.output: Pẹlu awọn iwoye 77,000 ati ọgọọgọrun awọn asọye, fidio naa ti gba awọn aati adalu lati ọdọ awọn oluwo, pẹlu ọpọlọpọ ti sọ pe o ṣe awada ti “awọn ibẹru” ti ile-iṣẹ wara.
rows.reference: Pẹlu awọn wiwo 77,000 ati awọn ọgọgọrọ awọn ọrọ, fidio ti gba awọn ikunra alapọ lati awọn oluwo, pẹlu ọpọlọpọ awọn wi pe o jẹ imọlẹ awọn "ibanujẹ" ti ile-iṣẹ alagbata.

rows.source: "Very poor decision using cows to advertise this product.
rows.output: "Ìpinnu tí ó jẹ́ aláìníláárí lílo màlúù láti ṣe ìpolówó ọjà yìí.
rows.reference: ”Ipinnu buburu patapata ni lati lo awọn maalu fun ipolongo ọja yii.

rows.source: Like us they need to get pregnant and give birth in order to produce milk, except their babies are stolen from them within days of giving birth," one wrote.
rows.output: Bí a ṣe ń ṣe, wọ́n nílò láti di ìyàwó àti láti bí ọmọ láti mú ẹ̀jẹ̀ jáde, àmọ́ àwọn ọmọ wọn ni wọ́n jí gbé lọ́sàn-án lẹ́yìn bí wọ́n ti bí ọmọ,” ẹnì kan kọ̀wé.
rows.reference: Gẹgẹbi awa naa wọn nilo lati loyun ki wọn si bimọ fun wọn lati ni wara, ayafi bi wọn ba ji awọn ọmọ wọn lọ laipẹ ọjọ ti wọn bi wọn,”ẹnikan kọ.

rows.source: The Elvie breast pump fits discreetly inside a nursing bra (Elvie/Mother)
rows.output: Ẹ̀rọ ìyọ̀ǹda Elvie wà ní ìkọ̀kọ̀ nínú bọ́ọ̀lù ìyá (Elvie/Mọ́dì)
rows.reference: Ifun ọyan Elvie n kun inu bira iya ti n fun ọmọ lọmu daradara (Elvie/Iya)

rows.source: Another commented: "Understandably traumatic for both mother and baby.
rows.output: Ẹlòmíràn sọ pé: “Nítorí náà, ó jẹ́ ìrora fún ìyá àti ọmọ méjèèjì.
rows.reference: Awọn miiran sọrọ: Iloye iyọnu fun iya ati ọmọ.

rows.source: But yeah why not use them to advertise a breast pump for mothers who get to keep their babies?"
rows.output: Ṣugbọn bẹẹni kilode ti a ko le lo wọn lati ṣe igbega fun fifa ọmu fun awọn iya ti o ni anfani lati pa awọn ọmọ wọn mọ?
rows.reference: Ṣugbọn kilode ti a ko lo wọn lati polongo fun fifun ọyan fun awọn iya ti o n tọju awọn ọmọ wọn?"

rows.source: Someone else added: "Such an out of touch advert."
rows.output: Ẹlòmíràn fi kun: “Ìpolówó tí kò ní ìsopọ̀ pẹ̀lú òtítọ́.
rows.reference: ẹlmiran tun ṣafikun: “Irufẹ ipolongo ailefọwọkan.”

rows.source: Others defended the advert, with one woman admitting that she found the song "hilarious."
rows.output: Àwọn kan dáàbò bo ìpolówó náà, ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn obìnrin sì jẹ́wọ́ pé orin náà “jẹ́ ẹ̀rín.”
rows.reference: Awọn ẹlomiiran kin ipolongo naa lẹhin, pẹlu obirin kan ti o gba pe o ri orin naa "dun leti."

rows.source: "I think this is a genus idea.
rows.output: Mo rò pé èyí jẹ́ ìmọ̀ràn ẹ̀yà kan.
rows.reference: "Mo ro pe eyi jẹ imọran ọlọgbọn.

rows.source: I would've had one if I was still breastfeeding.
rows.output: Tí mo bá ń fún ọmú.
rows.reference: Emi yoo ti ni ọkan ti mo ba n fun ọmọ lọmu.

rows.source: Pumping made me feel exactly like a cow.
rows.output: Ìfọ̀kànbalẹ̀ mú kí n nímọ̀lára bí màlúù.
rows.reference: Fifun jẹ ki n dabi maalu.

rows.source: The advert is a little mad but I took it for what it was.
rows.output: Àwọn ìpolówó náà jẹ́ díẹ̀ láti inú ọkàn ṣùgbọ́n mo gbà á fún ohun tí ó jẹ́.
rows.reference: Ipolongo naa jẹ aṣiwere diẹ ṣugbọn mo gba bi o ti jẹ.

rows.source: This is a genius product," one wrote.
rows.output: Ọja yii jẹ́ ọlọ́gbọ́n-ọlọ́gbọ́n, ọkan sọ.
rows.reference: Eyi jẹ ọja ọlọgbọn,"ọkan kọwe.

rows.source: Another commented: "This is a fun advert aimed at mums who pump (often in their workplaces or toilets) and feel like "cows."
rows.output: Ẹlòmíràn sọ pé: “Ìpolówó yìí jẹ́ ìpolówó aláyọ̀ tí ó ń bá àwọn ìyá tí wọ́n ń fọ́ (nígbà míràn níbi iṣẹ́ tàbí ilé ìwẹ̀) tí wọ́n sì ń rò pé “ẹran ọ̀sìn.”
rows.reference: Awọn miiran sọrọ: “Eyi jẹ ipolongo ẹfẹ fun awọn iya ti on fun (lọpọ igba ni ibi iṣẹ tabi ile igbọnsẹ wọn) ti wọn n ni iriri bi “maalu.”

rows.source: This is not an advert praising or judging the dairy industry."
rows.output: Eyi kii ṣe ipolowo ti n yìn tàbí ṣe ìdájọ́ ilé iṣẹ́ ọ̀rá.
rows.reference: Eyi kiiṣe ipolongo lati morinyin tabi ṣe idajọ fun awọn ile iṣẹ wara.”

rows.source: At the end of the video the group of women reveal they've all been dancing with the discreet pumps tucked in their bras.
rows.output: Ni ipari fidio naa, ẹgbẹ awọn obinrin naa ṣe afihan pe gbogbo wọn ti n jo pẹlu awọn bata ti o rọrun ti a fi pamọ sinu awọn bras wọn.
rows.reference: Ni opin fidio naa ẹgbẹ ti awọn obinrin fi han pe wọn ti wa ni ijó pẹlu awọn ifasoke awọn inu bira wọn.

rows.source: The concept behind the campaign is based on the insight that many women who breast-pump say they feel like cows.
rows.output: Ìmọ̀ràn tó wà lẹ́yìn ìpolongo náà wá láti inú ìmọ̀lára pé ọ̀pọ̀ obìnrin tó ń fún ọmú sọ pé wọ́n máa ń nímọ̀lára pé wọ́n dà bí ẹran.
rows.reference: Erongba lẹhin ipolongo naa da lori imọran pe ọpọlọpọ awọn obirin tí ó ń fun ọyan ni wọn sọ pe ìrírí àwọn dàbí ti maalu.

rows.source: The Elvie Pump however, is completely silent, has no wires or tubes and fits discreetly inside a nursing bra, giving women the freedom to move, hold their babies, and even go out while pumping.
rows.output: Ẹ̀rọ Elvie Pump, sibẹsibẹ, jẹ́ aláìrọ̀rùn, kò ní àwọn ìkọ́kọ́ tàbí àwọn àpò, ó sì lè wọ inú bọ́ọ̀lù ọmọ tí ń fún obìnrin ní òmìnira láti rìn, dìdì ọmọ wọn mú, kí wọ́n sì jáde nígbà tí wọ́n bá ń fọ́.
rows.reference: Awọn Pọmpu Elvie naa, ni ipalọlọ patapata, ko ni awọn waya tabi awọn tubu ati ti o n wọ inu bira pẹlu irọrun, ti o n fun awọn obinrin ni ominira lati lọ kiiri, gbe awọn ọmọ wọn, ati paapaa jade lọ lakoko fifun.

rows.source: Ana Balarin, partner and ECD at Mother commented: "The Elvie Pump is such a revolutionary product that it deserved a bold and provocative launch.
rows.output: Ana Balarin, alabaṣepọ ati Ojogbon Ẹkọ ati Idagbasoke (ECD) ni Iya, sọ pé: “Ẹrọ Elvie Pump jẹ́ ọja tó jẹ́ ìyípadà bẹ́ẹ̀ tí ó tọ́ sí ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àti ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ìkórè.
rows.reference: Ana Balarin, alabaṣepọ ati ECD ni Iya ti sọrọ: "Pọmpu Elvie jẹ iru ohun elo igbalode ti o yẹ ni jijẹ iṣafilọlẹ nla ati titan.

rows.source: By drawing a parallel between expressing women and dairy cows we wanted to put breast pumping and all its challenges in the spotlight, while demonstrating in an entertaining and relatable way the incredible sense of freedom that the new pump will bring.
rows.output: Nipa fifi afiwe laarin fifihan awọn obinrin ati awọn malu wara, a fẹ lati ṣe afihan fifa ọmu ati gbogbo awọn italaya rẹ, lakoko ti a n ṣe afihan ni ọna ti o dun ati ti o le ni oye iyalẹnu ti ominira ti yoo mu wa nipasẹ fifa ọmu tuntun.
rows.reference: Nipasẹ pe o ni afiwe laarin sisọ awọn obinrin ati awọn maalu bi a ṣe fẹ lati fi fifun ọmu ati gbogbo awọn adojukọ rẹ han ni gbangba, lakoko ti o ṣe afihan ni ọna idanilaraya ati ọna ti o ni idiwọn ti ominira ti pọmpu tuntun naa yoo mu wa.

rows.source: This is not the first time the Elvie pump has made the headlines.
rows.output: Ìyẹn kì í ṣe ìgbà àkọ́kọ́ nìyẹn tí Elvie ń ṣe àkópọ̀.
rows.reference: Eyi kiiṣe ni igba akọkọ ti pọmpu Elvie ti ni akọle ninu iroyin.

rows.source: During London Fashion Week, a mother of two appeared on the catwalk for designer Marta Jakubowski while using the product.
rows.output: Nígbà Ìpàdé Aṣọ London, ìyá kan tó ní ọmọ méjì fara hàn ní àtẹ́lẹwọ́ fún oníṣèṣè Marta Jakubowski nígbà tí ó ń lò ọjà náà.
rows.reference: Ni akoko Ọsẹ Oge Lọndọnu, iya ti o ni ọmọ meji han lori afara irin oge fun oniṣẹ oge Marta Jakubowski nigba lilo ọja naa.

rows.source: Hundreds of Migrant Children Quietly Moved to a Tent Camp on the Texas Border
rows.output: Ọgọ́rọ̀ọ̀rún àwọn ọmọ ìgbàanì tí wọ́n ń fìdí múlẹ̀ ni wọ́n ti tún gbé lọ sí àgọ́ ìrìnkiri kan ní àgbègbè Texas
rows.reference: Ọgọgọrun awọn ọmọde ni o ṣilọ si ibudo agọ kan lẹnubode Texas

rows.source: The number of detained migrant children has spiked even though monthly border crossings have remained relatively unchanged, in part because harsh rhetoric and policies introduced by the Trump administration have made it harder to place children with sponsors.
rows.output: Àwọn ọmọ ará òkèèrè tí wọ́n fàṣẹ ọba mú ti pọ̀ sí i, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ìrìn àjò ààlà lọ́sẹ̀ lọ́sẹ̀ ti wà ní ìpamọ́, apá kan nínú ìtànkálẹ̀ àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ ìkórìíra àti ìlànà tí ìjọba Trump ti mú kí ó ṣòro láti fi àwọn ọmọdé sí àwọn ẹni tí wọ́n fẹ
rows.reference: Iye awọn ọmọde ti o ṣilọ ti ṣokunfa bi o tilẹ jẹ igba ẹnu ibode oloṣooṣu ni ko yii pada, ni apakan agbekalẹ ofin iṣejọba Trump t jẹ ki o nira lati mu awọn ọmọ ti awon onigbọwọ.

rows.source: Traditionally, most sponsors have been undocumented immigrants themselves, and have feared jeopardizing their own ability to remain in the country by stepping forward to claim a child.
rows.output: Ní ìtàn, ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn olùpèsè ni àwọn ará òkèèrè tí kò ní àwọn ìwé ìrìnnà, wọ́n sì bẹ̀rù pé kí wọ́n fọwọ́ pàtàkì mú ọmọ kan, kí wọ́n sì ba ànfàní wọn láti wà ní orílẹ̀-èdè náà jẹ́.
rows.reference: Niti ibilẹ, ọpọ awọn onigbọwọ nio jẹ awọn oluṣikiri ti koni akọsilẹ fun ra wọn, ti ẹru ailegbe inu ilu wa fun wọn ti wọn kosi le jade lati sọ pe awọn ni wọn ni ọmọ.

rows.source: The risk increased in June, when federal authorities announced that potential sponsors and other adult members of their households would have to submit fingerprints, and that the data would be shared with immigration authorities.
rows.output: Ìṣòro náà pọ̀ sí i ní Okudu, nígbà tí àwọn aláṣẹ àpapọ̀ kéde pé àwọn tó lè ṣe àtìlẹ́yìn àti àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ àgbà mìíràn ti ilé wọn yóò ní láti fi ìfọ̀rọ̀wérọ̀ wọn hàn, àti pé àwọn data náà yóò pín pẹ̀lú àwọn aláṣẹ ìkọ̀kọ̀.
rows.reference: Ewu yii pọsi ni oṣu kẹfa, nigba ti awọn alaṣẹ ijọba apapọ sọ pe gbogbo onigbọwọ ati awọn agba miiran ni o gbọdọ jade fun idamọ itẹka, ati pe a o pin awọn data naapẹlu awọn oṣiṣẹ alaṣẹ ẹnubode.

rows.source: Last week, Matthew Albence, a senior official with Immigration and Customs Enforcement, testified before Congress that the agency had arrested dozens of people who applied to sponsor unaccompanied minors.
rows.output: Ní ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá, Matthew Albence, tó jẹ́ ọ̀gá àgbà kan nínú Ẹ̀ka Ìpínlẹ̀ àti Àwọn Ètò Ìpínlẹ̀, sọ̀rọ̀ níwájú Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣòfin pé àjọ náà ti mú ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ èèyàn tí wọ́n béèrè láti gbé àwọn ọmọ kékeré tí kò sí níbẹ̀.
rows.reference: Lọsẹ to kọja, Matthew Albence, oṣiṣẹ agba pẹlu ile iṣẹ Ẹnubode ati Aṣọbode, jẹri niwaju Igbimọ pe ibiṣẹ naa ti mu ọpọ eniyan ti o kọwe lati ṣe onigbọwọ awọn ọmọ wẹwẹ ti ẹnikẹni ko tẹle.

rows.source: The agency later confirmed that 70 percent of those arrested did not have prior criminal records.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ náà tẹ́wọ́ gba lẹ́yìn náà pé 70 ogorun àwọn tí wọ́n mú kò ní ìtàn ọ̀daràn kankan tẹ́lẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ile iṣẹ naa ṣjẹri pe ida ọgọrun ninu awọn ti a mu ni koni awọn akọsilẹ ọdaran tẹlẹ.

rows.source: "Close to 80 percent of the individuals that are either sponsors or household members of sponsors are here in the country illegally, and a large chunk of those are criminal aliens.
rows.output: "Ni isunmọ 80 ogorun awọn eniyan ti o jẹ boya awọn onigbowo tabi awọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ ẹbi ti awọn onigbowo ni o wa ni orilẹ-ede naa ni aifọwọyi, ati pe ọpọlọpọ ninu wọn jẹ awọn ajeji ọdaràn."
rows.reference: "O to 80 ninu ida ọgọrun ti awọn ẹni-kọọkan ti o jẹ pe awọn onigbọwọ tabi awọn ọmọ ile ti awọn onigbọwọ wa ni ilu yii lọna aitọ, ati peọpọ wọn ni o jẹ ajoji ọdaran.

rows.source: So we are continuing to pursue those individuals," Mr. Albence said.
rows.output: Nítorí náà, a ń bá a lọ láti lépa àwọn ẹni kọ̀ọ̀kan yẹn,” ọ̀gbẹ́ni Albence sọ.
rows.reference: Nitori naa a ṣi n le awọn irufẹ ẹni bẹẹ,” Arakunrin Albence sọ bẹẹ.

rows.source: Seeking to process the children more quickly, officials introduced new rules that will require some of them to appear in court within a month of being detained, rather than after 60 days, which was the previous standard, according to shelter workers.
rows.output: Ní ìsapá láti mú kí ìmúṣẹ àwọn ọmọ náà yára, àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìjọba mú àwọn òfin tuntun wá tí yóò jẹ́ kí àwọn kan lára ​​wọn hàn ní ilé ẹjọ́ lẹ́yìn oṣù kan tí wọ́n ti mú wọn, dípò oṣù méjì 60 tí ó ti jẹ́ àkókò àtijọ́, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ibùdó
rows.reference: N wa lati ṣoṅa awọn ọmọ naa ni kiakia, awọn oṣiṣẹ ṣe agbekalẹ awọn ofin tuntun ti yoo ni ki awọn kan ninu wọn fi ara han ni ile ẹjọ laarin oṣu kan ti a ti wọn mọle, yatọsi oni ọgọta ọjọ, eyi ti o jẹ aṣa tẹlẹ, bii awọn oṣiṣẹ onile ti wi.

rows.source: Many will appear via video conference call, rather than in person, to plead their case for legal status to an immigration judge.
rows.output: Ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ yóò hàn nípasẹ̀ ìfọ̀rọ̀wérọ̀ àwòrán, kì í ṣe ní ọ̀nà ìbílẹ̀, láti bẹ̀bẹ̀ ẹjọ́ wọn fún ìpìlẹ̀ òfin sí adájọ́ ìjọba.
rows.reference: ọpọ ni yoo farahan ni fidio ajumọ pe, yatọsi onifarahan, lati sọ nipa ẹjọ wọn fun iduro ofin fun adajọ arinrinajo.

rows.source: Those who are deemed ineligible for relief will be swiftly deported.
rows.output: Àwọn tí wọ́n rò pé kò yẹ fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ yóò jìyà ìkọ̀kọ̀.
rows.reference: Awọn ti ko yẹ fun itulara ni a o da pada si ori ede wọn ni kiakia.

rows.source: The longer that children remain in custody, the more likely they are to become anxious or depressed, which can lead to violent outbursts or escape attempts, according to shelter workers and reports that have emerged from the system in recent months.
rows.output: Àwọn ọmọdé tí wọ́n wà ní àtìmọ́lé pẹ́, wọ́n ṣeé ṣe kí wọ́n máa bínú tàbí kí wọ́n rẹ̀wẹ̀sì, èyí sì lè yọrí sí ìkọlù tàbí ìsapá láti sá lọ, gẹ́gẹ́ bí àwọn oṣiṣẹ́ ibùdó àti ìròyìn tí wọ́n ti hàn ní àwọn oṣù tó ṣáájú.
rows.reference: Niwọn bi awọn ọmọ naa baṣe wa ni apamọ, bẹẹ ni ijaya tabi iporuuru yoo jẹ ti wọn, eyi ti o le jasi irukerudo tabi ipinnu ati salọ, gẹgẹbi awọn oniṣẹ ile ti wi ati awọn ijabọ ti o farahan lori ẹrọ ni ou aipẹ.

rows.source: Advocates said those concerns are heightened at a larger facility like Tornillo, where signs that a child is struggling are more likely to be overlooked, because of its size.
rows.output: Àwọn agbẹjọ́rò náà sọ pé àwọn ìṣòro wọ̀nyí ti pọ̀ sí i ní ibi tó tóbi bíi Tornillo, níbi tí àmì pé ọmọdé ń jìyà lè rọrùn láti pàdánù nítorí ìwọ̀n rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Awọn agbẹjọro sọ pe awọn ti o kan maa n saba waye ni awọn ẹwọn bii Tornillo, nibi ti awọn ami pe ọmọ n tiraka ti di afojufo, nitori titobi rẹ.

rows.source: They added that moving children to the tent city without providing enough time to prepare them emotionally or to say goodbye to friends could compound trauma that many are already struggling with.
rows.output: Wọ́n fi àfikún sí i pé kí wọ́n lè rìn àwọn ọmọ lọ sí ìlú àgọ́ láìsí àkókò tó tó láti mú wọn dàgbà ní ọpọlọ tàbí kí wọ́n sọ fún àwọn ọ̀rẹ́ wọn, èyí lè mú kí ìrora tó pọ̀ tó, èyí tó pọ̀ jù nínú wọn.
rows.reference: Wọn ṣafikun pe mimu awọn ọmọde lọsi ilu tẹnti laipese akoko to fun igbaradi wọn fun imọlara tabi ki wọn ki awọn ọrẹ wọn pe o dabọ le jasi iyọnueyi ti ọpọ n dojukọ lọwọ.

rows.source: Syria tells US, French and Turkish 'occupying forces' to withdraw immediately
rows.output: Síṣíà sọ fún àwọn agbófinró AMẸRIKA, Faransé àti Tọ́kì pé kí wọ́n jáde lẹ́sẹkẹsẹ
rows.reference: Siria sọ fun US, Faranse ati Tọki ‘tiogba ilẹ wọn’ lati kuro ni kiakia

rows.source: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Foreign Minister Walid al-Moualem also called on Syrian refugees to come home, even though the country's war is now in its eighth year.
rows.output: Ní ìpàdé Àpapọ̀ Àwọn Orílẹ̀-Èdè, Minisita fún Ọ̀rọ̀ Ìjìnlẹ̀ Walid al-Moualem sọ pé kí àwọn ará ilé Síríà tí wọ́n ń gbé nílẹ̀ òkèèrè padà wá, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé ogun ní Síríà ti wà ní ọdún kẹjọ báyìí.
rows.reference: Ni ibanisọrọ pẹlu Ajọ Apapọ UN, Minisita Ilẹ Okeere Walid al-Moualem tun pe awọn oluwabo ni Syria lati pada wale, bi o tilẹ jẹpe ogun ilu naa wa ni ọdun kẹjọ rẹ.

rows.source: Moualem, who also serves as deputy prime minister, said the foreign forces were on Syrian soil illegally, under the pretext of fighting terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."
rows.output: Moualem, ẹni tí ó tún jẹ́ igbákejì akọ̀wé àkọ́kọ́, sọ pé àwọn agbára òkèèrè wà ní ilẹ̀ Síríà ní ìdààmú, lábẹ́ ìtẹ́lọ́rùn pé wọ́n ń bá àwọn apanilẹ́yìn jà, wọ́n á sì “gbọ́dọ̀ ṣe bẹ́ẹ̀.”
rows.reference: Moualem, ti o tun duro bii igbakeji minisita alakoso pata, sọpe awọn ologun ajeji naa wa ni ori ilẹ Siria ni ọna aitọ, labẹ idinbọn pe wọn n ja lodi si awọn ẹṣin-o-ku, ati “ni a o baja bi o ti tọ.”

rows.source: "They must withdraw immediately and without any conditions," he told the assembly.
rows.output: Wọ́n gbọ́dọ̀ yọkuro lẹ́sẹkẹsẹ àti láìsí ipò kankan,” ó sọ fún àpéjọ náà.
rows.reference: "Wọn gbọdọ kuro lẹsẹkẹsẹ ati laisi idinwọn," o sọ fun ajọ naa.

rows.source: Moualem insisted that the "war on terror is almost over" in Syria, where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011, with millions more uprooted from their homes.
rows.output: Moualem tẹnumọ́ pé “ogun lodi sí ìbànújẹ́ ti fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ parí” ní Síríà, níbi tí ó ti lé ní ọgọ́rùn-ún mẹ́ta [360,000] ènìyàn tí wọ́n ti kú láti ọdún 2011, pẹ̀lú mílíọ̀nù tí wọ́n ti yí kúrò ní ilé wọn.
rows.reference: Moualem tẹnumọ pe "ogun ilodisi idunkoko mọni ti fẹ pari" ni Siria, nibiti awọn eniyan ti o ju 360,000 ti o ti kú niwon 2011, pẹlu awọn milionu ti o ti ṣi kuro ni ibugbe wọn.

rows.source: He said Damascus would continue "fighting this sacred battle until we purge all Syrian territories" of both terror groups and "any illegal foreign presence."
rows.output: Ó sọ pé Dámásìsì yóò máa bá a lọ láti máa gbèjà ìjà náà títí tí a fi lépa gbogbo ilẹ̀ Síríà kúrò nínú ẹgbẹ́ ọmọ ogun méjì yìí àti “ẹ̀yà ọmọ ilẹ̀ òkèèrè kankan tí kò bófin mu.”
rows.reference: O sọ pe Damasku yoo tẹsiwaju "ja ogun mimọ yii titi a o fi mu gbogbo agbegbe Siria" kuro ninu awọn ẹgbẹ idunkoko mọni ati "eyikeyi awọn ajoji."

rows.source: The United States has some 2,000 troops in Syria, mainly training and advising both Kurdish forces and Syrian Arabs opposed to President Bashar al-Assad.
rows.output: Àwọn ìpínlẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà ní àwọn ọmọ ogun tó tó 2,000 ní Síríà, ní pàtàkì fún ìkọ́nilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àti ìṣàkóso fún àwọn ọmọ ogun Kúrdì àti àwọn ọmọ ilẹ̀ Síríà tí kò fẹ́ kí Ààrẹ Bàshár al-Assad jẹ́.
rows.reference: Orilẹ ede Amẹrika ni o ni awọn ẹgbẹ ogun 2,000 ni Siria, ti o wa fun didanilẹkọ ati imọran fun awọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ ogun Kurdish ati Siria ti o jẹ Arabu lati lodi si Aare Bashar al-Assad.

rows.source: France has more than 1,000 troops on the ground in the war-wracked country.
rows.output: Ilẹ̀ Faransé ní àwọn ọmọ ogun tó ju 1,000 lọ ní ilẹ̀ kan tó ń jà.
rows.reference: Faranse ni o ni ẹgbẹrun ọmọ ogun ni ilẹ ni orilẹ-ede ti ogun ti bajẹ.

rows.source: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said the conditions were fine for them to return, and he blamed "some western countries" for "spreading irrational fears" that prompted refugees to stay away.
rows.output: Nípa àwọn ará ìlú tí wọ́n fipá mú, Mowalem sọ pé àwọn ipò dára fún wọn láti padà, ó sì fi ẹ̀sùn kan “àwọn orílẹ̀-èdè ìwọ̀ oòrùn kan” fún “títan ìbẹ̀rù àìmọ̀” tí ó mú kí àwọn ará ìlú má ṣe lọ.
rows.reference: Lori ọrọ awọn oluwa abo nilu miiran, Moualem sọ pe awọn ipo ti o dara wa fun wọn lati pada, o si da "awọn orilẹ-ede iwọ oorun" lẹbi fun "itankale ibẹru aitọ" ti o fa awọn awọn oluwa abo nilu miiran lati ma wale.

rows.source: "We have called upon the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate these returns," he said.
rows.output: "A ti pe agbegbe agbaye ati awọn ajọ alaanu lati jẹ ki awọn ipadabọ wọnyi rọrun," o sọ.
rows.reference: "A ti pe awọn orilẹ-ede agbaye ati awọn ajọ iranlọwọ eniyan lati ṣe iranlọwọ fun awọn atunṣe ipada yii,"bi o ti wi.

rows.source: "They are politicizing what should be a purely humanitarian issue."
rows.output: Wọ́n ń ṣèlúṣe ohun tí ó yẹ kí ó jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ ètò ọrọ̀ ajé.
rows.reference: Wọn n ti ọrọ oṣelu bọ ohun ti o yẹ ki o jẹ ohun iranlọwọ eniyan.”

rows.source: The United States and the European Union have warned that there will be no reconstruction aid for Syria until there is a political agreement between Assad and the opposition to end the war.
rows.output: Àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà àti Ìparapọ̀ Yúróòpù ti kìlọ̀ pé kò sí ìrànlọ́wọ́ ìtọ́jú ohun-ìní fún Síríà títí tí wọ́n á fi dé ìpinnu ìṣèlú láàárín Àsìkò àti àwọn alátakò láti parí ogun náà.
rows.reference: Ilu Amẹrika ati Apapọ Uropu ti kilo wi pe koni si iranwọ atunṣe fun Siria titi di igba ti ifohunṣọkan waye laarin Assad ati alatako lati pari ogun naa.

rows.source: UN diplomats say a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the last major rebel stronghold of Idlib has created an opportunity to press ahead with political talks.
rows.output: Àwọn aṣojú ìjọba orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà sọ pé àdéhùn tuntun tí Rọ́ṣíà àti Tọ́kì ṣe láti dá àgọ́ ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ sílẹ̀ ní agbègbè ìkọ̀kọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀ ìkọ̀kọ̀ �
rows.reference: Awọn aṣoju UN sọ pe adehun kan laipe laarin Ruṣia ati Tọki lati ṣeto agbegbe kan ti o ni idaniloju ni igbẹkẹle imuduro ibi gbigba awọn aṣodisi ijọba ti Idlib ti ṣe ìdásílẹ̀ anfani lati tẹsiwaju pẹlu awọn ibara-ẹni-sọrọ awọn oloṣelu.

rows.source: The Russian-Turkish deal averted a large-scale assault by Russian-backed Syrian forces on the province, where three million people live.
rows.output: Ìpinnu Rọ́ṣíà àti Tọ́kì yìí yẹra fún ìkọlù ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ ọmọ ogun Rọ́ṣíà tí wọ́n ń ṣètìlẹ́yìn fún nípa ìpínlẹ̀ kan tí ẹgbẹẹgbẹ̀rún mẹ́ta ń gbé.
rows.reference: Ajọsọ Ruṣia-Tọki ti ṣamukuro ipani nla lọwọ awọn ọmọ ogun Siria ti Ruṣia kin lẹhin ni ipinlẹ naa, nibiti milionu meta eniyan n gbe.

rows.source: Moualem however stressed that the agreement had "clear deadlines" and expressed hope that military action will target jihadists including fighters from the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, who "will be eradicated."
rows.output: Moualem sì tẹnu mọ́ ọn pé àdéhùn náà ní “àkókò tí ó dájú” ó sì retí pé ìkọlù náà yóò dojú kọ àwọn jìhàdì, títí kan àwọn ológun láti ẹgbẹ́ Nusra Front tó ní ìbáṣepọ̀ pẹ̀lú Al-Qaeda, tí “yóò pa run.”
rows.reference: Moualem sọ pe adehun naa ni "awọn akoko ipari" ati pe o ni ireti pe awọn jagunjagun yoo dojuko awọn ajija ẹsin jihadi pẹlu awọn onija lati ẹgbẹ Nusra ti Al-Qaeda, ti wọn yoo "pa kuro."

rows.source: UN envoy Staffan de Mistura is hoping to soon convene the first meetings of a new committee comprised of government and opposition members to draft a post-war constitution for Syria and pave the way to elections.
rows.output: Ẹni tí ó jẹ́ aṣojú Ìparapọ̀ Àwọn Orílẹ̀-Èdè Nàìjíríà Staffan de Mistura ń retí láti ṣe àpèjọ àkọ́kọ́ ti ẹgbẹ́ tuntun kan tí ó ní àwọn ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ ìjọba àti ìdàrúdàpọ̀ láti kọ ìwé òfin lẹ́yìn ogun fún Síríà àti láti mú ọ̀nà sí ìdìbò.
rows.reference: Aṣoju UN Staffan de Mistura ni ireti lati pe awọn ipade akọkọ ti igbimọ tuntun kan ti o ni ijọba ati awọn ẹgbẹ alatako lati ṣe ipinlẹ ofin fun Siria ati ki o gbe ọna si awọn idibo kalẹ.

rows.source: Moualem laid out conditions for the Syrian government's participation in the committee, saying the panel's work should be restricted "to reviewing the articles of the current constitution," and warned against interference.
rows.output: Moualem ti ṣe alaye awọn ipo fun ikopa ijọba Siria ninu igbimọ naa, o sọ pe iṣẹ igbimọ naa yẹ ki o ni opin “lati ṣe atunyẹwo awọn nkan ti ofin lọwọlọwọ,” o si kilọ lodisi ifọwọyi.
rows.reference: Moualem gbekalẹ awọn ipo fun ilọwọsi ti ijọba Siria ninu igbimọ naa, o sọ pe iṣẹ igbimọ naa yẹ ki o wa ni idiwọn "lati ṣe atunyẹwo awọn iwe ti ofin ti o wa lọwọlọwọ," o si kilo lodi si idasi.

rows.source: Why Trump Will Win a Second Term
rows.output: Kí nìdí tí Trump yóò fi ṣẹ́gun ìdìbò kejì
rows.reference: Idi ti Trump yoo fi wọle ẹlẹkeji

rows.source: By that logic, Mr. Trump would win re-election in 2020 unless, as many liberal viewers are probably hoping, impeachment and scandal end his presidency prematurely.
rows.output: Láti inú ètò yẹn, Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump yóò ṣẹ́gun ìdìbò ààrẹ ní ọdún 2020, àfi bí, gẹ́gẹ́ bí ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn olùkànsí òmìnira ṣe lè rò pé, ìyọnu àti ọ̀rọ̀ ẹ̀gàn yóò mú kí ìjọba rẹ̀ parí kíákíá.
rows.reference: Nipa iṣaro naa, Ọgbẹni Trump yoo tun wọle ni 2020 ayafi, bi awọn ọpọlọpọ oluwo ti ni ireti, ile kuro lori alefa ati ẹgan ba parinijẹ arẹ rẹ laipe.

rows.source: In what would no doubt be "The most dramatic finale of a presidency ever!"
rows.output: Ní ohun tí ó ṣeé ṣe kí ó jẹ́ “Ìparí ìṣàkóso tí ó ní ìdààmú jù lọ lailai!”
rows.reference: Ninu ohun ti ko ni iyemeji "Ipari julọ ti o jẹ ti arẹ kan laelae!"

rows.source: As of now, there are no signs of viewer fatigue.
rows.output: Lọwọlọwọ, ko si ami ti rirẹ oluwo.
rows.reference: Ni bayii, kosi aami isuni oluworan.

rows.source: Since 2014, prime-time ratings have more than doubled to 1.05 million at CNN and nearly tripled to 1.6 million at MSNBC.
rows.output: Lati ọdun 2014, awọn idiyele akoko akoko akoko ti pọ si diẹ sii ju miliọnu kan lọ si CNN ati pe o ti pọ si miliọnu 1.6 ni MSNBC.
rows.reference: Lati ọdun 2014, awọn oṣuwọn akoko ni diẹ ju ilọpo meji si 1.05 milionu ni CNN ati pe o fẹrẹ di mẹta si 1.6 milionu ni MSNBC.

rows.source: Fox News has an average of 2.4 million prime-time viewers, up from 1.7 million four years ago, according to Nielsen, and MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" has topped cable ratings with as many as 3.5 million viewers on major news nights.
rows.output: Ìròyìn Fox ní àárín 2.4 mílíọ̀nù àwọn olùkànsí ìrọ̀lẹ́, pọ̀ sí i láti 1.7 mílíọ̀nù ọdún mẹ́rin sẹ́yìn, gẹ́gẹ́ bí Níelson ṣe sọ, àti pé MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" ti gba àkọsílẹ̀ káàbọ̀ pẹ̀lú 3.5 mílíọ̀nù olùkànsí ní alẹ́ ọjọ́ ìròyìn pàtàkì.
rows.reference: Iroyin Fox ni o ni awọn oluwo ti awọn akoko bi 2.4 milionu, lati ori 1.7 milionu ni ọdun mẹrin sẹyin, ni ibamu si Nielsen, ati MSNBC "Iṣafihan Rakeli Maddow" ti wa loke aworan kebu pẹlu ọpọlọpọ awọn oluwo 3.5 million lori awọn iroyin pataki.

rows.source: "This is a fire that people are being drawn to because it's not something we understand," said Neal Baer, show runner of the ABC drama "Designated Survivor," about a cabinet secretary who becomes president after an attack destroys the Capitol.
rows.output: "Èyí jẹ́ iná tí àwọn èèyàn ń fọkàn tán nítorí pé kì í ṣe nǹkan tí a kò lóye," Neal Baer, olùdarí eré náà "Designated Survivor," nípa ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ kábìnet kan tí ó di ààrẹ lẹ́yìn ìkọlù kan tí ó bà jẹ́ ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin.
rows.reference: "Eyi ni ina ti a ti fa awọn eniyan si nitoripe kiiṣe ohun ti a loye rẹ," ni Neal Baer sọ, olufihan ti ere ABC "Aṣoju Onwalaye," nipa akọwe ile-igbimọ kan ti o di arẹ lẹhin ti ikolu kan pa Olu-ilu run.

rows.source: Nell Scovell, a veteran comedy writer and author of "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," has another theory.
rows.output: Nell Scovell, oníṣọ̀rọ̀ eré ìdárayá tó ní ìrírí àti onkọ̀wé ti “Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys” Club,” ní ìtàn míràn.
rows.reference: Nell Scovell, gbajugbaja onkọwe apanilẹrin ati onkọwe "Ẹya ti o Pani Lẹrin: Ati Awọn Otitọ Diẹ Nipa Yiyọ wọ Ẹgbẹ Ọmọkùnrin Hollywood "," ni tiọri miiran.

rows.source: She remembers a cab ride in Boston before the 2016 election.
rows.output: Ó rántí ìrìn àjò takisí kan ní Boston ṣáájú ìdìbò 2016.
rows.reference: O ranti ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ kan ti o nlo ni Boston ṣaaju idibo ọdun 2016.

rows.source: The driver told her he would be voting for Mr. Trump.
rows.output: Ọkọ ayọkẹlẹ naa sọ fun u pe oun yoo dibo fun Ọgbẹni Trump.
rows.reference: Awakọ naa sọ fun un pe oun yoo dibo fun Ọgbẹni Trump.

rows.source: Why? she asked.
rows.output: Kí nìdí? ó béèrè.
rows.reference: Kí nìdí? o beere.

rows.source: "He said, "Because he makes me laugh,"" Ms. Scovell told me.
rows.output: Ó sọ pé, “Nítorí pé ó máa ń jẹ́ kí n rẹ́rìn-ín,” Ms. Scovell sọ fún mi.
rows.reference: “O sọ pe, “Nitori pe o n mu mi rẹrin,”” Ms. Scovell sọ fun mi.

rows.source: There is entertainment value in the chaos.
rows.output: Iye ere wa ninu ìkà.
rows.reference: Ohun idanilaraya wa ninu Idarudapọ naa.

rows.source: Of course, unlike anything else on TV, the story lines coming out of Washington could determine the future of Roe v. Wade, whether immigrant families can reunite and the health of the global economy.
rows.output: Dajudaju, ko dabi ohunkohun miiran lori tẹlifisiọnu, awọn itan-akọọlẹ ti n bọ lati Washington le pinnu ọjọ iwaju ti Roe v. Wade, boya awọn idile aṣikiri le tun darapọ ati ilera ti eto-ọrọ agbaye.
rows.reference: Dajudaju, yatọsi ohun miiran lori TV, awọn itan ti o n jade lati Washington le pinnu ọjọ iwaju ti Roe v. Wade, boya awọn idile aṣikiri le tun darapọ ati ilera ọrọ aje agbaye.

rows.source: Tuning out is a luxury only the most privileged viewers can afford.
rows.output: Ìyípadà ìfọwọ́kàn jẹ́ ohun kan tí àwọn olùwo tí ó ní ìbàlẹ̀ ọkàn nìkan lè lè.
rows.reference: Iyijade jẹ ohun iyebiye ti awọn oluworan alanfaani kan leni.

rows.source: And yet, it goes beyond being an informed citizen when you find yourself on hour six of watching a panel of experts debate Bob Woodward's use of "deep background" sourcing for his book "Fear," Paul Manafort's $15,000 ostrich-leather bomber jacket ("a garment thick with hubris," The Washington Post said) and the implications of Stormy Daniels's lurid descriptions of Mr. Trump's, um, anatomy.
rows.output: Ati sibẹsibẹ, o kọja jije araalu ti o mọ nigbati o ba rii ararẹ ni wakati mẹfa ti o n wo igbimọ ti awọn amoye ti n jiroro lori lilo Bob Woodward ti "jinle abẹlẹ" orisun fun iwe rẹ "Ibẹru," jaketi ostrich-awọ $15,000 ti Paul Manafort ("aṣọ ti o nipọn pẹlu igberaga," The Washington Post sọ) ati awọn itumọ ti awọn apejuwe ti Stormy Daniels ti Mr. Trump's, um, anatomy.
rows.reference: Sibẹ, o kọja nini oye gẹgẹbi ọmọ onilu nigba ti o ba ba ara rẹ ni ipo wiwo igbimọ ariyanjiyan awọn oloye nipa Bob Woodward ti o lo “ẹkunrẹrẹ ipinlẹ” fun iwe rẹ "Iberu," Paul Manafort $ 15.000 ostrich-leather bomber jaketi ("Aṣọ ti o nipọn pẹlu hubris," Ti Ifiweranṣẹ Washington sọ) ati awọn iṣokunfa ti Stormy Daniels ti ṣe alaye ti Ọgbẹni Trump, um, ẹkọ ẹya ara.

rows.source: I, for one, will never look at Super Mario the same way again.
rows.output: Mo, fún ọ̀kan, kò ní wo Super Mario ní ìgbà kan náà.
rows.reference: Emi, gẹgẹbi ẹnikan, kii yoo wo Super Mario ni ọna kanna mọ.

rows.source: "Part of what he's doing that makes it feel like a reality show is that he is feeding you something every night," said Brent Montgomery, chief executive of Wheelhouse Entertainment and the creator of "Pawn Stars," about the Trump show's rotating cast and daily plot twists (picking a fight with the N.F.L., praising Kim Jong-un).
rows.output: "Ẹ̀ka kan ti ohun tí ó ń ṣe tí ó mú kí ó dà bí eré ìtàgé ni pé ó ń fún ọ ní nǹkan ní gbogbo alẹ́," ni Brent Montgomery, olùdarí ilé-iṣẹ́ Wheelhouse Entertainment tí ó dá "Pawn Stars," nípa ìtàgé Trump tí ń yí padà àti ìyípadà ìtàn ojoojúmọ́ (tí ń bá N.F.L. ja, tí ó ń yìn Kim Jong-un).
rows.reference: ”Lara ohun ti o n ṣe ti o fi dabi ẹni pe otitọ ni pe o n fun ọ ni nnkankan ni gbogbo aṣalẹ,” Brent Montgomery ni o sọ bẹẹ, alakoso agba ti Ere Idaraya Wheelhouse ati oluṣẹdati “Pawn Stars,”nipa olukopa iyikiri afihan Trump ati ipinnu yiyi ojoojumọ (nini ija pẹlu N.F.L.,yinyin Kim Jong-un).

rows.source: You can't afford to miss one episode or you're left behind.
rows.output: Ti o ko ba le farada lati padanu iṣẹlẹ kan, iwọ yoo fi silẹ ni ẹhin.
rows.reference: O le fẹ lati padanu ẹpisodu kan aijẹbẹ, wa wa lehin ni.

rows.source: When I reached Mr. Fleiss this week, it was a sunny 80 degrees outside his home on the north shore of Kauai, but he was holed up inside watching MSNBC while recording CNN.
rows.output: Nígbà tí mo dé Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Fleiss ní ọ̀sẹ̀ yìí, ó jẹ́ 80 ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n oòrùn níta ilé rẹ̀ ní etí òkun àríwá Kauai, ṣùgbọ́n ó wà nínú ilé rẹ̀ tí ó ń wo MSNBC nígbà tí ó ń kọ CNN.
rows.reference: Nigba ti mo de ọdọ Arakunrin Fleiss ni ọsẹ yii, o jẹ akoko oorun oni 80 digiri nita ile rẹ ni eti odo ariwa ti Kauai, ṣugbọn n ṣe lo ranju mọ wiwo MSNBC nigba ti o n rẹkọdu CNN.

rows.source: He couldn't peel himself away, not with Brett Kavanaugh set to face the Senate Judiciary Committee and the future of the Supreme Court hanging in the balance.
rows.output: Ó kò lè yàtọ̀ sí ara rẹ̀, kì í ṣe pẹ̀lú Brett Kavanaugh tí ń dojú kọ́ Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìmúrasílẹ̀ Sẹ́nétọ̀ àti ọjọ́ iwájú Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jù Lọ tí ó wà nínú ewu.
rows.reference: Kole ya ara rẹ kuro, kiiṣe pẹlu Brett Kavanaugh ti o fẹ kọju ẹgbẹ igbimọ aṣofin ati ọjọ iwaju Ile ẹjọ ti o ṣi wa nibẹ.

rows.source: "I remember when we were doing all those crazy shows back in the day and people said, "This is the beginning of the end of Western civilization,"" Mr. Fleiss told me.
rows.output: Mo rántí nígbà tí a ń ṣe àwọn ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ àwọn èèyàn wọ̀nyí sọ pé, “Èyí ni ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ òpin ìlú Ìwọ̀-Oòrùn.”
rows.reference: "Mo ranti nigba ti a ṣe gbogbo awọn afihan aṣiwere wọnyi latijọ ti awọn eniyan sọ pe,"Eyi ni ibẹrẹ ti opin ọlaju ila oorun, "" Arakunrin Fleiss sọ fun mi.

rows.source: "I thought it was sort of a joke, but it turns out they were right."
rows.output: Mo rò pé ó jẹ́ irú ẹ̀rín, ṣùgbọ́n ó dà bíi pé wọ́n tọ́.
rows.reference: "Mo ro pe o jẹ irufẹ yẹyẹ, ṣugbọn o wa jasi otitọ."

rows.source: Amy Chozick, a writer at large for The Times covering business, politics and media, is the author of the memoir "Chasing Hillary."
rows.output: Amy Chozick, onkọwe fun The Times ti o n bo iṣowo, iṣelu ati media, ni onkọwe ti iwe-iranti "Chasing Hillary."
rows.reference: Amy Chozick, onkọwe kan ti o salọ ti nkọ nipa òwò, oṣelu ati awọn midia ni Times, ni onkọwe ti akọsilẹ "Lílé Hillary."

rows.source: Outside money floods into tightest midterm election House races
rows.output: Àwọn owó ńlá ń wọ inú ìdíje ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin àárín àkókò tó kún fún ìdíje
rows.reference: Lati ita ni owo ti maa n ṣan wa fun ere ije ibo Ile ti o le

rows.source: It's not surprising that Pennsylvania's 17th is seeing a flood of cash, thanks to a realignment of a congressional districts that landed two incumbents in a race for the same seat.
rows.output: Kò ṣòro fún Pennsylvania's 17th láti rí owó tí ń bọ̀, nítorí ìyípadà àwọn ìpínlẹ̀ ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tó fi àwọn méjì tí wọ́n wà nípò ààrẹ sínú eré ìje fún àga kan náà.
rows.reference: Kiiṣe iyanilẹnu pe Pennsylvania ipo 17th n ri iṣan omi owo, ọpẹ lọwọ apapọ ile igbimọ ẹkun ti o ni awọn oloṣelu ti o tun pada wa lẹẹkeji fun ere ije ijoko kan naa.

rows.source: This recently redrawn suburban Pittsburg district pits Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - who won his seat in another district in a special election last spring.
rows.output: Ìpínlẹ̀ ìjọba ìbílẹ̀ tí a tún ṣe láìpẹ́ yìí ń fi ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú Démọ́kúrátì, Rep. Conor Lamb, tí ó ṣẹ́gun àtẹ̀jáde rẹ̀ nínú ìdìbò pàtàkì kan ní ìgbà ìkẹta.
rows.reference: Eyi laipe ni igberiko ilu ẹkun Pittsburg pits Democrat Aṣoju Conor Lamb - eni ti o gba ijoko rẹ ni agbegbe miiran ni idibo pataki ni igba ojo ti o kọja.

rows.source: Lamb is running against another incumbent, Republican Keith Rothfus, who currently represents the old Pennsylvania 12th district, which overlaps heavily with the new 17th.
rows.output: Àwọn ewúrẹ́ máa ń sáré lòdì sí alákòóso mìíràn, Olóṣèlú Keith Rothfus, tó ń ṣojú fún ìjọba Pennsylvania 12th tó ti kọjá, tó ń bá àgbègbè tuntun 17th mu.
rows.reference: Lamb n dije pẹlu ẹlomiran, Republikani Keith Rothfus, ti o ṣe aṣoju agbegbe ẹkun Pennsylvania 12th, eyi ti o sunle pupọ pẹlu titun 17th.

rows.source: The maps were redrawn after the Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled in January that the old districts were unconstitutionally gerrymandered in Republicans' favor.
rows.output: Àwọn maapu náà ni a tún ṣe lẹ́yìn tí Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jù Lọ ti Pennsylvania rí ní January pé àwọn ìpínlẹ̀ àtijọ́ ti jẹ́ aláìṣe ìjọba ní ìfọwọ́sí àwọn Olóṣèlú.
rows.reference: Awọn maapu naa ni atunya lẹhin igbimọ ile-ẹjọ Pennsylvania ti o dajọ ni oṣu kini pe awọn agbegbe atijọ ni ko tọna labẹ ofin ti o si jẹ ojurere fun awọn Republikani.

rows.source: The race in the new 17th has touched off a campaign finance slugfest between the major party finance arms, the Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) and the National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).
rows.output: Ìdárayá nínú 17th tuntun ti bẹ̀rẹ̀ ìforígbárí ìnáwó ìpolongo láàárín àwọn ẹgbẹ́ ìpolongo pàtàkì, Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìpolongo Democratic Congressional Committee (DCCC) àti Ìgbìmọ̀ Ìpolongo National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).
rows.reference: Ere ije ti o wa ni 17th titun ni o ti fi ọwọ kan owo ipolongo ibo laarin awọn ẹgbẹ iṣowo pataki, Igbimọ ti Ipolongo Idibo Ile Aṣofin Democrati (DCCC) ati Igbimọ Ile-iṣẹ ti Ipolongo Idibo National Republikani (NRCC).

rows.source: Lamb became a familiar name in Pennsylvania after a narrow win in a widely watched in March special election for Pennsylvania's 18th Congressional District.
rows.output: Lamb di orukọ ti o mọ ni Pennsylvania lẹhin iṣẹgun kekere kan ninu idibo pataki ti o gbajumọ ni Oṣu Kẹta fun agbegbe 18th ti Pennsylvania.
rows.reference: Lamb di orukọ olokiki ni Pennsylvania lẹhin ijawebori lọna kiun ni eyi ti ọpọ wo ni ibo oṣu kẹta ninu idibo akanṣe fun Pennsylvania ni 18th Ẹkun Idibo Ile Igbimọ

rows.source: That seat had been held by a Republican for over a decade, and President Donald Trump won the district by 20 points.
rows.output: Ìjọba yẹn ti jẹ́ ti Olóṣèlú kan fún ogún ọdún, àti Ààrẹ Donald Trump gba ìpínlẹ̀ yẹn ní 20 àwọn ìpín.
rows.reference: Ijoko yii ni Republikani wa tẹlẹ fun bi ọdun mẹwa, ti Aarẹ Donald Trump jawe bori ni ẹkun rẹ pẹlu ogun koko.

rows.source: Political pundits have given Democrats a slight edge.
rows.output: Àwọn olókìkí ìṣèlú ti fún àwọn Dimọ́kùràtì ní ẹ̀dọ̀fóró díẹ̀.
rows.reference: Awọn olumọran nipa oṣelu ti fun Democrati ni ilọwaju diẹ.

rows.source: U.S. Weighed Penalizing El Salvador Over Support for China, Then Backed Off
rows.output: Àwọn ìpinnu U.S. Léèrè ìyà fún El Salvador nítorí ìtìlẹ́yìn fún Ṣáínà, lẹ́yìn náà, ó yára yára
rows.reference: Amẹrika Idiwọn ifiyajẹni El Salvador Nipa Ikilẹhin fun China, Wọn Wa Pehinda

rows.source: Diplomats noted that the Dominican Republic and Panama had already recognized Beijing, with little pushback from Washington.
rows.output: Àwọn aṣojú náà ṣàkíyèsí pé Orílẹ̀-èdè Olómìnira Dominican àti Panama ti mọ̀ Beijing tẹ́lẹ̀, pẹ̀lú ìdààmú díẹ̀ láti ọ̀dọ̀ Washington.
rows.reference: Awọn aṣoju ilu ti woye pe Ilẹ Olominira ti Dominican ati Panama ti fontẹlu Beijing, pẹlu ipadasẹhin diẹ lọdọ Washington.

rows.source: Mr. Trump had a warm meeting with President Juan Carlos Varela of Panama in June 2017 and had a hotel in Panama until partners evicted the Trump Organization's management team.
rows.output: Ọgbẹni Trump ní ìpàdé ìfẹ́ni pẹ̀lú Ààrẹ Juan Carlos Varela ti Panama ní Okudu 2017, ó sì ní ilé ìtura kan ní Panama títí tí àwọn alájọṣepọ̀ fi lé ẹgbẹ́ ìṣàkóso Trump kúrò.
rows.reference: Arakunrin Trump ni ipade ti o dara pẹlu Aare Juan Carlos Varela ti Panama ni oṣu kẹfa 2017 ati pe o ni otẹẹli ni Panama titi awọn alabaṣiṣẹpọ le ẹgbẹ isakoso Igbimọ Trump jade.

rows.source: State Department officials decided to call back the American chiefs of diplomatic missions from El Salvador, the Dominican Republic and Panama over the "recent decisions to no longer recognize Taiwan," Heather Nauert, the department's spokeswoman, said in a statement early this month.
rows.output: Àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ilé iṣẹ́ ìjọba ilẹ̀ Amẹ́ríkà pinnu láti pè àwọn olórí ìjọba wọn padà láti El Salvador, Jamani Dominican, àti Panama nítorí “àwọn ìpinnu tuntun láti kọ́ Taiwan sílẹ̀,” Heather Nauert, agbẹnusọ ilé iṣẹ́ náà sọ ní ìpàdé kan ní ìbẹ̀rẹ̀ oṣù yìí.
rows.reference: Awọn aṣoju Ile-iṣẹ Ipinle pinnu lati pe awọn olori Amẹrika ti awọn aṣoju ilu lokeere lati El Salvador, Ilẹ Olominira Dominika ati Panama lori awọn "ipinnu lati ma ṣadamọ Taiwan," Heather Nauert, agbọrọsọ ile-iṣẹ naa, sọ ninu ọrọ kan ni ibẹrẹ osù yii.

rows.source: But penalties were only considered against El Salvador, which received an estimated $140 million in American aid in 2017, including for narcotics controls, development and economic support.
rows.output: Ṣugbọn awọn ijiya ni a ka si lodi si El Salvador, eyiti o gba to $ 140 million ni iranlọwọ Amẹrika ni ọdun 2017, pẹlu fun iṣakoso oogun, idagbasoke, ati atilẹyin eto-ọrọ.
rows.reference: Ṣugbọn awọn ijiya ni a kà fun El Salivador nikan, ti o gba iranwọ owo $140milionu Amẹrika ni ọdun 2017, pẹlu fun iṣakoso awọn egbogi oloro, idagbasoke ati atilẹyin aje.

rows.source: The proposed penalties, which included cuts to financial aid and targeted visa restrictions, would have been painful for the Central American country and its high unemployment and murder rates.
rows.output: Àwọn ìyàtọ̀ tí a pinnu, tí ó ní àwọn dínkù owó ìrànwọ́ owó àti ìdènà ìwé ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀, yóò ti jẹ́ ìrora fún orílẹ̀-èdè ará àríwá àríwá àti ìwọ̀n ìdààmú àti ìpànìyàn rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Awọn ijiya ti a pinnu naa, eyi ti o wa pe kosi iranwo owo ati awọn idiwọn ifọwọsi iwe irin-ajo, ibatijẹ irora fun orilẹ-ede Amẹrika Aarin naa ati awọn ainiṣẹ ti o pọ ati awọn ipaniyan ti o ga.

rows.source: As internal meetings progressed, North American and Central American officials postponed a high-level conference focused on security and economic prosperity to follow up a similar gathering last year that was seen as a step forward in efforts to prevent migrants from heading to the United States.
rows.output: Bi awọn ipade inu ile ti n lọ lọwọ, awọn oṣiṣẹ lati Ariwa ati Central America ti sun siwaju apejọ giga ti o dojukọ aabo ati aisiki eto-ọrọ lati tẹle apejọ ti o jọra ni ọdun to kọja, eyiti a rii gẹgẹ bi ilọsiwaju ninu awọn akitiyan lati dena awọn aṣikiri lati lọ si Amẹrika.
rows.reference: Bi awọn ipade ti ilọsiwaju ikọkọ ti n lọ lọwọ, Awọn oṣiṣẹ Ariwa Amẹrika ati Amẹrika Aarin ti fi isunsiwaju si apejọ ti o gaju lori aabo ati ọrọ aje lati tẹle iru apejọ kanna ni ọdun to koja ti a ti ri bi igbesẹ siwaju ni awọn igbiyanju lati dena wiwọle awọn arinrin-ajo si Amẹrika.

rows.source: But by mid-September, top administration officials made clear that they wanted the conference to go forward, effectively ending any consideration of penalties for El Salvador.
rows.output: Ṣugbọn ni aarin-Oṣu Kẹsan, awọn oṣiṣẹ pataki ti iṣakoso naa sọ pe wọn fẹ ki apejọ naa tẹsiwaju, eyiti o jẹ ki eyikeyi akiyesi ti awọn ijiya fun El Salvador.
rows.reference: Ṣugbọn ni aarin oṣu Kẹsan, awọn olori ile iṣakoso sọ kedere pe wọn fẹ apero naa lati tẹsiwaju, ni fifi opin si ijiya fun El Salivador.

rows.source: Vice President Mike Pence is now slated to address the conference, now scheduled for mid-October, in a signal of the import the administration places on the gathering, the diplomats said.
rows.output: Ìgbakeji Ààrẹ Mike Pence yóò sọ̀rọ̀ níbi ìpàdé yìí, tí wọ́n ti ṣètò fún àárín Oṣù Kẹwàá, ní fífi hàn pé pàtàkì tó fún ìjọba láti pàdé yìí, nígbà tí àwọn aṣojú náà sọ.
rows.reference: Igbakeji Aarẹ, Mike Pence ti wa bayi lati ba apejọ sọrọ, eyi ti a ṣeto fun aarin-oṣu kẹwa, ni ifihan pataki ti iṣakoso gbele apejọ naa, awọn aṣoju ni o sọ bẹẹ.

rows.source: And the three American envoys quietly returned to El Salvador, Panama and the Dominican Republic with no new tough messages or punishments from Washington.
rows.output: Àwọn aṣojú Amẹ́ríkà mẹ́ta náà padà sẹ́yìn ní ìdákẹ́jẹ́ẹ́ sí El Salvador, Panama, àti Jamani, láìsí ìsọ̀rọ̀ tuntun tàbí ìyàwó láti Washington.
rows.reference: Awọn aṣoju Amẹrika mẹta tun pada si El Salvador, Panama ati Ilẹ Olominira Dominican kẹlẹkẹlẹ laisi awọn ifiranṣẹ tabi awọn ijiya titun lati Washington.

rows.source: A White House spokesman for Mr. Bolton declined to comment on the details of the debate that were described by the three American officials, including two diplomats, who agreed to discuss the internal deliberations on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: Ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn aṣojú ilé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin fún Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Bolton kọ̀ láti sọ̀rọ̀ lórí àlàyé ìjíròrò náà tí àwọn ọ̀dọ́ mẹ́ta ti sọ, títí kan àwọn aṣojú méjì, tí wọ́n gba láti jíròrò àwọn ìgbìyànjú inú ilé náà lórí ìdánimọ̀.
rows.reference: Agbẹnusọ White House kan fun Ọgbẹni Boltonkọ lati ṣe alaye lori awọn ariyanjiyan ti awọn alakoso Amẹrika mẹta ṣe alaye, pẹlu awọn aṣoju meji, ti wọn gba lati jiroro lori awọn igbimọ ti inu ni ibamu si àìdánimọ.

rows.source: Their accounts were corroborated by an outside analyst who is close to the administration and also spoke on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: Àwọn ìtàn wọn jẹ́ ìdánilójú nipasẹ́ olùṣàkóso òde, ẹni tí ó wà nítòsí ìṣàkóso náà, tí ó sì sọ̀rọ̀ ní ipò àìmọ̀.
rows.reference: Awọn akọọlẹ wọn ni alatupalẹ lati ita kinlẹhin, ẹni ti o sunmọ iṣakoso naa ti o tun sọ ni ipo àìdánimọ.

rows.source: Study History
rows.output: Kọ́wé Ìtàn
rows.reference: Ka Itan

rows.source: The next shoe to drop could be the special counsel Robert Mueller's report on Mr. Trump's possible obstruction of justice, of which there now is very substantial evidence in the public record.
rows.output: Ẹni tó tẹ̀ lé e lẹ́yìn náà lè jẹ́ ìròyìn pàtàkì Robert Mueller lórí àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump lè ṣe láti dènà ìdájọ́, níbi tí ẹ̀rí tó pọ̀ gan-an ti wà nínú àkọsílẹ̀ àwọn aráàlú.
rows.reference: Bata ti o kan lati mulẹ ni ijabọ lori ida-ofin duro Arakunrin Trump ti agbaninimọran akanṣe Robert Mueller ṣe, eyi ti o ni awọn ẹri ti o rinlẹ ni awujọ.

rows.source: Mr. Mueller is reportedly also turning his investigation to whether Mr. Trump's campaign colluded with Russia in its attack on our elections.
rows.output: Ọgbẹni Mueller ni a sọ pe o tun n ṣe iwadii boya ipolongo Ọgbẹni Trump ṣe ifowosowopo pẹlu Russia ninu ikọlu rẹ si awọn idibo wa.
rows.reference: Arakunrin Mueller tun n ṣewadi boya ipolongo ibo Arakunrin Trump kọlu Rọṣia ni ti ikọlu rẹ si idibo wa.

rows.source: Should Congress change hands, Mr. Trump will find himself facing accountability in that body, just as he prepares to go again before the voters, and perhaps eventually a jury of his peers.
rows.output: Ti Ile-igbimọ Aṣofin ba yipada, Ọgbẹni Trump yoo rii ara rẹ ti o dojukọ iṣiro ninu ara rẹ, bi o ṣe n mura lati tun ṣe niwaju awọn oludibo, ati boya nikẹhin ẹgbẹ awọn ẹlẹgbẹ rẹ.
rows.reference: Bi ayipada ba wa ni ile igbimọ, Arakunrin Trump yoo ri pe oun ni idojukọ nipa ijabọ owo nibẹ, bi o ti tun fẹ ṣe lati dojukọ awọn oludibo, paapaa awọn adajọ ẹgbẹ rẹ.

rows.source: That is a lot of ifs, and I do not mean to suggest that Mr. Trump's fall is inevitable - nor that of his equivalents in Europe.
rows.output: Iyẹn jẹ ọpọlọpọ awọn bọtini, ati pe Emi ko tumọ lati daba pe idinku Ọgbẹni Trump jẹ dandan - tabi ti awọn deede rẹ ni Yuroopu.
rows.reference: Iyẹn jẹ ọpọ boya, emi o wa fẹ sọ pe iṣubu Arakunrin Trump daju – tabi ti ojugba rẹ ni Uropu.

rows.source: There are choices to be made by all of us on both sides of the Atlantic that will affect how prolonged the struggle may be.
rows.output: Àwọn yíyàn láti ṣe fún gbogbo wa lórí ìhà méjèèjì Òkun Atlantíkì yóò nípa lórí bí ìforígbárí náà ṣe pẹ́ tó.
rows.reference: Yiyan wa fun gbogbo wa ni oju mejeji ti Okun eyi ti o le sọ bi akitiyan naa ṣe le pẹ to.

rows.source: In 1938, German officers were ready to stage a coup d"état against Hitler, if only the West had resisted him and backed the Czechoslovaks at Munich.
rows.output: Ni ọdun 1938, awọn ọmọ ogun Jamani ti ṣetan lati ṣe ifipabanilopo lodi si Hitler, ti Iwọ-oorun ba ti koju rẹ ati ki o ṣe atilẹyin fun awọn Czechoslovaks ni Munich.
rows.reference: Ni 1938, awọn oṣiṣẹ Jamani ṣetan lati gba ijọba lọwọ Hitler, iyẹn bi o jẹpe awọn ila oorun ba ṣodi si ti wọn si kin Czechoslovaks ni Munich lẹhin.

rows.source: We failed, and missed an opportunity to avoid the years of carnage that ensued.
rows.output: A kuna, a si padanu anfani lati yago fun awọn ọdun ti ipaniyan ti o tẹle.
rows.reference: A kuna, a si padanu anfaani lati dẹkun ado olori ọdun naa ti o tẹle.

rows.source: The course of history pivots around such inflection points, and democracy's inexorable march is accelerated or delayed.
rows.output: Ìtàn ìtàn yí padà ní àwọn ibi tí ó ṣe pàtàkì bẹ́ẹ̀, àti pé ìjọba tiwantiwa, tí kò lè dákẹ́, yára yára tàbí dúró sílẹ̀.
rows.reference: Itan wa yika iṣẹlẹ yii, iṣejọba ara ẹni ni o lọsiwaju tabi fa sẹhin.

rows.source: Americans face several of these inflection points now.
rows.output: Àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà dojú kọ ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn ibi tí wọ́n ti lè yí padà báyìí.
rows.reference: Awọn Amẹrika wa ni idojukọ asawọ koko yii bayii.

rows.source: What will we do if Mr. Trump fires Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein, the man who controls the fate of Mr. Mueller's investigation?
rows.output: Kí ni a ó ṣe tí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump bá lé Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Rod Rosenstein, tó ń ṣàkóso ìgbọ́kànlé àyẹ̀wò Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Mueller?
rows.reference: Kini ohun ti a o ṣe bi Arakunrin Trump ba da Igbakeji Agbẹjọro Gbogboogbo Rod Rosenstein duro, ẹni ti o n ṣakoso ayanmọ iwaadi Arakunrin Mueller?

rows.source: Rosenstein has been in hot water ever since this paper reported that, last year, he suggested secretly recording the president and speculated about his being unfit for office.
rows.output: Ìwọ̀nba rẹ̀ ti wà nínú omi gbigbona láti ìgbà tí ìwé yìí ròyìn pé, ní ọdún tó kọjá, ó rò pé kí wọ́n fara balẹ̀ gbé àkọsílẹ̀ ààrẹ náà jáde, ó sì ń ṣe àwọn àfihàn nípa ìdánilójú rẹ̀ láti ṣe ìṣàkóso.
rows.reference: Rosenstein ti wa ninu iyọnu lati igba ti akọsilẹ yii ti jabọ pe, lọdun to kọja, o gbohun aarẹ silẹ nikọkọ ti o sọ nip ape oun o peye lati tẹsiwaju lẹnu iṣẹǝ.

rows.source: Mr. Rosenstein says The Times's account is inaccurate.
rows.output: Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Rọ́ṣénṣtẹ́in sọ pé àkọsílẹ̀ Ìwé Ìròyìn náà kò tọ̀nà.
rows.reference: Arakunrin Rosenstein wi pe akọọlẹ Times naa ko koju-oṣuwọn.

rows.source: "How will we respond if the newly requested F.B.I. investigation of Brett Kavanaugh is not full or fair - or if he is confirmed to the Supreme Court despite credible accusations of sexual assault and dishonest testimony?
rows.output: Báwo ni yóò ṣe rí lára ​​wa nígbà tí ìwádìí tuntun tí F.B.I. béèrè nípa Brett Kavanaugh kò pé tàbí tó tọ́—tàbí tí wọ́n bá fọwọ́ sí i lórí Ilé Ẹjọ́ Gíga Jù Lọ nípa ẹ̀sùn ìfipábánilòpọ̀ tí ó dájú àti ẹ̀rí ẹ̀tanú?
rows.reference: "Báwo ni a ṣe máa fèsì tí ìwádìí túntun tí F.B.I bèèrè fún lórí Brett Kavanaugh kò bá kún tó tàbí tí ó bá ṣègbè - tàbí tí ìwádìí náà bá ṣàfomọ́ rẹ̀ fún Ilé Ẹjọ́ tó ga jùlọ láìwo bí àwọn ẹ̀sùn ìfipabánilòpọ̀ àti ìjẹ́rìí èkè ṣe wúwo sí?

rows.source: And above all, will we vote in the midterms for a Congress that will hold Mr. Trump accountable?
rows.output: Àpapọ̀, ṣé a ó dìbò fún Ìgbìmọ̀ Aṣòfin kan tó máa dájọ́ Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump?
rows.reference: Ní pàtàkì jùlọ, ńjẹ́ a máa ìbò ní ìdìbò tó ń bọ̀ fún Ìlé ìgbìmọ̀ aṣòfin tí ó máa mú kí Ọ̀gbẹ́ni Trump tẹ̀lé ìlànà tí òfin là kalẹ̀?
