rows.source: Europe clinches Ryder Cup victory in Paris
rows.output: Yuroopu gba ife eya Ryder Cup ni ilu Paris
rows.reference: Ọmọ Úróópù ló borí ní ìdíje ti Ryder ní Paris

rows.source: Team Europe has won the 2018 Ryder Cup defeating Team USA by a final score of 16.5 to 10.5 at Le Golf National outside Paris, France.
rows.output: Ẹgbẹ́ Yúróòpù ti ṣẹ́gun Ìdíje Ryder 2018, nípa ṣíṣe ìṣirò ikẹhin ti 16.5 sí 10.5 ní Le Golf National lóde Paris, Faranse.
rows.reference: Àwọn ẹgbẹ́ tí wọ́n wá láti Úróópù ná àwọn ẹgbẹ́ tí Amẹ́ríkà ní 16.5 sí 10.5 ní Le Golf National tó wà nítòsí Paris ní Faransé.

rows.source: The US has now lost six consecutive times on European soil and has not won a Ryder Cup in Europe since 1993.
rows.output: Àwọn ará ìlú Amẹ́ríkà ti pàdánù lẹ́ẹ̀mejì tó ṣe pàtàkì lórí ilẹ̀ Yúróòpù, wọn kò sì ṣẹ́gun Ìdíje Ryder kankan ní Yúróòpù láti ọdún 1993.
rows.reference: Ẹlẹ́kẹ̀ẹfà rèé tí ẹgbẹ́ ti Amẹ́ríkà máa pàdánù ìdíje ti Ryder léraléra ní ilẹ̀ Úróópù láti ọdún 1993

rows.source: Europe regained the crown as the Danish captain Thomas Bjorn's team reached the 14.5 points they required to beat the United States.
rows.output: Yuroopu tun gba ade naa bi ẹgbẹ agbabọọlu Denmark ti Thomas Bjorn ti de awọn aaye 14.5 ti wọn nilo lati ṣẹgun Amẹrika.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn, ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè Denmark àti olórí agbábọ́ọlù fún ẹgbẹ́ ti Úróópù ní máàkì 14.5 t’ọ́n nílò láti na ẹgbẹ́ ti Amẹ́ríkà.

rows.source: US star Phil Mickelson, who struggled most of the tournament, plunked his tee-shot into the water at the par-3 16th hole, conceding his match to Francesco Molinari.
rows.output: Ìròyìn tuntun ti o ti kọja
rows.reference: Phil Mickelson, tí kò ṣe dáadáa ní ìdíje náà, gbá bọ́ọ̀lù láti ibi tee lọ sínú omi. Bí Francesco Molinari ṣe nàá nìyẹn.

rows.source: The Italian golfer Molinari shined in all of his rounds, becoming 1-of-4 players to ever go 5-0-0 since the tournament's current format begun in 1979.
rows.output: Ẹrọ orin golfu Ilu Italia Molinari tan imọlẹ ni gbogbo awọn iyipo rẹ, di ọkan ninu awọn oṣere mẹrin nikan lati ni igbasilẹ 5-0-0 lati igba ti ọna lọwọlọwọ ti idije naa ti bẹrẹ ni ọdun 1979.
rows.reference: Ó yẹ Molinari, ọmọ ẹgbẹ́ agbábọ̀ọ̀lù gọ́ọ̀fù torí ó yege nínú gbogbo ìfẹsèwọnsẹ̀ márùn-ún tó gbá. Ó jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn mẹ́rin tó ní irú àṣeyorí yìí.

rows.source: American Jordan Spieth was blown out 5&4 by the lowest-ranked player on the European team, Thorbjorn Olesen of Denmark.
rows.output: Ẹnìkan lára ​​àwọn ará Amẹ́ríkà, Jordan Spieth, ni wọ́n fàṣẹ ọba mú ní 5&4 ní ọwọ́ Thorbjorn Olesen láti Denmark, ẹni tí ó jẹ́ ẹni tí ó kéré jù lọ nínú ẹgbẹ́ Yúróòpù.
rows.reference: Thorbjorn Olesen, bí ó tilẹ̀ jẹ́ pé kò mọ gọ́ọ̀fù gbá dáadáa, síbẹ̀ ó na Jordan Spieth, ọmọ Amẹ́ríkà ní 5 sí 4.

rows.source: The world's top-ranked player, Dustin Johnson, fell 2 and 1 to Ian Poulter of England who may have played in his final Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Ẹni tó jẹ́ olórí àwọn tí wọ́n ń ṣeré ní gbogbo àgbáyé, Dustin Johnson, ṣubú pẹ̀lú 2 àti 1 sí Ian Poulter láti England, ẹni tó lè ti ṣe eré Ryder Cup tó kẹ́yìn rẹ̀.
rows.reference: Ian Poulter, ọmọ orílẹ̀-èdè England na Dustin Johnson, agbágọ́ọ̀fù tó gbóná ní àgbáyé ní 2 sí 1. Ó ṣeéṣe kó jẹ́ Ian Poulter ‘ò ní kópa nínú ìdíje Ryder mọ́.

rows.source: A veteran of eight Ryder Cups, Spaniard Sergio Garcia became the tournaments all-time winningest European with 25.5 career point.
rows.output: Ọmọ ogun mẹjọ ti Ryder Cup, Spaniard Sergio Garcia di olutọju European ti o ni igbasilẹ ti o ga julọ pẹlu 25.5 aaye iṣẹgun.
rows.reference: Spaniard Sergio Garcia ni gbajúgbajà agbágọ́ọ̀fù tó gba ife Ryder ní ẹẹ̀mẹjọ. Gbogbo máàkì tó ní jẹ́ 25.5.

rows.source: "I don't usually cry but today I can't help it.
rows.output: "Mo sábà máa ń sunkún, ṣùgbọ́n lónìí, mi ò lè ràn mí lọ́wọ́.
rows.reference: ”Lóòótọ́ mò ń kẹ́ àmọ́ ẹkún ayọ̀ ni tòní.

rows.source: It's been a rough year.
rows.output: Ó ti jẹ́ ọdún tí ó le gan-an.
rows.reference: Ọdún yìí ‘ò rọgbọ.

rows.source: So thankful for Thomas to pick me and believe in me.
rows.output: Inú mi dùn gan-an fún Thomas pé ó yan mi àti pé ó gbà mí gbọ́.
rows.reference: Mo dúpẹ́ lọwọ́ Thomas tó rànmílọ́wọ́ láti di agbágọ́ọ̀fù.

rows.source: I am so happy, so happy to get the cup back.
rows.output: Mo dùn gan-an, mo dùn gan-an láti gba ife náà padà.
rows.reference: Inú mi dùn, inú mi dùn láti gba ife ìdíje yìí padà.

rows.source: It's about the team., and I'm happy I was able to help," said an emotional Garcia following the European victory.
rows.output: Ó jẹ́ nípa ẹgbẹ́ náà, mo sì dùn gan-an pé mo lè ràn wọ́n lọ́wọ́,” ni ẹni tí ó ní ìmọ̀lára yìí sọ lẹ́yìn ìṣẹ́gun ilẹ̀ Yúróòpù.
rows.reference: Iṣẹ́ àjọṣẹ ni. Inú mi dùn pé mo jẹ́ ọ̀kan nínú àwọn olóríire náà,” tayọ̀tayọ̀ ni Gracia sọ̀rọ̀ nípa àṣeyọrí ẹgbẹ́ Úróópù.

rows.source: He passes the torch to his fellow countryman John Ram who took down US golf legend Tiger Woods 2&1 in singles play on Sunday.
rows.output: Ó fi ìfọwọ́kàn náà fún ẹlẹ́gbẹ́ orílẹ̀-èdè rẹ̀, John Ram, ẹni tó ṣẹ́gun ẹlẹ́wọ̀n gọ́ọ̀lì orílẹ̀-èdè Amẹ́ríkà, Tiger Woods, 2&1, nínú eré ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ní ọjọ́ Sunday.

rows.source: "The incredible pride I feel, to beat Tiger Woods, I grew up watching that guy," said 23-year-old Rahm.
rows.output: "Ìgbàgbọ́ tí mo ní nínú èyí jẹ́ ńlá, láti ṣẹ́gun Tiger Woods, mo dàgbà tí mo ń wo ọkùnrin yìí."
rows.reference: John Rahm, ọmọ ọdfún 23, ní “Mo máa ń wo Tiger Woods nígbà tí mo wà ní kékeré. Ohun ìwúrí ló jẹ́ fún mi láti na Tiger.”

rows.output: Woods padanu gbogbo awọn ere mẹrin rẹ ni Ilu Faranse ati pe o ni igbasilẹ ti 13-21-3 Ryder Cup iṣẹ-ọdun.

rows.output: Ìṣirò àjèjì kan láti ọ̀dọ̀ ọ̀kan lára ​​àwọn agbabọọlu tó dáńgájíá jù lọ, tí ó ti gba àmì ẹ̀yẹ àgbáyé mẹ́rìnlá, ẹ̀ẹ̀kejì nìkan sí Jack Nicklaus.

rows.output: Ẹ̀fúùfù Pupa: Ìwọ̀n ìwọ̀n dín kù ní Pinellas, Manatee àti Sarasota
rows.reference: Àwọn ohun tuntun t’ọ́n ṣẹlẹ̀ nípa ìjì inú omi: Ìjì yí kò jà mọ́ ní àwọn abúlé bíi Pinellas, Manatee àti Sarasota

rows.source: The newest report from the Florida Fish and Wildlife Commission shows a general decrease in Red Tide concentrations for parts of the Tampa Bay area.
rows.output: Iroyin tuntun lati Igbimọ Eja ati Egan Florida fihan idinku gbogbogbo ninu awọn iye Red Tide fun awọn apakan ti agbegbe Tampa Bay.
rows.reference: Àjọ tó ń rí sí ọ̀rọ̀ ẹja àti ẹran igbó ní Florida ní ìjì omi ti dẹ́kun ní àwọn agbègbè Tampa Bay.

rows.source: According to the FWC, patchier bloom conditions are being reported in areas of Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte and Collier counties - which suggests decreasing concentrations.
rows.output: Gẹgẹbi FWC, awọn ipo alawọ ewe ti o ni awọn aaye ni a n jabo ni awọn agbegbe Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte ati Collier - eyiti o tumọ si idinku idinku.
rows.reference: Àjọ Florida yìí ní koọ sí ìjì omi ní àwọn abúlé bíi Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte àti Collier.

rows.source: A bloom the Red Tide extends approximately 130 miles of coastline from northern Pinellas to southern Lee counties.
rows.output: Ìdàgbàsókè Ìrì dúdú náà gbooro sí ìsàlẹ̀ 130 kìlómítà ti etíkun láti àríwá Pinellas sí gúúsù Lee.
rows.reference: Àríwá Pinellas ni ìjì omi yìí ti sàn dé gúsù abúlé Lee. Ó tó ibùsọ̀ 130 tí ìjì omi naà deé.

rows.source: Patches can be found about 10 miles offshore of Hillsborough County, but at fewer sites relative to last week.
rows.output: Àwọn àpòpọ̀ lè rí ní àgbègbè mẹ́wàá láti ilẹ̀ Hillsborough County, ṣùgbọ́n ní àwọn ibi kéré jù lọ ní ìfiwéra pẹ̀lú ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá.
rows.reference: Àpá ìjì omi yìí wà ní ibùsọ̀ 10 sí abúlé Hillsborough, àmọ́ kò pọ̀ tó ti ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá.

rows.source: Red Tide has also been observed in Pasco County.
rows.output: Ìkún omi pupa tún ti rí ní ìpínlẹ̀ Pasco.
rows.reference: Ìjì omi náà jà ní abúlé Pasco.

rows.source: Medium concentrations in or offshore of Pinellas County have been reported in the past week, low to high concentrations offshore of Hillsborough County, background to high concentrations in Manatee County, background to high concentrations in or offshore of Sarasota County, background to medium concentrations in Charlotte County, background to high concentrations in or offshore of Lee County, and low concentrations in Collier County.
rows.output: Awọn idiwọ ti o wa ni tabi ni ita ti Ipinle Pinellas ti jẹ ijabọ ni ọsẹ to kọja, awọn idiwọ kekere si giga ni ita ti Ipinle Hillsborough, awọn idiwọ abẹlẹ si giga ni Ipinle Manatee, awọn idiwọ abẹlẹ si giga ni tabi ni ita ti Ipinle Sarasota, awọn idiwọ abẹlẹ si giga ni Ipinle Charlotte, awọn idiwọ abẹlẹ si giga ni tabi ni ita ti Ipinle Lee, ati awọn idiwọ kekere ni Ipinle Collier.
rows.reference: Láàrin ọ̀sẹ̀ bíi mélòó kan, Ìjì yí ti dínkù ní Pinellas àti agbègbè ẹ̀. Ó tún dínkù sí ti abúlé àti agbègbè Hillsborough, Mantee, Sarasota, Charlotte, Lee àti Collier.

rows.source: Respiratory irritation continues to be reported in Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, and Collier counties.
rows.output: Ìbànújẹ́ ẹ̀mí ń bá a lọ ní ìpínlẹ̀ Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, àti Collier.
rows.reference: Ìṣòrò pẹ̀lú èémi pọ̀ ní abúlé Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, àti Collier.

rows.source: Respiratory irritation was not reported in Northwest Florida over the past week.
rows.output: Ìbànújẹ́ ẹ̀mí kò sí ní ìwọ̀ oòrùn Florida ní ọ̀sẹ̀ tó kọjá.
rows.reference: Àmọ́ kò sí ìṣòrò pẹ̀lú èémí ní àríwá-iwọ-oòrùn Floria lọ́sẹ̀ tó kọjá.

rows.source: Macedonia's PM Zoran Zaev, his wife Zorica and his son Dushko cast their ballot for the referendum in Macedonia on changing the country's name that would open the way for it to join NATO and the European Union in Strumica, Macedonia September 30, 2018.
rows.output: Shugaban kasar Macedonia Zoran Zaev, matarsa ​​Zorica da dansa Dushko sun kada kuri'ar amincewa da kuri'ar raba gardama a kasar Macedonia na canza sunan kasar da zai baiwa kasar damar shiga NATO da kungiyar Tarayyar Turai a Strumica, kasar Macedonia ranar 30 ga Satumba, 2018.
rows.reference: Firaministan Macedonia Zoran Zaev, da shi da matarsa  Zorica da ɗansa Dushko sun kaɗa kuri’arsu ta raba gardamar a cikin Macedonia a kan canza sunan ƙasar wanda zai buɗe hanya da shiga NATO da Tarayyar Turai a cikin Strumica, Macedonia 3 ga Satumba, 2018.

rows.source: In front of parliament in Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, 54, was preparing a small stage and pulling up chairs in front of tents set up by those who will boycott the referendum.
rows.output: A gaban majalisar dokokin birnin Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, mai shekaru 54, yana shirin wani karamin dandalin da kuma tara kujeru a gaban gidajen da aka kafa da wadanda za su yi watsi da zaben.
rows.reference: A gaban majalisar dokoki da ke cikin Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, mai shekaru 54, ya shirya wani ƙaramin munbari kuma ya janyo kujeru sama ta gaban tanti-tanti da waɗanda ke ƙaurace wa raba gardamar suka kafa.

rows.source: "We are for NATO and EU, but we want to join with our heads up, not through the service door" Kavadarkov said.
rows.output: "Muna goyon bayan NATO da EU, amma muna son shiga cikin kwarin gwiwa, ba ta ƙofar hidima ba" in ji Kavadarkov.
rows.reference: “Mu na NATO da Tarayyar Turai ne, amma muna son shiga da mutuncimu, ba ta bayan ƙofar aiki ba,” inji Kavadarkov.

rows.source: "We are a poor country, but we do have dignity.
rows.output: Mun kasance kasa mai talauci, amma har yanzu muna da daraja.
rows.reference: “Mu wata ƙasa ce talaka, amma muna da kamala.

rows.source: If they don't want to take us as Macedonia, we can turn to others like China and Russia and become part of Euro-Asia integration."
rows.output: Idan ba sa son karɓar mu a matsayin Masedoniya, za mu iya juya zuwa wasu kamar Sin da Rasha mu zama wani ɓangare na haɗin kai na Turai-Asiya."
rows.reference: Idan ba su son su ɗauke mu a matsayin Macedonia, za mu iya juyawa ga sauran kamar China da Rusha kuma mu zama ɓangare na haɗewar Turai da Asiya.”

rows.source: Prime Minister Zaev says NATO membership will bring much needed investment to Macedonia, which has an unemployment rate of more than 20 percent.
rows.output: Firayim Minista Zaev ya ce shiga NATO zai kawo jari mai bukata a kasar Makidoniya, wadda ke da kashi 20 cikin dari na rashin aikin yi.
rows.reference: Firaminista Zaev ya ce zama mamban NATO zai kawo zuba jari sosai zuwa ga Macedonia, wadda ke da wani kimar rashin aikin yi na fiye da kashi 20 cikin ɗari.

rows.source: "I believe the huge majority will be in favor because more than 80 percent of our citizens are in favor of EU and NATO," Zaev said after casting his ballot.
rows.output: "Na yi imani da yawa da yawa za su amince da shi domin sama da kashi 80 cikin 100 na 'yan kasar mu muna goyon bayan EU da NATO," Zaev ya ce bayan ya kada kuri'arsa.
rows.reference: “Na yi imani da yawa sosai za su so saboda fiye da kashi 80 cikin ɗari na ‘yan ƙasarmu suna son Tarayyar Turai da NATO,”inji Zaev bayan kaɗa kuri’arsa.

rows.source: He said that a "yes" result would be "confirmation of our future."
rows.output: Ya ce "eh" zai zama "tabbatar da makomarmu."
rows.reference: Ya ce wani sakamako na “eh” zai zama tabbatarwa da makomarmu.”

rows.source: A poll published last Monday by Macedonia's Institute for Policy Research said between 30 and 43 percent of voters would take part in the referendum - below the required turnout.
rows.output: An yi wata kuri'ar jin ra'ayin jama'a a makon da ya gabata ta Cibiyar Nazarin Manufofin Jamhuriyar Makidoniya ta ce kashi 30 zuwa 43 na masu kada kuri'a za su shiga zaben - kasa da yawan kuri'un da ake bukata.
rows.reference: Wani zaɓen jin ra’ayin jama’a da Cibiyar Nazarin Ƙuduri ta Macedonia ta buga ranar Litinin ya ce tsakanin kashi 30 zuwa 43 cikin ɗari na masu jefa kuri’a za su shiga cikin raba gardamar - kasa da fitowar da ake buƙatar.

rows.source: Another poll, conducted by Macedonia's Telma TV, found 57 percent of respondents planning to vote on Sunday.
rows.output: Wani bincike da Telma TV na kasar Macedonia ta gudanar ya nuna cewa kashi 57 cikin 100 na wadanda aka yi binciken na shirin kada kuri'a a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Wani jin ra’ayin jama’ar, da gidan talabijin na Telma na Macedonia, ya samo kashi 57 cikin ɗari na masu martanin suna shirya jefa kuri’ar ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: Of those, 70 percent said they would vote yes.
rows.output: Daga cikin wadanda suka amsa, kashi 70 cikin 100 sun bayyana cewa za su kada kuri'ar eh.
rows.reference: Daga waɗannan, kashi 70 cikin ɗari za su so su jefa eh.

rows.source: For the referendum to be successful turnout needs to be 50 percent plus one vote.
rows.output: Don a yi nasara a zaben, dole ne kashi 50 cikin 100 na masu kada kuri'a su zabi.
rows.reference: Don raba gardamar ta ci nasara da buƙatar fitowar ta zama kashi 50 cikin ɗari da ƙarin kuri’a ɗaya.

rows.source: A failure in the referendum would represent the first serious blow to policy of the pro-Western government since it took over in May last year.
rows.output: Wani gazawa a zaben na nuni da karo na farko da gwamnatin da ta yi kishin Yammacin Turai ta samu rauni.
rows.reference: Wata gazawa a cikin raba gardamar za ta zama matsala ta farko ga ƙudurin masu goyon bayan gwamnatin Yamma tun da ta kama ragama a cikin Mayu na shekarar da ta wuce.

rows.output: Sergio Aguero da Raheem Sterling sun yi wa tsaron gida na Brighton da kuma nasarar da Manchester City ta samu a kan Brighton da City 2-0 a ranar Asabar a filin wasa na Etihad a Manchester, Ingila.

rows.output: Ya yi gudu tsakanin masu tsaron birnin Brighton guda uku, kafin ya soka cikin filin budadden.

rows.output: Sannan Aguero ya sami kansa a kewaye da rigunan kore guda hudu.

rows.source: He pushed around one defender before outrunning several more at the edge of the Brighton box.
rows.output: Ya yi gaba da wani mai tsaron gida kafin ya zarce da yawa a gefen akwatin Brighton.

rows.source: He then pushed a pass to his left, finding Sterling.

rows.source: The English forward used his first touch in the box to give the ball back to Aguero, who used his right boot to beat Brighton keeper Mathew Ryan with a shot into the right side of the net.
rows.output: An yi amfani da farko na Ingilishi a cikin akwatin don ba da kwallon ga Aguero, wanda ya yi amfani da takalmin dama don doke mai tsaron gida na Brighton Mathew Ryan da harbin da ya shiga gefen hagu na raga.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasan gaba na Ingilan ya yi amfani da tabinsa na farko a cikin akwatin don ba da ƙwallo ga Aguero, wanda ya yi amfani da takalminsa na dama don bugan golan Brighton  Mathew Ryan da wani ɗan duka zuwa cikin gefen dama na ragar.

rows.source: "Aguero is struggling with some problems in his feet," City manager Pep Guardiola told reporters.
rows.output: "Aguero yana fama da wasu matsaloli a kafafunsa," in ji manajan City Pep Guardiola.

rows.source: "We spoke about him playing 55, 60 minutes.
rows.output: "Mun yi magana game da shi yana wasa 55, 60 mintuna.

rows.source: That's what happened.
rows.output: Wannan shi ne abin da ya faru.
rows.reference: Wannan shi ne abin da ya faru.

rows.source: We were lucky he scored a goal in that moment."

rows.source: But it was Sterling who gave the Sky Blues the initial advantage in the Premier League scuffle.
rows.output: Amma Sterling ne ya ba wa Sky Blues fa'ida ta farko a fafatawar Premier League.

rows.output: An tafiya a cikin minti na 29.

rows.output: Ya taka wata kwallon da ta yi kyau a gefen hagu zuwa Leroy Sane.

rows.source: Sane took a few touches before leading Sterling toward the far post.
rows.output: Sane ya yi wasu taɓawa kafin ya jagoranci Sterling zuwa kusurwar mai nisa.
rows.reference: Sane ya ɗan yi wasu taɓe-taɓe kafin jagorar Sterling zuwa ƙarshen matsaya mai nisa.

rows.source: The Sky Blues forward tapped the ball into the net just before sliding out of bounds.
rows.output: Fuskar Blue ta ci kwallo a cikin raga kafin ta fita daga iyakokin.
rows.reference: Mai bugun gaban na Sky Blues ya taɓa ƙwallon zuwa cikin raga kawai kafin ficewa daga iyakokin.

rows.source: City battles Hoffenheim in Champions League group play at 12:55 p.m. on Tuesday at Rhein-Neckar-Arena in Sinsheim, Germany.
rows.output: Birnin yana fafatawa da Hoffenheim a wasan rukuni na gasar zakarun Turai da karfe 12:55 na rana a ranar Talata a filin wasa na Rhein-Neckar-Arena a Sinsheim, Jamus.
rows.reference: City ɗin yana yakar Hoffenheim a cikin wasan gungun Champions League da ƙarfe 12:55 na rana a ranar Talata at Rhein-Neckar-Arena da ke cikin Sinsheim, Jamus.

rows.source: Scherzer wants to play spoiler vs. Rockies
rows.output: Scherzer yana son zama mai lalata da Rockies
rows.reference: Scherzer yana son zama mai ɓatawa da Rockies

rows.source: With the Nationals eliminated from playoff contention, there wasn't much reason to force another start.
rows.output: Tare da Nationals sun fita daga fafatawar, ba a yi wani dalili na tilasta wani farawa ba.
rows.reference: Da yake an cire Nationals daga gasar sake wasa, babu wani dalili na tilasta sake farawa.

rows.source: But the ever-competitive Scherzer hopes to take the mound on Sunday against the Colorado Rockies, but only if there are still playoff implications for the Rockies, who hold a one-game lead over the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NL West.
rows.output: Amma Scherzer mai gasa koyaushe yana fatan zai hau filin a ranar Lahadi a kan Rockies na Colorado, muddin akwai wasu abubuwan da suka shafi wasan karshe ga Rockies, wadanda ke da nasaba da jagorancin wasa guda a kan Dodgers na Los Angeles a yankin NL West.
rows.reference: Amma mai son gasar kodayaushe Scherzer yana fatan ɗaukan tarin ranar Lahadi a kan Colorado Rockies, amma kawai idan har yanzi kawai tasirori na sake wasa don Rockies din, wadanda ke rike wani jagorancin wasa a saman Los Angeles Dodgers a cikin NL West ɗin.

rows.source: The Rockies clinched at least a wild-card spot with a 5-2 win over the Nationals on Friday night, but are still looking to lock up their first division title.
rows.output: An tabbatar da samun wuri a gasar cin kofin duniya tare da nasarar da suka yi a kan Kungiyar ta 5-2 a daren Juma'a, amma har yanzu suna neman tabbatar da lashe gasar.
rows.reference: Rockies sun aƙalla sami wawan katin fice tare da wata cin nasara 5 da 2 a kan Nationals a ranar Juma’a da dare, amma har yanzu suna neman su rufe matsayinsu na sashe na farko.

rows.source: "Even though we're playing for nothing, at least we can be able to toe the rubber knowing that the atmosphere here in Denver with the crowd and the other team would be playing at probably the highest level of any point I would face this year.
rows.output: Ko da muna wasa don komai, aƙalla za mu iya yin ƙoƙari mu yi wasa a kan roba tare da sanin cewa yanayin nan a Denver tare da taron jama'a da kuma ƙungiyar da za ta yi wasa a matakin mafi girma a kowane lokaci da zan fuskanta a wannan shekara.
rows.reference: “Kodayake muna wasa ne ba dan kome ba, aƙalla za mu iya taka roba muna sane da cewa yanayin a cikin Denver yana tare da dandazon jama’a kuma ɗaya ƙungiyar za ta wasa a kila lebur mafi girma na kowane bigire da zan fuskanta wannan shekara.

rows.source: Why wouldn't I want to compete in that?"
rows.output: Me yasa ba zan so in yi gasa a cikin hakan ba?
rows.reference: Me zai hana na so na yi gasa a cikin wannan?”

rows.source: The Nationals have yet to announce a starter for Sunday, but are reportedly inclined to let Scherzer pitch in such a situation.
rows.output: An kada 'yan wasan su bayyana wanda zai fara buga wasa a ranar Lahadi, amma rahotanni sun ce za su bari Scherzer ya buga a irin wannan yanayi.
rows.reference: Har yanzu Nationals ɗin ba su sanar da wani mafari ba don Lahadi amma an ba da rahoto sun so su bari Scherzer ya tsananta yanayin.

rows.source: Scherzer, who would be making his 34th start, threw a bullpen session on Thursday and would be pitching on his normal rest Sunday.
rows.output: Scherzer, wanda zai yi wasansa na 34, ya yi zaman jefa kwallo a ranar Alhamis kuma zai yi jifa a ranar Lahadi da hutun da ya saba.
rows.reference: Scherzer, wanda zai yi farinsa na 34, ya jefa wani babban lokaci a ranar Alhamis kuma zai tsananta a kan hutunsa na daidai ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: The Washington right-hander is 18-7 with a 2.53 ERA and 300 strikeouts in 220 2/3 innings this season.
rows.output: Mai tsaron dama na Washington yana da 18-7 da kuma 2.53 ERA da kuma bugun jini 300 a cikin innings 220 2/3 a wannan kakar.
rows.reference: Mai riƙe Washington daidai yana 18-7 tare da wani 2.53 ERA da bugun waje 300 a cikin 220 2/3 innings wannan lokacin.

rows.source: Trump rallies in West Virginia
rows.output: Taron Trump a West Virginia
rows.reference: Trump ya yi gangami a cikin Virginia ta Yamma.

rows.source: The President obliquely referred to the situation surrounding his Supreme Court pick Brett Kavanaugh while talking about the importance of Republican turnout in the midterm elections.
rows.output: Shugaban ya yi magana a hankali game da halin da ake ciki dangane da zaben Kotun Koli na Brett Kavanaugh yayin da yake tattaunawa kan muhimmancin fitowar jam’iyyar Republican a zaben tsakiyar wa’adi.
rows.reference: Shugaban ya ɗan ambaci yanayin da ke kewaye da wanda ya zaɓa don Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh a lokacin da yake magana game da amfanin fitowa ta ‘yan jam’iyyar Republican a cikin zaɓuɓɓukan tsakiyar zango.

rows.source: "All of what we've done is at stake in November.
rows.output: "Dukkan abin da muka yi a halin yanzu yana cikin hadari a watan Nuwamba.
rows.reference: “Dukkan abin da muka yi ya tsaya ciki a Nuwamba.

rows.source: Five weeks away from one of the most important elections in our lifetimes.
rows.output: Makonni biyar kafin daya daga cikin zaben da ya fi muhimmanci a rayuwarmu.
rows.reference: Makonni biyar daga yanzu daga ɗaya daga cikin zaɓuɓɓuka mafi amfani a cikin lokacin rayuwarmu.

rows.source: This is one of the big, big -- I'm not running but I'm really running that's why I'm all over the place fighting for great candidates," he said.
rows.output: Wannan yana daya daga cikin manyan, manyan -- ba na gudu ba amma ina gudu sosai wanda shine dalilin da ya sa nake ko'ina yana fafatawa don manyan 'yan takara," ya ce.
rows.reference: Wannan shi ne daga cikin babban, babban - Ba zan tsaya ba amma a zahiri zan tsaya shi ya sa nake dukkan kowane wuri ina yaƙi don ‘yan takara na gari,” inji shi.

rows.source: Trump continued, "You see this horrible, horrible radical group of Democrats, you see it happening right now.
rows.output: Trump ya ci gaba, "Kuna ganin wannan rukunin masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini, masu ra'ayin addini,
rows.reference: Trump ya ci gaba, “Kun ga wannan bala’in, gungun bala’i na ‘yan jam’iyyar Democrats, kun ga abin da ke faruwa yanzun nan.

rows.source: And they're determined to take back power by using any means necessary, you see the meanness, the nastiness.
rows.output: Kuma suna da niyyar dawo da mulki ta kowace hanya da suke da ita, kuna ganin tsananin talauci, rashin kyau.
rows.reference: Kuma sun ƙudurta karɓan iko ta yin amfani da kowace damar za su iya, kun ga baƙin halin, rashin kirkin.

rows.source: They don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over in order to get power and control, that's what they want is power and control, we're not going to give it to them."
rows.output: Ba sa damuwa da wanda suke cutarwa, ko wanda suke bukatar su yi tafiya a kai domin samun karfi da iko, haka suke so, karfi da iko, ba za mu bada musu ba."
rows.reference: Ba ruwansu da wanda suka ɓata wa rai, wanda za su rusa su sami iko da sarrafa, shi ya sa abin da suke so shi ne iko da sarrafa, ba za mu ba su shi ba.”

rows.source: Democrats, he said, are on a mission to "resist and obstruct."
rows.output: Masu ra'ayin dimokuradiyya, a cewarsa, suna da burin "juriya da toshe."
rows.reference: ‘Yan jam’iyyar Democrat, inji shi, suna kan manufa ce ta “ƙi da kange.”

rows.source: "And you see that over the last four days," he said, calling the Democrats "angry and mean and nasty and untruthful."
rows.output: Kuma kuna ganin hakan a cikin kwanaki hudu da suka gabata," ya ce, yana kiran 'yan Democrat a matsayin "mugun hali, masu tsauri da mugunta da kuma rashin gaskiya."
rows.reference: “Kuma kun ga cewa a cikin kwanaki huɗu da suka wuce,” inji shi, yana mai kiran ‘yan Democrat ɗin da “masu fushi da baƙin ciki da zali da rashin gaskiya.”

rows.source: He referenced Senate Judiciary Committee ranking Democratic Sen. Dianne Feinstein by name, which received loud boos from the audience.
rows.output: Ya ambaci mukaddashin shugaban kwamitin shari'a na majalisar dattawa, Sanata Dianne Feinstein, wanda ya haifar da ihun murna daga masu sauraro.
rows.reference: Ya ambaci babban dan Kwamitin Shari’a na Majalisar Dattawa Sanata Dianne Feinstein da sunanta, wanda masu sauraro suka yi wa ihu.

rows.source: "Remember her answer?
rows.output: Ka tuna amsarta?
rows.reference: “Kun tuna amsarta?

rows.source: Did you leak the document?
rows.output: Shin ka bayyana takardar?
rows.reference: Kin yi yoyon takardar?

rows.source: Uh, uh, what.
rows.output: Ina tsammanin ba zan iya fahimtar ku ba.
rows.reference: Uh, uh, me.

rows.source: No, uh no, I wait one - that was really bad body language - the worst body language I've ever seen."
rows.output: A'a, uh a'a, na jira daya - hakan ya yi muni sosai a cikin yadda mutum yake - mafi muni a cikin yadda mutum yake da na taba gani.
rows.reference: A’a, uh, a’a, na jira ɗaya ne - wannan mummunan abu ne na alamar rashin gaskiya - mafi munin alamar rashin gaskiya da ban taɓa gani ba.”

rows.source: Labour is no longer a broad church.
rows.output: Aikin ba kungiyar da ta yi fice ba.
rows.reference: Yanzu Labour ba wani babban majami’a ne ba.

rows.source: It is intolerant of those who speak their minds
rows.output: Ba ta da hakuri ga wadanda suke magana da gaskiya.
rows.reference: Wani rashin haƙuri ne na waɗanda ke faɗan abin da ke cikin zuciyarsu

rows.source: When Momentum's activists in my local party voted to censure me, it was hardly a surprise.
rows.output: Lokacin da masu fafutuka na Momentum a jam'iyyata ta gida suka kada kuri'ar cire ni, ba abin mamaki ba ne.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ‘yan rajin Momentum a cikin jam’iyyata ta gida suka jefa kuri’a don tsaida ni, ba wani abin mamaki ne ba.

rows.source: After all, I'm the latest in a line of Labour MPs to be told we are not welcome - all for speaking our minds.
rows.output: Bayan haka, ni ne mafi karanci a cikin jerin 'yan majalisar Labour da aka gaya mana ba mu da maraba - duk saboda magana kan ra'ayinmu.
rows.reference: Tun da yake, ni ne mafi sabo a wani layi na mambobin Labour na majalisa da za a faɗa musu ba a maraba da mu - dukka saboda faɗan abi da ke zuciyarmu.

rows.source: My parliamentary colleague Joan Ryan received similar treatment because she resolutely stood up to antisemitism.
rows.output: Abokin majalisar ministoci na Joan Ryan ya samu irin wannan magani ne saboda ta tsaya tsayin daka wajen yaki da zindikin Yahudawa.
rows.reference: Abokiyata a majalisa Joan Ryan ta sami irin wulakanci saboda ta tsaya tsayin daka tana faɗa da ra’ayin ƙin Yahudawa.

rows.source: In my case, the censure motion criticised me for disagreeing with Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.output: A cikin yanayina, an caccaki kudurin cirewa saboda rashin amincewa da Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.reference: A nawa misalin, batun dakatarwar ya soke ni don ƙin yarda da Jeremy Corbyn.

rows.source: On the importance of a responsible economic policy, on national security, on Europe, ironically similar issues on which Jeremy disagreed with previous leaders.
rows.output: A kan muhimmancin manufofin tattalin arziki masu alhaki, kan tsaron kasa, kan Turai, a ban dariya batutuwa iri daya da Jeremy ya sabawa shugabannin da suka gabata.
rows.reference: A kan amfani na wani ƙudurin tattalin arzikin mai kyau, a kan tsaron ƙasa, a kan Turai, abin takaici batutuwa iri guda wanda a kai Jeremy ya ƙi yarda da shugabanni da suka wuce.

rows.source: The notice for the Nottingham East Labour meeting on Friday stated that "we want the meetings to be inclusive and productive."
rows.output: Sanarwar taron jam'iyyar Labour ta Nottingham Gabas a ranar Juma'a ta bayyana cewa "muna son tarukan su kasance masu hada kai da kuma samar da sakamako."
rows.reference: Sanarwa don taron Labour ta Nottingham ta Gabas a ranar Juma’a ta kawo cewa, “muna son tarukan su zama a haɗe da  ma’ana.”

rows.source: For most of my eight years as the local Labour MP, the Friday night GC meetings have been exactly that.
rows.output: A cikin yawancin shekaru takwas na zama dan majalisar dokokin yankin, taron GC na yammacin Juma'a ya kasance daidai da haka.
rows.reference: Ga mafi yawan na shekaru takwas ɗin a matsayi na mamban Labour a majalisa, haka dai yake daren tarukan GC.

rows.source: Sadly today, it is not the tone of many meetings and the promise of "kinder, gentler" politics has long been forgotten if, indeed, it ever began.
rows.output: A yau, ba haka ba ne yanayin yawancin taruka da alkawarin "kinder, gentler" siyasa ya yi daɗe ba a tuna ba, ko da a zahiri ya fara.
rows.reference: Abin takaici a yau, ba shi ne fasalin taruka da yawa kuma alkawari na siyasa ta “ihsani, hankali” tuni aka manta idan, ma, an taɓa farawa.

rows.source: It has become increasingly apparent that differing views are not tolerated in the Labour party and every opinion is judged on whether it is acceptable to the party leadership.
rows.output: Ya zama kusan bayyane cewa ra'ayoyi daban-daban ba a amince da su a cikin jam'iyyar Labour ba, kuma ana tantance kowane ra'ayi bisa ko yana da amincewar shugabancin jam'iyyar.
rows.reference: Yana ƙara zama a bayyane fili cewa ba a haƙuri da ra’ayoyi daban-daban a cikin jam’iyyar Labour kuma ana hukunta kowane ra’ayi a kan ko zai karɓu ga shugabannin jam’iyyar.

rows.source: This started shortly after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues with whom I had previously thought I shared a similar political outlook began expecting me to do a U-turn and take positions I would never have otherwise agreed with - whether on national security or the EU single market.
rows.output: Wannan ya fara ne kusan lokacin da Jeremy ya zama shugaba, yayin da abokan aiki da na yi tunanin ina da ra'ayi na siyasa iri daya, suka fara tsammanin in yi juyin juya hali in dauki matsayi da ba zan taba amincewa da shi ba - ko a fannin tsaron kasa ko kuma kasuwar EU guda.
rows.reference: Wannan ya fara jim kaɗan bayan Jeremy ya zama shugaba, don abokan aiki da nake jin a da muna da irin mahangar siyasa sun fara tsammani zan yi wani juyi da daukan matsaya da ba zan taɓa yarda da su ba - ko a kan tsaron ƙasa ko kasuwa guda ta Tarayyar Turai.

rows.source: Whenever I speak publicly - and it doesn't really matter what I say - there follows a tirade of abuse on social media calling for deselection, denouncing the politics of the centre, telling me I should not be in the Labour party.
rows.output: Duk lokacin da na yi magana a bainar jama'a - kuma ba komai abin da na fada - sai wani gagarumin zagi ya biyo baya a kafafen sada zumunta na kira da a cire ni, suka yi Allah wadai da siyasar tsakiya, suna cewa ba ni da wuri a jam'iyyar Labour.
rows.reference: A kodayaushe na yi magana a cikin jama’a - kuma ba ruwan haƙiƙa abin da na ce - kawai sai tarun cin mutunci a kan kafar sadar zumunta ana kira ga sake zaɓe, ana watsi da siyasar ta tsakiya, ana faɗa mun cewa ya kamata na zama ba na cikin jam’iyyar Labour.

rows.source: And that is not just my experience.
rows.output: Kuma hakan ba kawai abin da nake fuskanta ba ne.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan ba kawai abin da na gani ne ba.

rows.source: Indeed, I know I am more fortunate than some of my colleagues as the comments directed at me tend to be political.
rows.output: To, na san cewa ina da sa'a fiye da wasu abokan aikina, domin kalamai masu alaka da ni yawanci suna da alaka da siyasa.
rows.reference: Haƙiƙa, na san na ti sa’a sosai fiye da sauran abokan aikina saboda umarce-umarce da ake fuskantowa a kaina sukan zama na siyasa.

rows.source: I am in awe of the professionalism and determination of those colleagues who face a torrent of sexist or racist abuse every day but never shy away.
rows.output: Ina jin tsoron kwarewar sana'a da kuma jajircewar wadannan abokan aikina wadanda ke fuskantar guguwar cin zarafi na jinsi ko kuma na launin fata kowace rana, amma ba su taba jinkirin fuskantar su ba.
rows.reference: Ina cikin dan shayi na ra’ayin kwarewa da ƙudurtawa ta waɗannan abokan aikin waɗanda ke fuskantar wani cin mutunci ta fuska jinsi ko bambancin launin fata a kowace rana amma ba su taɓa gudu ba.

rows.source: One of the most disappointing aspects of this era of politics is how levels of abuse have become normalised.
rows.output: Wani abu mai ban takaici game da wannan zamani na siyasa shi ne yadda matakan cin zarafi suka zama ruwan dare.
rows.reference: Daya daga cikin ɓangarorin abu mafi ɓata rai a wannan lokaci na siyasa shi ne yadda lebur-lebur na cin mutunci suna zama ruwan dare.

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn claimed last week that the Labour party should foster a culture of tolerance.
rows.output: Jeremy Corbyn ya yi iƙirarin mako da ya gabata cewa jam'iyyar Labour ya kamata ta haɓaka al'adar juriya.
rows.reference: Jeremy Corbyn ya ce a mako da ya wuce cewa ya kamata jam’iyyar Labour ta samar da wata al’adar haƙuri.

rows.source: The reality is we are no longer that broad church and with every "no-confidence" motion or change of selection rules the party becomes narrower.
rows.output: Gaskiyar ita ce, ba mu waccan babbar coci ba ce kuma tare da kowace "motsa rashin amincewa" ko canje-canje a cikin ka'idojin zabe, jam'iyyar ta zama kunkuntar.
rows.reference: Abin da yake zahiri shi ne yanzu mu ba wancan babbar majami’ar ne ba da kowane batu na “ba a yarda da iyawa ba” ko canjin dokokin zaɓe a ce jam’iyya tana zama karama.

rows.source: I have had lots of advice over the past two years urging me to keep my head down, not to be so vocal and then I would "be all right."
rows.output: Na samu shawarwari da yawa a cikin shekaru biyu da suka gabata da ke karfafa mini in kiyaye kaina, kada in yi yawa da magana sannan zan "yi kyau".
rows.reference: Na sha samun sharawa da yawa a cikin shekaru biyu da suka wuce ana kira da na yi shiru, kar na yi surutu shi ke nan zan zama “ba wata matsala.”

rows.source: But that is not what I came into politics to do.
rows.output: Amma hakan ba shine dalilin da na shiga harkokin siyasa ba.
rows.reference: Amma ban shiga siyasa don na yi wannan abu ba.

rows.source: Ever since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a school pupil, provoked by the Thatcher government's neglect that had left my comprehensive school classroom literally falling down, I've sought to champion better public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or government minister.
rows.output: Tun lokacin da na shiga Labour shekaru 32 da suka wuce a matsayin dalibi, wanda ya sa na yi wa gwamnatin Thatcher kaca-kaca da rashin kulawa da ta yi wanda ya bar makarantar sakandare ta ta kasa kasa ta fadi, na yi ƙoƙarin zama mai fafutukar samun ingantattun ayyukan jama'a ga waɗanda suka fi buƙata - ko a matsayin ɗan kwamitin yanki ko ministan gwamnati.
rows.reference: Tun da ma na shiga jam’iyyar Labour shekaru 32 da suka wuce a matsayin wani yaro dan makaranta, da ya sami zaburarwa daga wazarai na gwamnatin Thatcher da a fakaice ta bar cikekken ajina na makaranta yana faɗuwa, na yi tunanin na zama gwarzon gyara ayyukan jama’a ga waɗanda ke buƙatar sosai - ko a matsayi na wani kansila na gida ko ministan gwamnati.

rows.source: I have never hidden my politics, including at the last election.
rows.output: Ban taba boye siyasar nawa ba, ciki har da zabukan da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Ban taɓa boye siyasata ba, har da cikin zaɓen da ya gabata.

rows.source: No one in Nottingham East could have been in any way confused about my policy positions and areas of disagreement with the current leadership.
rows.output: Babu wanda ke Nottingham Gabas da zai iya yin kowace rudani game da matsayin manufofina da wuraren da na yi rashin jituwa da shugabancin yanzu.
rows.reference: Ba wani daga cikin Nottingham ta Gabas da za a ce ya shiga ruɗani game da matsayin ƙudurina da yankuna na rashin amincewa tare da shugabancin yanzu.

rows.source: To those who promoted the motion on Friday, all I would say is that when the country is ploughing towards a Brexit that will hurt households, businesses and our public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on my loyalty to the Labour party leader.
rows.output: Ga wadanda suka inganta kudirin a ranar Juma'a, duk abin da zan ce shi ne cewa yayin da kasar ke tafiya zuwa ga Brexit da zai cutar da iyalai, kasuwanci da ayyukan jama'a, ban fahimci sha'awar yin asara da lokaci da kuzari a kan amincina ga shugaban jam'iyyar Labour ba.
rows.reference: Ga waɗanda suka tallata batu na ranar Juma’a, abin da dukka zan ce shi ne cewa a lokacin da ƙasar ke tattaki zuwa wani Brexit da zai cutar da iyalai, kasuwanci da ayyukan gwamnati, ban fahimci sha’awar ɓata lokaci da ƙarfin gwiwa ba a kan mubaya’a ta zuwa ga shugaban jam’iyyar Labour.

rows.source: But really the one message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, it is to my constituents, whether Labour members or not: I am proud to serve you and I promise that no amount of deselection threats or political expediency will deter me from acting in what I believe are the best interests of you all.
rows.output: Amma a zahiri saƙon da nake da shi ba shine ga Momentum na Nottingham ba, sai dai ga masu zaɓe na, ko suna cikin jam'iyyar Labour ko a'a: Ina alfahari da yi muku hidima kuma ina ba da alkawarin cewa babu wani adadi na barazanar zaben ko hankali na siyasa da zai hana ni yin abin da na yi imani shine mafi kyawun sha'awar ku duka.
rows.reference: Amma a zahiri kuwa saƙo ɗaya da nake da shi ba zuwa ga Nottingham Momentum ne ba, zuwa ga mazaɓata ne, ko mambobin Labour ko a’a: Ina alfahari da yin aiki don jama’a kuma na yi alkawari cewa ba wani irin barazana sake zaɓe ko ruɗanin siyasa da zai hana ni yin aiki a cikin abin da na yi imani da shi shi ne mafi kyawun abubuwan da za su yi wa jama’a dadi gaba ɗaya.

rows.source: Chris Leslie is MP for Nottingham East
rows.output: Chris Leslie shine wakilin Majalisar Dokokin Burtaniya (MP) na Nottingham Gabas.
rows.reference: Chris Leslie mamban majalisa ne na Nottingham ta Gabasa

rows.source: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Unbeaten Ayr go top
rows.output: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr mara nasara ta kai matsayi na daya
rows.reference: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr da ba a doke ba ta yi sama

rows.source: Two late tries may have skewed the final result somewhat, but there is no doubt Ayr deserved to triumph in this wonderfully-entertaining Tennent's Premiership match of the day.
rows.output: Biyan biyu na baya na iya canza sakamakon karshe, amma babu shakka Ayr sun cancanci nasara a wannan wasan da aka yi da kyau na Tennent's Premiership na yau.
rows.reference: Gwaje-gwaje guda biyu masu jinkiri sun tsallake sakamakon ƙarshe wani iri, amma babu shakka Ayr ya dace ya ci nasara a cikin wannan nishaɗi mai ban mamaki na wasan Premiership na Tennent na ranar.

rows.source: They now top the table, the only unbeaten side of the ten.
rows.output: Yanzu suna kan teburin, daya tilo da ba su yi rashin nasara ba daga cikin goma.
rows.reference: Su ne yanzu ke saman teburin, ɓangare da kaɗai ba a doke ba na goman.

rows.source: In the end, it was their superior defence, as much as their better chance-taking, which carried the home side and coach Peter Murchie had every right to be pleased.
rows.output: A karshe, karfinsu na kare kai ya fi karfinsu na daukar damar samun nasara, wanda ya ba da damar kungiyar ta samu nasara, kuma koci Peter Murchie ya yi daidai da jin dadin hakan.
rows.reference: Daga ƙarshe, tsaronsu da ya fi girma ne, kamar ma samun damarsu ta yin magana sosai, wanda ta ɗauki gefen gidan kuma mai horar da ‘yan wasa Peter Murchie yana dukkan dalili da zai ji daɗi.

rows.source: "We've been tested over our games this far, and we're still unbeaten, so I have to be happy," he said.
rows.output: "Mun yi gwaji a kan wasanninmu har yanzu, kuma ba mu taba yin rashin nasara ba, don haka ina bukatar in yi farin ciki," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “An gwada mu a cikin wasanninmu har zuwa nan, kuma har yanzu ba a doke mu ba, don haka dole na yi murna,” inji shi.

rows.source: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Credit to Ayr, they took their chances better than we did."
rows.output: Robyn Christie ta Melrose ta ce: "Kudi ga Ayr, sun yi amfani da damar da suka fi mu yi."
rows.reference: Robyn Christie na Melrose ya ce: “Yabo ya tabbata ga Ayr, sun ɗauki damammakinsu sosai fiye da yadda muka yi.”

rows.source: Grant Anderson's 14th minute try, converted by Frazier Climo, put Ayr in front, but, a yellow card for Scotland cap Rory Hughes, released for the game by Warriors, allowed Melrose to make numbers tell and Jason Baggot grabbed an unconverted try.
rows.output: A cikin minti na 14, Grant Anderson ya zura kwallo a raga, wanda Frazier Climo ya canza, ya sanya Ayr a gaba. Sai dai, katin rawaya da aka baiwa Rory Hughes, wanda ya fito daga Scotland kuma ya fitar da shi daga wasan, ya ba Melrose damar daidaita adadin kuma Jason Baggot ya zura kwallo a raga ba tare da canji ba.
rows.reference: Gwajin mintina na 14 na gudunmawar Anderson, da  Frazier Climo ya sauya, sa Ayr a gaba, amma, wani rawayar kati don kyaftin na Scotland Rory Hughes, da Warriors suka sake don wasan, ya bari Melrose ta yi lambobin faɗa da Jason Baggot

rows.source: Climo stretched the Ayr lead with a penalty, before, right on half-time, he scored then converted a solo try to make it 17-5 to Ayr at the break.
rows.output: Climo ya taimaka wa Ayr da kwallo, kafin, a karshen rabin, ya ci kwallo sannan ya rama, wanda ya sa aka tashi 17-5 a kan Ayr a lokacin hutu.
rows.reference: Climo ya faɗaɗa shugabancin Ayr tare da wani fenalti, kafin, lokacin hutun rabin lokaci, ya ci shi ke nan ya musanya wani gwajin kai kaɗai don ya sa ya zama 17 zuwa 5 zuwa Ayr a hutun.

rows.source: But Melrose began the second half well and Patrick Anderson's try, converted by Baggot, reduced the leeway to five points.
rows.output: Amma Melrose ta fara sauran rabin da kyau kuma gwajin Patrick Anderson, wanda Baggot ya canza, ya rage tazarar zuwa maki biyar.
rows.reference: Amma Melrose ta fara rabi na biyun ne daidai kuma Patrick Anderson ya yi kokari, da Baggot ya musanya, rage hanyar wucewar zuwa matakai biyar.

rows.source: There was then a lengthy hold-up for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was stretchered off, and from the restart, Ayr surged further ahead through a Stafford McDowall try, converted by Climo.
rows.output: Sannan an yi jinkiri sosai saboda raunin da ya yi tsanani ga Ruaridh Knott, wanda aka kai shi dakin gwaje-gwaje, kuma daga sake farawa, Ayr ta kara kwallo ta hanyar Stafford McDowall, wanda Climo ya zura kwallo a raga.
rows.reference: A da akwai a lokacin wani jinkiri mai tsayi don wani rauni mai yawa ga Ruaridh Knott, wanda aka ɗauka a kan makara, kuma sake farawar, Ayr ta tura gaba dan saman ta hanyar wani gwaji na Stafford McDowall, da Climo ya musanya.

rows.source: Ayr acting captain Blair Macpherson was then yellow-carded, and again, Melrose made the extra man pay with an unconverted Bruce Colvine try, at the end of a spell of fierce pressure.
rows.output: Kyaftin Ayr na yanzu, Blair Macpherson, sai aka ba shi jan kati, kuma, kamar yadda aka saba, Melrose ta yi amfani da karfin da ya wuce kima, tare da zura kwallo a raga ta Bruce Colvine, a karshen wani lokaci mai tsanani.
rows.reference: Sa’an nan an ba wa muƙaddashin kyaftin ɗin Ayr Blair Macpherson kati rawaya, haka kuma, Melrose ya sa mutumin ya ƙara biya wani gwajin Bruce Colvine da ba a musanya ba, daga ƙarshe wani mummuna harin matsi.

rows.source: The home side came back, however, and when Struan Hutchinson was yellow-carded for tackling Climo without the ball, from the penalty line-out, MacPherson touched down at the back of the advancing Ayr maul.
rows.output: Gidan ya dawo, duk da haka, kuma lokacin da Struan Hutchinson ya samu jan kati don kai hari ga Climo ba tare da kwallon ba, daga layin hukuncin, MacPherson ya zura kwallo a raga a bayan harin Ayr.
rows.reference: Ɓangaren gidan ya dawo, amma, kuma a lokacin da aka ba da kati rawaya a Struan Hutchinson don tunkarar Climo ba tare da ƙwallo ba, daga layin wajen fenalti the penalty, MacPherson ya taɓa ƙasa daga bayan tunkuɗewar Ayr da ke kusantowa.

rows.source: Climo converted, as he did again almost from the restart, after Kyle Rowe gathered David Armstrong's box kick and sent flanker Gregor Henry away for the home side's fifth try.
rows.output: Climo ya canza, kamar yadda ya yi sau ɗaya kuma daga sabon farawa, bayan Kyle Rowe ya tattara bugun bugun daga kai sai mai tsaron gida David Armstrong ya tura Gregor Henry mai gefe don cin kwallon gida na biyar.
rows.reference: Climo ya musanyu, kamar yadda ya sake yi aƙalla daga farawa, bayan Kyle Rowe ya tara bugun akwati na David Armstrong kuma ya aika Gregor Henry wani waje don gwajin gefen gida na biyar.

rows.source: Still Game star looks set for new career in restaurant industry
rows.output: Tauraruwar wasan kwaikwayo mai ci gaba tana shirin fara sabon sana'a a masana'antar abinci
rows.reference: Har yanzu tauraro Game ya shirya don sabon aiki a masana’antar sayar da abinci

rows.source: Still Game star Ford Kieran looks set to move into the hospitality industry after it was discovered he's been named as the director of a licensed restaurants company.
rows.output: Tauraron wasan kwaikwayo na har abada Ford Kieran yana shirin shiga masana'antar karbar baki bayan da aka gano cewa an nada shi a matsayin daraktan wani kamfani mai lasisi na gidajen abinci.
rows.reference: Har yanzu tauraro Game Ford Kieran ya nuna ya shirya shiga zuwa cikin masana’antar kulawa bayan an gano an ba shi matsayi na daraktan wani kamfani mai lasisin sayar da abinci.

rows.source: The 56-year-old plays Jack Jarvis on the popular BBC show, which he writes and co-stars with long-time comedy partner Greg Hemphill.
rows.output: Wani mutum mai shekaru 56 yana wasa Jack Jarvis a shahararren shirin BBC, wanda ya rubuta kuma ya yi tare da abokin aikin barkwanci na dogon lokaci Greg Hemphill.
rows.reference: Mai shekaru 56 yana fitowa a Jack Jarvis a cikin sanannen shirin BBC, wanda yake rubutawa da sauran taurari tare da mai haɗn gwiwa dan barkwanci Greg Hemphill.

rows.source: The duo have announced that the upcoming ninth series will be the final one in the show's run, and it appears Kiernan is planning for life after Craiglang.
rows.output: An sanar da cewa jerin na tara na gaba zai zama na ƙarshe a cikin jerin, kuma yana bayyana cewa Kiernan yana shirin rayuwa bayan Craiglang.
rows.reference: Su biyun sun sanar da cewa jerin nau’uka na tara da ke zuwa za su zama na ƙarshe a cikin gudanar da shirin, kuma ya bayyana Kiernan yana shirya rayuwa bayana Craiglang.

rows.source: According to official record listings, he is the director of Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.output: Bisa ga rikodin hukuma, shi ne shugaban kamfanin Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.reference: A cewar rubutaccen labari na jere-jere na kamfani, shi ne darakta na Adriftmorn Limited.

rows.source: The actor declined to comment on the story, though a Scottish Sun source hinted that Kiernan was looking to get involved in Glasgow's "thriving restaurant trade."
rows.output: Dan wasan ya ki yin tsokaci kan labarin, duk da cewa wani tushen The Sun na Scotland ya nuna cewa Kiernan na neman shiga cikin "kasuwancin gidan abinci mai tasowa na Glasgow."
rows.reference: Ɗan wasan kwaikwayon ya ki yin ya ce wani kome a kan labarin, kodayake wata kafar labari ta Scottish Sun ta tsegunta cewa Kiernan yana neman ya shiga cikin “kasuwar sayar da abinci mai ci gaba” ta Glasgow.

rows.source: 'The sea is ours': landlocked Bolivia hopes court will reopen path to Pacific
rows.output: 'Ƙasar tana da mu': Ƙasar da ba ta da ruwa ta Bolivia tana fatan kotu za ta sake buɗe hanyar zuwa Tekun Pasifik
rows.reference: ‘Tekun namu ne’: Bolivia da ke rufe da ƙasa tana fatan kotu za ta buɗe hanyar zuwa Pacific

rows.source: Sailors patrol a rigging-clad naval headquarters in La Paz.
rows.output: Masu ruwa da tsaki suna zagayawa a kan wani shingen ruwa a hedkwatar sojojin ruwa a La Paz.
rows.reference: Matuƙan jirgin ruwa suna sintiri a wurin tsayuwa na hedikwatar sojojin ruwa a cikin La Paz.

rows.source: Public buildings fly an ocean-blue flag.
rows.output: Gine-ginen jama'a suna tashi da tutarsu mai shuɗi mai shuɗi.
rows.reference: Gine-ginen gwamnati sun daga tutar launin teku shudi.

rows.source: Naval bases from Lake Titicaca to the Amazon are daubed with the motto: "The sea is ours by right.
rows.output: Tashoshin ruwa daga tafkin Titicaca zuwa Amazon suna dauke da tambarin: "Ramin namu ne ta doka.
rows.reference: Sansanonin sojojin ruwa daga Tabkin Titicaca zuwa  Amazon da aka sa wa motto: “Teku namu ne a haƙƙi.

rows.source: To recover it is a duty."
rows.output: Don dawo da shi wajibi ne."
rows.reference: Dawo da shi haƙƙinmu ne.”

rows.source: Throughout landlocked Bolivia, the memory of a coastline lost to Chile in a bloody 19th-century resource conflict is still vivid - as is the yearning to sail the Pacific Ocean once more.
rows.output: A duk fadin kasar da aka kewaye da Bolivia, tunanin bakin teku da aka rasa ga Chile a cikin rikicin albarkatun kasa mai jini a karni na 19, har yanzu yana da haske sosai - kamar yadda sha'awar tafiya a cikin tekun Pasifik sau ɗaya.
rows.reference: A cikin gaba ɗaya Bolivia da ke kewaye da ƙasa, tuna rasa wani yankin bakin teku ga Chile wani mummunan rikicin albarkar abu na ƙarni na 19 har yanzu a fili a yake - don saboda shi ne buƙatar su sake bi ta ruwan Tekun Pacific Ocean.

rows.source: Those hopes are perhaps at their highest in decades, as Bolivia awaits a ruling by the international court of justice on 1 October after five years of deliberations.
rows.output: Wadannan fata wataƙila sun kai kololuwa a cikin shekaru goma, yayin da Bolivia ke jiran hukuncin kotun hukunta manyan laifuka a ranar 1 ga Oktoba bayan shekaru biyar na tunani.
rows.reference: Waɗannan ire-iren fata suna watakila mafi girma a cikin shekaru, a lokacin da Bolivia din ke jiran wani ƙaramin hukunci daga kotun duniya a ranar 1 ga Oktoba bayan shekaru biyar ana jin bahasi.

rows.source: "Bolivia has the momentum, a spirit of unity and serenity, and is of course expecting with a positive view the outcome," said Roberto Calzadilla, a Bolivian diplomat.
rows.output: "Bolivia tana da karfin gwiwa, wani ruhin hadin kai da kwanciyar hankali, kuma ba shakka tana sa ran da kyakkyawar hangen nesa sakamakon," in ji Roberto Calzadilla, wani jakadan Bolivian.
rows.reference: "Bolivia tana da kuzari, da halin haɗin kai da kwanciyar hankali, kuma ba shakka tana tsammanin wani kyakkyawan batu da zai fito,” inji Roberto Calzadilla, wani jami’in diflomasiyya na Bolivia.

rows.source: Many Bolivians will watch the ICJ ruling on big screens across the country, hopeful that the tribunal in The Hague will find in favour of Bolivia's claim that - after decades of fitful talks - Chile is obliged to negotiate granting Bolivia a sovereign outlet to the sea.
rows.output: Yawan 'yan Bolivia za su kalli hukuncin kotun ICJ akan manyan alluna a fadin kasar, suna fatan cewa kotun da ke Hague za ta yanke hukunci a kan ikirarin Bolivia cewa - bayan shekaru da dama na tattaunawa marasa tabbas - Chile na da wajibcin tattaunawa na ba Bolivia damar shiga teku.
rows.reference: ‘Yan Bolivia za su kalli hukuncin na Kotun Duniyar a kan manyan talabijoji a faɗin ƙasar, suna masu fatan cewa kotun ta The Hague za ta sami matsaya na yarda da neman na Bolivia - bayan shekaru masu yawa na tattaunawa da ba nasara - Chile ta yarda da tattaunawa inda ta ba wa Bolivia ‘yancin mafita zuwa ga tekun.

rows.source: Evo Morales, Bolivia's charismatic indigenous president - who faces a controversial battle for re-election next year - also has plenty riding on Monday's ruling.
rows.output: Evo Morales, shugaban ƙasar Bolivia mai ban sha'awa da kuma ɗan ƙasar - wanda ke fuskantar wata mummunar gwabza na sake tsayawa takara a shekara mai zuwa - kuma yana da abubuwa da yawa da za su dogara da hukuncin ranar Litinin.
rows.reference: Evo Morales, shugaban Bolivia mai farin jini ɗan asali - wanda ke fuskantar wani yaƙi mai ruɗarwa na sake zaɓe shekara mai zuwa yana da dama mai yawa daga hukuncin na ranar Litinin.

rows.source: "We are very close to returning to the Pacific Ocean," he vowed in late August.
rows.output: "Muna kusa sosai da komawa cikin Tekun Pasifik," ya yi alkawari a karshen watan Agusta.
rows.reference: “Mun kusan dawowa zuwa ga Tekun Pacific,” a wata  jaddadawa a cikin ƙarshen Agusta.

rows.source: But some analysts believe that the court is unlikely to decide in Bolivia's favour - and that little would change if it did.
rows.output: Amma wasu masana sun yi imanin cewa kotun ba za ta yanke hukunci a kan Bolivia ba - kuma ba za a yi sauyi mai yawa ba idan ta yi.
rows.reference: Amma wasu masu fashin baƙi sun yi imani cewa zai yi wahala ta yanke hukunci yadda Bolivia ɗin ke so - kuma cewa ba abin da zai canza idan ta yi.

rows.source: The Netherlands-based UN body has no power to award Chilean territory, and has stipulated that it will not determine the outcome of possible talks.
rows.output: Jami'ar Majalisar Dinkin Duniya da ke kasar Netherlands ba ta da ikon bayar da kasa ga Chile, kuma ta bayyana cewa ba za ta tantance sakamakon tattaunawar da za a yi ba.
rows.reference: Hukumar Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniyar mai mazauni a Netherlands ba ta da iko na bayar da iyakar ta Chile, kuma ta bayyana cewa ba za ta ƙudurta abin da zai bayyana na tattaunawar da za yiwu.

rows.source: That the ICJ's ruling comes only six months after the final arguments were heard indicates the case "wasn't complicated," said Paz Zárate, a Chilean expert in international law.
rows.output: Hukuncin kotun ICJ ya zo ne kawai watanni shida bayan an yi muhawara ta karshe, wanda ke nuna cewa "ba a rikita shi ba," in ji Paz Zárate, kwararre kan doka ta kasa da kasa ta kasar Chile.
rows.reference: Cewar hukunci na Kotun Duniyar yana zuwa ne kawai a bayan watanni shida da jin mahawarorin ƙarshe ya nuna shari’ar “ba ta da rudani,” inji Paz Zárate wata ƙwararriya ‘yar Chile a kan shari’ar ƙasa-da-ƙasa.

rows.source: And far from furthering Bolivia's cause, the past four years may have set it back.
rows.output: Kuma kusa da kara karfafa Bolivia, shekaru hudu da suka gabata sun yi jinkirin ci gaba.
rows.reference: Kuma bai yi kusa da taimakon shari’ar ta Bolivia ba, shekaru huɗun da suka wuce kila sun jawo mata koma baya.

rows.source: "The issue of access to the sea has been hijacked by the current Bolivian administration," said Zárate.
rows.output: "Batun samun damar zuwa teku ya shiga hannun gwamnatin Bolivia a halin yanzu," in ji Zárate.
rows.reference: “Gwamnatin Bolivia ta yanzun ta kame batun na samun iso ga tekun,” inji Zárate.

rows.source: Morales's belligerent rhetoric has sapped any residual Chilean goodwill, she suggested.
rows.output: Kalaman da Morales ya yi ya yi kasa a gwiwa ya lalata duk wani kyakkyawan fata da ya rage na kasar Chile, in ji ta.
rows.reference: “Surutan Morales marassa kyau sun ƙare duk wani tausayi na Chile, a ra’ayinta.

rows.source: Bolivia and Chile will at some point continue to talk, but it will be extremely difficult to hold discussions after this.
rows.output: Bolivia da Chile za su yi magana a wani lokaci, amma zai yi matukar wahala a gudanar da tattaunawa bayan haka.
rows.reference: Bolivia da Chile za su a wani lokaci ci gaba da magana, amma zai zama abu mai wahala sosai a yi wa tattaunawa a bayan wannan.

rows.source: The two countries have not exchanged ambassadors since 1962.
rows.output: Dukkan kasashen biyu ba su yi musayar jakadun gida ba tun 1962.
rows.reference: Ƙasashen biyun ba su yi musayar jakadu ba tun 1962.

rows.source: Former president Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, Bolivia's representative at The Hague, rejected the idea that the court's decision-making was unusually speedy.
rows.output: Tsohon shugaban kasa Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, mai wakiltar Bolivia a Hague, ya ki amincewa da ra'ayin cewa hukuncin kotun ya yi sauri fiye da yadda aka saba.
rows.reference: Tsohon shugaban ƙasa Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, wakilin Bolivia a Hague, ya ki batu na cewa tsarin yanke hukuncin na kotun yana sauri ba yadda aka saba ba.

rows.source: Monday will bring Bolivia "an extraordinary opportunity to open a new era of relations with Chile" and a chance to "put an end to 139 years of disagreements with mutual benefits," he said.
rows.output: Lahadi za ta kawo "wata dama ta musamman wajen bude sabon zamani na dangantaka da Chile" kuma zai ba da damar "kawo karshen shekaru 139 na sabani da amfanin juna," in ji shi.
rows.reference: Litinin za ta kawo wa Bolivia “wata dama da ba irinta don bude wani sabon shafi na huldodi tare da Chile” da kuma wata dama ta “kawo wani karshe ga shekaru 139 na rashin jituwa tare da fa’idoji da juna,” inji shi.

rows.source: Calzadilla also denied that Morales - still one of Latin America's most popular presidents - was using the maritime issue as a political crutch.
rows.output: Calzadilla ya kuma musanta cewa Morales - har yanzu daya daga cikin shugabannin Latin Amurka mafi shahara - yana amfani da batun teku a matsayin taimako na siyasa.
rows.reference: Calzadilla kuma ya ƙi cewa Morales - wanda har yanzu ɗaya ne daga shugabannin Latin America da suka fi farin jini - ya yi amfani ne da batun na teku a matsayin wani abin siyasa.

rows.source: "Bolivia will never give up its right to have access to the Pacific Ocean," he added.
rows.output: "Bolivia ba za ta taba mika 'yancinta na samun damar zuwa Tekun Pasifik ba," ya kara da cewa.
rows.reference: Ya kara da cewa "Bolivia ba za ta taɓa barin haƙƙin taɓa na samun iso zuwa ga Tekun Pacific.”

rows.source: "The ruling is an opportunity to see that we need to overcome the past."
rows.output: "Hukuncin wata dama ce ta ganin cewa muna bukatar mu wuce baya."
rows.reference: “Hukuncin wata dama ce ta ganin cewa an manta abin da ya faru a bayan.”

rows.source: North Korea says nuclear disarmament won't come unless it can trust US
rows.output: Koriya ta Arewa ta ce cire makaman nukiliya ba zai zo ba sai da amincewa da Amurka.
rows.reference: Koriya ta Arewa ta ce rage makaman nukiliya ba zai zo ba sai har za ta iya aminta da Amurka

rows.source: North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho says his nation will never disarm its nuclear weapons first if it can't trust Washington.
rows.output: Ministan Harkokin Waje na Koriya ta Arewa Ri Yong Ho ya ce kasarsa ba za ta yi watsi da makamanta ba, idan ba za ta iya amincewa da Washington ba.
rows.reference: Ministan Harkokin Ƙasashen Waje na Koriya ta Arewa Ri Yong Ho ya ce ƙasarsa ba za ta taɓa rabuwa da makamanta na nukiliya daga farko ba sai idan ba za aminta da Washington ba.

rows.source: Ri was speaking Saturday at the United Nations General Assembly.
rows.output: Ri ta yi magana a ranar Asabar a Majalisar Dinkin Duniya.
rows.reference: Ri yana magana ne ranar Asabar a Babban Taro na Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya.

rows.source: He called on the United States to follow through on promises made during a summit in Singapore between the rivals' leaders.
rows.output: Ya bukaci Amurka da ta cika alkawuran da aka yi a lokacin taron da aka yi a Singapore tsakanin shugabannin biyu masu hamayya.
rows.reference: Ya kira Amurka da ta bi aiwatar da alkawura da aka yi a babban taro a cikin Singapore  tsakanin shugabannin masu gaba.

rows.source: His comments come as US. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo seems to be on the verge of restarting deadlocked nuclear diplomacy more than three months after the Singapore with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.
rows.output: Maganar tasa ta zo ne a daidai lokacin da sakataren harkokin wajen Amurka Mike Pompeo ke shirin sake farfado da tattaunawar makaman nukiliya da ta tsaya cak sabon kwanaki uku bayan ganawarsa da shugaban Koriya ta Arewa Kim Jong Un a Singapore.
rows.reference: Zantukan nasa sun zo ne a yayin da Sakataren Harkokin Ƙasashen Waje na Amurka Mike Pompeo yake dab da sake fara maganar diflomasiyyar da ta ci tura a kan nukiliyar fiye da watanni uku bayan taron Singapore tare da Kim Jong Un na Koriya ta Arewa.

rows.source: Ri says it's a "pipe dream" that continued sanctions and U.S. objection to a declaration ending the Korean War will ever bring the North to its knees.
rows.output: Ri ya ce "mafarkin zinariya" cewa ci gaba da takunkumi da kin amincewar Amurka na sanarwar da ta kawo karshen yakin Koriya za su taba sa Arewacin kasar ta yi kasa a gwiwa.
rows.reference: Ri ya ce wani kawai “mafarki ne” da ke ci gaba da takunkumi da ki na Amurka ga wani furuci wanda kawo ƙarshen Yaƙin Koriya zai taɓa kawo Arewar zuwa ga gwiwowinta.

rows.source: Washington is wary of agreeing to the declaration without Pyongyang first making significant disarmament moves.
rows.output: Washington yana da taka tsantsan game da amincewa da sanarwar ba tare da Pyongyang ta fara yin muhimman ayyukan kawar da makaman nukiliya ba.
rows.reference: Washington tana jin shakkun na yarda da furucin ba tare da Pyongyang da farko ta yi wata muhimmiyar hoɓɓasa na rage makaman ba.

rows.source: Both Kim and U.S. President Donald Trump want a second summit.
rows.output: Dukkan Kim da shugaban Amurka Donald Trump suna son wani taro na biyu.
rows.reference: Gaba ɗaya Kim da Shugaban Amurka Donald Trump suna son wani babban taro na biyu.

rows.source: But there is widespread skepticism that Pyongyang is serious about renouncing an arsenal that the country likely sees as the only way to guarantee its safety.
rows.output: Amma akwai shakku sosai cewa Pyongyang ta yi niyyar janyewa daga makamin da kasar ta ga shi ne kawai hanyar tabbatar da tsaronta.
rows.reference: Amma akwai rashin yarda mai yawa cewa Pyongyang ba ta himmatu sosai ba game da watsi da wani makami da ƙasar ke ganin shi ne kusan kaɗai hanyar garanti ɗinta na samun kariya.

rows.source: Pompeo is planning to visit Pyongyang next month to prepare for a second Kim-Trump summit.
rows.output: Pompeo yana shirin ziyartar Pyongyang a watan mai zuwa domin shirya wani taron Kim da Trump na biyu.
rows.reference: Pompeo yana shirin ziyartar Pyongyang wata mai zuwa don shirya wani babban taro na biyu da Kim da Trump.

rows.source: Paris fashion shows reveal latest line in massive headwear on it's way to a High Street near you
rows.output: Fashar Paris tana bayyana sabon layin manyan huluna da ke kan hanyar zuwa titin ku
rows.reference: Nune-nunen kayan ado na Paris ya fito da mafi sabon layi a cikin kayan ka a kan hanyarsa ta zuwa wani Babban Titi kusa da kai

rows.source: If you want to upsize your hat collection or completely block out the sun then look no further.
rows.output: Idan kuna son kara girman tarin hularku ko kuma ku toshe rana gaba daya to kada ku duba wani abu.
rows.reference: Idan kana son kara girman hularka da ka tara ko toshe gaba ɗaya rana shi ke nan kar ka ƙara gaba.

rows.source: Designers Valentino and Thom Browne unveiled an array of wacky oversized head gear for their SS19 collection on the runway which dazzled the style set at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.output: Masu zanen kaya Valentino da Thom Browne sun gabatar da tarin kayan kwalliya na ban mamaki, masu girma da yawa don tarin SS19 nasu a kan titin da ya mamaye masu sha'awar salon a Makon Kaya na Paris.
rows.reference: Masu tsara kaya Valentino da Thom Browne sun baje-koli wa kayan kai masu girma da kyau don tarun kayansu na SS19 a kan hanyar wucewa waɗanda suka ƙayatar da salon da aka kafa a Makon Kayan Ado na Paris.

rows.source: Highly impractical hats have swept Instagram this summer and these designers have sent their eye-popping creations down the catwalk.
rows.output: Wannan babban kaya masu ban mamaki sun mamaye Instagram a wannan bazara kuma wadannan masu zanen kaya sun aika da abubuwan da suka yi ban mamaki a kan titin catwalk.
rows.reference: Hulunan da ba a iya tunani sun mamaye Instagram wannan damunar kuma waɗannan masu tsara kayan sun zuba idanunsu na ƙirƙire-ƙirƙire a ƙasan tattakin nuna salon kaya.

rows.source: The stand out piece by Valentino was an over-the-top beige hat adorned with a feather-like wide brim that swamped the models heads.
rows.output: Wurin da ya fi fice da Valentino ya yi shi ne babbar hula mai launin ruwan toka mai kauri mai kama da fuka-fuki, wadda ta lullube kai-kai.
rows.reference: Abin da ya fito daga Valentino wata hula ce ta sama da ake sawa da wani gashi da ya mamaye kan masu nuna samfurorin.

rows.source: Other over-sized accessories included bejeweled watermelons, a wizard hat and even a pineapple - but they are not designed to keep your head warm.
rows.output: Sauran kayan ado masu girma sun hada da ruwan biski masu yawan zinariya, hula mai sihiri, da kuma ayaba - amma ba a tsara su don kiyaye kai dumi ba.
rows.reference: Sauran manyan abubuwan tallafin sun haɗa da kankana mai kayan ado, wata hular masu da ma wata abarba - amma ba a tsara su don sa dumi a kanka ba.

rows.source: Thom Browne also revealed a selection of bizarre masks- and just in time for Halloween.
rows.output: Thom Browne shima ya bayyana wani zaɓi na abin ban mamaki - da kuma daidai lokacin hutun Halloween.
rows.reference: Thom Browne kuma ya fio da wani zaɓi na ban mamaki safofin fuska - kuma kawai don lokaci na Halloween.

rows.source: Many of the colourful masks had sewn up lips and resembled more like Hannibal Lecter than haute couture.
rows.output: Yawancin abubuwan ban sha'awa suna da leɓuna da aka haɗa kuma sun yi kama da Hannibal Lecter fiye da haute couture.
rows.reference: Da yawa daga cikin safofin fuskar masu launi suna da ɗinki a leɓɓa kuma sun yi kama da Hannibal Lecter a maimakon salon ado na haute couture.

rows.source: One creation resembled scuba diving gear complete with snorkel and goggles, while another looked like a melted ice cream cone.
rows.output: Wani abu ya yi kama da kayan nutsewa tare da snorkel da gilashin ruwa, yayin da wani ya yi kama da wani kankara da aka narke.
rows.reference: Wata ƙagowar ya yi kama da kayan shiga ruwan teku na scuba tare da snorkel da tubarau, wani kuwa ya yi kama da bututun ƙanƙarar madara mai narkewa.

rows.source: And if you continue the huge fashion statement- you are in luck.
rows.output: Kuma idan kuka ci gaba da wannan babban furcin kayan kwalliya - kuna da sa'a.
rows.reference: Kuma idan ka ci gaba da babban bayani a kan kayan ado - kana cikin nasara.

rows.source: Style watchers predict that the enormous bonnets could be making their way to high streets near you.
rows.output: Masu lura da salon sun yi hasashen cewa manyan kwanduna na iya zuwa kan titunan ku kusa.
rows.reference: Masu kallon salo sun yi kintace cewa manyan bonnets za su iya fara zuwa manyan titunan na kusa da kai.

rows.source: The out-sized hats come hot on the heels of 'La Bomba', the straw hat with a two-foot wide brim that's been seen on everyone from Rihanna to Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.output: Wannan babban hula ta zo ne bayan 'La Bomba', babbar hula mai fadi biyu da aka gani a kan kowa daga Rihanna zuwa Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.reference: Manyan hulunan suna zuwa da kyau a kan takalma masu tsawo na 'La Bomba', hula mai tsinke tare da ƙafofi biyu gajeru da aka gani a kan kowa daga Rihanna zuwa ga Emily Ratajkowski.

rows.source: The cult label behind the highly impractical hat that was splashed across social media sent another big creation down the catwalk - a straw beach bag almost as big as the swimsuit-clad model toting it.
rows.output: Alamar kungiyar da ke bayan wannan babbar hula mai ban tsoro da aka nuna a ko'ina a kafafen sada zumunta, ta aika da wani babban abin kirkire-kirkire a kan titin - wata buhun bakin teku da aka yi da raga, wadda ta kai girman rigar wanka da wata budurwa mai dauke da ita.
rows.reference: An watsa irin yadda hular take da ake maitar so sosai a cikin kafofin sada zumunta mai aika wata babbar kirkira har zuwa wurin tattakin nuna salon ado - ga wata jakar kara ta bakin teku kusan babba kamar samfuri na rigar wanka a ruwa da ake sawa.

rows.source: The burnt orange raffia bag, trimmed with raffia fringing and topped with a white leather handle, was the stand out piece in Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.output: Jajayen jakar raffia mai launin ruwan hoda, wadda aka yi mata ado da gashin raffia da kuma saman da aka yi da fata fari, ita ce babbar jarumar tarin Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 a Paris Fashion Week.
rows.reference: Jakar mai launin lemo, da aka gyara tare da gefe-gefen raffia mai sama na wani farin mariki na fata, ita ce abin da ya yi fice a cikin kayan La Riviera SS19 na Jacquemus a Makon Kayon Ado na Paris. Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris

rows.source: Celebrity stylist Luke Armitage told FEMAIL: 'I'm expecting to see large hats and beach bags arrive on the high street for next summer - as the designer has made such a huge impact it would be hard to ignore the demand for the oversized accessories.'
rows.output: Mai salo mai suna Luke Armitage ya gaya wa FEMAIL: 'Ina sa ran ganin manyan hula da jakunkuna na bakin teku sun zo kan titin don lokacin rani mai zuwa - saboda masu zanen sun yi tasiri sosai, zai yi wuya a yi watsi da bukatar manyan kayan haɗi.'
rows.reference: Sanannen mai salo Luke Armitage ya fada a FEMAIL: ‘Ina tsammanin ganin manyan huluna da jakakkunan bakin teku sun zo a kan babban titi don damuna ta gaba - don saboda mai tsarawar ya yi wani babban tasiri zai yi wahala a manta da buƙatar ta manyan kayayyakin tallafin.’

rows.source: John Edward: Languages skills essential for global citizens
rows.output: John Edward: Ilimin harsuna yana da matukar muhimmanci ga 'yan kasa na duniya
rows.reference: John Edward: Muhimman hikimomin harsuna don ‘yan kasa na duniya

rows.source: Scotland's independent schools maintain a track record of academic excellence, and this has continued in 2018 with another set of outstanding exam results, which is only strengthened by individual and collective success in sports, art, music and other community endeavours.
rows.output: Makarantun da ke da ‘yancin kai a Scotland suna da tarihin samun nasarar ilimi, kuma wannan ya ci gaba a shekarar 2018 tare da wani saitin sakamakon jarabawar da ya yi fice, wanda ya karu da nasarorin da suka samu a wasanni, zane, kiɗa, da sauran ayyukan al’umma.
rows.reference: Makarantun Scotland masu zaman kansu suna riƙe da wani rubutaccen bayani na fice ta fuskar ilmi, kuma wannan ya ci gaba a cikin 2018 tare da wani yanki na sakamakon jarrabawa da ta yi fice, wanda kawai cin nasara mutum da ta tare cikin wasanni, da fasaha, waƙa da sauran al’amuran al’umma ke ƙarfafawa.

rows.source: With upwards of 30,000 pupils across Scotland, these schools, represented by The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS), strive to deliver the best level of service to their pupils and parents.
rows.output: Tare da sama da dalibai 30,000 a duk faɗin Scotland, waɗannan makarantu, wanda Ƙungiyar Makarantun Masu zaman kansu ta Scotland (SCIS) ta wakilta, suna ƙoƙarin samar da mafi kyawun sabis ga ɗalibansu da iyayensu.
rows.reference: Tare da samun ƙarin yara ‘yan makaranta 30,000 a faɗin Scotland, wadannan makarantun, wanda Majalisar Makarantu Masu Zaman Kansu (Scottish Council of Independent Schools), ke hoɓɓasa don samar da lebur na aiki mafi kyau ga ƙananan yara da iyayensu.

rows.source: Independent schools aim to prepare their pupils for further and higher education, their chosen career and their place as global citizens.
rows.output: Makarantun da ba na gwamnati ba suna da burin shirya dalibansu don karatu da manyan makarantu, sana'arsu da zaɓaɓɓu, da kuma matsayinsu na 'yan ƙasa na duniya.
rows.reference: Makarantu masu zaman kansun na da manufa ta shirya yaransu don karin samun babban ilmi, hanyar rayuwa da suka zaɓa da wurinsu a matsayin ‘yan ƙasa na duniya.

rows.source: As an education sector that can design and implement a bespoke school curriculum, we are seeing modern languages continue as a popular and desired subject of choice within schools.
rows.output: A matsayin wani bangare na bangaren ilimi da zai iya tsara da aiwatar da tsarin karatu na musamman, muna ganin harsunan zamani suna ci gaba da zama batun da aka fi so a cikin makarantu.
rows.reference: A matsayin wani sashe na ilmi da zai iya tsara da aiwatar da manhajar makaranta da ake magana, muna ganin harsunan zamani suna ci gaba da da sanuwa da kuma darasi da ake so na zabi a cikin makarantu.

rows.source: Nelson Mandela said: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head.
rows.output: Nelson Mandela ya ce: "Idan ka yi magana da mutum a cikin harshen da ya fahimta, hakan zai shafi kansa.
rows.reference: Nelson Mandela ya ce: “Idan ka yi magana da wani mutum a cikin wani harshe da yake fahimta, wannan yakan shiga kansa.

rows.source: If you talk to him in his own language that goes to his heart."
rows.output: Idan ka yi magana da shi a cikin harshensa, hakan ya shiga zuciyarsa.
rows.reference: Idan ka yi magana da a cikin harshensa wannan yakan shiga zuciyarsa.”

rows.source: This is a powerful reminder that we can't just rely on English when wanting to build relationships and trust with people from other countries.
rows.output: Wannan wani tunatarwa ne mai ƙarfi cewa ba za mu iya dogaro da Turanci kawai ba idan muna son gina dangantaka da amincewa da mutane daga ƙasashe daban-daban.
rows.reference: Wannan wata tunatarwa ce mai ƙarfi cewa ba za mu iya dogaro da Turanci ba a yayin son gina hulɗoɗi da aminci tare da mutane daga sauran ƙasashe.

rows.source: From this year's recent exam results, we can see that languages are topping the league tables with the highest pass rates within independent schools.
rows.output: Daga sakamakon jarabawar da aka yi kwanan nan, za mu iya ganin cewa harsuna suna kan kan teburin gasar da mafi yawan kashi a makarantun da ba na gwamnati ba.
rows.reference: Daga sakamakon jarrabawa na kwanan nan na wannan shekara, za mu iya ganin cewa harsuna suna saman teburan jaddawali tare da kimomi da suka fi girma a cikin makarantu masu zaman kansu.

rows.source: A total of 68 per cent of pupils who studied foreign languages achieved a Higher grade A.
rows.output: Kashi 68 cikin 100 na daliban da suka yi karatun harsunan waje sun sami darajar Higher A.
rows.reference: Wata jimillar kashi 68 cikin ɗari ne na ɗalibai da suka karanta harsunan ƙasashen waje suka sami wata Babbar daraja ta A.

rows.source: The data, collected from SCIS's 74 member schools, showed that 72 per cent of students achieved a Higher grade A in Mandarin, while 72 per cent of those studying German, 69 per cent of those studying French and 63 per cent studying Spanish also achieved an A.
rows.output: Bayanan da aka tattara daga makarantun membobin SCIS 74, sun nuna cewa kashi 72 cikin 100 na daliban da suka yi Mandarin sun sami darajar A, yayin da kashi 72 cikin 100 na wadanda suka yi karatun Jamusanci, kashi 69 cikin 100 na wadanda suka yi Faransanci, da kuma kashi 63 cikin 100 na wadanda suka yi karatun Sipaniya suma sun sami A.
rows.reference: Bayanan, da aka tattara daga mambobin makaranta 74 na SCIS ɗin, sun nuna cewa kashi 72 cikin ɗari na ɗaliban sun ci wata Babbar daraja ta A a cikin Mandarin, sai kuma kashi 72 cikin ɗari na waɗanda suka karanta Jamusanci, kashi 69 cikin ɗari na waɗanda suka karanta Farasanci da kashi 63 cikin ɗari da ke karanta Spanish su ma sun sami wata A.

rows.source: This demonstrates that independent schools in Scotland are supporting foreign languages as vital skills that children and young people will undoubtedly require in the future.
rows.output: Wannan yana nuna cewa makarantun da ba na gwamnati ba a Scotland suna tallafawa harsunan waje a matsayin muhimman ƙwarewa waɗanda yara da matasa za su buƙaci shi tabbatacce a nan gaba.
rows.reference: Wannan yana nuna cewa makarantu masu zaman kansu a cikin Scotland suna goyon bayan harsunan ƙasashen waje a matsayin muhimman hikimomi da yara da samari za su babu shakka buƙata a nan gaba.

rows.source: Languages now, as a subject choice, are being held in the same regard as STEM subjects (science, technology, engineering and mathematics) in independent school curriculums and elsewhere.
rows.output: Yanzu harsuna, a matsayin zaɓin batun, ana ɗaukarsu a matsayin abin daraja iri ɗaya kamar batutuwan STEM (kimiyya, fasaha, injiniya da lissafi) a cikin tsarin makarantun masu zaman kansu da kuma a wasu wurare.
rows.reference: Harsuna a yanzu, a matsayin darasin zaɓi, ana riƙe su a matsayi iri guda kamar darussan STEM (kimiyya, injiniya da lissafi) a cikin manhajojin makarantun masu zaman kansu da kuma wasu wani wurin.

rows.source: A survey by the UK Commission for Employment and Skills in 2014 found that of reasons employers gave for struggling to fill vacancies, 17 per cent were attributed to a languages skills shortage.
rows.output: Wani bincike da Hukumar Burtaniya ta Kula da Ayyuka da Kwarewa ta yi a shekarar 2014 ya gano cewa daga cikin dalilan da ma’aikata ke ganin suna da wahalar cike guraben aiki, kashi 17 cikin 100 na karancin kwarewar harshe ne.
