rows.reference: "Yankin tattalin arziki a kan Iran da Rasha shi ne, mafi yawa ko kasa, amfanuwa da maye gurbin man fetur," in ji shi, yayin da yake magana da Rasha a matsayin "tarin tsabar gari" tare da tattalin arziki da ke dogara da ƙafafun burbushin mai.

rows.source: The statements come as Trump administration has been on a mission to boost the export of its liquefied natural gas to Europe, replacing Russia, the far cheaper option for European consumers.
rows.output: Bayanan sun zo ne a daidai lokacin da gwamnatin Trump ke kokarin kara fitar da iskar gas da aka yi a cikin ruwa zuwa Turai, inda ta maye gurbin Rasha, wacce ita ce mafi arha zaɓi ga masu amfani da Turai.
rows.reference: Maganganun sun zo ne a lokacin da gwamnatin Trump tun da ta fara aiki a kan manufa don inganta fitar da iskar gas ta mai ruwa zuwa Turai, ta maye gurbin Rasha, mafi arhan zabi ga masu amfani da shi a Turai.

rows.source: For that effect, the Trump administration officials, including US President Donald Trump himself, try to persuade Germany to pull out of the "inappropriate" Nord Stream 2 pipeline project, which according to Trump, made Berlin Moscow's "captive."
rows.output: Don wannan dalili, jami'an gwamnatin Trump, ciki har da shugaban Amurka Donald Trump da kansa, suna kokarin shawo kan Jamus da ta janye daga aikin "marasa kyau" na Nord Stream 2, wanda a cewar Trump, ya sa Berlin ta zama "bawon" ga Moscow.
rows.reference: A sakamakon haka, jami'an gwamnatin Trump, ciki har da shugaban Kasar Amurka Donald Trump kansa, yayi ƙoƙarin rinjayar Jamus ta janye "wanda ba daidai ba ne" bututun man Nord Stream 2, wanda a cewar Trump, ya sanya Berlin Moscow’s ta zama “fursuna”.

rows.source: Moscow has repeatedly stressed that the $11 billion Nord Stream 2 pipeline, which is set to double the existing pipeline capacity to 110 billion cubic meters, is a purely economic project.
rows.output: Moscow ta yi ta maimaitawa cewa, na'urar bututun mai na Nord Stream 2 mai daraja dala biliyan 11, wadda za ta ninka karfin bututun da ake da shi zuwa biliyan 110 cubic, aikin tattalin arziki ne kawai.
rows.reference: Moscow ta kara jaddada cewa, Dala biliyan 11 na bututun man Nord Stream 2, wanda aka saita don ninka bututun mai me tasowa a yanzu har zuwa cubic mita biliyan 110, shi ne aikin tattalin arziki ne na gaskiya.

rows.source: The Kremlin argues that Washington's fervent opposition to the project is simply driven by economic reasons and is an example of unfair competition.
rows.output: Kremlin yana jayayya cewa, kin da Washington ke yi na aikin ba wai kawai yana da alaka da tattalin arziki ba, har ma yana nuna gasa mara kyau.
rows.reference: Kremlin ya yi ikirarin cewa babbar hamayya Washington da wannan aikin ta kaddamar da shi ne ta hanyar tattalin arziki kuma ya zama misali na wasan da ba daidai ba.

rows.source: "I believe we share the view that energy cannot be a tool to exercise pressure and that consumers should be able to choose the suppliers," Russian Energy Minister Aleksandr Novak said following a meeting with US Energy Secretary Rick Perry in Moscow in September.
rows.output: "Na yi imani da cewa muna da ra'ayi gama gari cewa makamashin ba zai iya zama kayan aikin matsa lamba ba kuma masu amfani su sami damar zabar masu samar da wutar lantarki," Ministan Makamashi na Rasha Aleksandr Novak ya ce bayan wani taro da Sakataren Makamashi na Amurka Rick Perry a Moscow a watan Satumba.
rows.reference: "Ina ganin mu na da ra'ayi cewa makamashi ba zai zama kayan aikin matsa lamba daya dace ace masu amfani dashi sun zabi masu samar dashi," in ji ministan makamashi na Rasha Aleksandr Novak bayan ganawa da Sakataren Harkokin Makamashin Amurka Rick Perry a Moscow a watan Satumba.

rows.source: The US stance has drawn backlash from Germany, which has reaffirmed its commitment to the project.
rows.output: An yi wa Jamus kuka kan matsayin Amurka, wanda ya tabbatar da jajircewarsa ga aikin.
rows.reference: Matakin Amurka ya jawo martani daga Jamus, wanda ya tabbatar da ƙaddamar da aikin.

rows.source: Germany's leading organization for industry, the Federation of German Industries (BDI), has called on the US to stay away from the EU energy policy and the bilateral agreements between Berlin and Moscow.
rows.output: Jam'iyyar Jamus ta jagoranci masana'antu, Kungiyar Masana'antu ta Jamus (BDI), ta bukaci Amurka ta nisanta kanta daga manufofin makamashin EU da yarjejeniyoyin da ke tsakanin Berlin da Moscow.
rows.reference: Ƙungiyar Jamus ta babbar masana'antu, kungiyar tarayyar masana'antu ta Jamus (BDI) ta yi kira ga Amurka da ta dakatar da manufofin makamashin EU da kuma yarjejeniyar hadin gwiwar tsakanin Berlin da Moscow.

rows.source: "I have a big problem when a third state interferes in our energy supply," Dieter Kempf, head of the Federation of German Industries (BDI) said following a recent meeting between German Chancellor Angela Merkel and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
rows.output: "Ina da matsala mai girma idan wata kasa ta uku ta shiga tsakani a cikin samar da makamashinmu," Dieter Kempf, shugaban kungiyar masana'antu ta Jamus (BDI) ya ce bayan wani taro da aka yi kwanan nan tsakanin firaministan Jamus Angela Merkel da shugaban kasar Rasha Vladimir Putin.
rows.reference: "Ina da babban matsala a yayin da jiha ta uku ta tsoma baki a wutar lantarkinmu," in ji Dieter Kempf, shugaban kungiyar tarayyar masana'antu ta Jamus (BDI), bayan yin wata ganawar da ta gabata tsakanin shugaban Jamus Angela Merkel da shugaban Rasha Vladimir Putin.

rows.source: Elizabeth Warren Will Take "Hard Look" At Running For President in 2020, Massachusetts Senator Says
rows.output: Elizabeth Warren za ta ɗauki "kallo mai wuya" game da gudu don shugaban kasa a 2020, in ji Sanata Massachusetts
rows.reference: Elizabeth Warren za ta yi "kyakkyawan nazari" ga Tsayawa takarar Shugaban kasa a 2020, Sanata Massachusetts ta ce

rows.source: Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren said on Saturday she would take a "hard look" at running for president following the midterm elections.
rows.output: Sanata Elizabeth Warren ta Massachusetts ta ce a ranar Asabar ta yi shirin yin la'akari da tsayawa takarar shugaban kasa bayan zaben tsakiyar wa'adi.
rows.reference: Sanatar Massachusetts Elizabeth Warren ta ce a ranar Asabar za ta yi "kyakkyawan nazari’’ akan tsayawar ta takarar Shugaban kasa bayan gudanar zaben tsaka-tsaki.

rows.source: During a town hall in Holyoke, Massachusetts, Warren confirmed she'd consider running.
rows.output: A yayin taron al'umma a Holyoke, Massachusetts, Warren ya tabbatar da cewa zai yi la'akari da tsayawa takara.
rows.reference: A lokacin da ake majalisar gari a Holyoke, Massachusetts, Warren Ta tabbatar da cewa za ta yi takara.

rows.source: "It's time for women to go to Washington and fix our broken government and that includes a woman at the top," she said, according to The Hill.
rows.output: "Yanzu lokaci ne mata su je Washington su gyara gwamnatinmu ta karye kuma hakan ya hada da mace a matsayi mafi girma," in ji ta, a cewar The Hill.
rows.reference: "Lokaci ya yi da mata za su je Washington domin gyara karyayyiyar gwamnatinmu kuma wannan ya hada da matan dake sama," in ji ta, a cewar The Hill.

rows.source: "After November 6, I will take a hard look at running for president."
rows.output: "Bayan ranar 6 ga watan Nuwamba, zan duba da kyau ko zan tsaya takarar shugaban kasa."
rows.reference: “Bayan Nuwamba 6, Zan yi duba da kyau akan tsayawa takarar shugaban kasa .”

rows.source: Warren weighed in on President Donald Trump during the town hall, saying he was "taking this county in the wrong direction.
rows.output: Warren ya yi magana kan shugaban kasa Donald Trump a yayin taron al'umma, yana mai cewa yana "janyo wannan kasa zuwa ga kuskure."
rows.reference: Warren ta yi tuhuma akan Shugaban Kasa Donald Trump a majalisar garin, yana cewa “yana mulkin kasar ta hanyar da bata dace ba.

rows.source: "I am worried down to my bones about what Donald Trump is doing to our democracy," she said.
rows.output: Ina matukar damuwa da kasusuwa game da abin da Donald Trump ke yi wa dimokuradiyyarmu," ta ce.
rows.reference: “Ina matukar damuwa akan abun da Donald Trump yake ma dimokuradiyyarmu,” ta ce.

rows.source: Warren has been outspoken in her criticism of Trump and his Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Warren ta yi tsokaci mai karfi kan Trump da kuma wanda ya gabace shi a Kotun Koli, Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Warren ta dade tana sukar Trump da Wakilin sa na Babban Kotu Brett Kavanaugh.

rows.source: In a tweet on Friday, Warren said "of course we need an FBI investigation before voting."
rows.output: A ranar Juma'a, Warren ya ce "tabbas muna bukatar binciken FBI kafin kada kuri'a."
rows.reference: A wani tween ranar Juma’a, Warren ta ce, “hakika mu na bukatan bincinken FBI kafin zabe.”

rows.source: A poll released on Thursday, however, showed a majority of Warren's own constituents do not think she should run in 2020.
rows.output: Wani bincike da aka fitar a ranar Alhamis ya nuna cewa mafi rinjaye na 'yan mazabar Warren ba sa tunanin ya kamata ta tsaya takara a shekarar 2020.
rows.reference: Wani sakamakon zabe da aka saki ranar Alhamis, duk da haka, ya nuna yawancin ‘yan yankin Warren basa tunanin tayi takara a 2020.

rows.source: Fifty-eight percent of "likely" Massachusetts voters said the senator should not run, according to the Suffolk University Political Research Center/Boston Globe poll.
rows.output: Hamsin da takwas cikin dari na masu kada kuri'a a Massachusetts da suka yi kama da tabbatacce sun ce bai kamata Sanata ya tsaya takara ba, a cewar binciken siyasa na Jami'ar Suffolk/Globe.
rows.reference: Kashi hamsin da takwas na “yiyuwar” mazaban Massachusetts sun ce ‘yar majalisar kar tayi takara, bisa ga zaben Cibiyar Binciken Siyasa ta Jimi’ar Suffolk/Zaben Duniya na Boston.

rows.source: Thirty-two percent supported such a run.
rows.output: Sittin da biyu cikin dari sun goyi bayan irin wannan gudu.
rows.reference: Kashi talatin da biyu sun ba da goyon bayan wannan takaran.

rows.source: The poll showed more support for a run by former Governor Deval Patrick, with 38 percent supporting a potential run and 48 percent against it.
rows.output: An yi binciken ya nuna cewa akwai karin goyon baya ga tafiyar da tsohon Gwamna Deval Patrick, inda kashi 38 cikin 100 na wadanda aka yi binciken suka goyi bayan yuwuwar tafiyar da kuma kashi 48 cikin 100 sun yi adawa da shi.
rows.reference: Sakamakon zaben ya nuna mafi goyon bayan takarar tsohon gwamna Deval Patrick, wanda kashi 38 su na nuna goyon bayan yiyuwar takarar da kuma kashi 48 marasa goyon baya shi.

rows.source: Other high profile Democratic names discussed in regard to a potential 2020 run include former Vice President Joe Biden and Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders.
rows.output: Sauran manyan mutane a cikin jam'iyyar Democrat da aka tattauna game da yiwuwar takara a shekarar 2020 sun hada da tsohon mataimakin shugaban kasa Joe Biden da Sanata Bernie Sanders daga Vermont.
rows.reference: Wasu manyan ‘yan Kungiyar Dimokuradiyya da aka tattauna akan yiyuwar takara a 2020 har da tsohon Mataimakin Shugaban Kasa Joe Biden da Dan Majalisar Vermont Bernie Sanders.

rows.source: Biden said he would decide officially by January, the Associated Press reported.
rows.output: Biden ya ce zai yanke shawara a hukumance a watan Janairu, kamar yadda hukumar Associated Press ta ruwaito.
rows.reference: Biden ya ce zai yanke shawara zuwa January, Associated Press ta kawo rihoto.

rows.source: Sarah Palin cites Track Palin's PTSD at Donald Trump rally
rows.output: Sarah Palin ta ambaci Track Palin's PTSD a taron Donald Trump
rows.reference: Sarah Palin Ta kaddamar da PTSD din Track Palin a taron Donald Trump

rows.source: Track Palin, 26, spent a year in Iraq after enlisting on Sept.
rows.output: Track Palin, 26, ya shafe shekara guda a Iraki bayan ya shiga aikin a watan Satumba.
rows.reference: Track Palin, 26, ta yi shekara daya a Iraki bayan ta shiga soja a Satumba.

rows.source: He was arrested and charged in a domestic violence incident on Monday night
rows.output: An kama shi kuma an gurfanar da shi a gaban kotu a wani lamari na cin zarafin gida a ranar Litinin da yamma
rows.reference: An ɗaure shi kuma an caje shi da tashin hankalin gida a daren Litinin

rows.source: "What my own son is going through, what he is going through coming back, I can relate to other families who feel ramifications of PTSD and some of the woundedness that our soldiers do return with," she told the audience at a rally for Donald Trump in Tulsa, Oklahoma.
rows.output: "Abin da ɗana nake fuskanta, abin da yake fuskanta lokacin dawowa, zan iya danganta shi da sauran iyalai da ke jin sakamakon PTSD da kuma wasu raunuka da sojojinmu ke dawowa da su," ta gaya wa masu sauraro a wani gangami na Donald Trump a Tulsa, Oklahoma.
rows.reference: “Abin da ɗana yake ciki, abin da yake farfaɗowa daga, zan iya danganta da sauran iyalan da suke jin ƙaddamarwa game da PTSD da kuma wasu daga cikin raunin da sojoji suke dawo da su, ta faɗa wa mutanen dake taron Donald Trump a Tulsa, Oklahoma.

rows.source: Palin called his arrest "the elephant in the room" and said of her son and other war veterans, "they come back a bit different, they come back hardened, they come back wondering if there is that respect for what it is that their fellow soldiers and airmen, and every other member of the military, has given to the country."
rows.output: Palin ya kira kama shi "doki a cikin dakin" ya ce game da ɗansa da sauran sojojin yaki, "suna dawowa kaɗan daban, suna dawowa da ƙarfi, suna dawowa suna mamakin ko akwai girmamawa ga abin da sojoji da jiragen sama, da kowane memba na soja, ya ba wa ƙasar."
rows.reference: Palin ta kira ɗaurin da aka masa “Giwa a cikin ɗaki” kuma ta ce akan ɗanta da wasu sojojin yaki, “su na dawowa a wani yanayi daban, su na da dawowa da rashin tausayi, su na dawowa a cikin tunanin idan akwai wannan girmamawan da yan’uwansu sojoji na kasa da na sama, da duk wani jam’in tsaro ya ba wa kasar sa.”

rows.source: He was arrested on Monday in Wasilla, Alaska, and charged with domestic violence assault on a female, interfering with a report of domestic violence and possession of a weapon while intoxicated, according to Dan Bennett, a spokesman for the Wasilla Police Department.
rows.output: An kama shi a ranar Litinin a Wasilla, Alaska, kuma an tuhume shi da cin zarafin gida, tsangwama wajen bayar da rahoton cin zarafin gida, da mallakar makami yayin shan giya, a cewar Dan Bennett, kakakin rundunar ‘yan sandan Wasilla.
rows.reference: An kama shi ne ranan Litinin a Wasilla, Alaska, kuma an caje shi da tashin hankalin cikin gida akan mace, tsoma kai a cikin rihoto akan tashin hankalin cikin gida da mallakar makami a yayin maye, a cewar Dan Bennet, Wakilin Sahen Yan Sanda na Wasilla.

rows.source: 18 states, D.C. support challenge to new asylum policy
rows.output: 18 jihohi, D.C. sun goyi bayan kalubalen manufofin sabon mafaka
rows.reference: Jihohi 18, D.C. su na goyon bayan kalubalen sabon tsarin mafaka

rows.source: Eighteen states and the District of Columbia are supporting a legal challenge to a new U.S. policy that denies asylum to victims fleeing gang or domestic violence.
rows.output: Akwai jihohi goma sha takwas da kuma yankin Columbia na goyon bayan kalubalantar doka ga sabuwar manufofin Amurka da ke hana bayar da matsuguni ga wadanda suka tsere daga tashin hankali na kungiyoyi ko kuma tashin hankali a gida.
rows.reference: Jihohi goma sha takwas da Gundumar Columbia su na goyon bayan kalubalen shari’a akan sabon tsarin Amurka da ke hanin mafaka ga tashin hankalin yan daba da tashin hankalin cikin gida.

rows.source: Representatives from the 18 states and the district filed a friend-of-the-court brief Friday in Washington to support an asylum-seeker challenging the policy, NBC News reported.
rows.output: Wakilan jihohi 18 da kuma babban birnin tarayya sun gabatar da wata kara ta abokan shari’a a ranar Juma’a a Washington don tallafawa wanda ke neman mafaka da ke kalubalantar manufofin, a cewar NBC News.
rows.reference: Wakilai daga kasashe 18 da gundumar sun yi fayil din bayanin abokin kotu ranar Juma’a, a Washington dan goyon bayan kalubalen mai neman mafaka akan tsarin, NBC ta kawo rihoto.

rows.source: The full name of the plaintiff in the Grace v. Sessions suit that the American Civil Liberties Union filed in August against the federal policy has not been revealed.
rows.output: Sunan cikakken wanda ke da hannu a karar Grace v. Sessions wanda kungiyar kare hakkin bil'adama ta Amurka ta shigar a watan Agusta a kan manufofin tarayya bai fito ba.
rows.reference: cikakken sunan Mai Kara a cikin Grace v. Ba’a warware karar taro da Kungiyar Yakin Basasa ta Amurka ta kai a Agusta akan tsarinn gwamnatin tarrayayar ba.

rows.source: She said her partner "and his violent gang member sons," abused her but U.S. officials denied her request for asylum July 20.
rows.output: Ta ce abokin zamanta da "ɗansa mai tayar da hankali," sun yi mata fyade, amma jami'an Amurka sun ki amincewa da bukatarta ta neman mafaka a ranar 20 ga Yuli.
rows.reference: Ta ce abokiyar tarayyar ta “tare da rigimammun yaran shi yan daba,” sun zage ta amma jami’an Amurka sun hana bukatar mafakar ta Yuli 20.

rows.source: She was detained in Texas.
rows.output: An kama ta a Texas.
rows.reference: An garkame ta a Texas.

rows.source: The states' attorneys supporting Grace described El Salvador, Honduras and Guatemala, which produce a large number of applicants for U.S. asylum, as nations facing pervasive problems with gangs and domestic violence.
rows.output: An bayyana kasashen El Salvador, Honduras da Guatemala, wadanda ke samar da mafi yawan masu neman mafaka a Amurka, a matsayin kasashe da ke fuskantar matsaloli masu yawa da suka shafi kungiyoyin asiri da cin zarafin gida.
rows.reference: Lauyoyin jiha masu goyon bayan Grace sun kamanta El Salvador, Honduras da Guatemala, waɗanda ke samar da masu neman mafaka a Amurka da yawa, a matsayin jihohi masu fuskantar matsaloli masu yawa da yan daba da tashn hankalin cikin gida.

rows.source: The new U.S. asylum policy reversed a 2014 decision by the Board of Immigrant Appeals that allowed undocumented immigrants fleeing domestic violence to apply for asylum.
rows.output: Manufar sabuwar hukumar shige da fice ta Amurka ta soke hukuncin da hukumar shige da fice ta yi a shekarar 2014 na baiwa masu shige da fice da ke tserewa cin zarafin gida damar neman mafaka.
rows.reference: Sabon tsarin mafakan ya yi juyi da wani yanke shawarar 2014 ta Hukumar Izinin Shiga da Fice wanda ya ke barin masu gudun tashin hankalin cikin gida da ba su da takardu su nemi mafaka.

rows.source: District of Columbia Attorney General Karl Racine said in a statement Friday that the new policy "ignores decades of state, federal, and international law."
rows.output: Kwamishinan Shari'a na Birnin Washington Karl Racine ya ce a cikin wata sanarwa a ranar Juma'a cewa manufar "ta yi watsi da shekaru da dama na dokokin jihar, tarayya da na kasa da kasa."
rows.reference: Babban Lauyan Gundumar Columbia Karl Racine, ya ce a cikin wata sanarwar Juma'a cewa sabuwar manufar "ba ta kula da shekarun da suka gabata na jaha, tarayya, da shari’ar kasa da kasa."

rows.source: "Federal law requires that all asylum claims be adjudicated on the particular facts and circumstances of the claim, and such a bar violates that principle," the friend-of-the court brief said.
rows.output: "Ka'idojin doka na tarayya ya bukaci a tantance dukkan ikirarin neman mafaka bisa ga takamaiman gaskiya da halin da ake ciki na wannan ikirari, kuma irin wannan haramcin ya saba wa wannan ka'ida," in ji takardar shigar da abokan hulɗa.
rows.reference: “Shari’ar Tarayya na bukatar cewa duk wani ikirarin neman mafaka da za a yanke hukunci a kan ainihin lamarin da, kuma irin wannan igiya ya karya wannan ka'idar, "in ji abokin shawarar kotu.

rows.source: Attorneys further argued in the brief that the policy denying immigrants entry hurts the U.S. economy, saying they are more likely to become entrepreneurs and "supply necessary labor."
rows.output: An kuma lauyoyin sun kara da cewa manufar hana ‘yan kasashen waje shiga kasar na cutar da tattalin arzikin Amurka, inda suka ce sun fi yin kasuwanci kuma suna samar da “aikin da ake bukata.”
rows.reference: Hukumomi sun ci gaba da jaddada bayyanan cewa manufofin hana ‘yan hijara shiga cutar da tattalin arzikin Amurka, su na cewa za su iya zama 'yan kasuwa da "samar da aikin da ya kamata."

rows.source: Attorney General Jeff Sessions ordered immigration judges to no longer grant asylum to victims fleeing domestic abuse and gang violence in June.
rows.output: Babban Lauyan Amurka Jeff Sessions ya umurci alkalan shige da fice da su daina bayar da izinin zama ga wadanda suka tsere daga cin zarafin gida da kuma tashin hankali na kungiyoyi a watan Yuni.
rows.reference: Babban Lauya Jeff Sessions ya umarci mahukuntan bakin haure da kada su sake ba da mafaka ga waɗanda ke fama da mummunar tashin hankali a cikin gida da kuma rikicin daba a watan Yuni.

rows.source: "Asylum is available for those who leave their home country because of persecution or fear on account of race, religion, nationality, or membership in a particular social group or political opinion," Sessions said in his June 11 announcement of the policy.
rows.output: "An ba da izinin neman mafaka ga wadanda suka bar kasarsu ta asali saboda tsangwama ko fargabar da suka samu saboda launin fata, addini, kasa, ko kuma zama memba na wata kungiya ta musamman, ko kuma ra'ayin siyasa," in ji Sessions a sanarwar da ya yi a ranar 11 ga watan Yuni.
rows.reference: "Mafaka na samuwa ga waɗanda suka bar ƙasarsu saboda zalunci ko tsoro saboda kabilanci, addini, asali, ko wakilci a wata ƙungiya ko ra'ayin siyasa," Sessions ya ce a ranar 11 ga watan yuni na sanarwar manufofin.

rows.source: Asylum was never meant to alleviate all problems -- even all serious problems -- that people face every day all over the world.
rows.output: Asylum was never meant to alleviate all problems -- even all serious problems -- that people face every day all over the world.
rows.reference: Bada mafaka ba zai warware dukkan matsalolin ba - ko dukan matsaloli masu tsanani - da mutane ke fuskantar kowace rana a duk faɗin duniya.

rows.source: Desperate rescue efforts in Palu as death toll doubles in race to find survivors
rows.output: Yunƙurin ceto da ake yi a Palu yayin da adadin wadanda suka mutu ya ninka a cikin gaggawar neman wadanda suka tsira.
rows.reference: Ƙoƙarin gaggawa na ceto a Palu yayin da mutuwar mutane ke kara tsanantuwa a gudun ceto rayayyu

rows.source: For survivors, the situation was increasingly dire.
rows.output: Ga waɗanda suka tsira, halin da ake ciki ya zama mai haɗari sosai.
rows.reference: Ga rayayyun, halin da ake ciki ya kara daɗuwa.

rows.source: "It feels very tense," said 35-year-old mother Risa Kusuma, comforting her feverish baby boy at an evacuation centre in the gutted city of Palu.
rows.output: "Yana jin kamar an cika shi da tashin hankali," in ji mahaifiyar shekara 35 Risa Kusuma, tana ta'aziyya ga jaririnta mai zazzabi a cibiyar tattara mutane a cikin birnin da ya lalace na Palu.
rows.reference: "Yana na da tashin hankali," in ji uwargida mai shekaru 35, Risa Kusuma, tana ta'azantar da jaririnta a wani wuri da aka aje su a garin Palu.

rows.source: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.
rows.output: Kowane minti, motar asibiti tana kawo gawarwaki.
rows.reference: “Cikin kowane minti motar asibiti ke shigo da gawawaki.

rows.source: Clean water is scarce."
rows.output: Ruwa mai tsafta yana da wuya a samu."
rows.reference: Ga wahala tsabtataccen Ruwa.”

rows.source: Residents were seen returning to their destroyed homes, picking through waterlogged belongings, trying to salvage anything they could find.
rows.output: Mazauna garin sun fara dawowa gidajensu da aka lalata, suna duba kayansu da ruwa ya shafa, suna kokarin ceto duk abin da za su iya samu.
rows.reference: An ga mazauna wurin su na dawowa gidaje su da ke a rushe, su na tsintar kayayyakin daga cikin ruwa, su na ƙoƙarin kimtsa duk abin da zasu iya samu.

rows.source: Hundreds of people were injured and hospitals, damaged by the magnitude 7.5 quake, were overwhelmed.
rows.output: Dubban mutane sun jikkata kuma asibitoci, da aka lalata ta girgizar da ta kasance 7.5, sun yi cunkoso.
rows.reference: Daruruwan mutane sun jikkata kuma asibitoci, sun lalace sakamakon girgizar kasa mai tsananin 7.5, ya mamaye.

rows.source: Some of the injured, including Dwi Haris, who suffered a broken back and shoulder, rested outside Palu's Army Hospital, where patients were being treated outdoors due to continuing strong aftershocks.
rows.output: Wasu daga cikin wadanda suka jikkata, ciki har da Dwi Haris, wanda ya samu karyewar baya da kafada, sun huta a wajen Asibitin Sojojin Palu, inda ake yi wa marasa lafiya magani a waje saboda har yanzu ana samun karfin girgizar kasa mai karfi.
rows.reference: Wasu daga cikin waɗanda suka jikkata, cikinsu har da Dwi Haris, wanda ya sami rauni a baya da kafada, yana hutawa a bayan asibitin Palu’s Army, inda ake kula da marasa lafiya a waje saboda karfin Jiamamin abun da ya faru.

rows.source: Tears filled his eyes as he recounted feeling the violent earthquake shake the fifth-floor hotel room he shared with his wife and daughter.
rows.output: Kukan ya cika masa idanu yayin da yake ba da labarin jin girgizar kasa mai karfi da ta girgiza dakin otal na hamsin da daya da ya raba da matarsa ​​da ‘yarsa.
rows.reference: Hawaye ya cika idanunsa yayin da yake tuna yanayin girgizar kasa ta girgiza har dakin otel hawa na biyar da yake da matarsa ​​da 'yar shi.

rows.source: "There was no time to save ourselves.
rows.output: Babu lokaci don mu kai ga kanmu.
rows.reference: “Bamu da lokacin tseratar da kammu.

rows.source: I was squeezed into the ruins of the wall, I think," Haris told Associated Press, adding that his family was in town for a wedding.
rows.output: An danna ni cikin tarkacen bango, ina tsammani," Haris ya gaya wa Associated Press, yana kara cewa danginsa suna cikin birnin don wani aure.
rows.reference: An matse ni cikin rusasshen bango, ina tsammanin, "Haris ya shaidawa Gamammun yan Jarida, ya kara da cewa iyalinsa sun zo garin ne don bikin aure.

rows.source: "I heard my wife cry for help, but then silence.
rows.output: Na ji matata tana kuka don taimako, sai kuma shiru.
rows.reference: “Na ji matata na kukan nema taimako, sai kuma shiru.

rows.source: I don't know what happened to her and my child.
rows.output: Ban sani ba abin da ya faru da ita da jaririna.
rows.reference: Ban san mai ya faru da ita da ‘ya ta ba.

rows.source: I hope they are safe."
rows.output: Ina fatan suna lafiya."
rows.reference: Ina tsammanin dai su na lafiya.”

rows.source: U.S. ambassador accuses China of 'bullying' with 'propaganda ads'
rows.output: Kwamishinan Amurka ya zargi kasar Sin da "kai hari" da "talla ta propaganda"
rows.reference: Jakadan Amurka ya zargi kasar Sin da 'cin zarafi' tare da 'farfaganda talla'

rows.source: A week after an official Chinese newspaper ran a four-page ad in a U.S. daily touting the mutual benefits of U.S.-China trade, the U.S. ambassador to China accused Beijing of using the American press to spread propaganda.
rows.output: Mako guda bayan wata jarida ta hukuma ta kasar Sin ta buga talla mai shafi hudu a cikin wata jarida ta Amurka tana bayyana fa'idodin juna na kasuwancin Amurka da kasar Sin, jakadan Amurka a kasar Sin ya zargi birnin Beijing da amfani da kafafen yada labarai na Amurka wajen yada labaran karya.
rows.reference: A mako daya bayan wata jarida ta kasar Sin ta yi amfani da shafuka hudu a kowace rana tana tallar kushe alakar kasuwanci Amurka - Sin, duk da haka, jakadun Amurka na kasar Sin ya zargi Beijing da yin amfani da manema labaran Amurka da yada farfaganda.

rows.source: U.S. President Donald Trump last Wednesday referred to the China Daily's paid supplement in the Des Moines Register - the state of Iowa's biggest selling newspaper - after accusing China of seeking to meddle in the Nov. 6 U.S. congressional elections, a charge China denies.
rows.output: Shugaban Amurka Donald Trump ya yi magana a ranar Laraba da ta gabata game da China Daily, wani shiri da ake biyan kuɗi a cikin jaridar Des Moines Register, wadda ita ce jaridar da ta fi sayarwa a jihar Iowa, bayan da ya zargi kasar Sin da ƙoƙarin yin tasiri a zaben majalisar dokokin Amurka na ranar 6 ga watan Nuwamba, wani zargi da kasar Sin ta musanta.
rows.reference: Amurka Shugaban kasar Donald Trump a ranar Laraba da ta gabata ya nuna cewa Sin na biyan kudi a kullum ga ragista Des Moines - Jarida mafi yawan sayarwa a Jihar Iowa - bayan da aka zarge kasar Sin da neman shiga harkokin a zaben shugaban kasa na watan Nuwamba 6, zargin da Sin ta karyata.

rows.source: Trump's accusation that Beijing was trying to meddle in U.S. elections marked what U.S. officials told Reuters was a new phase in an escalating campaign by Washington to put pressure on China.
rows.output: Zargin Trump cewa Beijing na kokarin yin tasiri a zaben Amurka ya nuna wani sabon mataki a cikin yakin da ke kara tsananta da gwamnatin Amurka ke yi na matsa wa kasar Sin lamba.
rows.reference: Zargin Trump akan cewa Beijing tana kokarin neman shiga harkokin a zaben Amurka wanda ya nuna cewa jami'an Amurka sun shaida wa kamfanin dillancin labarun Reuters cewa, wani sabon shiri ne na Washington da Amurka ta matsa lamba kan kasar Sin.

rows.source: While it is normal for foreign governments to place advertisements to promote trade, Beijing and Washington are currently locked in an escalating trade war that has seen them level rounds of tariffs on each other's imports.
rows.output: Yayin da al'ada ce ga gwamnatocin kasashen waje su saka tallace-tallace don inganta kasuwanci, har yanzu birnin Beijing da Washington na cikin wani yaki na kasuwanci da ke kara ta'azzara wanda ya sa suka sanya haraji kan juna.
rows.reference: Daidai ne ga gwamnatocin kasashen waje su gabatar da tallace-tallace don inganta cinikayya, Beijing da Washington su na kulle a cikin wani yunkurin cinikayyar yaki wanda ya kai su ga matakan jadawalin kudaden shiga akan kowane.

rows.source: China's retaliatory tariffs early in the trade war were designed to hit exporters in states such as Iowa that supported Trump's Republican Party, Chinese and U.S. experts have said.
rows.output: An kuma yi wa masu fitar da kayayyaki daga jihohi kamar Iowa da suka goyi bayan jam'iyyar Republican ta Trump, in ji masana kasar Sin da Amurka.
rows.reference: Martanin kasar Sin na farkon akan jadawalin kuɗin fito a yakin kasuwanci shi ne kaddamar da masana'antu da za su karya jihohi irin su Iowa wanda dake goyon bayan Jam'iyyar Republican Party na Trump, Sinanci da Amurka suka fada.

rows.source: Terry Branstad, the U.S. ambassador to China and the former longtime governor of Iowa, a major exporter of agricultural goods to China, said Beijing had hurt American workers, farmers and businesses.
rows.output: Terry Branstad, jakadan Amurka a kasar Sin kuma tsohon gwamnan Iowa, babban mai fitar da kayayyakin noma zuwa kasar Sin, ya ce birnin Beijing ya cutar da ma’aikatan Amurka, manoma da ‘yan kasuwa.
rows.reference: Terry Branstad, jakadan Amurka a kasar Sin da kuma tsohon gwamnan jihar Iowa, babban mai sayar da kayan aikin noma zuwa kasar Sin, ya ce Beijing ta cutar da ma'aikatan Amurka, manoma da kasuwanni.

rows.source: China, Branstad wrote in an opinion piece in Sunday's Des Moines Register, "is now doubling down on that bullying by running propaganda ads in our own free press."
rows.output: An kai kasar Sin, Branstad ya rubuta a wani rubutu na ra'ayi a cikin jaridar Des Moines a ranar Lahadi, "yana kara matsawa kan wannan tashin hankali ta hanyar gudanar da tallace-tallacen yada labarai a cikin jaridunmu na 'yanci."
rows.reference: Sin, Branstad ya rubuta a wani sashi na ra'ayi a ranar Lahadi cikin Ragista Des Moines, "yanzu yana raguwar a kan wannan cin zarafi ta hanyar yin amfani da tallace-tallacen farfaganda a cikin jaridun kyauta."

rows.source: "In disseminating its propaganda, China's government is availing itself of America's cherished tradition of free speech and a free press by placing a paid advertisement in the Des Moines Register," Branstad wrote.
rows.output: "A cikin yada yakin neman zabensa, gwamnatin kasar Sin tana amfani da wani al'adar Amurka da ake so na 'yancin faɗar albarkacin baki da 'yancin jarida ta hanyar sanya talla a jaridar Des Moines Register," in ji Branstad.
rows.reference: "A cikin watsa labaran furofaganda, gwamnatin kasar Sin tana ba da gudummawa game da kirkirar al'adun Amurka na ‘yancin magana da ‘yancin yan jaridu ta hanyar biyan tallace-tallace a cikin Ragista Des Moines," in ji Branstad.

rows.source: "In contrast, at the newsstand down the street here in Beijing, you will find limited dissenting voices and will not see any true reflection of the disparate opinions that the Chinese people may have on China's troubling economic trajectory, given that media is under the firm thumb of the Chinese Communist Party," he wrote.
rows.output: "A gefe guda, a gidan jarida a kan titin nan a birnin Beijing, ba za ku sami muryoyin da suka yi watsi da hukuma da yawa ba, kuma ba za ku ga wani tunani na gaskiya ba game da ra'ayoyin da suka bambanta da 'yan kasar Sin za su iya yi game da hanyar tattalin arzikin kasar Sin mai damuwa, ganin cewa kafafen yada labarai suna karkashin kulawar karfi na jam'iyyar Kwaminis ta Sin."
rows.reference: Ya kara da cewar, "a gurin karatu a birnin Beijing, za ku samu ba hayaniyar muryoyi da zai iya hanaku fahimtar ra’ayoyi daban-daban da al'ummar kasar Sin ke fuskanta na damuwar tatalin arziki, saboda gidan watsa labarai na karkashin ikon Jam'iyyar Kwaminis ta Sin, "in ji shi.

rows.source: He added that "one of China's most prominent newspapers dodged the offer to publish" his article, although he did not say which newspaper.
rows.output: Ya kara da cewa "daya daga cikin manyan jaridun kasar Sin ta ki amincewa da buga" labarinsa, duk da cewa bai bayyana wace jarida ba.
rows.reference: Ya kara da cewa "daya daga cikin jaridu mafi shahara a kasar Sin ya yi watsi da tayin don buga" labarinsa, duk da dai bai fadi wace jarida ce ba.

rows.source: Republicans Alienating Women Voters Ahead of Midterms With Kavanaugh Debacle, Analysts Warn
rows.output: Masu ra'ayin mazan jiya suna takaici 'yan mata masu jefa kuri'a kafin tsakiyar lokaci tare da bala'in Kavanaugh, masana sun yi gargadi
rows.reference: 'Yan Republican Su na Rarraba Kan Mata Masu Zabe Gabanin Tsaka-Tsakin Mulki Tare da Kavanaugh Debacle, Masu sa ido sunyi gargadin

rows.source: As many top Republicans stand-by and defend Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh in the face of several allegations of sexual assault, analyst have warned they will see a backlash, particularly from women, during the upcoming midterm elections.
rows.output: Yayin da yawancin manyan 'yan Republican ke tsaye tare da kare zababben alkali na Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh a gaban da'awar cin zarafi da dama, masana sun yi gargadin cewa za su fuskanci mummunan sakamako musamman daga mata a lokacin zaben tsakiyar wa'adi.
rows.reference: Da yawa daga cikin manya Republican sun tsaya kyam kuma su na kare wakilin Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh yayin da yake fuskantar zargin cin zarafin mata, masu sa ido sun yi gargadin cewa za su ga cikas, musamman daga mata, a lokacin zaɓen a tsaka-tsaki mai zuwa.

rows.source: The emotions surrounding this have been extremely high, and most Republicans are on record already showing they wanted to go forward with a vote.
rows.output: Tunanin da ke tattare da wannan ya kasance mai girma sosai, kuma mafi yawan 'yan Republican sun riga sun rubuta ra'ayinsu na son ci gaba da kada kuri'a.
rows.reference: Halin da ke kewaye da wannan ya kasance mai girma, kuma yawancin 'yan Jamhuriyyar Republican su na cikin tsarin dake nuna cewa su na son ci gaba da zabe.

rows.source: Those things can't be walked back," Grant Reeher, a professor of political science at Syracuse University's Maxwell School told The Hill for an article published Saturday.
rows.output: Wadannan abubuwa ba za a iya komawa baya ba," Grant Reeher, farfesa a fannin kimiyyar siyasa a Jami'ar Syracuse ta Makarantar Maxwell ta gaya wa The Hill a cikin wani labari da aka buga a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Waɗannan abubuwa ba za a iya komawa baya da su ba, "Grant Reeher, farfesa a kimiyyar siyasa a makarantar Maxwell School a Jami'ar Syracuse ya shaidawa The Hill na wani labarin da aka buga a ranar Asabar.

rows.source: Reeher said he doubts Senator Jeff Flake's (R-Arizona) last-minute push for an FBI investigation will be enough to placate angry voters.
rows.output: Reeher ya ce yana shakkar goyon bayan Sanata Jeff Flake (R-Arizona) na karshe na binciken FBI zai wadatar wajen kwantar da hankalin masu zabe masu fushi.
rows.reference: Reeher ya ce yana shakkun Sanata Jeff Flake na (R-Arizona) a turawan karshe na binciken FBI zai iya tunzurawa zuwa ga fushin masu zabe.

rows.source: "Women are not going to forget what happened yesterday - they are not going to forget it tomorrow and not in November," Karine Jean-Pierre, a senior adviser and national spokeswoman for the progressive group MoveOn said on Friday, according to the Washington, D.C. newspaper.
rows.output: "Matan ba za su manta da abin da ya faru jiya ba - ba za su manta da shi gobe ba kuma ba a watan Nuwamba ba," in ji Karine Jean-Pierre, wata babbar mai ba da shawara kuma mai magana da yawun kungiyar ci gaban ci gaba ta MoveOn, a ranar Juma'a, a cewar jaridar Washington, D.C.
rows.reference: "Mata ba za su manta da abin da ya faru a jiya ba - ba za su manta da gobe ba a watan Nuwamba," in ji Karine Jean-Pierre, babban jami'in shawara kuma kakakin mai magana da yawun mata 'yan kungiyar MatsaGaba tace a ranar Jumma'a, a cewar Jaridar Washington DC.

rows.source: On Friday morning, protestors chanted "November is coming!" as they demonstrated in the hallway of the Senate as the Republicans controlling the Judiciary Committee chose to move forward with Kavanaugh's nomination despite the testimony of Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic reported.
rows.output: A ranar Asabar, masu zanga-zangar sun yi ihu da "Nuwamba na zuwa!" yayin da suke zanga-zangar a falon majalisar dattawa yayin da masu ra'ayin Republican da ke kula da kwamitin shari'a suka zabi ci gaba da amincewa da sunan Kavanaugh duk da shaidar Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic ta ruwaito.
rows.reference: A safiyar Jumma'a, masu zanga-zangar sun yi waka "Nuwamba na zuwa!" kamar yadda suka nuna a zauren majalisar dattawa kamar yadda 'yan Republican waɗanda ke kula da kwamitin Shari'a sun zabi su cigaba da gabatarwar Kavanaugh duk da shaidar Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic ne ya kawo rohoton.

rows.source: "Democratic enthusiasm and motivation is going to be off the chart," Stu Rothenberg, a nonpartisan political analyst, told the news site.
rows.output: "Sha'awar dimokuradiyya da kishin kasa za su yi yawa," in ji Stu Rothenberg, wani mai nazarin siyasa wanda ba ya jam'iyya, a cikin wata hira da shafin labarai.
rows.reference: "Sha'awar dimokuradiya da karfafa gwiwa zai fita a cikin sakon," in ji Stu Rothenberg, mai ba da rahotannin siyasa, ya fada shafin labaran yanar gizon.

rows.source: "People are saying it's already been high; that's true.
rows.output: Mutane suna cewa ya riga ya yi yawa; gaskiya ne.
rows.reference: "Mutane su na cewa ya riga ya kasance a sama, wannan gaskiya ne.

rows.source: But it could be higher, particularly among swing women voters in the suburbs and younger voters, 18- to 29-year-olds, who while they don't like the president, often don't vote."
rows.output: Amma zai iya zama mafi girma, musamman a tsakanin masu kada kuri'a na juyawa a yankunan karkara da matasa masu kada kuri'a, masu shekaru 18 zuwa 29, wadanda duk da cewa ba sa son shugaban kasa, sau da yawa ba sa kada kuri'a."
rows.reference: Amma zai iya zama mafi girma, musamman a tsakanin kungiyoyin mata masu jefa kuri'a, a yankunan karkara da kananun masu jefa kuri'a, 'yan shekaru 18 zuwa 29, waɗanda ba su son shugaba, ba za su yi zabe ba."

rows.source: Even before Ford's public testimony detailing her allegations of sexual assault against the Supreme Court nominee, analysts suggested a backlash could follow if Republicans pushed forward with the confirmation.
rows.output: Ko da kafin Ford ta yi shari'ar jama'a inda ta bayyana zargin cin zarafin jima'i da aka yi mata na neman mukamin Kotun Koli, masana sun yi hasashen cewa za a iya samun mayar da martani idan 'yan Republican suka ci gaba da gudanar da tabbatar da mukamin.
rows.reference: Ko kafin shaida Ford ta bayyana ga jama’a game da zarginta na cin zarafin jima'i akan Kotun Koli zababbe, masu sharhi sun nuna goyon bayan da za su iya biyo baya idan Jamhuriyyar Republican ta ci gaba da tabbatarwa.

rows.source: "This has become a muddled mess for the GOP," said Michael Steele, former chairman of the Republican National Committee, early last week, according to NBC News.
rows.output: "Abin da ya faru shi ne cewa jam'iyyar GOP ta yi rudani," in ji Michael Steele, tsohon shugaban jam'iyyar Republican National Committee, a farkon mako, a cewar NBC News.
rows.reference: "Wannan ya zama babban rikici ga GOP," in ji Michael Steele, tsohon shugaban kwamitin Republican Kwamitin Tarayya, a farkon makon da ya gabata, a cewar Labaran NBC.

rows.source: "It's just not about the committee vote or the final vote or whether Kavanaugh is put on the bench, it's also about the way Republicans have handled this and how they have treated her," Guy Cecil, director of Priorities USA, a group that helps to elect Democrats, pointed out to the news channel.
rows.output: "Ba kawai game da kuri'ar kwamiti ko kuri'ar karshe ba ko kuma ko za a sanya Kavanaugh a kan kujerar, yana da alaka da yadda 'yan Republican suka gudanar da wannan da kuma yadda suka yi mata," Guy Cecil, daraktan kungiyar Priorities USA, wata kungiya da ke taimakawa wajen zaben 'yan Democrat, ya bayyana ga tashar labarai.
rows.reference: "Ba kawai game da zaben kwamitin ko zaben karshe ko kuma Kavanaugh aka sanya a kan benci, kuma game da yadda Republicans suka magance wannan da yadda suka yi mata," Guy Cecil, darektan Fifikon Amurka, wani rukuni na taimakawa don zabe 'yan Democrat, da aka nuna wa tashar watsa labarai.

rows.source: However, Americans appear to be somewhat split over who to believe in the wake of Ford's and Kavanaugh's testimonies, with slightly more siding with the latter.
rows.output: Amma, Amurkawa sun bayyana suna da ra'ayi daban-daban kan wanda za su amince da shi bayan shaidar Ford da Kavanaugh, inda dan kadan ya goyi bayan na baya.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, Amirkawa sun rabu akan wanda zasu gaskanta bayan bayyyanar shaidar Ford da Kavanaugh, tare da rinjaye kadan da kuna rinjaye anjima.

rows.source: A new poll from YouGov shows that 41 percent of respondents definitely or probably believed Ford's testimony, while 35 percent said they definitely or probably believed Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Wani sabon bincike daga YouGov ya nuna cewa kashi 41 cikin 100 na masu amsa sun yi imani da tabbacin Ford, yayin da kashi 35 cikin 100 suka ce sun yi imani da tabbacin Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Wani sabon zabe YouGov ya nuna kashi 41 cikin dari na masu amsa shakka ko tabbas sun gaskanta gaskiyar Ford, yayin da kashi 35 cikin dari sun tabbata ko tabbas sunyi imani da Kavanaugh.

rows.source: Additionally, 38 percent said they thought Kavanaugh has probably or definitely lied during his testimony, while just 30 percent said the same about Ford.
rows.output: Bugu da ƙari, kashi 38 cikin 100 na wadanda aka yi wa tambaya sun ce sun yi imanin cewa Kavanaugh ya yi yiwuwa ko tabbas ya yi karya a lokacin da yake shaida, yayin da kashi 30 cikin 100 kawai suka ce haka game da Ford.
rows.reference: Bugu da ƙari, kashi 38 cikin dari sun ce sunyi tunanin Kavanaugh ya yi ƙarya a lokacin da yake gabatar da shaida, yayin da kawai kashi 30 cikin dari suka faɗi daidai da Ford.

rows.source: After the push from Flake, the FBI is currently investigating the allegations brought forward by Ford as well as at least one other accuser, Deborah Ramirez, The Guardian reported.
rows.output: Bayan tura daga Flake, a halin yanzu hukumar FBI na binciken zargin da Ford da aƙalla wani mai zargi, Deborah Ramirez, suka gabatar, kamar yadda The Guardian ya ruwaito.
rows.reference: Bayan turi daga Flake, FBI na binciken lamarin da Ford suka gabatar da shi tare da wani mutum daya da ake zargi, Deborah Ramirez, a cewar The Guardian.

rows.source: Ford testified before the Senate Judiciary Committee under oath last week that Kavanaugh drunkenly assaulted her at the age of 17.
rows.output: Ford ta shaida a gaban kwamitin shari'a na majalisar dattawa a makon da ya gabata cewa, a cewar ta, Kavanaugh ya yi mata cin zarafi a lokacin da take da shekaru 17 cikin shaye-shaye.
rows.reference: Ford ya bayyana a gaban Majalisar kwamitin Dattijan Shari'a da rantsuwa a makon da ya wuce cewa Kavanaugh na maye lokacin da yaci zarafinta tana da shekaru 17.

rows.source: Ramirez alleges that the Supreme Court nominee exposed his genitals to her while they attended a party during their time studying at Yale in the 1980s.
rows.output: Ramirez ya yi ikirarin cewa wanda aka zaba a matsayin Alkalin Alkalan Amurka ya bayyana jikin sa a gare ta yayin da suke halartar wani biki a lokacin da suke karatu a Yale a cikin shekarun 1980.
rows.reference: Ramirez yayi zargin cewa zababben dan Kotun Kolin ya nuna al'aurarsa gare ta yayin da suke halarci wata ƙungiya a yayin da suke karatun Yale a shekarun 1980.

rows.source: The Inventor of the World Wide Web Plans to Start a New Internet to Take on Google and Facebook
rows.output: Mai Kirkirar Intanet na shirin fara sabon Intanet don yin takara da Google da Facebook
rows.reference: Wanda ya kirkiro yanar gizo ta duniya yana shirin fara sabon yanar gizo akan farfajiyar google da facebook.

rows.source: Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, is launching a startup that seeks to rival Facebook, Amazon and Google.
rows.output: Tim Berners-Lee, wanda ya kirkiro Intanet, yana kaddamar da wani kamfani da ke neman ya yi takara da Facebook, Amazon da Google.
rows.reference: Tim Berners-Lee, wanda ya Ƙirƙiri Yanar Gizo a duniya, yana ƙaddamar fara wani shiri wanda zai yi gogayya da Facebook, Amazon da Google.

rows.source: The technology legend's latest project, Inrupt, is a company that builds off of Berners-Lee's open source platform Solid.
rows.output: Shugaban fasaha na baya-bayan nan, Inrupt, wani kamfani ne da ke gina kan dandalin Solid na budaddiyar tushe na Berners-Lee.
rows.reference: Kayan aikin fasaha na zamani Inrupt, wani kamfanin ne wanda ke gina cibiyar dandalin budewa na Berners-Lee Solid.

rows.source: Solid allows users to choose where their data is stored and what people are allowed to have access to what information.
rows.output: Solid yana bawa masu amfani damar zaɓar inda za a adana bayanansu da kuma wanda ya kamata a ba su damar samun dama ga wane bayani.
rows.reference: Ma’adinai na ba masu amfani damar zabar wajen adana bayyanai da kuma abin da aka ba mutane damar samun damar bayanai.

rows.source: In an exclusive interview with Fast Company, Berners-Lee joked that the intent behind Inrupt is "world domination."
rows.output: A cikin wani hira na musamman da Fast Company, Berners-Lee ya yi dariya cewa manufar da ke bayan Inrupt ita ce "mamayar duniya."
rows.reference: A wata ganawa ta musamman tare da kamfanin Fast, Berners-Lee ya raha cewa, dalilin kera Inrupt shi ne "mulkin duniya."

rows.source: "We have to do it now," he said of the startup.
rows.output: "Muna bukatar mu yi shi yanzu," in ji shi na kamfanin.
rows.reference: "Ba dole ne mu yi shi yanzu ba," ya ce game da farawa.

rows.source: "It's a historical moment."
rows.output: "Wannan wani lokaci ne na tarihi."
rows.reference: "Lokacin tarihi ne yanzu."

rows.source: The app uses Solid's technology to allow people to create their own "personal online data store" or a POD.
rows.output: An yi amfani da fasahar Solid don baiwa mutane damar ƙirƙirar nasu "kantin bayanai na sirri na kan layi" ko POD.
rows.reference: Aikace-aikace yana amfani da fasaha na Solid don bawa mutane damar ƙirƙirar nasu "bayanan ajiya a intanit" ko POD.

rows.source: It can contain contact lists, to-do lists, calendar, music library and other personal and professional tools.
rows.output: Zai iya ƙunsar jerin tuntuɓar, jerin abubuwan da za a yi, kalanda, ɗakin karatu na kiɗa, da sauran kayan mutum da na sana'a.
rows.reference: Yakan ƙunshi jerin lambobin sadarwa, jerin abubuwan da za’a yi, kalandar, ɗakin karatu na wakoki da wasu kayan aiki na kai kadai da gwanayen kayan aiki.

rows.source: It's like Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack and Spotify are all available on one browser and all at the same time.
rows.output: Kamar Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack da Spotify duk suna samuwa a cikin mai bincike guda ɗaya kuma duk a lokaci guda.
rows.reference: Yana kama da Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack da Spotify duk su na samuwa a kan farfajiyar bincike daya duk a lokaci guda.

rows.source: What's unique about the personal online data store is that it is completely up to the user who can access what kind of information.
rows.output: Abin da ya bambanta game da ma'ajiyar bayanan sirri na kan layi shi ne cewa gabaɗaya ya dogara da mai amfani wanda zai iya samun wane irin bayani.
rows.reference: Abun ban mamaki game da gurbin ajiya na kai a shagon yanar gizo shi ne cewa mai amfani da shi na da cikakken ikon samun irin bayanai.

rows.source: The company calls it "personal empowerment through data."
rows.output: Kamfanin ya kira shi "karfafa mutum a matsayin wani bangare na bayanai."
rows.reference: Kamfanin ya kira shi "karfafawa ta hanyar bayanan da aka tattara ."

rows.source: The idea for Inrupt, according to the company's CEO John Bruce, is for the company to bring resources, process and appropriate skills to help make Solid available to everyone.
rows.output: Ra'ayin Inrupt, kamar yadda shugaban kamfanin John Bruce ya bayyana, shine kamfanin ya kawo albarkatu, hanyoyi, da kuma kwarewa masu dacewa don taimakawa wajen sanya Solid samuwa ga kowa.
rows.reference: Ra’ayin Inrupt, a cewar Shugaban kamfanin John Bruce, shi ne kamfanin zai kawo albarkatun, tsari da kuma dacewa don taimakawa wajen samar da Solid ga kowa.

rows.source: The company currently consists of Berners-Lee, Bruce, a security platform bought by IBM, some on-staff developers contracted to work on the project, and a community of volunteer coders.
rows.output: Yanzu kamfanin ya kunshi Berners-Lee, Bruce, wani dandamali na tsaro da IBM ta saya, wasu masu haɓaka da ke aiki a kan aikin, da al'umma na masu shirye-shirye masu aikin sa kai.
rows.reference: Kamfanin a halin yanzu ya ƙunshi Berners-Lee, Bruce, wani tsari na tsaro wanda IBM ya saya, wasu masu haɓaka ma'aikata sun yi aiki akan aikin, da ƙungiyar ‘yan sa kan coders.

rows.source: Starting this week, technology developers around the world could create their own decentralized apps using the tools available on the Inrupt website.
rows.output: Daga wannan makon, masu haɓaka fasaha a duk faɗin duniya za su iya ƙirƙirar nasu aikace-aikacen da aka raba ta amfani da kayan aikin da ke akwai akan gidan yanar gizon Inrupt.
rows.reference: Farawa daga wannan satin, masu samar da fasaha a duniya za su iya ƙirƙirarar tasu mahanja da aka rarrabe ta hanyar amfani da kayan aikin da aka samu akan shafin Inrupt.

rows.source: Berners-Lee said that he and his team are not talking to "Facebook and Google about whether or not to introduce a complete change where all their business models are completely upended overnight.
rows.output: Berners-Lee ya ce ba shi da kuma tawagarsa suna tattaunawa da "Facebook da Google game da ko za su gabatar da cikakken canji inda dukkan samfuran kasuwancinsu suka canza dare."
rows.reference: Berners-Lee ya bayyana cewa shi da abokansa ba su tatauna da "Facebook da Google ba game da ko za su gabatar da canji inda duk samfurin kasuwancin su za su gabata a cikin dare.

rows.source: "We are not asking their permission."
rows.output: "Muna neman izininsu ba."
rows.reference: "Ba ma neman izinin su."

rows.source: In a post on Medium published on Saturday, Berners-Lee wrote that Inrupt's "mission is to provide commercial energy and an ecosystem to help protect the integrity and quality of the new web built on Solid."
rows.output: A cikin wani rubutu a kan Medium da aka buga a ranar Asabar, Berners-Lee ya rubuta cewa manufar Inrupt's "itace ne don samar da karfin kasuwanci da kuma tsarin halittu don taimakawa wajen kare inganci da ingancin sabuwar gidan yanar gizo da aka gina akan Solid."
rows.reference: A cikin wata jarida da aka buga a ranar Asabar, Berners-Lee ya rubuta cewa "Inrupt" manufar shi ne samar da makamashi na kasuwanci da kuma al'amarin don taimakawa wajen kare amincin da ingancin ginin sabon shafin yanar gizon Solid. "

rows.source: In 1994, Berners-Lee transformed the Internet when he established the World Wide Web Consortium at Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
rows.output: A shekara ta 1994, Berners-Lee ya canza Intanet ne lokacin da ya kafa Cibiyar Duniya ta Duniya a Cibiyar Fasaha ta Massachusetts.
rows.reference: A 1994, Berners-Lee ya sake canza yanar-gizon lokacin da ya kafa Gammayar Duniyar Yanar Gizo a Cibiyar Fasaha Massachusetts.

rows.source: In recent months, Berners-Lee has been an influential voice in the net neutrality debate.
rows.output: A cikin watannin da suka gabata, Berners-Lee ya kasance murya mai tasiri a muhawarar 'yancin intanet.
rows.reference: A cikin 'yan watanni, Berners-Lee ya kasance mai babbar murya a cikin muhawarar rashin daidaito.

rows.source: Even while launching Inrupt, Berners-Lee will remain the Founder and Director of World Wide Web Consortium, the Web Foundation and the Open Data Institute.
rows.output: Ko da yake kaddamar da Inrupt, Berners-Lee zai ci gaba da zama wanda ya kafa kuma Darakta na Cibiyar Watsa Labarai ta Duniya, Cibiyar Watsa Labarai, da Cibiyar Bayanai Mai Bude Ilimi.
rows.reference: Ko da a lokacin da aka kaddamar da Inrupt, Berners-Lee zai kasance wanda ya kafa da kuma mai ba da umarni na Gammayyar Yanar Gizo, mai suna Web Foundation da Budaden Cibiyar Bayanai.

rows.source: "I'm incredibly optimistic for this next era of the web," Berners-Lee added.
rows.output: "Na yi matukar fata ga wannan zamanin na gaba na yanar gizo," Berners-Lee ya kara da cewa.
rows.reference: Ina da kyakyawan fata ga wannan sauyin zamani na yanar gizo, “berners -lee ya kara da cewa.

rows.source: Bernard Vann: WW1 Victoria Cross cleric celebrated
rows.output: Bernard Vann: WW1 Victoria Cross cleric murna
rows.reference: Bernard Vann: An karrama malamin WW1 victoria cross

rows.source: The only Church of England cleric to win a Victoria Cross during World War One as a combatant has been celebrated in his hometown 100 years on.
rows.output: Mai hidimar Cocin Ingila daya tilo da ya samu Cross na Victoria a lokacin Yaƙin Duniya na ɗaya a matsayin mai fafutuka, an yi bikin a garinsa shekaru 100 bayan rasuwarsa.
rows.reference: Babban ikilisiyar chocin ingila daya taba lashe kyautar girma na Victoria cross a lokacin yakin duniya Daya kuma jajirtacce ya sha bikin murna a garin su shekaru 100 da doriya.

rows.source: Lt Col The Reverend Bernard Vann won the award on 29 September 1918 in the attack at Bellenglise and Lehaucourt.
rows.output: Maj. An ba da kyautar ne a ranar 29 ga Satumba 1918 saboda harin da aka kai a Bellenglise da Lehaucourt.
rows.reference: Lt Col The Reverend Bernard Vann ya lashe lambar yabo a ranar 29 Satumba 1918 a harin a Bellenglise da Lehaucourt.

rows.source: However, he was killed by a sniper four days later and never knew he had won the highest British military honour.
rows.output: Amma, an kashe shi da wata bindiga ‘yar bindiga kwana hudu bayan haka, bai taba sanin cewa ya samu mafi girman karramawar sojojin Birtaniya ba.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, maharbin boye ne ya kashe shi kwanaki hudu daga bisani, kuma bai san cewa ya lashe kyauta mafi girma na sojojin Birtaniya ba.

rows.source: A commemorative stone was unveiled by his two grandsons at a parade in Rushden, Northamptonshire, on Saturday.
rows.output: An bayyana wani dutse na tunawa da shi ne da hannun jikansa biyu a wata zanga-zangar da aka yi a Rushden, Northamptonshire, a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: An bayyana dutsen tunawa da shi wanda jikokin shi guda biyu ne suka gabatar a wani shinge a Rushden, Northamptonshire, ranar Asabar.

rows.source: One of his grandsons, Michael Vann, said it was "brilliantly symbolic" the stone would be revealed exactly 100 years on from his grandfather's award-winning feat.
rows.output: Daya daga cikin jikansa, Michael Vann, ya ce "alama ce mai ban mamaki" cewa dutse zai bayyana daidai shekara ɗari daga lokacin da kakansa ya samu nasara.
rows.reference: Ɗaya daga cikin jikokinsa, Michael Vann, ya ce "kayatacciyar alama" ce wanda za a bayyana dutsen shekaru 100 daidai da samun kyautar kakansa.

rows.source: According to the London Gazette, on 29 September 1918 Lt Col Vann led his battalion across the Canal de Saint-Quentin "through a very thick fog and under heavy fire from field and machine guns."
rows.output: A cewar jaridar Landan, a ranar 29 ga Satumba 1918, Kyaftin Vann ya jagoranci rundunarsa ta wuce Canal de Saint-Quentin "ta cikin hazo mai kauri da kuma karkashin wuta mai yawa daga bindigogi da na'urorin daukar hoto."
rows.reference: A cewar kundin tarihin London, ranar 29 ga Satumba 1918, Lt Col Vann ya jagoranci dakarunsa a fadin Canal de Saint-Quentin "ta hanyar mai matukar damuwa da hazo mai matukar duhu ga wuta daga filin daga da bindigogi na inji."

rows.source: He later rushed up to the firing line and with the "greatest gallantry" led the line forward before rushing a field-gun single-handed and knocked out three of the detachment.
rows.output: Daga baya ya yi gaggawar zuwa layin wuta ya jagoranci layin gaba da "gallantry" kafin ya ruga da bindigar filin ya kuma kawar da uku daga cikin rundunar.
rows.reference: Daga bisani sai ya haura zuwa layin harbi tare "mafi girma jarumta" wanda ya jagorancin gaban layin kafin ya fakaito da bindigar -fili shi kadai kuma ya durkusa runduna uku.

rows.source: Lt Col Vann was killed by a German sniper on 4 October 1918 - just over a month before the war ended.
rows.output: Maj Vann ya kashe shi da wani mai harbin bindiga na Jamus a ranar 4 ga Oktoba 1918 - kusan wata guda kafin a kawo karshen yakin.
rows.reference: Maharbin ɓoye na ƙasar Jamus ne ya kashe Laftanar Kanar Vann a ranar 4 ga watan Oktobar 1918 - wata daya kawai kafin a gama yaƙin.

rows.source: Michael Vann, 72, said his grandfather's actions were "something that I know that I could never live up to but something which is humbling."
rows.output: Michael Vann, 72, ya ce ayyukan kakansa "wani abu ne da na sani cewa ba zan iya rayuwa ba, amma wani abu mai ban sha'awa."
rows.reference: Michael Vann, mai shekaru 72, ya ce ayyukan kakansa "wani abu da na san cewa ba zan taba iya zama ba sai dai wani abu da yake da tawali'u."

rows.source: He and his brother Dr James Vann also laid a wreath after the parade, which was led by the Brentwood Imperial Youth Band.
rows.output: Shi da ɗan’uwansa Dr James Vann suma sun sanya gaisuwa bayan da aka gudanar da taron, wanda ƙungiyar matasa ta Brentwood Imperial ta jagoranta.
rows.reference: Shi da ɗan'uwansa, Dr James Vann, sun kuma sanya kyalle bayan faretin, wanda Brentwood Imperial Youth Band ya jagoranta.

rows.source: Michael Vann said he was "feeling very honoured to play a part in the parade" and added "the valour of a genuine hero is being demonstrated by the support that is going to be given by a lot of people."
rows.output: Mika'ilu Vann ya ce "yana jin dadi sosai don yin rawa a cikin wannan taron" kuma ya kara da cewa "jaruntaka na gaskiya yana bayyana ta hanyar goyon bayan da mutane da yawa za su bayar."
rows.reference: Michael Vann ya ce "na ji daɗin karamawan sosai don rawan da na taka a cikin faratin" kuma ya kara da cewa babban jarumi ne wanda a nunawa goyon baya da kuma taimakon da mutane ke bayarwa."

rows.source: MMA fans stayed up all night to watch Bellator 206, they got Peppa Pig instead
rows.output: Masu sha'awar MMA sun yi barci a daren don kallon Bellator 206, sun sami Peppa Pig maimakon
rows.reference: Masoyan MMA sun kwana a zaune domin kallon Bellator 206, amma kuma sai suka samu Peppa Pig a maimako

rows.source: Imagine this, you have stayed up all night to watch the a packed Bellator 206 only to be denied watching the main event.
rows.output: Ka yi tunanin haka, kun yi maraice cikin dare don kallon cunkoson Bellator 206 kawai don an hana ku kallon babban taron.
rows.reference: Ka yi la'akari da haka, ka kwana zaune don kallon Bellator 206 amma kawai sai a hana ka kallon ainihin taron.

rows.source: The bill from San Jose contained 13 fights, including six on the main card and was being shown live through the night in the UK on Channel 5.
rows.output: Kudirin daga San Jose ya kunshi fadace-fadace 13, ciki har da shida a babban katin, kuma ana nuna shi kai tsaye a duk dare a Birtaniya a tashar Channel 5.
rows.reference: Lissafin daga San Jose ya ƙunshi fadace-fadace 13, ciki harda shida a kan babban katin kuma an nuna su kai tsaye cikin dare a Birtaniya akan Tasha na 5.

rows.source: At 6am, just as Gegard Mousasi and Rory MacDonald were preparing to face each other, viewers in the UK were left stunned when the coverage changed to Peppa Pig.
rows.output: Da karfe 6 na safe, daidai lokacin da Gegard Mousasi da Rory MacDonald ke shirin fuskantar juna, masu kallo a Birtaniya sun yi mamaki lokacin da aka canza watsa shirye-shiryen zuwa Peppa Pig.
rows.reference: Ƙarfe 6 na safe, kamar yadda Gegard Mousasi da Rory MacDonald suka shirya don fuskantar juna, masu kallo a Birtaniya sun kasance masu mamaki lokacin da yanayin ya canza zuwa Peppa Pig.

rows.source: Some were unimpressed after they had stayed awake until the early hours especially for the fight.
rows.output: Wasu ba su ji dadin ba bayan sun yi taka-tsan-tsan har zuwa awanni masu wuya musamman domin yakin.
rows.reference: Wadansu ba su damu ba bayan sun kwana zaune har zuwa har farkon safiya musamman don fadan.

rows.source: One fan on Twitter described the switch to the children's cartoon as "some sort of sick joke."
rows.output: Wani mai sha'awar Twitter ya bayyana canjin zuwa wasan kwaikwayo na yara a matsayin "irin wani irin barkwanci mai ban tsoro."
rows.reference: Masoyi daya ya bayyana a Twitter cewa canji zuwa zane mai ban dariya na yara kamar “wani irin wasan mararsa lafiya.’

rows.source: "It's government regulation that at 6 a.m. that content was not suitable so they had to switch to children's programming, " said Dave Schwartz, Bellator senior vice president of marketing and communication, when asked about the transmission.
rows.output: "Shi ne dokar gwamnati ta yi hakan a karfe 6 na safe cewa abun cikin ba ya dace da haka sai suka canza zuwa shirye-shiryen yara," in ji Dave Schwartz, mataimakin shugaban kamfanin Bellator na manyan harkokin kasuwanci da sadarwa, lokacin da aka tambaye shi game da watsa shirye-shiryen.
rows.reference: "Dokar gwamnati ce cewa karfe 6 na safe a canza tashar domin shirin bai dace ba don haka dole su canza zuwa shirye shiryen yara," in ji Dave Schwartz, matamakin shugaba na sadarwa da kasuwanci, lokacin da aka tambaye shi game da watsawa.

rows.source: ""Peppa the pig," yes."
rows.output: "Peppa the pig," eh.
rows.reference: ""Peppa aleden," eh."

rows.source: Bellator company president Scott Coker said that they are going to work on their scheduling to include UK viewers in the future.
rows.output: Shugaban kamfanin Bellator Scott Coker ya ce za su yi aiki kan jadawalin su don hada masu kallo a Birtaniya a nan gaba.
rows.reference: Shugaban kamfanin Bellator, Scott Coker, ya ce za su yi aiki a kan shirye-shiryen su hade da masu kallo na Birtaniya a nan gaba.

rows.source: "I think that when I think about the replay, I think that we can probably work it out," Coker said.
rows.output: "Ina ganin cewa lokacin da na yi tunani game da sake kunnawa, ina ganin cewa watakila za mu iya magance shi," Coker ya ce.
rows.reference: "Ina tsammanin idan na yi tunani game da sake bugawa, ina tsammanin zai iya wadatarwa," in ji Coker.

rows.source: "But it's six in the morning on a Sunday there and we won't be able to work this out until Sunday our time, Monday their time.
rows.output: "Amma yana da shida na safe a ranar Lahadi a can kuma ba za mu iya aiki da wannan ba har zuwa Lahadi lokacinmu, Litinin lokacinsu.
rows.reference: "Amma shida ne na safiyar ranar Lahadi a can, kuma ba za mu iya yin hakan ba har sai lokacin mu na Lahadi, Litinin lokacin su.

rows.source: But we are working on it.
rows.output: Amma muna aiki a kai.
rows.reference: amma mu na aiki akan shi.

rows.source: Believe me, when it switched over there were a lot of texts going back and forth and they all were not friendly.
rows.output: Ka yi imani da ni, lokacin da aka canza zuwa can, akwai wasu rubuce-rubuce da yawa suna tafiya baya da baya kuma ba duka ba ne na abokantaka.
rows.reference: Ku yarda da ni, lokacin da aka sauya shi a can akwai sakonni da suke ta yawo gaba da baya kuma dukansu ba su da dadi.

rows.source: We were trying to fix it, we thought it was a technical glitch.
rows.output: Mun kasance muna ƙoƙarin gyara shi, mun yi tunanin kuskuren fasaha ne.
rows.reference: Mu na ƙoƙarin gyara shi, mun yi tsammani abu ne da ya shafi matsalar fasaha.

rows.source: But it wasn't, it was a governmental issue.
rows.output: Amma ba haka ba ne, al'amari ne na gwamnati.
rows.reference: Amma ba haka ba, batu ne na gwamnati.

rows.source: I can promise you the next time it's not going to happen.
rows.output: Zan iya ba ku tabbacin cewa na gaba ba zai faru ba.
rows.reference: Ina maku alkwalin hakan ba zai sake faruwa ba.

rows.source: We'll keep it down to five fights instead of six - like we normally do - and we tried to overdeliver for the fans and we just went over.
rows.output: Za mu kiyaye shi zuwa fama biyar maimakon shida - kamar yadda muke yi - kuma mun yi ƙoƙarin yin ƙari ga magoya baya kuma kawai mun wuce.
rows.reference: Ku yarda dani, lokacin da aka sauya shi a can akwai sakonni da suke ta yawo gaba da baya kuma dukansu ba su da dadi.

rows.source: It's an unfortunate situation."
rows.output: Lamarin mara dadi ne.
rows.reference: halin takaici ne.”

rows.source: Desert Island Discs: Tom Daley felt 'inferior' over sexuality
rows.output: Rikodin Tsibirin Hamada: Tom Daley ya ji "mara kyau" game da jima'i
rows.reference: Hamada Tsibirin Discs: Tom Daley ya ji 'dagawa' saboda jinsi

rows.source: Olympic diver Tom Daley says he grew up feeling inferior to everyone because of his sexuality - but that gave him the motivation to become a success.
rows.output: Mai nutsewa a gasar Olympics Tom Daley ya bayyana cewa ya girma yana jin kasa da kowa saboda jinsinsa - amma hakan ya ba shi kwarin gwiwar zama mai nasara.
rows.reference: Ɗan wasan Olympics Tom Daley ya ce ya girma yana jin dagawa fiye da kowa saboda jinsin sa - amma hakan ne ya bashi hazaka wajen samun nasara.

rows.source: The 24-year-old said he did not realise until he went to secondary school that "not everyone is like me."
rows.output: Mai shekaru 24 ya bayyana cewa bai gane ba sai ya tafi makarantar sakandare cewa "ba kowa kamar ni ba."
rows.reference: Dan shekaru 24 ya ce bai fahimta ba har sai da ya tafi makarantar sakandare cewa "ba kowa ba ne kamar ni."

rows.source: Speaking on the first Radio 4 Desert Island Discs presented by Lauren Laverne, he said he spoke out about gay rights to give others "hope."
rows.output: Yana magana a kan farkon shirin Radio 4 Desert Island Discs da Lauren Laverne ya gabatar, ya ce ya bayyana hakkin LGBTQ+ don ba wasu "fata."
rows.reference: Da yake jawabi a gidan farko Rediyo 4 Hamadan Tsibiri wanda Lauren Laverne ya gabatar, ya ce ya yi magana game da hakkokin 'yan luwadi na ba da wasu "fata".

rows.source: He also said becoming a parent made him care less about winning the Olympics.
rows.output: Ya kuma ce zama uba ya sa ya kasa damuwa da lashe gasar Olympics.
rows.reference: Kuma yace kasancewarsa uba ya sanya shi rashin damuwa akan cin wasan Olympics.

rows.source: The regular presenter of the long-running show, Kirsty Young, has taken a number of months off because of illness.
rows.output: Mai gabatar da shirin na yau da kullun, Kirsty Young, ta dauki hutun watanni da yawa saboda rashin lafiya.
rows.reference: Mai gabatarwa da shirin na yau da kullum, Kirsty Young, ya dauki watanni da dama na hutu saboda rashin lafiya.

rows.source: Appearing as a castaway on Laverne's first programme, Daley said he felt "less than" everyone else growing up because "it wasn't socially acceptable to like boys and girls."
rows.output: Bayyana a matsayin wanda aka yi masa garkuwa da shi a shirin farko na Laverne, Daley ya ce ya ji "kasa da" kowa a lokacin girma saboda "ba a yarda da son yara maza da mata ba."
rows.reference: Yayin da ya bayyana a matsayin wani na daban a kan shirin farko na Laverne, Daley ya ce yana jin "kasa da" kowa na girma saboda "ba a yarda da ba jama’a su so maza da 'yan mata ba."

rows.source: He said: "To this day, those feelings of feeling less than, and feeling different, have been the real things that have given me the power and strength to be able to succeed."
rows.output: Ya ce: “Har yau, wadannan ji na jin kasa da kasa, da jin bambamci, sun kasance abubuwan da suka ba ni karfin gwiwa da karfin gwiwa don in iya samun nasara.
rows.reference: Ya ce: "Har wa yau, irin abubuwan da nake ji na ƙasa da, da kuma jin wani abu daban, sun kasance ainihin abubuwan da suka ba ni iko da karfi don samun nasara."

rows.source: He wanted to prove that he was "something," he said, so that he did not disappoint everyone when they eventually found out about his sexuality.
rows.output: Ya so ya tabbatar da cewa shi "wani abu ne," ya ce, don haka ba zai bata wa kowa rai ba idan suka gano ainihin jinsinsa daga baya.
rows.reference: Ya so ya tabbatar da cewa shi "wani abu," in ji shi, don haka bai yi takaici ga kowa ba a lokacin da suka gano jinsin sa.

rows.source: The two-time bronze Olympic medallist has become a high-profile LGBT campaigner and used his appearance at this year's Commonwealth Games in Australia to appeal for more countries to decriminalise homosexuality.
rows.output: Mai ritayar Olympics sau biyu ya zama mai fafutukar LGBT kuma ya yi amfani da halartarsa ​​a wasannin Commonwealth a wannan shekara a Ostiraliya wajen rokon kasashe da dama da su soke hukuncin kisa na jima'i.
rows.reference: Wakilin wasan Olympics na tagulla guda biyu ya zama dan wasan LGBT mai girma kuma ya yi amfani da shi a gasar Commonwealth na wannan shekara a Australia don neman kara yawan kasashe da zasu bada daman luwadi.

rows.source: He said he spoke out because he felt lucky to be able to live openly without ramifications and wanted to give others "hope."
rows.output: Ya ce ya yi magana ne saboda yana jin sa’ar rayuwa a fili ba tare da wani sakamako ba, kuma yana son baiwa wasu “fata”.
rows.reference: Ya ce ya yi magana ne saboda ya ji daɗin kasancewa a fili ba tare da raguwa ba kuma yana so ya ba wasu "fata".

rows.source: The three-time world champion said falling in love with a man - US film-maker Dustin Lance Black, who he met in 2013 - "caught me by surprise."
rows.output: Sau uku zakaran duniya ya ce soyayya da namiji - wanda shi ne darektan fina-finan Amurka Dustin Lance Black, wanda ya hadu da shi a shekarar 2013 - ya kama ni da mamaki.
rows.reference: Shi zakara uku a duniya ya ce fadawa soyaya da namij i-dan wasan Dustin Lance Black na Amurka, wanda ya hadu da shi a 2013 - "ya zame man abun mamaki."

rows.source: Daley married the Oscar winner, who is 20 years his senior, last year but he said the age gap had never been an issue.
rows.output: Daley ya auri wanda ya lashe lambar yabo, wanda ya kai shekaru 20 a gaban sa, a shekarar da ta gabata amma ya ce tazarar shekaru ba ta taba zama matsala a gare shi ba.
rows.reference: Daley ya auri zakaran Oscar, wanda ya girme shi da shekaru 20, a bara amma ya ce tazarar shekarun ba damuwa bane.

rows.source: "When you go through so much at such a young age" - he went to his first Olympics aged 14 and his father died of cancer three years later - he said that it was hard to find someone the same age who had experienced similar highs and lows.
rows.output: "Lokacin da kuka yi ta cikin haka a irin wannan shekaru" - ya tafi gasar Olympics ta farko yana da shekaru 14 kuma mahaifinsa ya rasu saboda ciwon daji shekaru uku bayan haka - ya ce yana da wahala a sami wani irin wannan shekarun da ya fuskanci irin wannan manyan abubuwa da kuma koma baya.
rows.reference: "Idan kayi fama da abubuwa da yawa a kanana shekaru" - ya tafi wasan Olympics din shi na farko yana da shekaru 14 kuma mahaifinsa ya mutu ciwon daji bayan shekaru uku - ya ce yana da wuya a sami mutumin da ya taɓa samun irin wannan matsayi sama da kasa.

rows.source: The couple became parents in June, to a son called Robert Ray Black-Daley, and Daley said his "whole perspective" had changed.
rows.output: Ma'auratan sun zama iyaye a watan Yuni, ga wani ɗa mai suna Robert Ray Black-Daley, kuma Daley ya ce "dukkan hangen nesansa" ya canza.
rows.reference: Ma’auratan sun zama iyaye a Yuni, ga ɗa mai suna Robert Ray Black-Daley, kuma Daley ya ce “dukka haganen zaman gaban shi” ya canja.

rows.source: "If you had asked me last year, it was all about 'I need to win a gold medal'," he said.
rows.output: "Idan ka tambaye ni a shekarar da ta gabata, duk abin da ya kasance shi ne 'Ina bukatan lashe lambar zinare', in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Idan da ka tambayeni bara, duk batun ‘ina bukatan na ci lambar zinariya ne’, inji shi.

rows.source: "You know what, there are bigger things than Olympic gold medals.
rows.output: "Kun san abin da, akwai manyan abubuwa fiye da zinare na wasannin Olympics.
rows.reference: “Ka san meye, akwai wasu manyan abubuwa fiye da lambar zinariyar wasar Olympics.

rows.source: My Olympic gold medal is Robbie."
rows.output: Zinariya ta Olympics ta kaina ita ce Robbie.
rows.reference: Lambar zinariyar wasar Olympics dina Robbie ne.”

rows.source: His son has the same name as his father Robert, who died in 2011 aged 40 after being diagnosed with brain cancer.
rows.output: Dansa mai suna Robert, wanda ya rasu a shekarar 2011 yana da shekaru 40 bayan an gano masa cutar daji, yana da suna iri ɗaya da mahaifinsa.
rows.reference: Dan shi yana da suna daya da baban shi Robert, wanda ya mutu a 2011 a shekara 40 bayan an gano shi da cutar daji ta kwakwalwa.

rows.source: Daley said his dad did not accept he was going to die and one of the last things he had asked was if they had their tickets yet for London 2012 - as he wanted to be on the front row.
rows.output: Daley ya ce mahaifinsa bai amince cewa zai mutu ba kuma daya daga cikin abubuwan karshe da ya nema shi ne ko suna da tikitin su na London 2012 - domin ya so ya kasance a layin gaba.
rows.reference: Daley ya ce baban shi bai yarda cewa zai mutu ba kuma abun daya daga cikin abubuwan karshe da ya tambaya shi ne idan su na da tiketin su zuwa Landan 2012 - tun da yana son ya zauna a layin gaba.

rows.source: "I couldn't say to him 'you're not going to be around to be on the front row dad'," he said.
rows.output: "Ban iya cewa masa 'ba za ka kasance a nan don zama a gaban layi baba' ba," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Ban iya ce mashi ‘ba zaka samu daman zama a layin gaba ba baba’,” ya ce.

rows.source: "I was holding his hand as he stopped breathing and it wasn't until he'd actually stopped breathing and he was dead that I finally acknowledged he wasn't invincible," he said.
rows.output: "Naji saurin rike hannunsa yayin da ya daina numfashi, kuma ba har sai da gaske ya daina numfashi kuma ya mutu ba na amince da cewa ba shi da kakkautawa."
rows.reference: “Ina rike da hannun shi a lokacin da ya daina nunfashi kuma har sai da ya asalin daina numfashi kuma ya mutu kafin na yarda cewa dan Adam ne,” ya ce.

rows.source: The following year Daley competed at the 2012 Olympics and won bronze.
rows.output: A shekara mai zuwa Daley ya fafata a gasar Olympics ta 2012 kuma ya samu tagulla.
rows.reference: Shekarar gaban Daley ya yi takara a wasar Olympics na 2012 kuma ya ci tagulla.

rows.source: "I just knew that this is what I had dreamt of my whole life - to dive in front of a home crowd at an Olympic Games, there was no better feeling," he said.
rows.output: "Na san kawai cewa wannan shine abin da na yi mafarki na dukan rayuwata - don nutsewa a gaban taron jama'a a lokacin wasannin Olympics, babu wani jin dadi mafi girma," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Ni kawai na san cewa wannan shi ne abun da nake mafarkin shi duk rayuwa ta - na yi iyo a gaban taron mutanen gida a Wasar Olympics, babu wani yanayi da yafi haka,” ya ce.

rows.source: It also inspired his first song choice - Proud by Heather Small - which had resonated with him in the build up to the Olympics and still gave him goosebumps.
rows.output: Hakan kuma ya zaburar da farkon wakarsa - Girmamawa ta Heather Small - wadda ta yi masa tasiri a lokacin da ake shirin gasar Olympics, har yanzu tana ba shi dumin jiki.
rows.reference: Kuma yayi wahayi a zabin wakar shi ta farko - Alfahari daga Heather Small - wanda yayi jimame da shi a shirye shiryen wasar Olympics kuma ya ke tayar mashi da sigar jiki.

rows.source: Desert Island Discs is on BBC Radio 4 on Sunday at 11:15 BST.
rows.output: Desert Island Discs yana kan BBC Radio 4 a ranar Lahadi da karfe 11:15.
rows.reference: Hamadan Tsibiri Disc yana kan BBC Radiyo 4 a ranar Lahadi a karfe 11:15

rows.source: Out-of-form Mickelson benched on Ryder Cup Saturday
rows.output: Mickelson da ba ya taka leda a cikin tawagar Amurka a gasar Ryder ta ranar Asabar
rows.reference: An ajiye gajiyayyen dan wasa Mickelson a gasar Kofin Ryder ranar Asabar

rows.source: American Phil Mickelson will set a record on Sunday when he plays his 47th Ryder Cup match, but he will have to turn his form around to avoid it being an unhappy milestone.
rows.output: Amurkawa Phil Mickelson zai kafa tarihi a ranar Lahadi idan ya buga wasansa na 47 a gasar cin kofin Ryder, amma zai bukaci ya inganta wasansa domin ya guji wannan biki mara dadi.
rows.reference: Dan wasan Amurka Phil Mickelson zai kafa tarihi a ranar Lahadi lokacin da ya taka leda a gasar cin kofin Ryder na 47, amma dole ne ya sauya tsarinsa don kauce baƙin ciki a matsayin.

rows.source: Mickelson, playing in the biennial event for a record 12th time, was benched by captain Jim Furyk for Saturday's fourballs and foursomes.
rows.output: Mickelson, yana wasa a wannan taron na shekara-shekara a karo na 12, an dakatar da shi da kyaftin Jim Furyk don buga wasan zagaye hudu da kuma wasan kwallon kafa.
rows.reference: Mickelson, wanda ke taka leda a cikin biki na 12, kyaftin Jim Furyk ne ya ajiye dan wasan a kwallo hudu ga mutum hudu na ranar Asabar.

rows.source: Instead of being at the center of the action, as he so often has been for the United States, the five-times major winner split his day between being a cheerleader and working on his game on the range in the hope of rectifying what ails him.
rows.output: Maimakon ya kasance a tsakiyar aikin, kamar yadda ya kasance sau da yawa ga Amurka, wanda ya lashe babban kofi sau biyar, ya yi ranar sa tsakanin zama mai farin ciki da kuma aiki da wasansa a filin wasa, yana fatan gyara abin da ke damunsa.
