rows.reference: Maimakon kasancewarsa a tsakiyar wasan, kamar yadda ya saba wa Amurka, fitaccen mai nasara sau biyar ya raba ranar tsakaninsa na kasancewa mai karfafawa da kuma aiki a kan wasansa a kan layi tare da bege na gyara abin da yake da shi .

rows.source: Never the straightest of drivers even at the peak of his career, the 48-year-old is not an ideal fit for the tight Le Golf National course, where the long rough routinely punishes errant shots.
rows.output: Ba a taɓa zama direba mafi tsauri ba, ko da a lokacin da ya fi dacewa, mutum mai shekaru 48 ba shine zaɓi mafi kyau ga wannan filin wasa mai tsauri na Le Golf National ba, inda kaurin ciyawa ke azabtar da kwallayen da ba daidai ba akai-akai.
rows.reference: Bai kasance tsayayye cikin deribobi ba ko a lokacin tashen wasan sa, dan shekaru 48 bai dace ba ga matakin wasan tsukakken wasan Le Golf na filin Tarayya, inda ke da tsayi ga azabtarwa da mummunar tashin hankali.

rows.source: And if the course on its own is not daunting enough, Mickelson, in the ninth match on Sunday, faces accurate British Open champion Francesco Molinari, who has teamed up with rookie Tommy Fleetwood to win all four of their matches this week.
rows.output: Kuma idan wasan da kansa bai isa ya firgita ba, Mickelson, a wasan na tara a ranar Lahadi, yana fuskantar zakaran gasar Biritaniya Francesco Molinari, wanda ya hada kai da sabon dan wasa Tommy Fleetwood wajen lashe duk wasannin hudu da suka yi a wannan makon.
rows.reference: Kuma idan wasan da kansa bai dace ba, Mickelson, a wasan na tara a ranar Lahadi, ya fuskanci babban zakara na Birtaniya Francesco Molinari, wanda ya haɗe tare da rookie Tommy Fleetwood don lashe dukkanin wasanni hudu a wannan makon.

rows.source: If the Americans, four points down starting the 12 singles matches, get off to a hot start, Mickelson's match could prove absolutely crucial.
rows.output: Idan Amurkawa, maki hudu a baya a fara wasan karshe na daya, sun fara da karfi, wasan Mickelson na iya zama mai matukar muhimmanci.
rows.reference: Idan mutanen amurka, da maki hudu kasa sun nuna cewa za su fara wasanni daidaiku 12, su tashi da zafi zuwa fara wasa, wasan na Mickelson zai zama mai muhimmiyar mahimmanci.

rows.source: Furyk expressed confidence in his man, not that he could say much else.
rows.output: Furyk ya bayyana kwarin gwiwa a kansa, kodayake ba zai iya cewa da yawa ba.
rows.reference: Furyk ya nuna amincewa da mutumin na shi, duk da ba zai iya cewa komai ba kuma.

rows.source: "He fully understood the role that he had today, gave me a pat on the back and put his arm around me and said he would be ready tomorrow," Furyk said.
rows.output: "Ya cika fahimtar rawar da yake takawa a yau, ya dora min hannu a bayana ya sanya hannu a kafada na ya ce zai shirya gobe," in ji Furyk.
rows.reference: "Ya fahimci muhimmancin da yake da ita a yau, ya tattaɓani a baya kuma ya sanya hannunsa kewaye da ni, ya ce zai kasance a shirye gobe," inji Furyk.

rows.source: "He's got a lot of confidence in himself.
rows.output: Ya yi imani da kansa sosai.
rows.reference: "Ya amince da kanshi sosai.

rows.source: He's a Hall of Famer and he's added so much to these teams in the past, and this week.
rows.output: Ya kasance a cikin Dakin Girmamawa kuma ya kara da yawa ga waɗannan ƙungiyoyin a baya, kuma a wannan makon.
rows.reference: Yana cikin sanannen jarumai kuma an karu da shi sosai a wannan kungiyar a da, kuma da wannan satin.

rows.source: I probably didn't envision him playing two matches.
rows.output: Wataƙila ban yi tunanin yana buga wasanni biyu ba.
rows.reference: Ban taɓa tsammanin zai yiwu ya buga wasani biyu ba.

rows.source: I envisioned more, but that's the way it worked out and that's the way we thought we had to go.
rows.output: Na yi tunanin fiye da haka, amma haka abin ya kasance kuma haka muka yi tunanin muna bukatar mu tafi.
rows.reference: Na yi tsammanin fiye, amma haka tsarin ya ke kuma itace hanyar da mu ke tunanin za mu bi.

rows.source: He wants to be out there, just like everyone else."
rows.output: Yana so ya kasance a wurin, kamar kowa.
rows.reference: Ya so ya kasance a can waje, kamar sauran mutane. "

rows.source: Mickelson will pass Nick Faldo's record for the most Ryder Cup matches played on Sunday.
rows.output: Mickelson zai zarce rikodin Nick Faldo na mafi yawan wasannin Ryder Cup da aka buga a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Mickelson zai wuce tarihin Nick Faldo a gasar cin kofin Ryder da aka buga ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: It could mark the end of a Ryder Cup career that has never quite matched the heights of his individual record.
rows.output: Wannan na iya nuna ƙarshen aikin gasar Ryder Cup wanda ba a taɓa kai girmansa ba a matsayin bayanan mutum.
rows.reference: Zai iya kawo ƙarshen wasan Ryder Cup wanda ba zai taɓa misaltuwa ba da babban matakin tarihin shi kadai.

rows.source: Mickelson has 18 wins, 20 losses and seven halves, though Furyk said his presence brought some intangibles to the team.
rows.output: Mickelson yana da nasara 18, asara 20 da rabi bakwai, kodayake Furyk ya ce kasancewarsa ya kawo wasu abubuwan da ba a iya gani ba a kungiyar.
rows.reference: Mickelson ya ci wasanni 18, an ci shi 20 da kuma sun zuze a bakwai, duk da cewa Furyk ya ce kasancewarsa ya kawo wasu abubuwan mahimmai ga kungiyar.

rows.source: "He's funny, he's sarcastic, witty, likes to poke fun at people, and he's a great guy to have in the team room," he explained.
rows.output: "Yana da ban dariya, yana da ban dariya, yana da hankali, yana son ya yi ba'a ga mutane, kuma yana da mutum mai kyau a cikin dakin taro," ya bayyana.
rows.reference: "Yana da ban dariya,wauta, mai ƙayatarwa, yana da son zolayar mutane, kuma ya zama babban dan wasa a cikin dakin wasan," inji shi.

rows.source: "I think the younger players had fun having a go at him, as well, this week, which was fun to see.
rows.output: Ina ganin 'yan wasan da suka kai shekaru sun ji dadin gwada shi, kuma hakan ya yi kyau a ganina.
rows.reference: "Ina tsammanin matasan ‘yan wasa na son zolayar shi, har ma, wannan satin, abin da yake da ban sha'awa.

rows.source: He provides a lot more than just play."
rows.output: Yana ba da ƙari fiye da wasa kawai.
rows.reference: Ya kawo abubuwa da yawa fiye da wassani kawai.”

rows.source: Europe captain Thomas Bjorn knows big lead can soon disappear
rows.output: Kyaftin Turai Thomas Bjorn ya san cewa babban jagora na iya bacewa da sauri
rows.reference: Kyaftin din Turai Thomas Bjorn ya san bada babban tazara zai shuɗe ba da daɗewa ba

rows.source: Thomas Bjorn, the European captain, knows from experience that a sizeable lead heading into the last-day singles in the Ryder Cup can easily turn into an uncomfortable ride.
rows.output: Thomas Bjorn, shugaban Turai, ya san daga kwarewa cewa gagarumin jagora a ranar karshe ta karshe a gasar Ryder Cup na iya sauya cikin sauki zuwa tafiya mai ban tsoro.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn, kyaftin din Turai, ya sani daga kwarewa sa cewa samun tazara kadan a cikin 'yan kwanaki na karshe a wasan daidaiku na Ryder Cup zamewa tuki ma wahala.

rows.source: The Dane made his debut in the 1997 match at Valderrama, where a side captained by Seve Ballesteros held a five-point advantage over the Americans but only just got over the finishing line with their noses in front by the narrowest of margins, winning 14½-13½.
rows.output: Dan kasar Denmark ya fara buga wasan a shekarar 1997 a Valderrama, inda kungiyar da Seve Ballesteros ke jagoranta ta samu nasara da maki biyar a kan Amurkawa, amma sun yi nasara da karamin ci, inda suka lashe 14½-13½.
rows.reference: Dane ya fara bugawa wasan shi na farko a 1997 a Valderrama, inda Seve Ballesteros ke jagorantar da maki biyar a kan 'yan Amurkan amma dai kawai ya sami nasarar kammala layi tare da hancunan su a gaba a tazarar mafi karanta, inda ya lashe 14½- 13½.

rows.source: "You keep reminding yourself that we had a big lead at Valderrama; we had a big lead at Brookline, where we lost, and at Valderrama, where we won, but only just," said Bjorn, pictured, after watching the Class of 2018 win 5-3 both on Friday and yesterday to lead 10-6 at Le Golf National.
rows.output: "Kullum kuna tunatar da kanku cewa muna da babban jagora a Valderrama; muna da babban jagora a Brookline, inda muka yi asara, da Valderrama, inda muka yi nasara, amma kawai kadan," in ji Bjorn, wanda aka nuna, bayan ya kalli Class of 2018 ta lashe 5-3 a ranar Juma'a da kuma jiya don jagorantar 10-6 a Le Golf National.
rows.reference: "Ka ci gaba da tunatar da kanka cewa mu na da babban jagora a Valderrama, mu na da babban jagora a Brookline, inda muka rasa, kuma a Valderrama, inda muka ci nasara, amma kawai," inji Bjorn, wanda ya kwatanta, bayan kallon Ajin 2018 lashe 5-3 a ranar Jumma'a da kuma jiya don kai 10-6 a Le Golf National.

rows.source: So history will show me and everybody on that team that this is not over.
rows.output: Don haka, tarihin zai nuna ni da kowa a kan wannan tawagar cewa wannan ba a kammala ba.
rows.reference: Toh Tarihi zai nuna mani da duk wanda ke wannan kungiyar cewa ba’a gama ba tukun.

rows.source: You go full bore tomorrow.
rows.output: Kuna tafiya cikin cikakkiyar gudu gobe.
rows.reference: Kana da cikaken shiga gobe.

rows.source: Get out there and do all the right things.
rows.output: Fita can kuma ka yi dukkan abubuwan da suka dace.
rows.reference: ka je can kayi duka abun da ya kamata daidai.

rows.source: This is not over till you've got the points on the board.
rows.output: Wannan ba a kammala ba har sai kun sami maki a kan allo.
rows.reference: Ba’a gama wannan ba sai ka samo makunan dake kan allo.

rows.source: We have a goal, and that is to try to win this trophy, and that's where the focus stays.
rows.output: Muna da burin, kuma hakan ya shafi kokarin lashe wannan kofi, kuma hakan ne ya sa hankalin ya kasance.
rows.reference: Mu na da manufa, kuma shi ne mu kokarta muci wannan kofin, kuma nan ne inda zamu mai da himma.

rows.source: I've said all along, I focus on the 12 players that are in our side, but we are so well aware of what's standing across on the other side - the greatest players in the world."
rows.output: Na ce a baya, ina mai da hankali kan 'yan wasa 12 da ke cikin kungiyarmu, amma muna da masaniya sosai game da abin da ke gefen daya - manyan 'yan wasa a duniya.
rows.reference: Na fada tun farko, ina mai da himma akan ‘yan wasa 12 dake tawagarmu, amma kuma duk mun san mai ke faruwa a dayan ɓangaren - su na da zakarun yan wasa na duniya.”

rows.source: Delighted how his players have performed on a tough golf course, Bjorn added: "I would never get ahead of myself in this.
rows.output: An yi farin ciki da yadda 'yan wasansa suka yi a kan wani kwas ɗin golf mai wahala, Bjorn ya ce: "Ba zan taba yin gaba da kaina a cikin wannan ba.
rows.reference: Sanin yadda wadannan ‘yan wasan suka yi a filin golf mai wahala, Bjorn ya kara: “Ba zan taɓa zuwa sama da kaina ba a wannan.

rows.source: Tomorrow's a different beast.
rows.output: Gobe wani dabba ne.
rows.reference: Gobe na daban ne babba.

rows.source: Tomorrow is the individual performances that come forward, and that is a different thing to do.
rows.output: Gobe ne lokacin da kowane mutum ya fito da kuma abin da ya ke yi, wani abu ne daban.
rows.reference: Gobe shi ne yin daidaiku da ke zuwa gaba, kuma shima abu ne na daban wajen yi.

rows.source: It's great to be out there with a partner when things are going good, but when you're out there individually, then you're tested to the full of your capacity as a golfer.
rows.output: Yana da kyau kasancewa a waje tare da abokin tarayya lokacin da abubuwa suke tafiya da kyau, amma lokacin da kuke a waje da kanku, to, an gwada ku zuwa iyakar karfin ku a matsayin dan wasan golf.
rows.reference: Yana da kyau idan ya kasance tare da abokin tarayya lokacin da abubuwa ke da kyau, amma idan kun fita waje ɗaidaiku, to ana jarraba ku da cikakken ikon ku a matsayin golfer.

rows.source: That's the message that you need to get across to players, is get the best out of yourself tomorrow.
rows.output: Saƙon da kuke buƙatar isarwa wa 'yan wasa shi ne ku sami mafi kyawun ku gobe.
rows.reference: Wannan shi ne saƙo da kake buƙatar ya isa zuwa ga 'yan wasa, shi ne fitar da iya kwazon ka gobe.

rows.source: Now, you leave your partner behind and he has to go and get the best out of himself, as well."
rows.output: Yanzu, ka bar abokin tarayyarka a baya kuma dole ne ya tafi ya fitar da mafi kyawun kowanne, kuma.
rows.reference: Yanzu, ku bar abokanku a baya domin dole ne fitar da iya kwazon sa da kanshi, da kuma. "

rows.source: In contrast to Bjorn, opposite number Jim Furyk will be looking for his players to perform better individually than they did as partners, the exceptions being Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas, who picked up three points out of four.
rows.output: Akwai bambanci tsakanin Bjorn, yayin da adadin Jim Furyk zai kasance yana neman 'yan wasansa su yi nasara da kansu fiye da yadda suka yi a matsayin abokan tarayya, ban da Jordan Spieth da Justin Thomas, wadanda suka samu maki uku cikin hudu.
rows.reference: Ya bambanta da Bjorn, kishiyar lambar Jim Furyk zai nemi 'yan wasansa suyi aiki da kwarewa fiye da yadda suke yi a tarayya, waɗanda suka hada da Jordan Spieth da Justin Thomas, wanda ya dauki maki uku daga cikin hudu.

rows.source: Furyk himself has been on both ends of those big last-day turnarounds, having been part of the winning team at Brookline before ending up a loser as Europe pulled off the "Miracle at Medinah."
rows.output: Furyk da kansa ya kasance a bangarorin biyu na waɗannan manyan juyi na ranar ƙarshe, yana cikin ƙungiyar da ta yi nasara a Brookline kafin ya zama wanda ya yi rashin nasara a lokacin da Turai ta yi "Al'ajibai a Medinah."
rows.reference: Furyk kansa ya kasance a kan iyakar wadannan manyan rukuni na baya-bayan nan, bayan kasancewa daya daga cikin 'yan wasan da suka lashe gasar a Brookline kafin su ci gaba da hasara yayin da Turai ta cire "Miracle a Madinah."

rows.source: "I remember every damn word of it," he said in reply to being asked how Ben Crenshaw, the captain in 1999, had rallied his players heading into the last day.
rows.output: Ina tuna kowace kalma mai tsauri na shi, ya ce a matsayin amsa ga yadda Ben Crenshaw, kyaftin a 1999, ya karfafa 'yan wasansa a rana ta karshe.
rows.reference: "Ina tunawa da duk wani mummunar magana," in ji shi a amsa cewa ana tambayar shi yadda Ben Crenshaw, kyaftin din a shekarar 1999, ya haɗa 'yan wasansa zuwa ranar ƙarshe.

rows.source: "We have 12 important matches tomorrow, but you'd like to get off to that fast start like you saw at Brookline, like you saw at Medinah.
rows.output: "Muna da wasanni 12 masu muhimmanci gobe, amma kuna son samun farawa mai sauri kamar yadda kuka gani a Brookline, kamar yadda kuka gani a Medinah.
rows.reference: "Mu na da wasanni 12 gobe, amma kuma sai kun tashi fara zuwa da sauri kamar yadda kuka gani a Brookline, kamar yadda kuka gani a Medinah.

rows.source: When that momentum gets going one way, it puts a lot of pressure on those middle matches.
rows.output: Lokacin da wannan motsi ya fara tafiya hanyar da ta dace, yana sanya babban matsin lamba a kan wadannan wasannin na tsakiya.
rows.reference: Lokacin da damuwa ya shiga ta hanya ɗaya, yana sanya matsanancin matsa lamba a kan waɗannan wassanin tsakiyar.

rows.source: We set up our line-up accordingly and put the guys out in the fashion that we felt like, you know, we're trying to make some magic tomorrow."
rows.output: Mun tsara layinmu bisa ga haka kuma mun sanya maza a cikin salon da muka ji, kun sani, muna ƙoƙarin yin sihiri gobe.
rows.reference: Mun kafa matakanmu bisa ga yadda ya kamata kuma muka sanya mutanen su cikin salon da muke so, kun sani, mu na ƙoƙarin yin bada mamaki a gobe. "

rows.source: Thomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter the other Europeans in the top half of the order.
rows.output: An ba da Thomas aikin gwada jagorantar yaki da dawowa kuma yana fuskantar Rory McIlroy a cikin babban wasa, tare da Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood da Ian Poulter sauran Turawa a cikin rabin farko na tsari.
rows.reference: An baiwa Thomas damar kokarin jagorancin Rory McIlroy a wasan sama tare da Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood da Ian Poulter da sauran 'yan Turai a cikin rabin sama a wannan tsarin.

rows.source: "I went with this group of guys in this order because I think it covers all the way through," said Bjorn of his singles selections.
rows.output: Na tafi tare da wannan rukunin maza a wannan tsari domin ina ganin ya rufe dukkan hanyar.
rows.reference: "Na tafi tare da wannan rukuni na mutane a cikin wannan tsari domin ina ganin yana rufe duk hanyar," in ji Bjorn na zabukansa.

rows.source: Germany's new warship postponed yet again
rows.output: Jamus sabuwar jirgin yaki ta jinkirta kuma.
rows.reference: An sake jinkirta sabon jirgin yakin ruwa Jamus kuma

rows.source: German Navy's newest frigate should have been commissioned in 2014 to replace ageing Cold War-era warships, but it won't be there until at least the next year due to faulty systems and snowballing cost, local media reported.
rows.output: Jirgin ruwan sojojin Jamus na sabo ya kamata a yi masa rantsuwa a shekarar 2014 don maye gurbin tsofaffin jiragen yakin sanyi, amma ba zai kasance ba har zuwa shekara mai zuwa saboda kura-kurai a cikin tsarin da kuma karuwar farashin, a cewar kafafen yada labarai na gida.
rows.reference: Ya kamata a kaddamar da sabon jirgin Sojin ruwan Jamus a shekarar 2014 don maye gurbin jiragen yaki tsofaffi Sanyi na zamani yaki. amma ba zai kasance ba har sai a kalla a shekara ta gaba saboda kuskuren tsarin da farashin dusar ƙanƙara, rahotanni na kafofin watsa labaru sun ruwaito.

rows.source: Commissioning of the "Rheinland-Pfalz," the lead ship of the brand new Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates, has now been postponed until the first half of 2019, according to Die Zeit newspaper citing a military spokesman.
rows.output: Hukumar ta "Rheinland-Pfalz", ita ce jirgin ruwa na farko na sabuwar ajin Baden-Wuerttemberg, yanzu an jinkirta har zuwa rabin farkon shekarar 2019, a cewar jaridar Die Zeit inda ta ambaci wani jami'in soja.
rows.reference: Kadamar da Rheinland-Pfalz, wadda ke jagorantar sabon nauyin Baden-Wuerttemberg, yanzu an dakatar da shi har zuwa farkon rabin shekarar 2019, in ji wata sanarwa ta Die Zeit.

rows.source: The vessel should have joined the Navy in 2014, but the troubling post-delivery issues plagued the fate of the ambitious project.
rows.output: Ya kamata jirgin ya shiga sojojin ruwa a shekarar 2014, amma matsalolin da suka taso bayan kammala ginin sun yi illa ga makomar aikin mai burin.
rows.reference: Ya kamata jirgin ya shiga Rundunar Sojan ruwa a shekarar 2014, amma matsalolin kamin kawowa ya tsaida da rabon zakulalen aikin.

rows.source: The four Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels the Navy ordered back in 2007 will come as replacement to the ageing Bremen-class frigates.
rows.output: Jiragen ruwa hudu na Baden-Wuerttemberg da Sojojin Ruwa suka yi oda tun 2007 za su maye gurbin tsofaffin jiragen ruwa na Bremen.
rows.reference: Jiragen ruwa hudu na Baden-Wuerttemberg da Sojin ruwa suka bada salahun a 2007 zai zo ne a matsayin sauyi ga tsohon Bremen-class frigates.

rows.source: It is understood they will feature a powerful cannon, an array of anti-aircraft and anti-ship missiles as well as some stealth technologies, such as reduced radar, infrared and acoustic signatures.
rows.output: An fahimci cewa za su ƙunshi wani babban bindiga, jerin makamai masu ɗaukar sama da jiragen ruwa, da kuma wasu fasahohin sirri, kamar rage radar, siginar infrared, da sauti.
rows.reference: An fahimci cewa za su ƙunshi wata tashar wuta mai karfi, jigon kayan yaki na jiragen sama da na jirgin ruwa da wasu fasahar zamani, kamar rage radar, infrared da kuma sa hannun sauti.

rows.source: Other important features include longer maintenance periods - it should be possible to deploy the newest frigates for up to two years away from home ports.
rows.output: Sauran abubuwan da suka dace sun hada da tsawaita lokacin kula - ya kamata a iya tura sabbin jiragen ruwa na mafi tsawon shekaru biyu daga tashoshin su.
rows.reference: Wasu muhimman siffofi sun haɗa da tsawon lokaci na haɓakawa - ya kamata a yi amfani da sabon frigates har zuwa shekaru biyu daga tashoshin ruwan gida.

rows.source: However, continuous delays mean that the cutting-edge warships - said to allow Germany to project power overseas - will already become outdated by the time they enter service, Die Zeit notes.
rows.output: Duk da haka, ci gaba da jinkiri yana nufin cewa jiragen ruwa na zamani - wadanda ake cewa suna baiwa Jamus damar yada karfin ta a kasashen waje - za su riga sun zama tsofaffi kafin su shiga aiki, a cewar Die Zeit.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, kara jinkirin yana nuna ingancin jirgin yaƙin - wanda zai ba Jamus izinin malakar karfin yaki a saman teku - zasu zama sun fita yayi a lokacin da za su shiga hidima, bayanin Die Zeit.

rows.source: The ill-fated F125 frigate made headlines last year, when the German Navy officially refused to commission the vessel and returned it to Blohm & Voss shipyard in Hamburg.
rows.output: An yi ta cece-kuce kan fashewar F125 a shekarar da ta gabata, lokacin da sojojin ruwa na Jamus suka ki karbar hukunci a hukumance, suka mayar da jirgin ga masana'antar jiragen ruwa ta Blohm & Voss a Hamburg.
rows.reference: Aibun F125 Frigate ya zama babban labari a shekarar bara, lokacin da jami’an sojin ruwa na Jamus suka ki kaddamar da jirgin kuma suka mayar da su zuwa wajen ajiyar Blohm & Voss a Hamburg.

rows.source: This was the first time the Navy has returned a ship to a shipbuilder after delivery.
rows.output: Wannan shi ne karon farko da Sojojin Ruwa suka dawo da jirgin ruwa zuwa masana'anta bayan an kai shi.
rows.reference: Wanna shi ne karin farka da Sojin ruwa zai mayar da jirgi zuwa ga mai gina shi bayan ya isar.

rows.source: Little was known about the reasons behind the return, but German media cited a number of crucial "software and hardware defects" that made the warship useless if deployed on a combat mission.
rows.output: Babu wani bayani da aka sani game da dalilan komawar, amma kafofin yada labarai na Jamus sun ambaci wasu kurakurai masu mahimmanci na "software da hardware" da suka sa jirgin yaki ya zama maras amfani idan aka tura shi aikin yaki.
rows.reference: Kadan aka sani game da dalilan da suka sa aka mayar, amma kafofin watsa labaru na Jamus sun ba da labarin "lahani da manhaja" wanda suka sa jirgin yakin zai zame marar amfani idan an tura shi a aikin gwagwarmaya.

rows.source: Software deficiencies were particularly important as the Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels will be operated by a crew of some 120 sailors - just half of the manpower on older Bremen class frigates.
rows.output: Rashin fasahar software ya kasance mai matukar muhimmanci yayin da jiragen ruwa na Baden-Wuerttemberg za a yi amfani da su ta hanyar ma'aikatan jirgin ruwa kusan 120 - kawai rabin ma'aikatan da ke kan tsofaffin jiragen ruwa na Bremen.
rows.reference: Karancin Manhaja ya kasance mai muhimmiyar muhimmanci kamar yadda ma'aikatan jirgin ruwa 120 na Baden-Wuerttemberg ke gudanar da su. Kusan rabin ma'aikatan tsohon Bremen class frigates.

rows.source: Also, it emerged that the ship is dramatically overweight which reduces its performance and limits the Navy's ability to add future upgrades.
rows.output: Haka kuma, ya bayyana cewa jirgin yana da nauyi fiye da kima wanda ke rage aikin sa kuma yana takaita sojojin ruwa na kara inganta nan gaba.
rows.reference: Har ila yau, ya bayyana cewa jirgin yana da nau’in mai nauyi wanda ya rage yin aikinsa kuma ya ƙayyade ikon sojin ruwa ingantawa na gaba.

rows.source: The 7,000-ton "Rheinland-Pfalz" is believed to be twice as heavy as similar-class ships used by the Germans in the Second World War.
rows.output: Jirgin ruwa mai nauyin ton 7,000 "Rheinland-Pfalz" ana ganin yana da nauyi sau biyu fiye da jiragen kasa iri daya da Jamusawa suka yi amfani da su a yakin duniya na biyu.
rows.reference: An kiyasta cewa "Rheinland-Pfalz" na ton 7,000 "yana da nauyi a matsayin jiragen ruwa na irin wannan jirgi da Jamus ke amfani da ita a yakin duniya na biyu.

rows.source: Aside from faulty hardware, the price tag of the entire project - including the training of the crew - is also becoming an issue.
rows.output: Baya ga kuskuren kayan aiki, kuma kudin dukan aikin - ciki har da horar da ma'aikata - ya zama matsala.
rows.reference: Baya ga kayan aiki mara kyau, farashin dukan aikin - ciki har da horar da ma'aikatan - yana zama batun.

rows.source: It is said to have reached staggering €3.1billion ($3.6bn) - up from initial €2.2 billion.
rows.output: An ce ya kai kusan Yuro biliyan 3.1 (£3.6bn) - sama da farkon Yuro biliyan 2.2.
rows.reference: An ce an kai kimanin dala biliyan €3.1 ($ 3.6bn) - daga farkon biliyan €2.2.

rows.source: Problems gripping the newest frigates become especially of importance in light of recent warnings that Germany's naval power is shrinking.
rows.output: Matsalolin da ke damun sabbin jiragen ruwa sun zama musamman masu muhimmanci idan aka yi la'akari da gargadin baya-bayan nan cewa ikon ruwa na Jamus yana raguwa.
rows.reference: Matsalolin da ke damun sabbin frigates sun zama mahimmanci a fagen gargadi na baya-bayan nan cewa ikon jiragen ruwa na Jamus yana raguwa.

rows.source: Earlier this year, Hans-Peter Bartels, chief of the German parliament's defense committee, acknowledged the Navy is actually "running out of deployment-capable ships."
rows.output: A farkon wannan shekarar, Hans-Peter Bartels, shugaban kwamitin tsaron majalisar dokokin Jamus, ya amince cewa sojojin ruwa na "gudun hijira da jiragen ruwa masu iya aiki."
rows.reference: Tun da farko wannan shekara, Hans-Peter Bartels, babban kwamandan kwamitin tsaro na kasar Jamus, ya amince da cewa jirgin ruwa na hakika yana "jiragen ruwa ya fara fita lokacin kaddamarwa na-jirage masu dama."

rows.source: The official said the issue has snowballed over time, because old ships were decommissioned but no replacement vessels were provided.
rows.output: Wani jami'in ya bayyana cewa, wannan batu ya ta'azzara a tsawon lokaci, saboda tsofaffin jiragen ruwa sun daina aiki ba tare da samun sabbin jirage na maye gurbinsu ba.
rows.reference: Jami'in ya ce matsalar ta dusar ƙanƙara a kan lokaci, saboda an dakatar da manyan jiragen ruwa tsofaffi amma ba a ba a kawo masu mayewa ba.

rows.source: He lamented that none of the of the Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates were able to join the Navy.
rows.output: Ya bayyana cewa babu wani daga cikin jiragen ruwa na Baden-Wuerttemberg da zai iya shiga cikin Sojojin Ruwa.
rows.reference: Ya yi baƙin ciki cewa babu wani daga cikin 'yan Baden-Wuerttemberg da suka shiga cikin jirgin ruwa.

rows.source: National Trust eavesdrops on secret life of bats
rows.output: Kungiyar National Trust tana sa ido kan rayuwar sirri na bats
rows.reference: Tarayya Aminci na leken asirin rayuwar jemagu

rows.source: New research being carried out at an estate in the Scottish Highlands aims to reveal how bats use the landscape in their hunt for food.
rows.output: Sabbin bincike da ake yi a wani gida a cikin tsaunukan Scotland na neman bayyana yadda kunkuru ke amfani da yanayin kasa wajen farautar abinci.
rows.reference: Sabon binciken da ake yi a wani yankin gidajen Sama na Scottish yana da manufa bayyana yadda jemagu suke amfani da wuri a cikin farauta don abinci.

rows.source: It is hoped the findings will shed new light on the behaviour of the unique flying mammals and help guide future conservation activities.
rows.output: Ana fatan binciken zai ba da haske kan halayen waɗannan dabbobin da ke tashi da kansu na musamman kuma zai taimaka wajen jagorantar ayyukan kiyayewa na gaba.
rows.reference: Ana fatan sakamakon binciken zai bayar da sabon haske game da halayyar mammals masu tashi da kuma taimakawa wajen jagorancin ayyukan kiyayewa na gaba.

rows.source: The study by scientists at the National Trust for Scotland will follow common and soprano pipistrelles as well as brown long-eared and Daubenton bats at Inverewe Gardens in Wester Ross.
rows.output: Wani bincike da masana kimiyya a cikin kungiyar kare muhalli ta kasa ta Scotland za su bi sawun gama gari da soprano pipistrelles da kuma bats na brown long-eared da Daubenton a wurin shakatawa na Inverewe a Wester Ross.
rows.reference: Masana binciken da masanan kimiyya suka yi a Tarrayan Aminci na Scotland za su bi na kullun da soprano pipistrelles tare da launin ruwan kasa da dogon-kunne da jamagen Daubenton a cikin Inverewe Gardens a Wester Ross.

rows.source: Special recorders will be placed at key locations around the property to track bat activities throughout the season.
rows.output: Ana sanya rikodin na musamman a wurare masu mahimmanci a kusa da dukiya don bin diddigin ayyukan ƙwallon ƙafa a duk lokacin.
rows.reference: za’a sanya naurar daukar murya na musamman a wajeje daban a zagayen kayayyakin domin duba al’amorin jemagun a cikin dukkan kakan.

rows.source: NHS staff and volunteers will also carry out mobile surveys using hand-held detectors.
rows.output: Ma'aikatan NHS da masu aikin sa kai za su gudanar da bincike ta hanyar amfani da na'urorin gano kwayoyin halitta.
rows.reference: Ma’aikatan NHS da masu sa kai za su kuma gudanar da bincike na wayar tafi-da-gidanka ta yin amfani da bincike na hannun.

rows.source: Expert sound analysis of all recordings will ascertain the frequency of the bat calls and which species are doing what.
rows.output: Ƙwararren binciken sauti na duk rikodin zai tantance yawan kiran kwari da nau'in da ke yin hakan.
rows.reference: Sakamakon sautin daga kwararru na dukkan daukan muryan za su iya sa a gane yawan kiran jemagu kuma da abin da kowane jinsuna ke yi.

rows.source: A habitat map and report will then be produced to create a detailed landscape-scale picture of their behaviour.
rows.output: Za a samar da taswirar mazaunin da rahoto don ƙirƙirar cikakken hoto na yanayin ƙasa na halayensu.
rows.reference: Za a samar da taswira da rahoto na al'ada don ƙirƙirar hoto mai zurfi game da halin su.

rows.source: Rob Dewar, nature conservation adviser for NTS, hopes the results will reveal which areas of habitat are most important to the bats and how they are used by each of the species.
rows.output: Rob Dewar, mai ba da shawara kan kiyaye muhalli ga NTS, yana fatan sakamakon zai bayyana wane yanki ne ya fi muhimmanci ga kwari da yadda ake amfani da su ta kowace jinsin.
rows.reference: Rob Dewar, mai ba da shawara game da yanayin na NTS, yana fatan sakamakon zai bayyana abin da yankunan zama mafi muhimmanci ga jemagui da kuma yadda suke amfani da kowannensu.

rows.source: This information will help determine the benefits of habitat management work such as meadow creation and how best to maintain woodlands for bats and other associated species.
rows.output: Wannan bayanin zai taimaka wajen tantance fa'idodin aikin sarrafa muhalli kamar ƙirƙirar ciyayi da kuma yadda za a kula da gandun daji don kifin gizo-gizo da sauran nau'ikan da ke da alaƙa.
rows.reference: Wannan bayani zai taimaka wajen ƙayyade amfani da aikin gudanarwa na gida kamar aikin samar da kayan aiki da kuma yadda zai fi dacewa don kula da gandun daji na jemagu da wasu irin jinsuna su.

rows.source: Bat populations in Scotland and across the UK have declined considerably over the past century.
rows.output: Yawan jinsin jinni a Scotland da sauran kasashen Birtaniya sun ragu sosai a cikin karni da ya gabata.
rows.reference: Yawan jemagu a Scotland da wasu kasashen Bitaniya ya sauka sosai a cikin karni na baya.

rows.source: They are under threat from building and development work that affects roosts and loss of habitat.
rows.output: Suna cikin hadari daga ayyukan gini da ci gaba da ke shafar wuraren zama da kuma asarar muhalli.
rows.reference: Su na cikin barazana daga gine-gine da aikin ci gaba da ke shafar hawaye da asarar wurin zama.

rows.source: Wind turbines and lighting can also pose a risk, as can flypapers and some chemical treatments of building materials, as well as attacks by pet cats.
rows.output: Motocin iska da fitilu suma suna haifar da hadari, kamar kura da wasu magungunan sinadarai na kayan gini, da kuma kai hari daga kyanwa.
rows.reference: Hasken iska da hasken lantarki na iya haifar da haɗari, kamar yadda jaridu da wasu magungunan sunadarai na kayan gine-gine suke yi, da kuma hare-haren daga dabba gida maguna.

rows.source: Bats are not actually blind.
rows.output: Dabbobin da ake kira bats ba makaho ba ne.
rows.reference: Gaskiyar shi ne jemgai ba makafai bane.

rows.source: However, due to their nocturnal hunting habits their ears are more useful than their eyes when it comes to catching prey.
rows.output: Duk da haka, saboda halayen farautar dare, kunnuwansu sun fi amfani da idanunsu wajen kama farauta.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, saboda halin su na farautan dare kunnuwan su sun fi amfani bisa ga idanuwansu idan yazo batun kama nama.

rows.source: They use a sophisticated echo-location technique to pinpoint bugs and obstacles in their flight path.
rows.output: Suna amfani da wata fasaha mai rikitarwa ta ƙayyadaddun wurare don gano kwari da cikas a cikin hanyar tserewa.
rows.reference: Su na amfani da haddaden tsarin sauraren sautin wuri da gano kwari da abubuwan dake tashe hanyar su.

rows.source: The NTS, which is responsible for the care of more than 270 historical buildings, 38 important gardens and 76,000 hectares of land around the country, takes bats very seriously.
rows.output: Kungiyar NTS, wacce ke da alhakin kula da gine-gine sama da 270 na tarihi, lambuna 38 masu muhimmanci, da kuma hekta 76,000 na fili a fadin kasar, tana daukar kura-kurai da muhimmanci sosai.
rows.reference: NTS, waɗanda ke da nauyin kiyaye fiye da gidanjen tarii 270, lambuna masu amfani 38 da kadada 76,000 na fili a cikin kasar, su na daukan jemage da matukan mahimmanci.

rows.source: It has ten trained experts, who regularly carry out surveys, roost inspections and sometimes rescues.
rows.output: Yana da kwararru goma, wadanda ke gudanar da bincike akai-akai, duba gida, kuma wani lokacin ceto.
rows.reference: Yana da kwarraru goma, masu yawan yin bincike, dibin tarin gidajen jemagai da kuma ceto wani lokaci.

rows.source: The organisation has even set up Scotland's first and only dedicated bat reserve at Threave estate in Dumfries and Galloway, which is home to eight of Scotland's ten bat species.
rows.output: Kungiyar ta kafa aikin ajiyar da ba a taba yi ba a Scotland a gidan Threave a Dumfries da Galloway, wanda ke zama gidan nau'ikan tsuntsayen Scotland guda takwas cikin goma.
rows.reference: Masana’antar ta ma bude gidan ajiyar jemagai kawai na farko a Scotland a Dukiyar Threave dake Dumfires da Galloway, wanda ke da jinsi jemagai 8 daga cikin goma na Scotland.

rows.source: Estate manager David Thompson says the estate is the ideal territory for them.
rows.output: Manajan gida David Thompson ya ce gonar ita ce yankin da ya dace a gare su.
rows.reference: Manajan Dukiyar David Thompson yace dukiyar na yanki mafi dacewa masu.

rows.source: "Here at Threave we have a great area for bats," he said.
rows.output: "A nan a Threave muna da babban yanki ga bats," in ji shi.
rows.reference: “Nan a Threave mu na da kyakkyawan yanki wa jemagai,” yace.

rows.source: "We've got the old buildings, lots of veteran trees and all the good habitat.
rows.output: Muna da tsofaffin gine-gine, da yawa daga cikin bishiyoyin da suka dade, da duk wani mazaunin da ya dace.
rows.reference: “Mu na da tsofaffin gidaje, tsoffafin itace da kuma mazauni mai kyau.

rows.source: But there is much about bats that is still unknown, so the work we do here and at other properties will help us understand more about what they need to thrive."
rows.output: Amma akwai abubuwa da yawa game da kwarangwal da har yanzu ba a sani ba, don haka aikin da muke yi a nan da sauran kadarori zai taimaka mana mu fahimci abin da suke bukata don bunƙasa."
rows.reference: Amma akwai abubuwa da yawa akan jemagai da ba a sani ba, saboda haka ayyukan da muke yi akan wannan dukiyar zai taimake mu wajen gane wasu abubuwa da suke bukata dan su bunƙasa.”

rows.source: He stresses the importance of checking for bats before carrying out maintenance within properties as it is possible unwitting destruction of a single maternity roost could kill up to 400 females and young, possibly wiping out an entire local population.
rows.output: Ya jaddada mahimmancin duba gizo-gizo kafin fara gyara a cikin kadarori domin yana yiwuwa a lalata gizo-gizo da gangan ta hanyar lalata gizo-gizo guda daya kawai.
rows.reference: Ya jaddada mahimmanci diba jenmagan kafin a yi aikin kulawa da dukiyar tunda yana yiyuwa rusa tarin gidan matan zai iya kai ga mutuwan har matan su da yaran su 400, wanda zai iya yiyuwar shafe gaba ki daya yawan tsuntsayen yankin.

rows.source: Bats are protected and it is illegal to kill, harass or disturb them or destroy their roosts.
rows.output: Ana kare bats kuma yana da haramun a kashe, a yi musu tsangwama ko a tsoratar da su ko kuma a lalata gidajensu.
rows.reference: Ana kiyaye jemagai dan haka bai hallatta a kashe su, tayar masu da hankali ko damuwar su ko rigiza gidajen su ba.

rows.source: Elisabeth Ferrell, Scottish officer for the Bat Conservation Trust, has encouraged the public to pitch in to help.
rows.output: Elisabeth Ferrell, jami'ar Scotland ga kungiyar kare kurayen, ta bukaci jama'a da su shiga taimakawa.
rows.reference: Elisabeth Ferrel, Jami’ar Scotland ta Ma’aikatar Kula da Jemage, ta nemi goyon bayan mutane su hada gwiwa wurin taimakawa.

rows.source: She said: "We still have a lot to learn about our bats and for many of our species we just don't know how their populations are faring."
rows.output: Ta ce: "Har yanzu muna da abubuwa da yawa da za mu koya game da kwariyarmu kuma ga yawancin nau'inmu, ba mu san yadda ake tafiyar da yawan jama'arsu ba."
rows.reference: Ta ce: “Mu na da abubuwa da yawa da zamu koya akan jemagai da kuma jinsunan su masu yawa kwai bamu san yadda yanayin yawan su yake ba.”

rows.source: Ronaldo dismisses rape claims as lawyers set to sue German magazine
rows.output: Ronaldo ya yi watsi da zargin fyade a matsayin lauyoyin suka shirya kai karar mujallar Jamus.
rows.reference: Ronaldo yayi watsi da ikirarin fyaɗe a yayin da lauyoyi suke shirin su kai ƙarar mujallar Jamus.

rows.source: Cristiano Ronaldo has branded rape claims against him as "fake news," saying that people "want to promote themselves" by using his name.
rows.output: Cristiano Ronaldo ya kira zargin fyade da ake yi masa da "labaran karya," yana mai cewa mutane "suna son yin suna" ta hanyar amfani da sunansa.
rows.reference: Cristiano Ronaldo yayi kira da ikirarin da aka mashi akan fyaɗe akan “labarun ƙarya”, yana cewa mutane “su na so su inganta kansu” ta hanyar amfani da sunan shi.

rows.source: His lawyers are set to sue German news magazine Der Spiegel, which published the allegations.
rows.output: An shirya lauyoyinsa su shigar da kara ga mujallar labarai ta Jamus Der Spiegel, wadda ta buga zargin.
rows.reference: Lauyoyin shi su na shirin kai ƙarar mujallar Jamus Der Spiegel, wanda suka buga zargin.

rows.source: The Portugal and Juventus forward has been accused of raping an American woman, named as Kathryn Mayorga, in a Las Vegas hotel room in 2009.
rows.output: An zarge dan wasan gaba na Portugal da Juventus da laifin fyade da wata mata Amurka mai suna Kathryn Mayorga a dakin otel a Las Vegas a shekarar 2009.
rows.reference: An zargi dan wasan gaban na Portugal da Juventus da yi wa wata mata ‘yar Amurka fyaɗe, mai suna Kathryn Mayorga, a wani dakin otel na Las Vegas a 2009.

rows.source: He is alleged to have then paid her $375,000 to keep quiet about the incident, Der Spiegel reported on Friday.
rows.output: An zarge shi da ya biya ta dala 375,000 domin ta yi shiru kan lamarin, kamar yadda Der Spiegel ta ruwaito a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Ana zargin cewa bayan haka ya biya ta dala 375,000 dan ta rufe bakin ta akan abun, Der Spiegel sun yi rihoto ranar Jumma’a.

rows.source: Speaking in an Instagram Live video to his 142 million followers hours after the claims were reported, Ronaldo, 33, slammed the reports as "fake news."
rows.output: Yin magana a cikin bidiyon Instagram Live ga mabiyan sa miliyan 142 sa'o'i bayan an ruwaito ikirari, Ronaldo mai shekaru 33, ya yi watsi da ikirarin a matsayin "labaran karya."
rows.reference: A lokacin da yake magana ta hanyar bidiyon shi ta Instagram da masu bin shi Miliyan 142 sa’o’i bayan an yi rihoton ikirarin, Ronaldo, 33, yayi watsi da rihoton matsayin “labarin karya”

rows.source: "No, no, no, no , no.
rows.output: A'a, a'a, a'a, a'a, a'a.
rows.reference: “A’a, a’a, a’a, a’a, a’a.

rows.source: What they said today, fake news," the five-time Ballon d'Or winner says into the camera.
rows.output: Abin da suka ce yau, labaran karya," in ji wanda ya lashe kyautar Ballon d'Or sau biyar a cikin kyamarar.
rows.reference: abun da suka ce yau, labarin karya ne,” maciyin Ballon d’Or biyar din yace a cikin kamarar.

rows.source: "They want to promote themselves by using my name.
rows.output: Suna son su kara sunansu ta hanyar amfani da sunana.
rows.reference: “Su na so su inganta kansu ta hanyar amfani da suna na.

rows.source: It's normal.
rows.output: Yana da al'ada.
rows.reference: Hakan daidai ne.

rows.source: They want to be famous to say my name, but it is part of the job.
rows.output: Suna son a san su don cewa suna da sunana, amma hakan wani bangare ne na aikin.
rows.reference: Su na so su yi suna ta hanyar ambaton suna na, amma yana cikin aikin.

rows.source: I am a happy man and all good," the player added, smiling.
rows.output: Ni mutum ne mai farin ciki da kuma mai kyau, in ji dan wasan, yana murmushi.
rows.reference: “Ni mutun ne dake cikin kwanciyar hankali kuma komai kalau,” dan wasan ya ƙara, yana murmushi.

rows.source: Ronaldo's lawyers are preparing to sue Der Spiegel over the allegations, which they have called "an inadmissible reporting of suspicions in the area of privacy," according to Reuters.
rows.output: Laƙawun Ronaldo suna shirin ɗaukar matakin shari'a kan Der Spiegel bisa zargin, wanda suka kira "raba zarge-zarge a yankin sirri," a cewar Reuters, bisa ga jaridar.
rows.reference: Lauyoyi masu kare Ronaldo su na shirin su kai ƙarar Der Spiegel akan zargin, wanda suka kira “Rihoton da bashi da hujja akan zargi ta yankin sirri,” bisa ga Reuters.

rows.source: Lawyer Christian Schertz said the player would seek compensation for "moral damages in an amount corresponding to the gravity of the infringement, which is probably one of the most serious violations of personal rights in recent years."
rows.output: An ba da shawarar lauya Christian Schertz ya ce dan wasan zai nemi diyya saboda "laifukan da suka shafi dabi'a a cikin adadin da ya dace da munin laifin, wanda wataƙila ɗaya ne daga cikin manyan take hakkin ɗan adam a cikin 'yan shekarun nan."
rows.reference: Lawyer Christian Schertz ya ce dan wasan zai nemi cin tara akan “ɓata masa halaye na dabi'a, a cikin adadin da ya dace da nauyin laifin, wanda yakan iya zama mafi tsananin cin zarafin haƙin ɗan adam a cikin shekarun nan.”

rows.source: The alleged incident is said to have taken place in June 2009 at a suite at the Palms Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas.
rows.output: An ce lamarin ya faru ne a watan Yuni 2009 a wani daki a otal din Palms da kuma caca a Las Vegas.
rows.reference: Zargin ana cewa wai ya faru ne a Yuni 2009 a wani babban ɗaki na Palm Otel and Casino a Las Vegas.

rows.source: After meeting in a nightclub, Ronaldo and Mayorga reportedly went back to the player's room, where he allegedly anally raped her, according to papers filed at Clark County District Court in Nevada.
rows.output: Bayan haduwa da wani kulob na dare, Ronaldo da Mayorga sun tafi dakin mai wasan, inda ake zargin an yi mata fyade a bayan gida, kamar yadda aka bayyana a cikin takardun da aka shigar a kotun gundumar Clark a Nevada.
rows.reference: Bayan sun hadu a wani gidan wasan kwaikwayo na dare, Ronaldo da Mayorga wai sun koma dakin dan wasan, wurin da a zargin ya mata fyaɗe a duburi, bisa ga takardun da aka saka a fayil ɗin dake Kotun Gundumar Clark a Nevada.

rows.source: Mayorga claims Ronaldo fell to his knees after the alleged incident and told her he was "99 percent" a "good guy" let down by the "one percent."
rows.output: Mayorga ta yi iƙirarin cewa Ronaldo ya fadi a gwiwa bayan abin da ake zarginsa da shi kuma ya gaya mata cewa shi "99 cikin 100" "mutumin kirki" ne da "daya cikin 100" ya taimaka masa.
rows.reference: Mayorga tayi ikirari cewa Ronaldo ya faɗi akan gwiwan shi bayan hakan kuma ya ce mata “kashi 99” “mutumin kirki” wanda ke samun akasi daga “kashi ɗaya”.

rows.source: The documents claim that Ronaldo confirmed the pair had sex, but that it was consensual.
rows.output: Wadannan takardu sun yi iƙirarin cewa Ronaldo ya tabbatar da cewa ma'auratan sun yi jima'i, amma ya ce an yi hakan da yardar rai.
rows.reference: Takardur su na ikirari cewa Ronaldo ya gasganta cewa su biu sun yi jima’i, amma cikin yarjejeniya ce.

rows.source: Mayorga also claims she went to the police and had photographs taken of her injuries at a hospital, but later agreed to an out-of-court settlement because she felt "terrified of retaliation" and was worried about "being publicly humiliated."
rows.output: Mayorga ta yi iƙirarin cewa ta je ofishin 'yan sanda ta kuma yi hoton raunukanta a asibiti, amma daga baya ta amince da sulhu a wajen kotu domin ta ji "ta firgita da ramuwar gayya" kuma tana damuwa da "zama jama'a."
rows.reference: Mayorga kuma tayi ikirari cewa ta je wajen ‘yan sanda kuma an ɗauki hotunan raunin da ta ji a asibit, amma daga baya ta yadda da sulhu a wajen kotu saboda ta ji “tsoron ramuwa” kuma ta damu akan “dizguwa a fuskar mutane.”

rows.source: The 34-year-old says she is now seeking to overturn the settlement as she continues to be traumatized by the alleged incident.
rows.output: Matar mai shekaru 34 ta ce yanzu tana neman a soke yarjejeniyar domin har yanzu tana fama da raɗaɗi daga lamarin da ake zarginsa da shi.
rows.reference: Yar shekara 34 ɗn yanzu tana neman juya sulhun a yayin da ta ci gaba da fuskantar kunci daga abun da ya farun.

rows.source: Ronaldo was on the verge of joining Real Madrid from Manchester United at the time of the alleged assault, and this summer moved to Italian giants Juve in a €100 million deal.
rows.output: Ronaldo yana gab da shiga Real Madrid daga Manchester United a lokacin da aka yi zargin cin zarafi, kuma a wannan lokacin ya koma manyan ‘yan wasan Italiya Juve kan kudi Yuro miliyan 100.
rows.reference: Ronaldo yana kan komawa Real Madrid daga Manchester United a lokacin da farmakin da ake zargin ya faru, kuma wannan ranin ya koma babban kungiyar kwallon Italia Juventus a yarjejeniyar Yuro miliyan100.

rows.source: Brexit: UK 'would forever regret' losing carmakers
rows.output: Brexite: Birtaniya za ta yi nadama har abada idan ta rasa masana'antar kera motoci
rows.reference: Brexit: UK ‘har abada zata yi da na sanin’ rasa masu kera motoci

rows.source: The UK "would regret it forever" if it lost its status as a world leader in car manufacturing after Brexit, Business Secretary Greg Clark has said.
rows.output: Birtaniya "za ta yi nadama har abada" idan ta rasa matsayinta na jagora a duniya wajen kera motoci bayan Brexit, in ji Sakataren Kasuwanci Greg Clark.
rows.reference: UK “zata yi da na sanin shi har abada” idan tayi rashin matsayin ta na shugabancin kera mota bayan Brexit, Sakataren Sana’a Greg Clark yace.

rows.source: He added it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal it would temporarily halt production at its factory in Burnaston, near Derby.
rows.output: Ya kara da cewa, abin damuwa ne cewa, Toyota UK ta gaya wa BBC cewa, idan Birtaniya ta bar EU ba tare da yarjejeniya ba, za ta dakatar da samar da motoci na wucin gadi a masana'antar ta ta Burnaston, kusa da Derby.
rows.reference: Ya kara cewa abun “damuwa ne” cewa Toyota UK ta fada wa BBC cewa idan Britain ta fita EU ba tare da yarjejeniya ba zata sayar da aiki na dan wani lokaci a masana’antar ta a Burnaston, kusa da Derby.

rows.source: "We need a deal," Mr Clark said.
rows.output: "Muna bukatar yarjejeniya," Mista Clark ya ce.
rows.reference: “Mu na bukatar yarjejeniya,” Mr Clark ya ce.

rows.source: The Japanese carmaker said the impact of border delays in the event of a no-deal Brexit could cost jobs.
rows.output: Mai kera motoci na Japan ya ce tasirin jinkirin iyakoki a cikin yanayin ficewar Brexit na iya haifar da asarar ayyuka.
rows.reference: Kamfanin Japan din na mota yace tasirin jinkiri a iyakar kasa a yanayin Brexit babu yarjejeniya zai iya kwao rasa ayyuka.

rows.source: The Burnaston plant - which makes Toyota's Auris and Avensis - produced nearly 150,000 cars last year of which 90% were exported to the rest of the European Union.
rows.output: Matsayin Burnaston - wanda ke yin Toyota's Auris da Avensis - ya samar da kusan motoci 150,000 a shekarar da ta gabata daga cikinsu kashi 90% an fitar da su zuwa sauran kasashen Tarayyar Turai.
rows.reference: Masana’antar Burnaston din - wanda ke hada Toyota Auris da Avensis - sun kera kusan motoci 150,000 bara wanda a ciki kashi 90 aka fitar zuwa sauran kasashen Turai.

rows.source: "My view is that if Britain crashes out of the EU at the end of March we will see production stops in our factory," said Marvin Cooke, Toyota's managing director at Burnaston.
rows.output: "Ra'ayina shi ne cewa idan Birtaniya ta yi karo da EU a karshen Maris, za mu ga aikin samarwa ya tsaya a masana'antar mu," in ji Marvin Cooke, darektan gudanarwa na Toyota a Burnaston.
rows.reference: “A gani na shi ne idan Britain ta fita EU a karshen Maris zamu ga sayawar kira a masana;antar mu,” inji Mavin Cooke, Manajin Direkta na Toyota a Burnaston.

rows.source: Other UK car manufacturers have raised fears about leaving the EU without agreement on how cross-border trade will function, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.output: Sauran masu kera motoci a Burtaniya sun bayyana damuwarsu game da ficewa daga Tarayyar Turai ba tare da yarjejeniya kan yadda cinikin iyakoki zai yi ba, ciki har da Honda, BMW, da Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.reference: Wasu masu kera motocin UK sun nuna jin tsoro akan fita EU ba tare da yarjejniya ba akan yadda kasuwancin tsallaken iyaka zai kasance, har da Honda, BMW da Jaguar Land Rover.

rows.source: BMW, for example, says it will close its Mini plant in Oxford for a month following Brexit.
rows.output: BMW, misali, ta ce za ta rufe masana’antar Mini a Oxford na wata guda saboda Brexit.
rows.reference: BMW, kamar misali, ta ce zata kulle karamin masana’antar ta da ke Oxford na tsawon wata daya bayan Brexit.

rows.source: The main concerns relate to what carmakers say are supply chain risks in the event of a no-deal Brexit.
rows.output: Muhimman abubuwan da suka shafi su ne abin da masana'antun motoci ke cewa hadarin sarkar samar da kayayyaki a cikin yanayin ficewar Birtaniya daga Tarayyar Turai ba tare da yarjejeniya ba.
rows.reference: Babban damuwan yana dangance da abun da makera motoci suka ce ne dangane da hadarin samun kayayyakin aiki idan akayi Brexit ba yarjejeniya.

rows.source: Toyota's production line is run on a "just-in-time" basis, with parts arriving every 37 minutes from suppliers in both the UK and the EU for cars made to order.
rows.output: Layin samar da Toyota yana gudana ne bisa tsarin "kawai a lokacin", inda sassa ke isa kowane minti 37 daga masu samar da su a cikin Burtaniya da EU don motocin da aka yi wa umarni.
rows.reference: Ana aiwatar da hanyar sarrafawar Toyota na akan tsarin “gab-da-lokaci”, yadda sassa su na isowa ko wani minti 37 daga masu kaya duk daga UK da EU na motocin da ake kira dan sari.

rows.source: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be disruption at the border which the industry says could lead to delays and shortages of parts.
rows.output: Idan Burtaniya ta fice daga EU ba tare da yarjejeniya ba a ranar 29 ga Maris, ana iya samun cikas a kan iyaka wanda masana'antu ke cewa zai haifar da jinkiri da karancin sassa.
rows.reference: Idan UK ta bar EU ba tare dayarjejeniya ba ranar 29 ga watan Maris, za’a iya samun matsaloli a iyaka wanda masana’antar ta ce yakan iya kawo jinkiri da rashin isashen sassa.

rows.source: It would be impossible for Toyota to hold more than a day's worth of inventory at its Derbyshire plant, the company said, and so production would be stopped.
rows.output: Ba zai yiwu Toyota ta rike fiye da kwanaki biyu na ajiyar kaya a masana'antar ta ta Derbyshire ba, kamar yadda kamfanin ya bayyana, kuma don haka za a daina samarwa.
rows.reference: Ba zai yiyu Toyota ta rike fiye da kayan aiki na kwana daya a masana’antar ta na Derbyshire, kamfanin ta ce, dan haka aiki zai saya.

rows.source: Mr Clark said Theresa May's Chequers plan for future relations with the EU is "precisely calibrated to avoid those checks at the border."
rows.output: Mista Clark ya ce shirin Chequers na Theresa May kan dangantakar nan gaba da EU "yana daidaita daidai don gujewa wadannan binciken a kan iyaka."
rows.reference: Mr Clark ya ce tsarin binciken Theresa May na dagantakan gaba da EU an “asalin tsara shi dan kauyce wa wadannan binciken a iyaka.”

rows.source: "We need to have a deal. We want to have the best deal that will allow as I say not just the success at present to be enjoyed but for us to grasp this opportunity," he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.
rows.output: "Muna bukatar mu samu yarjejeniya. Muna son samun mafi kyawun yarjejeniya da za ta ba mu damar, kamar yadda na fada, ba kawai samun nasara a halin yanzu ba, har ma da mu dauki wannan dama."
rows.reference: “Mu na bukatar mu samu yarjejeniya. Mu na so mu samu mafi kyakkyawan yarjejeniya da zai bamu daman kamar yadda na fada ba kawai nasaran da zamu ji dadin shi a halin yanzu ba amma mu samu yin amfani da wannan daman,” ya fada a tsarin Yau na Radiyon BBC 4.

rows.source: "The evidence from not just Toyota but other manufacturers is that we need to absolutely be able to continue what has been a highly successful set of supply chains."
rows.output: "Shaidar daga ba kawai Toyota ba, amma sauran masu kera motoci ma, ita ce muna bukatar mu ci gaba da samun nasarar da aka samu a hanyoyin samar da kayayyaki."
rows.reference: “Hujjan da ba na Toyota ba kawai amma har da na wasu makera shi ne mu na asalin bukatar mu ci gaba da abun da yake nasarraren samar da kayaki.”

rows.source: Toyota was unable to say how long production would be stopped, but in the longer term, warned that added costs would reduce the plant's competitiveness and eventually cost jobs.
rows.output: Toyota ba zai iya cewa tsawon lokacin da aka dakatar da samarwa ba, amma a cikin dogon lokaci, ya yi gargadin cewa karin kudade za su rage gasa na masana'antar kuma a karshe su yi asarar ayyuka.
rows.reference: Toyota ta kasa fadan tsawon lokacin da za a sayar da aiki, amma a hangen gaba, sun bada gargadin cewa farashi zai rage karfin gasar masana’antar kuma hakan zai kai ga asarar ayyuka.

rows.source: Peter Tsouvallaris, who has worked at Burnaston for 24 years and is the Unite union convenor at the plant, said his members are increasingly concerned: "In my experience once these jobs go they never come back.
rows.output: Pita Tsouvallaris, wanda ya yi aiki a Burnaston na shekaru 24 kuma shi ne shugaban kungiyar ma'aikata ta Unite a masana'antar, ya ce a gare shi: "A cikin kwarewata, da zarar wadannan ayyukan sun tafi, ba sa dawowa.
rows.reference: Peter Tsouvallaris, wanda yayi aiki a Burnaston na tsawon shekaru 24 kuma shi ne kakakin kungiyar hadin kai a masana’antar, yace mambobin su na ci gaba da damuwa: “A cikin kwarewata da zaran wadannan ayyukan sun tafi ba sa taba dawowa.

rows.source: A government spokesperson said: "We have put forward a precise and credible plan for our future relationship with the EU."
rows.output: Wani mai magana da yawun gwamnati ya ce: "Mun gabatar da wani tsari mai tsauri da kuma mai yiwuwa ga dangantakarmu ta gaba da EU."
rows.reference: Wani kakakin gwamnati ya ce: “Mun mika tsarin daidai kuma na gaskiya don alakar mu ta gaba da EU.”

rows.source: Trump meeting with Rosenstein may be delayed again, says White House
rows.output: Taron Trump da Rosenstain na iya jinkiri, in ji fadar White House
rows.reference: Haduwar Trump da Rosenstein zai iya samun jinkiri kuma, inji White House

rows.source: Donald Trump's high-stakes meeting with deputy attorney general Rod Rosenstein could be "pushed back another week" as the fight over supreme court nominee Brett Kavanaugh continues, the White House said on Sunday.
rows.output: Taron da Donald Trump ya yi da mataimakin babban lauyan kasar Rod Rosenstein na iya jinkirta "har wata guda" saboda takaddamar da ake yi kan zaben babban kotun Brett Kavanaugh, fadar White House ta bayyana a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Haduwar Donald Trump na mahimmanci da mataimakin lauya janar Rod Rosenstein zai iya “matsawa gaba da sati daya” a yayin da fada akan waklin babban kotu Brett Kavanaugh ya ci gaba, White House ta ce ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: Rosenstein oversees the work of special counsel Robert Mueller, who is investigating Russian election interference, links between Trump aides and Russia and potential obstruction of justice by the president.
rows.output: Rosenstein yana kula da aikin lauyan musamman Robert Mueller, wanda ke binciken yadda Rasha ta yi tasiri a zaben, alakar da ke tsakanin abokan Trump da Rasha, da kuma yiwuwar cewa Trump ya toshe adalci.
rows.reference: Rosenstein ke kula da aikin mashawarci na musamman Robert Mueler, wanda ke binciken tsangwamar Rasha akan zabe, mahadi tsakanin ma’aikatan Trump da Russia da yiyuwar toshe adalci daga Shugaban kasar.

rows.source: Whether or not Trump will fire the deputy attorney general, and thereby endanger Mueller's independence, has fuelled Washington gossip for months.
rows.output: Shin Trump zai kori mataimakin babban lauyan gwamnati, wanda hakan zai iya kawo cikas ga ‘yancin kai na Mueller, ya kasance abin tattaunawa a Washington tsawon watanni.
rows.reference: Shin Trump zai kori ko ba zai kori mataimakin alkalin alkalai daga aiki, a hakan ya saka ‘yancin Mueller cikin hadari, ya cika gulmar Washington a watanni.

rows.source: Earlier this month, the New York Times reported that Rosenstein discussed wearing a wire to record conversations with Trump and the possibility of removing the president via the 25th amendment.
rows.output: A farkon wannan watan, Jaridar New York Times ta ruwaito cewa, an yi ta tattaunawa tsakanin shugaban ma'aikatan fadar shugaban kasa, John F. Kelly da wani babban jami'in ma'aikatar shari'a, Rod J. Rosenstein, game da sanya na'urar rikodi a cikin tattaunawa da Trump da kuma yiwuwar cire shi daga mukaminsa ta hanyar gyara na 25 na kundin tsarin mulki.
rows.reference: Farkon watan nan, New York Times sun yi rihoto cewa Rosenstein ya tattauna tare da waya dan rikodin labarin shi da Trump da kuma yiyuwar cire Shugaban kasar ta hanyar doka a 25.

rows.source: Rosenstein denied the report.
rows.output: Rosenstein ya musanta rahoton.
rows.reference: Rosenstein ya karyata rihoton.

rows.source: But last Monday he went to the White House, amid reports he was about to resign.
rows.output: Amma a ranar Litinin da ta gabata ya tafi fadar White House, a daidai lokacin da rahotanni ke cewa zai yi murabus.
rows.reference: Amma Litinin din da ta wuce ya je White House, a cikin rahoton cewa zai yi marabus.

rows.source: Instead, a meeting with Trump, who was then at the United Nations in New York, was announced for Thursday.
rows.output: Maimakon haka, an sanar da taro da Trump, wanda a lokacin yana cikin Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a birnin New York, a ranar Alhamis.
rows.reference: A maimakon haka, haduwar shi da Trump, wanda a lokacin yake Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a New York, aka sanar a ranar Alhamis.

rows.source: Trump said he would "prefer not" to fire Rosenstein but then the meeting was delayed to avoid a clash with the Senate judiciary committee hearing in which Kavanaugh and one of the women who have accused him of sexual misconduct, Dr Christine Blasey Ford, both testified.
rows.output: Trump ya ce ya "fi so ba" ya kori (Rosenstein) amma sai an jinkirta taron ne don kaucewa rikici da shari'ar majalisar dattijai ta majalisar dattawa, inda aka yi wa (Kavanaugh) da kuma daya daga cikin mata biyu da suka zarge shi da cin zarafi, Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, suka shaida.
rows.reference: Trump ya ce zai “fi son kar” ya kori Rosenstein amma dai an jinkirta haduwar ne dan kar a samu karo da sauraron kwamitin ‘yan majalisa na Shari’a wurin da Kavanaugh da wata matar da suke zargin shi da halayen da ba su dace ba akan jima’i, Dr Christine Blasey Ford, dukka sun bada shaida.

rows.source: On Friday, Trump ordered a one-week FBI investigation of claims against Kavanaugh, further delaying a full Senate vote.
rows.output: A ranar Juma'a, Trump ya umurci binciken FBI na mako guda kan zarge-zargen da ake yi wa Kavanaugh, wanda ya kara jinkirin kada kuri'a ta dukkan majalisar dattawa.
rows.reference: Ranar Juma’a, Trump ya bada umurnin binciken FBI na sti daya, akan ikirarai kan Kavanaugh, wanda ya kara kawo jinkiri ga zaben Yan Majalisa.

rows.source: Trump's press secretary, Sarah Sanders, appeared on Fox News Sunday.
rows.output: Makarantar tattaunawa ta Trump, Sarah Sanders, ta fito a gidan talabijin na Fox Sunday.
rows.reference: Sakataren Kakaki na Trump, Sara Saunders, ta bayyana a Fox News ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: Asked about the Rosenstein meeting, she said: "A date for that hasn't been set, it could be this week, I could see that pushing back another week given all of the other things that are going on with the supreme court.
rows.output: An tambaye ta game da taron da ya shafi Rosenstein, ta ce: "Ba a saita ranar ba, zai iya zama wannan mako, zan iya ganin yana tura baya mako guda idan aka yi la'akari da sauran abubuwan da ke faruwa a kotun koli.
rows.reference: Da aka tambaye ta akan haduwar Rosenstein din, ta ce: “Ba’a saka rana ba ma wannan, zai iya zama wannan satin, ina ganin za’a iya masar da shi gaba da sati daya bisa ga dukka abubuwan da ke tafiya a babban kotun.

rows.source: But we'll see and I always like to keep the press updated."
rows.output: Amma za mu gani kuma ina son in sanar da kafafen yada labarai cewa akwai abubuwa da yawa da za a yi.
rows.reference: Amma za mu gani kuma za muci gaba da ‘yan jarida bayanai."

rows.source: Some reporters would contest that assertion: Sanders has not held a White House press briefing since 10 September.
rows.output: Wasu masu rubutun labarai za su yi jayayya da wannan ikirari: Sanders bai gudanar da taron manema labarai na fadar White House ba tun ranar 10 ga Satumba.
rows.reference: Wasu 'yan jarida za su yi hamayya da wannan bayani: Sanders bai gudanar da wani jawabi a Fadar White House tun 10 Satumba.

rows.source: Host Chris Wallace asked why.
rows.output: Host Chris Wallace ya tambayi dalilin.
rows.reference: Mai watsa shiri Chris Wallace ya tambayi me yasa.

rows.source: Sanders said the scarcity of briefings was not due to a distaste for TV reporters "grandstanding," although she said: "I won't disagree with the fact that they grandstand."
rows.output: Sander ta ce rashin yawan taron manema labarai ba saboda rashin son masu yada labarai na talabijin "su yi nuni da girman kai," duk da cewa ta ce: "Ban yarda da gaskiyar cewa suna yin nuni ba."
rows.reference: Sanders ya ce, rashin yin jawabin da aka yi bai kasance ba ne saboda matsala ga masu sauraro na TV, "duk da cewa ta ce: "Ba zan karyata gaskiyar ba cewa su na da kima."

rows.source: She then suggested direct contact between Trump and the press will increase.
rows.output: Sannan ta ba da shawarar cewa tuntubar Trump kai tsaye da kafafen yada labarai za ta karu.
rows.reference: Daga nan sai ta ba da shawarar ganinTrump kai tsaye hakan zai sa ‘yan jarida su karu.

rows.source: "The president does more Q&A sessions than any president has prior to him," she said, adding without citing evidence: "We've looked at those numbers."
rows.output: "Shugaban ya gudanar da zaman tambayoyi da amsoshi fiye da kowanne shugaban da ya gabace shi," in ji ta, tana kara cewa ba tare da bayar da wata shaida ba: "Mun duba wadannan lambobin."
rows.reference: "Shugaban ya yi karin Q & A zaman lafiya fiye da kowane shugaban da yake gabansa," inji ta, ba tare da nuna shaida ba: "Mun duba wadannan lambobin."

rows.source: Briefings will still happen, Sanders said, but "if the press has the chance to ask the president of the United States questions directly, that's infinitely better than talking to me.
rows.output: Tattaunawa za ta ci gaba da faruwa, in ji Sanders, amma “idan kafafen yada labarai sun samu damar yin tambayoyi ga shugaban kasar Amurka kai tsaye, hakan ya fi kyau fiye da yin magana da ni.
rows.reference: Jawabin zai gabata har yanzu, in ji Sanders, amma "idan manema labarai na da damar tambayar shugaban Amurka tambayoyin, kai tsaye toh yafi kyau fiye da magana da ni.

rows.source: We try to do that a lot and you've seen us do that a lot over the last few weeks and that's going to take the place of a press briefing when you can talk to the president of the United States."
rows.output: Muna ƙoƙarin yin hakan da yawa kuma kun ga mun yi hakan a cikin makonni da suka gabata kuma hakan zai maye gurbin taron manema labarai lokacin da za ku iya magana da shugaban Amurka.
rows.reference: Mun yi ƙoƙarin yin haka sosai kuma kun gan mu yin hakan sosai a cikin 'yan makonnin da suka wuce kuma wannan zai faru na taƙaitaccen jawabi lokacin da za ku iya magana da shugaban Amurka."

rows.source: Trump regularly takes questions when leaving the White House or participating in open sessions or press conferences with visiting dignitaries.
rows.output: Trump yana yawan amsa tambayoyi lokacin da yake barin Fadar White House ko halartar zaman bude ko taron manema labarai tare da manyan baki.
rows.reference: Trump yakan amsa tambayoyi lokacin fita daga White House ko idan ya hallarci budaden taro ko taron manema labarai da baki masu ziyara.

rows.source: Solo press conferences are rare.
rows.output: Taron manema labarai na kashin kai ba su da yawa.
rows.reference: Boyayen jawabin manema labarai na da wuya.

rows.source: In New York this week the president perhaps demonstrated why, making a freewheeling and at times bizarre appearance before gathered reporters.
rows.output: A cikin New York a wannan makon shugaban kasa watakila ya nuna dalilin hakan, ta hanyar yin bayani cikin 'yanci kuma a wasu lokuta ya yi kama da wani abu mai ban mamaki a gaban 'yan jarida da aka tara.
rows.reference: A Birnin New York wannan satin, shugaban kasa ya nuna dalilin da ya sa, ya ke yin ganin daman sa da kuma fitowa lokuta masu ban mamaki kafin ya tattara manema labarai.

rows.source: Health secretary writes to EU workers at NHS Scotland over Brexit fears
rows.output: Sakataren lafiya ya rubuta wa ma’aikatan EU a NHS Scotland kan fargabar Brexit
rows.reference: Sakataren kiwon lafiya ya rubuta wa ma'aikatan EU a NHS Scotland game da tsoron Brexit

rows.source: The Health Secretary has written to EU staff working in Scotland's NHS to express the country's gratitude and wish for them to stay on post-Brexit.
rows.output: Ministan Lafiya ya rubuta wa ma'aikatan EU da ke aiki a NHS na Scotland don bayyana godiyar kasar da fatan su ci gaba da zama bayan Brexit.
rows.reference: Sakataren Lafiya ya rubuta wa ma'aikatan EU da ke aikin NHS na Scotland don nuna godiya ga kasar kuma su na so su zauna bayan-Brexit.

rows.source: Jeane Freeman MSP sent a letter with less than six months to go until the UK withdraws from the EU.
rows.output: Jeane Freeman MSP ta aika da wasiƙa da ƙasa da watanni shida kafin Birtaniya ta fice daga EU.
rows.reference: Jeane Freeman MSP ta aika da wasika kasa da watanni shida don tafiya har sai Birtaniya ta janye daga EU.

rows.source: The Scottish Government has already committed to meet the cost of settled status applications for EU citizens working in its devolved public services.
rows.output: Gwamnatin Scotland ta riga ta yi alkawarin biyan kuɗin aikace-aikacen matsayin da aka kafa ga 'yan ƙasar EU da ke aiki a cikin ayyukanta na gwamnatin da aka mayar da hankali.
rows.reference: Gwamnatin Scotland ta rigaya ta yi ƙoƙari don saduwa da farashin da za a bi don biyan bukatun 'yan ƙasa na EU waɗanda ke aiki a cikin ayyukan jama'a.

rows.source: In her letter, Ms Freeman wrote: "Over the summer, negotiations between the UK and EU on withdrawal have continued, heading towards expected decisions this autumn.
rows.output: A cikin wasikarta, Ms Freeman ta rubuta: "A lokacin bazara, tattaunawa tsakanin Burtaniya da EU kan ficewa sun ci gaba, tare da tafiya zuwa yanke shawara da ake sa ran a kaka.
rows.reference: A cikin wasikar ta, Ms Freeman ta rubuta: "A lokacin rani, tattaunawar tsakanin Birtaniya da EU a kan janyewa ya ci gaba, zuwa ga yanke shawarar wannan kakan.

rows.source: But the UK Government has also been stepping up its preparations for a possible no-deal scenario.
rows.output: Amma gwamnatin Burtaniya ta kuma fara shirye-shiryen yin shiri don wata yuwuwar yanayin rashin yarjejeniya.
rows.reference: Amma Gwamnatin Birtaniya ta ci gaba da shirye-shirye don yiwuwar rashin daidaitawa.

rows.source: I know this must be a very unsettling time for all of you.
rows.output: Na san wannan dole ne ya zama lokaci mai matukar tashin hankali ga kowa.
rows.reference: Na san wannan lokaci dole yako rashin natsuwa gare ku duka.

rows.source: That is why I wanted to reiterate now how much I value the contribution of every member of staff, regardless of their nationality.
rows.output: Wannan shine dalilin da ya sa na so in sake tabbatar da yadda nake daraja gudunmawar kowane ma'aikaci, ba tare da la'akari da asalinsa ba.
rows.reference: Shi ya sa nake so in sake nuna yadda kowone ma’aikaci ke da daraja a gudummawar da yake bayarwa, ko dan wane ƙasa ne.

rows.source: Colleagues from across the EU, and beyond, bring valuable experience and skills that strengthen and improve the work of the health service, and benefit the patients and communities we serve.
rows.output: Abokan aiki daga ko'ina cikin EU, da kuma wajen, suna kawo kwarewa da basira masu mahimmanci da ke karfafa da inganta aikin sabis na lafiya, kuma suna amfanar marasa lafiya da al'ummomin da muke yi wa hidima.
rows.reference: Abokan aiki daga ko'ina cikin EU, da kuma bayan haka, su na ba da kwarewa mai mahimmanci don ƙarfafawa da inganta aikin kiwon lafiya, da kuma amfani da marasa lafiya da al'ummomin da muke bautawa.

rows.source: Scotland is absolutely your home and we very much want you to stay here."
rows.output: Scotland ita ce gaskiya gidan ku kuma muna son ku zauna a nan sosai.
rows.reference: Scotland ta zama cikakken gida kuma munfi son ku zauna nan."

rows.source: Christion Abercrombie Undergoes Emergency Surgery After Suffering Head Injury
rows.output: Christion Abercrombie ya yi aikin tiyata cikin gaggawa bayan ya ji rauni a kai
rows.reference: Anyi wa Christion Abercrombie Tiyatar Gaggawa Bayan Raunin da ya Samu a Kai

rows.source: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie underwent emergency surgery after suffering a head injury in Saturday's 31-27 defeat to the Vanderbilt Commodores, the Tennessean's Mike Organ reported.
rows.output: An yi wa dan wasan tsakiya na Jami'ar Tennessee Christion Abercrombie tiyatar gaggawa bayan ya samu rauni a kai a lokacin da aka doke shi da ci 31-27 a ranar Asabar da Commodores na Jami'ar Vanderbilt, kamar yadda Tennessean's Mike Organ ya ruwaito.
rows.reference: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie aka wa tiyata gaggawa bayan raunin da ya ji a kai ranar Asabar da ta sha kashi 31-27 ga Vanderbilt Commodores, kamfanin Organic na Tennessean suka kawo rehoton.

rows.source: Tennessee State head coach Rod Reed told reporters the injury happened shortly before halftime.
rows.output: Kocin Jami’ar Tennessee Rod Reed ya gaya wa ‘yan jarida cewa raunin ya faru kusan mintuna biyar kafin karshen rabin lokaci.
rows.reference: Shugaban kocin Tennessee Rod Reed ya shaida wa manema labaru cewa raunin da ya faru ya faru ne kafin rabin lokaci.

rows.source: "He came to the sideline and just kind of collapsed there," Reed said.
rows.output: Ya zo gefen kuma kawai ya fadi a wurin, in ji Reed.
rows.reference: Ya je daidai layin gefe kuma anan ya fadi”, Reed yace.

rows.source: Trainers and medical personnel gave Abercrombie oxygen on the sideline before placing him on a stretcher and taking him back for further evaluation.
rows.output: Mai horarwa da ma'aikatan likitanci sun ba Abercrombie iskar oxygen a gefen filin wasa kafin su sanya shi a kan gado su kai shi baya don karin bincike.
rows.reference: Masu horarwa da ma'aikatan kiwon lafiya sun ba Abercrombie oxygen a kan gefen layi kafin su sanya shi a kan shimfiɗa da kuma mayar da shi don ƙarin kimantawa.

rows.source: An official from Tennessee State told Chris Harris of WSMV in Nashville, Tennessee, that Abercrombie was out of surgery at Vanderbilt Medical Center.
rows.output: Wani jami'in hukumar Tennessee State ya gaya wa Chris Harris na WSMV a Nashville, Tennessee, cewa Abercrombie ya fita daga asibitin likitanci na Vanderbilt.
rows.reference: Jami’in daga Jaha Tennessee ya fada wa Chris Harris na WSMV a Nashville,Tennessee, cewa Abercrobie ya fito daga tiyatar a Asibitin Vanderbilt.

rows.source: Harris added that there are "no details on type/extent of injury yet" and Tennessee State is trying to figure out when the injury occurred.
rows.output: Harris ya kara da cewa, "babu wani bayani kan irin/matsayin raunin da aka samu tukuna" kuma Jami'ar Tennessee na kokarin gano lokacin da raunin ya faru.
rows.reference: Harris ya kara da cewa "babu cikakkun bayanai akan irin/yawan raunin tukunan" kuma Jihar Tennessee na kokarin gano lokacin da rauni ya faru.

rows.source: Abercrombie, a redshirt sophomore, is in his first season with Tennessee State after transferring from Illinois.
rows.output: Abercrombie, wani mai shekaru biyu da ya sa rigar ja, yana cikin kakarsa ta farko a Jihar Tennessee bayan ya koma daga Illinois.
rows.reference: Abercrombie, mai jar rigar sophomore,yana cikin kakar sa na farko tare da Jaha Tennessee bayan canja wuri daga Illinois.

rows.source: He had five total tackles Saturday before exiting the game, which brought his season total to 18 tackles.
rows.output: Ya yi wasu kama biyar a ranar Asabar kafin ya fita daga wasan, wanda ya kawo jimlar kakar wasa zuwa kama 18.
rows.reference: Yana da tabi biyar a ranar Asabar kafin fita daga wasan, wanda ya kawo kakarsa har zuwa tabi 18.

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK
rows.output: Masu sayar da kayayyaki daga kasashen waje za su biya harajin tambari mafi girma idan sun sayi kadarori a Birtaniya
rows.reference: Za a caje masu siya na ƙetare mafi girma aikin hatimi idan sun sayi dukiya a Birtaniya

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK with the extra cash used to help the homeless under new Tory plans
rows.output: Masu saye daga kasashen waje za su biya harajin tambari mafi girma idan sun sayi kadarori a Birtaniya tare da kudaden da aka yi amfani da su wajen taimakawa marasa gida a karkashin sabbin shirye-shiryen Tory
rows.reference: Za a caje masu siya na ƙetare mafi girma aikin hatimi idan sun sayi dukiya a Birtaniya tare da karin tsabar kudi da ake amfani da su don taimaka wa marasa gida a karkashin sabon shirin Tory

rows.source: The move will neutralise the success of Corbyn's drive to attract young voters
rows.output: Matsalar za ta soke nasarar da Corbyn ya samu wajen jawo matasa masu kada kuri'a.
rows.reference: Wannan motsi zai kawar da nasarar Corbyn don jawo hankalin matasa masu jefa kuri'a

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on those who are not paying tax in the UK
rows.output: Harajin tambarin zai faru ne kan wadanda ba su biyan haraji a Birtaniya
rows.reference: Aikin hatimi zai yi tasiri a kan waɗanda ba su biyan haraji a Birtaniya

rows.source: The Treasury expects it raise up to £120 million a year- to help the homeless
rows.output: Hukumar Kudi tana sa ran tara har zuwa fam miliyan 120 a shekara - don taimakawa marasa gida
rows.reference: Ma’ajiyar kudin tsammanin tashin sa har zuwa miliyan £120 a kowace shekara - don taimaka wa marasa gida

rows.source: Foreign buyers are set to be charged a higher stamp duty rate when they buy property in the UK - with the extra cash used to help the homeless, Theresa May will announce today.
rows.output: Masu saye da waje za su biya kudin harajin tambari mafi girma idan sun sayi kadarori a Birtaniya - tare da kudaden da aka samu za a yi amfani da su wajen taimakawa marasa gida, Theresa May za ta sanar a yau.
rows.reference: Ana sa ran masu siyan na ƙetare za a caje su mafi girma aikin hatimi idan sun sayi dukiya a Birtaniya - tare da ƙarin tsabar kuɗin da ake amfani da su don taimaka wa marasa gida, Theresa May za ta sanar a yau.

rows.source: The move will be seen as an attempt to neutralise the success of Jeremy Corbyn's drive to attract young voters with pledges to provide more affordable housing and target high earners.
rows.output: Wannan matakin zai yi kama da yunƙurin rage nasarar da Jeremy Corbyn ya samu wajen jawo matasa masu jefa ƙuri'a tare da alkawuran samar da ƙarin gidaje masu araha da kuma mayar da hankali kan masu samun kuɗi mai yawa.
rows.reference: Za a ga wannan matakin a matsayin ƙoƙarin kore nasarar da Jeremy Corbyn ya samu domin jawo hankalin matasa masu jefa kuri'a tare da alkawurra don samar da gidaje masu araha da kuma ƙaddara da samar da tsauraran matakai.

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on individuals and firms not paying tax in the UK, with the extra money boosting the Government's drive to combat rough sleeping.
rows.output: Harajin tambarin zai shafi mutane da kamfanoni da ba sa biyan haraji a Birtaniya, tare da karin kudin da za a samu zai kara karfin gwamnati wajen yaki da barci a tituna.
rows.reference: Aikin hatimin zai tashi ga akan daidaiku da kamfani da rashin biyan haraji a Birtaniya, tare da karin kudaden tallafawa gwamnatin ta hanyar magance rashin barci.

rows.source: The surcharge - which is in addition to the present stamp duty, including the higher levels introduced two years ago on second homes and buy-to-lets - could be as much as three per cent.
rows.output: Ƙarin haraji - wanda ke ƙara ga harajin tambari na yanzu, gami da ƙarin matakan da aka gabatar shekaru biyu da suka gabata kan gidajen na biyu da na haya - zai iya kaiwa kashi uku cikin dari.
rows.reference: Ƙarin - wanda da yake kari ne ga aikin hatimi na yanzu, ciki har da matakan da aka gabatar a cikin shekaru biyu da suka gabata a kan gidaje biyu da kuma sayen bada haya - zai iya zama kusan kashi uku cikin dari.

rows.source: The Treasury expects the move to raise up to £120 million a year.
rows.output: Rijistar tana sa ran wannan matakin zai haifar da kusan fam miliyan 120 a duk shekara.
rows.reference: Ma’ajiyar kudin na tsammanin tashin sa har zuwa miliyan £120 a shekara.

rows.source: An estimated 13 per cent of new-build London properties are bought by non-UK residents, driving up prices and making it harder for first-time buyers to get a foot on the housing ladder.
