rows.output: Kimanin kashi 13 cikin 100 na sabbin gidajen da aka gina a Landan ana siyan su da wadanda ba 'yan kasar Birtaniya ba, wanda hakan ke kara tsadar gidaje da kuma saukaka wa masu sayen gida na farko su samu damar shiga harkar gidaje.
rows.reference: An kiyasta kimanin kashi 13 cikin dari na sababbin kayan haɗin gine-ginen London ana saye ne daga ‘yan kasar waje masu zama a Britaniya, farashin na hawa kuma yana sa masu sayen farko su wahala wajen samun gidajen shiga.

rows.source: Many wealthy areas of the country - particularly in the capital - have become "ghost towns" because of the high number of foreign buyers who spend most of their time out of the country.
rows.output: Yankunan da suka fi kudi a kasar - musamman a babban birnin - sun zama "garuruwan fatalwa" saboda yawan masu saye da kudi daga kasashen waje da ke ciyar da yawancin lokacinsu a wajen kasar.
rows.reference: Yawancin yankuna masu arziki a kasar - musamman ma a babban birnin kasar - sun zama "biranen fatalwa" saboda yawan adadin masu saya na kasashen waje waɗanda mafi yawan lokutan basa zaune kasar.

rows.source: The new policy comes just weeks after Boris Johnson called for a stamp duty cut to help more young people own their first home.
rows.output: Manufar da aka gabatar kwanan nan tana zuwa ne a daidai lokacin da Boris Johnson ya yi kira da a rage harajin tambari don taimakawa ƙarin matasa su mallaki gidansu na farko.
rows.reference: Sabuwar manufofi ya zo ne kawai makonni bayan Boris Johnson ya yi kira ga takaddamar hatimi don taimakawa matasan da suka mallaki gidansu.

rows.source: He accused big construction firms of keeping property prices high by snapping up land but not using it, and urged Mrs May to abandon quotas on affordable homes to fix Britain's "housing disgrace."
rows.output: Ya zargi manyan kamfanonin gine-gine da tsare-tsaren gidaje masu tsada ta hanyar sayen filaye amma ba su amfani da su ba, ya kuma bukaci Mrs May ta daina takaita gidajen masu karamin karfi domin magance "abin kunya" na Birtaniya.
rows.reference: Ya zargi manyan Kamfanonin gine-gine da ajiye kayyaki masu manyan farashin ta hanyar karbe ƙasa ba tare da yin amfani da ita ba, kuma ya bukaci Mrs May ta bar kudaden shiga kan gidajen don magance "matsalar gidaje a Britaniya.”

rows.source: Mr Corbyn has announced an eye-catching series of proposed housing reforms, including rent controls and an end to "no-fault" evictions.
rows.output: Mista Corbyn ya sanar da wani jerin gyare-gyaren gidaje masu ban sha'awa, ciki har da iya biyan hayar da kuma karshen "ba tare da laifi ba" korar.
rows.reference: Mista Corbyn ya sanar da wani tsari na gyaran gidaje da aka tsara, ciki har da tsarin haya da kuma kawo ƙarshen “rashin-lafin” fitarwa.

rows.source: He also wants to give councils greater powers to build new homes.
rows.output: Yana kuma son ba majalisu karin iko don gina sabbin gidaje.
rows.reference: Har ila yau, yana so ya ba majalisa ikon da zai iya gina gidaje.

rows.source: Mrs May said: "Last year I said I would dedicate my premiership to restoring the British dream - that life should be better for each new generation.
rows.output: Misis May ta ce: "A shekarar da ta gabata na ce zan sadaukar da shugabancina wajen dawo da mafarkin Birtaniya - cewa rayuwa ya kamata ta fi kyau ga kowace sabuwar al'umma.
rows.reference: Mrs May tace: "A bara na ce zan keɓe mulki don maido da mafarkin Birtaniya - cewa rayuwa ta fi kyau ga kowane sabon ƙarni.

rows.source: And that means fixing our broken housing market.
rows.output: Kuma hakan na nufin gyara kasuwar gidajen da suka karye.
rows.reference: Kuma wannan yana nufin gyaran gidajen kasuwannin da suka rushe.

rows.source: Britain will always be open to people who want to live, work and build a life here.
rows.output: Birtaniya za ta kasance a bude ko da yaushe ga mutanen da ke son zama, aiki da gina rayuwa a nan.
rows.reference: Birtaniya za ta kasance a bude ga mutanen da suke so su zauna, aiki da gina rayuwa a nan.

rows.source: However, it cannot be right that it is as easy for individuals who don't live in the UK, as well as foreign-based companies, to buy homes as hard-working British residents.
rows.output: Duk da haka, ba daidai ba ne cewa yana da sauƙi ga mutanen da ba sa zama a Birtaniya, da kuma kamfanonin da ke ƙasashen waje, su sayi gidaje kamar yadda masu aiki tuƙuru na Birtaniya ke yi.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, ba daidai ba ne cewa yana da sauƙi ga mutanen da ba su zaune a Birtaniya, da kuma kamfanoni na kasashen waje, don sayen gidaje a matsayin mazaunan Birtaniya masu wahala.

rows.source: For too many people the dream of home ownership has become all too distant, and the indignity of rough sleeping remains all too real."
rows.output: Ga mutane da yawa, mafarkin mallakar gida ya yi nisa da yawa, kuma rashin kunya na kwana a titi ya kasance mai ma'ana sosai.
rows.reference: Ga mutane da yawa mafarkin mallakar gida ya zama da nisa sosai, kuma rashin tausayi na mummunar barci yana kara tabbatuwa da gaske. "

rows.source: Jack Ross: 'My ultimate ambition is to manage Scotland'
rows.output: Jack Ross: 'Burina na ƙarshe shine in kula da Scotland'
rows.reference: Jack Ross: 'Babban burin na shi ne in gudanar da Scotland'

rows.source: Sunderland boss Jack Ross says his "ultimate ambition" is to become the Scotland manager at some stage.
rows.output: Kociyan Sunderland Jack Ross ya ce burinsa na karshe shi ne ya zama kociyan kungiyar Scotland a wani lokaci.
rows.reference: Shugaban Sunderland Jack Ross ya ce "burinsa" shi ne ya zama kocin Scotland a wani mataki.

rows.source: The Scot, 42, is relishing the challenge of reviving the North-East club, who currently sit third place in League One, three points off the top.
rows.output: Dan Scot mai shekaru 42, yana jin dadin kalubalen sake farfado da kulob din Arewa maso Gabas, wanda a halin yanzu yake matsayi na uku a gasar League One, a kan maki uku daga saman.
rows.reference: Scot, mai shekaru 42, yana farin cikin kalubalantar dawoda kungiyar wasan na North-East, wanda a halin yanzu ke zama na uku a League na daya, maki uku daga saman.

rows.source: He moved to the Stadium of Light this summer after guiding St Mirren back to the Scottish Premiership last season.
rows.output: Ya koma filin wasa na Light a wannan bazara bayan ya jagoranci St Mirren zuwa gasar Scottish Premiership a kakar da ta gabata.
rows.reference: Ya koma Stadium mai Haske a wannan kakar rani bayan ya jagoranci St Mirren komawa fremiya kakar wasan Scotland.

rows.source: "I wanted to play for my country as a player.
rows.output: Na so in yi wasa da kasar na a matsayin dan wasa.
rows.reference: "Ina so in buga wa kasarta wasa.

rows.source: I got a B cap and that was it," Ross told BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
rows.output: Na samu B cap kuma haka ya kasance," Ross ya gaya wa BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
rows.reference: Na samu hular B kuma wannan shi ne, "in ji Ross ya shaidawa BBC Scotland’s Muryarwasanni."

rows.source: "But I grew up watching Scotland at Hampden a lot with my dad as a kid, and it is always something that has drawn me back.
rows.output: Amma na girma ina kallon Scotland a Hampden da yawa tare da mahaifina a matsayin yaro, kuma koyaushe wani abu ne da ya ja hankalina ya dawo.
rows.reference: "Amma na girma da kallon Scotland a Hampden da yawa tare da mahaifina a matsayin yaro, kuma yana da wani abu ke jawoni.

rows.source: That opportunity would only come, though, if I am successful in club management."
rows.output: Wannan damar za ta zo ne kawai, duk da haka, idan na yi nasara a cikin gudanarwar kulob.
rows.reference: Wannan damar za ta zo, duk da haka, idan na ci nasara a gudanar da kungiyar."

rows.source: Ross's predecessors as Sunderland manager include Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet and Paulo Di Canio.
rows.output: Manajojin Sunderland kafin Ross su ne Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet da Paulo Di Canio.
rows.reference: Wadanda suka gabaci Ross a matsayin masu gudarwa Sunderland sun hada da Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet da Paolo Di Canio.

rows.source: The former Alloa Athletic boss says he felt no trepidation in following such established names at such a big club, having previously rejected overtures from Barnsley and Ipswich Town.
rows.output: Tsohon kocin Alloa Athletic ya ce bai ji tsoro ba ya bi da irin wadannan sunaye a wata babbar kungiya, bayan da ya ki amincewa da tayin daga Barnsley da Ipswich Town.
rows.reference: Tsohon shugaban Alloa Athletic ya ce ba ya tsoron abin da wadannan sunayen suka kafa a irin wannan babban kungiyar, bayan da yaki tayin Barnsley da Ipswich Town.

rows.source: "Success for me at the moment will be gauged by 'can I return this club to the Premier League?'
rows.output: "Yunwa a gare ni a halin yanzu ita ce 'za a iya mayar da wannan kulob din zuwa gasar Premier?'
rows.reference: "Nasara a gare ni a wannan lokacin shi ne 'zan iya mayar da kungiyar zuwa Wasanin Fremiya?'

rows.source: Because of the structure and facilities at this club, it undoubtedly belongs in the Premier League," he said.
rows.output: Saboda tsarin da kayan aikin wannan kulob din, ba shakka yana cikin gasar Premier," ya ce.
rows.reference: Saboda tsari da kayayyaki a wannan kungiya, ba abun mamaki ba ne mu na Wassanin Fremiya, "in ji shi.

rows.source: "It is not an easy task to get it there, but I would probably only view myself as being successful here if I can get the club back there."
rows.output: "Ba aikin da ba ya da sauƙi ba ne a samu a can, amma ina tsammanin zan yi la'akari da kaina a matsayin wanda ya yi nasara a nan idan zan iya kai kulob din a can."
rows.reference: "Ba abu mai sauki ba ne don samun shi a can, amma zan iya ganin kai na kamar yadda na ci nasara a nan idan na iya samun kungiyar a can."

rows.source: Ross is only three years into his management career, after a period as assistant boss at Dumbarton and a 15-month spell on Hearts' coaching staff.
rows.output: Ross yana da shekaru uku kacal a cikin aikinsa na gudanarwa, bayan wani lokaci a matsayin mataimakin koci a Dumbarton da kuma wani lokaci na watanni 15 a cikin ma'aikatan koci na Hearts.
rows.reference: Shekaru Ross uku ne kawai a aikin gudanarwa, bayan wani lokaci a matsayin mataimakin mai gudanarwa a Dumbarton da kuma watanni 15 a Hearts 'koyon gudanar da wasanni.

rows.source: He then helped Alloa recover from relegation to the third tier, and transformed St Mirren from the brink of relegation to Championship title winners the following season.
rows.output: Sannan ya taimaka wa Alloa ta murmure daga faduwa zuwa mataki na uku, ya kuma canza St Mirren daga gefen faduwa zuwa zakarun gasar Championship a kakar wasa ta gaba.
rows.reference: Ya kuma taimakawa Alloa ta sake farfadowa zuwa rukuni na uku, kuma ya sake canza St Mirren daga rawar ta taka a gasar zakarun Turai a kakar wasa ta gaba.

rows.source: And Ross says he feels more comfortable now than he ever did during his playing career at Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren and Hamilton Academical.
rows.output: Kuma Ross ya ce yanzu yana jin daɗi fiye da yadda ya taɓa ji a duk lokacin aikinsa na wasa a Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren da Hamilton Academical.
rows.reference: Kuma Ross ya ce yana jin dadi fiye da yadda ya taba yi a lokacin da yake wasa a Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren da Hamilton Academical.

rows.source: "It was probably a real crossroads," he recalled, of taking charge of Alloa.
rows.output: "Ya kasance wata kofar shiga tsakani," ya tuna, game da karbar ragamar Alloa.
rows.reference: "Ya zama mai yiyuwa da rudarwa," ya tuna, ya karbi ragamar Alloa.

rows.source: "I genuinely did believe management was the right fit for me, more so than playing.
rows.output: Na gaskanta da gaske cewa gudanarwa shine madaidaicin dacewa da ni, fiye da buga kwallo.
rows.reference: "Na yi imani da gaske cewa gudanarwa ya fi dacewa da ni, fiye da wasa.

rows.source: It sounds bizarre because I did okay, made a reasonable living out of it, and enjoyed some reasonable highs.
rows.output: Yana da ban mamaki domin na yi kyau, na sami rayuwa mai kyau daga ciki, kuma na ji wasu manyan abubuwa masu kyau.
rows.reference: Yana da ban mamaki saboda na yi kokari, na yi rayuwa mai kyau daga ciki, kuma na ji dadin wasu daukaka.

rows.source: But playing can be tough.
rows.output: Amma yin wasa na iya zama da wahala.
rows.reference: Amma wasa zai iya zama da wuya.

rows.source: There are a lot of things you have to get through on a weekly basis.
rows.output: Akwai abubuwa da yawa da kuke buƙatar wucewa a kowane mako.
rows.reference: Akwai abubuwa masu yawa da za ka fuskanta a kowane mako-mako.

rows.source: I still go through that in terms of the stresses and pressure of the job but management just feels right.
rows.output: Har yanzu ina wucewa ta haka game da damuwa da matsin lamba na aikin amma gudanarwa kawai yana jin daɗi.
rows.reference: Har yanzu ina ci gaba da wannan batun dangane da matsalolin da matsa lamba na aikin amma gudanarwa na ji daidai.

rows.source: I always wanted to manage and now I am doing it, it feels the most comfortable I have been in my own skin throughout my entire adult life."
rows.output: Ina so in yi aiki da kuma yanzu ina yi, yana jin mafi dadi da na kasance a jikina na kaina a duk tsawon rayuwata na babba."
rows.reference: A koyaushe ina so in gudanar kuma yanzu ina yin hakan, ina jin dadi sosai da ina cikin kumbin a tsawon rayuwana."

rows.source: You can listen to the full interview on Sportsound on Sunday, 30 September, on Radio Scotland between 12:00 and 13:00 BST
rows.output: Za ku iya sauraron cikakken hirar a kan Sportsound a ranar Lahadi, 30 ga Satumba, a gidan rediyon Scotland tsakanin 12:00 zuwa 13:00 na safe.
rows.reference: Kuna iya sauraron cikakken tambayoyi game da Wasanni a Lahadi, 30 Satumba, a kan Radio Scotland tsakanin 12:00 da 13:00 BST

rows.source: Perfect time for a pint is 5.30pm on a Saturday, survey finds
rows.output: Lokaci mai kyau don gilashin giya shine karfe 5.30 na yamma a ranar Asabar, wani bincike ya gano
rows.reference: Lokaci cikakken pint shi ne 5.30pm a ranar Asabar, binciken ya nuna

rows.source: The summer heatwave has boosted takings for Britain's struggling pubs but heaped more pressure on restaurant chains.
rows.output: Zafin rani ya kara kudaden shiga ga gidajen giya na Burtaniya da ke fama da matsala, amma ya kara matsin lamba ga sarkar abinci.
rows.reference: Gudun zafi ya bunkasa shiga wajen shakatawa Birtaniya da ke fafatawa amma ya kara matsa lamba a kan gidajen cin abinci.

rows.source: Pub and bar groups saw sales rise 2.7 per cent in July - but takings in restaurants were down 4.8 per cent, figures revealed.
rows.output: Kungiyoyin mashaya da gidajen shan barasa sun ga cewa tallace-tallace ya karu da kashi 2.7 a watan Yuli - amma an bayyana cewa tallace-tallacen gidajen cin abinci ya ragu da kashi 4.8 cikin dari.
rows.reference: Wajajen shakatawa da mashaya sun samu tashin ciniki da kashi 2.7 bisa dari, a yuli amma wajajen cin abinci sun sauka da kashi 4.8 cikin dari, adadi sun nuna.

rows.source: Peter Martin, of business consultancy CGA, which compiled the figures, said: "Continued sunshine and England's longer than expected participation in the World Cup meant July followed a similar pattern to the previous month of June, when pubs were up 2.8 per cent, except that restaurants were hit even harder.
rows.output: Pita Martin, daga kamfanin ba da shawara kan harkokin kasuwanci CGA, wanda ya tattara kididdigar, ya ce: "Karin rana da kuma shiga Ingila cikin gasar cin kofin duniya fiye da yadda ake tsammani, ya sa watan Yuli ya bi irin tsarin watan Yuni da ya gabata, lokacin da gidajen giya suka karu da kashi 2.8 cikin dari, sai dai cewa gidajen cin abinci sun fuskanci matsala fiye da haka."
rows.reference: Peter Martin, mai kula da harkokin kasuwancin CGA, wanda ya hada da adadi, ya ce: "Ya ci gaba da haskakawa da Ingila fiye da yadda aka sa ran shiga cikin gasar cin kofin duniya a watan Yuli, wanda ya biyo bayan irin wannan yanayin zuwa watan Yuni na baya, a lokacin da aka samu kashi 2.8 cikin dari, sai dai yawancin gidajen cin abinci sun fi taɓuwa.

rows.source: The fall of 1.8 per cent in restaurant trading in June just got worse in July.
rows.output: Rashin nasarar da aka samu na 1.8 cikin dari a harkar gidajen abinci a watan Yuni ya kara tabarbarewa a watan Yuli.
rows.reference: Faduwar kashi 1.8 cikin dari a cinikin sayar da abinci a watan Yuni kawai ya munana a watan Yuli.

rows.source: Drink-led pubs and bars performed by far the strongest with like-for-likes up more than restaurants were down.
rows.output: Gidan shaye-shaye da gidajen giya sun yi mafi kyau, tare da kamfanoni masu kama da juna sun tashi sama da gidajen cin abinci da suka ragu.
rows.reference: Rumfunan saida abin sha da mashaya sun kara karfi tare da ire-iren sa fiye da gidajen cin abinci da suka kasance kasa.

rows.source: Food-led pubs also suffered in the sun, although not as dramatically as the restaurant operators.
rows.output: Gidan abinci masu jagora sun kuma yi fama da zafi, kodayake ba kamar masu gudanar da gidajen abinci ba.
rows.reference: Rumfunan sayar da abinci suma sun sha wahala a rana, amma bai kai ga irin na ma’ikatan gidajen cin abinci ba.

rows.source: It seems people just wanted to go out for a drink.
rows.output: Ya bayyana cewa mutane suna son fita don sha.
rows.reference: Da alama mutane su na so su fita ne don samun abun sha.

rows.source: Across managed pubs and bars drink sales were up 6.6 per cent for the month, with food down three per cent."
rows.output: A cikin gidajen cin abinci da mashaya da aka sarrafa, sayar da abin sha ya karu da kashi 6.6 cikin dari na watan, yayin da abinci ya ragu da kashi uku cikin dari."
rows.reference: A duk wuraren da ake gudanar da shan giya da mashayar ababen sha sayarwa ya kai har 6.6 cikin dari na watan, da abinci kasa da kashi uku. "

rows.source: Paul Newman, of leisure and hospitality analysts RSM said: "These results continue the trend we've seen since the end of April.
rows.output: Paul Newman, na masu nazari na hutu da masauki RSM ya ce: "Wadannan sakamakon suna ci gaba da yanayin da muka gani tun karshen watan Afrilu.

rows.source: The long hot summer could not have come at a worse time for food-led operators and time will tell whether the more moderate temperatures we've experienced in August will provide some much-needed respite."

rows.source: Total sales growth across pub and restaurants, including new openings, was 2.7 per cent in July, reflecting the slow down in brand roll-outs.

rows.source: The Coffer Peach Tracker industry sales monitor for the UK pub, bar and restaurant sector collects and analyses performance data from 47 operating groups, with a combined turnover of over £9 billion, and is the established industry benchmark.
rows.output: Mai Bibiyar Coffer Peach Tracker masana'antar sayar da kayayyaki don sashin gidan cin abinci na Birtaniya, mashaya da gidan abinci yana tattara da nazarin bayanan aiki daga 47 rukunin aiki, tare da jimillar juzu'i sama da £9 biliyan, kuma shine ma'auni na masana'antu da aka kafa.
rows.reference: Kamfanin Kasuwancin Coffer Peach Tracker na sa idanu ga kamfanonin Birtaniya, yankin mashaya da gidajen cin abinci da ke tattarawa da kuma nazarin tattalin bayanan da aka samu daga kungiyoyi masu aiki 47, da karuwar fiye da dala biliyan 9,kuma shi ne tushen alamar masana'antar.

rows.output: Binciken da Digital Awareness UK da kungiyar Headmasters da Headmistresses (HMC) ta gudanar, ya gano cewa kashi 40 cikin 100 na yara masu shekaru 11 zuwa 18 suna da asusu biyu, inda rabin wadanda suka amince suna da asusun sirri.

rows.source: HMC chief Mike Buchanan said: "It's disturbing so many teenagers are tempted into creating online spaces where parents and teachers cannot find them."

rows.source: Eilidh Doyle has been elected to the board of Scottish Athletics as a non-executive director at the governing body's annual general meeting.
rows.output: An zabi Eilidh Doyle a majalisar gudanarwar Scottish Athletics a matsayin darakta mara aiki a taron shekara-shekara na hukumar gudanarwa.
rows.reference: An zabi Eilidh Doyle zuwa kwamitin hukumar wasanni ta Scottish a matsayin karamin darekta a babban taron kungiyar gudanarwa na shekara-shekara.

rows.source: Doyle is Scotland's most decorated track and field athlete and chairman Ian Beattie described the move as a great opportunity for those guiding the sport to benefit from her wide-ranging experience at international level over the past decade.
rows.output: Doyle ita ce mafi yawan 'yan wasa a Scotland a cikin hanyar tseren da filin wasa, kuma shugaban Ian Beattie ya bayyana matakin a matsayin babbar dama ga wadanda ke jagorantar wasan su amfana daga gogewarta mai fa'ida a matakin kasa da kasa sama da shekaru goma da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Doyle ne mafi kyawun dan wasan gudu da sauran wasannin fili na Scotland kuma shugaba Ian Beattie ya bayyana cewa wannan matsayi ne mai matukar dama ga waɗanda ke jagorantar wasanni don samun damar amfani da ita a cikin matakin kasa da kasa a cikin shekaru goma da suka wuce.

rows.source: "Eilidh has massive respect across the Scottish, UK and world athletics community and we are sure athletics in Scotland would benefit hugely by bringing her on to the board," Beattie said.
rows.output: "Eilidh tana da girmamawa sosai a cikin al'ummar wasannin motsa jiki na Scotland, Burtaniya da duniya, kuma mun yi imanin cewa wasannin motsa jiki a Scotland za su amfana sosai ta hanyar kawo ta cikin kwamitin."
rows.reference: "Eilidh yana da girmamawa sosai a tsakanin al'ummar Scotland, Birtaniya da kuma kungiyar 'yan wasa na duniya, kuma mun tabbata yan wasa a Scotland za su amfana sosai ta hanyar kawo ta ga kwamitin," Beattie ya ce.

rows.source: Doyle said: "I am keen to act as a voice for athletes and I am hoping I can really contribute and help guide the sport in Scotland."
rows.output: Doyle ta ce: "Ina matukar sha'awar zama murya ga 'yan wasa kuma ina fatan zan iya ba da gudummawa sosai kuma in taimaka wajen jagorantar wasan a Scotland."
rows.reference: Doyle ya ce: "Ina sha’awar inyi aikin muryar ga 'yan wasa kuma ina fatan zan iya bada gudunmawata da taimakawa wajen jagorancin wasanni a Scotland."

rows.source: The American, who won the 200 metres and 400 metres at the 1996 Games in Atlanta among his total of four Olympic golds and is now a regular BBC pundit, was left unable to walk after suffering a transient ischemic attack.
rows.output: Mai shekaru 58 a duniya, wanda ya lashe tseren mita 200 da 400 a gasar Olympics ta 1996 a Atlanta a tsakanin lambobin zinare na Olympics guda hudu, kuma yanzu dan wasan BBC ne na yau da kullun, ya kasa tafiya bayan ya kamu da bugun zuciya na wucin gadi.

rows.output: Ta hanyar jawo kwatancen bayyana nono da shanu, muna son mu sanya shan nono da duk kalubalen da ke tattare da shi a cikin haske, yayin da muke nuna ta hanyar nishadi da kuma abin da ya shafi yadda wannan babban jin dadi da sabon famfo zai kawo.

rows.reference: wannan ba shi ne karin farko da famfo Elvie ke fitowa a kannun labarai ba.

rows.source: During London Fashion Week, a mother of two appeared on the catwalk for designer Marta Jakubowski while using the product.
rows.output: A lokacin London Fashion Week, mace mai yara biyu ta bayyana a kan titin jirgin sama don mai zanen Marta Jakubowski yayin da take amfani da samfurin.
rows.reference: A lokacin London Fashion Week, wata mahaifiyar yara biyu ta bayyana tana tafiyar gayu ga zanen Marta Jakubowski yayin amfani da samfurin.

rows.source: Hundreds of Migrant Children Quietly Moved to a Tent Camp on the Texas Border
rows.output: Dubban Yara Migrants An ɗauke su zuwa Wurin Hutawa na Tenti a Kan iyakar Texas
rows.reference: Daruruwan yara 'Yan gudun hijira sun tafi a hankali zuwa sansanin alfarma a kan iyakar Texas

rows.source: The number of detained migrant children has spiked even though monthly border crossings have remained relatively unchanged, in part because harsh rhetoric and policies introduced by the Trump administration have made it harder to place children with sponsors.
rows.output: Yawan yaran ƙaura da aka tsare ya ƙaru duk da cewa yawan shigo da ƙasashen waje a kowane wata ba su canja sosai ba, a wani ɓangare saboda tsauraran maganganu da manufofin da gwamnatin Trump ta gabatar sun sa ya yi wuya a sanya yara tare da masu daukar nauyinsu.
rows.reference: Yawan adadin yara 'yan gudun hijirar da ake tsare da su sun karu ko da yake haɗin kan iyakoki a kowane wata ya kasance ba tare da canzawa ba, a wani bangare saboda rashin amincewa da manufofi da gwamnatin Trump ya gabatar da shi ya sa ya fi ƙarfin sanya yara tare da masu tallafawa.

rows.source: Traditionally, most sponsors have been undocumented immigrants themselves, and have feared jeopardizing their own ability to remain in the country by stepping forward to claim a child.
rows.output: A tarihi, yawancin masu tallafawa sun kasance 'yan gudun hijira ba tare da takardar shaidar zama dan kasa ba, kuma sun ji tsoron lalata damar su na ci gaba da zama a kasar ta hanyar fitowa fili don daukar wani yaro.
rows.reference: A al'adance, yawancin masu tallafawa sun kasance baƙi ne ba tare da izini ba, kuma su na jin tsoro samun daman ikon kansu na kasancewa a cikin ƙasa ta hanyar ci gaba da bukata yara.

rows.source: The risk increased in June, when federal authorities announced that potential sponsors and other adult members of their households would have to submit fingerprints, and that the data would be shared with immigration authorities.
rows.output: Haɗarin ya ƙaru a watan Yuni, lokacin da hukumomin tarayya suka sanar da cewa masu yuwuwar tallafawa da sauran manya a cikin gidajensu za su buƙaci bayar da yatsa, kuma bayanan za a raba su tare da hukumomin shige da fice.
rows.reference: Haɗarin ya haɓaka a watan Yuni, lokacin da hukumomin tarayya suka bayyana cewa masu tallafawa da sauran 'yan ƙananan mazaunan su a gida zasu bada zanen hannun su, kuma za a raba bayanai tare da hukumomin shige da fice.

rows.source: Last week, Matthew Albence, a senior official with Immigration and Customs Enforcement, testified before Congress that the agency had arrested dozens of people who applied to sponsor unaccompanied minors.
rows.output: A makon da ya gabata, Matthew Albence, babban jami'in tsaro da kula da shige da fice, ya shaida wa majalisar dokoki cewa hukumar ta kama wasu mutane da dama da suka nemi daukar nauyin yara marasa gida.
rows.reference: A makon da ya gabata, Matthew Albence, babban jami'in ma'aikatar kula da Shige da fice da kwastam, ya shaida wa majalisar cewa, hukumar ta kama mutane da dama da suka nemi tallafa wa kananan yara.

rows.source: The agency later confirmed that 70 percent of those arrested did not have prior criminal records.
rows.output: Hukumar ta tabbatar da cewa kashi 70 cikin 100 na wadanda aka kama ba su da tarihin aikata laifuka a baya.
rows.reference: Daga bisani hukumar ta tabbatar da cewar kashi 70 cikin dari na waɗanda aka kama ba su da takardun laifi.

rows.source: "Close to 80 percent of the individuals that are either sponsors or household members of sponsors are here in the country illegally, and a large chunk of those are criminal aliens.
rows.output: "Kusa da kashi 80 cikin 100 na mutanen da ko dai masu daukar nauyin ko kuma mambobin gidan masu daukar nauyi suna nan a kasar ba bisa ka'ida ba, kuma yawancin wadanda su ne 'yan kasashen waje masu aikata laifuka.
rows.reference: "Kusan kashi 80 cikin dari na mutanen da suke da goyon baya ko masu goyon baya na gida su na nan a cikin kasar ba tare da izini ba, kuma babban ɓangare na waɗanda su ne masu laifi.

rows.source: So we are continuing to pursue those individuals," Mr. Albence said.
rows.output: Don haka muna ci gaba da farautar wadannan mutane," in ji Mista Albence.
rows.reference: Don haka mu na ci gaba da bin wadannan mutane, "in ji Mr. Albence.

rows.source: Seeking to process the children more quickly, officials introduced new rules that will require some of them to appear in court within a month of being detained, rather than after 60 days, which was the previous standard, according to shelter workers.
rows.output: Yin gaggawar aiwatar da yaran, jami'ai sun gabatar da sabbin ka'idoji da za su bukaci wasu daga cikinsu su bayyana a kotu cikin wata guda da aka kama su, maimakon bayan kwanaki 60, wanda shi ne tsarin da ya gabata, a cewar ma'aikatan sansani.
rows.reference: Nema don aiwatar da yara da sauri, jami'ai sun gabatar da sababbin ka'idodin da zasu bukaci wasu daga cikinsu su bayyana a kotu a cikin wata daya da aka tsare, maimakon bayan kwanaki 60, wanda shi ne daidaitattun baya, bisa ga ma'aikatan tsari.

rows.source: Many will appear via video conference call, rather than in person, to plead their case for legal status to an immigration judge.
rows.output: Da yawa za su bayyana ta hanyar taron bidiyo, maimakon a zahiri, domin su roki hukuncin shari'a ga alkalin shige da fice.
rows.reference: Mutane da yawa za su fito ta hanyar kiran taro na bidiyo, maimakon mutum, don yin jigilar su game da shari'a, a matsayin mai hukunci.

rows.source: Those who are deemed ineligible for relief will be swiftly deported.
rows.output: Wadanda aka ga ba su cancanta ba don samun tallafi za a kwashe su cikin gaggawa.
rows.reference: Waɗanda ake zaton ba su cancanci taimako ba za mu mayar da su.

rows.source: The longer that children remain in custody, the more likely they are to become anxious or depressed, which can lead to violent outbursts or escape attempts, according to shelter workers and reports that have emerged from the system in recent months.
rows.output: Yara suna ci gaba da zama a tsare, hakan yana nufin za su iya samun damuwa ko bakin ciki, wanda zai iya haifar da tashin hankali ko yunkurin tserewa, a cewar ma'aikatan cibiyar da rahotanni da suka fito daga tsarin a cikin watannin da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Yawancin yaran su na kasancewa a gidan tsaro, mafi yawan su so samu damuwa ko girgiza, wanda zai iya haifar da tashin hankali ko kuma yunkurin tserewa, bisa ga ma'aikatan tsari da rahotanni da suka fito daga cikin tsarin kwanan nan.

rows.source: Advocates said those concerns are heightened at a larger facility like Tornillo, where signs that a child is struggling are more likely to be overlooked, because of its size.
rows.output: Masu goyon bayan sun ce damuwar ta karu a wani babban wurin kamar Tornillo, inda alamun cewa yaro yana fama da matsala ba a lura da su ba, saboda girman wurin.
rows.reference: Masu bada shawara sun ce wadanada ya shafa su na damuwa sosai a manya gidajen kamar na Tornillo, wurin da alamun cewa yaro na gwagwarmaya na da saukin a kyale shi, saboda girman shi.

rows.source: They added that moving children to the tent city without providing enough time to prepare them emotionally or to say goodbye to friends could compound trauma that many are already struggling with.
rows.output: Sun kara da cewa, mayar da yara zuwa birnin sansani ba tare da samar da isasshen lokaci don shirya tunaninsu ko kuma su yi bankwana da abokansu ba, zai iya kara musu damuwa da da yawa daga cikinsu ke fama da shi.
rows.reference: Sun kara cewa mayar da yara birnin alfarwa ba tare da isashen lokaci a shirya hankalin su ko yi ya wabokanansu sallama ba zai iya kara masu takaici wanda da yawan su ke fama da shi.

rows.source: Syria tells US, French and Turkish 'occupying forces' to withdraw immediately
rows.output: Suriya ta gaya wa Amurka, Faransa, da Turkiyya su fita daga kasar nan nan da nan
rows.reference: Sham ta fada wa ‘sojojin mamaya’ na Amurka, Faransa da Turkiya zasu janye ba tare da jinkiri ba

rows.source: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Foreign Minister Walid al-Moualem also called on Syrian refugees to come home, even though the country's war is now in its eighth year.
rows.output: A taron Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Ministan Harkokin Waje Walid al-Moualem ya yi kira ga ‘yan gudun hijirar Siriya da su koma gida, duk da cewa yakin kasar ya kai shekara ta takwas.
rows.reference: A jawabi ma Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Ministan Harkokin Waje al-Moualem yayi kira ga masu gudun hijira na da su dawo gida, duk da yakin kasar yanzu yana cikin shekara na takwas.

rows.source: Moualem, who also serves as deputy prime minister, said the foreign forces were on Syrian soil illegally, under the pretext of fighting terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."
rows.output: Moualem, wanda kuma ya zama mataimakin firaminista, ya ce dakarun kasashen waje suna cikin kasar Siriya ba bisa ka'ida ba, a karkashin tsarin yaki da ta'addanci, kuma "za a yi musu hukunci."
rows.reference: Moualem, wanda yake kuma matsayin mataimakin firayam minista, yace sojojin kasar wajen su na Sham ne ba tare da izini ba, a karkashin babatun yaki da ta’addanci, kuma “za’a magance su yadda ya kamata.”

rows.source: "They must withdraw immediately and without any conditions," he told the assembly.
rows.output: "Suna bukatar su fice nan take ba tare da wani sharadi ba," ya gaya wa taron.
rows.reference: “Dole su janye ba tare da jinkiri ba kuma ba tare da wani sharaɗi ba,” ya fada wa taron.

rows.source: Moualem insisted that the "war on terror is almost over" in Syria, where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011, with millions more uprooted from their homes.
rows.output: Moualem ya tabbatar da cewa, "yakin ta'addanci ya kusa ƙarewa" a Siriya, inda sama da mutane 360,000 suka mutu tun daga shekara ta 2011, tare da miliyoyin da suka rasa matsugunansu.
rows.reference: Moualem ya dage cewa “yaki da ta’addanci ya kusan karewa” a Sham, wurin da fiye da mutane 360,000 suka rasa rayuwar su tun 2011, tare da rashin gidajen miliyoyin mutane.

rows.source: He said Damascus would continue "fighting this sacred battle until we purge all Syrian territories" of both terror groups and "any illegal foreign presence."
rows.output: Ya ce Damascus za ta ci gaba da "yaki da wannan yaki mai tsarki har sai mun kore dukkan yankunan Siriya" daga kungiyoyin ta'addanci biyu da "duk wani kasashen waje marasa izini."
rows.reference: ya ce Damascus zata ci gaba da “yakin nan mai sarki har sai an tsarkake dukka yankunan Sham” na duk kungiyoyin ta’addanci da “duk wani jami’i da ke nan ba tare da izini ba.”

rows.source: The United States has some 2,000 troops in Syria, mainly training and advising both Kurdish forces and Syrian Arabs opposed to President Bashar al-Assad.
rows.output: Amurka tana da sojoji kusan 2,000 a Siriya, musamman horarwa da ba da shawara ga duka sojojin Kurdawa da 'yan Siriya da ke adawa da shugaba Bashar al-Assad.
rows.reference: Amurka tana da wasu sojoji 2,000 a Sham, akasarinsu su na ba da horo da shawara wa sojojin Kurdawa da Larabawan Sham da basa son Shugaban kasar Bashar al-Assad.

rows.source: France has more than 1,000 troops on the ground in the war-wracked country.
rows.output: Faransa tana da sojoji sama da 1,000 a kasar da ke fama da yaki.
rows.reference: Faransa tana da fiye da sojoji 1,000 a kasar da ke fama da yakin.

rows.source: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said the conditions were fine for them to return, and he blamed "some western countries" for "spreading irrational fears" that prompted refugees to stay away.
rows.output: A kan batun ‘yan gudun hijira, Moualem ya ce yanayin ya dace da su dawo, kuma ya zargi “wasu kasashen yammacin duniya” da “yada tsoro mara hankali” da ya sa ‘yan gudun hijira suka nisa.
rows.reference: Akan batun yan gudun hijira, Moualem ya ce yanayin sun gyaru masu su dawo, kuma ya zargi “wasu ƙasashen yammaci” da “yada tsoro mara kyau” da yasa masu gudun hijira suka ƙi dawowa.

rows.source: "We have called upon the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate these returns," he said.
rows.output: "Mun kira al'ummar duniya da kungiyoyin jin kai da su saukaka wadannan dawowar," ya ce.
rows.reference: “Mun yi kira ga kasashen duniya da kungiyoyin agaji su sauƙaƙe da dawowar su,” ya ce.

rows.source: "They are politicizing what should be a purely humanitarian issue."
rows.output: "Suna siyasantar da wani abu da ya kamata kawai ya zama batun jin kai."
rows.reference: “Su na siyasance abun da zallan batun jin kai ne.”

rows.source: The United States and the European Union have warned that there will be no reconstruction aid for Syria until there is a political agreement between Assad and the opposition to end the war.
rows.output: Amurka da Tarayyar Turai sun yi gargadin cewa ba za a samu wani taimakon sake gina kasar ba a Syria har sai an cimma yarjejeniyar siyasa tsakanin Assad da adawa don kawo karshen yakin.
rows.reference: Amurka da Kungiyar Turai sun ba da gargadi cewa ba za’a bayar da agajin sake gine-ginen Sham ba har sai an samu yarjejeniya tsakanin Assad da ‘yan adawa ga yakin.

rows.source: UN diplomats say a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the last major rebel stronghold of Idlib has created an opportunity to press ahead with political talks.
rows.output: Diplomats na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya sun ce yarjejeniyar da aka yi kwanan nan tsakanin Rasha da Turkiyya na kafa wani yanki mai kariya a karshe na karshe na yankin Idlib ya bude wata dama ta ci gaba da tattaunawar siyasa.
rows.reference: ma’aikatan hulɗa na Majalisar Dinkin Duniya sun ce wani yarjejeniya na kwanan nan tsakanin Rasha da Turkiya dan kebe tudun mun tsira a babban yankin karshe da ‘yan adawa suke rike da shi a Idlib ya samar da daman ci gaba da maganganun siyasa.

rows.source: The Russian-Turkish deal averted a large-scale assault by Russian-backed Syrian forces on the province, where three million people live.
rows.output: Yarjejeniyar Rasha-Turkiyya ta hana wani babban hari da sojojin Siriya da Rasha ke goyon baya suka yi kan lardin da mutane miliyan uku ke zaune.
rows.reference: Yarjejeniyar Rasha da Turkiyar ya kawar da babban hari da ‘yan Sham masu goyon bayan Rasha suka kai lardin, wurin da mutane miliyan uku suke zama.

rows.source: Moualem however stressed that the agreement had "clear deadlines" and expressed hope that military action will target jihadists including fighters from the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, who "will be eradicated."
rows.output: Moualem ya jaddada cewa yarjejeniyar tana da “takamaiman lokutan kammala aiki” kuma ya bayyana fatan cewa ayyukan soji za su yi niyya ga ‘yan ta’adda ciki har da ‘yan ta’addan da ke da alaka da Al-Qaeda, Nusra Front, wadanda za a kawar da su.
rows.reference: Moualem duk da haka ya jadadda cewa yarjejeniyar ta na da “bayyanannen kwanaki” kuma sun bayyana sa rai cewa aikin sojoji zai mayar da hankali ga ‘yan ta’adda ne tare da mafaɗa daga Nusra Front masu alaka da Al-Qaeda, waɗanda “za’a magance.”

rows.source: UN envoy Staffan de Mistura is hoping to soon convene the first meetings of a new committee comprised of government and opposition members to draft a post-war constitution for Syria and pave the way to elections.
rows.output: Babban jami'in Majalisar Dinkin Duniya Staffan de Mistura na fatan gudanar da tarurrukan farko na wani sabon kwamiti da ya kunshi mambobi daga gwamnati da adawa domin tsara kundin tsarin mulkin bayan yakin basasa na Siriya da kuma bude hanya ga zabe.
rows.reference: Wakilin Majalisar Ɗinkin Duniya Staffan de Mistura yana sa ran cikin kwanan nan zai kira taron farko na kwamitin wanda ke kunsheda mambobin gwamnati da na ‘yan adawa su rubuta tsarin mulkin kasa bayan yaki na Sham ya kuma buɗe hanyar zabe.

rows.source: Moualem laid out conditions for the Syrian government's participation in the committee, saying the panel's work should be restricted "to reviewing the articles of the current constitution," and warned against interference.
rows.output: Moualem ya bayyana sharuddan shiga gwamnatin Syria cikin kwamitin, inda ya bayyana cewa aikin kwamitin ya takaita ne "kan duba sashe na kundin tsarin mulkin da ake da shi," kuma ya gargadi game da tsoma baki.
rows.reference: Moualem ya fitar da sharruɗan da zasu sa gwamnatin Sham ta shiga cikin kwamitin, yana cewa a kuntata aikin bangarorin “zuwa yin bitar dokokin wannan tsarin mulkin na yau,” kuma yana bada gargaɗin tsangwama.

rows.source: Why Trump Will Win a Second Term
rows.output: Me ya sa Trump Zai Yi Nasara a Zaben Kasa na Biyu
rows.reference: Abun Da Ya Sa Trump Zai Sake Cin Zabe Karo na Biyu

rows.source: By that logic, Mr. Trump would win re-election in 2020 unless, as many liberal viewers are probably hoping, impeachment and scandal end his presidency prematurely.
rows.output: Ta wannan hanyar, Mista Trump zai yi nasara a sake zaben shugaban kasa a shekarar 2020 sai dai, kamar yadda da yawa daga cikin masu ra'ayin mazan jiya suka yi fatan, cire shi da kuma zargin zai kawo karshen shugabancinsa da wuri.
rows.reference: Bisa ga wannan dabarar, Mr. Trump zai sake cin zabe karo na biu a 2020 sai dai idan, yadda mambobin jam’iyyar ‘yanci da yawa suke sa rai, tsiguwa da abubuwan kunya sun kawo karshen shugabancin shi kafin lokacin sa.

rows.source: In what would no doubt be "The most dramatic finale of a presidency ever!"
rows.output: A cikin wanda ba shakka zai zama "Mafi ban mamaki na karshe na shugabanci kuma!"
rows.reference: A abun da ba ko gardama zai zama “mafi ban mamakin karshen shugabanci har abada!”

rows.source: As of now, there are no signs of viewer fatigue.
rows.output: A halin yanzu, babu alamun gajiya a tsakanin masu kallo.
rows.reference: A halin yanzu, babu wani alamar gajiyar mai kallo.

rows.source: Since 2014, prime-time ratings have more than doubled to 1.05 million at CNN and nearly tripled to 1.6 million at MSNBC.
rows.output: Tun daga 2014, ƙimar lokacin aiki sun fi ninka zuwa miliyan 1.05 a CNN da kusan sau uku zuwa miliyan 1.6 a MSNBC.
rows.reference: Tun 2014, kididdigar firayim lokaci ya nunku fiye da gida biyu zuwa miliyan 1.05 a CNN da kuma kusan nunki uku zuwa miliyan 1.6 a MSNBC.

rows.source: Fox News has an average of 2.4 million prime-time viewers, up from 1.7 million four years ago, according to Nielsen, and MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" has topped cable ratings with as many as 3.5 million viewers on major news nights.
rows.output: An kiyasta Fox News da mutane miliyan 2.4 a lokacin dare, wanda ya karu daga miliyan 1.7 a shekarar da ta gabata, a cewar Nielson, kuma MSNBC ta yi "The Rachel Maddow Show" ta yi fice a cikin jerin abubuwan da aka fi kallo da kusan mutane miliyan 3.5 a ranakun labarai masu muhimmanci.
rows.reference: Fox News su na da matsakaicin masu kallon firayim lokaci miliyan 2.4, sama daga miliyan 1.7 shekaru huɗu da suka wuce, a cewar Nielsen, da “Wasar Rachel Maddow” na MSNBC ya yi rinjayen kididdigar kebur da masu kallo har zuwa miliyan 3.5 a daren manyan labarai.

rows.source: "This is a fire that people are being drawn to because it's not something we understand," said Neal Baer, show runner of the ABC drama "Designated Survivor," about a cabinet secretary who becomes president after an attack destroys the Capitol.
rows.output: "Wannan wuta ce da mutane ke jan hankalinsu domin ba wani abu ne da muke fahimta ba," in ji Neal Baer, mai kula da shirin wasan kwaikwayo na ABC "Designated Survivor," game da sakatariyar majalisar da ta zama shugaba bayan wani hari ya lalata Capitol.
rows.reference: “Wannan wuta ne da ake jawo mutane zuwa saboda ba abu ne da muke ganewa ba,” inji Neal Baer, mai gudanar da wasan kwaikwayon ABC “Designated Survivor”, akan sakataren majalisa da ya zama shugaban kasa bayan an kai hari da ya hallaka Capitol.

rows.source: Nell Scovell, a veteran comedy writer and author of "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," has another theory.
rows.output: Nell Scovell, wata kwararriyar marubuciya mai ban dariya kuma marubuciyar "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," tana da wata ra'ayi.
rows.reference: Nell Scovell, tsohon marubucin ban dariya da kuma marubucin “Kawai Sassan Ban Dariyan: Da Wasu Gaskia Mara Daɗi Akan Yin Laɓaɓa Zuwa Cikin Kungiyar Mazan Hollywood”, yana da wani zato.

rows.source: She remembers a cab ride in Boston before the 2016 election.
rows.output: Ta tuna da tafiya a cikin taksi a Boston kafin zaben 2016.
rows.reference: Ta tuna wani tafiya a taksi a Boston kafin zaben 2016.

rows.source: The driver told her he would be voting for Mr. Trump.
rows.output: Mai tuka motar ya gaya mata zai zabi Mista Trump.
rows.reference: Direban ya ce mata zai zabi Mr. Trump.

rows.source: Why? she asked.
rows.output: Me yasa? Ta tambaya.
rows.reference: Dan meye? ta tambaya.

rows.source: "He said, "Because he makes me laugh,"" Ms. Scovell told me.
rows.output: "Ya ce, "Saboda yana sa ni dariya,"" Ms. Scovell ta gaya mani.
rows.reference: “Yace, “Saboda yana bani dariya,” Mr. Scovell ta faɗa mun.

rows.source: There is entertainment value in the chaos.
rows.output: Akwai darajar nishadi a cikin hargitsi.
rows.reference: Akwai darajar nishaɗi a hargitsi.

rows.source: Of course, unlike anything else on TV, the story lines coming out of Washington could determine the future of Roe v. Wade, whether immigrant families can reunite and the health of the global economy.
rows.output: Tabbas, ba kamar komai a talabijin ba, layukan labarai daga Washington na iya tantance makomar Roe v. Wade, ko iyalan 'yan gudun hijira za su iya sake haduwa, da kuma lafiyar tattalin arzikin duniya.
rows.reference: dama ai, ba kamar duk wani abu dake telebijin ba, labaran dake fitowa daga Washington zasu iya kayyade zaman gaban Roe v. Wade, ko ‘yan gudun hijira zasu iya sake haɗuwa da kuma lafiyar tattalin arzikin duniya.

rows.source: Tuning out is a luxury only the most privileged viewers can afford.
rows.output: Cirewa wani abu ne da kawai masu kudi suke iya ba da lokaci.
rows.reference: Fitowa alfarma ne da zababbun masu kalo kawai ke iya wa.

rows.source: And yet, it goes beyond being an informed citizen when you find yourself on hour six of watching a panel of experts debate Bob Woodward's use of "deep background" sourcing for his book "Fear," Paul Manafort's $15,000 ostrich-leather bomber jacket ("a garment thick with hubris," The Washington Post said) and the implications of Stormy Daniels's lurid descriptions of Mr. Trump's, um, anatomy.
rows.output: Kuma duk da haka, ya wuce zama ɗan ƙasa mai ilimi lokacin da kuka sami kanku a cikin sa'o'i shida na kallon kwamitin masana suna tattaunawa kan amfani da "bayanin zurfi" na Bob Woodward don littafinsa "Tsoro," rigar fuka-fukan da aka yi wa Paul Manafort akan dala 15,000 ("kayan da aka yi da fuka-fukan da aka yi da fuka-fukan da aka yi da fuka-fukan da aka yi da fuka-fukan da aka yi da fuka-fukan da aka yi da fuka-fukan da aka yi da fuka-fukan da aka yi
rows.reference: kuma a hakan, ya wuce zama ɗan kasa sananne idan ka ga kan ka a awa shida na kallon kwamitin gwanaye su na tattauna amfani da “bayanai masu zurfi” na Bob Woodward yana nemar ma littafin shi “Tsoro,” Jaket ɗin fata mai zanen jimina na Paul Manafort mai farashin dala 15,000 (“wani kaya mai kauri da kima,” Washington post sun ce) da kuma muhimmancin tsatsan bayanin, um, jikin Mr Trump da Stormy Daniel ya yi.

rows.source: I, for one, will never look at Super Mario the same way again.
rows.output: Ni, a gare ni, ba zan sake kallon Super Mario haka ba.
rows.reference: Ni, Musamman, bazan sake kallon Super Mario kamar yadda na saba ba.

rows.source: "Part of what he's doing that makes it feel like a reality show is that he is feeding you something every night," said Brent Montgomery, chief executive of Wheelhouse Entertainment and the creator of "Pawn Stars," about the Trump show's rotating cast and daily plot twists (picking a fight with the N.F.L., praising Kim Jong-un).
rows.output: "Daya daga cikin abin da yake yi wanda ke sa ya ji kamar shirin gaskiya shi ne cewa yana ciyar da ku wani abu kowace dare," in ji Brent Montgomery, shugaban kamfanin Wheelhouse Entertainment kuma wanda ya kirkiro "Pawn Stars," game da nuna Trump na nuna wani bangare na gani da kuma juyin labari na yau da kullun (kawo rikici da NFL, yabon Kim Jong-un).
rows.reference: “Cikin abubuwan da yake yi yana sa ya zama kamar wasan gaskia shi ne yana ciyar da kai wani abu kowane dare,” inji Brent Mongomery, babban shugaban Wheelhouse Entertainment da kuma makerin “Pawn Stars,” akan wasan Trump mai juyin yan wasa da tsari (zabin faɗa da N.F.L, da yabon Kim Jong-un).

rows.source: You can't afford to miss one episode or you're left behind.
rows.output: Ba za ku iya yin watsi da wani shiri ba ko kuma ku fice a baya.
rows.reference: Ba za ka so ka rasa kowane kashi ba ko a bar ka a baya.

rows.source: When I reached Mr. Fleiss this week, it was a sunny 80 degrees outside his home on the north shore of Kauai, but he was holed up inside watching MSNBC while recording CNN.
rows.output: Lokacin da na kai Mista Fleiss wannan makon, rana ce mai kyau 80 a wajen gidansa a bakin tekun arewa na Kauai, amma yana cikin gidan yana kallon MSNBC yayin da yake rikodin CNN.
rows.reference: Lokacin da na sami Mr. Fleiss wannan satin, akwai rana sosai har zuwa digiri 80 a wajen gidan shi a arewacin tashar Kauai, amma ya boye a ciki yana kallon MSNBC a yayin da yake rikodin CNN.

rows.source: He couldn't peel himself away, not with Brett Kavanaugh set to face the Senate Judiciary Committee and the future of the Supreme Court hanging in the balance.
rows.output: Bai taba iya cire kansa ba, ba tare da Brett Kavanaugh da ke shirin fuskantar kwamitin shari'a na majalisar dattawa da kuma makomar kotun koli tana cikin hadari ba.
rows.reference: Ya kasa cire kanshi daga wurin, ba a yayi da Brett Kavanaugh yake fuska da fuska da Kwamitin ‘Yan Majalisa na Shair’a ba kuma da makomar Babban Kotu a rataye a ma’auni ba.

rows.source: "I remember when we were doing all those crazy shows back in the day and people said, "This is the beginning of the end of Western civilization,"" Mr. Fleiss told me.
rows.output: Ina tunawa da lokacin da muke yin wadannan wasannin da ba su da hankali a zamanin nan kuma mutane sun ce, "Wannan shine farkon karshen al'ummar yammacin duniya," Mista Fleiss ya gaya mani.
rows.reference: “Na tuna lokacinda muke yin wasannin barkwanci a baya da mutane suka ce, "wannan shi ne farin ilimin boko,"" Mr Fleiss ya gaya min.

rows.source: "I thought it was sort of a joke, but it turns out they were right."
rows.output: Na yi tunanin wani irin wasa ne, amma ya juya sun yi gaskiya.
rows.reference: “na dauka kawai wasa ne, amma sai ya zama gaskiyan su ne.”

rows.source: Amy Chozick, a writer at large for The Times covering business, politics and media, is the author of the memoir "Chasing Hillary."
rows.output: Amy Chozick, marubuciya a babban kamfanin jaridar The Times, tana rufe harkokin kasuwanci, siyasa da kafafen yada labarai, ita ce marubuciyar tarihin rayuwa "Chasing Hillary."
rows.reference: Amy Chozick, marubuci kan lokutan kasuwanci, siyasa da kafar sadarwa, shi ne ya rubuta littafin “Chasing Hillary.”

rows.source: Outside money floods into tightest midterm election House races
rows.output: Kudade masu yawa suna shiga cikin zaben majalisar wakilai mafi tsauri
rows.reference: Kuɗin waje ya cika mafi kusancin zaben tsakiyar wa’adi na ‘yan majalisa

rows.source: It's not surprising that Pennsylvania's 17th is seeing a flood of cash, thanks to a realignment of a congressional districts that landed two incumbents in a race for the same seat.
rows.output: Ba abin mamaki ba ne cewa Pennsylvania's 17th ya ga yawan kudade, saboda sake fasalin gundumomin majalisar da ya sa 'yan majalisar biyu suka yi takara don kujerar daya.
rows.reference: Ba abun mamaki bane cewa 17 na Pennsylvania yana ganin kuɗi masu yawa, godiya ga sake daidaituwar gundumar majalisa da ya kawo ga masu sarauta biyu a gasar kujera ɗaya.

rows.source: This recently redrawn suburban Pittsburg district pits Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - who won his seat in another district in a special election last spring.
rows.output: Wannan sabon zane na yankin birni na Pittsburg na baya-bayan nan yana kai wa dan jam'iyyar Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - wanda ya lashe kujerarsa a wani yanki a zaben musanya a bazara.
rows.reference: Wannan sabon tsarin yankunan wajen Pittsburg ya haɗda Ɗan Majalisar Jam’iyyar Damokraɗiya Conor Lamb - wanda ya ci kujerar a wata gundumar a wani zaben musamman bazarar da ta wuce.

rows.source: Lamb is running against another incumbent, Republican Keith Rothfus, who currently represents the old Pennsylvania 12th district, which overlaps heavily with the new 17th.
rows.output: Akwai wani dan takara mai ci, Republican Keith Rothfus, wanda a halin yanzu yake wakiltar tsohon yankin Pennsylvania 12, wanda ke da alaka sosai da sabon 17.
rows.reference: Lamb yana takarar tare da wani Ɗan Majalisa, Ɗan jam’iyar Republican Keith Rothfus, wanda ke wakiltar tsohon Gundumar Pennsylvania na 12, wanda ya haɗda sosai da sabon na 17.

rows.source: The maps were redrawn after the Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled in January that the old districts were unconstitutionally gerrymandered in Republicans' favor.
rows.output: An sake zayyana taswirorin bayan Kotun Koli ta Pennsylvania ta yanke hukunci a watan Janairu cewa tsofaffin yankunan sun gaza a siyasance a kan jam'iyyar Republican.
rows.reference: An sake zane taswirar ne bayan Babban Kotun Pennsylvania ta yanken hukunci a Janairu cewa an haɗe iyakan tsofaffin gundumomin na ba akan shari’a ba dan a yima jam’iyar Republicans ni’ima.

rows.source: The race in the new 17th has touched off a campaign finance slugfest between the major party finance arms, the Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) and the National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).
rows.output: An fara yakin kudi tsakanin manyan kungiyoyin tara kudade na jam'iyyun, Kwamitin Yakin Neman Zabe na Majalisar Dokokin Amurka (DCCC) da Kwamitin Yakin Neman Zabe na Jam'iyyar Republican (NRCC).
rows.reference: Takarar a sabon na 17 ɗin ya buɗe hanyar gasar kuɗi tsakanin saasan kuɗaɗen manyan jam’iyu, Kwamitin Yakin Zaben Majalisa na Damokraɗiya (DCCC) da Kwamitin Yakin Zaben na Kasa na Republicans (NRCC).

rows.source: Lamb became a familiar name in Pennsylvania after a narrow win in a widely watched in March special election for Pennsylvania's 18th Congressional District.
rows.output: Lamb ya zama sunan da aka sani a Pennsylvania bayan nasarar da ya samu a zaben musamman da aka gudanar a watan Maris na zaben kujerar majalisar dokokin Amurka ta 18 ta Pennsylvania.
rows.reference: Lamb ya zama sanannen suna a Pennsylvania bayan matsatten nasara a wani zaben mussamman da aka kalla sosai a Maris na Majalisar 18 na Gundumar Pennsylvania.

rows.source: That seat had been held by a Republican for over a decade, and President Donald Trump won the district by 20 points.
rows.output: Wannan kujerar ta kasance a hannun Republican sama da shekaru goma, kuma shugaba Donald Trump ya lashe yankin da kuri'u 20.
rows.reference: Wannan kujerar da tana hannun Republican ne fiye da shekaru goma, kuma shugaban kasa Donald Trump ya ci gundumar da maki 20.

rows.source: Political pundits have given Democrats a slight edge.
rows.output: Masu nazarin harkokin siyasa sun baiwa 'yan Democrat karamin fa'ida.
rows.reference: Manazartan siyasa sun ba wa jam’iyar Ɗamokraɗiya ɗan matsatsen sa’ar nasara.

rows.source: U.S. Weighed Penalizing El Salvador Over Support for China, Then Backed Off
rows.output: Amurka ta Yi La'akari da Hukuncin Kisa Kan Tallafin El Salvador na Sin, Sannan ta Fice
rows.reference: Amurka Ta yi Nazarin Hukunta El Salvador Don Goyon Bayan China, Sai ta Fasa

rows.source: Diplomats noted that the Dominican Republic and Panama had already recognized Beijing, with little pushback from Washington.
rows.output: Diplomats sun lura cewa Jamhuriyar Dominican da Panama sun riga sun amince da birnin Beijing, tare da karancin tursasawa daga Washington.
rows.reference: Ma’aikatan hulɗa sun lura cewa Jamhuriryar Dominican da Panama sun riga sun shaida da Beijing, tare da ɗan karamin turi daga Washington.

rows.source: Mr. Trump had a warm meeting with President Juan Carlos Varela of Panama in June 2017 and had a hotel in Panama until partners evicted the Trump Organization's management team.
rows.output: Mista Trump ya yi wani taro mai dumi da shugaban kasar Panama Juan Carlos Varela a watan Yuni 2017, kuma yana da otal a Panama har sai abokan hulɗarsa suka kore ƙungiyar Trump.
rows.reference: Mr. Trump ya yi taron fara’a da Shugaba Juan Carlos Varela na Panama a Yuni 2017 kuma yana da otel a Panama har sai da abokanan sana’a suka kori masu gudanar da aikin kungiyar Trump.

rows.source: State Department officials decided to call back the American chiefs of diplomatic missions from El Salvador, the Dominican Republic and Panama over the "recent decisions to no longer recognize Taiwan," Heather Nauert, the department's spokeswoman, said in a statement early this month.
rows.output: Jami'an Ma'aikatar Harkokin Waje sun yanke shawarar kiran dawo da manyan jami'an diflomasiyya na Amurka daga El Salvador, Jamhuriyar Dominican da Panama kan "shawarwarin da aka yanke kwanan nan na dakatar da amincewa da Taiwan," in ji Heather Nauert, mai magana da yawun ma'aikatar a wata sanarwa da aka fitar a farkon wannan watan.
rows.reference: Jami’an Sassan Kasa sun yanke hukunci su dawo da manyan ma’aikatan hulɗar Amurka da ke El Salvador, Jamhuriyar Dominacan da Panama akan wannan “hukuncin kwanan nan na daina shaida Taiwan,” Heather Nauert, kakakin sashen, ta faɗa a bayani farkon wannan watan.

rows.source: But penalties were only considered against El Salvador, which received an estimated $140 million in American aid in 2017, including for narcotics controls, development and economic support.
rows.output: Amma an yi la'akari da hukunci ne kawai a kan El Salvador, wanda ya samu kimanin dala miliyan 140 a cikin taimakon Amurka a shekarar 2017, ciki har da na sarrafa miyagun kwayoyi, ci gaba, da tallafin tattalin arziki.
rows.reference: Amma kawai tara aka yi nazari akan El Salvador, waɗanda suka samu kimanin agajin dala miliyan 140 daga Amurka a 2017, harda kula da kwayoyi, goyon bayan ci gaba da tattalin arziki.

rows.source: The proposed penalties, which included cuts to financial aid and targeted visa restrictions, would have been painful for the Central American country and its high unemployment and murder rates.
rows.output: Wadannan hukuncin da aka gabatar, wadanda suka hada da rage tallafin kudi da kuma takaita biza, za su yi zafi ga kasar tsakiyar Amurka da kuma yawan rashin aikin yi da kuma yawan kashe-kashe.
rows.reference: Taran da aka yi nazarin, wanda har da yanke agajin kuɗi da kuntatawar takardun izinin shiga, da za su yi zafi wa Kasar ta Tsakiyar Amurka da ke fama da rashin aiki da kashe-kashe.

rows.source: As internal meetings progressed, North American and Central American officials postponed a high-level conference focused on security and economic prosperity to follow up a similar gathering last year that was seen as a step forward in efforts to prevent migrants from heading to the United States.
rows.output: Yayin da tarurrukan cikin gida ke gudana, jami'an Arewacin Amurka da Tsakiyar Amurka sun jinkirta wani babban taro da ya mayar da hankali kan tsaro da ci gaban tattalin arziki don bin wani taro mai kama da haka da aka yi a shekarar da ta gabata, wanda aka dauka a matsayin wani muhimmin mataki na kokarin hana 'yan gudun hijira tafiya zuwa Amurka.
rows.reference: A yayin da taron cikin gidan ke guduna, Jami'ai na Arewacin Amurka da na tsakiya sun dakatar da wani taro mai zurfi kan batun tsaro da wadataccen tattalin arziki don bitan wannan taron na bara wanda aka ganshi a matsayin matakin kokarin hana masu gudun hijirar zuwa Amurka.

rows.source: But by mid-September, top administration officials made clear that they wanted the conference to go forward, effectively ending any consideration of penalties for El Salvador.
rows.output: Amma a tsakiyar watan Satumba, manyan jami'an gwamnati sun bayyana cewa suna son taron ya ci gaba, wanda hakan ya nuna cewa an kawar da duk wani tunani na hukunta El Salvador.
rows.reference: Amma a tsakiyar watan Satumba, manyan jami'an gwamnati sun bayyana cewa su na so taron ya ci gaba, yadda ya kamata a kawo karshen hukuncin da ake yi wa El Salvador.

rows.source: Vice President Mike Pence is now slated to address the conference, now scheduled for mid-October, in a signal of the import the administration places on the gathering, the diplomats said.
rows.output: Mataimakin Shugaban Kasa Mike Pence yanzu zai yi jawabi ga taron, wanda aka shirya a tsakiyar watan Oktoba, a matsayin alamar muhimmancin da gwamnati ke baiwa taron, a cewar jakadun.
rows.reference: Mataimakin shugaban kasar Mike Pence yanzu an tsara zai yi bayani a taron, wanda aka shirya a tsakiyar watan Oktoba, a wata alama ta shigo da ayyukan gwamnati a taron, in ji jakadan.

rows.source: And the three American envoys quietly returned to El Salvador, Panama and the Dominican Republic with no new tough messages or punishments from Washington.
rows.output: Kuma jakadun Amurka uku sun koma El Salvador, Panama da Jamhuriyar Dominican cikin shiru, ba tare da sabbin sakonni masu tsauri ko hukunci daga Washington ba.
rows.reference: Kuma wakilan Amurka guda uku sun koma El Salvador, Panama da Jamhuriyar Dominica ba tare da sababbin saƙonni ko azabtarwa daga Washington ba.

rows.source: A White House spokesman for Mr. Bolton declined to comment on the details of the debate that were described by the three American officials, including two diplomats, who agreed to discuss the internal deliberations on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: Wani mai magana da yawun fadar White House na Mista Bolton ya ki yin tsokaci kan bayanan muhawarar da aka bayyana da masu baiwa jami’an Amurka uku da suka hada da manyan jami’an diflomasiyya biyu, wadanda suka amince da tattaunawar cikin gida a kan sharadin rashin bayyana sunayensu.
rows.reference: Kakakin Fadar White House Mr. Bolton ya ƙi yin sharhi game da cikakken muhawarar da jami'an Amurka uku suka bayyana, ciki harda ma'aikatan diplomasiyya guda biyu, waɗanda suka amince da su tattauna boye a ciki.

rows.source: Their accounts were corroborated by an outside analyst who is close to the administration and also spoke on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: Asusun nasu ya samu goyon baya daga wani mai nazari daga waje wanda ke da alaka da gwamnati kuma ya yi magana a karkashin sharadin rashin suna.
rows.reference: an tabbatar da bayanansu daga manazarci wanda ke kusa da gwamnati kuma yayi magana a yanayin boye.

rows.source: Study History
rows.output: Koyi Tarihin
rows.reference: Karanta Tarihi

rows.source: The next shoe to drop could be the special counsel Robert Mueller's report on Mr. Trump's possible obstruction of justice, of which there now is very substantial evidence in the public record.
rows.output: Na gaba da za a yi shi ne rahoton babban lauyan musamman Robert Mueller kan yiwuwar Mista Trump na hana adalci, wanda yanzu akwai hujjoji masu yawa a cikin rikodin jama'a.
rows.reference: Takalmi na gaba da za a sauke zai iya kasancewa na mai bada shawara na musamman Robert Mueller ne rahoto game da yiwuwar tsayar da adalci na Mr. Trump, wanda a yanzu akwai hujja sosai a cikin rajistar jama'a.

rows.source: Mr. Mueller is reportedly also turning his investigation to whether Mr. Trump's campaign colluded with Russia in its attack on our elections.
rows.output: Mista Mueller dai ana ruwaito yana binciken ko yunkurin Mista Trump ya hada baki da Rasha a hare-haren da ta kai kan zabukanmu.
rows.reference: An ruwaito cewa Mr. Mueller ya mayar da akalansa kan gano ko kamfen din Mr. Trump ya hada kai da Rasha a harin da aka yi a kan zabukanmu.

rows.source: Should Congress change hands, Mr. Trump will find himself facing accountability in that body, just as he prepares to go again before the voters, and perhaps eventually a jury of his peers.
rows.output: Idan Majalisar ta canza hannu, Mista Trump zai sami kansa yana fuskantar alhaki a cikinta, kamar yadda yake shirin tafiya a karo na biyu a gaban masu kada kuri'a, kuma watakila a karshe juri na abokan aikinsa.
rows.reference: idan har majilisar ta chanza hannu, Mr. Trump zai samu kanshi cikin tuhumar daukar alhakin a wannan gamayyar, kamar yadda yake shirin komawa gaban masu zabe, kuma kila ta kasance a tsakanin sa’oin shi.

rows.source: That is a lot of ifs, and I do not mean to suggest that Mr. Trump's fall is inevitable - nor that of his equivalents in Europe.
rows.output: Wannan yana nufin cewa akwai abubuwa da yawa da za a yi la'akari da su, kuma ba na nufin in ba da shawarar cewa faduwar Mista Trump ba ta da wani tasiri - ko kuma na makamantansa a Turai.
rows.reference: akwai alamomin tambaya da yawa, kuma bawai ina nufin faduwar Mr. Trump ba zai iya yiyuwa ba-kawai na tsaran shi a turai.

rows.source: There are choices to be made by all of us on both sides of the Atlantic that will affect how prolonged the struggle may be.
rows.output: Akwai zabi da za mu yi duka a bangarorin biyu na Tekun Atlantika da zai shafi tsawon lokacin yakin.
rows.reference: Akwai zaɓin da za a yi da mu duka a bangarorin biyu na Atlantic wanda zai shafi yadda za a iya yin dogon gwagwarmaya wata kila.

rows.source: In 1938, German officers were ready to stage a coup d"état against Hitler, if only the West had resisted him and backed the Czechoslovaks at Munich.
rows.output: A shekara ta 1938, jami'an Jamus sun shirya su yi juyin mulki kan Hitler, idan kawai yammacin duniya ta yi masa adawa kuma ta goyi bayan Czechoslovaks a Munich.
rows.reference: A shekara ta 1938, jami'an Jamus sun shirya juyin mulki a kan Hitler, idan Yammacin Amurka suka ki shi kuma sun goyi bayan Czechoslovaks a Munich.

rows.source: We failed, and missed an opportunity to avoid the years of carnage that ensued.
rows.output: Muka kasa, kuma mun rasa damar gujewa shekarun tashin hankali da suka biyo baya.
rows.reference: Mun kasa, kuma mun rasa damar da za mu kauce wa shekarun da aka yi na kisan kai da ya auku.

rows.source: The course of history pivots around such inflection points, and democracy's inexorable march is accelerated or delayed.
rows.output: Hanyar tarihi tana kewaye da irin wannan maki, kuma dimokuradiyya ba za ta iya jurewa ba, kuma tana hanzarta ko jinkirta ci gaba.
rows.reference: Hanyoyin tarihi su na faɗakarwa game da irin wannan matsala, kuma ana tafiyar da dimokuradiyya dole ba tare da sauri ko jinkiri ba.

rows.source: Americans face several of these inflection points now.
rows.output: Amurkawa suna fuskantar wasu daga cikin wadannan wuraren juyawa a yanzu.
rows.reference: Amurkawa sun fuskanci da yawa wannan gajiyawar makin yanzu.

rows.source: What will we do if Mr. Trump fires Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein, the man who controls the fate of Mr. Mueller's investigation?
rows.output: Me za mu yi idan Mista Trump ya kori Mataimakin Babban Lauyan, Rod Rosenstein, wanda ke da iko kan binciken Mista Mueller?
rows.reference: Menene za mu yi idan Mr. Trump ya kori mataimakin Babban mai Shari'a Janar Rod Rosenstein, mutumin da yake jagorancin binciken Mr. Mueller?

rows.source: Rosenstein has been in hot water ever since this paper reported that, last year, he suggested secretly recording the president and speculated about his being unfit for office.
rows.output: An yi wa Rosenzweig kuka tun bayan wannan jarida ta ruwaito cewa, a shekarar da ta gabata, ya ba da shawarar yin rikodin sirrin shugaban kasa kuma ya yi hasashen cewa yana iya zama ba shi da cancantar mukaminsa.
rows.reference: Rosenstein ya kasance a cikin ruwan zafi tun lokacin da wannan takarda ta ruwaito cewa, a bara, ya bada shawara a asirce ga shugaban kasa kuma ya yi la'akari game da rashin cancantar sa ga ofishin.

rows.source: Mr. Rosenstein says The Times's account is inaccurate.
rows.output: Mista Rosenstein ya ce rahoton Times ba daidai ba ne.
rows.reference: Mr. Rosenstein ya ce asusun Times ɗin ba daidai ba ne.

rows.source: "How will we respond if the newly requested F.B.I. investigation of Brett Kavanaugh is not full or fair - or if he is confirmed to the Supreme Court despite credible accusations of sexual assault and dishonest testimony?
rows.output: Yaya za mu amsa idan binciken da aka nema na F.B.I. na Brett Kavanaugh ba cikakke ba ne ko adalci ba - ko kuma idan an tabbatar da shi a kotun koli duk da zargin fyade da ya yi da kuma karya shaida?
rows.reference: "Yaya za mu amsa idan sabon bincike na binciken F.B.I. na Brett Kavanaugh bai cika ba ko ba gaskiya - ko kuma idan an tabbatar da shi a Kotun Koli duk da kwakwaran zargin da ake yi na cin zarafin jima’i da kuma shaidar rashin gaskiya?

rows.source: And above all, will we vote in the midterms for a Congress that will hold Mr. Trump accountable?
rows.output: Kuma mafi mahimmanci, za mu zabe a zaben tsakiyar wa'adi don Majalisar da za ta sa Mr. Trump ya amsa?
rows.reference: Kuma a duka, za mu yi zabe a tsakiyar don majalisar dokoki da za ta rike Mr. Trump da alhaki?

rows.source: If we fail those tests, democracy will be in for a long winter.
rows.output: Idan muka gaza wadannan gwaje-gwajen, dimokuradiyya za ta shiga cikin sanyi mai tsawo.
rows.reference: Idan muka fadi wadancan gwajegwajen, dimokuradiyya zai kasance a cikin hunturu mai tsawo.

rows.source: But I believe we will not fail, because of the lesson I learned in Prague.
rows.output: Amma ina ganin ba za mu gaza ba, saboda darasin da na koya a Prague.
rows.reference: Amma inada yakinin bazamu fadi ba, saboda darasin da na koya a Prague.

rows.source: My mother was a Czechoslovak Jew who was deported to Auschwitz by the same Nazi regime that once occupied my ambassadorial home.
rows.output: Mahaifiyata Baƙar fata ce ta Czechoslovak wadda aka yi gudun hijira zuwa Auschwitz ta hanyar mulkin Nazi ɗaya da ya taɓa zama gidana na jakadanci.
rows.reference: Mahaifiyata bayahudiyar Czechoslovak ce wacce aka maida ta zuwa Auschwitz ta wannan tsarin mulkin na Nazi wanda ya taba zama a gidan jakadanci na.

rows.source: She survived, immigrated to America and, 60 years later, sent me off to light Sabbath candles on that table bearing the swastika.
rows.output: Ta tsira, ta yi hijira zuwa Amurka, kuma shekaru 60 bayan haka, ta aika da ni in kunna fitilun Shabbat a kan wannan teburin da ke dauke da swastika.
rows.reference: Ta tsira, ta yi hijira zuwa Amirka, kuma bayan shekaru 60, ta tura ni zuwa kunna kendir din sabbath a kan tebur din can da ke dauke da swastika.

rows.source: With that as my heritage, how can I not be an optimist about our future?"
rows.output: Tare da haka a matsayin gadona, ta yaya ba zan iya zama mai kyakkyawan fata game da makomarmu ba?
rows.reference: Da wannan a matsayin abun gado na, yaya zan zama mai tsatsauran ra’ayi a game da nan gaba ba?”

rows.source: Norman Eisen, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, is the chairman of Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington and the author of "The Last Palace: Europe's Turbulent Century in Five Lives and One Legendary House."
rows.output: Norman Eisen, wani babban malami a Cibiyar Brookings, shi ne shugaban kungiyar 'yan kasa don alhakin da kuma Washington kuma marubucin "Gidan sarauta na ƙarshe: ƙarni na Turai mai cike da tashin hankali a cikin rayuwa biyar da wani gida mai ban mamaki."
rows.reference: Norman Eisen, babban dan’uwa a ma’aikatar Brookings, shi ne shugaban kungiyar Jama'ar Alhaki da kuma da’a, a Birnin Washington da marubucin "The Last Palace: Rikitaccen karnin Turai a rayuka biyar da gidan tarihi daya.”

rows.source: Rangers' Graham Dorrans optimistic ahead of Rapid Vienna clash
rows.output: Masu tseren Rangers sun yi fatan Graham Dorrans kafin haduwa da Vienna ta sauri
rows.reference: Rangers' Graham Dorrans yana da yakini gabanin haduwar Rapid Vienna

rows.source: Rangers host Rapid Vienna on Thursday, knowing that victory over the Austrians, following the impressive draw in Spain against Villarreal earlier this month, will put them in a strong position to qualify from Group G of the Europa League.
rows.output: Rangers suna karbar bakuncin Rapid Vienna a ranar Alhamis, suna da tabbacin cewa nasarar da suka samu a kan 'yan Austriya, biyo bayan wasan da suka tashi 3-3 da suka yi da Villarreal a Spain a farkon wannan watan, zai sanya su cikin kyakkyawan matsayi don tsallakewa daga Group G na gasar Europa League.
rows.reference: Rangers sun karbi bakuncin Rapid Vienna a ranar Alhamis, inda suka san cewa nasarar da ta samu a kan Austrians, bayan zira kwallo a Spain da Villarreal a farkon wannan watan, zai sanya su cikin matsayi mai karfi don samun damar shiga kungiyar G na Europa League.

rows.source: A knee injury prevented midfielder Graham Dorrans from making his first appearance of the season until the 2-2 draw with Villarreal but he believes Rangers can use that result as a springboard to greater things.
rows.output: Raunin gwiwa ya hana dan wasan tsakiya Graham Dorrans ya fara buga wasa a kakar wasa ta bana har sai da aka tashi 2-2 da Villarreal, amma yana ganin Rangers za su iya amfani da wannan sakamakon a matsayin tukunyar tserewa zuwa manyan abubuwa.
rows.reference: Raunin gwiwa ya hana dan wasan tsakiya Graham Dorrans buga farkon kakar wasa ta bana har zuwa 2-2 da Villarreal amma ya yi imanin cewa Rangers zai iya amfani da wannan sakamakon a matsayin matashi zuwa ga manyan abubuwa.

rows.source: "It was a good point for us because Villarreal are a good side," said the 31-year-old.
rows.output: "Ya kasance wani muhimmin lokaci a gare mu domin Villarreal kungiya ce mai kyau," in ji mutumin mai shekaru 31.
rows.reference: "Wannan maki ne mai kyau a gare mu saboda Villarreal na da kyau," a cewar dan shekaru 31.

rows.source: "We went into the game believing we could get something and came away with a point.
rows.output: "Muka shiga wasan da muka yi imani za mu samu wani abu kuma muka tafi da maki daya."
rows.reference: "Mun fara wasan da imani cewa mu na iya samun wani abu kuma muka tsira da maki daya

rows.source: Maybe we could have nicked it in the end but, overall, a draw was probably a fair result.
rows.output: Wataƙila mun iya kama shi a ƙarshe amma, gabaɗaya, kunnen doki ne mai yiwuwa ya zama sakamakon adalci.
rows.reference: Wataƙila da mun ci su a ƙarshen amma, gaba ɗaya, kunnen dokin yana iya zama kyakkyawar sakamako.

rows.source: They were probably better in the first half and we came out in the second half and were the better side.
rows.output: Sun yi yiwuwa sun fi kyau a farkon rabin, sannan muka fito a rabin na biyu kuma muka kasance mafi kyawun kungiya.
rows.reference: Sun kasance mafi kyau a farkon rabin kuma mun fito a cikin rabi na biyu kuma mun kasance mafi kyau gefen.

rows.source: Going into Thursday, it's another big European night.
rows.output: A ranar Alhamis, wani babban dare na Turai ne.
rows.reference: Nufatar ranar Alhamis, wani babban dare ne a Turai.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can get three points but that will be tough game because they had a good result in their last game but, with the crowd behind us, I'm sure we can push on and get a positive result.
rows.output: Yi waɗannan maki uku, amma wannan zai yi wuya saboda sun yi kyakkyawan wasa a wasan da suka yi kwanan nan, amma tare da magoya baya suna bayanmu, na tabbata za mu iya matsawa kuma mu samu sakamako mai kyau.
rows.reference: Mu na fatan, za mu iya samun maki uku amma wannan zai zama matsala mai wuya saboda su na da kyakkyawar sakamako a wasan karshe amma, da taron magoya bayan mu, na tabbata za mu iya turawa don samun sakamako mai kyau.

rows.source: Last year was definitely tough, between everything that happened with my injuries and the changes at the club itself but there's a feelgood factor about the place now.
rows.output: Shekarar da ta gabata ta yi tsanani, tsakanin komai da ya faru da raunukan da na samu da kuma sauye-sauyen da aka samu a kulob din, amma akwai wani abu mai kyau game da wurin yanzu.
rows.reference: A bara ya kasance da wuya, tsakanin abin da ya faru da raunin da na yi da kuma canje-canje a kungiyar amma yanzu akwai alamun dadi a wurin yanzu.

rows.source: The squad's good and the boys are really enjoying it; the training's good.
rows.output: Tawagar tana da kyau kuma yaran suna jin dadin hakan; horon yana da kyau.
rows.reference: Tawagar nada kyau kuma yaran na jin dadi haka; motsa jikin na da kyau.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can push on now, put last season behind us and be successful."
rows.output: Mu fatan za mu ci gaba da tafiya yanzu, mu bar kakar da ta gabata a bayanmu, mu kuma mu samu nasara."
rows.reference: Da fatan, za mu iya turawa yanzu, mu sanya kakar bara a baya don kuma mu ci nasara."

rows.source: Women are losing sleep over this retirement savings fear
rows.output: Mata suna yin barci a kan wannan tsoron ajiyar ritaya
rows.reference: Mata na kasa barci saboda tsoron rasa kudin ajiyarsu na ritaya

rows.source: Despite the fact that survey participants had a clear idea of how they wanted to be cared for, few people were talking to their family members about it.
rows.output: Duk da haka, masu amsa binciken suna da cikakken ra'ayi game da yadda suke son a kula da su, amma mutane kaɗan ne suka yi magana da 'yan uwansu game da shi.
rows.reference: Duk da cewa mahalarta binciken su na da ra'ayi game da yadda suke so a kula da su, kadan daga cikin mutane su na magana da' yan uwansu game da shi.

rows.source: About half of the individuals in the Nationwide study said they were speaking with their spouses about the cost of long-term care.
rows.output: Kusan rabin mutanen da ke cikin binciken kasa baki daya sun ce suna magana da matansu game da farashin kula da su na dogon lokaci.
rows.reference: Kusan rabin mutane a nazarin duk kasar sun ce su na magana da matansu game da kudin da ake kulawa da dadewa.

rows.source: Only 10 percent said they spoke with their kids about it.
rows.output: Kashi ɗaya bisa ɗari ne kawai suka ce suna magana da yaransu akai.
rows.reference: Kashi 10 bisa dari ne kawai sukayi magana da yayan su game da haka.

rows.source: "People want a family member to care for them, but they aren't taking the steps to have the conversation," said Holly Snyder, vice president of Nationwide's life insurance business.
rows.output: "Mutane suna son wani daga cikin iyalansu ya kula da su, amma ba sa ɗaukar matakan da za su yi magana game da shi," in ji Holly Snyder, babban jami'in gudanarwa na kamfanin inshorar rayuwa na kasa da kasa.
rows.reference: "Mutane su na son dangi su kula da su, amma ba su daukan matakai don tattaunawa," in ji Holly Snyder, Mataimakin Shugaban Hukumar Harkokin inshura.

rows.source: Here's where to begin.
rows.output: Ga inda za a fara.
rows.reference: Ga inda za a fara.

rows.source: Talk to your spouse and the kids: You can't prepare your family to provide care if you don't make your wishes known well ahead of time.
rows.output: Tattauna da matarka da yaran: Ba za ka iya shirya danginka su ba da kulawa ba idan ba ka sanar da su abin da kake so ba da wuri.
rows.reference: Kayi ma matar ka magana da yaran: Bazaka iya shirya iyalin ka don samun kulawa ba idan baka bayyanar da fatan ka an sani ba kafin lokaci.

rows.source: Work with your advisor and your family to discuss where and how to receive care, as those choices can be a significant factor in determining the cost.
rows.output: Yi aiki tare da mai ba da shawara da iyalinku don tattauna inda da yadda za ku karɓi kulawa, saboda waɗannan zaɓuɓɓukan na iya zama muhimmin abu wajen tantance farashi.
rows.reference: Kayi aiki da masu baka shawara da iyalin ka don tattauna ina da yanda za’a karbi kulawa, don wadannan zabubbukan nada muhimman abubuwa don kayyade kudin.

rows.source: Bring in your financial advisor: Your advisor can also help you come up with a way to pay for those expenses.
