rows.output: Kawo mai ba da shawara kan harkokin kudi: Mai ba da shawara zai iya taimaka maka samun hanyar biyan wadannan kudade.
rows.reference: Shigo da mai bada shawara akan harkokin kudin ka: Mai baka shawara na iya taimaka maka ne wajen nuna maka hanyoyin da zaka iya biyan wadancan kudin da aka kashe.

rows.source: Your funding choices for long-term care can include a traditional long-term care insurance policy, a hybrid cash-value life insurance policy to help cover these expenses or self-insuring with your own wealth - as long as you have the money.
rows.output: Zaɓuɓɓukanku na kula da dogon lokaci na iya haɗawa da manufofin kula da dogon lokaci na gargajiya, manufofin haɗin gwiwa masu ƙima na rayuwa don taimakawa rufe waɗannan kuɗaɗen ko kuma kula da kanku tare da dukiya - muddin kuna da kuɗi.
rows.reference: Zaɓen kuɗin daukar nauyin ka na kulawar dogon zangona iya haɗawa da manufofin inshora na kula da dogon zango na gargajiya, wani matashin manufofin inshoran muhimmancin kudi don taimakawa wajen rufe wadancan kudaden da aka kashe ko inshoran kai da kudin ka -matukar kanada kudin.

rows.source: Hammer out your legal documents: Head off legal battles at the pass.
rows.output: Ƙirƙiri takardun shari'a: Ka guji fafatawar shari'a a matakin farko.
rows.reference: Fito da takaddun shari’ar ka: Kashe fadace-fadace na doka a lokacin baya.

rows.source: Get a health-care proxy in place so that you designate a trusted individual to oversee your medical care and ensure that professionals comply with your wishes in case you're unable to communicate.
rows.output: Samu wani mai kula da lafiya ya zama dole don haka za ku iya nada wani mutum mai aminci ya kula da lafiyar ku kuma ku tabbatar cewa kwararru sun bi sha'awar ku idan ba za ku iya sadarwa ba.
rows.reference: Nemi wani wakili na kiwon lafiya a wurin domin ka zaɓi mutumin da ka amincema don kula da lafiyar ya kuma tabbatar da cewa kwararru sunbi bukatun ka koda ka kasa magana.

rows.source: Also, consider a power of attorney for your finances.
rows.output: Haka kuma, yi la'akari da wani wakilci na doka don harkokin kuɗin ku.
rows.reference: Har ila yau, kayi la'akari da ikon lauya don kudaden ka.

rows.source: You would select a trusted person to make financial decisions for you and ensure your bills get paid if you're incapacitated.
rows.output: Za ku zaɓi mutum mai aminci ya yi muku shawarwari na kuɗi kuma ku tabbatar da cewa an biya kuɗin ku idan kun rasa ikon yin hakan.
rows.reference: Zaka zabi mutum daya da ka yarda da shi don yanke shawara game da kudaden ka da kuma tabbatar da an biya cajin kudade koda bazaka iya biya ba.

rows.source: Don't forget the small details: Imagine that your elderly parent has a medical emergency and is on the way to the hospital.
rows.output: Kar a manta da ƙananan bayanai: Yi tunanin cewa iyayenku na girma suna da gaggawar likita kuma suna kan hanyar zuwa asibiti.
rows.reference: kar ka manta da kananan cikakkun bayanan: Ka yi tunanin cewa iyayen ka tsofaffi su na da cuta mai bukatar taimakon gaggawa kuma su na kan hanyar zuwa asibiti.

rows.source: Would you be able to answer questions on medications and allergies?
rows.output: Za ku iya amsa tambayoyi game da magunguna da rashin lafiyar jiki?
rows.reference: Zaka iya amsa tambayoyi game da magunguna da cututtuka?

rows.source: Spell out those details in a written plan so that you're ready.
rows.output: Fadakar da cikakkun bayanai a cikin wani rubutaccen shiri don haka ku shirya.
rows.reference: Rubuta wadannan cikakkun bayanan a shiryayyen rubutu don ka shirya.

rows.source: "It's not just the financials that are in play, but who are the doctors?" asked Martin.
rows.output: "Ba kawai kudaden da ke tattare da shi ba ne, amma waɗanne likitoci ne?" Martin ya tambaya.
rows.reference: "Ba wai kudi kawai ake magana ba, amma suwaye likitocin?" Martin ya tambaya.

rows.source: "What are the medications?
rows.output: Menene magungunan?
rows.reference: “Menene magungunan?

rows.source: Who will care for the dog?
rows.output: Waɗanne ne za su kula da karen?
rows.reference: Wa zai kula da karen?

rows.source: Have that plan in place."
rows.output: "Yi wannan shirin aiki."
rows.reference: ka samu wannan shirin a rai.”

rows.source: Man shot multiple times with air rifle in Ilfracombe
rows.output: Wani ya harbe shi da bindigar iska a Ilfracombe
rows.reference: An harbe mutum sau da yawa da bindigar iska a Ilfracombe

rows.source: A man has been shot multiple times with an air rifle as he walked home from a night out.
rows.output: Wani mutum ya samu harbin bindiga mai iska da dama yayin da yake tafiya gida daga wani dare.
rows.reference: An harbi wani mutum sau da yawa da bindigar iska yayin da yake tafiya gida daga fitar dare.

rows.source: The victim, in his 40s, was in the Oxford Grove area of Ilfracombe, Devon, when he was shot in the chest, abdomen and hand.
rows.output: Wanda aka azabtar, yana da shekaru arba'in, yana cikin yankin Oxford Grove na Ilfracombe, Devon, lokacin da aka harbe shi a kirji, ciki, da hannu.
rows.reference: Wanda aka harban, yana cikin shekarunsa na 40, yana yankin Oxford Grove din llfracombe, Devon, a yayin da aka harbe shi a kirji, cibiya da hannu.

rows.source: Officers described the shooting, which took place at about 02:30 BST, as a "random act."
rows.output: Jami'an sun bayyana harbin da ya faru da misalin karfe 02:30 na safe, a matsayin "aiki na bazuwar."
rows.reference: Jami’an sun bayyana harbin, wanda ya gudana da misalin 02:30 BST, a matsayin “mai aukuwa akai-akai.”

rows.source: The victim did not see his attacker.
rows.output: Wanda aka azabtar bai ga wanda ya kai masa hari ba.
rows.reference: Wanda aka harban baiga wanda ya harbe shi ba.

rows.source: His injuries are not life-threatening and police have appealed for witnesses.
rows.output: Raunin nasa ba su da hatsarin rayuwa kuma ‘yan sanda sun yi kira ga shaidu.
rows.reference: Raunukan shi ba masu barazana ga rayuwa bane kuma yan sanda na rokon shaidu su fito.

rows.source: Earthquakes and tsunamis in Indonesia
rows.output: Garin da tsunami a Indonesia
rows.reference: Girgizar kasa da tsunamis a Indonesia

rows.source: At least 384 people have been killed by a powerful earthquake and tsunami that hit the Indonesian city of Palu on Friday, officials said, with the death toll expected to rise.
rows.output: Aƙalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu sakamakon wani girgizar ƙasa mai ƙarfi da tsunami da suka afku a birnin Palu na Indonesia a ranar Juma'a, kamar yadda jami'ai suka bayyana, tare da hasashen cewa adadin wadanda suka mutu zai karu.
rows.reference: Akalla mutane 384 ne suka rasa rayukansu sakamakon wani girgizar kasa da tsunami mai tsanani da suka faru a birnin Palu ranar Juma’a, Jami'an suka ce, ana sa ran karuwar waɗanda suka mutu.

rows.source: With communications knocked out, relief officials have not been able to get any information from Donggala regency, an area north of Palu that is closer to the epicenter of the 7.5 magnitude quake.
rows.output: Tare da sadarwa ta karye, jami'an agaji ba su iya samun wani bayani daga gundumar Donggala, wadda ke arewacin Palu, kuma tana kusa da tsakiyar girgizar da ta auna 7.5 a ma'aunin Richter.
rows.reference: Saboda rashin hanyar sadarwa, jami'an tsaro ba su samu kowane bayani daga Donggala regency ba, wani yanki a arewacin Palu wanda ya fi kusa da farfadowar girgizar kasa mai karfin 7.5.

rows.source: In Palu, more than 16,000 people were evacuated after the disaster struck.
rows.output: A cikin Palu, sama da mutane 16,000 aka kwashe bayan bala'in ya afku.
rows.reference: A Palu, an kwashe mutane fiye da 16,000 bayan da bala'in ya fara.

rows.source: Here are some key facts about Palu and Donggala, on the island of Sulawesi:
rows.output: Ga wasu muhimman abubuwan da suka shafi Palu da Donggala, a tsibirin Sulawesi:
rows.reference: Ga wadansu bayanai game da Palu da Donggala, akan tsibirin Sulawesi:

rows.source: Palu is the capital of Central Sulawesi province, located at the end of a narrow bay on the west coast of Sulawesi island, with an estimated population of 379,800 in 2017.
rows.output: Palu babban birnin jihar Tsakiyar Sulawesi ne, yana kusa da karamin tafkin da ke gabar tekun yammacin tsibirin Sulawesi, tare da kiyasin yawan jama'a 379,800 a shekarar 2017.
rows.reference: Palu shi ne babban birnin lardin Sulawesi na tsakiya, wanda yake a ƙarshen bakin teku a yammacin bakin tekun tsibirin Sulawesi, tare da kimanin mutane 379,800 a 2017.

rows.source: The city was celebrating its 40th anniversary when the quake and tsunami hit.
rows.output: Birnin yana bikin cika shekaru arba'in da tashin hankali da ambaliya suka afku.
rows.reference: Birnin yana bikin tunawa da shekaru 40 a lokacin da girgizar kasa da tsunami suka fara.

rows.source: Donggala is a regency stretching along more than 300 km (180 miles) of coastline in the northwest of Sulawesi island.
rows.output: Donggala ƙaramar hukuma ce da ke tafiya a cikin fiye da kilomita 300 (mil 180) na bakin teku a arewa maso yammacin tsibirin Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Donggala wani tsari ne wanda ke tafiya fiye da kilomita 300 (kilomita 180) na bakin teku a arewa maso yammacin tsibirin Sulawesi.

rows.source: The regency, an administrative region below a province, had an estimated population of 299,200 in 2017.
rows.output: Mutanen da ke karkashin mulkin mallaka, wani yanki na gudanarwa a kasa da lardin, sun yi hasashen yawan jama'a 299,200 a shekarar 2017.
rows.reference: Tsarin mulki, wani yanki na kasa da ke ƙasa a lardin, nada kimanin mutane 299,200 a shekarar 2017.

rows.source: Fishing and farming are the mainstays of the Central Sulawesi province's economy, especially the coastal region of Donggala.
rows.output: Kamun kifi da noma sune manyan abubuwan da ke tattare da tattalin arzikin jihar Tsakiyar Sulawesi, musamman yankin bakin teku na Donggala.
rows.reference: su da aikin noma sune ainihin yanayin tattalin arzikin lardin Sulawesi, musamman ma yankunan bakin teku na Donggala.

rows.source: Nickel mining is also important in the province, but is mostly concentrated in Morowali, on the opposite coast of Sulawesi.
rows.output: Hanyar nickel ma tana da muhimmanci a lardin, amma galibi tana mai da hankali ne a Morowali, a gefen daya na Sulawesi.
rows.reference: Nickel mining ma yana da mahimmanci a lardin, amma mafi yawa ya fi mayar da hankali ne a Morowali, a gefen kudancin Sulawesi.

rows.source: Palu and Donggala have been hit by tsunamis several times in the past 100 years, according to Indonesia's Disaster Mitigation Agency.
rows.output: Palu da Donggala sun fuskanci ambaliyar ruwa da dama a cikin shekaru 100 da suka gabata, a cewar hukumar kula da bala'i ta kasar Indonesia.
rows.reference: Paman da Donggala sun sha samun aukuwar tsunamis a cikin shekaru 100 da suka gabata, in ji kamfanin Indonesia's Disaster Mitigation.

rows.source: In 1938, a tsunami killed more than 200 people and destroyed hundreds of houses in Donggala.
rows.output: A shekarar 1938, wata igiyar ruwa ta kashe sama da mutane 200, kuma ta lalata gidaje sama da ɗari a Donggala.
rows.reference: A 1938, tsunami ya kashe mutane fiye da 200 kuma ya hallaka daruruwan gidaje a Donggala.

rows.source: A tsunami also struck western Donggala in 1996, killing nine.
rows.output: Wani tsunami ya kuma afku a gabashin Donggala a shekarar 1996, inda ya kashe mutane tara.
rows.reference: Wani tsunami kuma ya bugi yammacin Donggala a shekarar 1996, ya kashe mutane tara.

rows.source: Indonesia sits on the seismically Pacific Ring of Fire and is regularly hit by earthquakes.
rows.output: Indonesia tana kan wutar lantarki ta Pacific Ring of Fire kuma akai-akai ana afkawa da girgizar kasa.
rows.reference: Indonesia na zaune a kan tsaunuka na Pacific Ring na Wuta kuma girgizar kasa na yawan samunsu.

rows.source: Here are some of the major quakes and tsunamis in recent years:
rows.output: Ga wasu daga cikin manyan girgizar kasa da tsunami a cikin shekarun nan:
rows.reference: Ga wasu manyan girgizar ƙasa da tsunami a cikin 'yan shekarun nan:

rows.source: 2004: A major quake on the western coast of Indonesia's Aceh province in northern Sumatra on Dec. 26 triggered a tsunami that struck 14 countries, killing 226,000 people along Indian Ocean coastline, more than half of them in Aceh.
rows.output: 2004: Wani babban girgizar kasa a gabar tekun yammacin kasar Indonesia ta Aceh a arewa maso yammacin Sumatra a ranar 26 ga watan Disamba ta haifar da wani tsunami da ya afkawa kasashe 14, wanda ya yi sanadin mutuwar mutane 226,000 a gabar tekun Tekun Indiya, fiye da rabin wadanda suka mutu a Aceh.
rows.reference: 2004: Babban girgizar kasa a yammacin tekun Aceh dake arewacin Sumatra a ranar 26 ga Disamban bara ya haifar da tsunami wanda ya shafi kasashe 14, inda ya kashe mutane 226,000 a bakin tekun Indiya, fiye da rabin su a Aceh.

rows.source: 2005: A series of strong quakes hit the western coast of Sumatra in late March and early April.
rows.output: 2005: An tara girgizar kasa ta afku a gabar tekun yammacin Sumatra a karshen Maris da farkon Afrilu.
rows.reference: 2005: Jerin girgizar kasa ya faru a yammacin tsibirin Sumatra a cikin karshen Maris da farkon Afrilu.

rows.source: Hundreds died in Nias Island, off the coast of Sumatra.
rows.output: Miliyoyin mutane sun mutu a tsibirin Nias, a gabar tekun Sumatra.
rows.reference: Daruruwa sun mutu a tsibirin Nias, a bakin tekun Sumatra.

rows.source: 2006: A 6.8 magnitude hit south of Java, Indonesia's most populated island, triggering a tsunami that smashed into the southern coast, killing nearly 700 people.
rows.output: 2006: Wani girgizar kasa mai girman 6.8 a kudu da Java, mafi yawan yankin da ke cikin Indonesia, ya haifar da wani tsunami da ya lalata bakin tekun kudu, inda ya kashe mutane kusan 700.
rows.reference: 2006: Girman 6.8 auku a kudancin Java, tsibirin da yafi kowanne cika a Indonesia, wanda ya haifar da tsunami wanda ya shiga har kudancin bakin teku, inda ya kashe kusan mutane 700.

rows.source: 2009: A 7.6 magnitude quake struck near the city of Padang, capital of West Sumatra province.
rows.output: 2009: Wani girgizar kasa mai girman 7.6 ya afku kusa da birnin Padang, babban birnin jihar West Sumatra.
rows.reference: 2009: Girgizar kasa mai girma ta 7.6 ta auku a kusa da birnin Padang, babban birnin lardin yammacin Sumatra.

rows.source: More than 1,100 people were killed.
rows.output: Fiye da mutane 1,100 sun mutu.
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane 1,100 aka kashe.

rows.source: 2010: A 7.5 magnitude quake hit one of the Mentawai islands, off Sumatra, triggering up tsunami of up to 10 meters that destroyed dozens of villages and killed around 300 people.
rows.output: 2010: Wani girgizar kasa mai girman 7.5 ya afku a daya daga cikin tsibiran Mentawai, a gabashin Sumatra, wanda ya haifar da wani tsunami na kimanin mita 10 wanda ya lalata guraren kauyuka da dama kuma ya kashe kusan mutane 300.
rows.reference: 2010: Girgizar kasa mai girma ta 7.5 ta auku a daya daga cikin tsibirin Mentawai, daga Sumatra, inda ta haifar da tsunami har zuwa mita 10 da suka lalata kananan garuruwa masu yawa kuma suka kashe kimanin mutane 300.

rows.source: 2016: A shallow quake hit the Pidie Jaya regency in Aceh, causing destruction and panic as people were reminded by the devastation of the deadly 2004 quake and tsunami.
rows.output: 2016: Wani raƙuman girgizar ƙasa ya afku a yankin Pidie Jaya a Aceh, wanda ya haifar da barna da fargaba yayin da mutane suka tuna da lalacewar da aka yi a shekarar 2004 mai kisa da tsunami.
rows.reference: 2016: Wani mummunan girgizar kasa ya auku a yankin Pidie Jaya a Aceh, ya haddasa rugurgujewar abubuwa da tsoro yayin da aka tunatar da mutane game da mummunan girgizar kasa da tsunami da ta auku a 2004.

rows.source: No tsunami was triggered this time, but more than 100 were killed by fallen buildings.
rows.output: Ba a haifar da wani tsunami ba a wannan karon, amma sama da 100 ne suka mutu sakamakon rugujewar gine-gine.
rows.reference: Ba a sami tsunami ba a wannan lokaci, amma fiye da mutane 100 suka mutu sakamakon gine-ginen da suka fadi.

rows.source: 2018: Major quakes hit Indonesia's tourist island of Lombok, killing more than 500 people, mostly on the northern side of the island.
rows.output: 2018: An kwashe manyan girgizar kasa a tsibirin Lombok na yawon bude ido na Indonesia, wanda ya yi sanadin mutuwar mutane sama da 500, musamman a gefen arewa na tsibirin.
rows.reference: 2018: Babban girgizar kasar ya auku a tsibirin Lombok dake Indonesiya, inda ya kashe mutane sama da 500, mafi yawa a arewacin tsibirin.

rows.source: The quake destroyed thousands of buildings and left thousands of tourists temporarily stranded.
rows.output: Garin ya lalata dubban gine-gine kuma ya bar dubban masu yawon bude ido a cikin wani yanayi na wucin gadi.
rows.reference: Girgizar ta ruguza dubban gine-gine kuma ta bar dubban masu 'yan yawon bude ido cikin wani hali na dan lokaci.

rows.source: Sarah Palin's Eldest Son Arrested on Domestic Violence Charges
rows.output: An kama ɗan Sarah Palin da laifin cin zarafin gida.
rows.reference: An kama babban dan Sarah Palin kan tuhumar rikicin cikin gida

rows.source: Track Palin, the eldest son of former Alaska governor and vice presidential candidate Sarah Palin, has been arrested on assault charges.
rows.output: An kama Track Palin, babban ɗan tsohon gwamnan Alaska kuma dan takarar mataimakin shugaban ƙasa Sarah Palin, bisa laifin cin zarafi.
rows.reference: Track Palin, babban dan tsohon gwanan Alaska kuma mataimakin shugaban dan takara Sarah Palin, an kama shi kan tuhumar cin zarafi.

rows.source: Palin, 29, of Wasilla, Alaska, was arrested on suspicion of domestic violence, interfering with a report of domestic violence and resisting arrest, according to a report released Saturday by Alaska State Troopers.
rows.output: An kama Palin, mai shekaru 29, daga Wasilla, Alaska, bisa zargin cin zarafin gida, hana bayar da rahoton cin zarafin gida, da kuma kin amsa, a cewar wani rahoto da aka fitar a ranar Asabar da jami'an tsaron jihar Alaska suka fitar.
rows.reference: An kama Palin, mai shekaru 29, na Wasilla, Alaska, kan zargin da ake yi na tada hankalin cikin gida, tare da yin katsalandan ga rahotannin tada hankali cikin gida da, a cewar wani rahoton da Alaska State Troopers ta fitar, a ranar Asabar.

rows.source: According to the police report, when a female acquaintance attempted to call police to report the alleged crimes, he took her phone from her.
rows.output: Bisa ga rahoton ‘yan sanda, lokacin da wata abokiyar zama ta yi yunkurin kiran ‘yan sanda domin ta kai rahoton laifukan da ake zarginsa da aikatawa, sai ta kwace mata wayar.
rows.reference: A cewar rahoton 'yan sanda, idan wata mata tayi kokarin ta kira' yan sanda don bayar da rahoton laifukan da ake zargin, sai ya dauki wayarta daga gareta

rows.source: Palin is being remanded in Mat-Su Pretrial Facility and is being held on a $500 unsecured bond, reported KTUU.
rows.output: An tsare Palin a Cibiyar Pretrial ta Mat-Su kuma ana tsare da ita akan kudi $500 ba tare da tsarewa ba, kamar yadda aka ruwaito da KSTUU.
rows.reference: An sa Palin a cikin Mat-Su Pretrial Facility kuma ana gudanar da shi a kan yarjejeniyar takardar alkawali na $500, in ji KTUU.

rows.source: He appeared in court Saturday, where he declared himself "not guilty, for sure" when asked his plea, reported the network.
rows.output: Ya bayyana a kotu a ranar Asabar, inda ya bayyana kansa a matsayin “ba da laifi, tabbas” lokacin da aka tambaye shi da laifi, kamar yadda hukumar ta bayar da rahoto.
rows.reference: Ya bayyana a kotu a ranar Asabar, inda ya bayyana kansa "ba laifi ba, a gaskiya" lokacin da aka neme shi, ruwaitowar cibiyar sadarwa.

rows.source: Palin faces three Class A misdemeanours, meaning he could be imprisoned for up to a year and fined $250,000.
rows.output: Palin yana fuskantar laifuka uku na aji A, ma'ana zai iya samun daurin shekara guda da kuma tarar dala 250,000.
rows.reference: Palin yana fuskantar nau'o'i uku na Aji na, ma'ana zai iya tsare shi har zuwa shekara guda kuma ya biya $ 250,000.

rows.source: He has also been charged with a Class B misdemeanour, punishable by a day in jail and a $2,000 fine.
rows.output: An kuma tuhume shi da laifin cin zarafi na aji B, wanda zai iya kaiwa ga kwana daya a gidan yari da tarar dala 2,000.
rows.reference: Ana kuma tuhuma shi da wani mummunan lakabi na Ajin B, wanda hukunci shi ne ya je kurkuku na rana guda da kuma tarar $2,000.

rows.source: It is not the first time criminal charges have been filed against Palin.
rows.output: Ba a karon farko ba ne ake tuhumar Palin da laifin aikata laifi.
rows.reference: Ba shi ne karo na farko da aka gurfanar da Palin ba akan mayan laifuka.

rows.source: In December 2017, he was accused of assaulting his father, Todd Palin.
rows.output: A watan Disamba 2017, an zarge shi da cin zarafin mahaifinsa, Todd Palin.
rows.reference: A watan Disamba na shekara ta 2017, an zarge shi da kisa ga mahaifinsa, Todd Palin.

rows.source: His mother, Sarah Palin, called police to report the alleged attack.
rows.output: Mahaifiyarsa, Sarah Palin, ta kira ‘yan sanda domin bayar da rahoton harin da ake zarginsa da shi.
rows.reference: Mahaifiyarsa, Sarah Palin, ta kira 'yan sanda don bayar da rahoto game da harin.

rows.source: The case is currently before Alaska's Veteran's Court.
rows.output: Yanzu harkar tana cikin Kotun Alaska ta Tsofaffi.
rows.reference: Shari’ar tana gaban Kotun Tsohon Kotun Alaska a yanzu haka.

rows.source: In January 2016 he was charged with domestic assault, interfering with the report of a domestic violence crime, and possessing a weapon while intoxicated in connection with the incident.
rows.output: A watan Janairun 2016, an tuhume shi da cin zarafin gida, kawo cikas ga rahoton laifin tashin hankali, da kuma mallakar makami yayin shan giya, a cikin alakar lamarin.
rows.reference: A watan Janairu 2016 an zargi shi da aikata laifuka na gida, da rikici da rahoto game da aikata ta'addanci a cikin gida, da kuma samun makamin yayin da yake cike da haɗari dangane da wannan lamarin.

rows.source: His girlfriend had alleged that he punched her in the face.
rows.output: An zarge shi da ya buga matarsa ​​a fuska.
rows.reference: Budurwar shi ta yi zargin cewa ya doke ta a fuska.

rows.source: Sarah Palin was criticised by veterans groups in 2016 after linking her son's violent behaviour to PTSD stemming from his service in Iraq.
rows.output: An yi wa Sarah Palin suka daga kungiyoyin tsofaffin sojoji a shekarar 2016 bayan da ta danganta halin tashin hankali na dansa da ciwon PTSD da ya samo asali daga hidimar da ya yi a Iraki.
rows.reference: An soki Sarah Palin a lamarin ta hanyar kungiyoyin tsofaffin soja a shekara ta 2016 bayan ya haɗu da halayyar danginta ga PTSD daga aikinsa a Iraki.

rows.source: Indonesia earthquake tsunami: hundreds killed
rows.output: Bala'in girgizar kasa da ambaliyar ruwa a kasar Indonesia: an kashe mutane da dama
rows.reference: Girgizar kasar Indonesia ta tsunami: daruruwa sun mutu

rows.source: At least 384 people have died after an earthquake hit the Indonesian island of Sulawesi on Friday.
rows.output: Aƙalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu bayan wata girgizar ƙasa ta afku a tsibirin Sulawesi na Indonesia a ranar Juma'a.
rows.reference: Akalla mutane 384 ne suka mutu bayan girgizar kasa ta mamaye tsibirin Sulawesi a Indonesia a ranar Juma’a.

rows.source: The 7.5-magnitude earthquake triggered a tsunami and has destroyed thousands of homes.
rows.output: Girgizar kasa mai karfin awo 7.5 ta haifar da ambaliya kuma ta lalata dubban gidaje.
rows.reference: Girgizar kasa mai magnitude 7.5 ya haifar da tsunami kuma ya rushe dubban gidajen.

rows.source: Electricity and communication networks are down with death tolls expected to rise in coming days.
rows.output: Hanyoyin wutar lantarki da sadarwa sun yi kasa da mutuwar da ake sa ran za ta karu a cikin 'yan kwanaki masu zuwa.
rows.reference: Harkokin lantarki da sadarwar sun lalace tare da tsammani karin matattu za' tashi a cikin kwanaki masu zuwa.

rows.source: The earthquake hit just off central Sulawesi which is northeast of the Indonesian capital, Jakarta.
rows.output: Garin girgizar kasa ya afku ne a gabashin tsakiyar Sulawesi, wanda ke arewa da babban birnin kasar, Jakarta.
rows.reference: Girgizar ta fara ne kawai daga tsakiyar Sulawesi wanda ke arewa maso gabashin kasar Indonesia, Jakarta.

rows.source: Videos are circulating on social media showing the moment of impact.
rows.output: Ana yada bidiyo a shafukan sada zumunta da ke nuna lokacin da aka yi hadari.
rows.reference: Bidio na ta yawu a shafukan watsa labarai na nuna lokacin tasiri.

rows.source: Hundreds of people had gathered for a beach festival in the city of Palu when the tsunami smashed on shore.
rows.output: Dubban mutane sun taru domin bikin bakin teku a cikin birnin Palu sa’ad da igiyar ruwan ta afkawa gabar teku.
rows.reference: Daruruwan mutane sun taru don bikin rairayin bakin teku a birnin Palu lokacin da tsunami ya rushe a bakin tekun.

rows.source: Federal prosecutors seeking rare death penalty for NYC terror attack suspect
rows.output: Wani lauya na gwamnati ya nemi hukuncin kisa mai tsanani ga wanda ake zargi da kai harin ta'addanci a birnin New York.
rows.reference: Masu gabatar da kara na tarayya na neman hukuncin kisa na kisa ga dan ta’adda NYC

rows.source: Federal prosecutors in New York are seeking the death penalty for Sayfullo Saipov, the suspect in the New York City terror attack that killed eight people -- a rare punishment that hasn't been carried out in the state for a federal crime since 1953.
rows.output: An kama wanda ake zargin da laifin kai harin ta'addanci a birnin New York, Sayfullo Saipov, kuma masu gabatar da kara na tarayya a birnin New York na neman hukuncin kisa. Wannan hukuncin kisa na karshe ne da aka yi a jihar saboda wani laifi na tarayya tun 1953.
rows.reference: Masu gabatar da kara na tarayya a birnin New York suna neman hukuncin kisa ga Sayfullo Saipov, wanda ake zargin a harin da ya faru a birnin New York, wanda ya kashe mutane takwas - hukuncin da ba a yi ba a jihar don aikata laifukan tarayya tun shekara ta 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, 30, allegedly used a Home Depot rental truck to carry out an attack on a bike path along the West Side Highway in Lower Manhattan, mowing down pedestrians and cyclist in his path on Oct.
rows.output: Saipov, 30, ya yi ikirarin amfani da wata motar haya ta Home Depot wajen kai hari kan hanyar keke a gefen West Side a Lower Manhattan, inda ya yi ta shawagi kan masu tafiya a kasa da kuma masu tafiya a kan babura a cikin hanyarsa a watan Oktoba.
rows.reference: Saipov, mai shekaru 30, ya yi amfani da motoci mai hawa na gida domin gudanar da hare-haren kan hanyar machine da ta hanyar West Side Highway a Lower Manhattan, inda ya kaddamar akan masu tafiya a kafa da kekuna a hanyarsa a watan Oktoba.

rows.source: In order to justify a death sentence, prosecutors will have to prove that Saipov "intentionally" killed the eight victims and "intentionally" inflicted serious bodily injury, according to the notice of intent to seek the death penalty, filed in the Southern District of New York.
rows.output: Don tabbatar da hukuncin kisa, masu gabatar da kara za su bukaci tabbatar da cewa Saipov "da gangan" ya kashe wadanda abin ya shafa takwas da "da gangan" ya jawo musu munanan raunuka, bisa ga sanarwar niyyar neman hukuncin kisa, da aka mika a yankin Kudu na New York.
rows.reference: Don tabbatar da hukuncin kisa, masu gabatar da kara za su tabbatar da cewa Saipov "da gangan" ya kashe mutane takwas da "ganganci" ya jawo mummunan rauni a jiki, bisa ga sanarwar na neman hukuncin kisa, aka a yankin Kudancin Sabon Gundumar New York.

rows.source: Both of those counts carry a possibly death sentence, according to the court document.
rows.output: Dukkan wadannan tuhume-tuhumen na iya haifar da hukuncin kisa, a cewar takardar kotun.
rows.reference: Dukkan waɗanda nan la'akari su na da hukuncin kisa, bisa ga takardun kotu.

rows.source: Weeks after the attack, a federal grand jury slapped Saipov with a 22-count indictment that included eight charges of murder in aid of racketeering, typically used by federal prosecutors in organized crime cases, and a charge of violence and destruction of motor vehicles.
rows.output: Bayan harin, wata kotun tarayya ta sanya Saipov a gaban kotu da laifuffuka 22 da suka hada da tuhume-tuhume takwas na kisan kai da aka yi da gangan, wanda galibi masu gabatar da kara na tarayya ke amfani da su a shari’o’in laifukan kungiyoyi, da kuma tuhume-tuhume na tashin hankali da lalata motoci.
rows.reference: Makonni bayan harin, babban kotun tarayya ta maka wa Saipov zarge-zarge 22 da suka hada da laifuffuka guda takwas na kisan kai don taimakon rashin gaskiya, yawanci sune masu gabatar da kara ke yi a laifukan shiryeyyen laifi, da kuma cajin tashin hankali da halakar da motoci.

rows.source: The attack required "substantial planning and premeditation," prosecutors said, describing the manner in which Saipov carried it out as "heinous, cruel and depraved."
rows.output: An yi wa Saipov tuhume-tuhume da dama, wadanda suka hada da kisan kai, yunkurin kisan kai, da kuma yin amfani da makami mai hadari, in ji masu gabatar da kara.
rows.reference: Wannan harin ya bukaci "tsarawa mai mahimmanci da kaddamarwa," in ji masu gabatar da kara, inda ya bayyana irin yadda Saipov ya dauki shi a matsayin "mai mugunta, mummunan hali da kuma marar sa tausayi."

rows.source: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov caused injury, harm, and loss to the families and friends of Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, and Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," the notice of intent states.
rows.output: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov ya haifar da rauni, cutarwa, da asarar dangi da abokai na Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, da Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," sanarwar nufin ta bayyana.
rows.reference: "Sayfullo Habibullaevic Saipov ya haifar da rauni, cuta, da hasara ga iyalai da abokai Diego Enrique Angelini, Nicholas Cleves, Ann-Laure Decadt, Darren Drake, Ariel Erlij, Hernan Ferruchi, Hernan Diego Mendoza, da Alejandro Damian Pagnucco," sanarwa na niyyar jihohi.

rows.source: Five of the victims were tourists from Argentina.
rows.output: Bakwai daga cikin wadanda abin ya shafa suna da alaka da yawon bude ido daga Argentina.
rows.reference: Biyar daga cikin waɗanda aka kashe 'yan yawon bude ido daga Argentina

rows.source: It has been a decade since the Southern District of New York last prosecuted a death penalty case.
rows.output: Shekaru goma kenan da yankin Kudu na New York ya yi shari'ar hukuncin kisa.
rows.reference: An yi shekaru goma tun lokacin da yankin kudancin New York ya kaddamar da hukuncin kisa.

rows.source: The defendant, Khalid Barnes, was convicted of murdering two drug suppliers but was ultimately sentenced to life in prison in September 2009.
rows.output: An same su ne Khalid Barnes, wanda aka samu da laifin kashe mutane biyu da ke sayar da miyagun kwayoyi, kuma a karshe an yanke masa hukuncin daurin rai da rai a watan Satumban 2009.
rows.reference: Wanda aka gurfanar da shi, Khalid Barnes, an yanke masa hukunci ne game da kashe masu raba kwaya biyu, amma an yanke masa hukuncin kisa a watan Satumba na 2009.

rows.source: The last time the death penalty was carried out in a New York federal case was in 1953 for Julius and Ethel Rosenberg, a married couple executed after they were convicted of conspiracy to commit espionage for the Soviet Union during the Cold War two years before.
rows.output: Mafi girman lokacin da aka yi wa hukuncin kisa a shari'ar tarayya ta New York shine a shekarar 1953 ga Julius da Ethel Rosenberg, ma'auratan da aka yanke wa hukuncin kisa bayan da aka yanke musu hukuncin kisa kan hada baki da aikata laifuka ga Tarayyar Soviet a lokacin yakin cacar baka shekaru biyu kafin.
rows.reference: karshen a lokacin da aka yanke hukuncin kisa a tarayya New York a 1953 ga Julius da Ethel Rosenberg, ma'aurata bayan da aka yanke musu hukuncin kulla makirci don Tarayyar Soviet a lokacin Yakin Tsana shekaru biyu da suka gabata.

rows.source: Both Rosenbergs were both put to death by the electric chair on June 19, 1953.
rows.output: Dukkanin Rosenbergs an kashe su ne ta hanyar kujerar lantarki a ranar 19 ga watan Yuni, 1953.
rows.reference: Dukansu Rosenbergs sun mutu ne ta hanyar kujerar lantarki ranar 19 ga Yuni, 1953.

rows.source: Saipov, a native of Uzbekistan, demonstrated a lack of remorse in the days and months following the attack, according to court documents.
rows.output: Saipov, wanda ya fito daga Uzbekistan, bai nuna nadama ba a cikin kwanaki da watanni bayan harin, a cewar takardun kotu.
rows.reference: Saipov, dan kasar Uzbekistan, ya nuna rashin tausayi a cikin kwanaki da watanni bayan harin, bisa ga takardun kotu.

rows.source: He stated to investigators that he felt good about what he had done, police said.
rows.output: Ya gaya wa masu bincike cewa yana jin dadi game da abin da ya yi, a cewar ‘yan sanda.
rows.reference: Ya bayyana wa masu binciken cewa ya jin daɗin abin da ya yi, 'yan sanda sun ce.

rows.source: Saipov told authorities he was inspired to carry out the attack after watching ISIS videos on his phone, according to the indictment.
rows.output: An gaya wa hukumomi cewa Saipov ya samu kwarin guiwa ya aiwatar da harin bayan ya kalli bidiyon ISIS a wayarsa, bisa ga tuhumar.
rows.reference: Saipov ya shaida wa hukumomin da cewa ya samu kwarin guiwa bayan gudanar da harin bayan ya duba bidiyon ISIS a wayarsa, bisa ga zargin.

rows.source: He also requested to display the ISIS flag in his hospital room, police said.
rows.output: Ya kuma nemi a nuna tutarsa ta ISIS a dakin sa na asibiti, a cewar ‘yan sanda.
rows.reference: Har ila yau, ya bukaci a nuna tutar Isis a cikin dakin asibiti, in ji 'yan sanda.

rows.source: He has pleaded not guilty to the 22-count indictment.
rows.output: Ya amsa laifin tuhume-tuhume 22 da aka tuhume shi da shi.
rows.reference: Ya yi zargin ba shi da laifi ga tuhuma 22 na zargin.

rows.source: David Patton, one of the federal public defenders representing Saipov, said they are "obviously disappointed" with the prosecution's decision.
rows.output: David Patton, ɗaya daga cikin lauyoyin jama'ar tarayya da ke wakiltar Saipov, ya bayyana cewa "a fili suna jin kunya" da shawarar tuhumar.
rows.reference: David Patton, daya daga cikin masu kare hakkin jama'a na tarayya a jihar Saipov, ya ce su na da "takaici" tare da yanke shawara.

rows.source: "We think the decision to seek the death penalty rather than accepting a guilty plea to life in prison with no possibility of release will only prolong the trauma of these events for everyone involved," Patton said.
rows.output: "Muna ganin shawarar neman hukuncin kisa maimakon amincewa da laifi da rayuwa a gidan yari ba tare da yiwuwar sakin sa ba, zai kara tsawaita radadin wadannan abubuwan ga kowa da kowa," in ji Patton.
rows.reference: "Mu na tsammanin shawarar da za a nemi hukuncin kisa maimakon karɓar laifin mai laifi zuwa rai a kurkuku ba tare da yiwuwar saki ba zai shawo kan matsalolin abubuwan da ke faruwa ga kowa da kowa", inji Patton.

rows.source: Saipov's defense team had previously asked prosecutors not to seek the death penalty.
rows.output: Kungiyar lauyoyin Saipov sun nemi a baya daga masu gabatar da kara kada su nemi hukuncin kisa.
rows.reference: Lauyoyi masu kare Saipov sun nemi masu gabatar da kara kada su nemi hukuncin kisa.

rows.source: Tory MP says NIGEL FARAGE should be put in charge of Brexit negotiations
rows.output: Wani dan majalisar dokokin Tory ya ce ya kamata a ba NIGEL FARAGE gudanar da tattaunawar ficewa daga Turai
rows.reference: Tory MP ya ce NIGEL FARAGE ya kamata a kula da tattaunawar Brexit

rows.source: Nigel Farage vowed to 'mobilise the people's army' today during a protest at the Tory conference.
rows.output: Nigel Farage ya yi alkawarin "mobilise da jama'a" a yau yayin zanga-zangar da aka yi a taron jam'iyyar Tory.
rows.reference: Nigel Farage ya yi alwashin yin 'yan tawaye a yau yayin zanga-zanga a taron Tory.

rows.source: The former Ukip leader said politicians had to 'feel the heat' from Eurosceptics - as one of Theresa May's own MPs suggested he should be in charge of negotiations with the EU.
rows.output: Tsohon shugaban jam'iyyar Ukip ya ce 'yan siyasa suna bukatar su "ji zafi" daga masu adawa da Tarayyar Turai - kamar daya daga cikin 'yan majalisar Theresa May ya ba da shawarar ya zama shugaban tattaunawar da za a yi da EU.
rows.reference: Tsohon shugaban Ukip ya ce 'yan siyasar sun' ji zafi 'daga' yan kasuwa na Eurosceptics - kamar yadda daya daga cikin wakilai na Theresa May ta ba da shawara cewa ya kamata tayi la'akari da tattaunawar da EU.

rows.source: Conservative backbencher Peter Bone told the march in Birmingham that the UK 'would have been out' by now if Mr Farage was Brexit Secretary.
rows.output: Dan jam'iyyar Conservative Peter Bone ya gaya wa tseren a Birmingham cewa, Birtaniya za ta kasance a waje da yanzu idan Mista Farage ya kasance Sakataren Brexit.
rows.reference: Wani mai goyon baya na baya-bayan nan, Peter Bone, ya shaida wa manema labaru a Birmingham cewa Birtaniya za ta fita daga yanzu idan Mr Farage ya zama Sakatare Brexit.

rows.source: But the challenge Mrs May faces in reconciling her deeply divided ranks has been underlined by pro-Remain Tories joining a separate protest against Brexit in the city.
rows.output: Amma kalubalen da Mrs May ke fuskanta wajen daidaita bangarorinta masu rikitarwa, ya samu karin haske ta hanyar ‘yan jam’iyyar Tory masu goyon bayan ci gaba da shiga zanga-zangar daban-daban kan ficewar Birtaniya daga kungiyar Tarayyar Turai a birnin.
rows.reference: Amma ƙalubalen da Mrs May ta fuskanta wajen sulhu da ragamar da aka yi a tsakanin bangarori daban-daban da aka yi sun nuna cewa, Pro-Remain Tories na shiga cikin rashin amincewa da Brexit a birnin.

rows.source: The premier is struggling to keep her Chequers compromise plan on track amid attacks from Brexiteers, Remainers and the EU.
rows.output: Firaministan na fama da kiyaye shirin sulhu na Chequers a kan hanya, a cikin hare-haren da masu goyon bayan Brexit, masu adawa da shi, da kuma EU.
rows.reference: Fremiya na fama da matsalolin kulawa da masu bincikenta sunyi shiri akan hanya a cikin hare-hare daga Brexiteers, Remainers da EU.

rows.source: Allies insisted she will push ahead with trying to strike a deal with Brussels despite the backlash - and force Eurosceptics and Labour to choose between her package and 'chaos'.
rows.output: Abokan tarayya sun dage cewa za ta ci gaba da kokarin cin nasara a yarjejeniyar da za ta yi da Brussels duk da koma bayan da aka samu, tare da tilasta wa masu shakku da kuma jam'iyyar Labour su zabi tsakanin kunshin ta da 'rashin tsari'.
rows.reference: Abokai sun dage cewa ta tura gaba tare da ƙoƙarina buga yarjejeniyar tare da Brussels duk da sakamakon - kuma ta tilasta yan Turai da Labour don su zabi tsakaninta da 'rudani'.

rows.source: Mr Bone told the Leave Means Leave rally in Solihull that he wanted to 'chuck Chequers'.
rows.output: Mista Bone ya gaya wa taron Leave Means Leave a Solihull cewa yana son "jefar da Chequers".
rows.reference: Mista Bone ya shaida wa kamfanin dillancin labaran AFP cewa, yana son 'duba' 'Masu binciken'.

rows.source: He suggested Mr Farage should have been made a peer and given responsibility for negotiations with Brussels.
rows.output: Ya ba da shawarar cewa ya kamata a yi Mista Farage a matsayin dan takarar kujerar majalisar dattawa kuma a ba shi alhakin tattaunawa da Brussels.
rows.reference: Ya ba da shawarar cewa Mr Farage ya kamata ya zama dan takara kuma ya ba da alhakin tattaunawar da Brussels.

rows.source: 'If he had been in charge, we would have been out by now,' he said.
rows.output: 'Idan ya yi mulki, da mun fita tuni,' ya ce.
rows.reference: "In da ya kasance mai kula, da yanzu mun fita," in ji shi.

rows.source: The Wellingborough MP added: 'I will stand up for Brexit but we need to chuck Chequers.'
rows.output: Mai wakiltar mazabar Wellingborough ya ce: 'Zan tsaya tsayin daka kan Brexit amma muna bukatar mu kawar da Chequers.'
rows.reference: The Wellingborough MP ya kara: 'Zan tsaya a kan Brexit amma mu na buƙatar mu duba masu bincike.'

rows.source: Setting out his opposition to the EU, he said: 'We didn't fight world wars to be subservient.
rows.output: Yayin da yake bayyana adawa da EU, ya ce: "Ba mu yi yaƙi da yaki na duniya don zama masu biyayya ba.
rows.reference: Da yake nuna adawa da EU, ya ce: 'Ba mu yi yaƙe-yaƙe na duniya ba don mu zama kaskantattu.

rows.source: We want to make our own laws in our own country.'
rows.output: Muna son yin dokokinmu da kanmu a kasarmu.
rows.reference: Mu na son yin dokokinmu a ƙasar mu.’'

rows.source: Mr Bone dismissed suggestions that public opinion had changed since the 2016 vote: 'The idea that the British people have changed their minds and want to remain is completely untrue.'
rows.output: Mista Bone ya yi watsi da shawarwarin cewa ra'ayin jama'a ya canza tun bayan zaben 2016: "Ra'ayin cewa mutanen Birtaniya sun canza ra'ayinsu kuma suna son zama cikin kasar Birtaniya ba gaskiya ba ne."
rows.reference: Mr Bone ya yi watsi da cewa shawarwarin da ra'ayoyin jama'a sun canja tun lokacin zaben 2016: 'Da ra'ayin cewa mutanen Birtaniya sun canza tunaninsu kuma su na so su kasance ba daidai ba ne.'

rows.source: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns was also at the march, telling reporters: 'I am simply saying: Prime Minister, listen to the people.
rows.output: Dan jam'iyyar Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns ya kasance a cikin tseren, yana gaya maniyyata: 'Ina cewa kawai: Firayim Minista, saurari mutane.
rows.reference: Tory Brexiteer Andrea Jenkyns ya kasance a cikin tafiyar, yana mai ba da rahotanni: ‘Ina cewa kawai: Frem minister ya saurari mutane.

rows.source: 'Chequers is unpopular with the general public, the Opposition's not going to vote for it, it's unpopular with our party and our activists who actually pound the streets and get us elected in the first place.
rows.output: 'Chequers ba ta da shahara a tsakanin jama'a, jam'iyyar adawa ba za ta zabe ta ba, ba ta da shahara a cikin jam'iyyarmu da masu fafutuka wadanda a zahiri ke tafiya a kan tituna da samun mu zabe a farko.
rows.reference: 'Masu bincike ba su da tsaurin ra'ayi tare da jama'a, da' Yan adawa ba za su yi zabe ba, ba tare da jam'iyyarmu da 'yan gwagwarmayarmu ba, waɗanda suka lalata tituna kuma suka sa mu zaɓa tun a farkon.

rows.source: Please drop Chequers and start listening.'
rows.output: Don Allah ku jefar da Chequers kuma ku fara saurare.
rows.reference: Don Allah sauke Masu bincike kuma ka fara sauraro.'

rows.source: In a pointed message to Mrs May, she added: 'Prime ministers keep their jobs when they keep their promises.'
rows.output: A cikin saƙon da aka nuna ga Mrs May, ta ƙara da cewa: 'Firayim Ministan suna riƙe mukamansu lokacin da suke riƙe alkawuran da suka yi.'
rows.reference: A cikin sakon da aka nuna wa Mrs May, ta kara da cewa: 'Firaim Ministocin su na ci gaba da aikin su idan sun kiyaye alkawuransu.'

rows.source: Mr Farage told the rally politicians must be made to 'feel the heat' if they were about to betray the decision made in the 2016 referendum.
rows.output: Mista Farage ya gaya wa taron cewa dole ne ‘yan siyasa su ji zafi idan suna shirin cin amanar shawarar da aka yanke a zaben 2016.
rows.reference: Mr Farage ya fadawa 'yan siyasa cewa dole ne' yan siyasar su fara 'jin zafi' idan su na son cin yaudara da aka yi a cikin referendum na 2016.

rows.source: 'This is now about a matter of trust between us - the people - and our political class,' he said.
rows.output: Wannan yanzu game da amincewa ne tsakanin mu - jama'a - da ajin siyasar mu, a cewarsa.
rows.reference: 'Wannan shi ne yanzu game da batun yadda tsakaninmu - mutanen - kuma da 'yan siyasa ', inji shi.

rows.source: 'They are trying to betray Brexit and we are here today to tell them 'we won't let you get away with doing that'.'
rows.output: Suna kokarin yin karya da Brexit kuma muna nan a yau don gaya musu 'ba za mu bar ku ku yi hakan ba'.
rows.reference: 'Suna ƙoƙari su yaudare Brexit kuma mu na nan a yau don mu gaya musu' ba za mu bari ku tafi tare da yin haka ba '.

rows.source: In a message to the enthusiastic crowd he added: 'I want you to make our political class, who are on the verge of betraying Brexit, feel the heat.
rows.output: A cikin sakon da ya aika wa taron da ya cika da kuzari, ya kara da cewa: "Ina so ku sa ajin siyasa, wadanda ke kan gaban yin zagon kasa ga Brexit, su ji zafi.
rows.reference: A cikin sakon zuwa ga taron masu farin ciki sai ya kara da cewa: 'Ina so ku sanya' yan siyasarmu, waɗanda suke kusa da cin amana Brexit, su ji zafi.

rows.source: 'We are mobilising the people's army of this country that gave us victory in Brexit and will never rest until we have become an independent, self-governing, proud United Kingdom.'
rows.output: Muna tattara sojojin jama'a na wannan ƙasa da ta ba mu nasarar Brexit kuma ba za ta huta ba har sai mun zama ƙasar da ta yi nasara, mai cin gashin kanta, mai daraja, United Kingdom.
rows.reference: 'Mu na tattara rundunonin sojoji na wannan kasa wanda ya ba mu nasara a Brexit kuma ba za mu huta ba har sai mun zama masu zaman kansu, mulkin kai, da Alfaharin Britaniya.'

rows.source: Meanwhile, Remainers marched through Birmingham before holding a two-hour rally in the city centre.
rows.output: A halin yanzu, masu ci gaba da kasancewa a cikin Burtaniya sun yi tattaki ta Birmingham kafin su gudanar da wani taron na tsawon sa'o'i biyu a tsakiyar birnin.
rows.reference: A halin yanzu, Remainers ya yi rangadi ta Birmingham kafin ya yi zagaye na sa'oi biyu a tsakiyar birnin

rows.source: A smattering of activists waved Tories Against Brexit banners after the launch of the group this weekend.
rows.output: Ƙungiyar masu fafutuka sun yi ta zagayawa da tutoci na "Tories Against Brexit" bayan ƙaddamar da ƙungiyar a karshen mako.
rows.reference: Rikakken dan gwagwarmaya ya daga kyalen Tories akan Brexit bayan an kaddamar da kungiyar a cikin ranakun hutu.

rows.source: Labour peer Lord Adonis mocked the Conservatives for the security issues they suffered with a party app as the conference opened.
rows.output: An yi wa dan majalisar Labour, Lord Adonis, suka ga jam’iyyar Conservative saboda matsalar tsaro da suka fuskanta da manhajar jam’iyyar a lokacin da aka bude taron.
rows.reference: Dan Labor Lord Adonis ya yi zoloya wa Conservatives game da matsalolin tsaro da suka sha wahala tare da aikace-aikace na jam'iyya yayin buɗe taron.

rows.source: 'These are the people who tell us they can have the IT systems in place and all of the technology for Canada plus plus, for the frictionless border, for free trade without borders in Ireland,' he added.
rows.output: Wadannan su ne mutanen da suke gaya mana za su iya samun tsarin IT da duk fasahar don Kanada da Ireland, da kuma iyakar iyaka, ciniki kyauta ba tare da iyakoki ba, in ji shi.
rows.reference: ‘Waɗannan su ne mutanen da suka gaya mana cewa za su iya samun tsarin IT a wuri daya da kuma dukkanin fasaha na kara-karan Canada, don badaddiyar iyaka, don ciniki kyauta ba tare da iyakoki a Ireland ba,’ ya kara da cewa.

rows.source: 'It is a complete farce.
rows.output: 'Yan iska ne.
rows.reference: 'Cikakken barkwanci ne.

rows.source: There isn't such a thing as a good Brexit,' he added.
rows.output: Ba a samu irin abin da ake kira da kyau ba,' ya kara da cewa.
rows.reference: Babu wani abu mai kyau kamar Brexit, ‘ya kara da cewa.

rows.source: Warren plans to take a 'hard look' at running for president
rows.output: Warren na shirin duba yiwuwar tsayawa takarar shugaban kasa
rows.reference: Warren za ta yi "kyakkyawan nazari" ga Tsayawa takarar Shugaban kasa

rows.source: U.S. Sen. Elizabeth Warren says she'll take a "hard look at running for president" after the November elections.
rows.output: Sanatan Amurka, Elizabeth Warren, ta bayyana cewa za ta duba yiwuwar tsayawa takarar shugaban kasa sosai bayan zaben watan Nuwamba.
rows.reference: Amurka Sen. Elizaberth ta ce za ta yi "kyakkyawan nazari akan Tsayawa takarar Shugaban kasa” bayan gudana zaben Nuwamba.

rows.source: The Boston Globe reports the Massachusetts Democrat spoke about her future during a town hall in western Massachusetts Saturday.
rows.output: An ba da rahoton cewa jaridar Boston Globe ta bayyana ra'ayinta game da makomarta a yayin taron birni a yankin yammacin Massachusetts a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Boston Globe ta ruwaito ce ‘yar Massachusetts Democrat tayi magana game da makomarta a lokacin da ake zauren gari a yammacin Massachusetts ranar Asabar.

rows.source: Warren, a frequent critic of President Donald Trump, is running for re-election in November against GOP state Rep. Geoff Diehl, who was co-chairman of Trump's 2016 Massachusetts campaign.
rows.output: Warren, wanda ke yawan sukar Shugaba Donald Trump, yana takara a sake zaben a watan Nuwamba a kan GOP Rep. Geoff Diehl na jihar, wanda ya kasance kodinetan Trump na kamfen na 2016 na Massachusetts.
rows.reference: Warren, mai yawan sukan Shugaba Donald Trump, yana neman takarar sake neman zaben a watan Nuwamba tsakaninsa da dan majalisat Jaha GOP. mai suna Geoff Diehl, wanda ya kasance shugaban kungiyar neman takara Trump na 2016 Massachusetts.

rows.source: She has been at the center of speculation that she might take on Trump in 2020.
rows.output: Ta kasance a tsakiyar hasashe cewa za ta iya tsayawa takara da Trump a 2020.
rows.reference: Ta kasance a tsakiyar zancen cewa zata iya tsayawa takara da Trump a 2020.

rows.source: Saturday afternoon's event in Holyoke was her 36th meeting with constituents using the town hall format since Trump took office.
rows.output: Taron ranar Asabar da rana a Holyoke ita ce ta 36 a cikin tarurrukan da ta yi da masu zabe ta hanyar taron birni tun bayan da Trump ya hau mulki.
rows.reference: A taron rana na Asabar a Holyoke wanda shi ne taro 36 da mazabanta da yin amfani da tsarin zaure gari tun da Trump ya shiga ofishi.

rows.source: An attendee asked her if she planned to run for president.
rows.output: Wani mai halarta ya tambaye ta ko tana shirin tsayawa takarar shugaban kasa.
rows.reference: Wani mahalarcin taron ya tambaye ta ko tana shirin tsayawa takaran shugaban kasa.

rows.source: Warren replied that it's time "for women to go to Washington to fix our broken government, and that includes a woman at the top."
rows.output: Warren ya ce, "lokaci ne na mata su tafi Washington su gyara gwamnatinmu ta karye, kuma hakan ya hada da mace a matsayi mafi girma."
rows.reference: Warren ta mai da martani cewa lokaci yayi “da mata za su je Washington domin gyara karrariya gwamnatinmu kuma wannan ya hada da matan dake sama,"

rows.source: Arrest made in shooting death of LSU's Sims
rows.output: An kama wani a cikin harbin da aka yi wa LSU's Sims
rows.reference: Anyi kame a harbin kisan da akayi wa LSU Sims

rows.source: Police in Baton Rouge, La., announced Saturday that a suspect has been arrested in the shooting death of LSU basketball player Wayde Sims on Friday.
rows.output: An sanar da jami'an 'yan sanda a Baton Rouge, La., a ranar Asabar cewa an kama wani a kisan gillar da aka yi wa dan wasan kwallon kwando na Jami'ar Jihar Louisiana, Wayde Sims, a ranar Juma'a.
rows.reference: 'Yan sanda a Baton Rouge, La., Sun sanar a ranar Asabar cewa, an kama wani wanda ake zargi a kisan da aka yi wa' yar wasan kwando na LSU, Wayde Sims ranar Jumma'a.

rows.source: The Baton Rouge Police Department announced the arrest of Dyteon Simpson, 20, at an 11 a.m. ET news conference.
rows.output: Rundunar ‘yan sandan Baton Rouge ta sanar da kama Dyteon Simpson, mai shekaru 20, a wata hira da manema labarai da safe.
rows.reference: Sashen 'yan sandan Baton Rouge ta sanar da kama Dyteon Simpson, 20, a karfe 11 na safe. a taron labaran ET.

rows.source: They had released a video of the shooting on Friday, asking for help identifying a man seen in the footage.
rows.output: Sun fitar da bidiyo na harbin a ranar Juma'a, inda suke neman taimako wajen gano wani mutum da aka gani a cikin bidiyon.
rows.reference: Sun fito da bidiyon harbi a ranar Juma'a, su na neman taimako don gano mutumin da aka gani a cikin hotunan.

rows.source: Sims, 20, was shot and killed near Southern University's campus early Friday.
rows.output: An harbe Sims, mai shekaru 20, kusa da harabar jami'ar kasa ta kudu da wuri a ranar Juma'a.
rows.reference: Sims, 20, an harbe shi a kusa da sansanin Jami'ar Kudancin a safiyar ranar Juma'a.

rows.source: "Wayde Sims suffered a gunshot wound to the head and ultimately died as a result," police chief Murphy J. Paul told the media Saturday, per 247sports.
rows.output: "Wayde Sims ya ji rauni a kai daga harbin bindiga kuma a karshe ya mutu sakamakon hakan," shugaban 'yan sanda Murphy J. Paul ya gaya wa kafafen yada labarai ranar Asabar, a cewar 247sports.
rows.reference: "Wayde Sims ya sha wahalar harbi a kan kansa kuma ya mutu sakamakon haka," in ji shugaban 'yan sandan Murphy J. Paul a ranar Asabar, ta hanyar 247sports.

rows.source: Wayde stepped in to defend his friend and was shot by Simpson.
rows.output: Wayde ya shiga tsakani don kare abokinsa kuma ya samu harbin da Simpson ya yi.
rows.reference: Wayde ya shiga don kare abokinsa shi ne Simpson ya harbe shi.

rows.source: Simpson was questioned and admitted to being on scene, in possession of a weapon, and admitted to shooting Wayde Sims.
rows.output: An tambayi Simpson kuma ya amince cewa yana cikin wurin, yana da makami, kuma ya amince da harbin Wayde Sims.
rows.reference: An tambayi Simpson kuma ya yarda da kasancewa a wurin, makami da makami tare da shi, kuma ya yarda ya harbi Wayde Sims.

rows.source: Simpson was arrested without incident and taken into custody at East Baton Rouge Parish Police Department.
rows.output: An kama Simpson ba tare da wani lamari ba, an kai shi ofishin ‘yan sanda na gundumar East Baton Rouge.
rows.reference: An kama Simpson ba tare da wani hayaniya ba, kuma an kai shi an tsare a ma'aikatar 'yan sanda a garin East Baton Rouge.

rows.source: A 6-foot-6 junior who grew up in Baton Rouge, Sims played in 32 games with 10 starts last season and averaged 17.4 minutes, 5.6 points and 2.9 rebounds per game.
rows.output: Wani ɗan shekara 6-6 mai suna Sims wanda ya girma a Baton Rouge, ya buga wasanni 32 tare da fara wasa 10 a kakar da ta gabata kuma ya taka mintuna 17.4, maki 5.6, da kuma 2.9 a kowane wasa.
rows.reference: Mai 6-kafa-6 yaro wanda ya girma a Baton Rouge, Sims ya taka leda a wasanni 32 tare da farawa 10 da kimanin minti 17.4, maki 5.6 da 2.9 rebounds a duk wasa.

rows.source: Russian Grand Prix: Lewis Hamilton closes in on world title after team orders hand him win over Sebastian Vettel
rows.output: Gasar Tseren Jirgin Ruwa ta Rasha: Lewis Hamilton ya kusa lashe kambun duniya bayan an umurci tawagarsa da ta ba shi nasara a kan Sebastian Vettel
rows.reference: Grand Prix na Rasha: Lewis Hamilton ya rufe gasar cin kofin duniya a lokacin da 'yan wasa suka ba shi damar lashe Sebastian Vettel

rows.source: It became clear from the moment that Valtteri Bottas qualified ahead of Lewis Hamilton on Saturday that Mercedes" team orders would play a large part in the race.
rows.output: Ya zama bayyane daga lokacin da Valtteri Bottas ya cancanci zama a gaban Lewis Hamilton a ranar Asabar cewa umarnin kungiyar Mercedes za su taka rawa sosai a tseren.
rows.reference: Ya bayyana a fili tun lokacin da Valtteri Bottas ya cancanci gaban Lewis Hamilton a ranar Asabar cewar Mercedes '' 'yan wasan zasu taka muhimmiyar rawa a tseren.

rows.source: From pole, Bottas got a good start and almost hung Hamilton out to dry as he defended his position in the first two turns and invited Vettel to attack his teammate.
rows.output: Daga baya, Bottas ya samu kyakkyawan farawa kuma ya yi ƙoƙarin ya jefar da Hamilton a matsayin ya kare matsayinsa a cikin juyi biyu na farko kuma ya gayyaci Vettel ya kai wa abokin wasansa hari.
rows.reference: Daga pole, Bottas ya fara da kyau kuma har ya kusa rataye Hamilton don ya bushe a yayin kare matsayinsa a cikin biyun farko kuma ya gayyaci Vettel don kai hari ga abokin takara.

rows.source: Vettel went into the pits first and left Hamilton to run into the traffic at the tail of the pack, something which should have been decisive.
rows.output: Vettel ya shiga tashar farko kuma ya bar Hamilton ya gudu cikin zirga-zirgar da ke karshe, wanda ya kamata ya zama mai yanke hukunci.
rows.reference: Vettel ya shiga cikinf filin farko kuma ya bar Hamilton don ya shiga cikin zirga-zirga a wutsiyar fakitin, wani abin da ya kamata ya kasance na yanke shawara.

rows.source: The Mercedes pitted a lap later and came out behind Vettel, but Hamilton went ahead after some wheel-to-wheel action that saw the Ferrari driver reluctantly leave the inside free at risk of holding out after a double-move to defend on the third corner.
rows.output: An rasa Mercedes a zagaye na gaba kuma ya fito a bayan Vettel, amma Hamilton ya ci gaba bayan wasu ayyuka na kai da kai wanda ya ga direban Ferrari ya yi watsi da gefen kyauta a hadarin rike bayan motsi biyu na karewa a kusurwar ta uku.
rows.reference: Mercedes ya zarce layi daga baya kuma ya fito bayan Vettel, amma Hamilton ya yi gaba bayan wani tukin kan duki da sukayi da direban Ferrari wanda ya bari ba da son ran shi cikin kyakkyawan yanayi na rike wa bayan yunkuri-biyu na kare kusurwa na uku.

rows.source: Max Verstappen started from the back row of the grid and was in seventh by the end of the first lap on his 21st birthday.
rows.output: Max Verstappen ya fara daga layin baya na grid kuma ya kasance na bakwai a karshen farkon lap a ranar haihuwarsa ta 21.
rows.reference: Max Verstappen ya fara daga jerin baya na grid kuma ya kasance a cikin bakwai bayan ƙarshen karon farko a ranar haihuwarsa 21.

rows.source: He then led for a large part of the race as he held onto his tyres to target a quick finish and overtake Kimi Raikkonen for fourth.
rows.output: Sannan ya jagoranci mafi yawan tseren yayin da yake rike da tayoyinsa don neman kammala tseren cikin sauri da kuma wuce Kimi Raikkonen a matsayi na hudu.
rows.reference: Sai ya jagoranci babban ɓangare na tseren yayin da yake rike da tayar don ya kai ga dagacin karewa da sauri kuma ya samu shan gaban Kimi Raikkonen na hudu.

rows.source: He eventually came into the pits on the 44th lap but was unable to increase his pace in the remaining eight laps as Raikkonen took fourth.
rows.output: A ƙarshe ya zo cikin ramuka a zagaye na 44 amma ba zai iya ƙara saurin sa a sauran zagayen takwas ba yayin da Raikkonen ya ɗauki matsayi na huɗu.
rows.reference: Daga bisani sai ya shiga cikin filin a karo na 44 amma bai sami damar kara karfinsa a sauran ragowan karon takwas ba yayin da Raikkonen yazo na hudu.

rows.source: It's a difficult day because Valtteri did a fantastic job all weekend and was a real gentleman told let me by.
rows.output: Wata rana mai wahala ce domin Valtteri ya yi aiki mai ban mamaki a dukan karshen mako kuma mutum ne na gaske ya gaya mani in wuce.
rows.reference: Rana ce mai wuya saboda Valtteri ya yi aiki mai kyau cikin dukan karshen mako kuma ya kasance mai saukin kai da ya gaya mini.

rows.source: The team have done such an exceptional job to have a one two," said Hamilton.
rows.output: Ƙungiyar ta yi aiki sosai don samun matsayi na ɗaya da biyu," in ji Hamilton.
rows.reference: Kungiyar sunyi aikin yabawa da suka sami na daya da biyu,” cewar Hamilton.

rows.source: That Was Really Bad Body Language
rows.output: Hakan Ya Yi Mummunan Harshe na Jiki
rows.reference: Wannan mumunan alamar nuni ne

rows.source: President Donald Trump mocked Senator Dianne Feinstein at a rally on Saturday over her insistence she did not leak the letter from Christine Blasey Ford accusing Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh of sexual assault.
rows.output: Shugaba Donald Trump ya yi ba'a ga Sanata Dianne Feinstein a wani gangami a ranar Asabar kan jajircewarta na cewa ba ta yada wasikar Christine Blasey Ford da ke zargin alkali na Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh da cin zarafi.
rows.reference: Shugaban kasar Donald Trump ya zolayi Sanata Dianne Feinstein a wani taron sintirin a ranar Asabar game da zarginta cewa ba ta fitar da wasika daga Christine Blasey Ford ba, da ke zargin zababben dan Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh akan cin zarafin jima'i.

rows.source: Speaking at a rally in West Virginia, the president did not directly address the testimony given by Ford before the Senate Judiciary Committee, instead commenting that what was going on in the Senate showed that people were "mean and nasty and untruthful."
rows.output: A yayin wani gangami a West Virginia, shugaban kasar bai yi magana kai tsaye kan shaidar da Ford ya bayar a gaban kwamitin shari'a na majalisar dattawa ba, maimakon haka ya bayyana cewa abin da ke faruwa a majalisar ya nuna cewa mutane "suna da zafi da mugunta da rashin gaskiya."
rows.reference: Da yake jawabi a taron sintirin a West Virginia, shugaban kasa ya ba da adireshin da Ford ya bayar a gaban komitin shari'ar Majalisar Dattijai, maimakon bayyana cewa abin da ke gudana a Majalisar Dattijai ya nuna cewa mutane sun kasance "maƙaryata marar sa gaskiya."

rows.source: "The one thing that could happen and the beautiful thing that is going on over the last few days in the Senate, when you see the anger, when you see people that are angry and mean and nasty and untruthful," he said.
rows.output: "Abu daya da zai iya faruwa kuma abin da ya dace da ke faruwa a cikin majalisar a cikin kwanaki masu zuwa, lokacin da kuke ganin fushi, lokacin da kuke ganin mutanen da suke fushi da zafi da muguwar hali da rashin gaskiya," ya ce.
rows.reference: "Abu daya da zai iya faruwa da kuma kyakkyawar abin da ke faruwa a cikin 'yan kwanakin karshe a Majalisar Dattijai, lokacin da su ka ga fushi, lokacin da ka ga mutanen masu fushi da tauri kuma maƙaryata marar sa gaskiya," in ji shi.

rows.source: "When you look at releases and leaks and then they say "oh, I didn't do it.
rows.output: Lokacin da kuke kallon sakin da kuma zubar da jini, sannan suka ce "oh, ban yi ba.
rows.reference: “Idan ka kalli sakewan da fitowan bayanan sirri kuma sai suce “kai, ba ni nayi ba.

rows.source: I didn't do it."
rows.output: Ban yi ba.
rows.reference: Ba ni nayi ba.”

rows.source: Remember?
rows.output: Ka tuna?
rows.reference: Ka tuna?

rows.source: Dianne Feinstein, did you leak?
rows.output: Dianne Feinstein, shin kuna da hannu a ciki?
rows.reference: Dianne Feinstein, ka fitar?

rows.source: Remember her answer... did you leak the document - "oh, oh, what?
rows.output: Ka tuna amsarta... shin ka yi zubar da takardar - "oh, oh, menene?
rows.reference: Ka tuna da amsarta ... shin ka fitar da wannan takardar - "oh, oh, mene?

rows.source: Oh, no.
rows.output: A'a.
rows.reference: Oh, a’a.

rows.source: I didn't leak."
rows.output: Ban bayyana komai ba.
rows.reference: Ban fitar ba.”

rows.source: Well, wait one minute.
rows.output: To, jira minti daya.
rows.reference: To, jira minti daya.

rows.source: Did we leak...No, we didn't leak," he added, in an impression of the senator.
rows.output: Mun bayyana...A'a, ba mu bayyana ba," ya kara, a cikin kwaikwayon sanata.
rows.reference: Shin mun fitar dashi... A'a, ba mu fitar ba, "ya kara da cewa, kamar yadda sanatan ya nuna.

rows.source: Feinstein was sent the letter detailing the allegations against Kavanaugh by Ford back in July, and it was leaked earlier in September - but Feinstein denied that the leak came from her office.
rows.output: An aika waƙar zuwa ga ƙalubalen da aka yi wa Kavanaugh daga Ford a watan Yuli, kuma an yi ta a farkon Satumba - amma an ƙi cewa an yi ta daga ofishin.
rows.reference: An aika ma Feinstein wasikar da ke dauke da bayanan zargin da ake ma Kavanaugh daga Ford a watan Yulin, kuma takaddar ta fita a farkon watan Satumbar - amma Feinstein ya musanta zargin cewa daga cikin ofishin takaddar ta fito.

rows.source: "I did not hide Dr. Ford's allegations, I did not leak her story," Feinstein told the committee, The Hill reported.
rows.output: "Ban boye ikirari Dr. Ford ba, ban fitar da labarin ta ba," in ji Feinstein ga kwamitin, The Hill ta ruwaito.
rows.reference: “Ban boye ba Dr. Zargin, ban fitar da labarinta ba,” Feinstein ya fada ma kwamitin, Hill suka ruwaito.

rows.source: "She asked me to hold it confidential and I kept it confidential as she asked."
rows.output: Ta roƙe ni in rike shi a sirrance, na kuma rike shi a sirrance kamar yadda ta nema.
rows.reference: "Ta ce min in rike shi da sirri kuma na aje shi asiri kamar yadda ta ce min."

rows.source: But her denial did not appear to sit well with the president, who commented during the Saturday night rally: "I'll tell you what, that was really bad body language.
rows.output: Amma kin musanta hakan bai ji dadin shugaban kasa ba, wanda ya yi tsokaci a lokacin gangamin ranar Asabar: "Zan gaya muku, hakan ya yi muni sosai a cikin alamu.
rows.reference: Amma rashin amincewarta bai nuna ya samu shiga a wurin shugaban kasa ba, wanda ya yi sharhi yayin taron sintirin daren Asabar: “Zan fada maka wani abu, Wannan mummunan alamar nunin jiki ne.

rows.source: Maybe she didn't, but that's the worst body language I've ever seen."
rows.output: Wataƙila ba ta yi ba, amma wannan shine mafi muni da na taɓa gani.
rows.reference: Wataƙila ba ta yi ba, amma wannan ita ce mafi munin alamar nunin jiki da na taɓa gani. "

rows.source: Continuing his defense of the Supreme Court nominee, who has been accused of sexual misconduct by three women, the president suggested that the Democrats were using the allegations for their own ends.
rows.output: Ci gaba da kare shugaban kotun koli, wanda mata uku suka zarge shi da cin zarafi, shugaban kasar ya nuna cewa ‘yan Democrat suna amfani da zarge-zargen ne domin amfanin kansu.
rows.reference: Yayin ci gaba da kare zababbun Kotun Koli, wanda ake zargi da cin zarafin jima’i daga mata uku, shugaban ya bada shawarar cewa jam'iyyar Democrat ta yi amfani da zargin don biyan bukatar su.

rows.source: "They are determined to take back power by any means necessary.
rows.output: "Suna da niyyar dawo da mulki ta kowace hanya da ta dace.
rows.reference: “Sun jajirce don karbar mulki ta ko wane hali.

rows.source: You see the meanness, the nastiness, they don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over to get power and control," Mediaite reported the president saying.
rows.output: Kuna ganin ƙazanta, rashin tausayi, ba su damu da wanene suka cutar da su, wanda dole ne su yi tafiya a kai don samun iko da iko," Mediaite ta ruwaito shugaban kasa ya ce.
rows.reference: Kuna ganin muguntar, rashin da’a, ba su damu da waɗanda suka cutar ba,waɗanda zasu cutar domin su samu mulki da iko, Mediaite ya ruwaito shugaban kasar na cewa.

rows.source: Elite League: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants
rows.output: Ƙungiyar Elite: Taurarin Dundee 5-3 Masu Girma Belfast
rows.reference: Elite League: Dundee Stars 5-3 Belfast Giants

rows.source: Patrick Dwyer hit two goals for the Giants against Dundee
rows.output: Patrick Dwyer ya zura kwallaye biyu ga Giants a kan Dundee
rows.reference: Patrick Dwyer ya zura kwallaye biyu ma Giants ga Dundee

rows.source: Dundee Stars atoned for Friday's Elite League loss against Belfast Giants by winning the return match 5-3 in Dundee on Saturday.
rows.output: Taurarin Dundee sun yi gafara da asarar da suka yi a ranar Juma'a a gasar Elite League da suka yi da Belfast Giants, inda suka doke su da ci 5-3 a Dundee a ranar Asabar.
rows.reference: Kungiyar Dundee Stars sun dau fansar rashin da sukayi ga Elite League a kan Belfast Giants ta hanyar lashe gasar 5-3 a Dundee ranar Asabar.

rows.source: The Giants got an early two-goal lead through strikes from Patrick Dwyer and Francis Beauvillier.
rows.output: An tara waƙa ta farko daga hannun Patrick Dwyer da Francis Beauvillier.
rows.reference: Kungiya The Giants ne suka fara samun damar zura kwallo biyu ta hanyar Patrick Dwyer da Francis Beauvillier.

rows.source: Mike Sullivan and Jordan Cownie brought the home side level before Dwyer restored the Giants' lead.
rows.output: Mike Sullivan da Jordan Cownie sun kawo daidaito a gida, kafin Dwyer ya dawo da Giants.
rows.reference: Mike Sullivan da Jordan Cownie sun kawo matakin gida kafin Dwyer ya sake jagorancin Giants.

rows.source: Francois Bouchard equalised for Dundee before two Lukas Lundvald Nielsen goals secured their victory.
rows.output: François Bouchard ya zura kwallo a raga don Dundee, sannan Lukas Lundvald Nielsen ya zura kwallaye biyu don tabbatar da nasarar su.
rows.reference: Francois Bouchard ya ci kwallon da suka zo kunnen doki da Dundee kafin kwallo biyun Lucas Lundvald Nielsen su zama nasarar su.

rows.source: It was a third Elite League defeat of the season for Adam Keefe's men, who had come from behind to beat Dundee 2-1 in Belfast on Friday night.
rows.output: Wani koma-baya ne na gasar Elite a kakar wasa ta bana ga kungiyar Adam Keefe, wadanda suka dawo da ci 2-1 a kan Dundee a Belfast ranar Juma'a da daddare.
rows.reference: Wannan dai shi ne karo na uku na gasar cin kofin kwallon kafa da Elite League suka rasa ga 'yan wasan Adam Keefe, wanda daga baya ya buga Dundee 2-1 a Belfast a daren ranar Jumma'a.

rows.source: It was a fourth meeting of the season between the sides, with the Giants winning the previous three matches.
rows.output: Wannan shi ne na hudu a kakar wasa tsakanin kungiyoyin biyu, inda kungiyar Giants ta yi nasara a wasannin uku da suka gabata.
rows.reference: Shi ne karo na hudu na kakar a tsakanin bangare biyun,da Giants su na cin wassannin da suka gabata guda uku.

rows.source: Dwyer's opener came in the fourth minute on 3:35 from a Kendall McFaull assist, with David Rutherford providing the assist as Beauvillier doubled the lead four minutes later.
rows.output: Mai buɗe ƙofofin Dwyer ya zo a cikin minti na huɗu a kan 3:35 daga taimakon Kendall McFaull, tare da taimakon David Rutherford yayin da Beauvillier ya ninka kwallon a minti huɗu bayan haka.
rows.reference: Buɗewar Dwyer ya zo minti na hudu a kan 3:35 daga taimakon Kendall McFaull, tare da David Rutherford ya ba da taimakon kuma Beauvillier ninka jagorancin zuwa biyu minti hudu gabani.

rows.source: In what was a busy opening period, Sullivan brought the home side back into the game on 13:10 before Matt Marquardt became provider for Cownie's equaliser on 15:16.
rows.output: A cikin wani lokaci mai aiki sosai, Sullivan ya dawo da kungiyar gida a kan 13:10 kafin Matt Marquardt ya zama mai bayarwa ga Cownie's daidaito a kan 15:16.
rows.reference: wasan da yayi kamari daga farawa, Sullivan ya dawo da gidan su wasan cikin wasan a 13:10 kafin Matt Marquardt ya zama mai taimakawa a cin Cownie' na kunnen doki a 15:16.

rows.source: Dwyer made sure the Giants took a lead into the first break when he hit his second goal of the night at the end of the first period.
rows.output: Dwyer ya tabbatar da cewa Giants sun dauki jagoranci zuwa hutun farko lokacin da ya zura kwallonsa ta biyu a wannan dare a karshen farkon rabin.
rows.reference: Dwyer ya tabbatar da cewa Giants sun jagoranci wasan a farkon lokaci da ya ci kwallo na biyu na daren a karshen wannan lokacin.

rows.source: The home side regrouped and Bouchard once again put them on level terms with a power play goal on 27:37.
rows.output: Gidan ya sake haduwa, Bouchard ya sake saita su daidai da kwallo mai karfi a minti na 27:37.
rows.reference: Ƙungiyar da ke gidasun sun canza salo kuma Buchard ta sake jirkita su da wasan kwallon fin karfi akan 27:37.

rows.source: Cownie and Charles Corcoran combined to help Nielsen give Dundee the lead for the first time in the match late in the second period and he made sure of the win with his team's fifth halfway through the final period.
rows.output: Cownie da Charles Corcoran sun taimaka wa Nielsen ya ba Dundee jagora a karon farko a wasan da ya wuce tsakiyar minti na biyu, sannan ya tabbatar da nasarar da kungiyarsa ta samu a tsakiyar rabin karshe.
rows.reference: Cownie da Charles Corcoran sun hade don taimakama Nielsen don ya ba Dundee jagoraci a karo na farko a wasan a karshen wasa biyu kuma ya tabbatar da nasarar da ta samu a rukuni na biyar na tawagar a karshen wasa yakai karshe.

rows.source: The Giants, who have now lost four of their last five matches, are at home to Milton Keynes in their next match on Friday.
rows.output: Giyaman, wadanda suka yi rashin nasara a wasanni hudu na karshe, za su kara da Milton Keynes a gida a wasansu na gaba a ranar Juma'a.
rows.reference: Giants, waɗanda yanzu suka rasa hudu daga wasanni biyar na baya, su na cikin gida da Milton Keynes a wasan da za su buga na gaba a ranar Jumma'a.

rows.source: Air Traffic Controller Dies To Ensure Hundreds On Plane Can Escape Earthquake
rows.output: Wani mai kula da zirga-zirgar jiragen sama ya mutu don tabbatar da cewa mutane da dama a cikin jirgin sun tsira daga girgizar kasa
rows.reference: Mai kula da zirga-zirgar jiragen sama ya mutu don tabbatar da rayuwar mutane a cikin jirgin sama sun tseru daga girgizar kasa

rows.source: An air traffic controller in Indonesia is being hailed as a hero after he died ensuring that a plane carrying hundreds of people made it safely off the ground.
rows.output: An aikin kula da zirga-zirgar jiragen sama a Indonesia an yi masa karramawa a matsayin jarumi bayan ya mutu tabbatar da cewa jirgin da ke dauke da mutane da dama ya tashi cikin aminci daga kasa.
rows.reference: An yaba ma wani mai kula da zirga-zirgar jiragen sama a Indonesiya a matsayin gwarzo bayan ya mutu don tabbatar da cewa jirgin saman da ke dauke da daruruwan mutane ya tashi lafiya daga ƙasa.

rows.source: More than 800 people have died and many are missing after a major earthquake hit the island of Sulawesi on Friday, triggering a tsunami.
rows.output: Akwai mutane sama da 800 da suka mutu, kuma da yawa sun bace bayan wata babbar girgizar kasa ta afku a tsibirin Sulawesi a ranar Juma'a, lamarin da ya haifar da ambaliya.
rows.reference: Fiye da mutane 800 sun mutu kuma mutane da yawa sun bata bayan babban girgizar kasa ya mamaye tsibirin Sulawesi a ranar Jumma'a, yayin da ya haifar da tsunami.

rows.source: Strong aftershocks continue to plague the area and many are trapped in debris in the city of Palu.
rows.output: Ƙarfafa girgizar ƙasa na ci gaba da bazuwa a yankin kuma da yawa sun makale a cikin tarkacen gine-gine a birnin Palu.
rows.reference: Kananan girgizar kasa mai karfi sun ci gaba da zama annoba a yankin kuma mutane da yawa su na cikin tarzoma a birnin Palu.

rows.source: But despite his colleagues fleeing for their lives, 21-year-old Anthonius Gunawan Agung refused to leave his post in the wildly swaying control tower at Mutiara Sis Al Jufri Airport Palu airport.
rows.output: Amma duk da cewa abokan aikinsa sun gudu da rayukansu, Anthonius Gunawan Agung mai shekaru 21 ya ki barin matsayinsa a cikin ginin kulawa mai girgiza a filin jirgin sama na Mutiara Sis Al Jufri na Palu.
rows.reference: Amma duk da abokan aikin sa sun gudu don tserar da rayukansu, Anthonius Gunawan Agung, mai shekaru 21, ya ki ya bar gurin aikin sa a gini hasumiya a filin jirgin saman Maniara Sis Al Jufri dake filin jirgin saman Palu.

rows.source: He stayed put to make sure that the Batik Air Flight 6321, which was on the runway at the time, was able to take off safely.
rows.output: Ya zauna a wurin don tabbatar da cewa jirgin Batik Air 6321, wanda yake kan titin jirgin a lokacin, zai iya tashi lafiya.
rows.reference: Ya ci gaba da tabbatar da cewa Batik Air Flight 6321, wanda yake kokarin tashi a lokacin, ya tashi lafiya.

rows.source: He then jumped off the traffic control tower when he thought it was collapsing.
rows.output: Sannan ya yi tsalle daga ginin sarrafa zirga-zirga lokacin da ya yi tunanin yana rugujewa.
rows.reference: Yayi tsalle daga ginin hasumiyar a lokacin da yayi tunanin zai zube.

rows.source: He died later in hospital.
rows.output: Ya mutu daga baya a asibiti.
rows.reference: Ya mutu daga baya a asibiti.

rows.source: Spokesman for Air Navigation Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, said the decision may have saved hundreds of lives, Australia's ABC News reported.
rows.output: Mai magana da yawun sufurin jiragen sama na Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, ya bayyana cewa wannan shawarar na iya ceton rayuka da dama, a cewar labarin ABC na Australia.
rows.reference: Mai magana da yawun kamfanin Air Navigation Indonesia, Yohannes Sirait, ya ce hukuncin zai iya ceto daruruwan rayuka, rahoton ABC News na Australia.

rows.source: We prepared a helicopter from Balikpapan in Kalimantan to take him to a bigger hospital in another city.
rows.output: Mun shirya jirgin sama mai saukar ungulu daga Balikpapan a Kalimantan don kai shi wani babban asibiti a wata kasa.
rows.reference: Mun shirya jirgi mai tashin angulu daga Balikpapan a Kalimantan don ya dauke shi zuwa babban asibiti a wani garin.

rows.source: Unfortunately we lost him this morning before the helicopter reached Palu.
rows.output: Abin takaici, mun rasa shi da safe kafin jirgin sama ya kai Palu.
rows.reference: Wani abin bakin ciki shi ne mun rasa shi a wannan safiya kafin jirgi mai tashin angulun ya isa Palu.

rows.source: "Our heart breaks to hear about this," he added.
rows.output: "Zuciyarmu ta karye idan muka ji wannan labari," in ji shi.
rows.reference: "Zukatanmu na cikin jimamin jin wannan labarin," in ji shi.

rows.source: Meanwhile, authorities fear that the death toll could reach the thousands with the country's disaster mitigation agency saying that access to the the towns of Donggala, Sigi and Boutong is limited.
rows.output: A halin yanzu hukumomi suna fargabar cewa adadin wadanda suka mutu na iya kaiwa dubban mutane, inda hukumar kula da bala’o’i ta kasar ta bayyana cewa hanyoyin zuwa garuruwan Donggala, Sigi, da Boutong sun takaita.
rows.reference: A halin yanzu, hukumomi su na tsoron cewa mutuwar za ta iya kaiwa dubbai da hukumar rage bala’o’i ta kasar na cewa samun damar shiga garuruwan Donggala, Sigi da Boutong takaitacce ne.

rows.source: "The toll is believed to be still increasing since many bodies were still under the wreckage while many have not able to be reached," agency spokesman Sutopo Purwo Nugroho said.
rows.output: "Ana ganin har yanzu ana kara yawan mace-mace tun da har yanzu akwai jikin mutane da dama a karkashin tarkacen ginin yayin da wasu ba a iya isa gare su ba," in ji kakakin hukumar Sutopo Purwo Nugroho.
rows.reference: "An yi imani akwai yiwuwar karuwar matattun tunda gawawwaki da yawa na karkashin fasashshen jirgin yayin da an kasa samun da yawan su," in ji kakakin kungiyar Sutopo Purwo Nugroho.

rows.source: Waves that reached up to six meters have devastated Palu which will hold a mass burial on Sunday.
rows.output: Rashin lafiya da ya kai mita shida ya lalata Palu, wanda zai gudanar da binne gawarwaki a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Taguwar ruwa da ya kai kimanin mita shida ya lalata Palu wanda za a binne gawawwakin wuri daya ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: Military and commercial aircraft are bringing in aid and supplies.
rows.output: Jiragen sama na soji da na kasuwanci suna kawo agajin da kayayyaki.
rows.reference: Jirgin sojoji da jiragen sama na haya su na kawo taimako da kayayyaki.

rows.source: Risa Kusuma, a 35-year-old mother, told Sky News: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.
rows.output: Risa Kusuma, wata uwa mai shekaru 35, ta gaya wa Sky News: "Kowane minti daya motar asibiti tana kawo gawarwaki.
rows.reference: Risa Kusuma, mahaifiyar mai shekaru 35, ta bayyana ma Sky News: "Kowane minti motar asibiti na kawo gawawwaki.

rows.source: Clean water is scarce.
rows.output: Ruwa mai tsafta yana da wuya a samu.
