rows.reference: Ruwa mai tsafta na da wahalar samu.

rows.source: The mini-markets are looted everywhere."
rows.output: An sace kananan kasuwanni a ko'ina."
rows.reference: Ana kama kananan kasuwanni a ko'ina. "

rows.source: Jan Gelfand, head of the International Red Cross in Indonesia, told CNN: "The Indonesian Red Cross is racing to help survivors but we don't know what they'll find there.
rows.output: Jan Gelfand, shugaban kungiyar Red Cross ta kasa da kasa a Indonesia, ya gaya wa CNN: "Kungiyar Red Cross ta Indonesia na gaggawar taimakawa wadanda suka tsira amma ba mu san abin da za mu samu a wurin ba.
rows.reference: Jan Gelfand, shugaban kungiyar international Red Cross a Indonesia, ya shaida wa CNN: "Red Cross din Indonesia yana gaggawar zuwa don taimaka ma waɗanda suka rayu amma ba mu san abin da za su samu a can ba.

rows.source: This is already a tragedy, but it could get much worse."
rows.output: Wannan ya riga ya zama bala'i, amma zai iya kara tabarbarewa.
rows.reference: Wannan abun bakin ciki ne, amma zai iya fin haka. "

rows.source: Indonesia's President Joko Widodo arrived in Palu on Sunday and told the country's military: "I am asking all of you to work day and night to complete every tasks related to the evacuation.
rows.output: Shugaban kasar Indonesia Joko Widodo ya isa Palu a ranar Lahadi kuma ya gaya wa sojojin kasar: "Ina rokon duk ku ku yi aiki rana da dare don kammala dukkan ayyukan da suka shafi ceto.
rows.reference: Shugaban kasar Indonesiya, Joko Widodo, ya isa Palu ranar Lahadi kuma ya shaidawa sojojin kasar: "Ina umurtar ku duka ku yi aiki dare da rana don kammala dukkan ayyukan da suka shafi fitarwa.

rows.source: Are you ready?" CNN reported.
rows.output: "Shin kuna shirye?" CNN ta ruwaito.
rows.reference: Kun shirya?” CNN suka ruwaito.

rows.source: Indonesia was hit earlier this year by earthquakes in Lombok in which more than 550 people died.
rows.output: An kuma yi ta fama da girgizar kasa a Lombok a wannan shekara inda sama da mutane 550 suka mutu.
rows.reference: A farkon wannan shekarar, Indonesia ta samu girgizar kasa a Lombok, inda mutane fiye da 550 suka mutu.

rows.source: Micronesia plane crash: Air Niugini now says one man missing after lagoon plane crash
rows.output: Micronesia jirgin sama: Air Niugini yanzu ta ce mutum daya ya bace bayan hadarin jirgin sama a cikin ruwan tabki
rows.reference: Hadarin Jirgin Micronesia Air Niugini sun ce mutum daya ya bata bayan hadarin jirgin sama

rows.source: The airline operating a flight that crashed into a Pacific lagoon in Micronesia now says one man is missing, after earlier saying all 47 passengers and crew had safely evacuated the sinking plane.
rows.output: Hukumar jirgin sama da ke tashi a wani lagon teku a Micronesia ta bayyana cewa akwai wani mutum da ya bace, bayan da ta fara cewa duk fasinjoji 47 da ma'aikatan jirgin sun bar jirgin da ke nutsewa lafiya.
rows.reference: Kamfanin jiragen saman da ke aiki da jirgin da ya fada cikin tekun Pacific a Micronesia yanzu ya ce mutum guda ya bata, bayan da ya fadi cewa duk fasinjoji 47 da ma'aikatan jirgin da aka ceto daga cikin jirgin sama.

rows.source: Air Niugini said in a release that as of Saturday afternoon, it was unable to account for a male passenger.
rows.output: Air Niugini ta ce a wata sanarwa cewa da yammacin ranar Asabar, ba ta iya gano wani fasinjojin namiji.
rows.reference: Air Niugini sun ce a cikin takarda da su ka saki cewa tun daga ranar Asabar da yamma, ba su iya bada bayanin namiji daya ba.

rows.source: The airline said it was working with local authorities, hospitals and investigators to try to find the man.
rows.output: Sakamakon haka, kamfanin jirgin ya bayyana cewa yana hada kai da hukumomin yankin, asibitoci, da masu bincike domin gano mutumin.
rows.reference: Kamfanin jirgin sama sun ce su na aiki tare da hukumomi, asibitoci da masu bincike don kokarin gano mutumin.

rows.source: The airline did not immediately respond to requests for more details about the passenger, such as his age or nationality.
rows.output: Hukumar jirgin ta yi watsi da buƙatun ƙarin bayani game da fasinjojin, kamar shekarunsa ko ƙasarsa, har sai an yi musu tambayoyi.
rows.reference: Kamfanin jirgin sama bai amsa tambayoyin nan da nan ba don ƙarin bayani game da fasinja, kamar shekarunsa ko kasa

rows.source: Local boats helped rescue the other passengers and crew after the plane hit the water while trying to land at the Chuuk Island airport.
rows.output: Jiragen ruwa na gida sun taimaka wajen ceto sauran fasinjoji da ma'aikatan jirgin bayan ya buga ruwa yayin da yake kokarin sauka a filin jirgin sama na Chuuk Island.
rows.reference: kwale-kwalen gargajiya sun taimaka wajen ceton sauran fasinjoji da ma'aikatan bayan jirgin ya fada ruwa yayin da yake ƙoƙarin sauka a filin jirgin saman Chuuk Island.

rows.source: Officials said on Friday that seven people had been taken to a hospital.
rows.output: An bayyana cewa mutane bakwai suna cikin asibiti.
rows.reference: Jami'ai sun ce ranar Jumma'a mutane bakwai ne aka kai asibiti.

rows.source: The airline said six passengers remained at the hospital Saturday, and all of them were in stable condition.
rows.output: Hukumar jirgin ta ce fasinjoji shida sun kasance a asibiti a ranar Asabar, kuma duk suna cikin yanayi mai kyau.
rows.reference: Kamfanin jiragen sama sun ce mutane shida fasinjoji sun kasance a asibiti a ranar Asabar, kuma dukansu su na cikin yanayi mai kyau.

rows.source: What caused the crash and the exact sequence of events remains unclear.
rows.output: Abin da ya haifar da hadarin da kuma takamaiman jerin abubuwan da suka faru har yanzu ba a bayyana su ba.
rows.reference: Abin da ya haifar da hadarin da kuma ainihin jerin abubuwan da suka faru ya kasance a boye.

rows.source: The airline and the U.S. Navy both said the plane landed in the lagoon short of the runway.
rows.output: Hukumar jirgin da sojojin ruwa na Amurka sun ce jirgin ya sauka a cikin lagon kusa da titin saukar jirgin.
rows.reference: Kamfanin jirgin sama da Amurka Sojan ruwa duka sun ce jirgin saman ya sauka a cikin gabar kogin ta saboda karancin hanyar gudu.

rows.source: Some witnesses thought the plane overshot the runway.
rows.output: Wasu shaidu sun yi imanin cewa jirgin ya yi tsallakewa a filin jirgin.
rows.reference: Wasu shaidu sun yi zaton jirgin ya zarce hanyar gudun ne.

rows.source: American passenger Bill Jaynes said the plane came in very low.
rows.output: Mai tafiya da jirgin ruwa na Amurka Bill Jaynes ya ce jirgin ya zo da kyar.
rows.reference: Fasinjan Amurka Bill Jaynes ya ce jirgin saman ya zo a kasa sosai.

rows.source: "That's an extremely good thing," said Jaynes.
rows.output: "Wannan abu ne mai kyau sosai," in ji Jaynes.
rows.reference: "Wannan abu ne mai kyau," in ji Jaynes.

rows.source: Jaynes said he and others managed to wade through waist-deep water to the emergency exits on the sinking plane.
rows.output: Jaynes ya ce ya yi nasarar tafiya cikin ruwa mai zurfin gwiwa zuwa hanyoyin tserewa a kan jirgin da ke nutsewa.
rows.reference: Jaynes ya ce shi da wasu sun gudanar da tafiya cikin zurfin ruwa zuwa bude kofar gaggawa ga jirgin dake nutsewa.

rows.source: He said the flight attendants were panicking and yelling, and that he suffered a minor head injury.
rows.output: Ya ce ma’aikatan jirgin suna firgita kuma suna ihu, kuma ya samu karaya a kai.
rows.reference: Yace masu ma’aikatan jirgin saman sun rikice su na ihu, kuma ya sha wahala da rauni a kansa.

rows.source: The U.S. Navy said sailors working nearby on improving a wharf also helped in the rescue by using an inflatable boat to shuttle people ashore before the plane sank in about 30 meters (100 feet) of water.
rows.output: Sojojin ruwa na Amurka sun ce ma'aikatan da ke kusa da su suna inganta wani tashar jiragen ruwa suma sun taimaka a cikin ceto ta hanyar amfani da jirgin ruwa mai hoda wajen jigilar mutane zuwa gabar ruwa kafin jirgin ya nutse a kimanin mita 30 (ƙafa 100) na ruwa.
rows.reference: U.S din. Rundunar sojan ruwa ta ce masu aikin jirgi na aiki a kusa don inganta tashar jirgin ruwa kuma sun taimaka wajen ceto ta hanyar amfani da kwale-kwale mai iska don jigilar mutane zuwa gefen ruwa kafin jirgi ya nutse a cikin mita 30 (feet 100) na ruwa.

rows.source: Data from the Aviation Safety Network indicates 111 people have died in crashes of PNG-registered airlines in the past two decades but none involved Air Niugini.
rows.output: Bayanai daga Cibiyar Tsaro ta Sufurin Jiragen Sama sun nuna cewa mutane 111 sun mutu a hadarurrukan jiragen da ke da rajista a PNG a cikin shekaru ashirin da suka gabata, amma babu wanda ya shafi Air Niugini.
rows.reference: Bayanai daga Cibiyar Tsaro na Jirage ya nuna cewa mutane 111 sun mutu a hadarin PNG-kamfanonin jiragen sama mai rajista a cikin shekaru ashirin da suka gabata amma babu wanda ya shafi Air Niugini.

rows.source: Analyst lays out timeline of night woman was burned alive
rows.output: Mai nazari ya gabatar da jadawalin da dare mace ta kone
rows.reference: Masu bincike sun fitar da zangon lokacin dare da aka ƙona matar da rai

rows.source: The prosecution rested its case Saturday in the retrial of a man who is accused of burning a Mississippi woman alive in 2014.
rows.output: An gama shari'ar ranar Asabar a sake shari'ar wani mutum da ake zarginsa da kone wata mata a Mississippi a shekarar 2014.
rows.reference: Mai Shari'ar ya dakatar da shari'arsa a ranar Asabar a lokacin da aka yanke hukuncin wani mutumin da ake tuhumar kone matar Mississippi da rai a shekarar 2014.

rows.source: U.S. Department of Justice Analyst Paul Rowlett testified for hours as an expert witness in the field of intelligence analysis.
rows.output: An nazari daga Ma'aikatar Shari'a ta Amurka, Paul Rowlett, ya shaida na tsawon sa'o'i a matsayin kwararre a fannin nazari.
rows.reference: Amurka Mai bincike na sashen Ma'aikatar Shari'a Paul Rowlett ya bada shaida na tsawon sa'o'i kamar yadda mai shaidar gani da ido gwani yake a cikin binciken yake.

rows.source: He outlined for the jury how he used cellphone records to piece together the movements of 29-year-old defendant Quinton Tellis and the 19-year-old victim, Jessica Chambers, on the night she died.
rows.output: Ya bayyana wa juri yadda ya yi amfani da rajistar wayar salula wajen hada hanyoyin da dan shekara 29 mai suna Quinton Tellis da kuma wanda aka kashe mai shekaru 19, Jessica Chambers, a daren da ta rasu.
rows.reference: Ya bayyana wa alkalai yadda ya yi amfani da daukar murya ta wayar salula yana bibiyar mai shekaru 29 Quinton Tellis mai aikata laifi da mai shekaru 19 da haihuwa, Jessica Chambers wadda aka aikata wa laifin, a daren da ta mutu.

rows.source: Rowlett said he received location data from several cellphones that showed Tellis was with Chambers the evening of her death, contradicting his previous claims, The Clarion Ledger reported .
rows.output: Rowlett ya bayyana cewa ya samu bayanai kan wurin da wasu wayoyin salula suka nuna cewa Tellis yana tare da Chambers a maraice na mutuwar ta, wanda ya saba wa ikirari da ya yi a baya, kamar yadda jaridar Clarion Ledger ta ruwaito.
rows.reference: Rowlett ya ce ya karbi bayanan wuri daga wasu wayoyin salula wanda ya nuna cewa Tellis yana tare da Chambers a yammacin mutuwar ta, ya saba wa zargin da ya gabata, in ji Clarion Ledger.

rows.source: When data showed his cellphone was with Chambers' during the time he said he was with his friend Michael Sanford, police went to talk to Sanford.
rows.output: Lokacin da bayanai suka nuna cewa wayarsa tana tare da Chambers a lokacin da ya ce yana tare da abokinsa Michael Sanford, ‘yan sanda sun tafi su yi magana da Sanford.
rows.reference: Lokacin da bayanai suka nuna cewa wayarsa ta kasance tare da Chambers 'a lokacin da ya ce yana tare da abokinsa Michael Sanford,' yan sanda sun yi magana da Sanford.

rows.source: Sanford took the stand Saturday and testified that he wasn't in town that day.
rows.output: Sanford ya hau kujerar shaida a ranar Asabar ya tabbatar da cewa bai kasance a garin a wannan rana ba.
rows.reference: Sanford ya haw akwaki a ranar Asabar kuma ya shaida cewa ba ya garin a wannan rana ba.

rows.source: When prosecutors asked if Tellis was telling the truth when he said he was in Sanford's truck that night, Sanford said he was "lying, because my truck was in Nashville."
rows.output: Lokacin da masu gabatar da kara suka tambayi Tellis ko yana cewa gaskiya ne lokacin da ya ce yana cikin motar Sanford a wannan dare, Sanford ya ce yana "karya, domin motata tana Nashville."
rows.reference: Lokacin da masu gabatar da kara suka tambaye shi idan Tellis yana faɗar gaskiya lokacin da ya ce yana cikin motar Sanford a wannan dare, Sanford ya ce yana "kwance, domin motar tana Nashville."

rows.source: Another inconsistency was that Tellis said he had known Chambers for about two weeks when she died.
rows.output: Wani rashin daidaito shi ne Tellis ya ce ya san Chambers tsawon makonni biyu kafin ta mutu.
rows.reference: Wani kuma rashin daidaito shi ne cewa Tellis ya ce ya san Chambers ne kusan sati biyu kafin mutuwar ta.

rows.source: Cellphone records indicated they'd only known each other for a week.
rows.output: Rajistar wayar salula ta nuna cewa sun san juna na tsawon mako guda kawai.
rows.reference: bayanan waya sun nuna cewa sun san juna ne kawai a sati daya.

rows.source: Rowlett said that sometime after Chambers' death, Tellis deleted Chambers' texts, calls and contact information from his phone.
rows.output: Rowlett ya ce wani lokaci bayan mutuwar Chambers, Tellis ya goge saƙonnin Chambers, kiran waya da bayanan tuntuɓar sa daga wayarsa.
rows.reference: Rowlett ya ce wani lokaci bayan mutuwar Chambers, Tellis ya goge sakonin Chambers, kira da bayanin lamba daga wayarsa.

rows.source: "He erased her from his life," Hale said.
rows.output: "Ya goge ta daga rayuwarsa," Hale ya ce.
rows.reference: "Ya goge ta daga rayuwarsa," in ji Hale.

rows.source: The defense is scheduled to begin its closing arguments Sunday.
rows.output: Za a fara da muhawarar karewa ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Za a fara sauraron masu kare shi a ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: The judge said he expected the trial to go to the jury later that day.
rows.output: Alkalin ya ce yana tsammanin za a mika shari’ar ga juri a karshen ranar.
rows.reference: Alkalin ya ce yana tsammanin za a gabatar da shari'a zuwa ga alkalai bayan wannan ranar.

rows.source: The High Breed: What is conscious hip hop?
rows.output: The High Breed: Menene hip hop mai sani?
rows.reference: Jinsi Mai Saurin Girma: Menene sanannen hip hop?

rows.source: A hip hop trio wants to challenge the negative view of the genre by filling their music with positive messages.
rows.output: Wani rukuni na hip hop suna son kalubalantar ra'ayin mara kyau na nau'in ta hanyar cika kiɗan su da saƙonnin tabbatacce.
rows.reference: Wasu hip hop uku na so su kalubalanci ra'ayi mara kyau game da jinsin ta hanyar cikawa da kiɗa tare da sakonni masu kyau.

rows.source: The High Breed, from Bristol, claim hip hop moved away from its origins of political messages and tackling social issues.
rows.output: The High Breed, daga Bristol, sun yi iƙirarin cewa hip hop ya tashi daga asalin sa na saƙonnin siyasa da magance matsalolin zamantakewa.
rows.reference: Jinsi Mai Saurin Girma, daga Bristol, da'awar cewa hip hop ya bar shi asalin sakonnin siyasa da kuma magance matsalolin zamantakewa.

rows.source: They want to go back to its roots and make conscious hip hop popular again.
rows.output: Suna son komawa ga tushensa su sanya hip hop na sane ya shahara.
rows.reference: Su na son komawa tushensu kuma su yi sanannen hip hop da zai dawo da martabar su.

rows.source: Artists like The Fugees and Common have seen a recent resurgence in the UK through artists such as Akala and Lowkey.
rows.output: Masu fasaha irin su The Fugees da Common sun ga sabon farfadowa a Birtaniya ta hanyar masu fasaha irin su Akala da Lowkey.
rows.reference: Mawaki kamar Fugees da Common sun ga sake tashin shi a Birtaniya ta hanyar fasaha irin su Akala da LowKey.

rows.source: Another black person?!
rows.output: Wani baƙar fata?!
rows.reference: Wani baƙar fata?!

rows.source: NY nanny sues couple over firing after "racist" text
rows.output: Mai kula da yara na New York ya shigar da kara a kan ma'auratan bayan an kore shi saboda "rubutun kiyayya".
rows.reference: Mai kula da yaran NY tayi karan ma’aurata akan koranta bayan rubutun "wariyar launin fata"

rows.source: A New York nanny is suing a couple for discriminatory firing after receiving a misdirected text from the mother complaining that she was "another black person."
rows.output: Mai kula da yara a New York na neman diyya daga ma'aurata saboda korar da aka yi musu saboda rashin adalci bayan ta samu saƙon kuskure daga mahaifiyar tana cewa tana da "wani baƙar fata."
rows.reference: Mai kula da yara a New York tayi karan ma’aurata akan koranta ba bisa ka’ida ba bayan rubutun da ba ita aka nufata daga wata uwa tana korafin cewa ita "wata baƙar fata ce kuma"

rows.source: The couple deny they are racist, likening the suit to "extortion."
rows.output: Ma'auratan sun musanta cewa su 'yan tsiraru ne, suna kwatanta karar da "damfarar."
rows.reference: Ma’auratan sun karyata cewa su na da wariyar launin fata, cewa karar na da alaka da “kwace”

rows.source: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, a mother of two, expressed dismay when finding out that the new child care provider, Giselle Maurice, was black upon arriving for her first day of work in 2016.
rows.output: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, wata uwa mai yara biyu, ta nuna rashin jin dadi lokacin da ta gano cewa sabuwar mai kula da yaran, Giselle Maurice, baƙar fata ce a ranar farko ta aiki a 2016.
rows.reference: Lynsey Plasco-Flaxman, mahaifiyar mai yaya biyu, ta nuna damuwa lokacin da aka gano cewa sabon mai kulawa da yara, Giselle Maurice, baƙar fata ce daga isowa a ranar ta na farkon aiki a shekarar 2016.

rows.source: "NOOOOOOOOOOO ANOTHER BLACK PERSON," wrote Mrs Plasco-Flaxman to her husband in a text.
rows.output: "BA KOWA BA, WANI BAKAR FATA," matar Plasco-Flaxman ta rubuta wa mijinta a cikin sakon.
rows.reference: “a’aaaaaaaaaaaaaa WATA BAKAR FATA,” in ji Misis Plasco-Flaxman ga mijinta a cikin rubutu.

rows.source: However, instead of sending it to her husband, she sent it to Ms. Maurice, twice.
rows.output: Amma maimakon ta aika masa, ta aika wa Ms. Maurice sau biyu.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, maimakon aikawa zuwa ga mijinta, ta aika ta ga Ms. Maurice, sau biyu.

rows.source: After realizing her gaffe, an "uncomfortable" Plasco-Flaxman fired Ms. Maurice, stating that their outgoing nanny, who was African-American, had done a bad job and that she was instead expecting a Filipino, according to the New York Post.
rows.output: Bayan da ta gane kuskuren da ta yi, Plasco-Flaxman mai "mummunan yanayi" ya kori Ms. Maurice, inda ta bayyana cewa mai kula da yaran da ke fita, wadda Baƙar fata ce ta Amurka, ta yi mummunan aiki kuma tana sa ran wata 'yar Filipino, a cewar New York Post.
rows.reference: Bayan ta gane kuskurenta, "rashin jin dadi" Plasco-Flaxman ya kori Ms. Maurice, inda ta bayyana cewa tsohuwar ma’aikaciyar tasu wace yar afuruka-Amurka ce, ta yi mummunan aiki kuma yana da tsammanin za a kawo Filipino ne, a cewar New York Post.

rows.source: Ms. Maurice was paid for her one day of work and then sent home for an Uber.
rows.output: Misis Maurice ta samu albashi na kwana guda ta yi aiki sannan aka tura ta gida don Uber.
rows.reference: An biya ms. Maurice kudin aikin ta na rana daya sannan kuma aka tura ta gida da uber.

rows.source: Now, Maurice is suing the couple for compensation over the firing, and is seeking compensation to the tune of $350 a day for the six-month, live-in gig she had initially been hired to do, albeit without a contract.
rows.output: Yanzu, Maurice na neman di da mata diyya kan korar, kuma yana neman diyya da darajarsa ta kai dala 350 a rana na watanni shida na aikin da ta fara yi, duk da cewa ba tare da kwangila ba.
rows.reference: A halin yanzu, Maurice na karan ma'aurata don biyan diyya a kan koranta, kuma tana neman biyan diya da ya kai $ 350 a rana na watanni shida, kamar yadda yake a hayar aikin da aka dauke ta tayi, albeit ba tare da kwangila ba.

rows.source: "I want to show them, look, you don't do stuff like that," she told the Post on Friday, adding "I know it's discrimination."
rows.output: "Na so in nuna musu, kalli, ba ku yi abubuwa irin wannan ba," ta gaya wa Jaridar a ranar Juma'a, tana kara da "Na sani cewa shi nuna bambanci ne."
rows.reference: "Ina so in nuna musu, duba, ba’a yon abubuwa irin haka," ta fada ma Post a Jumma'a, kara da cewa "Na san don nuna bambanci ne."

rows.source: The couple have hit back at the claims that they are racist, saying that terminating Maurice's employment was the reasonable thing to do, fearing they could not trust her after offending her.
rows.output: Ma'auratan sun mayar da martani kan ikirarin cewa suna da kiyayya, inda suka ce cewa dakatar da aikin Maurice shine abin da ya dace, suna jin tsoron ba za su iya amincewa da ita ba bayan sun yi mata laifi.
rows.reference: Ma'auratan sun sake mai da martani sunce mu ba ma nuna alamun wariyar launin fata, su na cewa koran Maurice abin da ya kamata su yi kenan, saboda tsoron ba za ta amince da su ba bayan sun aikata mata laifin.

rows.source: "My wife had sent her something that she didn't mean to say.
rows.output: Matar ta aiko mata da wani abu da ba ta nufi ba.
rows.reference: “Matata ta tura ma ta wani abu da bashi take nufin fada ba.

rows.source: She's not a racist.
rows.output: Ba ta da kyama.
rows.reference: Bata nuna wariyar launin fata.

rows.source: We're not racist people," husband Joel Plasco told the Post.
rows.output: Muna da mutane baƙi," mijin Joel Plasco ya gaya wa Post.
rows.reference: mu ba masu nuna wariyar launin fata bane, “mijin Joel Plasco ya fadawa Post.

rows.source: "But would you put your children in the hands of someone you've been rude to, even if it was by mistake?
rows.output: "Amma za ku sanya 'ya'yanku a hannun wanda kuka yi wa rashin mutunci, ko da kuwa kuskure ne?
rows.reference: "Amma za ku sanya 'ya'yanku a hannun wani wanda kuka kasance da yiwa laifi, ko da kuwa ta kuskure ne?

rows.source: Your newborn baby?
rows.output: Yar jaririn ku?
rows.reference: Jariri sabon haihuwa?

rows.source: Come on."
rows.output: Bari mu tafi."
rows.reference: haba dai.’’

rows.source: Likening the suit to "extortion," Plasco said his wife was just two months off having a baby and was in a "very difficult situation."
rows.output: Yin la'akari da karar a matsayin "laifin cin zarafi," Plasco ya ce matarsa ​​ta kusa haihuwa kuma tana cikin "mawuyacin hali."
rows.reference: ya na kwatanta kara da “kwace,” Plasco ya ce matarsa na da ciki wanda bai wuce watanni biyu ta samu jariri ba don haka tana cikin "yanayi mai wahala."

rows.source: "You're going to go after someone like that?
rows.output: "Za ku je ka yi wa wani irin wannan hukunci?
rows.reference: "Za ku goyi bayan irin wannan abun?

rows.source: That's not a very nice thing to do," the investment banker added.
rows.output: Wannan ba abu ne mai kyau ba, in ji mai ba da lamuni.
rows.reference: Wannan ba abu ne mai kyau ba, "in ji ma’aikacin bankin zuba jari.

rows.source: While the legal case is still ongoing, the court of public opinion has been quick to denounce the couple on social media, slamming them for their behavior and logic.
rows.output: Yayin da shari'ar doka ke ci gaba da gudana, kotun ra'ayin jama'a ta yi sauri wajen yin Allah wadai da ma'auratan a shafukan sada zumunta, inda suka soki su kan halayensu da hankalinsu.
rows.reference: Duk da yake shari'a na kan gudana, kotun ra'ayi na jama'a sun gaggauta suka ga ma'auratan a kan labarun kafofin watsa labarai, su na kushe su saboda halayyarsu da tsarin.

rows.source: Paddington publishers feared readers wouldn't relate to a talking bear, new letter reveals
rows.output: Masu buga Paddington sun ji tsoron cewa masu karatu ba za su iya danganta su da bear mai magana ba, sabuwar wasika ta bayyana.
rows.reference: Masu buga littafan Paddington su na tsoron masu karatu ba zasu so alaka da ‘yar tsana mai magana ba, sabuwar wasika ta ruwaito

rows.source: Bond's daughter Karen Jankel, who was born shortly after the book was accepted, said of the letter: "It's hard to put oneself in the shoes of somebody reading it for the first time before it was published.
rows.output: Diyar Bond, Karen Jankel, wacce aka haifa kadan bayan an karɓi littafin, ta ce game da wasiƙar: "Yana da wuya a sanya kanku a cikin takalmin wani da ke karanta shi a karon farko kafin a buga shi.
rows.reference: ‘yar Bond, Karen Jankel, wacca aka haifa ba da daɗewa ba bayan an yarda da littafin, ya ce: "Yana da wuya ka saka kanka cikin takalmin wanda ya karanta shi a karo na farko kafin a buga shi.

rows.source: It's very amusing knowing now what we know about Paddington's huge success."
rows.output: Yana da ban sha'awa sanin yanzu abin da muka sani game da nasarar Paddington mai girma.
rows.reference: Yana da kyau yanzu a san abin da muka sani game da babban nasara na Paddington."

rows.source: Saying her father, who had worked as a BBC cameraman before being inspired to write the children's book by a small toy bear, would have been sanguine about his work being rejected, she added the 60th anniversary of the books publication was "bittersweet" after his death last year.
rows.output: Ta ce mahaifinta, wanda a baya ya yi aiki a matsayin mai daukar hoto na BBC, kafin ya samu wahayi ya rubuta littafin yara, zai ji dadi da aikinsa ya samu karbuwa, ta kara da cewa bayan mutuwarsa a shekarar da ta gabata, ranar cika shekaru 60 da buga littafin "ta yi zafi".
rows.reference: Da yake cewa mahaifinta, wanda ya yi aiki a matsayin mai daukar hoto a BBC kafin a yi masa wahayi don ya rubuta littafin yara ta hanyar karama ‘yar tsana, da yayi da na sani inda littafin bai karbu ba, ta kara da ranar bukin cikar littafin 60th da bugawa ya "mai wahala da dadi" bayan mutuwa sa a bara.

rows.source: Of Paddington, whom she describes as a "very important member of our family," she added her father was quietly proud of his eventual success.
rows.output: Daga Paddington, wanda ta bayyana a matsayin "mafi muhimmancin memba na danginmu," ta kara cewa mahaifinta yana da kyakkyawan fata game da nasarar da ya samu a karshe.
rows.reference: Daga Paddington, wadda ta bayyana a matsayin "mai mahimmanci daga cikin iyalinmu," in ji ta cewa mahaifinta yana da alfaharin da girman nasararsa.

rows.source: "He was quite a quiet man, and he wasn't a boastful person," she said.
rows.output: "Yana da mutum mai shiru sosai, kuma ba mutum ne mai cewa ba," ta ce.
rows.reference: "Shi mutum ne shiru-shiru, kuma bai kasance mai alfahari ba," inji ta.

rows.source: "But because Paddington was so real to him, it was almost like if you have a child who achieves something: you're proud of them even though it's not your doing really.
rows.output: "Amma saboda Paddington ya kasance na gaske a gare shi, kamar yadda kuke da yaro wanda ya cimma wani abu: kuna alfahari da shi ko da ba aikinku bane da gaske.
rows.reference: "Amma saboda Paddington sun kasance ainihin masu gaskiya a gare shi, yana cewa danka ne yayi wata nasara babba: zaka yi alfahari akan su ko da yake ba haka bane ba.

rows.source: I think he viewed Paddington's success sort of in that way.
rows.output: Ina ganin ya kalli nasarar Paddington ta wata hanya.
rows.reference: Ina tsammanin ya ga irin nasarar da Paddington ke yi, a wannan hanyar.

rows.source: Although it was his creation and his imagination, he always used to give the credit to Paddington himself."
rows.output: Duk da cewa shi ne ya halicce shi da kuma tunaninsa, sai ya ci gaba da ba da karramawa ga Paddington da kansa."
rows.reference: Ko da yake shi ne halittarsa da tunaninsa, ya kasance yana ba da girmamawa ga Paddington da kansa."

rows.source: My daughter was dying and I had to say goodbye over the phone
rows.output: Ɗiyata tana mutuwa kuma dole ne in yi bankwana ta wayar tarho
rows.reference: ‘ya ta tana mutuwa kuma dole in yi mata bankwana a kan waya

rows.source: On landing her daughter had been rushed to Nice's Hospital Louis Pasteur 2, where doctors worked in vain to save her life.
rows.output: Lokacin da jirgin ya sauka, an kai 'yarta asibitin Louis Pasteur 2 na Nice, inda likitoci suka yi kokarin banza na ceto rayuwarta.
rows.reference: Su na sauke an yi gaggawar kai 'yarta asibitin Nice a Louis Pasteur 2, inda likitoci suka yi aiki a banza don ceto rayuwarta.

rows.source: "Nad was calling regularly to say it was really bad, that she wasn't expected to make it," said Mrs Ednan-Laperouse.
rows.output: "Nad ta kira akai-akai ta ce yana da muni sosai, ba a sa ran za ta yi shi ba," in ji Misis Ednan-Laperouse.
rows.reference: "Nad na kira a kai a kai don ya ce yana da muni sosai, wai bazata tashi ba," in ji Mrs Ednan-Laperouse.

rows.source: "Then I got the call from Nad to say she was going to die within the next two minutes and I had to say goodbye to her.
rows.output: Sannan na samu kiran da Nad ta yi min na ce za ta mutu cikin mintuna biyu masu zuwa kuma ina bukatar in yi mata bankwana.
rows.reference: "Sai na samu kiran daga Nad don cewa za ta mutu a cikin minti biyu nan gaba kuma dole in yi mata bankwana.

rows.source: And I did.
rows.output: Kuma na yi.
rows.reference: Kuma na yi.

rows.source: I said, "Tashi, I love you so much, darling.
rows.output: Na ce, "Tashi, ina son ku da yawa, masoyi.
rows.reference: Na ce, "Tashi, ina son ki sosai, abar ƙaunata.

rows.source: I'll be with you soon.
rows.output: Zan kasance da ku nan ba da jimawa ba.
rows.reference: Zan kasance tare da ke ba da dadewa ba.

rows.source: I'll be with you.
rows.output: Zan kasance tare da ku.
rows.reference: Zan kasance tare da ke.

rows.source: The drugs doctors had given her to keep her heart pumping were slowly petering out and leaving her system.
rows.output: Magungunan da likitoci suka ba ta don ta ci gaba da bugun zuciyarta suna jinkirin kare ta kuma suna barin tsarin nata.
rows.reference: Magungunan da likitoci suka bata don ya cigaba da sa zuciyar ta aiki, sun fara dena aiki a hankali kuma su na barin yikinta.

rows.source: She had died some time before hand and this was it all shutting down.
rows.output: Ta mutu a baya a lokacin kuma wannan shi ne duka ya fara raguwa.
rows.reference: Ta mutu wasu yan lokuta kafin yanzu kuma Wannan shi ke rufewa duka.

rows.source: I had to just sit there and wait, knowing this was all unfolding.
rows.output: Dole ne in zauna a can in jira, na san wannan yana faruwa.
rows.reference: Dole na zauna kawai in jira, sanin cewa komai na warwarewa.

rows.source: I couldn't howl or scream or cry because I was in a situation surrounded by families and people.
rows.output: Ban iya yin kuka ko ihu ko kuka ba saboda ina cikin wani yanayi da ke kewaye da iyalai da mutane.
rows.reference: Na kasa kuka ko ihu saboda ina zagaye da yan’uwa da mutane.

rows.source: I had to really hold it together."
rows.output: Na yi matukar ƙoƙari na riƙe kaina.
rows.reference: Nayi iya kokarina don natsuwa.”

rows.source: Eventually Mrs Ednan-Laperouse, by now grieving for the loss of her daughter, boarded the plane alongside the other passengers - oblivious to the ordeal she was going through.
rows.output: A ƙarshe, Misis Ednan-Laperouse, wacce a yanzu ta yi baƙin ciki saboda mutuwar 'yarta, ta shiga jirgin tare da sauran fasinjoji - ba tare da sanin cewa tana cikin wani ƙalubale ba.
rows.reference: Daka karshe Mrs Ednan-Laperouse, ya zuwa yanzu tana jimamin mutuwar ‘yar ta, ta shiga jirgin tare da sauran fasinjojin- ba tare da la'akari da bala'in da ta ke ciki ba.

rows.source: "No-one knew," she said.
rows.output: "Babu wanda ya sani," ta ce.
rows.reference: “Ba wanda ya sani,”ta ce.

rows.source: "I had my head down, and tears were falling the whole time.
rows.output: Na saurari maganar, ina kallon yadda ake yi wa jikina duka.
rows.reference: “Nasa kaina a kasa, kuma hawaye na zuba duk lokacin.

rows.source: It's hard to explain, but it was on the flight I felt this overwhelming sense of sympathy for Nad.
rows.output: Yana da wuya a bayyana, amma a cikin jirgin ne na ji wannan jin dadi na tausayi ga Nad.
rows.reference: Yanada matukar wahalar bayani, amma a cikin jirgin ne na fara jin wani babban tausayi ga Nad.

rows.source: That he needed my love and understanding.
rows.output: Ya bukaci soyayyata da fahimtata.
rows.reference: Wai yana bukatar soyayya ta da fahimta ta.

rows.source: I knew how much he loved her."
rows.output: Na sani yadda yake sonta.
rows.reference: Nasan irin yawan son da yake mata.”

rows.source: Grieving women post cards to prevent suicides on bridge
rows.output: Mata masu bakin ciki suna aikawa da katin don hana kashe kansu a kan gada
rows.reference: Mata masu jimami su na aika katunan don hana masu kashe su akan gada

rows.source: Two women who lost loved ones to suicide are working to prevent others from taking their own lives.
rows.output: Matan biyu da suka rasa masoyansu ga kashe kansa suna aiki don hana wasu kashe kansu.
rows.reference: Mata biyu da suka rasa masoyan su ga kashe kansu su na aiki don hana wasu su kashe kansu.

rows.source: Sharon Davis and Kelly Humphreys have been posting cards on a Welsh bridge with inspirational messages and phone numbers that people can call for support.
rows.output: Sharon Davis da Kelly Humphreys suna aikawa da katin saƙo a kan gada ta Welsh tare da saƙon ƙarfafawa da lambobin waya da mutane za su iya kira don taimako.
rows.reference: Sharon Davis da Kelly Humphreys su na ta aikatar da katuna a kan gadar Welsh tare da sakonnin wahayi da lambobin waya waɗanda mutane zasu iya kira don tallafawa.

rows.source: Ms Davis' son Tyler was 13 when he began suffering with depression and killed himself aged 18.
rows.output: Ms Davis' son Tyler ya kasance yana da shekaru 13 lokacin da ya fara fama da damuwa kuma ya kashe kansa yana da shekaru 18.
rows.reference: ‘Dan Ms Davis, Tyler, yana da shekara 13 lokacin da ya fara fama da ciwon bakin ciki kuma ya kashe kansa a shekara 18.

rows.source: "I don't want any parent to feel the way I have to feel everyday," she said.
rows.output: "Ba na so a ga wani uba ya ji haka kamar yadda nake ji kowace rana," ta ce.
rows.reference: "Ba na son kowane iyaye su ji yadda zan ji a kullun," in ji ta.

rows.source: Ms Davis, aged 45, who lives in Lydney, said her son was a promising chef with an infectious grin.
rows.output: Ms Davis, mai shekaru 45, wacce ke zaune a Lydney, ta ce danta dan girki ne mai kima wanda ke da murmushi mai ban sha'awa.
rows.reference: Ms Davis, mai shekaru 45, wacce ke zaune a Lydney, ta ce ɗanta ya kasance mai ba da gudummawa mai cike da ciwo.

rows.source: "Everyone knew him for his smile.
rows.output: Kowa ya san shi saboda murmushinsa.
rows.reference: “Kowa ya san shi da murmushin shi.

rows.source: They always said his smile lit up any room."
rows.output: Su kullum sun ce murmushinsa yana haskaka kowane daki.
rows.reference: Su na yawan cewa murmushin shi yana haskaka kowane daki.

rows.source: However, he gave up work before he died, as he was "in a really dark place."
rows.output: Amma ya daina aiki kafin ya mutu, saboda yana "a wani wuri mai duhu sosai."
rows.reference: Duk da haka, ya bar aikin kafin ya mutu, yayin da yake "a cikin duhu."

rows.source: In 2014, Tyler's brother, who was 11 at the time, was the one to find his sibling after he had taken his own life.
rows.output: A shekarar 2014, dan’uwan Tyler mai shekaru 11 a lokacin, shi ne wanda ya gano ‘yar’uwansa bayan ya kashe kansa.
rows.reference: A shekarar 2014, ɗan'uwan Tyler, wanda yake dan shekara 11 a lokacin, shi ne ya sami gawar dan uwansa bayan ya ɗauki ransa.

rows.source: Ms Davis said: "I continually worry that there's going to be a knock on effect."
rows.output: Ina ci gaba da damuwa cewa za a sami tasiri.
rows.reference: Ms Davis ta ce: "Ina ci gaba da damuwa cewa akwai yiwuwar bugawa a kan sakama."

rows.source: Ms Davis created the cards, "to let people know there are people out there that you can go to and you can talk to, even if it's a friend.
rows.output: Ms Davis ta ƙirƙira katunan, "don sanar da mutane cewa akwai mutane a can da za ku iya tuntube su da kuma magana da su, ko da kuwa aboki ne.
rows.reference: Ms Davis ya kirkiro da katunan, "don sanar da mutane akwai mutanen da za ku iya zuwa wajen su kuma za ku iya magana da su, ko da kuwa aboki ne.

rows.source: Don't sit in silence - you need to talk."
rows.output: Kada ku zauna cikin shiru - kuna buƙatar magana."
rows.reference: Kar ku zauna shiru- yakamata ku yi magana.”

rows.source: Ms Humphreys, who has been friends with Ms Davies for years, lost Mark, her partner of 15 years, not long after the death of his mother.
rows.output: Ms Humphreys, wacce ta kasance abokiyar Ms Davies tsawon shekaru, ta rasa Mark, abokin zamanta na shekaru 15, ba da daɗewa ba bayan mutuwar mahaifiyarsa.
rows.reference: Ms Humphreys, wacce ta kasance kawa ga Ms Davies na tsawon shekaru, ta rasa Mark, abokin ta na shekaru 15, bayan rasuwar mahaifiyarsa ba da daɗewa ba.

rows.source: "He didn't say that he was feeling down or depressed or anything," she said.
rows.output: "Bai ce yana jin baƙin ciki ko damuwa ko wani abu ba," ta ce.
rows.reference: "Bai ce yana baya jin dadi ko yana cikn damuwa ko wani abu ba," in ji ta.

rows.source: "A couple of days before Christmas we noticed his change in attitude.
rows.output: "Kwanaki biyu kafin Kirsimeti muka lura da canjin halinsa.
rows.reference: "Kwanaki biyu kafin Kirsimeti mun lura da canji a yanayin halayyar sa.

rows.source: He was at rock bottom on Christmas Day - when the kids opened their presents he didn't make eye contact with them or anything."
rows.output: Ya kasance a ƙasan ƙasa a ranar Kirsimeti - lokacin da yara suka buɗe kyaututtukan, bai yi musu kallo ko wani abu ba.
rows.reference: Ya kasance a tushen dutsen a ranar Kirsimeti - lokacin da yara suka bude kyaututtukan su bai yarda ya hada ido da su ba,”

rows.source: She said his death was a huge trauma to them, but they have to work through it: "It rips a hole through the family.
rows.output: Ta ce mutuwarsa babban bala'i ne a gare su, amma dole ne su yi aiki da shi: "Yana haifar da rami a cikin iyali.
rows.reference: Ta ce mutuwarsa babbar matsala ce a gare su, amma dole ne suyi aiki ta hanyarsa: "Yana bar gibi a cikin iyalin.

rows.source: It tears us apart.
rows.output: Yana raba mu.
rows.reference: Ya hargitsa mu.

rows.source: But we've all got to carry on and fight."
rows.output: Amma muna duka muna bukatar mu ci gaba da fafutuka."
rows.reference: Amma dole mu cigaba da rayuwa da gwagwarmaya.”

rows.source: If you are struggling to cope, you can call Samaritans free on 116 123 (UK and Ireland), email jo@samaritans.org, or visit the Samaritans website here.
rows.output: Idan kuna fama da kula da kanku, zaku iya kiran Samaritans kyauta akan 116 123 (UK da Ireland), aika imel zuwa jo@samaritans.org, ko ziyarci gidan yanar gizon Samaritans a nan.
rows.reference: Idan kuna ƙoƙari ku jure, za ku iya kiran Samaritans kyauta akan 116 123 (Birtaniya da Ireland), imail jo@samaritans.org, ko ziyarci shafin yanar gizon Samaritan a nan.

rows.source: Brett Kavanaugh's future hangs in the balance as FBI begins investigation
rows.output: An bar makomar Brett Kavanaugh a hannun hukumar FBI da ta fara bincike.
rows.reference: Kasancewar Brett Kavanaugh ya rataya ne a sama, saboda FBI sun fara bincike

rows.source: "I thought, if we could actually get something like what he was asking for - an investigation limited in time, limited in scope - we could maybe bring a little unity," said Mr Flake on Saturday, adding that he feared the committee was "falling apart" amid entrenched partisan gridlock.
rows.output: Na yi tunani, idan za mu iya samun wani abu kamar abin da yake nema - bincike mai iyaka a lokaci, da iyaka a cikin iyaka - watakila za mu iya samun dan ci gaba.
rows.reference: "Ina tsammanin, idan za mu iya samun wani abu kamar abin da yake nema - bincike ne kawai na takaitancen lokaci, a iyakance - yadda za mu iya kawo hadin kai kadan," in ji Mr Flake a ranar Asabar, inda ya kara da cewa yana tsoron kwamitin " ya rabe " saboda yawan ra’ayin siyasa.

rows.source: Why didn't Mr Kavanaugh and his Republican supporters want the FBI to investigate?
rows.output: Me yasa Mista Kavanaugh da abokan sa na jam’iyyar Republican ba su so ‘yan sandan FBI su binciki?
rows.reference: Me yasa Mr Kavanaugh da magoya bayan jam'iyyar Republican sun so FBI su bincika?

rows.source: Their reluctance is all due to timing.
rows.output: Ƙin su ya samo asali ne daga lokaci.
rows.reference: Rashin so su ya ta’allaka ne da lokaci.

rows.source: The midterm elections are only five weeks away, on November 6 - if, as expected, the Republicans do badly, then they will be severely weakened in their attempts to get the man they want elected to the highest court in the land.
rows.output: Za a yi zaben tsakiyar wa'adi a cikin mako biyar kawai, a ranar 6 ga watan Nuwamba - idan, kamar yadda ake tsammani, 'yan Republican suka yi rashin nasara, to za su kasance cikin mawuyacin hali wajen kokarin su na samun mutumin da suke so ya zama shugaban kotun koli a kasar.
rows.reference: zaben tsakiyar wa’adi na sati biyar ne daga yanzu, a ranar 6 ga watan Nuwamba - idan, kamar yadda ake sa ran, 'yan Republican ba su yi kokari ba, to, za a taba su sosai a yunkurin su na daura mutumin da suke so a zaba zuwa mafi girman kotu a cikin kasa.

rows.source: George W. Bush has been picking up the phone to call Senators, lobbying them to support Mr Kavanaugh, who worked in the White House for Mr Bush and through him met his wife Ashley, who was Mr Bush's personal secretary.
rows.output: George W. Bush ya kasance yana ɗaukar waya don kiran Sanata, yana roƙon su su goyi bayan Mista Kavanaugh, wanda ya yi aiki a fadar White House ga Mista Bush kuma ta hanyarsa ya sadu da matarsa ​​Ashley, wadda ta kasance sakatariyar sirri ta Mista Bush.
rows.reference: George W. Bush yana ta daga waya yana kiran Sanatoci, yana rokon su don tallafawa Mr Kavanaugh, wanda yayi aiki a fadar White House ga Mr Bush kuma ta wurinsa ya hadu da matarsa Ashley, wanda shi ne magatakarda na Mr Bush.

rows.source: What happens after the FBI produces its report?
rows.output: Me zai faru bayan FBI ta samar da rahotonta?
rows.reference: Me zai faru bayan FBI ta samar da rahoto?

rows.source: There will be a vote in the Senate, where 51 Republicans and 49 Democrats currently sit.
rows.output: Za a yi kuri'a a Majalisar Dattijai, inda 'yan Republican 51 da 'yan Democrat 49 suka riga sun zauna.
rows.reference: Za ayi zabe a majalisar dattijai, inda 'yan Jamhuriyar Republican 51 da 49 Democrats ke zaune yanzu.

rows.source: It's still not clear whether Mr Kavanaugh can get to at least 50 votes on the Senate floor, which would allow Mike Pence, the vice president, to break a tie and confirm him to the Supreme Court.
rows.output: Har yanzu ba a fayyace ba ko Mista Kavanaugh zai iya samun akalla kuri'u 50 a kan bene na majalisar dattijai, wanda zai ba da damar Mike Pence, mataimakin shugaban kasa, ya warware kuri'ar da aka raba kuma ya tabbatar da shi a kotun kolin Amurka.
rows.reference: Har yanzu ba a bayyana ko Mr Kavanaugh zai iya zuwa akalla kuri'u 50 a Majalisar Dattijai ba, wanda zai ba Mike Pence, mataimakin shugaban kasa, ya karya tayin kuma ya tabbatar da shi zuwa Kotun Koli.

rows.source: North Korea defector numbers 'drop' under Kim
rows.output: Yawan wadanda suka tsere daga Koriya ta Arewa sun ragu a karkashin Kim.
rows.reference: Lambobin masu murabus a Koriya ta Arewa ya'sauka' a karkashin Kim

rows.source: The number of North Korean defectors to South Korea has fallen since Kim Jong-un came to power seven years ago, a South Korean lawmaker has said.
rows.output: Yawan 'yan tawayen Koriya ta Arewa zuwa Koriya ta Kudu ya ragu tun bayan da Kim Jong-un ya hau karagar mulki shekaru bakwai da suka gabata, a cewar wani dan majalisar Koriya ta Kudu.
rows.reference: Yawan mutanen Arewacin Koriya masu murabus zuwa Korea ta Kudu ya sauka tun lokacin da Kim Jong-un ya hau mulki a cikin shekaru bakwai da suka gabata, wani mai kula da ka'idoji na Koriya ta kudu ya ce.

rows.source: Park Byeong-seug, citing data from the South's unification ministry, said there had been 1,127 defections last year - compared with 2,706 in 2011.
rows.output: Park Byeong-seug, bisa ga bayanai daga ma'aikatar hadin kan kudu, ya bayyana cewa, an samu ficewa 1,127 a shekarar da ta gabata - idan aka kwatanta da 2,706 a shekarar 2011.
rows.reference: Park Byeong-seug, wanda ya bada bayanai daga ma'aikatar hadin kai ta Kudu, ya ce an samu raguwar murabus 1,127 a bara - idan aka kwatanta da 2,706 a shekarar 2011.

rows.source: Mr Park said tighter border controls between North Korea and China and higher rates charged by people smugglers were key factors.
rows.output: Mista Park ya bayyana cewa, ƙaƙƙarfan kulawar kan iyakokin da ke tsakanin Koriya ta Arewa da kasar Sin, da kuma ƙarin kuɗin da masu safarar mutane ke karba, manyan abubuwan da suka taimaka wajen hakan.
rows.reference: Mr Park ya ce, karin tsaron kan iyakan da ke tsakanin Koriya ta Arewa da Sin da kuma karin yawan farashin da masu fasa kwari ke yi sun kasance manyan dalilai.

rows.source: Pyongyang has made no public comments.
rows.output: Pajotai ya yi magana a bainar jama'a.
rows.reference: Pyongyang bai yi wani bayani ba a baya ne.

rows.source: The vast majority of defectors from the North are eventually offered South Korean citizenship.
rows.output: Mafi yawan wadanda suka tsere daga Arewa a karshe suna samun zama dan kasa na Koriya ta Kudu.
rows.reference: Mafi yawan masu murabus daga Arewa su na samun kyautar zama dan kasar Koriya ta kudu.

rows.source: Seoul says more than 30,000 North Koreans have illegally crossed the border since the end of the Korean War in 1953.
rows.output: Sai dai kasar Koriya ta Kudu ta ce sama da mutane 30,000 suka yi gudun hijira ba bisa ka'ida ba tun bayan yakin Koriya a shekarar 1953.
rows.reference: Seoul ya ce fiye da mutane 30,000 Arewa Koreans sun ketare iyaka ta hanyar haramtacciyar hanya tun lokacin karshen yakin Koriya a 1953.

rows.source: Most flee via China, which has the longest border with North Korea and is easier to cross than the heavily protected Demilitarised Zone (DMZ) between the two Koreas.
rows.output: Mafi yawan wadanda suka tsere suna amfani da kasar Sin, wadda ke da iyaka mafi tsawo da Arewacin Koriya, kuma tana da saukin wucewa fiye da iyakar da aka kare sosai (DMZ) tsakanin kasashen Koriya biyu.
rows.reference: Yawancin mutane sun tsere daga kasar Sin, wanda ke da dogon iyakaci da Koriya ta Arewa kuma ya fi sauƙin ketarewa fiye da yankin (DMZ) dake da kwakwaran tsaro a tsakanin Korear biyu.

rows.source: China regards the defectors as illegal migrants rather than refugees and often forcibly repatriates them.
rows.output: An yi la'akari da 'yan tserewa a matsayin 'yan gudun hijira ba tare da izini ba maimakon 'yan gudun hijira kuma galibi ana mayar da su baya ta hanyar tilastawa.
rows.reference: Kasar Sin ta na la'akari da masu murabus a matsayin masu shigowa ba bisa ka’ida ba a maimakon 'yan gudun hijira dan haka su na mai da su.

rows.source: Relations between the North and the South - who are still technically at war - have markedly improved in recent months.
rows.output: Huldar da ke tsakanin Arewa da Kudu - wadanda har yanzu suna cikin yanayi na yaki - sun samu ci gaba sosai a watannin baya.
rows.reference: Harkokin dangantaka a Arewa da Kudu - waɗanda har yanzu su na yaki - sun inganta a cikin 'yan watanni.

rows.source: Earlier this month, the leaders of the two countries met in Pyongyang for talks that centred on the stalled denuclearisation negotiations.
rows.output: A farkon wannan watan ne shugabannin kasashen biyu suka gana a Pyongyang domin tattaunawa da ta mayar da hankali kan shawarwarin dakatar da nukiliya da aka daskare.
rows.reference: Tun a farko wannan watan, shugabannin kasashen biyu sun gana a Pyongyang don tattaunawar da suka danganci tattaunawar sulhun rusa makaman nukiliya.

rows.source: This came after June's historic meeting between US President Donald Trump and Kim Jong-un in Singapore, when they agreed in broad terms to work towards the nuclear-free Korean peninsula.
rows.output: Wannan ya biyo bayan taron tarihi na watan Yuni tsakanin shugaban Amurka Donald Trump da Kim Jong-un a Singapore, lokacin da suka amince a kan muhimman batutuwa su yi aiki don samar da kwarin Korean da ba shi da makaman nukiliya.
rows.reference: Wannan ya zo bayan taron kafa tarihi Yuni tsakanin shugaban Amurka Donald Trump da Kim Jong-un a Singapore, lokacin da suka amince da yarjejeniyar da za ta kai ga raba kasar da makaman nukiliya.

rows.source: But on Saturday, North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong-ho blamed US sanctions for the lack of progress since then.
rows.output: Amma a ranar Asabar, Ministan Harkokin Waje na Koriya ta Arewa Ri Yong-ho ya zargi takunkumin da Amurka ta kakaba da rashin ci gaba tun daga lokacin.
rows.reference: Bayan taron Yuni tsakanin shugaban Amurka Donald Trump da Kim Jong-un a Singapore, sun amince da su shiga yarjejeniya don amfani da Jamhuriyyar Arewa maso gabashin Congo.

rows.source: "Without any trust in the US, there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances, there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first," Mr Ri said in a speech to the UN General Assembly in New York.
rows.output: "Ba tare da amincewa da Amurka ba, ba za a yi amincewa da tsaron ƙasarmu ba kuma a ƙarƙashin irin waɗannan yanayi, ba za mu iya kashe kanmu ba da farko," in ji Mista Ri a jawabin da ya gabatar wa Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a birnin New York.
rows.reference: Ya ce, "Ba tare da amincewa da Amurka ba, ba za mu amince da tsaron lafiyarmu ba, kuma a irin wadannan yanayi, babu wata hanyar da za lalata makaman mu da kanmu," in ji Mr Ri a cikin jawabinsa ga Majalisar Dinkin Duniya a birnin New York.

rows.source: Nancy Pelosi calls Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical," says he is unfit to serve on the Supreme Court
rows.output: Nancy Pelosi ta kira Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical," ta ce ba ya dace da zama a kotun koli
rows.reference: Nancy Pelosi ya kira Brett Kavanaugh "mai ban dariya," ya ce bai cacanci aiki a Kotun Koli ba

rows.source: House Minority Leader Nancy Pelosi called Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh "hysterical" and said that he was temperamentally unfit to serve on the Supreme Court.
rows.output: Shugabar ƙananan jam’iyyar Nancy Pelosi ta kira wanda aka zaba a kotun kolin Amurka Brett Kavanaugh da “hysterical” kuma ta ce ba shi da dacewa a yi masa aiki a kotun koli.
rows.reference: Shugaban Jagora na gida Nancy Pelosi da ya kira zababben dan Kotun Koli Brett Kavanaugh, ya ce "ba shi da cancanta ikon yin aiki a Kotun Koli.

rows.source: Pelosi made the comments in an interview Saturday at the Texas Tribune Festival in Austin, Texas.
rows.output: Pelosi ta yi magana a wata hira da aka yi a ranar Asabar a bikin Texas Tribune a Austin, Texas.
rows.reference: Pelosi ya yi sharhi a wata hirar ranar Asabar a shagali Texas Tribune a Austin, Texas.

rows.source: "I couldn't help but think that if a woman had ever performed that way, they would say 'hysterical,'" Pelosi said about her reaction to Kavanaugh's testimony before the Senate Judiciary Committee on Thursday.
rows.output: "Ban tabbata ba, idan mace ta taba yin haka, za su ce 'hysterical'."
rows.reference: "Na kasa daina tunanin cewa idan mace ta taba yin irin haka, za su ce 'mai ban dariya,'" Pelosi yace game da amsar ta akan shaidar Kavanaugh a gaban kwamitin majalisar dattijai a ranar Alhamis.

rows.source: Kavanaugh emotionally denied allegations that he had sexually assaulted Dr. Christine Blasey Ford when they were both teenagers.
rows.output: Kavanaugh ya ƙi da jinƙai ikirarin cewa ya yi wa Dr. Christine Blasey Ford fyade lokacin da suke matasa.
rows.reference: Kavanaugh cikin yanayi tausayi ya yi watsi da zargin cewa ya kai ma Dr harin jima’i. Christine Blasey Ford lokacin da suke yara duka.

rows.source: During his opening statement, Kavanaugh was very emotional, at times nearly shouting and choking up while discussing his family and his high school years.
rows.output: A lokacin gabatar da shi, Kavanaugh ya yi matukar damuwa, a wasu lokuta kusan ihu ne yake yi da kuma kuka yayin da yake magana kan iyalinsa da shekarunsa na sakandare.
rows.reference: A lokacin jawabinsa na budewa, Kavanaugh ya nuna tausayin sa sosai, a wasu lokuta yana kusan yin kururuwa da shakewa yayin tattaunawa game da iyalinsa da shekarun sa na sakandare.

rows.source: He also explicitly condemned Democrats on the committee, calling the allegations against him a "grotesque and coordinated character assassination" organized by liberals angry that Hillary Clinton lost the 2016 presidential election.
rows.output: Ya kuma yi Allah wadai da shi a fili da ’yan Democrat a kan kwamitin, inda ya kira zarge-zargen da ake yi masa da “kisan kai mai ban tsoro da tsari” da jam’iyyar ta shirya, domin sun yi fushi da Hillary Clinton ta yi asarar zaben shugaban kasa na 2016.
rows.reference: Har ila yau, ya kushe jam'iyyar Democrat a bayyane akan kwamitin, yana kiran zarge-zarge a kansa "wanda aka yi wa' yan ta'adda, da tsararren dakushe kyawawan halaye", wanda' yan tawayen suka shirya, sun yi fushi da cewa, Hillary Clinton ta fadi zaben shugaban kasar 2016.

rows.source: Pelosi said that she believed Kavanaugh's testimony proved that he could not serve on the Supreme Court, because it showed that he is biased against Democrats.
rows.output: Pelosi ta ce ta yi imanin cewa shaidar Kavanaugh ta nuna cewa ba zai iya zama a kotun koli ba, domin ta nuna cewa yana da son kai ga ‘yan Democrat.
rows.reference: Pelosi tace ta yarda cewa shaidar Kavanaugh ta tabbatar da cewa bazai iya yin hidima a kotun koli ba,saboda yana nuna bambanci akan yan jam’iyyar Democrat.

rows.source: "I think that he disqualifies himself with those statements and the manner in which he went after the Clintons and the Democrats," she said.
rows.output: Ina ganin ya kori kansa da wadannan kalamai da kuma yadda ya bi Clinton da Dimokuradiyya.
rows.reference: "Ina tsammanin cewa ya nuna rashin cancantar sa da wadannan maganganun da irin yadda ya bi bayan Clintons da yan jam’iyyar Democrat," in ji ta.

rows.source: Pelosi demurred when asked if she would try to impeach Kavanaugh if he is confirmed, and if Democrats gain the majority in the House of Representatives.
rows.output: Pelosi ta yi watsi da tambayar ko za ta yi ƙoƙarin tsige Kavanaugh idan an tabbatar da shi, kuma idan 'yan Democrat suka samu rinjaye a Majalisar Wakilai.
rows.reference: Pelosi ya ta kauce lokacin da aka tambaye ta idan za ta yi kokarin tsige Kavanaugh idan an tabbatar da shi, kuma idan Democrat ta sami mafi rinjaye a majalisar wakilai.

rows.source: "I will say this -- if he is not telling the truth to Congress or to the FBI, then he's not fit not only to be on the Supreme Court, but to be on the court he's on right now," Pelosi said.
rows.output: "Zan ce haka -- idan bai yi gaskiya ga Majalisar ko ga FBI ba, to ba ya dace ba kawai ya kasance a Kotun Koli, har ma ya kasance a kotun da yake a yanzu."
rows.reference: "Zan ce wannan - idan bai fadi gaskiya ga majalisa ko FBI ba, to, ba kawai koyun koli ne bai dace da shi ba, amma harda kotun da yake a yanzu," in ji Pelos.

rows.source: Kavanaugh is currently a judge on the D.C. Circuit Court of Appeals.
rows.output: Kavanaugh a halin yanzu jami'in kotun daukaka kara ta D.C. Circuit.
rows.reference: Yanzu haka Kavanaugh ya zama mai hukunci akan D.C. Zagayayyen kotun daukaka kara.

rows.source: Pelosi added that as a Democrat she was concerned about potential Kavanaugh rulings against the Affordable Care Act or Roe v. Wade, as he is considered to be a conservative justice.
rows.output: Pelosi ta kara da cewa a matsayinta na dan jam'iyyar Democrat, tana da damuwa game da yiwuwar hukuncin da Kavanaugh zai yanke kan Dokar Kula da Lafiya ko Roe v. Wade, domin ana ganin shi a matsayin alkalin shari'a na hagu.
rows.reference: Pelosi ta kara da cewa a matsayin ta na yar Democrat ta damu da yiwuwar yanke hukuncin Kavanaugh akan Dokar Kulawa tagari ko Roe v. Wade, Kamar yadda ake alkintawa ya zama alkali mai ra’ayin gargajiya.

rows.source: In his confirmation hearings, Kavanaugh sidestepped questions on whether he would overturn certain Supreme Court decisions.
rows.output: A yayin zaman sauraren tabbatar da nadin sa, Kavanaugh ya guji amsa tambayoyi kan ko zai soke wasu hukunce-hukuncen kotun koli.
rows.reference: A cikin tabbacin saurare, Kavanaugh ya yi wasu tambayoyi gafe game da ko zai soke wasu hukuncin Kotun Koli.

rows.source: "It's not time for a hysterical, biased person to go to the court and expect us to say, 'isn't that wonderful,'" Pelosi said.
rows.output: "Ba lokacin da mutum mai fushi da son kai ya tafi kotu ya sa mu ce, 'ba abin mamaki ba.'"
rows.reference: "Ba lokaci ba ne don raha, wanda ba'a so ya je kotun kuma yana fata mu ce, 'ba abin ban mamaki ba ne,' in ji Pelos.

rows.source: And Women Need to Wield It.
rows.output: Kuma Mata Suna Bukatar Amfani da Shi.
rows.reference: Kuma Mata Su na Buƙatar Yin Amfani Da Shi.

rows.source: It is a righteous diatribe, months and years of fury spilling over, and she can't get it out without weeping.
rows.output: Wannan wata kira ce ta gaskiya, da ta shafe watanni da shekaru tana fushi, kuma ba za ta iya fitar da ita ba tare da kuka ba.
rows.reference: Yana da ladabi mai adalci, watanni da shekaru na fushi ya wuce, kuma ba ta iya fitarwa ba, ba tare da kuka ba.

rows.source: "We cry when we get angry," Ms. Steinem said to me 45 years later.
rows.output: "Muna kuka idan muka yi fushi," Ms. Steinem ta gaya mani shekaru 45 bayan haka.
rows.reference: “Mu na kuka idan mu na fushi, "Ms. Steinem ta ce min shekaru 45 daga baya.

rows.source: "I don't think that's uncommon, do you?"
rows.output: "Ban yi tunanin hakan ba abu ne na al'ada, kina tunani?"
rows.reference: "Ba na zaton wannan shi ne ba daidadi, ka sani?"

rows.source: She continued, "I was greatly helped by a woman who was an executive someplace, who said she also cried when she got angry, but developed a technique which meant that when she got angry and started to cry, she'd say to the person she was talking to, "You may think I am sad because I am crying.
rows.output: Ta ci gaba, "Na samu taimako sosai daga wata mata da ta kasance shugaba a wani wuri, wacce ta ce tana kuma kuka lokacin da take fushi, amma ta haɓaka wata fasaha wacce ke nufin lokacin da ta yi fushi kuma ta fara kuka, za ta ce wa mutumin da take magana da shi, "Wataƙila kuna tunanin ina baƙin ciki saboda ina kuka.
rows.reference: Ta ci gaba da cewa, "Na samu taimako daga wata wacce shugaba a wani guri, wanda ta ce tana kuka yayin da ta yi fushi, amma ta ci gaba da yin amfani da fasaha wanda yake nufin lokacin da ta yi fushi kuma ta fara kuka, ta ce wa mutumin tana magana da ita, "Kana iya tunanin ina bakin ciki domin ina kuka.

rows.source: I am angry."
rows.output: Ina fushi.
rows.reference: Ina cikin fushi."

rows.source: And then she just kept going.
rows.output: Sannan ta ci gaba da tafiya.
rows.reference: Sai kuma ta cigaba da tafiya.

rows.source: And I thought that was brilliant."
rows.output: Kuma na yi tunanin hakan yana da ban mamaki."
rows.reference: Kuma nayi tsammanin wannan abu ne mai kyau. "

rows.source: Tears are permitted as an outlet for wrath in part because they are fundamentally misunderstood.
rows.output: An ba da izinin hawaye a matsayin hanyar fada da fushi, a wani bangare saboda ba a fahimce su sosai ba.
rows.reference: kwalla na fitowa sanadiyar laifi a sashe domin kuskuren fahimta.

rows.source: One of my sharpest memories from an early job, in a male-dominated office, where I once found myself weeping with inexpressible rage, was my being grabbed by the scruff of my neck by an older woman - a chilly manager of whom I'd always been slightly terrified - who dragged me into a stairwell.
rows.output: Wani daga cikin abubuwan da na fi dacewa da su daga wani aiki na farko, a cikin ofis da maza suka mamaye, inda na sami kaina na kuka da fushi marar bayyana, shi ne an kama ni da wuyana da wata tsohuwa - wata manaja mai sanyi da na yi tsoro - wadda ta ja ni cikin wani matakala.
rows.reference: Daya daga cikin abun tunawa mafi girma daga aiki na farko, a cikin ofishin maza suka mamaye, inda na taba yin kuka tare da fushi marar iyaka, sai wata tsohuwa ta kamani a wuya - sai shugaban mai saukin kai wanda nake shakku ko da yaushe- ya jani zuwa matakala.

rows.source: "Never let them see you crying," she told me.
rows.output: "Kada ka taba bari su gan ka kuka," ta gaya mini.
rows.reference: “kar ki taba bari su ganki kina kuka,” ta ce min.

rows.source: "They don't know you're furious.
rows.output: Ba su san kana cikin fushi ba.
rows.reference: Ba su san cewa kina fushi sosai ba.

rows.source: They think you're sad and will be pleased because they got to you."
rows.output: Suna tunanin kana bakin ciki kuma za su yi farin ciki domin sun kai ga gare ka.
rows.reference: Su na tunanin kina bakin ciki kuma za su ji dadi saboda sun same ki."

rows.source: Patricia Schroeder, then a Democratic congresswoman from Colorado, had worked with Gary Hart on his presidential runs.
rows.output: Patricia Schroeder, wacce a lokacin ‘yar majalisar dokokin Amurka ce daga Colorado, ta yi aiki tare da Gary Hart a yunkurin neman shugabancin kasar sa.
rows.reference: Patricia Schroeder, sa'an nan kuma yar majalisar dimokuradiyya daga Colorado, ta yi aiki tare da Gary Hart a kan neman shugabancin kasa.

rows.source: In 1987, when Mr. Hart was caught in an extramarital affair aboard a boat called Monkey Business and bowed out of the race, Ms. Schroeder, deeply frustrated, figured there was no reason she shouldn't explore the idea of running for president herself.
rows.output: A shekarar 1987, lokacin da Mista Hart ya kama shi a cikin wani al’amari na waje a kan wani jirgin ruwa mai suna Monkey Business, kuma ya yi ritaya daga tseren, Misis Schroeder, wadda ta ji takaici sosai, ta yi tunanin cewa babu wani dalili da zai hana ta bincika ra'ayin tsayawa takarar shugaban kasa kanta.
rows.reference: A shekarar 1987, lokacin da aka kama Mr Hart a hulda zina a cikin wani kwale-kwale mai suna Monkey Business sai ya fice daga tseren, Ms. Schroeder ya yi takaici sosai, ya bayyana cewa babu wani dalili da ya kamata ya hanna a fadada tunanin da zai sai ta nemi takarar shugaban kasa da kanta.

rows.source: "It was not a well-thought-out decision," she said to me with a laugh 30 years later.
rows.output: "Ba a yi la'akari da kyau ba ne," ta fada a raina da dariya shekaru talatin bayan haka.
rows.reference: "Ba wata shawara ce mai kyau ba," in ji ta tana dariya shekaru 30 daga baya.

rows.source: "There were already seven other candidates in the race, and the last thing they needed was another one.
rows.output: "Da yawa sun riga sun yi takara a zaben, kuma abu na karshe da suke bukata shi ne wani.
rows.reference: "Akwai wasu 'yan takara bakwai da suka kasance a cikin tseren, kuma abin da suke bukata shi ne wani.

rows.source: Somebody called it "Snow White and the Seven Dwarfs.""
rows.output: Wani ya kira shi "Farin Snow da Dwarfs Bakwai."
rows.reference: Wani ya kira shi "Farin Dusar Kankara da Wadanni Bakwai.""

rows.source: Because it was late in the campaign, she was behind on fund-raising, and so she vowed that she wouldn't enter the race unless she raised $2 million.
rows.output: Domin lokacin yakin neman zabe ya yi karanci, tana baya a harkar tara kudade, don haka ta yi alkawarin cewa ba za ta shiga zaben ba sai ta tara dala miliyan 2.
rows.reference: Domin ya makara a cikin yaƙin neman zaɓe, ta kasance a baya a kan samun kuɗi, don haka ta yi alƙawarin cewa ba za ta shiga tseren ba sai dai idan ta tara miliyan $2.

rows.source: It was a losing battle.
rows.output: Yaƙin ya ci nasara.
rows.reference: Wannan yaki ne damuke rasawa.

rows.source: She discovered that some of her supporters who gave $1,000 to men would give her only $250.
rows.output: Ta gano cewa wasu daga cikin magoya bayanta da suka ba mutane dala 1,000 za su ba ta kawai dala 250.
rows.reference: Ta gano cewa wasu daga cikin magoya bayanta sun ba da $1,000 ga maza zasu ba ta kawai $ 250.

rows.source: "Do they think I get a discount?" she wondered.
rows.output: "Shin suna tunanin ina samun rangwame?" ta yi tunani.
rows.reference: “Kana ganin na samu sauki?” tana mamaki.

rows.source: When she made her speech announcing that she would not launch a formal campaign, she was so overcome by emotions - gratitude for the people who'd supported her, frustration with the system that made it so difficult to raise money and to target voters rather than delegates, and anger at the sexism - that she got choked up.
rows.output: Lokacin da ta yi magana game da shirinta na kin kaddamar da yakin neman zabe na hukuma, ta yi matukar kaduwa da ji - godiya ga mutanen da suka goyi bayanta, takaici da tsarin da ya sa ya yi wahala a tara kudi da kuma kai wa masu kada kuri'a maimakon wakilai, da kuma fushi da jinsi - har ta kasa magana.
rows.reference: Lokacin da ta gabatar da jawabinta cewa ba za ta kaddamar da yakin takara ba, sai ta fada cikin tausayi - godiya ga mutanen da suka goyi bayanta, takaici ga tsarin da ya zo da wahalar samun kudi da kuma zartar da masu jefa kuri'a maimakon wakilai, da kuma fushi a kan jinsi - cewa ta gamsu da hakan.

rows.source: "You would have thought I'd had a nervous breakdown," recalled Ms. Schroeder about how the press reacted to her.
rows.output: "Za ka yi tunanin na yi fashi da makami," in ji Ms. Schroeder game da yadda kafafen yada labarai suka mayar da martani ga yadda take.
rows.reference: "Za ka yi tunanin na samu raunin hankali," ta tuna Ms. Schroeder game da yadda 'yan jarida suka matsa mata.

rows.source: "You'd have thought Kleenex was my corporate sponsor.
rows.output: "Za ka yi tunanin Kleenex shine mai daukar nauyina na kamfani.
rows.reference: "Kuna tsammani Kleenex ya kasance mai tsarin daukar nauyi na ko.

rows.source: I remember thinking, what are they going to put on my tombstone?
rows.output: Na tuna tunanin, me za su sanya a kan kabarina?
rows.reference: Na tuna wannan tunanin, mai zasu je sakawa akan kabarina?

rows.source: "She cried"?""
rows.output: "Ta yi kuka"?
rows.reference: “Tayi kuka”?””

rows.source: How the US-China trade war may be good for Beijing
rows.output: Yadda yakin kasuwanci tsakanin Amurka da Sin zai iya zama mai amfani ga birnin Beijing
rows.reference: Yadda yakin kasuwancin Amurka-Sin zai iya zama alheri ga Beijing

rows.source: The opening salvos of the trade war between the US and China were deafening, and while the battle is far from over, a rift between the countries may be beneficial to Beijing in the long term, experts say.
rows.output: Farkon harin kasuwanci tsakanin Amurka da kasar Sin ya yi girma sosai, kuma kodayake yakin bai kare ba, rarrabuwar kawuna tsakanin kasashen biyu na iya zama mai amfani ga birnin Beijing a dogon lokaci, in ji kwararru.
rows.reference: Makusudin fara yakin kasuwancin a tsakanin Amurka da Sin masu karfi ne, kuma matsala ba mai tsayawa yanzu bane, a tsakanin kasashen biyu kuma zai iya zama alheri ga Beijing na tsawon lokaci, in ji masana.

rows.source: Donald Trump, the US President, fired the first warning earlier this year by taxing key Chinese exports including solar panels, steel and aluminium.
rows.output: Donald Trump, shugaban Amurka, ya fara ba da gargadi a farkon wannan shekara ta hanyar sanya haraji kan fitar da kayayyakin kasar Sin da suka hada da firamare, karfe, da aluminium.
rows.reference: Donald Trump, shugaban kasar Amurka, yayi gargadin farko a farkon wannan shekarar ta hanyar sanya haraji kayayyakin fitarwa muhimmnai na kasar Sin, ciki har da feifen sola, karfe da dalma.

rows.source: The most significant escalation rolled in this week with new tariffs affecting $200 billion (£150 billion) worth of items, effectively taxing half of all goods coming into the US from China.
rows.output: Mafi girman tashin hankali ya zo a wannan makon tare da sabbin haraji da ke shafar dala biliyan 200 ($150 biliyan) na kayayyaki, wanda ke nufin ana harajin rabin dukkan kayayyakin da ke shiga Amurka daga kasar Sin.
rows.reference: Babban haɓakar da aka yi a wannan makon tare jadawalin kuɗin fito da suka shafi dala biliyan 200 (£150 biliyan) kimanin kayan, ta yadda za a biya kashi ɗaya daga cikin kayayyaki da ke zuwa Amurka daga kasar Sin.

rows.source: Beijing has retaliated each time in kind, most recently slapping tariffs of five to ten per cent on $60 billion of American goods.
rows.output: Beijing ya mayar da martani a kowane lokaci iri ɗaya, inda kwanan nan ya sanya haraji daga biyar zuwa goma cikin ɗari akan dala biliyan 60 na kayayyakin Amurka.
rows.reference: Beijing ta rama duk acikin nau'i daya, cikin kwanan nan sun kara jadawalin kuɗin fito daga kashi biyar zuwa kashi goma a cikin dala biliyan 60 na kayan Amurka.

rows.source: China has pledged to match the US shot-for-shot, and the world's second largest economy is unlikely to blink anytime soon.
rows.output: China ta yi alkawarin daidaita harbin Amurka, kuma ba zai yuwu tattalin arzikin kasar na biyu mafi girma a duniya ya yi kasa a gwiwa ba nan ba da jimawa ba.
rows.reference: Kasar Sin sunyi alkawarin amfani da tsarin Amurka na harbe ni-in harbe ka, kuma kasar wace itace to biyu a duniyan tatalin arziki ba su shirya jenyewa ba nan kusa.

rows.source: Getting Washington to back down means caving into demands, but publicly bowing to the US would be far too embarrassing for Xi Jinping, China's president.
rows.output: Samun Washington ta janye yana nufin yin kasa a gwiwa, amma yin kasa a gwiwa a bainar jama'a ga Amurka zai yi kasala ga Xi Jinping, shugaban kasar Sin.
rows.reference: Sanya Washington to janye kuma yana nufin kumawa cikin nema, amma janye wa Amurka a bainar jama’a zai fi zama abun kunya ga Xi Jinping, Shugaban Kasar Sin.

rows.source: Still, experts say if Beijing can play its cards right, US trade war pressures could positively support China over the long term by lowering the inter-dependence of the two economies.
rows.output: Har yanzu, kwararru sun ce idan Beijing ta yi amfani da katunan ta da kyau, matsin lamba na yakin kasuwanci na Amurka na iya tallafawa kasar Sin a harkokin tattalin arziki a dogon lokaci ta hanyar rage dogaro da juna na tattalin arzikin kasashen biyu.
rows.reference: Duk da haka, masana sun ce idan Beijing za ta iya buga katunansa daidai, Amurka za ta iya tallafawa kasar Sin cikin dogon lokaci ta hanyar rage- dogaro na tattalin arziki.

rows.source: "The fact that a quick political decision in either Washington or Beijing could create the conditions that start an economic tailspin in either country is actually a lot more dangerous than onlookers have acknowledged before," said Abigail Grace, a research associate who focuses on Asia at the Center for New American Security, a think tank.
rows.output: "Al'amari shi ne cewa, shawarar siyasa cikin sauri a Washington ko Beijing na iya haifar da yanayi da zai haifar da koma bayan tattalin arziki a kowanne kasa, wanda a gaskiya ya fi hadari fiye da yadda masu kallo suka amince da shi a baya," in ji Abigail Grace, wata mai bincike a Cibiyar Tsaro ta Sabuwar Amurka, wata cibiya mai ba da shawara.
rows.reference: "Gaskiya cewa a yanke shawarar siyasa cikin sauri a Washington ko Beijing zai iya haifar da yanayin da zai rage tattalin arziki a kowace kasa ya zama mafi haɗari fiye da yadda masu kallo suka amince a gabanin haka," in ji Abigail Grace, wani mai bincike da ke kula da Asiya. Cibiyar Sabon Tsaro ta Amurka, mai tankin tunanin.

rows.source: Syria 'ready' for refugees to return, says Foreign Minister
rows.output: Suriya ta shirya don dawo da 'yan gudun hijira, in ji ministan harkokin waje
rows.reference: Siriya ta “shirya” don dawo da 'yan gudun hijira, in ji ministan harkokin waje

rows.source: Syria says it's ready for the voluntary return of refugees and is appealing for help to rebuild the country devastated by a more than seven-year long war.
rows.output: Suriya ta bayyana shirye-shiryenta na karbar 'yan gudun hijirar da suka yi nesa da su, kuma tana rokon taimako wajen sake gina kasar da ta lalace sakamakon yakin da ya dauki sama da shekaru bakwai ana gwabzawa.
rows.reference: Siriya tace ashirye take su karbi yan gudun hijira da suka sa kansu dawowa kuma su na rokon neman taimakon sake gina kasar da ya ruguje sakamakon yakin da dauki fiye da shekara bakwai.

rows.source: Speaking to the United Nations General Assembly, Foreign minister Walid al-Moualem said conditions in the country are improving.
rows.output: A yayin da ake magana da Majalisar Dinkin Duniya, Ministan Harkokin Waje Walid al-Moualem ya bayyana cewa yanayin kasar na inganta.
rows.reference: Da suke magana da Babbar Majalisar Dinki Duniya, ministan harkokin waje Walid al-Moualem yace yanayin kasar na kara inganta.

rows.source: "Today the situation on the ground is more stable and secure thanks to progress made in combating terrorism," he said.
rows.output: "A yau yanayin da ke kasa ya fi dorewa kuma ya fi tsaro, saboda nasarorin da aka samu wajen yaki da ta'addanci," ya ce.
rows.reference: Ya ce, "Yau halin da ake ciki a cikin ƙasa ya kasance mafi karko da kuma tabbatar da godiya ga cigaban da aka samu wajen yaki da ta'addanci," inji shi.

rows.source: The government continues to rehabilitate the areas destroyed by terrorists to restore normalcy.
rows.output: Gwamnati tana ci gaba da gyara yankunan da 'yan ta'adda suka lalata domin dawo da zaman lafiya.
rows.reference: Gwamnati ta ci gaba da sake gyara wuraren da 'yan ta'adda suka ruguza don dawo da zaman lafiya.

rows.source: All conditions are now present for the voluntary return of refugees to the country they had to leave because of terrorism and the unilateral economic measures that targeted their daily lives and their livelihoods.
rows.output: Yanzu duk sharuɗɗan sun shirya don dawowar 'yan gudun hijira da suka bar ƙasar saboda ta'addanci da kuma matakan tattalin arziki na ɗaya daga cikin waɗannan abubuwan da suka shafi rayuwarsu da hanyoyin samun kuɗin shiga.
rows.reference: Dukkan yanayi sun kasance yanzu don dawo da 'yan gudun hijirar zuwa kasar sun fita ne saboda ta'addanci da kuma matakan tattalin arziki da suka shafi rayuwarsu ta yau da kullum da muhallin su.

rows.source: The UN estimates that more than 5.5 million Syrians have fled the country since the war began in 2011.
rows.output: An kiyasta cewa sama da miliyan 5.5 na 'yan kasar Siriya sun tsere daga kasar tun bayan da aka fara yakin a shekarar 2011.
rows.reference: Majalisar Dinkin Duniya ta kiyasta cewa fiye da mutane miliyan 5.5 sun tsere daga kasar tun lokacin da aka fara yakin shekarar 2011.

rows.source: Another six million people still living in the country are in need of humanitarian assistance.
rows.output: Wani miliyan shida na mutanen da har yanzu ke zaune a kasar suna bukatar taimakon jin kai.
rows.reference: Wasu mutane miliyan shida da ke zaune a kasar su na bukatar taimakon agaji.

rows.source: Al-Moualem said the Syrian regime would welcome help in rebuilding the devastated country.
rows.output: Al-Moualem ya ce, gwamnatin Siriya za ta marabci taimako wajen sake gina kasar da rikicin ya lalata.
rows.reference: Al-Moualem ya ce gwamnatin Siriya za ta maraba da taimako wajen sake gina ƙasar da aka rushe.

rows.source: But he stressed that it would not accept conditional assistance or help from countries that sponsored the insurgency.
rows.output: Amma ya jaddada cewa ba za ta karɓi taimako na sharadi ko taimako daga ƙasashen da suka tallafa wa tada kayar baya ba.
rows.reference: Amma, ya jaddada cewa, ba zai yarda da tallafi ba, ko taimako daga kasashen da suka tallafa wa tashin hankalin.

rows.source: Europe clinches Ryder Cup victory in Paris
rows.output: Turai ta samu nasara a gasar cin kofin Ryder a birnin Paris
rows.reference: Turai taci gasar kofin Ryder a Paris

rows.source: Team Europe has won the 2018 Ryder Cup defeating Team USA by a final score of 16.5 to 10.5 at Le Golf National outside Paris, France.
rows.output: An taka leda a gasar cin kofin Ryder ta 2018, inda Team Turai ta doke Team Amurka da ci 16.5 zuwa 10.5 a Le Golf National a wajen birnin Paris, Faransa.
rows.reference: Kungiyar Turai ta lashe gasar cin kofin Ryder Cup da cin kungiyar Amurka a wasan karshe na 2018 wasan ya kammalla da maki 16.5 zuwa 10.5 a Le Golf National waje Paris, Faransa.

rows.source: The US has now lost six consecutive times on European soil and has not won a Ryder Cup in Europe since 1993.
rows.output: Amurka ta yi rashin nasara a kasa da kasa a Turai a karo shida a jere kuma ba ta yi nasara a gasar Ryder Cup a Turai ba tun 1993.
rows.reference: A yanzu haka Amurka ta rasa sau shida a jere akan kasar Turai kuma ba ta lashe kofin Ryder a Turai tun 1993.

rows.source: Europe regained the crown as the Danish captain Thomas Bjorn's team reached the 14.5 points they required to beat the United States.
rows.output: An dawo da kambun Turai yayin da kungiyar kyaftin din Danish Thomas Bjorn ta samu maki 14.5 da ta doke Amurka.
rows.reference: Turai ta sake komawa kambi da dan wasan Denmark kyaftin Thomas Bjorn wanda ya kai maki 14.5 da suke buƙata na doke Amurka.

rows.source: US star Phil Mickelson, who struggled most of the tournament, plunked his tee-shot into the water at the par-3 16th hole, conceding his match to Francesco Molinari.
rows.output: Tauraron Amurka Phil Mickelson, wanda ya yi gwagwarmaya a yawancin gasar, ya buga wasansa a cikin ruwa a rami na 16, ya amince da rashin nasara ga Francesco Molinari.
rows.reference: Fitaccen jarumi Amurka Phil Mickelson, wanda ya ka attaka komai a wasan, ya jefa kwallo a cikin ruwa a par-3 rami na 16, inda ya barwa Francesco Molinari wasan shi.

rows.source: The Italian golfer Molinari shined in all of his rounds, becoming 1-of-4 players to ever go 5-0-0 since the tournament's current format begun in 1979.
rows.output: Dan wasan golf na Italiya Molinari ya yi fice a dukkan zagayen, ya zama ɗaya daga cikin 'yan wasa huɗu kawai da suka yi 5-0-0 tun lokacin da aka fara amfani da tsarin na yanzu a shekarar 1979.
rows.reference: Golfer Molinari na Italiya ya haskaka a cikin dukan raga, ya zama dan wasa 1-daga-4 da za su ci gaba da ci 5-0-0 tun lokacin da aka fara gasar a shekarar 1979.

rows.source: American Jordan Spieth was blown out 5&4 by the lowest-ranked player on the European team, Thorbjorn Olesen of Denmark.
rows.output: An yi wa dan kasar Amurka Jordan Spieth, wanda ya yi rashin nasara da ci 5&4 a hannun dan wasan da ya fi kowanne dan wasan Turai, Thorbjorn Olesen na Denmark.
rows.reference: Dan wasan Amurka Jordan Spieth ya fita akan 5&4 daga cikin 'yan wasa mafi ƙasƙanci a tawagar Turai, Thorbjorn Olesen na Denmark.

rows.source: The world's top-ranked player, Dustin Johnson, fell 2 and 1 to Ian Poulter of England who may have played in his final Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Dan wasan da ya fi kowa a duniya, Dustin Johnson, ya sha kashi da 2 da 1 a hannun Ian Poulter na Ingila, wanda watakila ya buga gasar Ryder Cup ta karshe.
rows.reference: Dustin Johnson, dan wasan gaba na duniya, ya fadi ne 2 da 1 zuwa Ian Poulter na Ingila wanda ya taka leda a gasar cin kofin Ryder na karshe.

rows.source: A veteran of eight Ryder Cups, Spaniard Sergio Garcia became the tournaments all-time winningest European with 25.5 career point.
rows.output: Wani tsohon dan wasan kwallon tebur na Spain Sergio Garcia, wanda ya halarci gasar Ryder guda takwas, ya zama dan kasar Turai mafi nasara a tarihin gasar da maki 25.5.
