rows.reference: Tsohon dan wasa gasar Ryder na takwas, Serbia Garcia ya zama dan wasan da ya lashe gasar cin kofin Turai a kowane lokaci da maki 25.5.

rows.source: "I don't usually cry but today I can't help it.
rows.output: "Ba na yawan kuka, amma yau na kasa gujewa hakan.
rows.reference: Ban cika yin kuka ba amma a yau ba zan iya rikewa ba.

rows.source: It's been a rough year.
rows.output: Shekarar ta kasance mai wuyar gaske.
rows.reference: Shekara ce mai tsanani.

rows.source: So thankful for Thomas to pick me and believe in me.
rows.output: Don Allah a ba da amsa a Hausa.
rows.reference: Ina godiya sosai da Thomas ya dauke ni kuma ya yarda da ni.

rows.source: I am so happy, so happy to get the cup back.
rows.output: Na yi matukar farin ciki, na yi matukar farin ciki da samun kofin a baya.
rows.reference: Ina farin ciki, farin ciki sosai da na kara dawo da kofin.

rows.source: It's about the team., and I'm happy I was able to help," said an emotional Garcia following the European victory.
rows.output: Yana da game da kungiyar, kuma ina matukar farin ciki da na iya taimaka musu," in ji wani mutum mai raɗaɗi Garcia bayan nasarar Turai.
rows.reference: Game da kungiyar ne., Kuma ina mai farin ciki na iya taimakawa, "cewar Garcia cikin yanayin tausayi bayan nasarar Turai.

rows.source: He passes the torch to his fellow countryman John Ram who took down US golf legend Tiger Woods 2&1 in singles play on Sunday.
rows.output: Ya mika wutar ga dan kasarsa John Ram wanda ya doke tauraron wasan golf na Amurka Tiger Woods da ci 2&1 a wasan karshe a ranar Lahadi.
rows.reference: Ya mika fitilar ga dan kasarsa, John Ram, wanda ya kaddamar da wasan kwallon kafa ta Amurka Tiger Woods 2 & 1 a wasan daidaiku na ranar Lahadi.

rows.source: "The incredible pride I feel, to beat Tiger Woods, I grew up watching that guy," said 23-year-old Rahm.
rows.output: "Abin mamaki ne jin alfahari, na doke Tiger Woods, na girma ina kallon wannan mutumin," in ji Rahm mai shekaru 23.
rows.reference: “Babban girman kai da nake ji, in bugi Tiger Woods, na girma ina kallon wannan mutumin, "cewar Rahm mai shekaru 23.

rows.source: Woods lost all four of his matches in France and now has a record of 13-21-3 career Ryder Cup record.
rows.output: Woods ya yi rashin nasara a dukkan wasanninsa a Faransa kuma yanzu yana da tarihin nasara 13-21-3 a gasar Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Woods ya rasa duk wasanninsa hudu a Faransa kuma yanzu yana da tarihin 13-21-3 na tarihin kofin career Ryder.

rows.source: A strange statistic by one of the greatest players of all-time, having won 14 major titles second to only Jack Nicklaus.
rows.output: Wani abin sha'awa ne da daya daga cikin manyan 'yan wasa a kowane lokaci, wanda ya lashe kofuna 14 na manyan gasa, na biyu kawai da Jack Nicklaus.
rows.reference: Wani kididdiga mai ban mamaki daga daya daga cikin manyan 'yan wasa na duk lokuta, ya lashe kyauta 14 na biyu da Jack Nicklaus kawai.

rows.source: Team USA struggled all weekend to find the fairways with the exception of Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas and Tony Finau, who played high-calibre golf throughout the entire tournament.
rows.output: Ƙungiyar Amurka ta yi gwagwarmaya duk karshen mako don nemo manyan hanyoyi, tare da Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas da Tony Finau, waɗanda suka buga ƙwallon golf mai inganci a duk lokacin gasar.
rows.reference: Kungiyar Amurka ta yi gwagwarmaya a karshen mako don gano hanyoyi masu kyau da ba tare da Patrick Reed, Justin Thomas da Tony Finau, waɗanda suka buga wasan golf mai girma a cikin duka wasannin.

rows.source: US captain Jim Furyk spoke after a disappointing performance for his squad, "I'm proud of these guys, they fought.
rows.output: Kyaftin ɗin Amurka Jim Furyk ya yi magana bayan wani aikin da ya yi wa ƙungiyarsa, "Na yi alfahari da waɗannan mutane, sun yi yaƙi.
rows.reference: Kyaftin din Amurka Jim Furyk yayi magana bayan takaicin wasan ga tawagarsa, "Ina alfahari da wadannan mutanen, sun yi fada.

rows.source: There was time this morning when we put some heat on Europe.
rows.output: A lokaci ne a safiyar yau muka sanya wasu matsin lamba a Turai.
rows.reference: Akwai lokaci wannan safiyar lokacin da muka sanya zafi kan Turai.

rows.source: We scrapped.
rows.output: Muka karye.
rows.reference: Mun goge.

rows.source: Hats off to Thomas.
rows.output: Godiya ga Thomas.
rows.reference: Huluna zuwa ga Thomas.

rows.source: He is a great captain.
rows.output: Shi babban kyaftin ne.
rows.reference: Shi babban kyaftin ne.

rows.source: All 12 of his players played very well.
rows.output: Dukkan 'yan wasan 12 sun taka rawar gani sosai.
rows.reference: Duka yan wasan shi 12 sunyi wasa da kyau sosai.

rows.source: We'll regroup, I'll work with the PGA of America and our Ryder Cup Committee and we'll move forward.
rows.output: Za mu sake haduwa, zan yi aiki tare da PGA ta Amurka da kwamitinmu na Ryder Cup, kuma za mu ci gaba.
rows.reference: Za mu sake haɗewa, zan yi aiki tare da PGA na Amurka da kwamitinmu na Ryder Cup kuma za mu ci gaba.

rows.source: I love these 12 guys and I'm proud to serve as captain.
rows.output: Ina son wadannan mutane maza 12 kuma ina alfahari da zama kyaftin.
rows.reference: Ina son wadannan mutanen 12 kuma ina alfaharin yin hidima a matsayin kyaftin.

rows.source: You have to tip your cap.
rows.output: Kuna buƙatar kaɗa hular ku.
rows.reference: Dole ka rankwafa hular ka.

rows.source: We got outplayed."
rows.output: Mun yi rashin kwarewa."
rows.reference: An buga mu sosai

rows.source: Red Tide Update: Concentrations decrease in Pinellas, Manatee and Sarasota
rows.output: Sabuntawa Red Tide: Yawan ya ragu a Pinellas, Manatee da Sarasota
rows.reference: Ingancin Jan Igiyar Ruwa Sinadarai na raguwa a Pinellas, Manatee da Sarasota

rows.source: The newest report from the Florida Fish and Wildlife Commission shows a general decrease in Red Tide concentrations for parts of the Tampa Bay area.
rows.output: Rahoton da aka fitar kwanan nan daga Hukumar Kifi da Dabbobi ta Florida ya nuna raguwar Red Tide gabaɗaya a wasu sassan yankin Tampa Bay.
rows.reference: Sababbin rahotanni daga Hukumar Florida Fish da wildlife na nuna raguwar sinadaran Jar Igiyar Ruwa a sassan yankin Tampa Bay.

rows.source: According to the FWC, patchier bloom conditions are being reported in areas of Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte and Collier counties - which suggests decreasing concentrations.
rows.output: Bisa ga FWC, an ba da rahoton yanayin fure mai launin fari a yankuna daban-daban na Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte da Collier - wanda ke nuna raguwar yawan adadin.
rows.reference: A cewar FWC,ana samun rahoton yanayin tsagewar kyalli bayar a yankunan Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Charlotte da Collier - wanda yake nuna rage yawan sinadarai.

rows.source: A bloom the Red Tide extends approximately 130 miles of coastline from northern Pinellas to southern Lee counties.
rows.output: Wani fari mai launin ja ya shafi kusan mil 130 na bakin teku daga arewacin Pinellas zuwa kudu Lee.
rows.reference: Kyallin Jar Igiyar Ruwa na kara yaduwa kimanin kilomita 130 na coastline daga kasashen arewacin Pinellas zuwa kudancin Lee.

rows.source: Patches can be found about 10 miles offshore of Hillsborough County, but at fewer sites relative to last week.
rows.output: An sami ramuka a kusan mil 10 a wajen gundumar Hillsborough, amma a ƙananan wurare idan aka kwatanta da makon da ya gabata.
rows.reference: Ana iya samun tsagewa kimanin kilomita 10 daga bakin takun kasar Hillsborough, amma a yankuna kadan da suke da alaka da makon da ya gabata

rows.source: Red Tide has also been observed in Pasco County.
rows.output: An ga Red Tide a gundumar Pasco.
rows.reference: An kuma lura da Jar Igiyar Ruwa a kasar Pasco.

rows.source: Medium concentrations in or offshore of Pinellas County have been reported in the past week, low to high concentrations offshore of Hillsborough County, background to high concentrations in Manatee County, background to high concentrations in or offshore of Sarasota County, background to medium concentrations in Charlotte County, background to high concentrations in or offshore of Lee County, and low concentrations in Collier County.
rows.output: An bayar da rahoton matsakaicin yawan gurbacewar iska a cikin ko kusa da gundumar Pinellas, ƙananan zuwa matsakaicin yawan gurbacewar iska a bakin tekun Hillsborough, bango zuwa matsakaicin yawan gurbacewar iska a gundumar Manatee, bango zuwa matsakaicin yawan gurbacewar iska a cikin ko kusa da gundumar Sarasota, bango zuwa matsakaicin yawan gurbacewar iska a gundumar Charlotte, bango zuwa matsakaicin yawan gurbacewar iska a cikin ko kusa da g
rows.reference: An bayar da rahoton samuwar sinadarai matsakaita a bakin teku da ke kasar Pinellas a cikin makon da ya gabata, ƙananan zuwa mafi girman sinadai a bakin tekun a kasar Hillsborough, baya zuwa mafi girman sindarai a cikin ko bakin teku a kasar Manatee, baya zuwa gagarumin sindarai a cikin ko bakin tekun yammacin kasar Sarasota, baya zuwa matsakaicin sinadarai a kasar Charlotte, baya zuwa babban sinadarai a ciki ko bakin tekun na kasar Lee, da kuma ƙananan sinadarai a kasar Collier.

rows.source: Respiratory irritation continues to be reported in Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, and Collier counties.
rows.output: Ƙarin rahotanni na ciwon numfashi ana samu a gundumar Pinellas, Manatee, Sarasota, Lee, da Collier.
rows.reference: An cigaba da samun rahoton Raunin numfashi a kasashen Pinellas, Manatee, Lee, da Collier.

rows.source: Respiratory irritation was not reported in Northwest Florida over the past week.
rows.output: Ba a ba da rahoton ciwon numfashi a Arewa maso Yamma na Florida a cikin makon da ya gabata ba.
rows.reference: Ba a ruwaito raunin numfashi ba a Northwest Florida a cikin makon da ya gabata.

rows.source: Macedonia's PM Zoran Zaev, his wife Zorica and his son Dushko cast their ballot for the referendum in Macedonia on changing the country's name that would open the way for it to join NATO and the European Union in Strumica, Macedonia September 30, 2018.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Macedonia Zoran Zaev, nwunye ya bụ Zorica na nwa ya nwoke bụ Dushko kpara votu maka ntuliaka na Macedonia banyere ịgbanwe aha obodo ahụ nke ga-eme ka ọ banye NATO na European Union na Strumica, Macedonia Septemba 30, 2018.
rows.reference: PM nke Macedonia Zoran Zaev, nwunye ya Zorica na nwa nwoke ya Dushko tinyere akwụkwọ ntuli aka ha maka nhọpụta ahụ na Macedonia maka ịgbanwe aha nke obodo ahụ nke ga-emepe ụzọ maka ya isonye NATO yana Europenan Union in Strumica, Macedonia Septemba 30, 2018.

rows.source: In front of parliament in Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, 54, was preparing a small stage and pulling up chairs in front of tents set up by those who will boycott the referendum.
rows.output: N'ihu nzuko omeiwu na Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov, 54, na-akwado obere ogbo ma na-ebuli oche n'ihu ogige ndị e tere mmanụ nke ndị ga-akpaghasị ntuli aka.
rows.reference: N’ihu nke nzụkọ ọmeiwu na Skopje, Vladimir Kavardarkov 54, nọ na akwadobe obere nyiwe, na ebute oche n’ihu ụlọ akanya nke ndị chọrọ igbochi nhọpụta ahụ tọrọ.

rows.source: "We are for NATO and EU, but we want to join with our heads up, not through the service door" Kavadarkov said.
rows.output: Anyị dị maka NATO na EU, mana anyị chọrọ isonye na anyị na-ebuli isi anyị, ọ bụghị site n'ọnụ ụzọ ọrụ. Kavadarkov kwuru.
rows.reference: “Anyị kwụnyere NATO na EU, mana anyị chọrọ iji ugwu wee banye, ọbụghị site n’ụzọ ọrụ” Kavadarkov kwuru.

rows.source: "We are a poor country, but we do have dignity.
rows.output: Anyị bụ obodo dara ogbenye, ma anyị ka nwere ọkwa.
rows.reference: “Anyị bụ obodo na enweghị ego, mana anyị nwere ugwu.

rows.source: If they don't want to take us as Macedonia, we can turn to others like China and Russia and become part of Euro-Asia integration."
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ha achọghị ịnakwere anyị dị ka Macedonia, anyị nwere ike ịgakwuru ndị ọzọ dị ka China na Russia wee bụrụ akụkụ nke Euro-Asia integration.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ha achọghị ịnabata anyị ka Macedonia, anyị nwere ike ịchọ ndị ọzọ dị ka China na Russia ma bụrụ akụkụ nke ngwakọta Euro-Asia.”

rows.source: Prime Minister Zaev says NATO membership will bring much needed investment to Macedonia, which has an unemployment rate of more than 20 percent.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Zaev kwuru na ndị otu NATO ga-eweta itinye ego nke ọma na Macedonia, nke nwere ọnụ ọgụgụ enweghị ọrụ karịrị 20%.
rows.reference: Praịm Minista Zaev kwuru nsonye NATO ga-ebute ntinye ego achọrọ na Macedonia, nke nwere oke enweghị ọrụ karịrị pasentị 20.

rows.source: "I believe the huge majority will be in favor because more than 80 percent of our citizens are in favor of EU and NATO," Zaev said after casting his ballot.
rows.output: "Kweere m na nnukwu ọtụtụ mmadụ ga-akwado ya n'ihi na ihe karịrị pasentị iri asatọ nke ụmụ amaala anyị na-akwado EU na NATO," Zaev kwuru mgbe ọ gara ịtụ vootu.
rows.reference: “Ekwenyere m n’ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ ga-amasị ya n’ihi karịa pasentị 80 nke ndị amaala anyị chọrọ EU na NATO,” Zaev kwuru ka ọ tụchara akwụkwọ ya.

rows.source: He said that a "yes" result would be "confirmation of our future."
rows.output: O kwuru na "ee" ga-abụ "ikwenye nke ọdịnihu anyị."
rows.reference: O kwuru na nsonaazụ “ee” ga-abụ “nkwenye nke ọdịnihu anyị.”

rows.source: A poll published last Monday by Macedonia's Institute for Policy Research said between 30 and 43 percent of voters would take part in the referendum - below the required turnout.
rows.output: N'izu gara aga, ụlọ ọrụ Macedonia maka nyocha amụma kwuru na pasentị iri atọ ruo iri anọ na atọ n'ime ndị ntuli aka ga-ekere òkè na ntuli aka - n'okpuru ọnụ ọgụgụ achọrọ.
rows.reference: Nyocha ebipụtara na Mọnde gara aga sitere n’aka Ewumewu maka Nyocha Iwu nke Macedonia kwuru n’etiti pasentị 30 na 43 nke ndị ntuli aka ga-esonye na nhọpụta ahụ - na erughi mpụta achọrọ.

rows.source: Another poll, conducted by Macedonia's Telma TV, found 57 percent of respondents planning to vote on Sunday.
rows.output: Mkpebi ọzọ, nke Telma TV nke Macedonia mere, chọpụtara na 57 pasent nke ndị a jụrụ ajụjụ na-eme atụmatụ ịtụ vootu na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Nyocha ọzọ, Telma TV nke Macedonia mere, hụrụ na pasentị 57 nke ndị nzaghachi na ahazi ituli aka na Sọnde.

rows.source: Of those, 70 percent said they would vote yes.
rows.output: N'ime ha, pasentị iri asaa kwuru na ha ga-atụ vootu ee.
rows.reference: Na nke ahụ, pasentị 70 kwuru na ha ga-atụnye ee.

rows.source: For the referendum to be successful turnout needs to be 50 percent plus one vote.
rows.output: Iji mee ntuli aka ka ihe ịga nke ọma, a ga-enwerịrị 50 pasentị na otu votu.
rows.reference: Ka nhọpụta ahụ gaa nke ọma ndị ga-apụta kwesịrị ịbụ pasentị 50 gbakwunye otu ntuli aka.

rows.source: A failure in the referendum would represent the first serious blow to policy of the pro-Western government since it took over in May last year.
rows.output: Mmeri n'ọgbakọ ahụ ga-egosi mmeri mbụ dị mkpa nye amụma nke ọchịchị nke na-akwado ndịda ọwụwa anyanwụ kemgbe ọ malitere n'ọnwa Mee afọ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ọdịda na nhọpụta ahụ ga-egosi nnukwu nsogbu izizi maka iwu nke gọọmentị na akwado ndị Odịda Anyanwụ kemgbe ọ nọchiri na Mey afọ gara aga.

rows.source: Watch: Manchester City's Sergio Aguero navigates through entire Brighton defense for goal
rows.output: Nleba anya: Sergio Aguero nke Manchester City na-agagharị n'ime nchekwa nchekwa nke Brighton ni nkenke
rows.reference: Lelee: Sergio Aguero nke Manchester City gafere ndị defensị Brighton niile maka goolu

rows.source: Sergio Aguero and Raheem Sterling dispatched of the Brighton defense in Manchester City's 2-0 win on Saturday at Etihad Stadium in Manchester, England.
rows.output: Sergio Aguero na Raheem Sterling mebiri nchekwa Brighton na mmeri Manchester City 2-0 na Satọde na Etihad Stadium na Manchester, England.
rows.reference: Sergio Aguero na Raheem Sterling tufuru defensị Brighton na mmeri 2-0 nke Manchester City na Satọde na Ama Egwuregwu Etihad na Manchester, England.

rows.source: Aguero made it look ridiculously easy on his score in the 65th minute.
rows.output: Aguero mere ka ọ dị mfe n'akara ya na nkeji iri isii na ise.
rows.reference: Aguero mere ka ọ dị nnukwu mfe iji nye goolu na nkeji nke 65.

rows.source: The Argentine striker received a pass at midfield at the start of the sequence.
rows.output: Onye ọkpọ egwuregwu Argentine nwetara ịgba bọọlụ n'etiti etiti n'oge mmalite nke usoro ahụ.
rows.reference: Strịka nwa Argentina ahụ nwetara bọọlụ n’etiti ama egwuregwu na mbido nke usoro ahụ.

rows.source: He raced between three Brighton defenders, before slashing into the open field.
rows.output: Ọ gbara ọsọ n'etiti ndị na-eche nche Brighton atọ, tupu ọ gbasaa n'ọhịa mepere emepe.
rows.reference: Ọ gbara ọsọ n’etiti defensi Brighton atọ, tupu ọ gbabanye n’ogige mepere emepe.

rows.source: Aguero then found himself surrounded by four green shirts.
rows.output: Mgbe ahụ, a chọtara Aguero gburugburu uwe elu akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ anọ.
rows.reference: Aguero hụrụ onwe ya ka ndị yi uwe elu na acha agba akwụkwọ ndụ gbara ya okirikiri.

rows.source: He pushed around one defender before outrunning several more at the edge of the Brighton box.
rows.output: O ji ụzọ onye nche otu tupu ịgafe ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ n'akụkụ nke ọma nke igbe Brighton.
rows.reference: Ọ kwapụrụ otu defensị tupu ọ gbanarị ọtụtụ ndị ọzọ n’isi nke bọksị Brighton.

rows.source: He then pushed a pass to his left, finding Sterling.
rows.output: M wee gaa n'aka ekpe, chọtara Sterling.
rows.reference: Mgbe ahụ ọ gbara bọọlụ n’akaekpe ya, chọta Sterling.

rows.source: The English forward used his first touch in the box to give the ball back to Aguero, who used his right boot to beat Brighton keeper Mathew Ryan with a shot into the right side of the net.
rows.output: Onye ọkpọ egwuregwu Bekee ji ụkwụ mbụ ya n'ime igbe ahụ nyeghachi bọọlụ ahụ n'aka Aguero, onye ji ụkwụ aka nri ya kụgbuo goolu n'akụkụ aka nri nke net.
rows.reference: Nwa Bekee ahụ jiri mmetụ izizi ya n’ime bọksị ahụ iji nyeghachi Aguero bọọlụ ahụ, onye nke ji akpụkpụ ụkwụ akanri ya iji gafere kipa Brighton bụ Mathew Ryan site na iji otu ọgbụgba gara n’akụkụ akanri nke net ahụ.

rows.source: "Aguero is struggling with some problems in his feet," City manager Pep Guardiola told reporters.
rows.output: "Ọgwụgwụ na-agbasi mbọ ike na ụfọdụ nsogbu na ụkwụ ya," onye njikwa Pep Guardiola gwara ndị nta akụkọ.
rows.reference: “Aguero nwere ụfọdụ nsogbu n’ụkwụ ya,” Onye njikwa City Pep Guardiola gwara ndị nta akụkọ.

rows.source: "We spoke about him playing 55, 60 minutes.
rows.output: Anyị kwuru banyere ya na-egwu nkeji iri ise na ise, iri isii.
rows.reference: “Anyị kwuru maka ya ịgba ya nkeji 55, 60.

rows.source: That's what happened.
rows.output: Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere.

rows.source: We were lucky he scored a goal in that moment."
rows.output: Anyị nwere chioma na ọ gbara bọọlụ n'oge ahụ.
rows.reference: Anyị nwere ihu ọma na ọ nyere goolu ahụ n’oge ahụ.”

rows.source: But it was Sterling who gave the Sky Blues the initial advantage in the Premier League scuffle.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ Sterling bụ onye nyere ndị na-acha anụnụ anụnụ ohere mbụ na asọmpi Premier.
rows.reference: Mana ọ bụ Sterling bụ onye nyere Sky Blues uru izizi na asọmpi Premier League.

rows.source: That goal came in the 29th minute.
rows.output: Ebumnuche ahụ bịara na nkeji iri abụọ na itoolu.
rows.reference: Goolu ahụ bịara na nkeji 29.

rows.source: Aguero received the ball deep in Brighton territory on that play.
rows.output: Aguero nwetara bọọlụ n'ime ala Brighton n'oge egwuregwu ahụ.
rows.reference: Aguero nwetara bọọlụ n’ime ogige Brighton n’egwuregwu ahụ.

rows.source: He sent a beautiful through ball along the left flank to Leroy Sane.
rows.output: O zipụrụ bọọlụ mara mma n'akụkụ aka ekpe ruo Sane.
rows.reference: O zigara ọmarịcha bọọlụ n’akụkụ akaekpe gakwuru Leroy Sane.

rows.source: Sane took a few touches before leading Sterling toward the far post.
rows.output: Sane were ụfọdụ mmetụ aka tupu ọ duzie Sterling gaa n'akụkụ dị anya nke post ahụ.
rows.reference: Sane metụrụ ya ole ma ole tupu o duru Sterling gaa n’isi post ahụ.

rows.source: The Sky Blues forward tapped the ball into the net just before sliding out of bounds.
rows.output: Onye n'ihu Sky Blues kụrụ bọọlụ ahụ n'ime net n'oge na-adịghị anya tupu ọ pụọ n'ókè.
rows.reference: Onye ihu Sky Blues ahụ kụbanyere bọọlụ ahụ n’ime net tupu ọ mịpụ n’ogige atọrọ.

rows.source: City battles Hoffenheim in Champions League group play at 12:55 p.m. on Tuesday at Rhein-Neckar-Arena in Sinsheim, Germany.
rows.output: Ndị otu ahụ na-egwu megide Hoffenheim na egwuregwu Champions League nke otu na elekere 12:55 nke ụtụtụ Tuzdee na Rhein-Neckar-Arena na Sinsheim, Germany.
rows.reference: City ga-ezute Hoffenheim n’ọkwa izizi nke Champions League na 12:55 ehihie, na Tusde na Rhein-Neckar-Arena dị na Sinsheim, Germany.

rows.source: Scherzer wants to play spoiler vs. Rockies
rows.output: Scherzer chọrọ ịkpata nsogbu megide Rockies
rows.reference: Scherzer chọrọ izute spoiler vs. Rockies

rows.source: With the Nationals eliminated from playoff contention, there wasn't much reason to force another start.
rows.output: N'ịbụ ndị Nnọchiteanya kagburu n'ọsọ asọmpi, ọ dịghị ihe mere ha ga-eji mee ka ha maliteghachi.
rows.reference: Ka ewepuru Nationals na asọmpi onye mmeri, enweghịzị ihe ga-eme iji kwanye mbido ọzọ.

rows.source: But the ever-competitive Scherzer hopes to take the mound on Sunday against the Colorado Rockies, but only if there are still playoff implications for the Rockies, who hold a one-game lead over the Los Angeles Dodgers in the NL West.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ asọmpi Scherzer na-aga n'ihu na-atụ anya ịmalite n'ụbọchị Sọnde megide ndị Rockies nke Colorado, ma ọ bụrụ na enwere ihe na-emetụta egwuregwu playoff maka ndị Rockies, bụ ndị na-edu otu egwuregwu n'ọkwa NL West nke Los Angeles Dodgers.
rows.reference: Mana onye nnukwu asọmpi Scherzer na atụ anya irigo akwa na Sọnde n’egwuregwu yana Colorado Rockies, mana naanị ma ọ bụrụ na enwere ndapụta egwuregwu onye mmeri maka Rockies, ndị ji otu mmeri egwuregwu n’elu Los Angeles Dodgers na NL West.

rows.source: The Rockies clinched at least a wild-card spot with a 5-2 win over the Nationals on Friday night, but are still looking to lock up their first division title.
rows.output: Ndị Rockies jiri mmeri 5-2 merie ndị Naijiria na Fraịde abalị, ma ha ka na-achọ ịkwado aha otu ha.
rows.reference: Rochies ritere opekata mpe ohere kaadị nhọrọ site na iji mmeri 5-2 n’elu Nationals n’abalị Fraịde, mana ha ka na achọ ịkwechiri iko ngalaba izizi ha.

rows.source: "Even though we're playing for nothing, at least we can be able to toe the rubber knowing that the atmosphere here in Denver with the crowd and the other team would be playing at probably the highest level of any point I would face this year.
rows.output: Ọbụna mgbe anyị na-egwu ihe efu, ma ọ dịkarịa ala, anyị ga-enwe ike ịkụtu rọba ahụ na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-ama jijiji na-
rows.reference: “Ọbụlagodi na anyị enweghi ihe anyị na achụ, opekata mpe anyị nwere ike igwu egwu mara na okirikiri ebe a na Denver dị n’etiti igwe mmadụ yana ndị otu ndị ọzọ ga-abụ igwu egwuregwu dị n’ọkwa kachasị n’oge ọ bụla m ga-ezute n’afọ a.

rows.source: Why wouldn't I want to compete in that?"
rows.output: Gịnị mere m ga-eji achọghị ịsọ mpi n’nke ahụ?
rows.reference: Gịnị kpatara na m agaghị achọ isonye na nke ahụ?”

rows.source: The Nationals have yet to announce a starter for Sunday, but are reportedly inclined to let Scherzer pitch in such a situation.
rows.output: Ndị Ntọala ahụ emebeghị ka ha kwupụta onye na-amalite maka Sọnde, mana a na-ekwu na ha na-achọ ka Scherzer pụta n'ọnọdụ dị otú ahụ.
rows.reference: Ndị Nationals ka na eche ikwupute onye mbido maka Sọnde, mana ekpesara na dabere na Scherzer tinye ọnụ n’ọnọdụ ahụ.

rows.source: Scherzer, who would be making his 34th start, threw a bullpen session on Thursday and would be pitching on his normal rest Sunday.
rows.output: Scherzer, onye ga-emecha malite nke iri atọ na anọ, tụbara nnọkọ ọzụzụ na Tọzdee ma ga-atụba na nkwụsị ya na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Scherzer, onye nke ga-eme mbido nke 34 ya, tinyere oge mgbatị ahụ na Tọsde, ọ ga-atụ bọọlụ na Sọnde bụ oge izu ike ya.

rows.source: The Washington right-hander is 18-7 with a 2.53 ERA and 300 strikeouts in 220 2/3 innings this season.
rows.output: Onye na-eme egwuregwu n'aka nri Washington dị afọ 18-7 nwere 2.53 ERA na 300 strikeouts na innings 220 2/3 n'oge a.
rows.reference: Onye akanri nke Washington bụ 18-7 nwere 2.53 ERA yana nkụpụta 300 na ịnịns 220 2/3 n’afo a.

rows.source: Trump rallies in West Virginia
rows.output: Mgbakọ Trump na West Virginia
rows.reference: Trump gbakọrọ ọhaneze na West Virginia

rows.source: The President obliquely referred to the situation surrounding his Supreme Court pick Brett Kavanaugh while talking about the importance of Republican turnout in the midterm elections.
rows.output: Onye isi ala zoro aka na ọnọdụ gbara nhọpụta Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu ya, Brett Kavanaugh, mgbe ọ na-ekwu maka mkpa ọ dị ịtụ vootu ndị Republican na ntuli aka etiti oge.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala rụtụrụ aka n’ụzọ ọzọ n’ọnọdụ ahụ metụtara nhọpụta Brett Kavanaugh maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị ebe ọ na ekwu maka mkpa nke mpụta ndị Repọblikan na ntuli aka etiti afọ.

rows.source: "All of what we've done is at stake in November.
rows.output: "Ọ dịghịkwa nke ihe anyị mere ga-efunahụ na Nọvemba.
rows.reference: “Ihe niile anyị megoro nwere ike imebisi na Nọvemba.

rows.source: Five weeks away from one of the most important elections in our lifetimes.
rows.output: Izu ise pụọ na otu n'ime ntuli aka kachasị mkpa ná ndụ anyị.
rows.reference: Izu ise fọdụrụ tupu otu ntuli aka kachasị mkpa na ndụ anyị.

rows.source: This is one of the big, big -- I'm not running but I'm really running that's why I'm all over the place fighting for great candidates," he said.
rows.output: Nke a bụ otu n'ime nnukwu, nnukwu -- Abụghị m onye na-agba ọsọ mana m na-agba ọsọ n'ezie nke ahụ bụ ihe mere m ji nọrọ ebe niile na-alụ ọgụ maka ndị na-eme ntuli aka mara mma," o kwuru.
rows.reference: Nke a bụ otu n’ime ihe ndị buru ibu, buru ibu -- anaghị m apụta mana m na apụta ya mere m ji nọrọ n’ebe niile na alụ ọgụ maka ndị ahọpụtara mara oke mma, “o kwuru.

rows.source: Trump continued, "You see this horrible, horrible radical group of Democrats, you see it happening right now.
rows.output: Ọzọkwa, ị na-ahụ otu ndị na-eme ihe ike, ndị na-eme ihe ike, ị na-ahụ ya ugbu a.
rows.reference: Trump gara n’ihu, “Ị hụrụ otu ndị nnupu isi a jọrọ oke njọ bụ Demokrats, ị na ahụ ka ọ na eme ugbu a.

rows.source: And they're determined to take back power by using any means necessary, you see the meanness, the nastiness.
rows.output: Ọ na-achọsi ike iweghachite ike site n'iji ụzọ ọ bụla eme ihe, ị hụla obi ọjọọ, iwe iwe.
rows.reference: Ha gbadosiri anya ike na iweghachi ike site n’ụzọ ọ bụla enwere ike, ị hụrụ obi akpọ ha, omume ọjọọ ahụ.

rows.source: They don't care who they hurt, who they have to run over in order to get power and control, that's what they want is power and control, we're not going to give it to them."
rows.output: Ha anaghị echegbu onwe ha maka onye ha na-emerụ, onye ha ga-erute n’ala iji nweta ike na njikwa, nke ahụ bụ ihe ha chọrọ, ike na njikwa, anyị agaghị enye ha."
rows.reference: Ha achọghị ịma onye ha mejọrọ, onye ha ga-arị elu iji nweta ike na njikwa, nke ahụ bụ ihe ha chọrọ ike na njikwa, anyị agaghị enye ha ya.”

rows.source: Democrats, he said, are on a mission to "resist and obstruct."
rows.output: Ndị Democrats, o kwuru, na-aga n'ụlọ mkpọrọ na "ịjụ na igbochi."
rows.reference: Demokrats, o kwuru, nọ na njem iji “gbochie ma kwụchibido.”

rows.source: "And you see that over the last four days," he said, calling the Democrats "angry and mean and nasty and untruthful."
rows.output: Ọ na-ekwu, na-akpọ ndị Democrats "iwe iwe na iwe iwe na iwe iwe na ụgha."
rows.reference: “Ma ị hụrụ n’ofe ụbọchị anọ gara aga,” o kwuru, na akpọ ndị Demokrats “ndị iwe, obi akpọ, ndị njọ yana ndị na anaghị ekwu eziokwu.’

rows.source: He referenced Senate Judiciary Committee ranking Democratic Sen. Dianne Feinstein by name, which received loud boos from the audience.
rows.output: O kwuru okwu banyere onye otu kọmitii ikpe ziri ezi nke Senate, onye isi ndị Democrats bụ Sen. Dianne Feinstein, nke mere ka ndị na-ege ntị na-eti mkpu.
rows.reference: Ọ kpọrọ aha Demokrat dị elu Ọmeiwu Dianne Feinstein nke Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu, nke nwetere nnukwu mkpu n’aka ndị igwe mmadụ ahụ.

rows.source: "Remember her answer?
rows.output: "Cheta azịza ya?
rows.reference: “Ịchetara azịza ya?

rows.source: Did you leak the document?
rows.output: Ị sachara akwụkwọ ahụ?
rows.reference: I kpughepuru akwụkwọ ahụ?

rows.source: Uh, uh, what.
rows.output: Ụfọdụ, gịnị.
rows.reference: Uh, uh, gịnị.

rows.source: No, uh no, I wait one - that was really bad body language - the worst body language I've ever seen."
rows.output: Ee, ee, m na-echere otu - nke ahụ bụ asụsụ ahụ nke ukwuu - asụsụ ahụ kacha njọ m hụtụrụla.
rows.reference: Mba, uh mba, m chere otu - enwere ngosi ahụ jọrọ njọ - ngosi ahụ kachasị njọ m hụgoro.”

rows.source: Labour is no longer a broad church.
rows.output: Igbo: Ọrụ anaghịzi abụ ụka sara mbara.
rows.reference: Labour abughịzị ụka gbasara agbasa.

rows.source: It is intolerant of those who speak their minds
rows.output: Ọ dị njọ nye ndị na-ekwu okwu ha
rows.reference: Ọ naghị anabata ndị na ekwu uche ha

rows.source: When Momentum's activists in my local party voted to censure me, it was hardly a surprise.
rows.output: Mgbe ndị na-akwado Momentum nọ n'òtù pati m nke obodo m kpebiri ịkatọ m, ọ bụghị ihe ijuanya.
rows.reference: Mgbe ndị nkwụgide Momentum nọ na ndọrọndọrọ mpaghara m tụnyere aka ka adachie ọnụ m, ọ bụghị ihe ntụmadị.

rows.source: After all, I'm the latest in a line of Labour MPs to be told we are not welcome - all for speaking our minds.
rows.output: Mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị, abụ m onye kacha ọhụrụ n'ahịrị ndị omeiwu ọrụ ndị a gwara na anyị anabataghị - ihe niile maka ikwu echiche anyị.
rows.reference: Elee anya, abụ onye nke kachasị ọhụrụ n’ahịrị nke MP ndị Labour agwara na anabataghị - naanị maka ikwu uche anyị.

rows.source: My parliamentary colleague Joan Ryan received similar treatment because she resolutely stood up to antisemitism.
rows.output: Onye otu mgbakọ mgbakọ nke Joan Ryan natara otu ọgwụgwọ ahụ n'ihi na o ji nkwanye ugwu megide ịkpọasị ndị Juu.
rows.reference: Ka onye otu m na nzụkọ ọmeiwu Joan Ryan nwetara otu omume ahụ n’ihi na ọ kwụdosiri ike n’ịjụ semitism.

rows.source: In my case, the censure motion criticised me for disagreeing with Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.output: N'okwu m, iwu a na-akatọ m maka ịghara ịkwado Jeremy Corbyn.
rows.reference: N’okwu nke m, ntimiwu mgbochi ahụ katọrọ m maka ịjụ Jeremy Corbyn.

rows.source: On the importance of a responsible economic policy, on national security, on Europe, ironically similar issues on which Jeremy disagreed with previous leaders.
rows.output: N'ihe gbasara mkpa iwu na-eme ihe n'ụzọ ziri ezi, n'ihe gbasara nchekwa obodo, n'ihe gbasara Europe, n'ụzọ ọchị, okwu ndị yiri nke ahụ bụ́ ndị Jeremy na-ekwenyeghị na ndị isi gara aga.
rows.reference: Na mkpa nke iwu akụnụba obodo ziri ezi, nche obodo, yana Europe, n’ụzọ ọzọ otu nsogbu ndị Jeremy jiri na ekwenyeghị na ndị isi gara aga.

rows.source: The notice for the Nottingham East Labour meeting on Friday stated that "we want the meetings to be inclusive and productive."
rows.output: Nkwuputa maka ọgbakọ Nottingham East Labour na Fraịde kwuru na "anyị chọrọ ka ọgbakọ ahụ gụnyere ma na-arụpụta ihe."
rows.reference: Ọkwa maka nzụkọ Nottingham East Labour na Fraịde kwuru na “anyị chọrọ nzụkọ ndị ahụ bụrụ nke dum ma mịpụta mkpụrụ.”

rows.source: For most of my eight years as the local Labour MP, the Friday night GC meetings have been exactly that.
rows.output: N'ime ọtụtụ n'ime afọ asatọ m dị ka onye omebe iwu ọrụ obodo, ọgbakọ GC Friday abalị e mere nke ọma.
rows.reference: N’imirikiti afọ asatọ m ka MP Labour mpaghara ahụ, abalị Fraịde nzụkọ GC na abụkarị nke ahụ.

rows.source: Sadly today, it is not the tone of many meetings and the promise of "kinder, gentler" politics has long been forgotten if, indeed, it ever began.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị mwute, taa, ọ bụghị ụda nke ọtụtụ nzukọ na nkwa nke "kinder, gentler" ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị agafebeghị ogologo oge ma ọ bụrụ na ọ malitere n'ezie.
rows.reference: Na mwute taa, ọ bụghị olu nke imirikiti nzụkọ yana ndọrọndọrọ “obi ọma, ume ala” ekwere na nkwa bụ ihe ndị echefugoro kemgbe ma ọ bụrụ, n’ezie, o bidoro ma ncha.

rows.source: It has become increasingly apparent that differing views are not tolerated in the Labour party and every opinion is judged on whether it is acceptable to the party leadership.
rows.output: N'ikpeazụ, ọ dị ka ọ dị mkpa ka echiche dị iche iche adịghị anabata n'òtù Labour, na a na-enyocha echiche ọ bụla dabere ma ọ dị mma maka ndị isi otu ahụ.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ihe pụtara ihie nke ukwuu na anaghị anabata nghọta dị iche iche na ndọrọndọrọ Labour, ọzọkwa a na ekpezi echiche ọ bụla ma a ga-anabata ya n’ọchịchị ndọrọndọrọ ahụ.

rows.source: This started shortly after Jeremy became leader, as colleagues with whom I had previously thought I shared a similar political outlook began expecting me to do a U-turn and take positions I would never have otherwise agreed with - whether on national security or the EU single market.
rows.output: Nke a malitere n'oge na-adịghị anya ka Jeremy ghọrọ onye ndu, ka ndị ọrụ ibe mụ na ndị m chere na m na-ekerịta echiche ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị malitere ịtụ anya ka m mee mgbanwe U na were ọnọdụ ndị agaghị m enwe nkwekọrịta - ma ọ̀ bụ nchekwa mba ma ọ bụ ahịa EU.
rows.reference: Nke a bidoro ozugbo Jeremy bụrụ onye isi, ndị ọrụ ibe m, ndị m chere na mụ na ha na ekekọrịta otu nghọta ndọrọndọrọ bidoro tụba anya na m ga-atụgharị ozugbo ma were ọnọdụ ndị m ga-agaghị ekwekọrịta na ya otu ọ bụla - ma ọ bụ na nchedo obodo ma ọ bụ otu ahịa EU.

rows.source: Whenever I speak publicly - and it doesn't really matter what I say - there follows a tirade of abuse on social media calling for deselection, denouncing the politics of the centre, telling me I should not be in the Labour party.
rows.output: Mgbe ọ bụla m na-ekwu okwu n'ihu ọha - ọbụna na ọ naghị adị mkpa ihe m na-ekwu - ụjọ na-eti mkpu na mgbasa ozi ọha na eze na-akpọ ka a wepụ m, na-akatọ ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị nke etiti, na-agwa m na ekwesịghị m ịnọ na pati Labour.
rows.reference: Mgbe ọ bụla m kwuru okwu n’ọhaneze - ọ gaghị agbasata ihe m kwuru - a na enwe nkwụtọ dị ukwuu na esote ozugbo n’ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze na akpọ maka mwepu, nkatọ ndọrọndọrọ nke etiti, na agwa m na m ekwesịghị ịnọ na ndọrọndọrọ Labour.

rows.source: And that is not just my experience.
rows.output: Ọ dịghịkwa ka ahụmahụ m.
rows.reference: Ma nke a abụghị naanị m.

rows.source: Indeed, I know I am more fortunate than some of my colleagues as the comments directed at me tend to be political.
rows.output: N'ezie, amaara m na m tozuru oke karịa ụfọdụ ndị ọrụ ibe m, dịka okwu ndị a na-ekwu m na-adịkarị ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị.
rows.reference: N’ezie, ama m na m ka nwee ihu ọma karịa ụfọdụ ndị ọrụ ibe m n’ihi asịsa ndị ezitere m na abụkarị maka ndọrọndọrọ.

rows.source: I am in awe of the professionalism and determination of those colleagues who face a torrent of sexist or racist abuse every day but never shy away.
rows.output: Ana m mụmụọ ọnụ ọchị maka ọkachamara na mkpebi siri ike nke ndị ọrụ ibe m nwere onwe ha na-eche ọtụtụ okwu nwoke na nwanyị ma ọ bụ okwu ọjọọ ihu kwa ụbọchị ma ha anaghị echegbu onwe ha.
rows.reference: Enwere m ntụmanya n’arụmọrụ na mkpebi nke ndị ọrụ ibe m ndị ahụ na enweta nkatọ okike mmadụ ma ọ bụ agbụrụ ya kwa ụbọchị mana ha anaghị agba ọsọ.

rows.source: One of the most disappointing aspects of this era of politics is how levels of abuse have become normalised.
rows.output: Otu n'ime akụkụ kachasị mwute nke oge a nke ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị bụ otú ọkwa nke mmetọ si bụrụ nke a na-anabata.
rows.reference: Otu n’ime akụkụ kachasị ada mmụọ nke oge ndọrọndọrọ a bụ otu okwu nkatọ ndị jọrọ njọ si buru ihe nkịtị.

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn claimed last week that the Labour party should foster a culture of tolerance.
rows.output: Jeremy Corbyn kwuru n'izu gara aga na ndị otu Labour kwesịrị ịkwalite omenala nkwanye ùgwù.
rows.reference: Jeremy Corbyn na arịọ n’izu gara aga na ndọrọndọrọ Labour kwesịrị ịmụta omume nke ndidi.

rows.source: The reality is we are no longer that broad church and with every "no-confidence" motion or change of selection rules the party becomes narrower.
rows.output: Ihe eziokwu bụ na anyị anọghịzi n'ụlọ ụka ahụ buru ibu, na n'ọnọdụ ọ bụla nke "enweghị ntụkwasị obi" ma ọ bụ mgbanwe nke iwu nhọpụta, pati ahụ na-aghọ obere.
rows.reference: Eziokwu bụ na anyị abụghịzị ụka ahụ gbasara agbasa, kwa ụkpụrụ “enweghị ntụkwasị obi” ọ bụla ma ọ bụ mgbanwe nke iwu nhọrọ, ndọrọndọrọ ahụ na akpụkọkwa akpụkọ.

rows.source: I have had lots of advice over the past two years urging me to keep my head down, not to be so vocal and then I would "be all right."
rows.output: N'ime afọ abụọ gara aga, enweela m ndụmọdụ dị ukwuu na-akwado m ka m kpuchie isi m, ka m ghara ikwu okwu nke ukwuu, na mgbe ahụ, a ga- "eme m nke ọma."
rows.reference: Enwere m ọtụtụ ndụmọdụ n’ofe afọ abụọ gara aga na agwa m ka m owe isi n’ala, ịhapụ ikwu oke okwu mgbe ahụ ‘m agaghị enwe nsogbu.”

rows.source: But that is not what I came into politics to do.
rows.output: Ma a sị na ọ bụghị ihe m si n'ọchịchị bịa.
rows.reference: Mana nke ahụ abụghị ihe m banyere ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị ịme.

rows.source: Ever since I joined Labour 32 years ago as a school pupil, provoked by the Thatcher government's neglect that had left my comprehensive school classroom literally falling down, I've sought to champion better public services for those who need them most - whether as a local councillor or government minister.
rows.output: N'ime afọ 32 gara aga, mgbe m sonyere ndị Labour dị ka nwa akwụkwọ ụlọ akwụkwọ, nke ọchịchị Thatcher kpatara n'ihi ịghara ilekọta ya nke hapụrụ klaasị ụlọ akwụkwọ m ka ọ daa, m na-achọ mgbe niile ịkwalite ọrụ ọha maka ndị chọrọ ha nke ukwuu - ma dị ka onye otu kansụl obodo ma ọ bụ onye ozi gọọmentị.
rows.reference: Kemgbe m sonyere Labour afọ 32 ka nwa akwụkwọ, nke nlegharị anya gọọmentị Thatcher kpalitere, nke hapụrụ ime ụlọ akwụkwọ m na nnukwu mmebi, achọrọ m na mbụ idu ọrụ mara mma nke ọhaneze maka ndị kachasị chọọ ha - ma abụ m onye ndu obere mpaghara ma ọ bụ minista gọọmentị.

rows.source: I have never hidden my politics, including at the last election.
rows.output: Akpọgidere m mma n'ọrụ ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị m, gụnyere na ntuli aka ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: Ezobeghị m ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị m na mbụ, gụnyere ntuli aka ikpeazụ.

rows.source: No one in Nottingham East could have been in any way confused about my policy positions and areas of disagreement with the current leadership.
rows.output: Onweghi onye n'ala Nottingham East nke nwere ike iche na o nwere mgbagwoju anya banyere echiche m na iwu na ebe m na-emegide ndu ugbua.
rows.reference: Ọnweghị onye ọ bụla nọ na Nottingham East ga-enwe mgbagwoju anya gbasara ọnọdụ iwu m yana mpaghara ndị mụ ekwenyeghị n’ọchịchị dị ugbu a.

rows.source: To those who promoted the motion on Friday, all I would say is that when the country is ploughing towards a Brexit that will hurt households, businesses and our public services, I do not understand the desire to waste time and energy on my loyalty to the Labour party leader.
rows.output: N'ime ndị na-akwado iwu a na Fraịde, ihe niile m ga-ekwu bụ na mgbe obodo ahụ na-akwọ ụgbọala n'ụzọ Brexit nke ga-akụda ezinụlọ, azụmahịa na ọrụ ọha, amaghị m ihe na-akpali ọchịchọ ịkwụsị oge na ike m na ịdị nsọ na onye ndu otu Labour.
rows.reference: Maka ndị ahụ kwadoro ụkpụrụ ahụ na Fraịde, ihe niile m nwere ike ikwu bụ na mgbe obodo na aga ịnwe Brexit ga-enwe mmetụta adịghị mma n’ọtụtụ ezinụlọ, azụmahịa na ọrụ ọhaneze anyị, aghọtaghị m agụụ iji gbuo oge na ike maka nkwado m na ndị isi ndọrọndọrọ Labour.

rows.source: But really the one message I have is not to Nottingham Momentum, it is to my constituents, whether Labour members or not: I am proud to serve you and I promise that no amount of deselection threats or political expediency will deter me from acting in what I believe are the best interests of you all.
rows.output: Ma na-ekwu n'ezie na ozi m bụghị na Nottingham Momentum, ọ bụ na ndị m na-anọchite anya, ma ọ bụ Labour ma ọ bụ na ọ bụghị: enwere m mpako ịrụ ọrụ gị ma na-ekwe nkwa na ọ nweghị ọnụ ọgụgụ nke ịhọrọ ịhọrọ ma ọ bụ ịdị njikere ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị ga-egbochi m ịrụ ọrụ nke m kwenyere na ọ bụ n'ọdịmma gị
rows.reference: Mana n’eziokwu otu ozi m nwere abụghị maka Nottingham Momentum, ọ bụ maka ndị mmebe m, ma ọ bụ ndị otu Labour ma ha abụghị: Enwere m afọ ojuju ijere unu ozi ma na ekwe nkwa na ọnweghị ihe egwu mwepu ole ma ọ bụ ngwangwa ndọrọndọrọ ga-akwụsị m ịme ihe m kwere kachasị dịịrị unu niile mma.

rows.source: Chris Leslie is MP for Nottingham East
rows.output: Chris Leslie bụ onye omebe iwu maka Nottingham East
rows.reference: Chris Leslie bụ MP maka Nottingham East

rows.source: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Unbeaten Ayr go top
rows.output: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Unbeaten Ayr na-aga n'elu
rows.reference: Ayr 38 - 17 Melrose: Ayr na ahụbeghị ọdịda agaala n’isi

rows.source: Two late tries may have skewed the final result somewhat, but there is no doubt Ayr deserved to triumph in this wonderfully-entertaining Tennent's Premiership match of the day.
rows.output: Mgbalị abụọ na-echere nwere ike imebi nsonaazụ ikpeazụ ntakịrị, mana enweghị obi abụọ na Ayr kwesịrị imeri n'asọmpi Tennent's Premiership na-atọ ụtọ nke ụbọchị.
rows.reference: Ọnwụnwa abụọ na abịaghị n’oge emebiela nsonaazụ ikpeazụ obere, mana enweghị mgbagha na Ayr kwesịrị imeri na asọmpi nke taa Tennent’s Premiership a tọrọ oke ụtọ.

rows.source: They now top the table, the only unbeaten side of the ten.
rows.output: Ugbu a, ha na-achị tebụl ahụ, naanị otu na-enweghị mmeri n'ime iri.
rows.reference: Ugbu a ha nọ n’isi tebul, naanị otu ndị emeribeghị n’asọmpi iri.

rows.source: In the end, it was their superior defence, as much as their better chance-taking, which carried the home side and coach Peter Murchie had every right to be pleased.
rows.output: N'ikpeazụ, ọ bụ nchekwa ha ka mma, dị ka oke ohere ha na-achụ, nke mere ka ndị ọbịa nwee obi ụtọ ma onye nkuzi Peter Murchie nwere ihe kpatara ịnụ ọkụ n'obi.
rows.reference: Na ngwụcha, ọ bụ difensị ha ka sie ike, yanakwa iwere ohere ha ka mma, nke burulu ndị ahụ nọ n’ụlọ, yana onye ndu Peter Murchie nwere ikike niile ịnwe obi ụtọ.

rows.source: "We've been tested over our games this far, and we're still unbeaten, so I have to be happy," he said.
rows.output: "Ọ dịbeghị mgbe anyị nwara egwuregwu anyị, anyị ka na-enweghị mmeri, ya mere m ga-enwe obi ụtọ."
rows.reference: “Anwaala anyị n’ofe egwuregwu anyị ruo ugbu a, emeribeghị anyị, yabụ obi juru n’anụrị,” ka o kwuru.

rows.source: Robyn Christie of Melrose said: "Credit to Ayr, they took their chances better than we did."
rows.output: Robyn Christie nke Melrose kwuru: "Ekele nye Ayr, ha were ohere ha karịa anyị mere."
rows.reference: Robyn Christie nke Melrose kwuru: “Ekele dịịrị Ayr, ha were ohere ha karịa ole anyị mere.”

rows.source: Grant Anderson's 14th minute try, converted by Frazier Climo, put Ayr in front, but, a yellow card for Scotland cap Rory Hughes, released for the game by Warriors, allowed Melrose to make numbers tell and Jason Baggot grabbed an unconverted try.
rows.output: N'ime nkeji iri na anọ, Grant Anderson gbara ọsọ, nke Frazier Climo tụgharịrị, tinye Ayr n'ihu, mana kaadị edo edo maka Rory Hughes, onye Scotland na-egwu egwu, nyere Melrose ohere ịbawanye ọnụ ọgụgụ ma Jason Baggot nwetara ọkpụ goolu na-enweghị ntụgharị.
rows.reference: Ọnwụnwa nkeji 14 nke Grant Anderson, nke Frazier Climo mezuru n’isi, tinyere Ayr n’ihu, enyere kaadị edo-edo maka onye isi Scotland Rory Hughes, nke ndị Warriors hapụrụ maka egwuregwu ahụ, nyere Melrose ohere ịme ka ọnụọgụ nyere ha aka, ma Jason Baggot nwetere ọnwụnwa emezughi n’isi.

rows.source: Climo stretched the Ayr lead with a penalty, before, right on half-time, he scored then converted a solo try to make it 17-5 to Ayr at the break.
rows.output: Climo gbatara Ayr lead with a penalty, tupu, n'etiti oge, o gbatara wee gba a otu-ịgbalị iji mee ka ọ 17-5 nye Ayr n'etiti oge.
rows.reference: Climo dọtịrị ndu Ayr ahụ site na iji penalti, tupu, ozugbo n’ọkara oge, ọ nyere goolu wee mezuo ọnwụnwa naanị ya iji mee ya 17-5 nke Ayr na nkejioge.

rows.source: But Melrose began the second half well and Patrick Anderson's try, converted by Baggot, reduced the leeway to five points.
rows.output: Ma butere Melrose nke abụọ nke ọma ma nwaa Patrick Anderson, nke Baggot gbanwere, belatara ohere ahụ na ise.
rows.reference: Mana Melrose bidoro agba nke abụọ nke ọma yanakwa ọnwụnwa Patrick Anderson, nke Bagoot mezuru n’isi, belatara oghere ahụ ka ọ bụrụ akara ise.

rows.source: There was then a lengthy hold-up for a serious injury to Ruaridh Knott, who was stretchered off, and from the restart, Ayr surged further ahead through a Stafford McDowall try, converted by Climo.
rows.output: Mgbe ahụ, e nwere ogologo oge nkwụsị maka mmerụ ahụ siri ike nke Ruaridh Knott, onye e bugara n'ụgbọ ihe mberede, na site na ịmalitegharị, Ayr gara n'ihu n'ihu site na mgbalị Stafford McDowall, nke Climo gbachara.
rows.reference: Enwere nnukwu ogbugbu oge maka nnukwu mmerụ ahụ Ruaridh Knott nwetara, onye nke ebupuru, na mmalitegharị, Ayr gatere aka site na ọnwụnwa Stafford McDowall, nke Climo mezuru n’isi.

rows.source: Ayr acting captain Blair Macpherson was then yellow-carded, and again, Melrose made the extra man pay with an unconverted Bruce Colvine try, at the end of a spell of fierce pressure.
rows.output: Onye isi ndị na-eme ihe nkiri Ayr, Blair Macpherson, ka a na-acha odo odo, ma Melrose mere ka ndị na-eme ihe na-eme ihe na-enweghị ihe mgbaru ọsọ, na njedebe nke oge dị ịtụnanya.
rows.reference: Osote kaptịn Ayr bụ Blair Macpherson nwetara kaadị edo-edo, ọzọkwa, Melrose mekwara ka nwoke ọzọ baa uru site na ọnwụnwa Bruce Colvine emezughi, na ngwụcha nke oge nnukwu ọkụ ahụ.

rows.source: The home side came back, however, and when Struan Hutchinson was yellow-carded for tackling Climo without the ball, from the penalty line-out, MacPherson touched down at the back of the advancing Ayr maul.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị nke ahụ, ndị otu n'ụlọ ahụ laghachiri azụ, mgbe a gbara Struan Hutchinson n'ọkụ maka ịgba Climo n'enweghị bọọlụ, site na mpaghara ntaramahụhụ, MacPherson metụrụ aka n'azụ ndị na-aga n'ihu Ayr maul.
rows.reference: Otu ahụ nọ n’ụlọ laghachitere, kaosiladị, mgbe enyere Struan Hutchinson kaadị edo-edo maka ịgba Climo ụkwụ onye na ejighi bọọlụ, na mpụga nke ahịrị penalti, MacPherson daturu n’azụ nke nsogbu Ayr na abịa ihu.

rows.source: Climo converted, as he did again almost from the restart, after Kyle Rowe gathered David Armstrong's box kick and sent flanker Gregor Henry away for the home side's fifth try.
rows.output: Climo gbanwere, dị ka o mere ọzọ site na ịmalitegharị, mgbe Kyle Rowe nwetara igbe ịgba bọọlụ David Armstrong wee ziga Gregor Henry n'akụkụ maka goolu nke ise nke otu ụlọ.
rows.reference: Climo gbanyere ya, dị ka ọ mechara ntakịrị ọzọ na mbidogharị, ka Kyle Rowe jidere ọgbụgba n’ime bọksị nke David Armstrong wee zipu onye nke akụkụ Gregor Henry maka ọnwụnwa nke ise nke otu ahụ nọ n’ụlọ.

rows.source: Still Game star looks set for new career in restaurant industry
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri nke Still Game yiri ka ọ ga-amalite ọrụ ọhụrụ na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ.
rows.reference: Onye nke Still Game ama ama chọrọ ọrụ ọhụrụ n’ụlọ ọrụ oriri na ọṅụṅụ

rows.source: Still Game star Ford Kieran looks set to move into the hospitality industry after it was discovered he's been named as the director of a licensed restaurants company.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri na Still Game, Kieran Ford, dị ka ọ ga-abanye n'ụlọ ọrụ ọbịa ka achọpụtara na a kpọrọ ya aha onye isi ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ nwere ikike.
rows.reference: Onye nke Still Game ama ama bụ Ford Kieran chọrọ ịbanye n’ụlọ ọrụ nlekọta ka achọpụtachara na akpọọla ya ka onye nduzi nke ụlọ ọrụ oriri na ọṅụṅụ enyere ikikere.

rows.source: The 56-year-old plays Jack Jarvis on the popular BBC show, which he writes and co-stars with long-time comedy partner Greg Hemphill.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri dị afọ 56 na-egwu Jack Jarvis na ihe nkiri BBC ama ama, nke o dere na ya na onye mmekọ ọchị ọchị ochie Greg Hemphill.
rows.reference: Onye afọ 56 ahụ mere Jack Darvis n’ihe ngosi BBC ama ama, nke ọ dere ma sonyere onye mmekọ ihe ọchị bụ Greg Hemphill.

rows.source: The duo have announced that the upcoming ninth series will be the final one in the show's run, and it appears Kiernan is planning for life after Craiglang.
rows.output: Ndị duo ahụ ekwupụtala na usoro nke itoolu na-abịa ga-abụ nke ikpeazụ na agba, na ọ dị ka Kiernan na-eme atụmatụ ndụ mgbe Craiglang gasịrị.
rows.reference: Mmadụ abụọ ahụ ekwuputela na nsotanso nke itoolu na abịa ga-abụ nke ikpeazụ n’usoro ihe ngosi ahụ, ọ pụtara na Kiernan na ahazi maka ndụ mgbe Craiglang bịara na njedebe.

rows.source: According to official record listings, he is the director of Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.output: Dị ka ndekọ gọọmentị siri dị, ọ bụ onye isi oche nke Adriftmorn Limited.
rows.reference: Site n’aka ndepụta ndekọ ziri ezi, ọ bụ onye nduzi nke Adriftmorn Limited.

rows.source: The actor declined to comment on the story, though a Scottish Sun source hinted that Kiernan was looking to get involved in Glasgow's "thriving restaurant trade."
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri ahụ jụrụ ikwu okwu banyere akụkọ ahụ, n'agbanyeghị na isi mmalite Scottish Sun tụrụ aro na Kiernan na-achọ ịbanye na azụmahịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na-eto eto na Glasgow.
rows.reference: Omenka ahụ jụrụ ikwu okwu maka akụkọ ahụ, agbanyeghị onye isi akụkọ Scottish Sun tụnyere na Kiernan na achọ isonye “n’azụmahịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ nke Glasgow na eme nke ọma.”

rows.source: 'The sea is ours': landlocked Bolivia hopes court will reopen path to Pacific
rows.output: "Ihe oké osimiri bụ nke anyị": Bolivia na-enweghị oke osimiri na-atụ anya na ụlọikpe ga-emeghe ụzọ ọzọ gaa n'Oké Osimiri Pasifik
rows.reference: “Osimiri ahụ bụ nke anyị’: Bolivia ala gbara okirikiri na atụ anya na ụlọ ikpe ga-emepegharị ụzọ gara Pasifik

rows.source: Sailors patrol a rigging-clad naval headquarters in La Paz.
rows.output: Ndị ọkwọ ụgbọ mmiri na-eche nche na isi ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri nke nwere ụgbọ mmiri na La Paz.
rows.reference: Ndị ụgbọ mmiri na agagharị isi ụlọ ọrụ ndị agha mmiri ụgbọ juru na La Paz.

rows.source: Public buildings fly an ocean-blue flag.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ọha na-efegharị ọkọlọtọ na-acha anụnụ anụnụ nke oke osimiri.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọhaneze na efegharị ọkọlọtọ nnukwu osimiri na acha agba eluigwe.

rows.source: Naval bases from Lake Titicaca to the Amazon are daubed with the motto: "The sea is ours by right.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri sitere na ọdọ mmiri Titicaca ruo Amazon na-ese ihe na okwu a: "Oké osimiri bụ nke anyị n'ọchịchọ."
rows.reference: Ọdụ ndị agha mmiri site na Titicaca ruo Amazon juputara na ekuku: “Osimiri ahụ bụ anyị site n’ikike.

rows.source: To recover it is a duty."
rows.output: Iweghachi ya bụ ọrụ."
rows.reference: Iweghachite ya bụ ọrụ.”

rows.source: Throughout landlocked Bolivia, the memory of a coastline lost to Chile in a bloody 19th-century resource conflict is still vivid - as is the yearning to sail the Pacific Ocean once more.
rows.output: N'ime Bolivia nke a na-akpọ ala mmiri, ihe ncheta nke okporo ụzọ a tufuru na Chile n'ọgụ akụ na ụba nke narị afọ nke 19 nke ọbara na-ekpo ọkụ ka dị ndụ - dị ka ọchịchọ ịkwọ ụgbọ mmiri n'Oké Osimiri Pacific ọzọ.
rows.reference: N’okirikiri Bolivia niile ala gbara okirikiri, ncheta nke akụkụ mmiri etufuru n’aka Chile n’esemokwu ekereụwa nke narị afọ 19 jọrọ oke njọ ka pụtara ihie - otu ahụ ka agụụ ịkwọ ụgbọ na Nnukwu Osimiri Pasifik otu ugboro ọzọ si dị.

rows.source: Those hopes are perhaps at their highest in decades, as Bolivia awaits a ruling by the international court of justice on 1 October after five years of deliberations.
rows.output: N'ime afọ ndị a, olileanya ahụ nwere ike ịdị elu, dịka Bolivia na-eche mkpebi nke ụlọ ikpe mba ụwa na 1 Ọktoba mgbe afọ ise nke mkparịta ụka gasịrị.
rows.reference: Ntụmanya ndị ahụ ikekwe kachasị ugbu a n’ime afọ iri, ka Bolivia na eche mkpebi nke ụlọ ọrụ ofesi nke akwụmọtọ na Ọktoba 1 ka afọ ise nrụrịta ụka gachara.

rows.source: "Bolivia has the momentum, a spirit of unity and serenity, and is of course expecting with a positive view the outcome," said Roberto Calzadilla, a Bolivian diplomat.
rows.output: "Ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia, ọ dịịrị Bolivia
rows.reference: “Bolivia ji agbamume ugbu a, mmụọ nke ịdị n’otu na ume ala, makwa jiri nlele dị mma wee na atụ anya ndapụta ahụ,” nke Roberto Calzadilla kwuru, onye nnọchite anya nke Bolivia.

rows.source: Many Bolivians will watch the ICJ ruling on big screens across the country, hopeful that the tribunal in The Hague will find in favour of Bolivia's claim that - after decades of fitful talks - Chile is obliged to negotiate granting Bolivia a sovereign outlet to the sea.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ndị Bolivia ga-ekiri mkpebi nke ICJ na nnukwu ihuenyo n'ofe mba ahụ, na-atụ anya na ụlọikpe dị na The Hague ga-ahụ na Bolivia nwere ihe ziri ezi na-ekwu na - mgbe ọtụtụ afọ nke mkparịta ụka na-adịghị mma gasịrị - Chile ga-ekwu okwu inye Bolivia ụzọ gaa n'oké osimiri.
rows.reference: Imirikiti ndị Bolivia ga-elele mkpebi ICJ n’ihuenyo buru ibu n’ofe obodo ahụ niile, na atụ anya na ụlọ ikpe ahụ dị na The Hague ga-eme nchọpụta na mmasị nke ebubo nke Bolivia na - ka ọtụtụ afọ iri nke okwu dị mma gachara - Chile nwere mmanye ịkparịta nkata na enye Bolivia ụzọ nnwere onwe gara n’osimiri.

rows.source: Evo Morales, Bolivia's charismatic indigenous president - who faces a controversial battle for re-election next year - also has plenty riding on Monday's ruling.
rows.output: Evo Morales, onye isi ala Bolivia nke na-adọrọ mmasị na onye si n'ala ụmụ amaala - onye na-eche ọgụ na-ese okwu maka ịzọ ọkwa ọzọ n'afọ na-abịa - nwekwara ọtụtụ ihe na-adabere na mkpebi e mere na Mọnde.
rows.reference: Evo Morales, onye isi ala nke amaala Bolivia na adọrọ mmasị - onye na eche ọgụ siri ike maka nhọpụtagharị ntuli aka n’afọ na esote - nwekwara ọtụtụ ihe ọ na adabere na mkpebi nke Mọnde.

rows.source: "We are very close to returning to the Pacific Ocean," he vowed in late August.
rows.output: "Anyị dị nso nso na-alaghachi na Osimiri Pasifik," o kwere nkwa na njedebe nke Ọgọst.
rows.reference: “Anyị nọ nso na ịlaghachi na Nnukwu Osimiri Pasifik,” ọ ṅwụrụ iyi na Ọgọst gara aga.

rows.source: But some analysts believe that the court is unlikely to decide in Bolivia's favour - and that little would change if it did.
rows.output: Ma ụfọdụ ndị nyocha kwenyere na ụlọikpe ahụ agaghị ekpebi n'ịkwado Bolivia - na na ọ dịghị ihe ga-agbanwe ma ọ bụrụ na ọ mere.
rows.reference: Mana ụfọdụ ndị nyocha kwenyere na ụlọ ikpe ahụ nwere ike ha agaghị enye mkpebi ga-amasị Bolivia - na obere ihe ga-agbanwe ma ọ bụrụ na ha mere.

rows.source: The Netherlands-based UN body has no power to award Chilean territory, and has stipulated that it will not determine the outcome of possible talks.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ UN nke dị na Netherlands enweghị ikike inye ala Chile, ọ na-ekwukwa na ọ gaghị ekpebi ihe ga-esi na mkparịta ụka nwere ike ime.
rows.reference: Ewumewu ahụ nọ na Netherland nwere ikike iji nye mpaghara Chile, ọ kọwara na ọ gaghị ekpebi ndapụta nke okwu ndị nwere ike ịdị.

rows.source: That the ICJ's ruling comes only six months after the final arguments were heard indicates the case "wasn't complicated," said Paz Zárate, a Chilean expert in international law.
rows.output: Nke ahụ na mkpebi ICJ na-abịa naanị ọnwa isii ka e nwechara mkparịta ụka ikpeazụ, na-egosi na "ikpe ahụ adịghị mgbagwoju anya," ka Paz Zárate, bụ ọkachamara n'ihe gbasara iwu mba ụwa nke Chile kwuru.
rows.reference: Na mkpebi nke ICJ na abịa naanị ọnwa isii ka anụchara ụbụbọ ndị ikpeazụ na egosi na okwu ahụ “agbagwojughi anya,” Paz Zárate kwuru, onye ọkachamara Chile n’iwu ofesi.

rows.source: And far from furthering Bolivia's cause, the past four years may have set it back.
rows.output: N'ezie, ihe anọ gara aga agaghị enyere Bolivia aka, kama imebi ya.
rows.reference: Nke tere aka na ịkwado ebumnuche ndị Bolivia, afọ anọ gara aga nwegoro ike ịdọghachi azụ.

rows.source: "The issue of access to the sea has been hijacked by the current Bolivian administration," said Zárate.
rows.output: "Ihe gbasara ịnweta oké osimiri ka ndị ọchịchị Bolivia ugbu a ji ya mee ihe n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi," ka Zárate kwuru.
rows.reference: “Okwu nke ịnweta ụzọ osimiri bụ nke ndị nchịkwa Bolivia nọ ugbu a weghagoro n’ike,” Zárate kwuru.

rows.source: Morales's belligerent rhetoric has sapped any residual Chilean goodwill, she suggested.
rows.output: Okwu ọgụ nke Morales emeela ka ọ dịkwuo mma nke ọma nke Chile, o kwuru.
rows.reference: Okwu ụtọ bụ asị nke Morales na akpasu iwe amịala amara onye Chile ọ bụla fọdụrụ, ọ tụnyere.

rows.source: Bolivia and Chile will at some point continue to talk, but it will be extremely difficult to hold discussions after this.
rows.output: Bolivia na Chile ga-aga n'ihu na-ekwu okwu, ma ọ ga-esi ike nke ukwuu ijide mkparịta ụka mgbe nke a gasịrị.
rows.reference: Bolivia na Chile n’otu oge ga-amalitekwa na ekwu okwu, mana ọ ga-esi nnukwu ike ịnwe mkparịta ụka ka nke a mechara.

rows.source: The two countries have not exchanged ambassadors since 1962.
rows.output: Mba abụọ ahụ emeghị mgbanwe ndị nnọchite anya kemgbe afọ 1962.
rows.reference: Obodo abụọ ahụ agbanwetabeghị onye nnọchite obodo kemgbe 1962.

rows.source: Former president Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, Bolivia's representative at The Hague, rejected the idea that the court's decision-making was unusually speedy.
rows.output: Onye bụbu onye isi ala Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, onye nnọchiteanya Bolivia na The Hague, jụrụ echiche na mkpebi ụlọ ikpe ahụ dị ngwa ngwa.
rows.reference: Onye isi ala gara aga Eduardo Rodríguez Veltzé, onye nnọchite nke Bolivia na The Hague, jụrụ alo na ịme mkpebi nke ụlọ ikpe ahụ na adịkebe ọsọ.

rows.source: Monday will bring Bolivia "an extraordinary opportunity to open a new era of relations with Chile" and a chance to "put an end to 139 years of disagreements with mutual benefits," he said.
rows.output: Mọnde ga-eweta Bolivia "ohere pụrụ iche imeghe oge ọhụrụ nke mmekọrịta na Chile" na ohere ị "mechie afọ 139 nke esemokwu na uru nke abụọ."
rows.reference: Mọnde ga-ewetere Bolivia “ohere pụrụ nnukwu iche iji mepee oge ọhụrụ na mmerịkọta n’etiti Chile” yana ohere iji “kwụsị afọ 139 nke esemokwu nwere elele nwekọrịta,” o kwuru.

rows.source: Calzadilla also denied that Morales - still one of Latin America's most popular presidents - was using the maritime issue as a political crutch.
rows.output: Calzadilla kwuru na Morales, onye ka na-ewu ewu na Latin America, anaghị eji okwu mmiri eme ihe ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị.
rows.reference: Calzadilla gọnarịkwara na Morales - onye ka bụ otu ndị isi ala nke Latin America akachasị mara - na eji okwu mmiri ahụ ka nkwado ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị.

rows.source: "Bolivia will never give up its right to have access to the Pacific Ocean," he added.
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị mgbe Bolivia ga-akwụsị ikike ya inwe ohere ịnweta Osimiri Pacific," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Bolivia agaghị ahapụ ikike ya iji nweta ụzọ gara Nnukwu Osimiri Pasifik,” o tinyere.

rows.source: "The ruling is an opportunity to see that we need to overcome the past."
rows.output: "Nchịkọta a bụ ohere ịhụ na anyị chọrọ ịgafe n'oge gara aga."
rows.reference: “Mkpebi ahụ bụ ohere iji hụ na anyị kwesịrị imeri ihe ndị gara aga.”

rows.source: North Korea says nuclear disarmament won't come unless it can trust US
rows.output: Ndị North Korea na-ekwu na a gaghị enwe nkwụsị nke nuklia ma ọ bụrụ na ha enweghị ike ịtụkwasị ndị America obi
rows.reference: Ndị North Korea ekwuola na nkwasa ngwa agha nuklịa agaghị eme belụsọ na ha enwere ntụkwasị obi na US

rows.source: North Korean Foreign Minister Ri Yong Ho says his nation will never disarm its nuclear weapons first if it can't trust Washington.
rows.output: Onye Mịnịsta na-ahụ maka mba ofesi North Korea bụ Ri Yong Ho kwuru na mba ya agaghị akwụsị ngwa agha nuklia ya nke mbụ ma ọ bụrụ na ha enweghị ike ịtụkwasị obi Washington.
rows.reference: Minista Ofesi nke North Korea Ri Yong Ho kwuru na mba ya agaghị eburu ụzọ ma ncha kwasaa ngwa agha nuklịa ma ọ bụrụ na ọ nweghị ike ịnwe ntụkwasị obi na Washington.

rows.source: Ri was speaking Saturday at the United Nations General Assembly.
rows.output: Ri na-ekwu okwu Satọde n'Ụlọ Nzukọ Mba Ndị Dị n'Otu.
rows.reference: Ri nọ na ekwu na Satọde na Mgbakọ Ezumezu nke United Nations.

rows.source: He called on the United States to follow through on promises made during a summit in Singapore between the rivals' leaders.
rows.output: Ọ kpọrọ Òtù Na-ahụ Maka Mba Ndị Dị n'Otu ka ha mezuo nkwa ndị e kwere n'oge ogbako dị na Singapore n'etiti ndị isi ndị iro.
rows.reference: Ọ kpọrọ ndị United States ka ha mezuo nkwa ha mere na n’ọgbakọ ahụ na Singapore n’etiti ndị isi ahụ na ama aka.

rows.source: His comments come as US. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo seems to be on the verge of restarting deadlocked nuclear diplomacy more than three months after the Singapore with North Korea's Kim Jong Un.
rows.output: Okwu ya na-abịa n'oge a na-eme atụmatụ maka Mịnịsta na-ahụ maka ihe gbasara mba ofesi nke United States bụ Mike Pompeo ka ọ maliteghachi mkparịta ụka nuklia nke dara mbà ihe karịrị ọnwa atọ ka ọ gachara na Singapore na onye ndu North Korea Kim Jong Un.
rows.reference: Okwu ya na abịa ka ndị US. Ọde Akwụkwọ nke Steeti Mike Pompeo dị ka ọ nọ nso na ibidogharị mkparịta ụka nuklịa kpọchiri akpọchi kemgbe n’ime ọnwa atọ ka Singapore gachara n’etiti Kim Jong Un nke North Korea.

rows.source: Ri says it's a "pipe dream" that continued sanctions and U.S. objection to a declaration ending the Korean War will ever bring the North to its knees.
rows.output: Ri kwuru na ọ bụ "nrọ efu" na mmachi na-aga n'ihu na mmegide U.S. nke nkwupụta na-akwụsị Agha Korea agaghị eme ka North kwụsị.
rows.reference: Ri kwuru na ọ bụ “nrọ efu” na ntaramahụhụ gara n’ihu yana mgbochi U.S. na nkwupute nkwụsị nke Ọgụ Korea ga-ebute North n’ikpere ya.

rows.source: Washington is wary of agreeing to the declaration without Pyongyang first making significant disarmament moves.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Washington na-akpachapụ anya ịkwado nkwupụta ahụ na-enweghị Pyongyang emeela ihe dị ịrịba ama n'ịkwụsị ngwa ọgụ.
rows.reference: Washington na akpachapụ nnukwu anya ịkwenye na nkwupute ebe Pyongyang emebeghị ihe doro anya na nkwasasị.

rows.source: Both Kim and U.S. President Donald Trump want a second summit.
rows.output: Ndị Kim na Onye isi ala U.S. Donald Trump chọrọ nzukọ nke abụọ.
rows.reference: Kim yana U.S. Onye isi ala Donald Trump chọrọ nzụkọ nke abụọ.

rows.source: But there is widespread skepticism that Pyongyang is serious about renouncing an arsenal that the country likely sees as the only way to guarantee its safety.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ na ọtụtụ ndị na-enwe obi abụọ ma Pyongyang dị njikere ịhapụ ngwa agha nke obodo ahụ nwere ike ịhụ dị ka ụzọ isi hụ na nchekwa ya.
rows.reference: Mana enwere obi mgbagha gbasara agbasa na Pyongyang dị njikere ịjụ ngwa agha nke obodo ahụ nwere ike ị na ahụ ka naanị ụzọ iji chedo onwe ya.

rows.source: Pompeo is planning to visit Pyongyang next month to prepare for a second Kim-Trump summit.
rows.output: Pompeo na-eme atụmatụ ịga Pyongyang n'ọnwa na-abịa iji kwado maka nzukọ nke abụọ Kim-Trump.
rows.reference: Pompeo na akwadobe ịga Pyongyang n’ọnwa na abịa iji kwadobe nzụkọ Kim-Trump nke abụọ.

rows.source: Paris fashion shows reveal latest line in massive headwear on it's way to a High Street near you
rows.output: N'ime ngosi ejiji Paris, a na-egosi ụdị kachasị ọhụrụ nke nnukwu okpu na-aga n'ụzọ gị.
rows.reference: Ihe ngosi ekike gosiri ahịrị kachasị ọhụrụ na nnukwu uwe isi na abịa Okporo Dị Elu nọketere gị

rows.source: If you want to upsize your hat collection or completely block out the sun then look no further.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ịchọrọ ịbawanye nchịkọta okpu gị ma ọ bụ kpuchie anyanwụ kpamkpam, lee ihe ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ iwegote mkpokọta okpu gị ma ọ bụ gbochie anwụ kpamkpam, achọna ebe ọzọ.

rows.source: Designers Valentino and Thom Browne unveiled an array of wacky oversized head gear for their SS19 collection on the runway which dazzled the style set at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.output: Ndị na-emepụta ihe Valentino na Thom Browne kpughere ụdị akwa akwa akwa akwa maka mkpokọta SS19 ha na runway nke kpalitere ndị na-ahụ maka ụdị na Paris Fashion Week.
rows.reference: Ndị ọmebe ekike Valentino na Thom Browne kpughepuru ikpo uwe isi jọrọ njọ maka mkpokọta SS19 ha n’okporo nke masịrị nka atọrọ na Izu Ekike Paris.

rows.source: Highly impractical hats have swept Instagram this summer and these designers have sent their eye-popping creations down the catwalk.
rows.output: N'ime okpomọkụ a, okpu ndị na-adịghị mma emeela ka ọgbọ ndị na-ese foto nke Instagram.
rows.reference: Okpu ndị na atụ n’anya ejula Instagram n’ọkọchị a, ma ndị ọmebe ekike ndị a ezipula mmepụta ha dị egwu n’ụzọ warawara.

rows.source: The stand out piece by Valentino was an over-the-top beige hat adorned with a feather-like wide brim that swamped the models heads.
rows.output: Ihe pụtara ìhè nke Valentino bụ okpu beige nke ukwuu nke nwere nnukwu brim dị ka nku, nke kpuchiri isi ndị na-egosi.
rows.reference: Okpu nke Valentino pụrụ iche bụ okpu beji dị egwu etinyere okpuru okpu dị obosara dị ka nku kpuchiri isi model ndị ahụ.

rows.source: Other over-sized accessories included bejeweled watermelons, a wizard hat and even a pineapple - but they are not designed to keep your head warm.
rows.output: N'elu n'elu, ihe ịchọ mma buru ibu gụnyere mmiri na-egbuke egbuke, okpu anwansi, na ọbụna piich - mana ha emebereghị iji mee ka isi gị kpoo ọkụ.
rows.reference: Ngwa ndị ọzọ buru oke ibu gụnyere anyụ akwanyere ọla mma, okpo amusu yana nfueru - mana emeghị ka ha nye isi gị okpomọkụ.

rows.source: Thom Browne also revealed a selection of bizarre masks- and just in time for Halloween.
rows.output: Thom Browne wepụtakwara ụfọdụ ihe mkpuchi na-adịghị mma - na n'oge kwesịrị ekwesị maka Halloween.
rows.reference: Thom Browne gosikwara ihe mkpuchi na ụtọ ụjọ - ọ bịara n’oge maka Halloween.

rows.source: Many of the colourful masks had sewn up lips and resembled more like Hannibal Lecter than haute couture.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ n'ime uwe mwụda ndị a na-egbuke egbuke nwere ọnụ akwa akwa ma yie ka ọ dị ka Hannibal Lecter karịa haute couture.
rows.reference: Imirikiti mkpuchi ihu ndị ahụ mara mma nwere egbugbere ọnụ akwachiri akwachi wee yie Hannibal Lecter karịa haute couture.

rows.source: One creation resembled scuba diving gear complete with snorkel and goggles, while another looked like a melted ice cream cone.
rows.output: Otu ihe e kere e mere ka ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ ikuku ikuku na goggles, ebe nke ọzọ yiri ka ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ ice cream kpọnwụrụ akpọnwụ.
rows.reference: Otu mmepụta yiri uwe eji adakpu n’ala mmiri n’uju ma nwee snọkel na ugogbe anya, ebe ọzọ yiri iko aịs krim gbazere agbaze.

rows.source: And if you continue the huge fashion statement- you are in luck.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-aga n'ihu na nnukwu nkwupụta ejiji- ị nọ n'ọnọdụ dị mma.
rows.reference: Ma ị gaa n’ihu na nkwupute ekike ahụ dị elu - ị nwere ihu ọma.

rows.source: Style watchers predict that the enormous bonnets could be making their way to high streets near you.
rows.output: Ndị na-ekiri ụdị na-atụ anya na nnukwu okpu nwere ike na-aga n'okporo ámá dị nso gị.
rows.reference: Ndị nlele ụdị ekike buru amụma na nnukwu mkpuchi ndị ahụ nwere ike ịbịarute n’okporo ndị dị elu nọketere gi.

rows.source: The out-sized hats come hot on the heels of 'La Bomba', the straw hat with a two-foot wide brim that's been seen on everyone from Rihanna to Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.output: Nke a na-ekpo ọkụ n'azụ 'La Bomba', okpu ahịhịa nwere okirikiri nke fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ ụkwụ abụọ n'obosara nke a hụrụ n'ahụ onye ọ bụla site na Rihanna ruo Emily Ratajkowski.
rows.reference: Okpu ndị basara abasa na abịa ozugbo na ngafe ‘La Bomba’, okpu ahịhịa nwere okpuru dị nzọụkwụ abụọ n’obosara nke ahụgoro n’ahụ mmadụ niile bido na Rihanna ruo Emily Ratajkowski.

rows.source: The cult label behind the highly impractical hat that was splashed across social media sent another big creation down the catwalk - a straw beach bag almost as big as the swimsuit-clad model toting it.
rows.output: Otu aha aha nke nwere okpu agha nke a na-ese n'elu mgbasa ozi ọha na eze weputara ihe okike ọzọ n'elu ikpo okwu - akpa osimiri straw nke fọrọ nke nta ka ọ dị ka uwe mmiri nke nwa agbọghọ yi ya.
rows.reference: Akara nkwekọrịta kwadoro okpu ahụ na adịghị mma maka ojiji ebuputere n’ebe mgbasa ozi ọhaneze zipuru nnukwu mmepụta ọzọ n’okporo ngosipụta - agba akụkụ osimiri ahịhịa buru ibu ruo ka mọdel yi uwe eji egwu mmiri bu ya.

rows.source: The burnt orange raffia bag, trimmed with raffia fringing and topped with a white leather handle, was the stand out piece in Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 collection at Paris Fashion Week.
rows.output: Akpa raffia oroma a na-ere, nke a na-akpụ akpụ na raffia, ma tinye ya na njedebe nke akpụkpọ anụ ọcha, bụ ihe kacha pụta ìhè n'ime Jacquemus' La Riviera SS19 nchịkọta na Paris Fashion Week.
rows.reference: Akpa raffia orenji gbara ọkụ, eji gịrịgịrị raffia dozie ma tinye ya aka akpụkpụ anụahụ dị ọcha, bụ ihe kwụpụrụ iche na mkpokọta SS19 nke Jacquemus’ La Riviera na Izu Ekike Paris.

rows.source: Celebrity stylist Luke Armitage told FEMAIL: 'I'm expecting to see large hats and beach bags arrive on the high street for next summer - as the designer has made such a huge impact it would be hard to ignore the demand for the oversized accessories.'
rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka ọdịdị ọdịdị Luke Armitage gwara FEMAIL: 'A na-atụ m anya ịhụ nnukwu okpu na akpa osimiri bịarute n'okporo ámá maka okpomọkụ na-abịa - ebe onye nrụpụta emeela nnukwu mmetụta, ọ ga-adị mfe ịghara ịrịọ maka nnukwu ihe ndị ahụ.'
rows.reference: Onye na eyi ndị ama ama uwe bụ Luke Armitage gwara FEMAIL: “M na atụ anya ịhụ nnukwu okpu na akpa akụkụ osimiri irute n’okporo ụzọ dị elu maka ọkọchị na esote - ebe onye ọmebe ekike ahụ enweela nnukwu mmetụta ọ ga-esi ike ịleghara ọchụchọ nke ihe enyemaka ndị buru oke ibu.’

rows.source: John Edward: Languages skills essential for global citizens
rows.output: John Edward: Ọ̀tụ̀tụ̀ asụsụ dị mkpa maka ụmụ amaala ụwa
rows.reference: John Edward: Nka asụsụ dị mkpa maka ndị amaala ụwa

rows.source: Scotland's independent schools maintain a track record of academic excellence, and this has continued in 2018 with another set of outstanding exam results, which is only strengthened by individual and collective success in sports, art, music and other community endeavours.
rows.output: N'afọ 2018, ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị na-achị onwe ha na Scotland na-aga n'ihu na-egosi ọmarịcha ihe ịga nke ọma n'ule, nke na-eme ka ihe ịga nke ọma n'otu n'otu na nke ọha na eze na egwuregwu, nka, egwu na ọrụ ndị ọzọ na-eme n'ime obodo.
rows.reference: Ụlọ akwụkwọ nnwere onwe nke Scotland dowere ndekọ nzọụkwụ nke agụmakwụkwọ kachasị, ma nke a gara n’ihu na 2018 site na iji nsonaazụ ule ndị mara oke mma, nke a na agụzogide site na mmeri ndị mmadụ na ndị otu n’egwuregwu, nka, egwu na mbọ ogbe ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: With upwards of 30,000 pupils across Scotland, these schools, represented by The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS), strive to deliver the best level of service to their pupils and parents.
rows.output: N'ịbụ ihe karịrị ụmụ akwụkwọ 30,000 n'ofe Scotland, ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị a, nke ndị Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS) nọchitere anya, na-agbalị inye ọkwa ọrụ kacha mma maka ụmụ akwụkwọ na ndị nne na nna ha.
rows.reference: Na mgbago ọnụọgụ nke ụmụ akwụkwọ 30,000 n’ofe Scotland, ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị a, nke The Scottish Council of Independent Schools (SCIS) na anọchite, na agba mbọ iwete ọkwa ọrụ kachasị maka ụmụ akwụkwọ ha na ndị nne na nna ha.

rows.source: Independent schools aim to prepare their pupils for further and higher education, their chosen career and their place as global citizens.
rows.output: Ụlọ akwụkwọ onwe ha na-achọ ime ka ụmụ akwụkwọ ha dị njikere maka agụmakwụkwọ ọzọ na nke elu, ọrụ ha họọrọ, na ịbụ ụmụ amaala ụwa.
rows.reference: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe na agba mbọ ịkwadobe ụmụ akwụkwọ maka agụmakwụkwọ ọdịnihu na nke dị elu, ọrụaka ha họpụtara yana ọnọdụ ha ka ndị amaala ụwa.

rows.source: As an education sector that can design and implement a bespoke school curriculum, we are seeing modern languages continue as a popular and desired subject of choice within schools.
rows.output: Dị ka ngalaba mmụta nke nwere ike ịmepụta na imejuputa usoro mmụta nkeonwe, anyị na-ahụ asụsụ ọgbara ọhụrụ ka ọ na-aga n'ihu dị ka isiokwu na-ewu ewu na nke a na-achọ n'ụlọ akwụkwọ.
rows.reference: Dị ka ngalaba agụmakwụkwọ nwere ike izube ma tinye usoro ọmụmụ nke ụlọ akwụkwọ dị elu, anyị na ahụ asụsụ ọhụụ ka ọ na aga n’ihu ka nke na akpọtụ yana isiokwu nke nhọrọ achọrọ n’ime ụlọ akwụkwọ.

rows.source: Nelson Mandela said: "If you talk to a man in a language he understands, that goes to his head.
rows.output: Nelson Mandela kwuru: "Ọ bụrụ na ị na-agwa nwoke n'asụsụ ọ na-aghọta, nke ahụ na-aga n'isi ya.
rows.reference: Nelson Mandela kwuru: “Ọ bụrụ na ịgwa nwoke okwu n’asụsụ ọ matara, nke ahụ na aga n’isi.

rows.source: If you talk to him in his own language that goes to his heart."
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ị na-ekwu ya n'asụsụ ya, ọ na-eru n'obi ya."
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ịgwa ya okwu n’asụsụ nke ya, nke ahụ na aga n’obi.”

rows.source: This is a powerful reminder that we can't just rely on English when wanting to build relationships and trust with people from other countries.
rows.output: Nke a bụ ihe ncheta siri ike na anyị enweghị ike ịdabere naanị na Bekee mgbe anyị chọrọ iwulite mmekọrịta na ntụkwasị obi na ndị si mba ọzọ.
rows.reference: Nke a bụ nnukwu ncheta na anyị enweghị ike ịdabere na Bekee mgbe anyị na achọ ịmebe mmekọrịta na ntụkwasị obi n’etiti ndị mmadụ si na obodo ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: From this year's recent exam results, we can see that languages are topping the league tables with the highest pass rates within independent schools.
rows.output: Site na nsonaazụ ule nke afọ a, anyị nwere ike ịhụ na asụsụ na-eduga na tebụl oche na ọnụego ịga nke ọma kacha elu n'etiti ụlọ akwụkwọ onwe.
rows.reference: Bido na nsonaazụ ule nke afọ a dị nso nso, anyị nwere ike ịhụ na asụsụ na agachasị na tebul asọmpi ahụ nke nwere ogo ntozu kachasị n’ime ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe.

rows.source: A total of 68 per cent of pupils who studied foreign languages achieved a Higher grade A.
rows.output: Pasentị iri isii na asatọ nke ụmụ akwụkwọ ndị mụrụ asụsụ ọzọ nwetara ọkwa dị elu A.
rows.reference: Mgbakọta nke pasentị 68 nke ụmụ akwụkwọ ndị gụrụ asụsụ ofesi nwetara akara A Dị Elu.

rows.source: The data, collected from SCIS's 74 member schools, showed that 72 per cent of students achieved a Higher grade A in Mandarin, while 72 per cent of those studying German, 69 per cent of those studying French and 63 per cent studying Spanish also achieved an A.
rows.output: Ntụle data ahụ, nke e nwetara n'ụlọ akwụkwọ 74 ndị otu SCIS, gosiri na 72 pasent nke ụmụ akwụkwọ nwetara ọkwa dị elu A na Mandarin, ebe 72 pasent nke ndị na-amụ German, 69 pasent nke ndị na-amụ French na 63 pasent nke ndị na-amụ Spanish nwetakwara A.
rows.reference: Data, anakọtara n’aka ụlọ akwụkwọ 74 sonyere na SCIS, gosiri na pasentị 72 nke ụmụ akwụkwọ nwetara akara A Dị Elu na Mandarin, ebe pasentị 72 nke ndị na agụ German, pasentị 69 nke ndị na agụ French na pasentị 63 na agụ Spanish nwetara A.

rows.source: This demonstrates that independent schools in Scotland are supporting foreign languages as vital skills that children and young people will undoubtedly require in the future.
rows.output: Nke a na-egosi na ụlọ akwụkwọ onwe onye na Scotland na-akwado asụsụ mba ọzọ dị ka nkà dị mkpa nke ụmụaka na ndị ntorobịa ga-achọ n'ezie n'ọdịnihu.
rows.reference: Nke a na egosi na ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe nọ na Scotland na akwado asụsụ ofesi ka nka dị mkpa nke ụmụaka na ndị ntorobịa ga-ejiriri n’ọdịnihu.

rows.source: Languages now, as a subject choice, are being held in the same regard as STEM subjects (science, technology, engineering and mathematics) in independent school curriculums and elsewhere.
rows.output: N'oge a, dị ka nhọrọ isiokwu, a na-ahụta asụsụ ugbu a n'otu ụzọ ahụ dị ka isiokwu STEM (sayensị, nkà na ụzụ, injinia na mgbakọ na mwepụ) na usoro ọmụmụ ụlọ akwụkwọ onwe onye na ebe ndị ọzọ.
rows.reference: Asụsụ ugbu a, dị ka nhọrọ isiokwu, ka a na ahụta n’otu anya ka isiokwu ndị STEM (sayensị, teknụzụ, ịnjinịarịn na mgbakọ na mwepu) n’usoro ọmụmụ ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe yana n’ebe ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: A survey by the UK Commission for Employment and Skills in 2014 found that of reasons employers gave for struggling to fill vacancies, 17 per cent were attributed to a languages skills shortage.
rows.output: Nnyocha nke UK Commission for Employment and Skills mere n'afọ 2014 chọpụtara na n'ime ihe ndị na-ewe mmadụ n'ọrụ na-enwe ike ịrụ ọrụ, pasentị iri na asaa bụ n'ihi enweghị nkà asụsụ.
rows.reference: Nyocha nke Ụlọ Ọrụ UK maka Arụmọrụ na Nka na 2014 hụrụ na ihe ndị na ewe n’ọrụ nyere ka ihe na egbochi ha na ikpoju ohere ọrụ, ekenyere pasenti 17 na ụkọ nka asụsụ.

rows.source: Therefore more and more, language skills are becoming imperative in order to prepare young people for their future careers.
rows.output: Ya mere, nkà asụsụ na-aghọ ihe dị mkpa karị, iji nyere ndị ntorobịa aka ịkwado maka ọrụ ha n'ọdịnihu.
rows.reference: Ya mere ọtụtụ oge, nka asụsụ na abụkwazị ihe dị mkpa maka ndị ntorobịa iji kwadobe onwe ha maka ọrụaka ọdịnihu ha.

rows.source: With more prospective job opportunities requiring languages, these skills are essential in a globalised world.
rows.output: N'ime ohere ọrụ ndị ọzọ na-achọ asụsụ, nka ndị a dị mkpa n'ụwa nke jikọtara ọnụ.
rows.reference: Ebe ọtụtụ ohere ọrụ ndị nwere ike ịpụta na achọ asụsụ, nka ndị a dị mkpa n’ụwa azụmahịa.

rows.source: Regardless of the career someone chooses, if they've learned a second language, they'll have a real advantage in the future having a life-long skill such as this.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị ọrụ onye ọ bụla họọrọ, ọ bụrụ na ha mụtala asụsụ nke abụọ, ha ga-enwe uru n'ọdịnihu nwere nka na-adịgide adịgide dị otú ahụ.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị ọrụaka mmadụ họrọ, ọ bụrụ na ha mụtara asụsụ nke abụọ, ha ga-enwe nnukwu uru n’ọdịnihu n’ihi ịnwe nka ogologo ndụ dị ka nke a.

rows.source: Being able to communicate directly with people from foreign countries will automatically put a multilingual person ahead of the competition.
rows.output: ikike ịkparịta ụka ozugbo na ndị si mba ọzọ ga-eme ka onye na-asụ asụsụ dị iche iche nwee ọganihu n'ọsọ ahụ.
rows.reference: Ịnwe ike ikwukọrịta okwu ozugbo n’etiti ndị mmadụ si mba ofesi ga-etinye mmadụ na asụ ọtụtụ asụsụ n’ihu ndị ya na ya na ama aka ozugbo.
