rows.source: According to a YouGov poll of more than 4,000 UK adults in 2013, 75 per cent were unable to speak a foreign language well enough to hold a conversation and with French being the only language spoken by a double-digit percentage, 15 per cent.
rows.output: N'afọ 2013, YouGov mere nyocha nke karịrị 4,000 ndị okenye UK, 75% enweghị ike ịsụ asụsụ mba ọzọ nke ọma iji nwee mkparịta ụka, na French bụ naanị asụsụ a na-asụ nke pasentị abụọ, 15%.
rows.reference: Site na nhọpụta YouGov nke ndị okenye karịrị 4,000 na 2013, pasentị 75 enwenwughi ike ịsụ asụsụ ofesi ole zuru oke iji kpaa nkata, ebe French bụ naanị asụsụ nwere mkpụrụọnụọgụ pasentị gbara mkpị, pasentị 15.

rows.source: This is why putting the investment into language teaching now is important for today's children.
rows.output: Nke a bụ ihe mere itinye ego n'ịkụzi asụsụ ugbu a ji dị mkpa maka ụmụaka taa.
rows.reference: Nke a kpatara itinye ego na nkuzi asụsụ ugbu a dị mkpa maka ụmụaka taa.

rows.source: Having multiple languages, particularly those of developing economies, will equip children with a better chance of finding meaningful employment.
rows.output: Inwe asụsụ dị iche iche, karịsịa ndị nke akụ na ụba na-emepe emepe, ga-akwado ụmụaka ka ha nwee ohere ka mma ịchọta ọrụ na-enye afọ ojuju.
rows.reference: Ịnwe ọtụtụ asụsụ, karịchara ndị akụnụba obodo na etolite, ga-akwadobe ụmụaka site na ịnye ha ohere ka mma na ịchọta ọrụ bara uru.

rows.source: Within Scotland, each school will differ in the languages they teach.
rows.output: N'ime Scotland, ụlọ akwụkwọ ọ bụla ga-adị iche na asụsụ ndị ha na-akụzi.
rows.reference: N’ime Scotland, ụlọ akwụkwọ ọ bụla ga-adị iche n’asụsụ ha na akuzi.

rows.source: A number of schools will focus on the more classic modern languages, whereas others will teach languages that are deemed to be most important for the UK when looking ahead to 2020, such as Mandarin or Japanese.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ụlọ akwụkwọ ga-elekwasị anya na asụsụ oge a, ebe ndị ọzọ ga-akụzi asụsụ ndị a na-ewere dị ka ndị kacha mkpa maka UK mgbe ha na-ele anya n'ihu 2020, dị ka Mandarin ma ọ bụ Japanese.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ụlọ akwụkwọ ga-agbado anya karịa n’asụsụ ọhụụ, ebe ndị ọzọ ga-akuzi asụsụ ndị a na ahụta ka ndị kachasị mkpa maka UK mgbe a na ele anya n’ihu na 2020, dị ka Mandarin ma ọ bụ Japanese.

rows.source: Whatever your child's interest, there will always be a number of languages to choose from within independent schools, with teaching staff who are specialists in this area.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị mmasị nwa gị, e nwere mgbe niile ọtụtụ asụsụ ịhọrọ n'ime ụlọ akwụkwọ onwe ha, nwere ndị ọrụ nkuzi bụ ndị ọkachamara n'ógbè a.
rows.reference: Ihe ọ bụla bụ mmasị nwata gị, a ga-enwerịrị ọnụọgụ asụsụ ndị a ga-esi na ha họrọ n’ime ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe, ga-enwe ndị nkuzi bụ ọkachamara na mpaghara a.

rows.source: Scottish independent schools are dedicated to providing a learning environment that will prepare children and arm them with the skills required to succeed, whatever the future holds.
rows.output: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị Scotland na-akwụ ụgwọ onwe ha na-achọ inye ebe mmụta nke ga-akwadebe ụmụaka ma nye ha nka ndị dị mkpa iji nwee ihe ịga nke ọma, n'agbanyeghị ihe ọdịnihu ga-abụ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe nke Scotland wepụtara onwe ha na iwete gburugburu mmụta ga-akwadobe ụmụaka ma jiri nka ndị achọrọ wee kwadobe ha iji mee nke ọma, ihe ọ bụla ọdịnihu wetere.

rows.source: It can't be denied at this time, in a global business environment, that languages continue to be vitally important to the country's future, so this must be mirrored in education.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị mgbe a ga-ekwu na n'oge a, n'ime ọnọdụ azụmahịa zuru ụwa ọnụ, asụsụ na-aga n'ihu na-adị mkpa maka ọdịnihu obodo, ya mere nke a ga-egosipụta na agụmakwụkwọ.
rows.reference: Enweghị ike ịgọnarị ya n’oge a, na gburugburu azụmahịa ụwa, na asụsụ gara n’ihu na adị oke mkpa n’ọdịnihu nke obodo, yabụ ekwesịrị igosipụta nke a n’agụmakwụkwọ.

rows.source: Indeed, modern languages should really be considered "international communication skills."
rows.output: N'ezie, asụsụ ọgbara ọhụrụ kwesịrị n'ezie ka a na-ewere ya dị ka "nka nkwurịta okwu mba ụwa."
rows.reference: N’ezie, ekwesịrị ịhụta asụsụ ọhụụ ka “nka nkwukọrịta ofesi.”

rows.source: Independent schools will continue to offer this choice, diversity and excellence for Scotland's young people.
rows.output: Ụlọ akwụkwọ onwe ha ga-aga n'ihu na-enye nhọrọ a, iche iche na ihe ịga nke ọma maka ndị ntorobịa Scotland.
rows.reference: Ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe ga-aga n’ihu na enye nhọrọ a, ndịiche na ọkachamma maka ndị ntorobịa nke Scotland.

rows.source: Il faut bien le faire.
rows.output: A ga-eme ya.
rows.reference: Il faut bien le faire.

rows.source: John Edward is Director of the Scottish Council of Independent Schools
rows.output: John Edward bụ onye isi ụlọ ọrụ Scottish Council of Independent Schools
rows.reference: John Edward bụ Onye Nduzi nke Nzụkọ nke Ụlọ Akwụkwọ Ndị Nnwere Onwe nke Scotland

rows.source: LeBron to make Lakers debut Sunday in San Diego
rows.output: LeBron ga-eme egwuregwu Lakers na Sọnde na San Diego
rows.reference: Lebron ga-apụta izizi maka ndị Lakers na Sọnde na San Diego

rows.source: The wait is nearly over for fans looking to see LeBron James make his first start for the Los Angeles Lakers.
rows.output: Ụjọ na-adịkarị nso maka ndị na-akwado ya na-eche ka ha hụ LeBron James na-egwu egwu mbụ ya maka Los Angeles Lakers.
rows.reference: Ọchịche abịabele na njedebe maka ndị nsuso na eche ịhụ LeBron James mee mbido izizi ya maka Los Angeles Lakers.

rows.source: Lakers coach Luke Walton has announced that James will play in Sunday's preseason opener against the Denver Nuggets in San Diego.
rows.output: Onye nkuzi Lakers Luke Walton kwuputara na James ga-egwu egwu na egwuregwu mmalite oge n'asọmpi megide Denver Nuggets na San Diego n'ụbọchị Sọnde.
rows.reference: Onye ndu ndị Lakers Luke Walton ekwuola na James ga-eso n’egwuregwu nke nkwadobe afọ asọmpi na Sọnde n’etiti Denver Nuggets na San Diego.

rows.source: But just how many minutes he'll play has yet to be determined.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ naanị ole nkeji ọ ga-egwu ka a ga-ekpebi.
rows.reference: Mana nkeji ole ọ ga-egwu egwuregwu ka amatabeghị.

rows.source: "It will be more than one and less than 48," said Walton on the Lakers" official website.
rows.output: "Ọ ga-abụ karịa otu na ihe na-erughị iri anọ na asatọ," ka Walton kwuru na weebụsaịtị Lakers gọọmentị.
rows.reference: “Ọ ga-akarị otu mana ọ gaghị eru 48,” nke Walton kwuru na weebụsaịtị ndị Lakers ziri ezi.

rows.source: Lakers reporter Mike Trudell tweeted that James will likely play limited minutes.
rows.output: Ndị na-edezi Lakers Mike Trudell tweeted na James ga-egwu nkeji ole na ole.
rows.reference: Onye mkpesa akụkọ nke Lakers Mike Trudell dere na James nwere ike igwu obere egwuregwu.

rows.source: Following practice earlier this week, James was asked about his plans for the Lakers" six-game preseason schedule.
rows.output: Mgbe emechara omume n'izu a, a jụrụ James gbasara atụmatụ ya maka usoro egwuregwu oge okpomọkụ nke Lakers isii.
rows.reference: Isochi nkwadobe na mbido nke izu a, ajụrụ James maka atụmatụ ya maka usoro nke nkwadobe afọ asọmpi egwuregwu isii nke Lakers.

rows.source: "I don't need preseason games at this stage of my career to get ready," he said.
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị mkpa ka m gbaa egwuregwu tupu oge eruo n'oge a nke ọrụ m iji kwadebe."
rows.reference: “Achọghị m egwuregwu a na-eme n’oge mmalite n’ọnọdụ m ugbu a n’ọrụ m, iji dị nkwadebe,” o kwuru.

rows.source: Trump's West Virginia Rally Time, YouTube Channel
rows.output: Ememe Trump na West Virginia, Oge, Ụdị YouTube
rows.reference: Oge nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ Trump nke West Virginia. Youtube Channel

rows.source: President Donald Trump begins a flurry of campaign rallies tonight in Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.output: Onye isi ala Donald Trump malitere ọtụtụ nnọkọ mgbasa ozi taa n'obodo Wheeling, West Virginia.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ala Donald Trump malitere ọtụtụ nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị na Wheeling, West Virginia.

rows.source: It's Trump's first of five scheduled rallies in the next week, including stops in friendly places including Tennessee and Mississippi.
rows.output: Nke a bụ nke mbụ Trump n'ime mmemme ise a haziri n'izu na-abịa, gụnyere nkwụsị na ebe enyi gụnyere Tennessee na Mississippi.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ nke izizi n’ime nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ ise achịkọbara Trump n’izu ise na-abịa, tinyere ebe nkwụsị nke ndị enyi tinyere Tennessee na Mississippi.

rows.source: With the confirmation vote on hold for his pick to fill the Supreme Court vacancy, Trump is aiming to build support for upcoming mid-term elections since Republicans are at risk of losing control of Congress when votes are cast on Nov.
rows.output: N'ịtụ vootu ịkwado nhọrọ ya iji mejupụta oghere Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu, Trump bu n'obi wulite nkwado maka ntuli aka etiti na-abịa ebe ndị Republican na-etinye nnukwu ihe egwu ịla n'iyi nchịkwa Congress mgbe a na-atụ vootu na Nov.
rows.reference: N’ijigide ntuli aka nkwado onye nhọrọ nke ya ịbanye n’ọkwa Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu ghe oghe,Trump na-atụ anya ịkwalite nkwado maka ntuli aka ọkara ọchịchị na-abịa, ebe ndị otu Repọblikan nọ n’ihe egwu nnarapụ njikwa Ụlọ Ọmebe iwu mgbe a ga-atụnye aka na Nov.

rows.source: What time is Trump's West Virginia rally tonight and how do you watch online?
rows.output: Kedu oge ngagharị iwe Trump na West Virginia taa abalị? Kedu ka esi ele ya anya n'ịntanetị?
rows.reference: Kedu oge bụ nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ West Virginia nke Trump n’abalị a, yana kedu ka ị ga-esi lelee ya n’ịntanetị.

rows.source: Trump's Wheeling, West Virginia rally is scheduled for 7 p.m. ET tonight, Saturday, September 29, 2018.
rows.output: Mgbakọ Trump na Wheeling, West Virginia bụ nke a na-eme atụmatụ maka elekere asaa nke abalị. Satọde, Septemba 29, 2018.
rows.reference: Etinyere nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ Trump nke Wheeling West Virginia na elekere 7 nke abalị. ET, Satọde, Septemba 29, 2018.

rows.source: You can watch Trump's West Virginia rally online below via live stream on YouTube.
rows.output: Ị nwere ike ikiri ogbako Trump na steeti West Virginia n'ịntanetị n'okpuru site na ịntanetị ndụ na YouTube.
rows.reference: I nwere ike lelee nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ Trump nke West Virginia n’ịntanetị, n’okpuru site na ihe nkiri ozugbo na Youtube.

rows.source: Trump is likely to address this week's hearings for Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh, which became tense over sexual misconduct allegations with an anticipated Senate confirmation vote on hold for up to a week while the FBI investigates.
rows.output: Mgbe a ga-ekwu maka ịhọpụta ụlọikpe kacha elu Brett Kavanaugh, nke nwere ike ịbụ nke a na-ekwu okwu n'oge a na-eme ya n'izu a, nke nwere ike ịbụ nke a na-ekwu okwu n'oge a na-eme ya n'izu a.
rows.reference: Trump nwere ike ikwu maka nnụrịta ụka nke izu a banyere onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu Brett Kavanaugh, nke malitere ịdị ọgbaghara n’ihi ebubo ihe mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị yana ntuli aka nkwado Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu a na-atụ anya ya ejigidere ihe ruru otu izu mgbe ndị FBI na-eme nyocha.

rows.source: But the primary aim of this flurry of rallies is helping Republicans facing touch November elections gain some momentum.
rows.output: Ma e wezuga ihe a na-eme ugbu a bụ inyere ndị Republican aka na-achọ ịzọ ọkwa n'ọnwa Nọvemba iji nweta ume.
rows.reference: Mana isi atụmatụ ọtụtụ nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ a bụ inyere ndị otu Repọblikan aka na ntuli aka Nọvemba siri ike nwetakwa agbamume.

rows.source: Thus, President Trump's campaign said these five rallies in the next week are aimed at "energizing volunteers and supporters as Republicans try to protect and expand the majorities they hold in the Senate and House of Representatives," according to Reuters.
rows.output: Ya mere, otu mkpọsa onyeisiala Trump kwuru na emume ndị a ga-eme n'izu na-abịa bụ iji "kwalite ndị ọrụ na ndị na-akwado ya ka ndị Republican na-agbalị ichebe na ịgbasa ọtụtụ ndị omeiwu ha nọ n'ụlọ omebe iwu na ụlọ omeiwu," dịka Reuters siri kwuo.
rows.reference: Ya mere, ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị Onye Isi Ala Trump kwuru na nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ nke izu ise a na-abịa bụ maka “ịgba ndị na-enyere aka akwụ ụgwọ na ndị nkwado ume, ka ndị otu Repọblikan na-agbalị ichekwa ma gbasaa na ịmịrịkịtị ha ji na Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Iwu nke Nnukwu na nke Obere” dabere na ndị Reuter.

rows.source: "Control of Congress is so critical for his agenda that the president will travel to as many states as possible as we head into the busy campaign season," a Trump campaign spokesman who declined to be named told Reuters.
rows.output: "Ịchịkwa nke Congress dị oke mkpa maka atụmatụ ya, onyeisiala ahụ ga-aga n'ọtụtụ steeti o kwere mee ka anyị na-abịaru nso n'oge oge mgbasa ozi na-ekwo ekwo," otu onye na-ekwuchitere mgbasa ozi Trump bụ onye jụrụ ikwu aha ya kwuru na Reuters.
rows.reference: “Njikwa Ụlọ Ọmebe Iwu dị oke mkpa maka atụmatụ ya, nke na onye isi ala ga-eje ọtụtụ obodo ka ọ nwere ike, ka anyị na-abanye n’oge ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị” onye nkwuchite okwu ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị Trump nke achọghị ka akpọ aha ya gwara Reuters.

rows.source: Scheduled for Wesbanco Arena in Wheeling, tonight's rally could bring supporters from "Ohio and Pennsylvania and draw coverage from the Pittsburgh media," according to the West Virginia Metro News.
rows.output: Nke a bụ nke a ga-eme n'ama egwuregwu Wesbanco Arena dị na Wheeling, nke a ga-eme n'abalị a nwere ike ịdọta ndị na-akwado ya site na "Ohio na Pennsylvania na dọta mkpuchi site na Pittsburgh media," dịka West Virginia Metro News siri kwuo.
rows.reference: Etinyere na Ama Wesbanco Wheeling, nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ abalị a nwekere ike ịkpọta ndị nkwado si “Ohio na Pennsylvania ma dọrọ mkpuchi site na mgbasa ozi Pittsburgh,”dabere na West Virginia Metro News.

rows.source: Saturday will be the second time in the past month that Trump has visited West Virginia, the state he won by more than 40 percentage points in 2016.
rows.output: Ụbọchị Satọdee ga-abụ nke abụọ n'ime ọnwa gara aga ka Trump gara West Virginia, steeti ọ meriri ihe karịrị pasentị 40 n'afọ 2016.
rows.reference: Satọde ga-abụ ugboro nke abụọ n’ọnwa gara aga Trump gara West Virginia, obodo nke o meriri site na ihe karịrị akara pesentị 40 na 2016.

rows.source: Trump is trying to help West Virginia Republican Senate candidate Patrick Morrisey, who is trailing in the polls.
rows.output: N'ezie, Trump na-agbalị inyere onye ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị Sineti Republican nke West Virginia, Patrick Morrisey, onye na-eso ụzọ na ntuli aka.
rows.reference: Trump na-agbali ịnyere onye ahọpụtara maka Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu Repọblikan West Virginia Patrick Morrisey aka, bụ onye nke na-akpụ akpụ na nyocha.

rows.source: "It's not a good sign for Morrisey that the president has to come to try to give him a boost in the polls," said Simon Haeder, a political scientist at West Virginia University, according to Reuters.
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị mma ka Morrisey na onyeisiala ga-abịa nwaa inye ya aka n'ịtụ vootu," ka Simon Haeder, onye sayensị ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na Mahadum West Virginia, kwuru, dịka Reuters siri kwuo.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụghị ezigbo akara dịịrị Morrisey na onye isi ala ga-abịa iji kwalite ya na nyocha,” Simon Haeder kwuru, onye nyocha sayensị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị na West Virginia University, dabere na Reuters.

rows.source: Ryder Cup 2018: Team USA show stomach for fight to keep hopes alive heading into Sunday singles
rows.output: Ryder Cup 2018: Ndị otu USA na-egosi na ha nwere agụụ maka ịlụ ọgụ iji mee ka olileanya ha dị ndụ na-aga n'ihu n'ime singles Sunday
rows.reference: Ryder Cup 2018: Ndị otu USA gosiri afọ ịlụ ọgụ iji dobe olile anya were banye na asompi agba nke otu onye na Sọnde

rows.source: After three one-sided sessions, Saturday afternoon's foursomes might just have been what this Ryder Cup needed.
rows.output: Mgbe mmemme atọ nke otu akụkụ gasịrị, mgbede Satọdee nke ndị anọ nwere ike ịbụ ihe a chọrọ maka asọmpi Ryder Cup a.
rows.reference: Ka akụchara agba otu akụkụ ugboro atọ, agba mmadụ anọ nke ehihe Satọde nwere ike bụrụ ihe Ryder Cup a chọrọ.

rows.source: The swinging pendulum of momentum is a completely invented sporting concept but one that players truly believe in, and never more so than at competitions like these.
rows.output: Pendulum na-efegharị efegharị bụ echiche egwuregwu zuru oke nke e chepụtara, ma ndị na-egwu egwuregwu kwenyere n'ezie na ya, na ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụla karịa n'asọmpi dị ka ndị a.
rows.reference: Ike nke nkuli ihe bụ kpamkpam atụmatụ egwuregwu achọpụtara mana ọ bụ nke ndị na-egwu egwuregwu kwenyere na ya, nke pụtakarịrị ihie na ụdị asompi dị otu a.

rows.source: So where would they say the momentum is now?
rows.output: Kedu ebe ha ga-ekwu na ike na-aga ugbu a?
rows.reference: Yabụ kedu ebe ha ga-ekwu na ike dị ugbu a?

rows.source: "They had a six-point lead and now it's four, so we are carrying that as a little bit of momentum I guess," said Jordan Spieth as he strolled off for the day.
rows.output: "Nwetara isi isii, ugbu a ọ bụ anọ, ya mere, anyị na-ebu nke ahụ dị ka ntakịrị ume, echere m."
rows.reference: “Ha ji akara isii aga ma ugbu a ọ bụ anọ, yabụ anyị ga-ebu nke ahụ dịka obere agbamume, a na m eche,” Jordan Spieth kwuru ka ọ na-apụ maka ụbọchị ahụ.

rows.source: Europe have the advantage, of course, four points ahead with twelve more in play.
rows.output: Ndị Europe nwere uru, n'ezie, isi anọ n'ihu na iri na abụọ ọzọ n'ọrụ.
rows.reference: Mba Europe nwere uru, n’ezie, akara anọ n’ihu yana iri na abụọ a ka na-akụ akụ.

rows.source: The Americans, as Spieth says, feel they have a little wind in their sails though and they have plenty to be encouraged by, not least the form of Spieth and Justin Thomas who played together all day and each boast three points from four.
rows.output: Ndị America, dị ka Spieth si kwuo, na-eche na ha nwere obere ifufe n'ime ụgbọ ha ma ha nwere ọtụtụ ihe ha ga-eme ka obi dị ha ụtọ, nke kachasị mma bụ ọdịdị Spieth na Justin Thomas bụ ndị na-egwu egwuregwu n'oge niile ma nke ọ bụla n'ime ha nwere isi atọ n'ime anọ.
rows.reference: Ndị America, dịka Spieth kwuru, chere na ha nwere obere ikuku n’ubu ha ma nwee ọtụtụ ihe agbamume, na abụghị opekempe ụdịdị Spieth na Justin Thomas, bụ ndị gwukọrọ egwuregwu ọnụ ụbọchị niile, na onye ọ bụla ga-anya isi akara atọ n’ime anọ.

rows.source: Spieth has been lethal from tee to green and is leading by example.
rows.output: Ihe Spieth na-eme bụ ihe na-egbu egbu site na tee ruo n'akwụkwọ ndụ akwụkwọ ndụ ma ọ na-edu site n'ihe atụ.
rows.reference: Spieth dị mmerụ ahụ kemgbe akụpụrụ na tee ruo na ama ndu ndu ma na-aga dịka ọmụmatụ.

rows.source: Those guttural screams of celebration got louder as his round went on, sinking a crucial putt to take match four all-square when he and Thomas had been two down after two.
rows.output: Mkpọtụ ndị ahụ na-akpụ akpụ nke ememe ahụ na-ada ụda ka ọ na-aga n'ihu, na-efunahụ putt dị mkpa iji mee ka egwuregwu anọ dị n'otu mgbe ha abụọ na Thomas ji ụzọ abụọ.
rows.reference: Mkpu ike nke anurị dasibere ike ka agba nke ya na-aga n’ihu, n’ịkụbanye bọọlụ dị mkpa iji mee ka egwuregwu nke anọ nọrọ n’otu akara mgbe ya na Thomas jiri ọkụkụ abụọ ‘na-akpụ akpụ ka ha kụchara ugboro abụọ.

rows.source: His putt that won them the match on 15 was met with a similar scream, the sort that tells you he believes that the American team is not out of this.
rows.output: Ọkpụkpụ ya nke meriri ha n'egwuregwu ahụ n'otu nkeji iri na ise nwere otu mkpu ahụ, ụdị nke na-agwa gị na otu ndị America adịghị ebe a.
rows.reference: Ụdị olu mkpu ahụ zutere ya na nkụbanye nke nyere ha mmeri na 15, ụdị nke na-agwa gị na ọ kwenyere na ndị America apụbeghị na nke a.

rows.source: "You've really just got to dig deep and worry about your own match," Spieth said.
rows.output: "Ị ga-ewere ya n'obi wee chee maka egwuregwu gị."
rows.reference: “Ị ga-enyobanye anya n’ime were na-atụ uche maka egwuregwu nke gị,” Spieth kwuru.

rows.source: It is all each of these players has left now.
rows.output: Ọ dị naanị ihe ndị a niile fọdụrụ ugbu a.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ naanị ihe ndị niile na-akụ egwuregwu a nwere ugbu a.

rows.source: 18 holes to make a mark.
rows.output: Ise n'elu iri na asatọ iji mee ihe nkpuchi.
rows.reference: Oghere18 iji nwee akara.

rows.source: The only players with more points than Spieth and Thomas over the past two days are Francesco Molinari and Tommy Fleetwood, the indisputable story of the Ryder Cup.
rows.output: Ndị egwuregwu na-enweta isi ihe karịa Spieth na Thomas n'ime ụbọchị abụọ gara aga bụ Francesco Molinari na Tommy Fleetwood, akụkọ na-enweghị mgbagha nke Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Naanị ndị na-akụ egwuregwu a nwere akara karịa Spieth na Thomas n’ime ụbọchị abụọ gara aga bụ Francesco Molinari na Tommy Fleetwood, akụkọ nke Ryder Cup enweghị mgbagha.

rows.source: Europe's odd but adorable couple are four from four and can do no wrong.
rows.output: Otu di na nwunye Europe na-akpa ọchị na-akpa ọchị bụ anọ n'ime anọ na enweghị ike ime ihe ọjọọ.
rows.reference: Njikọ mara mma ma na atụghị anya nke Europe bụ anọ n’ime anọ n’enweghị ike ime ihe ọjọọ ọ bụla.

rows.source: "Moliwood" were the only pair not to shoot a bogey on Saturday afternoon, but they also avoided bogeys on Saturday morning, Friday afternoon and the back nine on Friday morning.
rows.output: "Moliwood" bụ naanị ndị di na nwunye na-adịghị agba bogey n'ehihie Satọde, ma ha zutere bogey n'ụtụtụ Satọde, n'ehihie Fraịde, na nkeji itoolu n'ụtụtụ Fraịde.
rows.reference: “Moliwood” bụ naanị njikọ na-akụfeghị na ehihe Satọde, mana ha zenarịrị nkụfe n’ụtụtụ Satọde, ehihe Fraịde yana ngwucha oghere itoolu n’ụtụtụ Fraịde.

rows.source: That run, and the way their energy seems to flow both to and from this boisterous crowd cements that they are the players to beat on Sunday, and there would be no more popular player to seal a potential European victory as the sun sets over Le Golf National than Fleetwood or Molinari.
rows.output: Nke ahụ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ dị ka ọ na-eme ka ọ
rows.reference: Ọkụkụ ahụ, na ka ike ha si aga ma na-abịa site na ndị igwe mmadụ a na-eme mkpọtụ gosipụtara na ha bụ ndị egwuregwu a ga-achọ imeri na Sọnde, nke n’agaghị enwe onye egwuregwu ọzọ ama ama nwere ike bute mmeri nke mba Europe ka anwụ na-ada na Le Golf National karịa Fleetwood na Molinari.

rows.source: Preferably both simultaneously on different holes.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị mma, ha abụọ n'otu oge na oghere dị iche iche.
rows.reference: Ọ kacha mma ha abụọ n’otu oge n’oghere dị iche iche.

rows.source: Talk of European glory remains premature, though.
rows.output: Taa nke ukwu Europe ka dị ka ihe na-adịghị mma, n'agbanyeghị.
rows.reference: Okwu ebube mba Europe erubeghị, agbanyeghi.

rows.source: Bubba Watson and Webb Simpson made short work of Sergio Garcia, the morning's fourballs hero, when he was paired with Alex Noren.
rows.output: Bubba Watson na Webb Simpson mere ka ọrụ dị mkpirikpi nke Sergio Garcia, dike nke ụtụtụ, mgbe a na-akpọ ya na Alex Noren.
rows.reference: Bubba Watson na Webb Simpson jiri Sergio Garcia mere ihe egwuregwu na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ n’ụtụtụ, mgbe etinyekọrọ yana Alex Noren.

rows.source: A bogey and two doubles on the front nine dug the Spaniard and the Swede into a hole they never got close to climbing out of.
rows.output: Otu bọọlụ na abụọ abụọ n'ihu itoolu dugara onye Spen na onye Sweden n'olulu ha na-enweghị ike ịrịgo.
rows.reference: Ịkụfe otu ugboro na ịkụfe ugboro abụọ n’ọkụkụ ugboro itoolu kụnyere onye mba Spain na Sweden n’olulu nke ha enweghị ike ịrịpụta.

rows.source: On Sunday, though, there is nobody to help you out of your hole.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Sọnde, ọ dịghị onye ga-enyere gị aka pụọ n'ọgba gị.
rows.reference: Na Sọnde, agbanyeghị n’onweghị onye ga-enyere gị aka ịpụta n’olulu gị.

rows.source: The fourballs and foursomes are so fascinating to watch up close because of the interactions between pairings, the advice they give, the advice they don't and the way that a strategy can change in an instant.
rows.output: Ndị anọ na anọ na anọ na anọ na-akpali mmasị ikiri nso n'ihi mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ndị otu, ndụmọdụ ha na-enye, ndụmọdụ ha na-adịghị enye, na ụzọ ụzọ atụmatụ nwere ike isi gbanwee n'otu ntabi anya.
rows.reference: Bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ na agba mmadụ anọ bụ ihe ịtụ n’anya ịnọ nso lelee n’ihi mkparịta ụka dị na etiti njikọ a, ndụmọdụ ha na-enye, ndụmọdụ ha anaghị enye na otu atụmatụ na-esi agbanwe ozugbo ozugbo.

rows.source: Europe have played better as a team thus far and take a significant lead into the final day but this foursomes session also showed that Team USA has the stomach for the fight that some, especially Stateside, had been doubting.
rows.output: Ebe ndị Europe na-egwu nke ọma dị ka otu ahụ ruo ugbu a, ha na-eduga nke ukwuu n'ụbọchị ikpeazụ, mana oge a na-egwuri egwu na foursomes na-egosikwa na Team USA nwere agụụ ọgụ nke ụfọdụ, karịsịa ndị nọ n'akụkụ mmiri, na-enwe obi abụọ.
rows.reference: Mba Europe akụọla nke ọma dịka otu ruo ugbu a ma werekwa isi pụtara ihie ruo n’ụbọchị ikpeazụ mana agba mmadụ anọ a gosiri na otu USA nwere afọ ilụ ọgụ nke na ụfọdụ, ọ kachasị ndị Stateside na-agbagha mgbagha.

rows.source: Europe take 10-6 lead into Ryder Cup final day
rows.output: Europe na-ewe 10-6 na-aga n'ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke Ryder Cup
rows.reference: Mba Europe ji 10-6 aga, were banye Ryder Cup n’ụbọchị ikpeazụ

rows.source: Europe will take a healthy advantage into the final day of the Ryder Cup after emerging from Saturday's fourballs and foursomes matches with a 10-6 lead over the United States.
rows.output: Mpaghara Europe ga-ebu ụzọ nweta uru ahụike n'ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke iko Ryder mgbe ha si na egwuregwu anọ na abụọ pụta na Satọde na isi iri na isii karịa United States.
rows.reference: Mba Europe ga-eji uru mara abụba were banye ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke Ryder Cup ka ha jichara 10-6 aga United State na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ yana agba mmadụ anọ nke Satọde.

rows.source: Inspired duo Tommy Fleetwood and Francesco Molinari led the charge with two victories over a struggling Tiger Woods to take their tally so far at Le Golf National to four points.
rows.output: Ndị otu Tommy Fleetwood na Francesco Molinari, bụ́ ndị a kpaliri, duuru ụzọ site n'ịmeri abụọ n'ọgụ siri ike ha na Tiger Woods, ma nweta isi anọ na Le Golf National.
rows.reference: Ndị abụọ a akpalitere mmụọ ha, Tommy Fleetwood na Francesco Molinari bu ụzọ site na mmeri abụọ emeriri Tiger Woods n’agbalị mgbalị, n’iji akara anọ aga na Le Golf National.

rows.source: Thomas Bjorn's European side, bidding to retain the trophy they lost at Hazeltine two years ago, dominated a misfiring American side in the morning fourballs, taking the series 3-1.
rows.output: N'afọ 2016, ndị otu Europe nke Thomas Bjorn, na-achọ ịlaghachi n'ọkwa nke ha tụfuru na Hazeltine afọ abụọ gara aga, jisiri ike merie ndị otu America na-akụda mmụọ n'oge egwuregwu ụtụtụ anọ, na-ebute ụzọ 3-1.
rows.reference: Ndị otu mba Europe nke Thomas Bjorn, na-achụ ijigide iko mmeri anapụrụ ha na Hazeline afọ abụọ gara aga, nọgidere ndị mba America na-akụgheri akụgheri ike na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ n’ụtụtụ, were 3-1 merie agba nke ahụ.

rows.source: The U.S. offered more resistance in the foursomes, winning two matches, but they could not eat into the deficit.
rows.output: Nke U.S. na-egosi ike karịa n'ime ụzọ anọ, na-emeri egwuregwu abụọ, mana ha enweghị ike iri n'ime ụkọ.
rows.reference: Ndị US zọgidere nke ukwuu na agba mmadụ anọ, wee merie na asompi abụọ, mana ha enweghị ike ibelata ọnụọgụ mmeri.

rows.source: Jim Furyk's side need eight points from Sunday's 12 singles matches to retain the trophy.
rows.output: Otu ndị Jim Furyk chọrọ isi asatọ n'asọmpi iri na abụọ na Sọnde iji nweta iko ahụ.
rows.reference: Otu Jim Furyk chọrọ akara asatọ site na asompi 12 agba nke otu onye mere na Sọnde iji jigide iko mmeri ha.

rows.source: Fleetwood is the first European rookie to win four points in a row while he and Molinari, dubbed "Molliwood" after a sensational weekend are only the second pair to win four points from their opening four matches in Ryder Cup history.
rows.output: Fletụọdu bụ onye mbụ na Europe meriri isi anọ n'usoro mgbe ọ na Molinari, a na-akpọ "Molliwood" mgbe izu ụka dị egwu gasịrị, bụ naanị ndị na-egwu egwuregwu abụọ meriri isi anọ n'ime egwuregwu anọ mbụ ha na akụkọ ihe mere eme nke Ryder Cup.
rows.reference: Fleetwood bụ onye ọhụrụ mbụ mba Europe meriri akara anọ ugboro ugboro ebe ya na Molinari, agụrụ aha “Molliwood” ka izu ụka pụrụ iche gachara bụ otu abụọ jiri akara anọ merie na asompi izizi anọ ha na hịstrị Ryder Cup.

rows.source: Having crushed Woods and Patrick Reed in the fourballs they then gelled superbly to beat a deflated Woods and American rookie Bryson Dechambeau by an even more emphatic 5&4.
rows.output: Mgbe ha kụchara Woods na Patrick Reed n'ime anọ, ha wee jikọta nke ọma ịkụ Woods na onye rookie America bụ Bryson Dechambeau ọbụna 5 & 4.
rows.reference: Ebe ha merigoro Woods na Patrick Reed na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ, ha were jikọọ nke ọma were merie Woods dagoro mba na onye ọhụrụ mba America, Bryson Dechambeau site na 5&4 dara ụda.

rows.source: Woods, who dragged himself through two matches on Saturday, showed occasional bursts of brilliance but he has now lost 19 of his 29 matches in fourballs and foursomes and seven in a row.
rows.output: Woods, onye dọkpụrụ onwe ya site na egwuregwu abụọ na Satọde, gosipụtara mgbawa nke ịma mma mgbe ụfọdụ mana ọ efunahụla egwuregwu iri na itoolu n'ime egwuregwu iri abụọ na itoolu ya na anọ na anọ na asaa n'usoro.
rows.reference: Woods, bụ onye dọgidere onwe ya na asompi abụọ na Satọde gosiri anya nka ya na adanye adanye mana o tufuola asompi 19 n’ime 29 na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ yana agba mmadụ anọ na nke asaa ugboro ugboro.

rows.source: Justin Rose, rested for the morning fourballs, returned to partner Henrik Stenson in the foursomes to a 2&1 defeat of Dustin Johnson and Brooks Koepka - ranked one and three in the world.
rows.output: Nwa-ntụkwasị-obi Justin Rose, nke ezumike nka n'oge ụtụtụ anọ, laghachiri n'otu n'otu na Henrik Stenson na egwuregwu anọ na-efunahụ Dustin Johnson na Brooks Koepka - nke a na-ahazi nke ọma na nke atọ n'ụwa.
rows.reference: Justin Rose zuru ike bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ nke ụtụtụ, were laghachi isonyere Henrik Stenson na agba mmadụ anọ nke ejiri 2&1 were merie Dustin Johnson na Brooks Koepka-ndị nọ n’ọkwa nke mbu na nke atọ na mba ụwa.

rows.source: Europe did not have it al their own way though on a pleasant, breezy day south west of Paris.
rows.output: Europe enweghị ya niile n'onwe ha n'ụbọchị mara mma, na-ekpo ọkụ nke dị n'ebe ndịda ọdịda anyanwụ nke Paris.
rows.reference: Mba Europe enwetachaghị ya ka ha siri chọọ, agbanyeghị n’ụbọchị ikuku ọma mgbada ọdịda anyanwu nke Paris.

rows.source: Three-times major winner Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas set the benchmark for the Americans with two points on Saturday.
rows.output: Ndị mmeri ugboro atọ Jordan Spieth na Justin Thomas setịpụrụ ụkpụrụ maka ndị America na isi abụọ na Satọde.
rows.reference: Jordan Spieth onye mmeri ugboro atọ na Justin Thomas jiri akara abụọ were tọọ ọkọlọtọ maka mba America na Satọde.

rows.source: They earned a gritty 2&1 win over Spain's Jon Rahm and Ian Poulter in the fourballs and returned later to beat Poulter and Rory McIlroy 4&3 in the foursomes having lost the opening two holes.
rows.output: Nwetara mmeri na-adịghị mma 2&1 n'elu Spain Jon Rahm na Ian Poulter na anọ na-akpụ akpụ ma laghachi azụ ka ọ merie Poulter na Rory McIlroy 4&3 na foursomes mgbe ha tụfuru oghere abụọ mbụ.
rows.reference: Ha nwetara mmeri siri ike nke 2&1 na Jon Rahm na Ian Poulter nke mba Spain na bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ were laghachi ọzọ imeri Poulter na Rory Mcllroy 4&3 na agba mmadụ anọ, ebe emerigoro ha n’oghere mmalite abụọ.

rows.source: Only twice in Ryder Cup history has a team come back from a four-point deficit going into the singles, although as holders Furyk's side need only draw to retain the trophy.
rows.output: N'oge Ryder Cup, otu ugboro abụọ ka otu egwuregwu si n'azụ isi anọ na-abanye n'otu n'otu, ọ bụ ezie na dị ka ndị na-ejide, Furyk otu chọrọ naanị ịdọrọ ka ịtọhapụ ihe nrite ahụ.
rows.reference: Naanị ugboro abụọ na hịstrị Ryder Cup ka otu laghachiri azụ site na akara anọ ejiri emeri ha na mbanye agba nke otu onye, n’agbanyeghị dịka ndị ji iko, otu Furyk chọrọ naanị ịgbata onye laba, onye laba iji jigide iko mmeri ha.

rows.source: After being second-best for two days, however, a Sunday counter-attack looks as though it will be beyond them.
rows.output: Mgbe ha abụọ ụbọchị nke abụọ kacha mma, n'agbanyeghị, ọ na-egosi na ọ ga-abụ ihe karịrị ike ha.
rows.reference: Mgbe ha gbachara ndị nke abụọ n’ụbọchị abụọ, kosiladị, mbuso agha nke Sọnde dị ka ihe karịrị ha.

rows.source: North Korea says 'no way' will disarm unilaterally without trust
rows.output: Ndị Korea nke ugwu na-ekwu 'enweghị ụzọ' ga-akwụsị n'otu akụkụ na-enweghị ntụkwasị obi
rows.reference: North Korea kwuru “ọ gaghị eme” ịgbarapụ ngwa ọgụ na anataghị nkwenye

rows.source: North Korea's foreign minister told the United Nations on Saturday continued sanctions were deepening its mistrust in the United States and there was no way the country would give up its nuclear weapons unilaterally under such circumstances.
rows.output: Onye minista na-ahụ maka ihe gbasara mba ofesi nke North Korea gwara United Nations na Satọde na mmachi ndị a na-aga n'ihu na-eme ka obi sie ya ike na United States ma na ọ nweghị ụzọ ọ ga-esi hapụ ngwa agha nuklia ya n'otu akụkụ n'okpuru ọnọdụ ndị ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye Mịnịsta nke mba ofesi North Korea gwara United Nations na Satọde na ịga n’ihu amachibido ha na-ebute atụkwasịghị obi na United State nke na ọ nweghịkwa ka obodo ha ga-esi gbarapụ ngwa ọgụ nuklịa ha n’ụdị ọnọdụ ahụ.

rows.source: Ri Yong Ho told the world body's annual General Assembly that North Korea had taken "significant goodwill measures" in the past year, such as stopping nuclear and missiles tests, dismantling the nuclear test site, and pledging not to proliferate nuclear weapons and nuclear technology.
rows.output: Ri Yong Ho gwara òtù ụwa n'oge nnọkọ oge niile na North Korea ewerela "ụzọ ebere dị mkpa" n'ime afọ gara aga, dị ka ịkwụsị ule nuklia na ule ngwa agha, ịkụda ebe ule nuklia, na ịkwenye na ha agaghị ekpughe ngwa agha nuklia na teknụzụ nuklia.
rows.reference: Ri Yong Ho gwara otu mba ụwa na Mgbakọ Ezumezu ha kwa afọ na North Korea esorola “ezigbo ụzọ pụtara ihie” n’afọ gara aga, dị ka nkwụsị nlele ngwa nuklịa na ogbunigwe, ntọsa ebe nlele ngwa nuklịa ma kwee nkwa na ọ gaghị arụkasị ngwa ọgụ nuklịa na teknụzụ nuklịa.

rows.source: "However, we do not see any corresponding response from the U.S.," he said.
rows.output: "Otú ọ dị, anyị anaghị ahụ nzaghachi ọ bụla na-eme n'ime ihe a na-ekwu banyere U.S.," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Kosiladị, anyị ahụghị asịsa na-esote ya sitere na U,S” o kwuru.

rows.source: "Without any trust in the U.S. there will be no confidence in our national security and under such circumstances there is no way we will unilaterally disarm ourselves first."
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị ntụkwasị obi n'aka ndị America, enweghị ntụkwasị obi n'ọchịchị anyị. N'okpuru ọnọdụ ndị a, ọ gaghị ekwe omume ka anyị kwụsị ngwa agha n'onwe anyị nke mbụ."
rows.reference: “N’enweghị ntụkwasị obi na U.S, agaghị enwekwa okwukwe na nchekwa nke obodo anyị, na n’ụdị ọnọdụ a, ọ nweghị ka anyị ga-esi buru ụzọ gbarapụ ngwa ọgụ anyị.”

rows.source: While Ri reprised familiar North Korean complaints about Washington's resistance to a "phased" approach to denuclearization under which North Korea would be rewarded as it took gradual steps, his statement appeared significant in that it did not reject unilateral denuclearization out of hand as Pyongyang has done in the past.
rows.output: N'oge ahụ, Ri weghachiri mkpesa North Korea na-eme ugboro ugboro banyere Washington na-eguzogide ụzọ "nke a na-eme n'usoro" nke nkwụsị nuklia, nke North Korea ga-enweta ụgwọ ọrụ ka ọ na-aga n'ihu n'ụzọ nwayọọ nwayọọ, okwu ya yiri ka ọ dị mkpa n'ihi na ọ jụghị n'aka n'ịkwụsị n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu n'otu
rows.reference: Ebe Ri gbanwere mkpesa ndị North Korea banyere ọjụjụ nke Washington ime usoro “agba” mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa n’okpuru nke North Korea ga-erite elele dịka ọ na-esonye usoro obere obere, okwu ya bara uru n’ihi na ọ jụghị mgbarapụ ngwa nuklliya ozugbo dịka Pyongyang siri mee n’oge gara aga.

rows.source: Ri referred to a joint statement issued by Kim Jong Un and Donald Trump at a first ever summit between a serving U.S. president and a North Korean leader in Singapore on June 12, when Kim pledged to work toward "denuclearization of the Korean peninsula" while Trump promised guarantees of North Korea's security.
rows.output: Nke a bụ nkwupụta jikọrọ ọnụ nke Kim Jong Un na Donald Trump na nzukọ mbụ n'etiti onye isi ala US na-achị ugbu a na onye ndu North Korea na Singapore na June 12, mgbe Kim kwere nkwa ịrụ ọrụ maka "nkwụsị nke Korean Peninsula" ebe Trump kwere nkwa na-akwado nchekwa North Korea.
rows.reference: Ri rụtụrụ aka na nkwuputa Kim Jong Un na Donald Trump kwukọrịtara na ọgbakọ nke izizi n’etiti onye isi ala U.S nọ n’ọchịchị na onye ọchịchị North Korea na Singapore na Juun 12, mgbe Kim kwere nkwa ịhụ banyere “mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa nke okirikiri Korea” ebe Trump kwere nkwa nchekwa nke North Korea.

rows.source: North Korea has been seeking a formal end to the 1950-53 Korea War, but the United States has said Pyongyang must give up its nuclear weapons first.
rows.output: Mba Korea na-achọ ikpe ziri ezi nke agha Korea nke afọ 1950-53, mana United States kwuru na Pyongyang ga-akwụsị ngwa agha nuklia ya nke mbụ.
rows.reference: North Korea na-achọ njedebe agha 1950-53 nke Korea, mana United States ekwuola na Pyongyang ga-ebu ụzọ gbarapụ ngwa ọgụ nuklliya ya.

rows.source: Washington has also resisted calls to relax tough international sanctions on North Korea.
rows.output: Washington ekwela ka ọ dị mkpa ka ha belata iwu siri ike megide mba ndị ọzọ gbasara North Korea.
rows.reference: Washington ajụkwala oku ibelata mmachibido mba ụwa a siri ike nke North Korea.

rows.source: "The U.S. insists on the "denuclearization-first" and increases the level of pressure by sanctions to achieve their purpose in a coercive manner, and even objecting to the "declaration of the end of war,"" Ri said.
rows.output: "N'ụzọ dị otú a, U.S. na-ekwusi ike na "nke mbụ n'ime nke nwere ike ime ka ha nweta ebumnuche ha n'ụzọ na-akpaghasị ihe, na ọbụna na-emegide "nkwupụta nke njedebe nke agha," ka Ri kwuru.
rows.reference: “U.S kwụgidere na “mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa-izizi” ma bulikwuo nkwanye ya site na mmachibido iji mezuo ebumnuche ha n’ụzọ nkwanye, ma jụkwuo “nkwuputa nke njedebe agha” Ri kwuru.

rows.source: "The perception that sanctions can bring us on our knees is a pipe dream of the people who are ignorant about us.
rows.output: "Ihe na-ekwu na mmachi nwere ike ime ka anyị nọrọ n'ala anyị bụ nrọ nke ndị na-amaghị banyere anyị.
rows.reference: “Nghọta na mmachibido ga-akputu anyị n’ikpere anyị bụ nrọ efu nke ndị na amaghị anyị.

rows.source: But the problem is that the continued sanctions are deepening our mistrust."
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ nsogbu bụ na mmachi na-aga n'ihu na-eme ka obi abụọ anyị dịkwuo omimi."
rows.reference: Mana nsogbu bụ na ịganihu eme machibido na-emina enweghị ntụkwasị obi anyị.”

rows.source: Ri made no mention of plans for a second summit between Kim and Trump that the U.S. leader highlighted at the United Nations earlier in the week.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị mgbe ọ kpọrọ atụmatụ maka nchịkọta nke abụọ n'etiti Kim na Trump nke onye isi U.S. mere ka ọ pụta ìhè na United Nations n'oge nke izu.
rows.reference: Ri ekwughị maka atụmatụ ọgbakọ nke abụọ n’etiti Kim na Trump nke onye ọchịchị U.S kwuturu na United Nation n’izu ahụ.

rows.source: The minister instead highlighted three meetings between Kim and South Korean leader Moon Jae-in in the past five months and added: "If the party to this issue of denuclearization were South Korea and not the U.S., the denuclearization of the Korean peninsula would not have come to such a deadlock."
rows.output: Onye ozi ahụ kama kwusiri ike na e nwere nzukọ atọ n'etiti Kim na onye ndu South Korea Moon Jae-in n'ime ọnwa ise gara aga ma tinye: "Ọ bụrụ na otu pati na okwu a nke ikpochapụ nuklia bụ South Korea na ọ bụghị U.S., a ga-enwe ikpochapụ nuklia n'agwaetiti Korea."
rows.reference: Kama mịnịsta ahụ kwuturu maka nzụkọ atọ n’etiti Kim na onye ọchịchị South Korea Moon Jae-in n’ime ọnwa ise gara aga were tinyekwa: “Ọ bụrụ na ndị ọ metutara n’okwu nke mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa bụ South Korea na ọ bụghị U.S, mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa nke okirikiri Korea agaghị abịa n’ụdị nkụchikọ a.”

rows.source: Even so, the tone of Ri's speech was dramatically different from last year, when he told the U.N. General Assembly that targeting the U.S. mainland with North Korea's rockets was inevitable after "Mr Evil President" Trump called Kim a "rocket man" on a suicide mission.
rows.output: Ọbụna mgbe ahụ, ụda okwu Ri's dị nnọọ iche na nke afọ gara aga, mgbe o kwuru na nnọkọ U.N. General Assembly na ịtụ anya ala US na ogbunigwe North Korea bụ ihe a na-apụghị izere ezere mgbe "Mr. Onye isi ala ọjọọ" Trump kpọrọ Kim "rocket man" na njem igbu onwe ya.
rows.reference: Ọbụlagodi otu a, olu okwu Ri tụgharịrị nke ukwuu site na afọ gara aga, mgbe ọ gwara Mgbakọ Ezumezu U.N. kwuru na iji rọketị ndị North Korea wee nweta isi ala U.S. apụghị ime, ka “Ajọ Onye Isi Ala” Trump kpọrọ Kim “nwoke rọketị” nọ n’ọrụ igbu ọchụ.

rows.source: This year at the United Nations, Trump, who last year threatened to "totally destroy" North Korea, heaped praise on Kim for his courage in taking steps to disarm, but said much work still had to be done and sanctions must remain in place until North Korea denuclearizes.
rows.output: N'afọ a n'ụlọ omeiwu mba ụwa, Trump, onye n'afọ gara aga, kwere na ọ ga-akwatu "n'ụzọ zuru ezu" North Korea, toro Kim maka obi ike ya n'ịgbaso usoro iji kwụsị ngwa agha, ma kwuo na ọrụ dị ukwuu ka kwesịrị ime na mmachi ga-anọgide na ebe ahụ ruo mgbe North Korea kwụsịrị n'ụzọ zuru ezu.
rows.reference: N’afọ a na United Nations, Trump onye nke majara n’afọ gara aga “imebi kpam kpam” North Korea, kpokwasara Kim otito maka obi ọ nwere n’isoro usoro mgbarapụ ngwa agha, mana o kwuru na a ka nwere ọtụtụ ọrụ nke na mmachibido ka ga-adịgide ruo mgbe North Korea kwụsịrị ngwa nuklịa.

rows.source: On Wednesday, Trump said he did not have a time frame for this, saying "If it takes two years, three years or five months - doesn't matter."
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Wenezde, Trump kwuru na o nweghị oge a kapịrị ọnụ maka nke a, na-ekwu, "Ọ bụrụ na ọ na-ewe afọ abụọ, afọ atọ ma ọ bụ ọnwa ise - adịghị mkpa."
rows.reference: Na Wenesde, Trump kwuru na ọ nweghị oge ewepụtara maka nke a, na-ekwu “ọ bụrụ na ọ ga-ewe afọ abụọ, afọ atọ ma ọ bụ ọnwa ise- ọ nweghị ihe ọ pụtara.”

rows.source: China and Russia argue that the U.N. Security Council should reward Pyongyang for steps taken.
rows.output: N'otu aka ahụ, China na Rọshịa na-ekwu na ụlọ ọrụ nchekwa U.N. kwesịrị ịkwụ ụgwọ maka Pyongyang maka usoro e mere.
rows.reference: China na Russia na-arụrịta ụka na Ọgbakọ Nchekwa U.N. kwesịrị inye Pyongyang elele maka usoro ndị ha megoro.

rows.source: However, U.S. Secretary of State Mike Pompeo told the U.N. Security Council on Thursday that: "Enforcement of Security Council sanctions must continue vigorously and without fail until we realize the fully, final, verified denuclearization."
rows.output: Ọbụna, odeakwụkwọ mba ofesi U.S. Mike Pompeo gwara otu ndị ọrụ nchekwa United Nations na Tọzdee na: "A ga-aga n'ihu na-eme ihe ike nke iwu nchekwa nke otu ma ọ dịghị mgbe ọ ga-ada ruo mgbe anyị nwetara nnọkọ zuru oke, ikpeazụ, kwadoro na-enweghị nukes."
rows.reference: Kosiladị, U.S Mike Pompeo gwara Ọgbakọ Nchekwa U,N Na Tọsde na “Mmanye nke mmachibido Ọgbakọ Nchekwa ga-aga n’ihu ike n’ike na-adaghị mba ruo mgbe anyị mezuru mgbarapụ ngwa nuklịa kpam kpam, na njedebe.”

rows.source: The Security Council has unanimously boosted sanctions on North Korea since 2006 in a bid to choke off funding for Pyongyang's nuclear and ballistic missile programs.
rows.output: Ụlọ Nzukọ nchekwa ekwupụtala mmachibido iwu n'otu n'otu na North Korea kemgbe 2006 n'ịgbalị igbochi ego maka mmemme nuklia na ngwa agha ballistic nke Pyongyang.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ Nchekwa ahụ jikọrọ aka ọnụ kwalite mmachibido North Korea kemgbe 2006, n’ụzọ ịgbachi ego maka mmemme ngwa nuklịa na ogbunigwe Pyongyang.

rows.source: Pompeo met Ri on the sidelines of the U.N. General Assembly and said afterwards that he would visit Pyongyang again next month to prepare for a second summit.
rows.output: Pompeo zutere Ri n'akụkụ ọgbakọ U.N. General Assembly wee sị na mgbe ahụ na ọ ga-eleta Pyongyang ọzọ n'ọnwa na-abịa iji kwado maka nzukọ nke abụọ.
rows.reference: Pompeo zutere Ri n’akụkụ nke Mgbakọ Ezumezu U.N. wee gwa ya ka emechara na ọ ga-abịa Pyongyang ọzọ n’ọnwa na-abịa iji kwado maka ọgbakọ nke abụọ.

rows.source: Pompeo has visited North Korea three times already this year, but his last trip did not go well.
rows.output: Pompeo eruola North Korea ugboro atọ n'afọ a, ma njem ikpeazụ ya adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Pompeo ejeela North Korea ugboro atọ n’afọ a, mana njem ikpeazụ ya agaghị nke ọma.

rows.source: He left Pyongyang in July saying that progress had been made, only for North Korea within hours to denounce him for making "gangster-like demands."
rows.output: Ọ hapụrụ Pyongyang n'ọnwa Julaị, na-ekwu na e nwere ọganihu, mana n'ime awa ole na ole, North Korea katọrọ ya maka ịrịọ "arịrịọ dị ka nke mpụ."
rows.reference: Ọ hapụrụ Pyongyang na Julaị na-ekwu na enwela agamnihu, naanị ka North Korea jụ ya n’ime awa ole ma ole maka iti “iwu yiri nke ndị agboro.”

rows.source: North Korea pledged in a meeting with Moon this month to dismantle a missile site and also a nuclear complex if the United States took "corresponding measures."
rows.output: N'oge nzukọ a na-eme na Mọọnu n'ọnwa a, Naịjirịa kwere nkwa ibibi ebe mgbaba na ebe nuklia ma ọ bụrụ na United States ewere "atụmatụ kwekọrọ."
rows.reference: North Korea kwere nkwa na nzụkọ yana Moon mere n’ime ọnwa a ịtọsa ebe ogbunigwe nakwa ụlọ ọrụ nuklịa ma ọ bụrụ na United States esoro “usoro dabara.”

rows.source: He said Kim had told him the "corresponding measures" he was seeking were security guarantees Trump pledged in Singapore and moves toward normalization of relations with Washington.
rows.output: O kwuru na Kim kwuru na “atụmatụ ndị kwekọrọ” ọ na-achọ bụ nkwa nchekwa Trump kwere na Singapore na mmegharị iji kwado mmekọrịta ya na Washington.
rows.reference: O kwuru na Kim gwara ya, “usoro dabara” nke ọ na-achọ bụ nkwa nchekwa Trump kwere ya na nkwa na Singapore yana ịga n’ihu mee ka mmekọrịta dị n’etiti Washington dị mma.

rows.source: Harvard students take course in getting enough rest
rows.output: Ụmụ akwụkwọ Harvard na-amụ ihe gbasara otu esi ehi ụra nke ọma
rows.reference: Ụmụ akwụkwọ Harvard na-eme mmụta ka-esi enwe ezumike zuru ezu

rows.source: A new course at Harvard University this year has got all its undergraduates getting more sleep in a bid to combat the growing macho culture of studying through caffeine-fuelled 'all-nighters.'
rows.output: N'afọ a, otu ọmụmụ ihe ọhụrụ na Mahadum Harvard nwere ụmụ akwụkwọ niile na-ehi ụra karịa n'ihi na ha chọrọ ịlụso omenala nwoke na-adịghị mma ọgụ nke na-eme ka ha na-amụ ihe site n'ịṅụ kọfị na-eme ka ha na-ehi ụra n'abalị dum.
rows.reference: Mmụta ọ hụrụ dị na Mahadum Harvard n’afọ a mere ụmụ akwụkwọ niile na-agụ akwụkwọ ịrahụzu ụra, ime ka echere omenala iji kafin agụ akwụkwọ ‘abalị niile’ aka mgba.’

rows.source: An academic found students at the world's number one university are often clueless when it comes to the very basics about how to look after themselves.
rows.output: Onye ọkà mmụta sayensị chọpụtara na ụmụ akwụkwọ nọ na mahadum kacha elu n'ụwa na-enwekarị ihe efu mgbe ọ bụla ha chere maka ihe ndị bụ́ isi gbasara otú ha ga-esi na-elekọta onwe ha.
rows.reference: Onye mmụta chọpụtara na ụmụ akwụkwọ enwere na Mahadum mbu n’ụwa niile anaghị amakarị ihe kwesịrị ma abịa n’ilekọta onwe ha anya.

rows.source: Charles Czeisler, professor of sleep medicine at Harvard Medical School and a specialist at the Brigham and Women's Hospital, designed the course, which he believes is the first of its kind in the US.
rows.output: Onye nkuzi Charles Czeisler, bụ onye nkuzi ọgwụ ụra na Harvard Medical School na ọkachamara na ụlọ ọgwụ Brigham na ụmụ nwanyị, haziri usoro a, nke ọ kwenyere na ọ bụ nke mbụ ya na US.
rows.reference: Charles Czeisler, ọkammụta ahụike nke ụra na Havard Medical School yana onye ọkachamara na Brigham yana Women Hospital haziri mmụta ahụ, nke ọ kwenyere na ọ bụ ụdịdị ya mbu na US.

rows.source: He was inspired to start the course after giving a talk on the impact sleep deprivation had on learning.
rows.output: Mmetụta ịda mbà n'obi na mmụta.
rows.reference: Ọ nwetara echiche ịmalite mmụta ahụ ka ọ nyechara nkuzi banyere nsonazụ arahụghị ụra na-eme mmụta.

rows.source: 'At the end of it one girl came up to me and said: 'Why am I only being told this now, in my senior year?'
rows.output: 'N'ikpeazụ nke ya, otu nwa agbọghọ bịara n'ihu m wee sị: 'Gịnị kpatara na a na-agwa m nke a ugbu a, n'afọ ikpeazụ m?'
rows.reference: ‘Ka emechara nke ahụ otu nwa agbọghọ biakwutere m nwee sị: ‘Kedu ihe kpatara o jiri bụrụ ugbu a ka a na-agwa m ihe a, n’afọ senịọ m?’

rows.source: She said no one had ever told her about the importance of sleep - which surprised me,' he told The Telegraph.
rows.output: O kwuru na ọ dịghị onye mgbe ọ bụla gwara ya banyere mkpa ụra dị - nke tụrụ m n’anya, o kwuru na Telegraph.
rows.reference: O kwuru na ọ nwebeghị onye gwara ya uru ụra bara- bụ ihe tụrụ m n’anya.’ ọ gwara The Telegraph.

rows.source: The course, rolled out for the first time this year, explains to students the essentials of how good sleep habits help academic and athletic performance, as well as improve their general wellbeing.
rows.output: Mmemme a, ewepụtara oge mbụ n'afọ a, na-akụziri ụmụ akwụkwọ ihe ndị dị mkpa banyere otú àgwà ụra dị mma si eme ka arụmọrụ agụmakwụkwọ na egwuregwu dịkwuo mma, na-akwalitekwa ọdịmma ha n'ozuzu.
rows.reference: Nkuzi ahụ, nke ebupụtara n’izizi ya n’afọ a, kọwaara ụmụ akwụkwọ ka uru akparamagwa ezigbo ụra si enyere agumakwụkwọ yana ime mmemme egwuregwu aka, ma dozikwaa ahụ ha niile.

rows.source: Paul Barreira, professor of psychiatry at Harvard Medical School and executive director of the university's health services, said the university decided to introduce the course after finding students were seriously sleep deprived during the week.
rows.output: Paul Barreira, onye prọfesọ nke psychiatry na Harvard Medical School na onye isi nchịkwa nke ọrụ ahụike nke mahadum, kwuru na mahadum kpebiri itinye usoro a mgbe ha chọpụtara na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-ata ahụhụ nke ukwuu n'ụra n'izu ahụ.
rows.reference: Paul Barreira, ọkammụta ọrịa ọgụgụ isi na mmụọ na Harvard Medical School yana onye isi oche ọrụ ahụike nke mahadum, kwuru na mahadum ahụ kpebiri ịmalite mmụta ahụ ka achọpụtara na ụmụ akwụkwọ anaghị arahụzu ụra n’ime izu.

rows.source: The hour long course involves a series of interactive tasks.
rows.output: Nkeji awa ogologo oge gụnyere usoro ọrụ na-emekọrịta ihe.
rows.reference: Mmụta ahụ ruru otu awa tinyere usoro ọrụ mkparịta ụka.

rows.source: In one section there is an image of a dorm room, where students click on coffee cups, curtains, trainers and books to be told about the effects of caffeine and light and how athletic performance is impacted by sleep deficiency, and the importance of a bedtime routine.
rows.output: N'otu ngalaba, e nwere ihe oyiyi nke ụlọ akwụkwọ, ebe ụmụ akwụkwọ na-akpọkọta iko kọfị, akwa akwa, akpụkpọ ụkwụ na akwụkwọ ka ha mara mmetụta nke kọfị na ìhè na otú arụmọrụ egwuregwu si emetụta ya site na enweghị ụra, na mkpa ọ dị ịmepụta usoro ụra.
rows.reference: N’otu ngalaba enwere onyonyo ime ụlọ ụra, ebe ụmụ akwụkwọ na-apịdo n’iko kọfị, akwa mgbochi, akpụkpụ ụkwụ egwuregwu yana akwụkwọ iji gwa ha banyere nsonazụ kafin na ihie yana ka arahụghị ụra siri emetụta mmemme egwuregwu, n’uru mmemme oge ụra dị.

rows.source: In another section, participants are told how long-term sleep deprivation can increase risks of heart attacks, stroke, depression and cancer.
rows.output: N'akụkụ ọzọ, a na-agwa ndị sonyere otú ịda mbà n'obi ogologo oge nwere ike isi mee ka ihe ize ndụ nke ọrịa obi, ọrịa strok, ịda mbà n'obi, na ọrịa cancer dịkwuo elu.
rows.reference: Na ngalaba ọzọ, agwara ndị sonyere ka arahụghị ụra ogologo oge siri akpalite ihe egwu obi nkolopu, mkpọnwu ahụ, mmụọ ịda mba yana oria mkpụrụ akụ.

rows.source: A map of the campus, with interactive icons, then encourages participants to think about their daily routine.
rows.output: Pịnye nke ogige ahụ, nke nwere akara ngosi na-emekọrịta ihe, na-agba ndị sonyere ume ka ha chee echiche banyere ihe omume ha na-eme kwa ụbọchị.
rows.reference: Maapu ụlọ akwụkwọ nwere akara ngosi mkparịta ụka, wee na-akwado ndị sonyere ka ha chee banyere ihe ha na-eme kwa ụbọchị.

rows.source: 'We know it won't change students' behaviour instantly.
rows.output: Anyị maara na ọ gaghị agbanwe omume ụmụ akwụkwọ ozugbo.
rows.reference: ‘Anyị maara na ọ gaghị agbanwe agwa ụmụ akwụkwọ ozugbo.

rows.source: But we believe they have a right to know - just as you have a right to know the health effects of choosing to smoke cigarettes,' Prof Czeisler added.
rows.output: Ma na-ekweta na ha nwere ikike ịma - dịka unu nwekwara ikike ịma banyere mmetụta ahụike nke ịhọrọ ise sịga,' Prof Czeisler kwuru.
rows.reference: Mana anyị kwenyere na ha nwere ikike ịmata- dịka inwere ikike ịmata nsonazụ nhọrọ ise siga n’ahụike,’ Ọkammụta Czeisler gbakwunyere.

rows.source: The culture of pride in 'pulling an all-nighter' still exists, he said, adding that modern technology and ever-increasing pressure on students meant sleep deprivation was a growing problem.
rows.output: O kwuru na omenala nke ịnya ụgbọ ala n'abalị dum ka dị, ma o kwukwara na teknụzụ nke oge a na nrụgide na-arị elu na ụmụ akwụkwọ na-eme ka nsogbu ihi ụra na-arị elu.
rows.reference: Omenala ngala ‘ịmụ anya abalị niile’ ka dịkwa, o kwuru, tinyere teknụzụ agbara ọhụrụ yana mbawanye nkwanye na-adakwasa ụmụ akwụkwọ, pụtara na arahụghị ụra bụ nsogbu n’ebuwaye.

rows.source: Ensuring you have enough sleep, of a good quality, should be a student's 'secret weapon' to combat stress, exhaustion and anxiety, he said - even to avoid putting on weight, as sleep deprivation puts the brain into starvation mode, making them constantly hungry.
rows.output: Iji ọgwụgwụ gị nke ọma, nke dị mma, kwesịrị ịbụ "ngwa agha nzuzo" nke ụmụ akwụkwọ iji lụso nrụgide, ike ọgwụgwụ, na nchekasị ọgụ, ka o kwuru - ọbụna iji zere ibu ibu, ebe ịda mbà n'obi na-etinye ụbụrụ n'ọnọdụ agụụ, na-eme ka ha na-achọ nri mgbe niile.
rows.reference: Ịgba mbọ hụ na inwetara ụra zuru ezu, dị mma, kwesịrị ịbụ ngwa agha nwata akwụkwọ’ iji chere mgbakasị ahụ, ike ọgwụgwụ na obi mmapụ aka mgba, o kwuru - ọbụlagodi izenari ntinye ahụ, ka arahụghị ụra na-etinye ụbụrụ n’ọnọdụ oke agụụ, na-eme ha agụụ kwa mgbe.

rows.source: Raymond So, a 19-year-old Californian studying chemical and physical biology, helped Professor Czeisler design the course, having taken one of his classes last year during his first year at Harvard.
rows.output: Nwa nwoke dị afọ iri na itoolu si California, na-amụ kemịkalụ na sayensị anụ ahụ, nyere Prọfesọ Czeisler aka ịmepụta usoro a, mgbe ọ gụchara otu n'ime klas ya n'afọ gara aga n'afọ mbụ ya na Harvard.
rows.reference: Raymond So, nwata gbara afọ 19 nke California na-agụ kemikal na fisikal baịyọlọji nyere Ọkammụta Czeisler aka ịhazi mmụta ahụ, ebe o megoro otu klaasị ya n’afọ gara aga n’ime oge afọ izizi ya na Harvard.

rows.source: He said the course had opened his eyes and inspired him to push for a campus-wide course.
rows.output: O kwuru na nkuzi ahu emewo ka o si kpalie ya ime ka nkuzi ahu di nke obodo.
rows.reference: O kwuru na mmụta ahụ mepere anya ya wee kpalite echiche ya ịkwanye ka mmụta a bụrụ maka ụlọ akwụkwọ niile.

rows.source: The next step, he hopes, it to ask all postgraduate students to complete a similar study programme before joining the competitive institution.
rows.output: Nzọụkwụ ọzọ, ọ na-atụ anya, bụ ịrịọ ụmụ akwụkwọ niile nke postgraduate ka ha wuchaa usoro mmụta yiri nke ahụ tupu ha abanye n'ụlọ ọrụ asọmpi.
rows.reference: Nke na-esote ya, ọ na-enwe olile anya ịrịọ ụmụ akwụkwọ ndị gụchagoro mmụta izizi ka ha mejuputa mmụta yitebere nke a tupu ha abanye n’ụlọ akwụkwọ ahụ.

rows.source: Prof Czeisler recommended that students should consider setting an alarm for when to go to bed, as well as for when to wake, and be aware of the harmful effects of 'blue light' emitted by electronic screens and LED lighting, which can throw your circadian rhythm out of kilter, leading to problems falling asleep.
rows.output: Ọkammụta Czeisler tụrụ aro ka ụmụ akwụkwọ tụlee ịtọ oge ịkpọte mgbe ha ga-ehi ụra, yana mgbe ha ga-eteta, ma mara mmetụta ọjọọ nke ìhè 'acha anụnụ anụnụ' na-ebupụta na ihuenyo eletrọnịkị na ọkụ LED, nke nwere ike ime ka usoro iku ume gị daa, na-eduga n'okwu ịrahụ ụra.
rows.reference: Ọkammụta Czeisler kwadoro ka ụmụ akwụkwọ chee banyere itinye otimkpu maka mgbe ha chọrọ ịrahụ ụra, yana mgbe ha chọrọ ikuli, ma marakwa maka nsonazụ mmerụ ahụ ihuenyo ngwa eletrọnịk “ihie agba elu igwe” na-ebute yana ihie LED, nke nwere ike kụpụ usoro ka ahụ gị si akpa agwa, we bute nsogbu ịrahụ ụra.

rows.source: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Menga goal downs Gerrard's men
rows.output: Livingston 1 - 0 Rangers: Mgbalị Menga na-egbochi ndị otu Gerrard
rows.reference: Livingston 1-0 Rangers: Goolu Menga buturu ndị nke Gerrard

rows.source: Rangers suffered another bout of away-day blues as Dolly Menga's strike consigned Steven Gerrard's disjointed side to a 1-0 defeat at Livingston.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers nwetara ọzọ n'ime ihe ịma aka nke ịga n'ihu n'èzí ka ọkpụ Dolly Menga gbochiri otu Steven Gerrard na-adịghị mma 1-0 mmeri na Livingston.
rows.reference: Rangers natara ihe mgbu ka ọgbụgba Dolly Menga kwanyere akụkụ Steven Gerrard ghasara aghasa na mmeri 1-0 emeriri ha na Livingston.

rows.source: The Ibrox side were looking to record their first win on the road since February's 4-1 triumph at St Johnstone, but Gary Holt's team inflicted just Gerrard's second defeat in 18 games as manager to leave his side eight points adrift of runaway Ladbrokes Premiership leaders Hearts.
rows.output: Ndị Ibrox na-achọ ịdekọ mmeri mbụ ha n'èzí kemgbe February 4-1 meriri St Johnstone, mana otu Gary Holt mere ka ọ bụrụ mmeri nke abụọ nke Gerrard ka onye njikwa ya n'ime egwuregwu iri na asatọ ka ọ bụrụ ndị na-agba ọsọ asatọ n'azụ ndị isi otu egwuregwu, Hearts.
rows.reference: Akụkụ Ibrox ahụ na-achọ inweta mmeri nke izizi ha n’ụzọ kemgbe ha meriri 4-1 na Febuarị na St Johnstone, mana ndị otu Gary Holt nyere Gerrard mmeri nke abụọ emeriri ha n’egwuregwu 18 dịka onye njikwa jiri akara asatọ esegharị n’elu nke ndị mbu na Ladbrokes Premiership, Hearts.

rows.source: Menga struck seven minutes before half-time and a Rangers line-up short on inspiration never looked like levelling.
rows.output: Menga kụrụ nkeji asaa tupu oge ọkara, ndị otu Rangers na-enweghị mmụọ nsọ pụrụ iche ahụghị ka ọ ga-aga n'ihu.
rows.reference: Menga jiri tupu nkeji asaa nke ọkara oge were gbanye ọkpụ, na ndị Rangers n’enweghị mkpalite mmụọ adịghị ka ndị ga-agbanyekwa nke ha.

rows.source: While Rangers now drop down to sixth spot, Livingston climb to third and only behind Hibernian on goal difference.
rows.output: Ka ndị Rangers na-ada n'ọkwa nke isii, ndị Livingston na-arị elu n'ọkwa nke atọ ma na-eso Hibernian na ọdịiche goolu.
rows.reference: Ebe ndị Rangers gbadara na ndị nke isii, Linvingston gbagoro na ndị nke atọ ma jiri ndịiche dị na goolu nọrọ naanị n’azụ Hibernian.

rows.source: And there could be further trouble in store for Rangers after linesman Calum Spence had to be treated for a head wound after an object was apparently thrown from the away end.
rows.output: Ma nwee nsogbu ọzọ maka ndị Rangers ka onye nche Calum Spence nwetara ọgwụgwọ maka mmerụ ahụ n'isi mgbe ihe yiri ka a tụbara ya site n'akụkụ dị anya.
rows.reference: Na enwere ike inwe nsogbu n’ọdịnihu maka ndị Rangers ka agwọchara onye na-akwụ n’akụkụ Calum Spencem merụ ahụ n’isi, mgbe atụchara ihe si n’akụkụ nke ndị ọbịa.

rows.source: Gerrard made eight changes to the side which swept past Ayr into the Betfred Cup semi-finals.
rows.output: Gerrard mere mgbanwe asatọ na ndị otu ahụ nke gbara Ayr gburugburu na ọkara ikpeazụ nke iko Betfred.
rows.reference: Gerrard mere mgbanwe asatọ n’akụkụ nke gbafere Ayr were banye n’agba na-esote nke ikpeazụ nke Iko Betfred.

rows.source: Holt, on the other hand, went with the same Livi 11 which took a point off Hearts last week and he would have been delighted with the way his well-drilled outfit suffocated their opponents at every turn.
rows.output: Holt, n'aka nke ọzọ, gara Livi 11 nke wepụrụ otu isi n'ahụ obi Heart na izu gara aga, ọ ga-abụkwa na ọ masịrị ya n'ihe ụtọ nke otu ya nwere n'usoro nke na-egbochi ndị iro ha n'akụkụ niile.
rows.reference: Holt, n’aka nke ya, jiri otu 11 Livi wee gaa, nke napụrụ ndị Hearts otu akara izu gara aga, na ọ gaara ịmasịkwa ya otu ndị nke ya gbasiri ike siri sogide ndị iro ha n’ebe niile.

rows.source: Rangers may have dominated possession but Livingston did more with the ball they had.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers nwere ike ịchịkwa ihe onwunwe mana ndị Livingston mere ihe ndị ọzọ na bọọlụ ha nwere.
rows.reference: Rangers nwere ike bụrụ ndị kacha jide bọọlụ mana Livingston kacha jiri bọọlụ ha nwetere wee mere ihe.

rows.source: They should have scored just two minutes in when Menga's first-time lay-off sent Scott Pittman through on Allan McGregor's goal but the midfielder tugged his big chance wide.
rows.output: Ha kwesịrị ị nweta goolu n'ime nkeji abụọ. Mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị, ọ gbara Menga bọọlụ n'otu oge, wee hapụ Scott Pittman ka ọ gaa n'ihu Allan McGregor, mana onye etiti ahụ tụpụrụ ohere ya nke ukwuu.
rows.reference: Ha kwesịrị iji nkeji abụọ ha jiri banye nye goolu mgbe obere ọkpụkpa izizi nke Menga mere zipuru Scott Pittman na goolu nke Allan McGrego, mana onye nke ahụ na-agba n’etiti gbafuru nnukwu oghere ya.

rows.source: A deep Keaghan Jacobs free-kick then found skipper Craig Halkett but his defensive partner Alan Lithgow could only stab wide at the back post.
rows.output: Mgbọrọgwụ Keaghan Jacobs wee gbachie, wee chọta onyeisi ndị agha Craig Halkett, ma onye mmekọ nchekwa ya bụ Alan Lithgow nwere ike ịgbapụ n'azụ.
rows.reference: Ọgbụgba Keaghan Jacobs mere zutere onye na-eche goolu Craig Halkett mana onye mgbachibido otu ya Alan Lithgow nwere naanị ike ịgbafu ya n’azụ.

rows.source: Rangers did grab control but there looked to be more hope than belief about their play in the final third.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers jidere njikwa mana ọ dị ka enwere olileanya karịa okwukwe banyere ịgba egwu ha na nkeji iri na ise.
rows.reference: Rangers nwetara njikwa mana ọ dịka enwere olile anya karịa ka enwere nkwenye ka otu ha si agba na ngwucha nke atọ.

rows.source: Alfredo Morelos certainly felt he should have had a penalty on the quarter-hour mark as he and Steven Lawless collided but referee Steven Thomson waved away the Colombian's appeals.
rows.output: Ọ bụ Alfredo Morelos chere na ọ ga-enweta ntaramahụhụ n'ime nkeji iri na ise ka ọ na-akụtu Steven Lawless, mana onye ọka ikpe Steven Thomson jụrụ arịrịọ ya.
rows.reference: Alfredo Morelos chere na ọ kwesịrị ịgba penaliti n’akara nkeji iri na ise ka ya na Steven Lawless kụtara mana onye njikwa egwuregwu Steven Thomson lefere mkpesa onye Columbia ahụ anya.

rows.source: Rangers managed just two first-half shots on target but former Ibrox goalkeeper Liam Kelly was barely troubled by Lassana Coulibaly's header and a tame Ovie Ejaria strike.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers jisiri ike nweta ọkpụ abụọ n'ime ọkara mbụ, mana onye bụbu onye nche goolu Ibrox Liam Kelly nwere obere nsogbu na isi Lassana Coulibaly na ọkpụ ụkwụ dị nro Ovie Ejaria.
rows.reference: Rangers gbalịrị naanị ịgbata na postu ugboro abụọ n’ọkara nke mbu mana onye na-echeburu ndị Ibrox goolu Liam Kelly enweghị ihe mmekpa ahụ ọ bụla na nke Lassana Coulibaly jiri isi kụọ yana ọgbụgba adaghị ụda Ovie Ejaria gbara.

rows.source: While Livi's 34th-minute opener may have been against the run of play, no one can deny they deserved it for their graft alone.
rows.output: N'ime nkeji iri atọ na anọ, onye mmeri Livi nwere ike ịbụ ihe megidere ọsọ ọsọ, ma ọ dịghị onye nwere ike ikweta na ha kwesịrị ya maka mbọ ha naanị.
rows.reference: Ebe goolu nkeji 34th ndị Livi gbara nwere ike bụrụ ndapụta, ọ nweghị onye ga-ekwu na ọ dabarọ ha naanị maka mbọ ha gbara.

rows.source: Again Rangers failed to deal with a deep Jacobs set-piece.
rows.output: Ozugbo Rangers emeghị nke ọma n'ịrụ ọrụ na Jacobs set-piece miri emi.
rows.reference: Ọzọkwa Rangers enweghị ike metụta ọkpụkpa Jacob miri emi.

rows.source: Scott Arfield did not react as Declan Gallagher slotted the ball to Scott Robinson, who kept his cool to pick out Menga for a simple finish.
rows.output: Scott Arfield emeghị ka Declan Gallagher gbachara bọọlụ ahụ gaa Scott Robinson, onye nọ jụụ ịchọta Menga maka ịgba bọọlụ dị mfe.
rows.reference: Scott Arfield enweghị ihe ọ mere ka Declan Gallagher gbanyere Scott Robinson bọọlụ, bụ onye dara juu were họrọ Menga maka ịgbachapụ ya.

rows.source: Gerrard acted at the break as he swapped Coulibaly for Ryan Kent and the switch almost provided an immediate impact as the winger slotted in Morelos but the impressive Kelly raced from his line to block.
rows.output: Gerrard rụrụ ọrụ n'oge ezumike ahụ mgbe ọ gbanwere Coulibaly maka Ryan Kent na mgbanwe ahụ nyere aka ozugbo dị ka onye ọkpọ ahụ kụrụ Morelos mana Kelly pụtara ìhè si n'ahịrị ya gbochiri ya.
rows.reference: Gerrard megharịrị na oge ezumike dị ka o jiri Ryan Kent gbanwee Coulibaly nke metụrụ mmetụta ozugbo, ka onye nke na-agba n’akụkụ fanyere Morelos mana Kelly na-agba nke ọma gbara ọsọ site na ebe ọ nọ bịa gbochie.

rows.source: But Livingston continued to suck the visitors into playing exactly the type of game they enjoy, with Lithgow and Halkett sweeping up long ball after long ball.
rows.output: Ma a na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu, ma na-aga n'ihu
rows.reference: Mana Livingston gara n’ihu ime ka ndị ọbịa ahụ na-agba ụdị egwuregwu na-amasị ha, ebe Lithgow na Halkett na-agba bọọlụ ote aka kwa mgbe.

rows.source: Holt's side could have stretched their lead in the final stages but McGregor stood up well to deny Jacobs before Lithgow headed wide from the corner.
rows.output: N'akụkụ Holt nwere ike ime ka ọ bụrụ nke ikpeazụ, ma McGregor siri ike ịjụ Jacobs, ebe Lithgow gbara ọkpụ goolu n'akụkụ.
rows.reference: Akụkụ Holt kaara ịgbatị mmeri ha n’oge ikpeazụ mana McGregor kwuchiri wee jụ Jacobs, tupu Lithgow ewere isi kụpụ bọọlụ n’akụkụ.

rows.source: Rangers substitute Glenn Middleton had another late claim for a penalty as he tangled with Jacobs but again Thomson looked away.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers na-egwu egwu Glenn Middleton nwere arịrịọ ọzọ n'ime oge ikpeazụ ka ọ na-akpachi Jacobs, mana ọzọ, Thomson lere anya.
rows.reference: Onye nnọchite nke Rangers Glenn Middleton nwere mkpesa maka penaliti nke abịaghị n’oge ka ya na Jacobs kụkọrọ mana Thomson lefere anya ọzọkwa.

rows.source: Almanac: The inventor of the Geiger Counter
rows.output: Almanac: Onye mepụtara igwe Geiger
rows.reference: Almanak: Onye mepụtara ngụ Geiger

rows.source: And now a page from our "Sunday Morning" Almanac: September 30, 1882, 136 years ago today, and COUNTING ... the day the future physicist Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger was born in Germany.
rows.output: Ma ugbu a, ibe a si na "Sunday Morning" Almanac: Septemba 30, 1882, afọ 136 gara aga taa, na COUNTING ... ụbọchị a mụrụ onye na-eme nchọpụta sayensị Johannes Wilhelm "Hans" Geiger na Germany.
rows.reference: N’Ugbu a otu ibe sitere na Almanak “Ụtụtụ Sọnde” anyị: Septemba 30, 1882, afọ136 gara aga taa, wee Na-agụ ... ụbọchị nke amụrụ onye nke ga-abụ onye fiziks n’ọdịnihu Johannes Wilhem “Hans” na Germany.

rows.source: Geiger developed a method for detecting and measuring radioactivity, an invention that eventually led to the device known as the Geiger Counter.
rows.output: Geiger mepụtara usoro maka ịchọpụta na ịtụle radieshon redio, ihe okike nke butere ngwa a maara dị ka Geiger Counter.
rows.reference: Geiger mepụtara ụzọ esi achọpụta ma lelee nha redioaktiviti, nchọpụta nke mechara bute ngwa a na-akpọ Ngụ Geiger.

rows.source: A mainstay of science ever since, the Geiger Counter became a pop culture mainstay as well, as in the 1950 movie "Bells of Coronado," starring those seemingly unlikely cowpoke scientists Roy Rogers and Dale Evans:
rows.output: Ihe na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe nkiri na-eme ka ihe
rows.reference: Ebe ndabere sayensi kemgbe, Ngụ Geiger mechara bụrụkwa ndabere agbụrụ ọhụrụ, dịka n’ihe nkiri 1950 “Bells of Coronado.” ndị nọ na ya adịchaghị ka ndị nyocha sayensi na-achị ehi Roy Rogers na Dale Evans:

rows.source: Man: "What in the world is that?"
rows.output: Nwoke: "Gịnị ka ọ bụ n'ụwa a?"
rows.reference: Nwoke: “Ọ gịnị n’elu ụwa nke a bụ ihe ahụ?”

rows.source: Rogers: "It's a Geiger Counter, used to locate radioactive minerals, such as uranium.
rows.output: Rogers: "Ọ bụ igwe na-agụ ọkụ, a na-eji ya chọta mineral ndị na-egbu egbu, dị ka uranium.
rows.reference: Rogers: “Ọ bụ ihe Ngụ Geiger, ejiri achọpụta ebe ihe nnweta dị n’ala nọ dịka uranium.

rows.source: When you put these earphones on, you can actually hear the effects of the atoms given off by the radioactivity in the minerals."
rows.output: Mgbe i tinyeere ndị a na-eku ume n’isi gị, ị nwere ike ịnụ mmetụta nke ụmụ irighiri ihe ndị a na-ahapụ site na radieshon nke mineral ndị ahụ.
rows.reference: Mgbe ịgbanwuru ngwa nti a, i nwere ike ịnụ nsonazụ atọm na-enye sitere na redioaktiviti dị na ihe nnweta dị n’ala.”

rows.source: Evans: "Say, it sure is popping now!"
rows.output: Evans: "Olee, ọ na-eme ka ọkụ na-ama ugbu a!"
rows.reference: Evans: “Kwuo, ọ na-eme eme ugbu a!”

rows.source: "Hans" Geiger died in 1945, just a few days short of his 63rd birthday.
rows.output: "Ọkụ Hans" Geiger nwụrụ na 1945, nanị ụbọchị ole na ole tupu ụbọchị ọmụmụ ya nke iri isii na atọ.
rows.reference: “Hans” Geiger nwụrụ n’afọ 1945, naanị mkpụrụ ụbọchị ole ma ole ruo ụbọchị ọmụmụ 63 ya.

rows.source: But the invention that bears his name lives on.
rows.output: Ma a na-ahụ maka ihe ọhụrụ nke aha ya bụ.
rows.reference: Mana nchọpụta nke bu aha ya dịịrị gaba.

rows.source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells
rows.output: Ogwu ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa kansa ọhụrụ nwere ike ịkụziri usoro mgbochi ahụ ka ọ "hụ" mkpụrụ ndụ ndị na-agba agba
rows.reference: Ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ ọhụrụ nwere ike ikuziri sistem nchekwa ahụ ka ọ “hụ” selụ na-emebi ihe

rows.source: New cancer vaccine can teach the immune system to 'see' rogue cells and kill them
rows.output: Vaccine ọrịa kansa ọhụrụ a nwere ike ịkụziri usoro mgbochi ahụ ka ọ "hụ" mkpụrụ ndụ ndị na-agba agba ma gbuo ha.
rows.reference: Ọgwụ mgbochi ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ ọhụrụ nwere ike ikuziri sistem nchekwa ahụ ka ọ “hụ” selụ na-emebi ihe ma gbuo ha

rows.source: Vaccine teaches immune system to recognise rogue cells as part of treatment
rows.output: Vaccine na-akụziri usoro nchebe ahụ ka ọ mata mkpụrụ ndụ ndị na-emegide ya dị ka akụkụ nke ọgwụgwọ
rows.reference: Ọgwụ mgbochi na-akuziri sistem nchekwa ahụ ka ọ mata selụ na-emebi ihe dịka ụzọ ọgwụgwọ ọrịa

rows.source: Method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in lab
rows.output: Usoro na-agụnye iwepụta mkpụrụ ndụ ọbara ọcha n'aka onye ọrịa, na-agbanwe ha n'ụlọ nyocha
rows.reference: Ụzọ a tinyere ịmịpụta selụ nchekwa ahụ n’ahụ onye ọrịa, were gbanwee ya n’ụlọ nyocha

rows.source: They can then 'see' a protein common to many cancers and then reinjected
rows.output: Ha nwere ike ịhụ protein nke na-eme n'ọtụtụ ọrịa cancer wee weghachi ya
rows.reference: Ha nwere ike ‘ịhụ’ protin na-adịkarị n’ọtụtụ ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ, were gbaghachi ya azụ

rows.source: A trial vaccine is showing promising results in patients with a range of cancers.
rows.output: Nnwale ọgwụ mgbochi na-enye nsonaazụ na-ekwe nkwa n'ime ndị ọrịa nwere ụdị ọrịa kansa dị iche iche.
rows.reference: Ọgwụ mgbochi eji eme nlele na-egosi ndapụta nyere afọ ojuju na ndị ọrịa nwere ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ dị iche iche.

rows.source: One woman treated with the vaccine, which teaches the immune system to recognise rogue cells, saw her ovarian cancer disappear for more than 18 months.
rows.output: Otu nwanyị nke a na-emeso ọgwụ mgbochi ahụ, nke na-akụziri usoro ahụ ji alụso ọrịa ọgụ ka ọ mata mkpụrụ ndụ ndị na-adịghị mma, hụkwara ka ọrịa cancer ovarian ya pụọ ​​n’ime ihe karịrị ọnwa iri na asatọ.
rows.reference: Otu nwanyị ejiri ọgwụ mgbochi ahụ were gwọ, nke na-akuziri sistem nchekwa ahụ ịmata selụ na-emebi ihe, hụrụ ka ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ nke akpa akwa ya pụrụ ihe karịrị ọnwa 18.

rows.source: The method involves extracting immune cells from a patient, altering them in the laboratory so they can "see" a protein common to many cancers called HER2, and then reinjecting the cells.
rows.output: Usoro a na-agụnye iwepụta mkpụrụ ndụ ọbara ọcha n'aka onye ọrịa, mgbanwe ha n'ụlọ nyocha ka ha nwee ike "ịhụ" protein na-ekesa na ọtụtụ ọrịa cancer a na-akpọ HER2, wee tinyeghachi mkpụrụ ndụ ọbara ọcha.
rows.reference: Ụzọ ahụ tinyere ịmịpụta selụ nchekwa ahụ n’ahụ onye ọrịa, were gbanwee ya n’ụlọ nyocha ka ha were ‘hụ’ protin na-adịkarị n’ọtụtụ ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ a na-akpọ HER2, wee gbaghachi selụ ndị ahụ azụ.

rows.source: Professor Jay Berzofsky, of the US National Cancer Institute in Bethesda, Maryland, said: "Our results suggest that we have a very promising vaccine."
rows.output: Jay Berzofsky, bụ onye prọfesọ na National Cancer Institute dị na Bethesda, Maryland, kwuru: "Nsonaazụ anyị na-egosi na anyị nwere ọgwụ mgbochi na-ekwe nkwa."
rows.reference: Ọkammụta Jay Berzofsky nke US National Cancer Institute dị na Bethesda Maryland, kwuru: “Ndapụta anyị na-egosi na anyị nwere ọgwụ mgbochi nyere afọ ojuju.”

rows.source: HER2 "drives the growth of several types of cancer," including breast, ovarian, lung and colorectal cancers, Prof Berzofsky explained.
rows.output: HER2 "na-akwado uto nke ụdị ọrịa cancer dị iche iche," gụnyere ọrịa ara ara, ovarian, imi na ọrịa afọ, ka Prọfesọ Berzofsky kọwara.
rows.reference: HER2 ”na-akwa uto nke ọtụtụ ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ,” tinyere ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ nke ara, akpa akwa, ngu na ọwa nsi, Ọkammụta Berzofsky kọwara.

rows.source: A similar approach of taking immune cells out of patients and "teaching" them how to target cancer cells has worked in treating a type of leukaemia.
rows.output: Usoro yiri nke a na-ewepụ mkpụrụ ndụ ọbara ọcha n'ime ndị ọrịa ma "kụziere" ha ka ha na-elekwasị anya na mkpụrụ ndụ cancer arụ ọrụ nke ọma n'ịgwọ ụdị ụkwara.
rows.reference: Usoro yitebere inwepụ selụ nchekwa ahụ n’ahụ onye ọrịa were “kuziere” ha ka-esi achọpụta selụ ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ arụọla ọrụ n’ịgwọ otu ụdị ọrịa ụmị ọkpụkpụ.

rows.source: Kanye West Embarked on a Pro-Trump Diatribe, Wearing a MAGA Hat, After his SNL Appearance.
rows.output: Kanye West mere njem na-eti mkpu maka onye isi ala Trump, na-eyi okpu MAGA, mgbe ọ pụtara na SNL.
rows.reference: Kanye West Gara Njem Okwu Iwe Binyere Trump, Yiri Okpu MAGA, Ka Ọ Pụtachara na SNL.

rows.source: It Didn't Go Well
rows.output: Ọ dịghị mgbe ọ na-aga nke ọma.
rows.reference: Ọ Gaghị Nke Ọma

rows.source: Kanye West was booed in the studio during a Saturday Night Live after a rambling performance in which he praised U.S. President Donald Trump and said he would run for office in 2020.
rows.output: Kanye West nwetara ọkụ n'ụlọ ihe nkiri n'oge Satọdee Night Live mgbe ihe ngosi ya na-agwụ ike, ebe o toro Onye isi ala U.S. Donald Trump ma kwuo na ya ga-azọ ọkwa n'afọ 2020.
rows.reference: Etikporo Kanye West mkpu n’ụlọ egwu ahụ n’oge Saturday Night Live ka ọ mechara ihe nkiri ọ na-atagheri ọnụ nke otoro Onye Isi Ala Donald Trump nke U.S. were kwuo na ọ ga-apụta zọọ ọkwa na 2020.

rows.source: After performing his third song of the night, called Ghost Town in which he was wearing a Make America Great cap, he went on a rant against the Democrats and reiterated his support for Trump.
rows.output: Mgbe ọ rụchara abụ nke atọ nke abalị, nke akpọrọ Ghost Town, nke ọ na-eyi Make America Great cap, o were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were were
rows.reference: Ka ọ gụchara egwu nke atọ ya n’abalị ahụ, akpọrọ Ghost Town nke oyi okpu Make America Great, ọ gara n’ihu ikwutọ ndị Demokrat were kwuputakwa nkwado ya maka Trump.

rows.source: "So many times I talk to a white person and they say: "How could you like Trump, he's racist?"
rows.output: "Otu oge na-ekwu okwu na onye ọcha na ha na-ekwu: "Kedu ka ị ga-esi dị ka Trump, ọ bụ onye ọkà ihe ọmụma?"
rows.reference: “Ọtụtụ oge m na onye ọcha kparịtara ụka, ha ekwuo: “Kedu ka isi nwee mmasị na Trump, ọ bụ onye kpọrọ onye isi ojii asị?”

rows.source: Well, if I was concerned about racism I would've moved out of America a long time ago," he said.
rows.output: Ọ dị mma, ọ bụrụ na m na-echegbu onwe m banyere ịkpa ókè agbụrụ, agara m America ogologo oge gara aga," o kwuru.
rows.reference: N’ezie, ọ bụrụ na omume ịkpọ onye isi ojii asị na-emetụta m, agaara m apụ na America kemgbe.” o kwuru.

rows.source: SNL started the show with a skit starring Matt Damon in which the Hollywood star made fun of Brett Kavanaugh's testimony before the Senate Judicial Committee on sexual assault claims made by Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.output: SNL malitere ihe ngosi ahụ na ihe nkiri nke gosipụtara Matt Damon, nke kpọrọ ihe na-akpali akpali Brett Kavanaugh n'ihu Kọmitii Ikpe ikpe nke Senate banyere ebubo mmekọahụ nke Christine Blasey Ford mere.
rows.reference: SNL jiri obere ihe ịkpa ọchị wee malite ihe nkiri ahụ nwere Matt Damon, ebe onye ama ama nke Hollywood ahụ mere akaja nkwuputa Brett Kavanaugh n’ihu Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe nke Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu maka ebubo mwakpo nwanyị Christine Blasey Ford boro ya.

rows.source: Although it was not broadcast, the footage of West's rant was uploaded to social media by comedian Chris Rock.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na a naghị agbasa ya, ihe onyonyo nke okwu West ka e tinyere na mgbasa ozi ọha site n'aka onye na-akpa ọchị Chris Rock.
rows.reference: N’agbanyeghị na agbasaghị ya n’ikuku, onye mkpa ọchị Chris Rock bugoro ihe nkiri okwu iwe West ahụ na ụzọ mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta ọha.
