rows.source: It is unclear if Rock was trying to mock West with the posting.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị ihe doro anya na Rock na-agbalị ịkwa emo West na post ahụ.
rows.reference: O doghị anya ma Rock ọ chọrọ ime West akaja site na mbusa ozi ahụ.

rows.source: Also, West had complained to the audience that he had got a hard time backstage about his head wear.
rows.output: Ọzọkwa, West arịọla ìgwè mmadụ ahụ ebubo na o nwetara oge siri ike n'azụ ihe nkiri banyere isi uwe ya.
rows.reference: Ọzọkwa, West kpesara ndị n’elele ihe nkiri ahụ na emechuru ya ihu n’azụ ụlọ banyere okpu isi ya.

rows.source: "They bullied me backstage.
rows.output: "Ha na-akpagbu m n'azụ ihe nkiri.
rows.reference: “Ha gwara okwu m ọjọọ n’azụ ụlọ.

rows.source: They said, 'don't go out there with that hat on.'
rows.output: Ha kwuru, 'gaa n'èzí na-enweghị isi nke ahụ.'
rows.reference: Ha sịrị, ‘eyikwala okpu ahụ were pụọ ebe ahụ.’

rows.source: They bullied me!
rows.output: Ha tiri m mma!
rows.reference: Ha gwara m okwu ọjọọ!

rows.source: And then they say I'm in a sunken place," he said, according to the Washington Examiner.
rows.output: Ọzọkwa, ha na-ekwu na m nọ n'ọnọdụ a na-akpọ "sunken place," ka o kwuru, dịka Washington Examiner si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ha wee kwukwa ọzọ, na m nọ n’ime ebe omimi.” o kwuru, dabere na Washington Examiner.

rows.source: West went on: "You wanna see the sunken place?" saying that he would "put my superman cape on, because this means you can't tell me what to do. You want the world to move forward?
rows.output: Ọwụwa anyanwụ gara n'ihu: "Ị chọrọ ịhụ ebe a na-ada?" na-ekwu na ya ga- "tinye uwe mwụda m, n'ihi na nke a pụtara na ị gaghị enwe ike ịgwa m ihe ọ bụla. Ị chọrọ ka ụwa gaa n'ihu?
rows.reference: West gara n’ihu. “Ị chọrọ ịhụ ebe ihe omimi ahụ?” na-ekwu na ya ga-eyibe uwe superman ya, nke pụtara na ịgaghị agwa m ihe m ga-eme. Ị chọrọ ka ụwa gaa n’ihu?

rows.source: Try love."
rows.output: "Nwa n'anya."
rows.reference: Nwalee ịhụnanya.”

rows.source: His comments drew boos at least twice from the audience and SNL cast members appeared to be embarrassed, Variety reported, with one person there telling the publication: "The entire studio fell dead silent."
rows.output: Nkwuputa ya nwetara ụda mkpu opekata mpe ugboro abụọ site n'aka ndị na-ege ntị, ndị otu SNL yiri ka ha na-ewute ha, dị ka Variety si kwuo, otu onye nọ ebe ahụ gwara akwụkwọ akụkọ ahụ: "Ụlọ ihe nkiri ahụ gbachiri nkịtị kpamkpam."
rows.reference: Okwu ya kpalitere mkpu site na ndị n’elele ihe nkiri ahụ opekempe ugboro abụọ na ndị ọrụ SNL mere ka ndị emechuru ihu, Variety na-ekwu, nke otu onye na-agwa akwụkwọ ozi ahụ: “Ụlọ egwu ahụ niile dara juu.”

rows.source: West had been brought in as a late replacement for singer Ariana Grande, whose former boyfriend, the rapper Mac Miller had died a few days ago.
rows.output: Ndị ọwụwa anyanwụ ewebata dị ka nnọchi maka onye na-abụ abụ Ariana Grande, bụ onye bụbu enyi ya nwoke, rapper Mac Miller nwụrụ ụbọchị ole na ole gara aga.
rows.reference: Ewebatara West dịka onye nnọchi anya onye ọgụ egwu Ariana Grande n’oge ikpeazụ, bụ onye nke enyi ya nwoke na mbu, na-akụ egwu rap Mac Miller nwụrụ na mkpụrụ ụbọchị ole ma ole gara aga.

rows.source: West puzzled many with a performance of the song I Love it, dressed as a Perrier Bottle.
rows.output: Ọwụwa anyanwụ gbagwojuru ọtụtụ ndị anya na arụmọrụ abụ m hụrụ n'anya, yi uwe dị ka bọtlị Perrier.
rows.reference: West tinyere ọtụtụ mmadụ na mgbagwoju anya n’iyi uwe dịka Kalama Perrier were kụọ egwu I Love it ahụ.

rows.source: West got backing from head of conservative group TPUSA, Candace Turner who tweeted: "To one of the most courageous spirits: THANK YOU FOR STANDING UP TO THE MOB."
rows.output: Otu nke ọdịda anyanwụ nwetara nkwado site n'aka onye isi otu ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị nke ọdịnala, TPUSA, Candace Turner bụ onye tweeted: "N'otu n'ime mkpụrụ obi kacha obi ike: Daalụ maka ịnọgide na-eguzo n'ihu ìgwè mmadụ."
rows.reference: West nwetara nkwado site na onye isi otu TPUSA, Candace Turner, bụ onye nke dere na twitter: “Maka otu n’ime ndị nwere mmụọ siri ike: DAALỤ MAKA ỊKWỤGIDE N’IHU NDỊ IGWE MMADỤ.”

rows.source: But talk show host Karen Hunter tweeted that West was simply "being who he is and that's absolutely wonderful."
rows.output: Ma ọ bụkwanụ onye na-akwado mkparịta ụka bụ Karen Hunter tweeted na West na-eme "bụ onye ọ bụ na nke ahụ dị egwu n'ezie."
rows.reference: Mana onye nchịkọba ihe nkiri okwu Karen Hunter dere na twitter na West naanị “bụ onye ọ bụ, na nke a bụ ihe mara oke mma.”

rows.source: "But I chose NOT to reward someone (by purchasing his music or clothing or supporting his "art") who I believe is embracing and spewing ideology that is harmful to my community.
rows.output: "Ma mụtara na agaghị m akwụ ụgwọ onye (site n'ịzụta egwu ya ma ọ bụ uwe ya ma ọ bụ na-akwado "nka" ya) bụ onye na-anabata ma na-ekesa echiche na-emerụ obodo m."
rows.reference: “Mana A họrọ m na m “AGAGHỊ” enye mmadụ elele (site na ịzụ egwu ya ma ọ bụ uwe ya ma ọ bụ kwado “nka” ya} bụ Onye nke m kwenyere na ọ na-amakọ ma na-ekwuputa nkwenye dị mmerụ ahụ n’obodo.

rows.source: He is free.
rows.output: Ọ dị mma.
rows.reference: Ọ nwegoro onwe ya.

rows.source: So are we," she added.
rows.output: Ya mere, anyị na-eme otú ahụ,” o kwuru.
rows.reference: Yabụ ma anyị onwe anyị,” ọ gbakwunyere.

rows.source: Before the show, the rapper announced on Twitter that he had changed his name, saying that he was now "the being formally known as Kanye West."
rows.output: Tupu ihe ngosi ahụ, rapper ahụ kwupụtara na Twitter na ya agbanweela aha ya, na-ekwu na ọ bụ ugbu a "ihe e ji aha Kanye West mara."
rows.reference: Tupu ihe nkiri ahụ onye ọkụ egwu rap a, kwuputara na Twitter na ya agbanwego aha ya,na-ekwu na ọ bụ “onye nke amaara na mbu ka Kanye West.”

rows.source: He is not the first artist to change their name and follows in the footsteps of Diddy, also known as Puff Daddy, Puffy and P Diddy.
rows.output: Ọ bụghị onye mbụ na-agbanwe aha ya ma soro Diddy, nke a makwaara dị ka Puff Daddy, Puffy na P Diddy.
rows.reference: Ọ bụghị onye na-eme ihe egwuregwu izizi nke gbanwere aha ya, na-esonye na nzọ ụkwụ Diddy, onye amakwara ka Puff Daddy, Puffy na P.Diddy.

rows.source: Fellow rapper, Snoop Dogg has had the name Snoop Lion and of course the late music legend Prince, changed his name to a symbol and then the artist previously known as Prince.
rows.output: Onye na-egwu egwu ibe, Snoop Dogg ejirila aha Snoop Lion na n'ezie, onye nwuru anwu bụ́ onye egwu ama ama bụ́ Prince, gbanwere aha ya ka ọ bụrụ akara, wee bụrụ onye na-ese ihe a maara dị ka Prince.
rows.reference: Onye ọkụ egwu rap ibe ya, Snoop Dogg enwela mgbe ọ zara Snoop Lion, ọzọkwa onye ọkụ egwu bụ ọkaibe Prince, gbanwere aha ya ka ọ bụrụ akara yana onye na-eme ihe egwuregwu amaburu dịka Prince.

rows.source: Attempted murder charge over Belfast restaurant stabbing
rows.output: Ntọọrọ mgbapu n'ime ọkụ n'ime ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ dị na Belfast
rows.reference: Ịgba akwụkwọ maka ịnwa igbu ọchụ n’ihi ịsụ mma n’ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ Belfast.

rows.source: A 45-year-old man has been charged with attempted murder after a man was stabbed in a restaurant in east Belfast on Friday.
rows.output: Onye dị afọ iri anọ na ise eboro ebubo ịgbalị igbu mmadụ mgbe otu nwoke merụrụ ahụ́ n'otu ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ dị n'ebe ọwụwa anyanwụ Belfast na Fraịde.
rows.reference: Agbaala otu nwoke dị afọ 45 akwụkwọ maka ịnwa igbu ọchụ, ka asụchara otu nwoke mma n’ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ dị na ọwụwa anyanwụ Belfast na Fraịde.

rows.source: The incident happened in Ballyhackamore, police said.
rows.output: Ihe mberede a mere na Ballyhackamore, ndị uwe ojii kwuru.
rows.reference: Ihe mmereme ahụ mere na Ballyhackamore, onye uwe ojii kwuru.

rows.source: The defendant is expected to appear before Belfast Magistrates' Court on Monday.
rows.output: A na-atụ anya na onye a na-azara ọnụ ga-eje ozi n'Ụlọikpe Magistrates' nke Belfast na Mọnde.
rows.reference: A tụrụ anya na onye ahụ nke na-agọrọ onwe ya ga-abịa n’obere ụlọ ikpe Belfast na Mọnde.

rows.source: The charges will be reviewed by the Public Prosecution Service.
rows.output: Ụgwọ ndị ahụ ga-enyocha ya site na Ọfịs Ọchịchị Nchebe Ọha.
rows.reference: Ndị Ọrụ Ịgba Akwụkwọ Ọhaneze ga-enyocha akwụkwọ ahụ agbara.

rows.source: Game of Thrones star Kit Harington hits out at toxic masculinity
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri na Game of Thrones, Kit Harington, na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na-eti ihe na
rows.reference: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri Game of Thrones Kit Harrington akụsuola n’ihi ọrụ dịrị nwoke dị njọ

rows.source: Kit Harington is known for his sword-swinging role as Jon Snow in HBO's violent medieval fantasy series Game of Thrones.
rows.output: Nke a bụ Kit Harington mara maka ọrụ ya dị ka Jon Snow na usoro ihe nkiri nke HBO, Game of Thrones, bụ nke na-eme ihe ike na akụkọ ifo oge ochie.
rows.reference: Ejiri ịpịa mma mara Kit Harrington dịka Jon Snow na ihe nkiri HBO Game of Thrones nwere ihe egwu nke dabere na echiche agba ochie.

rows.source: But the actor, 31, has hit out at the stereotype of the macho hero, saying such roles on screen mean young boys often feel like they have to be tough to be respected.
rows.output: Ma onye na-eme ihe nkiri, dị afọ 31, ekwetaghị na stereotype nke dike nwoke, na-ekwu na ọrụ ndị dị otú ahụ na ihuenyo na-eme ka ụmụaka na-eto eto na-eche na ha ga-adị ike ka a na-asọpụrụ.
rows.reference: Mana nwoke ahụ na-eme ihe nkiri a, 31, akụsuola ejirimara enwere maka ndị dike, na-ekwu na ụdị ime ejije a n’ihuenyo pụtara na ụmụaka ndị nwoke ga-eche na ha kwesịrị isi ike tupu ha enweta nsọpụrụ.

rows.source: Speaking to The Sunday Times Culture, Kit said he believes 'something's gone wrong' and questioned how to tackle the problem of toxic masculinity in the #MeToo era.
rows.output: N'ekwughị okwu n'akwụkwọ akụkọ Sunday Times Culture, Kit kwuru na ọ kwenyere na "ihe adịghị mma" ma jụọ ka esi edozi nsogbu nke ịkpa ókè nwoke na nwanyị n'oge #MeToo.
rows.reference: Mgbe ọ na-agwa The Sunday Times Culture, Kit kwuru na ọ kwenyere ‘n’ihe emebiela’ wee jụọ ka a ga-esi were luso nsogbu ọrụ dịrị nwoke dị njọ ọgụ n’oge #MeToo.

rows.source: Kit, who recently married his Game of Thrones co-star Rose Leslie, also 31, admitted he feels 'quite strongly' about addressing the issue.
rows.output: Kit, onye lụrụ nwunye ya n'oge na-adịbeghị anya, onye na-eme ihe nkiri nke Game of Thrones, Rose Leslie, onye dị afọ 31, kwetara na ya na-eche "n'ụzọ siri ike" banyere okwu a.
rows.reference: Kit, onye nke lụrụ onye ya na ya na-emekọ ihe nkiri Game of Thrones Rose Leslie, dịkwa 31, kwetara na ọ ‘na-emetụta ya nke ukwuu’ banyere ịkpatụ aka n’okwu ahụ.

rows.source: 'I feel personally, quite strongly, at the moment - where have we gone wrong with masculinity?,' he said.
rows.output: "Ọ na-ama m na nke a, nke ukwuu, n'oge a - gịnị ka anyị mere na nwoke?" o kwuru.
rows.reference: ‘N’onwe m, ọ na-emetụta m nke ukwuu, ugbu a - kedu ebe anyị gabigara n’ọrụ dịrị nwoke?,’ o kwuru.

rows.source: 'What have we been teaching men when they're growing up, in terms of the problem we see now?'
rows.output: 'Gịnị ka anyị na-akụziri ụmụ nwoke mgbe ha na-eto eto, n'ihe gbasara nsogbu anyị na-ahụ ugbu a?'
rows.reference: ‘Kedu ihe anyị na-akuziri ụmụ-nwoke mgbe ha na-etolite etolite, n’ihe banyere nsogbu anyị na-ahụ ugbu a?’

rows.source: Kit believes television may be partly responsible for the rise in toxic masculinity thanks to its very masculine characters.
rows.output: Kit kwenyere na telivishọn nwere ike ịbụ akụkụ nke ịrị elu nke ịkpa ókè nwoke n'ihi àgwà nwoke ya nke ukwuu.
rows.reference: Kit kwenyere na igwe ihe nkiri ketere obere oke maka mbawanye ọrụ dịrị nwoke dị njọ, ekele dịịrị agwa ụmụ-nwoke n’ihe nkiri.

rows.source: He continued: 'What's innate and what's taught?
rows.output: Ọ gara n'ihu: 'Gịnị bụ nke a mụrụ na gịnị bụ nke e kụziiri?
rows.reference: Ọ gara n’ihu: ‘Kedu ihe bụ ọnatarachi na nke akuziri akuzi?

rows.source: What is taught on TV, and in the streets, that makes young boys feel they have to be this certain side of being a man?
rows.output: Gịnị ka a na-akụzi n’ime TV, na n’okporo ámá, nke na-eme ka ụmụ nwoke na-eto eto nwee mmetụta na ha ga-abụ akụkụ ụfọdụ nke ịbụ nwoke?
rows.reference: Kedu ihe a na-akuzi n’igwe ihe nkiri, yana n’ime ogbe na-eme ka ụmụaka ndị nwoke chee na ha kwesịrị ịdị ụdị akụkụ a na nwoke?

rows.source: I think that's really one of the big questions in our time - how do we change that?
rows.output: Ekwenyere m na nke ahụ bụ otu n'ime ajụjụ ndị dị mkpa n'oge anyị - kedu ka anyị ga-esi gbanwee nke ahụ?
rows.reference: A na m eche na nke ahụ bụ nnukwu ajụjụ n’oge anyị a -kedu ka anyị ga-esi gbanwee ya?

rows.source: Because clearly something has gone wrong for young men.'
rows.output: N'ihi na nke a doro anya na ihe adịghị mma maka ndị ntorobịa.
rows.reference: N’ihi o doro anya na ọ nwela ihe mebiri n’ụmụaka ndị nwoke anyị.’

rows.source: In the interview he also admitted that he wouldn't be doing any Game of Thrones prequels or sequels when the series comes to an end next summer, saying he is 'done with battlefields and horses'.
rows.output: N'ajụjụ ọnụ ahụ, o kwetara na ya agaghị eme ihe ọ bụla na-egosi ihe nkiri Game of Thrones ma ọ bụ ihe na-esote ya mgbe usoro ahụ gasịrị n'oge okpomọkụ na-abịa, na-ekwu na ọ "emechara na ubi agha na ịnyịnya."
rows.reference: N’ajụjụ ọnụ ahụ ọ kwetara na ya agaghị eme akụkọ mmalite ma ọ bụ nke nsochi Game of Thrones ma ejije ahụ bịa na njedebe n’oge okpomọkụ na-abịa, na-ekwu na ya na ama ịlụ agha na ịnyịnya emechela’.

rows.source: From November Kit will star in a revival of Sam Shepard's True West which is the story of a film producer and his brother, who is a robber.
rows.output: Site na Nọvemba Kit ga-egosi na mmeghari nke Sam Shepard's True West nke bụ akụkọ banyere onye na-emepụta ihe nkiri na nwanne ya nwoke, bụ onye ohi.
rows.reference: Site na na Novemba Kit ga-apụta na mmegharị Sam Shepard True West nke bụ akụkọ maka onye na-emepụta ihe nkiri na nwanne ya nwoke, bụ onye ohi.

rows.source: The actor recently revealed that he considers meeting his wife Rose to be the best thing to come out of Game of Thrones.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe nkiri ahụ kpughere na ọ na-ewere izute nwunye ya Rose dị ka ihe kacha mma sitere na Egwuregwu nke ocheeze.
rows.reference: Nwoke ahụ na-eme ihe nkiri kwuputara n’oge adịghị anya na ọ na-eche na izute nwunye ya Rose bụ ihe kachasị mma mere ya na Game of Thrones.

rows.source: 'I met my wife in this show, so in that way it gave me my future family, and my life from here on in,' he said.
rows.output: 'Zutere m nwunye m n'ime ihe ngosi a, ya mere n'ụzọ ahụ o nyere m ezinụlọ ọdịnihu m, na ndụ m site ugbu a gaa n'ihu,' ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: ‘Ezutere m nwunye m n’ihe nkiri a, yabụ n’ụzọ nke ahụ o nyere m ezinụlọ m n’ọdịnihu, ya na ndụ m were dịrị gaba.’ o kwuru.

rows.source: Rose played Ygritte, the love interest of Kit's character Jon Snow, in the Emmy award-winning fantasy series.
rows.output: Rose gbara Ygritte, ịhụnanya nke Kit's character Jon Snow, na ihe nkiri fantasy nke nwetara ihe nrite Emmy.
rows.reference: Rose mere Ygritte, bụ onye Kit na eṅomi, Jon Snow hụrụ n’anya, n’ejije nwetara awọdụ Emmy.

rows.source: The couple married in June 2018 on the grounds of Leslie's family estate in Scotland.
rows.output: Di na nwunye ahụ lụrụ na June 2018 n'ubi ụlọ ebe a na-eli ozu nke ezinụlọ Leslie na Scotland.
rows.reference: Di na nwunye ahụ lụrụ na Juun 2018 n’ala ogige be Leslie na Scotland.

rows.source: HIV/Aids: China reports 14% surge in new cases
rows.output: HIV/Aids: China na-akọ 14% ịrị elu na ọhụrụ ikpe
rows.reference: HIV/Ọrịa obiri n’aja ọcha: China n’akọ na-enwere mgbali 14% n’okwu ọhụrụ

rows.source: China has announced a 14% jump in the number of its citizens who are living with HIV and Aids.
rows.output: Ndị China ekwupụtala mmụba 14% na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị bi na ya na-ebi na HIV na AIDS.
rows.reference: China mara ọkwa na-enwere mgbali 14% n’ọnụọgụ ndị amaala ya nwere HIV na Ọrịa obiri n’aja ọcha.

rows.source: More than 820,000 people are affected in the country, health officials say.
rows.output: Karịa mmadụ 820,000 na-emetụta na mba ahụ, ndị ọrụ ahụike kwuru.
rows.reference: Ihe karịrị mmadụ 820,000 ka ọ metụtara n’obodo ahụ, ndị ọrụ ahụike na-ekwu.

rows.source: About 40,000 new cases were reported in the second quarter of 2018 alone.
rows.output: Ihe dị ka mmadụ iri anọ puku ọhụrụ e mere akụkọ banyere ya na nkeji anọ nke abụọ nke 2018.
rows.reference: Ihe ruru okwu 40,000 ọhụrụ ka ekpesara naanị n’ime agba nke abụọ na nkeji anọ 2018.

rows.source: The vast majority of new cases were transmitted through sex, marking a change from the past.
rows.output: Ihe ka ukwuu nke ikpe ọhụrụ a na-agbasa site n'ime mmekọahụ, na-egosi mgbanwe n'ihe gara aga.
rows.reference: Ọtụtụ n’ime okwu ọhụrụ a bụ site na n’ụzọ mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị ka esiri bufee ya, na-egosi mgbanwe n’oge gara aga.

rows.source: Traditionally, HIV spread rapidly through some parts of China as a result of infected blood transfusions.
rows.output: N'oge gara aga, HIV gbasara ngwa ngwa n'akụkụ ụfọdụ nke China n'ihi ọbara mmetọ.
rows.reference: N’omenala, HIV gbasara ngwangwa n’akụkụ ụfọdụ China n’ihi ọbara ndị butere ọrịa agbanyere ha.

rows.source: But the number of people contracting HIV in this way had been reduced to almost zero, Chinese health officials said at a conference in Yunnan province.
rows.output: Ma ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-ebute HIV n'ụzọ a ebelatala nke ukwuu, ndị ọrụ ahụike China kwuru na nzukọ na Yunnan.
rows.reference: Mana ọnụọgụ ndị na-ebute HIV n’ụzọ a, ebelatala ihe ruru efu, ndị ọrụ ahụike China kwuru n’ọgbakọ emere n’okirikiri Yunnan.

rows.source: Year-on-year, however, the number of those living with HIV and Aids in China has risen by 100,000 people.
rows.output: N'afọ ọ bụla, ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-ebi na HIV na AIDS na China abawanyela site na mmadụ 100,000.
rows.reference: Afọ n’elu afọ, kosiladị, ọnụọgụ ndị nwere HIV na Ọrịa obiri n’aja ọcha ejirila mmadụ 100,000 gbalie.

rows.source: HIV transmission through sex is an acute issue in China's LGBT community.
rows.output: mgbasa ozi HIV site n'ime mmekọahụ bụ nsogbu dị oke mkpa n'ime obodo LGBT nke China.
rows.reference: Nbufe HIV site na mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị bụ okwu siri ike n’ogbe LGBT ndị China.

rows.source: Homosexuality was decriminalised in China in 1997, but discrimination against LGBT people is said to be rife.
rows.output: Mwakpo nwoke na nwanyị na-akwadoghị na China na 1997, ma na-ekwu na a na-eme ịkpọasị megide ndị LGBT.
rows.reference: Ewepuru ịda iwu dị n’okwu mmekọrịta nwoke na nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị na nwaanyị na China na 1997, mana mkpachapụ ndị LGBT ka dị nnukwu.

rows.source: Because of the country's conservative values, studies have estimated that 70-90% of men who have sex with men will eventually marry women.
rows.output: N'ihi àgwà ndị omenkà nke mba ahụ, ọmụmụ ihe na-ekwu na 70-90% nke ndị ikom na-enwe mmekọahụ na ndị ikom ga-alụrịrị ụmụ nwanyị n'ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: N’ihi ụkpụrụ nchekwa nke obodo ahụ, mmụta nyocha na-ama amụma n’ihe ruru 70-90% ụmụ nwoke ndị na-enwe mmekọrịta nwoke na nwoke ga-emecha lụọ nwanyị.

rows.source: Many of the transmissions of the diseases come from inadequate sexual protections in these relationships.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ n'ime mgbasa nke ọrịa a na-enweta site na nchebe mmekọahụ ezughị oke n'ime mmekọrịta ndị a.
rows.reference: Ọtụtụ n’ime mbufe ọrịa ndị ahụ na esite na-emeghị mkpuchi mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị zuru oke n’ime ịme enyi ndị a.

rows.source: Since 2003, China's government has promised universal access to HIV medication as part of an effort to tackle the issue.
rows.output: N'afọ 2003, ọchịchị China kwere nkwa ịnweta ọgwụgwọ HIV zuru ụwa ọnụ dịka akụkụ nke mbọ iji dozie okwu a.
rows.reference: Kemgbe 2003, gọọmentị China ekwela nkwa nweta ọgwụ HIV bụ ozurumba dịka mbọ ha imegide okwu ahụ.

rows.source: Maxine Waters denies staffer leaked GOP senators' data, blasts 'dangerous lies' and 'conspiracy theories'
rows.output: Maxine Waters jụrụ onye ọrụ ya na-ekpughe data ndị omebe iwu GOP, na-ata "ihe ọjọọ ụgha" na "nkọwa nkọwa."
rows.reference: Maxine Waters agọla agụgọ na onye ọrụ ya bụ onye busara data ndị ọmebe iwu GOP, kwutọọ ‘asị ọjọọ’ na ‘amụma ịkpa nkata’

rows.source: U.S. Rep. Maxine Waters on Saturday denounced allegations that a member of her staff had posted the personal information of three Republican U.S. senators onto the lawmakers' Wikipedia pages.
rows.output: Onye omebe iwu U.S. Maxine Waters katọrọ ebubo na onye ọrụ ya tinyere ozi nkeonwe nke ndị omebe iwu Republican atọ nke U.S. na ibe Wikipedia ha.
rows.reference: U.S. Onye ọmebe iwu Maxine Waters na Satọde gọnarịrị ebubo na otu onye ọrụ ya tinyere ozi nkeonwe nke ndị ọmebe iwu atọ Repọblikan U.S. na ibe ọmebe iwu Wikipedia.

rows.source: The Los Angeles Democrat asserted that the claims were being pedaled by "ultra-right wing" pundits and websites.
rows.output: Onye ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị Los Angeles kwuru na ebubo a na-ere ahịa site n'aka "ndị na-eme ihe n'aka nri" na saịtị.
rows.reference: Onye Los Angeles Demokrat ahụ kwusiri ike na ndị na-ebusa ebubo ahụ bụ ndị otu “ultra-right wing” na ndị websaịtị.

rows.source: "Lies, lies, and more despicable lies," Waters said in a statement on Twitter.
rows.output: "Nkwa, nkwa, na ọtụtụ ihe ọjọọ."
rows.reference: “Asị, asị, na asị ọjọọ,” Waters kwuru na nkwuputa na Twitter.

rows.source: The released information reportedly included the home addresses and phone numbers for U.S. Sens. Lindsey Graham of South Carolina, and Mike Lee and Orrin Hatch, both of Utah.
rows.output: A na-ekwu na ozi e nyere gụnyere adreesị ụlọ na nọmba ekwentị maka Sinetọ Lindsey Graham nke South Carolina, na Mike Lee na Orrin Hatch, abụọ nke Utah.
rows.reference: Ozi nke ahụ ewepụtara nwere adreesị ụlọ na akara ekwentị maka Ndị Ọmebe Iwu U.S Lindsey Graham nke South Carolina, na Mike Lee yana Orrin Hatch, ha abụọ bụ ndị Utah.

rows.source: The information appeared online Thursday, posted by an unknown person on Capitol Hill during a Senate panel's hearing on the sexual misconduct allegations against Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Mkpebi aha ahụ pụtara n'ịntanetị n'ụbọchị Tọzdee, nke onye amaghị aha ya bipụtara n'Ugwu Kapitol n'oge nnọkọ kọmitii Sineti na ebubo mmetọ mmekọahụ megide onye ahọpụtara Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Ozi ahụ pụtara n’ịntanetị na Tọsde, nke amaghị onye tinyere ya na Capitol Hill n’oge nnụrịta ụka ọgbakọ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu banyere ebubo mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị eboro onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu Brett Kavanaugh.

rows.source: The leak came sometime after the three senators had questioned Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Mgbapụ ahụ mere mgbe ndị sinetọ atọ ahụ jụrụ Kavanaugh ajụjụ.
rows.reference: Mbusa ahụ pụtara mgbe ndị ọmebe iwu mmadụ atọ gbara Kavanaugh ajụjụ.

rows.source: Conservative sites such as Gateway Pundit and RedState reported that the IP address that identifies the source of the posts was associated with Waters" office and released the information of a member of Waters' staff, the Hill reported.
rows.output: N'akụkụ ndị na-akwado ọdịnala dị ka Gateway Pundit na RedState kọrọ na adreesị IP nke na-achọpụta isi mmalite nke posts ahụ metụtara ụlọ ọrụ Waters ma wepụta ozi gbasara onye otu ndị ọrụ Waters, dị ka akụkọ Hill siri kwuo.
rows.reference: Ndị saịtị nchekwa ụkpụrụ dịka Gateway Pundit na Redstate kwuputara na adreesị IP ejiri mara ebe ozi ahụ siri busa metụtara ụlọ ọrụ Waters, wee wepụta ozi nke onye ọrụ Waters, Hill kwuputara.

rows.source: "This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie," Waters continued.
rows.output: "Nkwupụta a na-enweghị isi bụ nke ụgha kpamkpam ma bụrụ ụgha zuru oke," Waters gara n'ihu.
rows.reference: “Ebubo a n’enwegh isi bụ ụgha kpamkpam yana asị zuru ezu,”Waters gara n’ihu.

rows.source: "The member of my staff - whose identity, personal information, and safety have been compromised as a result of these fraudulent and false allegations - was in no way responsible for the leak of this information.
rows.output: Onye ọrụ m - onye njirimara ya, ozi onwe ya, na nchekwa ya emebiela n'ihi ebubo aghụghọ na ụgha ndị a - enweghị ọrụ ọ bụla maka mwepu ozi a.
rows.reference: “Onye ọrụ m nke emebigoro nzuzo onye ọ bụ, ozi nkeonwe na nchekwa ya n’ihi ebubo aghụghọ na ụgha ndị a - enweghị ka aka ya siri dị na mbusa ozi ahụ.

rows.source: This unfounded allegation is completely false and an absolute lie."
rows.output: Nke a bụ nkwupụta na-enweghị isi, bụ nke ụgha kpamkpam ma bụrụ ụgha zuru oke.
rows.reference: Ebubo a n’enweghị isi bụ ụgha kpamkpam yana asị zuru ezu.”

rows.source: Waters' statement quickly drew criticism online, including from former White House press secretary Ari Fleischer.
rows.output: Okwu Waters nwetara nkatọ ngwa ngwa n'ịntanetị, gụnyere nke onye bụbu odeakwụkwọ mgbasa ozi White House bụ Ari Fleischer.
rows.reference: Nkwuputa Waters kpalitere nkọcha ozugbo n’ịntanetị, tinyere onye n’ahụ maka mgbasa ozi White House gara aga Ari Fleischer.

rows.source: "This denial is angry," Fleischer wrote.
rows.output: "Nke a na-akpasu iwe iwe aghụghọ," ka Fleischer dere.
rows.reference: “Ngọnarị a dị iwe,” Fleischer dere.

rows.source: "This suggests she doesn't have the temperment to be a Member of Congress.
rows.output: "Nke a na-atụ aro na ọ nweghị àgwà ọ ga-abụ onye otu Ụlọ Nzukọ Alaeze."
rows.reference: “Nke a pụtara na ọ nweghị ụdị mmụọ eji a bụ Onye Ọmebe Iwu.

rows.source: When someone is accused of something they didn't do, they must not be angry.
rows.output: Mgbe mmadụ na-ekwu na mmadụ mere ihe ha na-emeghị, ha ekwesịghị ịbụ iwe.
rows.reference: Mgbe eboro mmadụ ihe ha emeghị, ha ekwesịghị iwe iwe.

rows.source: They must not be defiant.
rows.output: Ha ekwesịghị ịdị nganga.
rows.reference: Ha ekwesịghị ịrụ ụka.

rows.source: They must not question the motives of the accuser.
rows.output: Ha ga-ajụ ajụjụ banyere ihe mere onye na-ekwu okwu.
rows.reference: Ha ekwesịghị ịjụ ebumnuche onye boro ebubo.

rows.source: They must be calm and serene."
rows.output: Ha ga-adị jụụ na nke dị jụụ."
rows.reference: Ha kwesịrị ịdị nwayọọ ma daa jụụ.”

rows.source: Fleischer was appearing to compare Waters' reaction to the Democrats' criticism of Judge Kavanaugh, who was accused by critics of seeming too angry during Thursday's hearing.
rows.output: Fleischer na-egosi na ọ na-atụnyere mmeghachi omume Waters na nkatọ ndị Democrats banyere onye ọka ikpe Kavanaugh, bụ ndị ndị nkatọ boro ebubo na ọ na-adị ha ka ha na-ewe iwe n'oge a na-ekpe ikpe na Tọzdee.
rows.reference: Ọ bịara dịka Fleischer na-atule omume Waters na nkọcha ndị Demokrat mere Ọka Ikpe Kavanaugh, bụ onye nke ndị nkọcha boro ebubo na ọ dịka ọ were nnukwu iwe n’oge nnụrịta ụka Tọsde.

rows.source: Omar Navarro, a Republican candidate running to unseat Waters in the midterm elections, also voiced his thoughts on Twitter.
rows.output: Omar Navarro, onye ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị Republican na-azọ ọkwa ọchịchị ka ọ pụọ na ntuli aka nke etiti, kwupụtakwara echiche ya na Twitter.
rows.reference: Omar Navarro, bụ onye nke Repọblikan na-achọ ịnapụ Waters oche n’oge ntuli aka ọkara ọchịchị, kwuputakwara echiche ya na Twitter.

rows.source: "Big if true," he tweeted.
rows.output: "Ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ eziokwu, ọ dị oke."
rows.reference: “Nnukwu ma ọ bụrụ eziokwu,” ọ dere.

rows.source: In her statement, Waters said her office had alerted "the appropriate authorities and law enforcement entities of these fraudulent claims.
rows.output: N'okwu ya, Waters kwuru na ụlọ ọrụ ya agwaala "ndị ọchịchị kwesịrị ekwesị na ndị ọrụ iwu gbasara nkwupụta aghụghọ a."
rows.reference: Na nkwuputa ya, Waters kwuru na ụlọ ọrụ ya akpọturugo “ ndị ikike dị n’aka na ndị mmanye iwu banyere ebubo ụgha ndị a.

rows.source: "We will ensure that the perpetrators will be revealed," she continued, "and that they will be held legally liable for all of their actions that are destructible and dangerous to any and all members of my staff."
rows.output: "Anyị ga-ahụ na a ga-ekpughe ndị mere ihe ahụ," ka o kwuru, "na na a ga-ata ha ụta n'ụzọ iwu kwadoro maka ihe niile ha mere nke na-emebi emebi na nke dị ize ndụ nye onye ọ bụla na ndị ọrụ m niile."
rows.reference: “Anyị ga-ahụ na ndị mere ya ga-apụta ihie,” ọ gara n’ihu “na iwu ga-ejide ha maka omume ha niile nke na-emerụ ahụ ma dị egwu ebe onye na ndị ọrụ m niile nọ.

rows.source: Johnny English Strikes Again review - underpowered Rowan Atkinson spy spoof
rows.output: Nlebanya Johnny English Strikes Again - ihe na-akụda mmụọ nke ihe ọchị ọgụgụ isi Rowan Atkinson
rows.reference: Nyocha Johnny English Strikes Again - buturu ihe nkiri nzuzo ịkpa ọchị Rowan Atkinson

rows.source: It's traditional now to look for Brexit significances in any new film with a British slant and that does seem applicable to this revival of the Johnny English action-comedy spoof franchise - which started back in 2003 with Johnny English and spluttered back to life in 2011 with Johnny English Reborn.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụla ka ọ dị ugbu a ịhụ ihe Brixit pụtara n'ime ihe nkiri ọ bụla ọhụrụ nwere ntụgharị Britain, na nke a yiri ka ọ dabara na ihe nkiri a na-emepegharị nke Johnny English - ihe nkiri na-atọ ọchị nke omume - nke malitere azụ na 2003 na Johnny English na spluttered azụ na ndụ na 2011 na Johnny English Reborn.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ omenala ugbu a ịchọ mkpa Brexit n’ihe nkiri ọhụrụ ọ bụla nwere nribama Britain, na nke a dịka ọ metụtara mmegharị ihe nkiri ịkpa ọchị nke Johnny English - bụ nke ejiri Johnny English malite na 2003, wee laghachikwa azụ na 2011 ka Johnny English Reborn.

rows.source: Will tongue-in-cheek self-satire on the subject of how obviously rubbish we are be the nation's new export opportunity?
rows.output: Ọ ga-abụ na anyị ga-aghọta onwe anyị n'ụzọ na-atọ ọchị, na-akwa emo banyere otú anyị si dị ọkụ, ga-abụ ohere ọhụrụ anyị ga-ebupụ?
rows.reference: Ọ pụtara na ihe nkiri njakịrị nke isiokwu otu anyị siri bụrụ ndị iberibe pụtara ihie, bụzi oghere nbufe ahịa ọhụrụ anyị?

rows.source: At any rate, the pop-eyed, rubber-faced incompetent Johnny English has had his licence to cock things up renewed for the second time - that name of his signalling more than anything else that he is a broad comic creation designed for non-English-speaking cinemagoing territories.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị nke ahụ, Johnny English nwere anya mmiri, ihu rọba enweghị ike ime ihe adịghị mma emeghachila ikike ya maka nke abụọ - aha ya na-egosi ihe karịrị ihe ọ bụla na ọ bụ ihe ọchị sara mbara nke e mere maka ndị na-asụghị Bekee na-ekiri ihe nkiri.
rows.reference: Kosiladị, onye nzuzu anya ọkpụ, ihu rọba Johnny English emegharịala ikike ya ịkwalite ihe nke ugboro abụọ - aha ya karịa ihe ọ bụla na-egosi na ọ bụ nchepụta ihe ịkpa ọchị emebere maka akụkụ obodo ndị anaghị asụ Bekee.

rows.source: He is of course the daft secret agent who despite his bizarre pretensions to smoothie glamour has got a little bit of Clouseau, a dash of Mr Bean and a dollop of that chap contributing a single note to the Chariots of Fire theme tune at the London 2012 Olympics opening ceremony.
rows.output: Ọ bụ onye ọrụ nzuzo na-adịghị ahụkebe onye nwere ụfọdụ ihe ịrịba ama nke ịma mma smoothie, nwere ntakịrị Clouseau, ntakịrị Mr Bean na dollop nke nwoke ahụ na-enye otu ụda na isiokwu Chariots of Fire na emume mmeghe nke London 2012 Olympics.
rows.reference: N’ezie ọ bụ onye iberibe ọrụ nzuzo nke agbanyeghị ṅṅomi ya gbagwojuru anya, nwere obere Clouseau, ntakịrị Mr Bean na nfechalụ nke nwoke ahụ n’etinye otu olu na isiokwu Chariots of Fire na mmalite mmemme Olympics London 2012.

rows.source: He's also originally based on the traveller and international man of mystery Atkinson once played in the now forgotten Barclaycard TV ads, leaving chaos in his wake.
rows.output: Ọ bụkwa nke mbụ dabere na onye njem na nwoke mba ụwa Atkinson na-egwuri egwu na mgbasa ozi TV Barclaycard echefuru echefu, na-ahapụ ọgba aghara n'azụ ya.
rows.reference: N’izizi ọ dabere n’onye njem yana nwoke nzuzo mba ụwa Atkinson nke emere na ihe mgbasa ozi Barclaycard TV echefugoro, na-ahapu ọgbaghara n’azụ ya.

rows.source: There are one or two nice moments in this latest JE outing.
rows.output: Enwere otu ma ọ bụ abụọ n'oge dị mma n'ime njem JE kacha ọhụrụ a.
rows.reference: Enwere otu oge ma ọ bụ abụọ mara mma na JE ọhụrụ a.

rows.source: I loved Johnny English approaching a helicopter while dressed in a medieval suit of armour and the rotor blades briefly clanging against his helmet.
rows.output: Ọ na-amasị m Johnny English na-abịaru helikopta mgbe ọ na-eyi uwe ụlọ ọrụ oge ochie, na ọkpụkpụ rotor na-akụkwa n'isi ya.
rows.reference: Ọ masịrị m ka Johnny English na-erute nso n’ụgbọ elu ebe oyi uwe agha ndị agba ochie, igwe nkucha were na-akụta n’okpu agha ya.

rows.source: Atkinson's gift for physical comedy is on display, but the humour feels pretty underpowered and weirdly superfluous, especially as the "serious" film brands like 007 and Mission Impossible themselves now confidently offer comedy as an ingredient.
rows.output: Nkà Atkinson maka ọchị anụ ahụ dị n'ihu, ma ọchị ahụ na-adị ka ọ na-adịghị ike ma na-adịghị mkpa, karịsịa ebe "ihe nkiri dị mkpa" dị ka 007 na Mission Impossible na-enye ọchị dị ka ihe.
rows.reference: Onyinye Atkinson nwere maka ịkpa ọchị a na-ahụ anya pụtara ihie, mana ịkpa ọchị ahụ esighi ike ma mafee oke, tụmadị ihe nkiri ndị ahụ “anaghị akpa ọchị” dịka 007 na Mission Impossible n’onwe ha na-enwekwa ihe ịkpa ọchị n’ime ya ugbu a.

rows.source: The humour feels as if it is pitched at kids rather than adults, and for me Johnny English's wacky misadventures aren't as inventive and focused as Atkinson's silent-movie gags in the persona of Bean.
rows.output: Nkọwa ahụ na-adị ka ọ na-aga ụmụaka kama ụmụ okenye, na maka m, ihe ọchị Johnny English na-eme ihe na-adịghị mma dị ka ihe ọchị Atkinson na-enweghị okwu na agwa Bean.
rows.reference: Ihe ịkpa ọchị ahụ dịka ọ bụ ụmụaka ka emebere ya karịa ndị okenye, maka mụ onwe m njegheri Johnny English enweghị ihe nchepụta pụrụ iche yana ebumnuche ya dịka ihe nkiri anaghị ekwu okwu nke Atkinson, n’onye nke Bean.

rows.source: The perennially topical premise now is that Great Britain is in serious trouble.
rows.output: Ihe na-eme ugbu a bụ na Great Britain nọ n'ọnọdụ siri ike.
rows.reference: Ebe mgbado ukwu isiokwu ugbu a bụ na Great Britain nọ n’oke nsogbu.

rows.source: A cyber-hacker has infiltrated Britain's super-secret web network of spies, revealing the identities of all Britain's agents in the field, to the dismay of the agent on duty - a regrettably small role for Kevin Eldon.
rows.output: Onye na-emepụta ihe n'ịntanetị enwetala ohere ịbanye na netwọkụ webụ dị oke egwu nke ndị ọrụ ọgụgụ isi Britain, na-ekpughe njirimara ndị ọrụ Britain niile nọ n'ọhịa, na-ewute onye ọrụ na-ahụ maka ọrụ - ọrụ dị mwute maka Kevin Eldon.
rows.reference: Onye nbanye ịntanetị anataghị ikike banyere na netwọk ndị ọrụ nzuzo kachasị dị nzuzo nke Britain, kpughee ndị ọrụ nzuzo niile nọ n’ọrụ, na mgbagwoju anya onye ọrụ nzuzo nọ ọrụ - obere ihe omume maka Kelvin Eldon.

rows.source: It's the last straw for a prime minister who is a pompous and embattled figure, already suffering a complete meltdown of political unpopularity: Emma Thompson does her very best with this quasi-Teresa-May character but there's nothing much in the script to work with.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị ihe ọzọ maka onye isi ala nke bụ onye na-ekwusi ike na onye agha, bụ onye na-enwebu nnukwu nsogbu nke ọdịda ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị kpam kpam: Emma Thompson na-eme ihe kacha mma na nke a nke abụọ-Teresa-Maị mana enweghị ihe ọ bụla na edemede ahụ iji rụọ ọrụ na ya.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ nke ikpeazụ maka onye isi ala bụ onye mpako nwere nsogbu, nke enweghịzi nkwado ọchịchị ọ bụla kpamkpam: Emma Thompson nwara ike ya na ime ihe omume a yitebere Teresa-May mana enwekebeghị ihe dị n’akwụkwọ ọ ga-eji rụọ ọrụ.

rows.source: Her intelligence advisers inform her that as every single active spy has been compromised, she will have to bring someone out of retirement.
rows.output: Ndị ndụmọdụ ya gbasara ọgụgụ isi gwara ya na ebe onye ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ nke ọma na-ekpughe, ọ ga-enwerịrị iweta onye n'ọrụ ezumike nka.
rows.reference: Ndị na-enye ya ndụmọdụ nchekwa gwara ya na ebe amagoro ndị ọrụ nzuzo ya niile, ọ ga-akpọpụta onye lagoro ezumike nka.

rows.source: And that means bumbling Johnny English himself, now employed as a schoolmaster in some posh establishment, but giving off-the-record lessons in how to be an undercover operative: some nice gags here, as English offers a School of Rock-type academy of spying.
rows.output: Ma nke a pụtara Johnny English na-akpagbu onwe ya, ugbu a ọrụ dị ka onye nkuzi n'ụlọ akwụkwọ mara mma, mana na-enye nkuzi n'azụ ihe nkiri banyere otu esi bụrụ onye ọrụ nzuzo: ụfọdụ ọchị mara mma ebe a, ka English na-enye ụlọ akwụkwọ nke Rock-type nke ịgba ọsọ.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ pụtara Johnny English na-emegheri emegheri n’onwe ya, onye nke ewere n’ọrụ dịka onye nkuzi n’ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị ọgaranya, mana na-enye nkuzi nke adịghị n’akwụkwọ ka-esi a bụ onye ọrụ nzuzo: ọmalịcha odide ebe a, dịka English nyere ụdị ụlọ akwụkwọ nzuzo School of Rock.

rows.source: English is whisked back to Whitehall for an emergency briefing and reunited with his former long-suffering sidekick Bough, played again by Ben Miller.
rows.output: Kpọọrọ English laghachi n'Whitehall maka nzukọ mberede ma sonyere onye otu ya nke ogologo oge na-achọsi ike Bough, nke Ben Miller na-egwuri egwu ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ebughachiri English na Whitehall maka inye ntuziaka ntụmadị were zukọta yana onye nke abụọ ya tagbugoro onwe ya n’ahụhụ Bough, bụ Ben Miller mere ya ọzọ.

rows.source: Bough is now a married man, hitched to a submarine commander, a jolly-hockey-sticks role in which Vicki Pepperdine is a bit wasted.
rows.output: Bough bụ ugbu a nwoke lụrụ di na nwunye, lụrụ onye isi ụgbọ mmiri, ọrụ egwuregwu hockey nke Vicki Pepperdine na-efunahụ ntakịrị.
rows.reference: Bough abụrụla onye lụrụ nwunye, ejikọrọ ya na onye isi ngwa ọgụ mmiri, bụ ihe omume onye nwere agba Vicki Pepperdine mere ka onye mmanya na-egbu.

rows.source: So the Batman and Robin of getting things terribly wrong on Her Majesty's Secret Service are back in action, encountering Olga Kurylenko's beautiful femme fatale Ophelia Bulletova.
rows.output: Ya mere, Batman na Robin nke na-eme ihe ọjọ́ọjọ́ na-ezighị ezi n'ọrụ nzuzo nke Eze nwanyị bụ́ ndị laghachiri n'ọrụ, na-ezute Ophelia Bulletova mara mma na nwanyị na-egbu egbu nke Olga Kurylenko gosipụtara.
rows.reference: Yabụ na Batman na Robin nke na emebi ihe mgbe niile N’ọrụ Nzuzo Her Majesty amalitekwala, na-ezute Olga Kurylenko dịka ọmalicha Ophelia Bulletova.

rows.source: Meanwhile, the prime minister is falling dangerously under the spell of the charismatic tech billionaire who claims he can solve Britain's computer woes: the sinister Jason Volta, played by Jake Lacy.
rows.output: N'otu oge ahụ, onye isi ala na-ada n'ọnwụnwa nke ọma n'okpuru ọgwụgwọ nke onye ọchụnta ego teknụzụ na-akpali akpali bụ onye na-ekwu na ya nwere ike dozie nsogbu kọmputa Britain: onye na-akpa nkata Jason Volta, nke Jake Lacy na-egwuri egwu.
rows.reference: Kosiladị, onye isi ala na-adanye na anwansi nke onye ọgaranya tech, bụ onye nke kwuru na ọ nwere ike idozi nsogbu kọmputa ndị Britain nwere: onye ọjọọ Jason Volta bụ Jake Lacy mere ya.

rows.source: English and Bough begin their odyssey of farcical high-jinks: disguised as waiters, they set fire to a flash French restaurant; they create mayhem smuggling themselves aboard Volta's luxury yacht; and English triggers pure anarchy as he attempts to use a Virtual Reality headset to familiarise himself with the interior of Volta's house.
rows.output: English na Bough malitere njem ha nke ọchị: e ji uwe mwụda chọọ ya mma, ha na-etinye ọkụ n'ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ French na-egbuke egbuke; ha na-emepụta ọgba aghara na-ebuga onwe ha n'ụgbọ mmiri Volta nke ọma; na English na-akpalite ọgba aghara zuru oke ka ọ na-agbalị iji isi iyi Virtual Reality chọpụta onwe ya n'ime ụlọ Volta.
rows.reference: English na Bough malitere njem nke egwuregwu nzuzu ịkpa ọchị ha: gbanwee dịka onye na-eke nri, ha mụnyere ọkụ n’ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ French; ha butere ọgbaghara izunye onwe ha n’ime ụgbọ mmiri ezumike Volta; English kpalitere mgbagwoju anya ka ọ nwara iji ngwa isi Virtual Reality nwere mata ime ụlọ Volta.

rows.source: All the stops are certainly pulled out for that last sequence, but as amiable and boisterous as it is, there's quite a bit of kids' TV about the whole thing.
rows.output: Ihe niile na-akwụsị ebe ahụ n'ezie, mana dị ka ọ dị mma na ọ na-eme mkpọtụ, enwere ọtụtụ ihe nkiri ụmụaka gbasara ihe niile.
rows.reference: Eji ihe niile were mee agba nke ikpeazụ ahụ, ma obi uto na egwumegwu niile dị ya, enwere obere TV ụmụaka dị n’ihe niile ahụ.

rows.source: Pretty moderate stuff.
rows.output: Ihe dị mma.
rows.reference: Ọmalịcha ihe agafeghị oke.

rows.source: And as with the other Johnny English films I couldn't help thinking: can't the British film industry give Rowan Atkinson a role that really does justice to his talent?
rows.output: Ma n'ikpeazụ, dị ka na Johnny English ndị ọzọ, enweghị ike ịkwụsị iche: ọ̀ ga-ekwe omume ka ụlọ ọrụ ihe nkiri Britain nye Rowan Atkinson ọrụ nke ga-eme nke ọma na ikike ya?
rows.reference: Dịka n’ihe nkiri Johnny English ndị ọzọ, ọ naghaghị m ịche: ndị na-eme ihe nkiri nke Britain enweghi ike nye Rowan Atkinson ihe omume ga-ebuputa onyinye ya nke ọma?

rows.source: Labour denies it is devising a plan for Britons to work a four day week but be paid for five days
rows.output: Ndị Labour na-ekwu na ha anaghị eme atụmatụ ihe ga-eme ka ndị Briten na-arụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n'izu mana ka ha na-akwụ ụgwọ maka ụbọchị ise
rows.reference: Labour na-agọnarị na ha anaghị akpa nkata atụmatụ ka ndị Britain na-arụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu ma nara ụgwọ ọrụ maka ụbọchị ise

rows.source: Jeremy Corbyn's Labour Party is to consider a radical plan which will see Britons working a four day week - but getting paid for five.
rows.output: Ndị otu Labour Jeremy Corbyn ga-atụle atụmatụ dị egwu nke ga-eme ka ndị Briten na-arụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n'izu - mana ha ga-anata ụgwọ maka ise.
rows.reference: Labour Party nke Jeremy Corbyn na-atule atụmatụ ga-agbanwe ihe nke ga-ahụ na ndị Britain rụọ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu ha anara ụgwọ ọrụ maka ụbọchị ise.

rows.source: The party reportedly wants company bosses to pass on savings made through the artificial intelligence (AI) revolution to workers by giving them an extra day off.
rows.output: Ndị otu ahụ na-ekwu na ha chọrọ ka ndị isi ụlọ ọrụ nyere ndị ọrụ ụbọchị mgbazinye ego nke ha nwetara site na mgbanwe ọgụgụ isi (AI).
rows.reference: Ndị otu a chọrọ ka ndị isi nwe ụlọ ọrụ na-enyefe akụ ha chekwabara n’aka ndị ọrụ siterena mgbanwe artificial intelligence (AI) site na inye ha ụbọchị ụma agaghị arụ ọrụ.

rows.source: It would see employees enjoy a three-day weekend - but still take home the same pay.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ ga-enwekwa izu ụka ụbọchị atọ - ma ka na-akpata otu ụgwọ ọrụ.
rows.reference: Ọ ga-eme na ndị na-arụ ọrụ ga-erite elele ụbọchị atọ n’izu ụka ma welakwaa otu ụgwọ ọnwa.

rows.source: Sources said the idea would 'fit' with the party's economic agenda and plans to tilt the country in favour of workers.
rows.output: Ndị isi kwuru na echiche ahụ ga-adaba n'atụmatụ akụ na ụba nke otu ahụ na atụmatụ ịgbanwe obodo ahụ n'otu n'otu n'ọrụ.
rows.reference: Ndị nzuputa okwu kwuru na echiche a “ga-adaba” na ebumnuche yana atụmatụ akụnụba nke otu a ime ka ọ dabaara ndị ọrụ.

rows.source: Shifting to a four-day week has been endorsed by the Trades Union Congress as a way for workers to take advantage of the changing economy.
rows.output: Igbo: Ịgbanwe na izu anọ ụbọchị ka ndị otu Trade Union Congress kwadoro dị ka ụzọ ndị ọrụ ga-esi nweta uru n'usoro akụ na ụba na-agbanwe.
rows.reference: Ndị otu Trades Union Congress akwadola ịmalite ụbọchị anọ n’ime izu dịka ụzọ ndị ọrụ ga-esi rite elele na akụnụba na-agbanwe.

rows.source: A senior Labour Party source told The Sunday Times: 'A policy review is expected to be announced before the end of the year.
rows.output: Otu isi mmalite nke Labour Party gwara The Sunday Times: "A na-atụ anya na a ga-ekwupụta nyocha amụma tupu njedebe nke afọ."
rows.reference: Onye senịọ nzuputa okwu nke Labour Party gwara Sunday Times: ‘A na-atu anya ịma ọkwa nyocha amụma tupu ngwucha afọ a.

rows.source: 'It won't happen overnight but a four-day working week is an aspiration that fits in with the party's approach to rebalancing the economy in favour of the worker as well as the party's overall industrial strategy.'
rows.output: 'Ọ dịghị mgbe ọ ga-eme n'otu abalị mana izu ọrụ anọ bụ ihe mgbaru ọsọ dabara na ụzọ otu pati ahụ si eme ihe n'ịkwado akụ na ụba n'ụzọ nke ndị ọrụ na nke ọrụ ụlọ ọrụ n'ozuzu.'
rows.reference: ‘Ọ gaghị eme ozugbo mana ịrụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu bụ ebumnobi ndị otu a dabara n’usoro ihazi akụnụba ka ọ dabaara ndị ọrụ yana mkpokota ụzọ nrụpụta ihe nke ndị otu ahụ.’

rows.source: The Labour Party would not be the first to endorse such an idea, with the Green Party pledging a four-day working week during its 2017 general election campaign.
rows.output: Ndị Labour Party agaghị abụ ndị mbụ kwadoro echiche dị otú ahụ, ebe ndị Green Party kwere nkwa izu ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n'oge mgbasa ozi ntuli aka ha n'afọ 2017.
rows.reference: Labour Party agaghị abụ ndị izizi kwadoro echiche a, ebe Green Party kwere nkwa ịrụ ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu n’ime oge ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị 2017.

rows.source: The aspiration is currently not being endorsed by the Labour Party as a whole, however.
rows.output: Ọchịchọ a na-achọghị nkwado nke Labour Party n'ozuzu ya ugbu a.
rows.reference: Labour Party anaghị akwado ebumnuche ahụ ugbu a dịka otu, kosiladị.

rows.source: A Labour Party spokesman said: 'A four-day working week is not party policy and it is not being considered by the party.'
rows.output: Onye na-ekwuchitere otu Labour kwuru: "Ụbọchị ọrụ ụbọchị anọ abụghị iwu pati ma a na-atụle ya."
rows.reference: Onye nkwuchite okwu Labour Party kwuru: ‘Ọrụ ụbọchị anọ n’izu abughị amụma ndị otu a nke na ndị otu a anaghị atule ya.’

rows.source: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell used last week's Labour conference to flesh out his vision for a socialist revolution in the economy.
rows.output: Onye isi ọchịchị na-egbu onwe ya bụ John McDonnell jiri ọgbakọ Labour n'izu gara aga mee ka echiche ya pụta ìhè maka mgbanwe socialist na akụ na ụba.
rows.reference: Shadow Chancellor John McDonnell jiri ọgbakọ Labour mere izu gara aga were kọwapụta echiche ya maka mgbanwe na akụnụba.

rows.source: Mr McDonnell said he was determined to claw back power from 'faceless directors' and 'profiteers' at utility firms.
rows.output: Ọkammụta McDonnell kwuru na ya na-achọsi ike ịlaghachi n'ike n'aka ndị nduzi "enweghị ihu" na "ndị na-erite uru" na ụlọ ọrụ ọkụ.
rows.reference: Mazị McDonnell kwuru na o kpebiri iweghachite ikike site na n’aka ndị ‘isi ụlọ ọrụ amaghị’ yana “ndị nrite oke uru’ n’ụlọ ọrụ ndị eji ebi ndụ.

rows.source: The shadow chancellor's plans also mean current shareholders in water companies may not get back their entire stake as a Labour government could make 'deductions' on the grounds of perceived wrongdoing.
rows.output: Onye isi ọchịchị onye nkwuchite ọnụ na-eme atụmatụ pụtara na ndị na-eketa òkè ugbu a na ụlọ ọrụ mmiri nwere ike ọ gaghị enwetaghachi òkè ha niile dị ka ọchịchị Labour nwere ike ime 'mwepụ' n'ihi mmejọ a na-eche.
rows.reference: Atụmatụ shadow chancellor ahụ pụtakwara na ndị nwere oke n’ụlọ ọrụ mmiri nwere ike ha agaghị enwetacha isi ego ha, maka gọọmentị Labour nwere ike ‘ime mwepu’ na ndabere ebumnobi ihe ezighi ezi.

rows.source: He also confirmed plans to put workers on company boards and create Inclusive Ownership Funds to hand 10 per cent of private-sector firms' equity to employees, who stand to pocket annual dividends of up to £500.
rows.output: O kwadoro atụmatụ ịtụnye ndị ọrụ n'ụlọ ọrụ na ịmepụta Ụlọ Ọrụ Nwe Nwe Nwe Iji Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee Nwee
rows.reference: O kwuputakwara atụmatụ itinye ndị ọrụ na bọdụ ụlọ ọrụ ma mepụta Inclusive Ownership Fund ga-enyefe pesenti 10 n’oke ụlọ ọrụ ndị nkịtị n’aka ndị ọrụ, ndị nwere ike inweta uru isi ego ruru £500.

rows.source: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy tell "60 Minutes" whether the FBI's investigation of Kavanaugh could change their minds
rows.output: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy gwara "60 Minutes" ma ọ bụ nyocha FBI nke Kavanaugh nwere ike ịgbanwe obi ha
rows.reference: Lindsey Graham, John Kennedy gwa “60 minutes” ma nyocha ndị FBI enwere ike ịgbanwe obi ha

rows.source: The FBI investigation into accusations against Judge Brett Kavanaugh has delayed a final vote on his nomination to the Supreme Court by at least a week, and raises the question of whether the bureau's findings could sway any Republican senators into pulling their support.
rows.output: Nnyocha FBI banyere ebubo eboro Ọkaikpe Brett Kavanaugh emebiela ntuli aka ikpeazụ maka nhọpụta ya n'Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu opekata mpe otu izu, ma na-ebutekwa ajụjụ ma ọ bụ ihe e chọtara n'aka ụlọ ọrụ ahụ nwere ike ime ka ndị omeiwu Republican ọ bụla kwụsị nkwado ha.
rows.reference: Nyocha ndị FBI na-eme banyere ebubo eboro Ọka Ikpe Brett Kavanaugh egbuola oge ime ntuli aka ikpeazụ na nhọpụta ya maka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu opekempe otu izu, wee bulite ajụjụ na nchọpụta ụlọ ọrụ ahụ enwere ike ịgbanwe obi ndị ọmebe iwu Repọblikan ịdọrọkwa nkwado ha.

rows.source: In an interview airing Sunday, "60 Minutes" correspondent Scott Pelley asked Republicans Sens. John Kennedy and Lindsey Graham whether the FBI could unearth anything that would lead them to change their minds.
rows.output: N'ajụjụ ọnụ na-egosi na Sọnde, onye nta akụkọ "60 Minutes" Scott Pelley jụrụ ndị otu Republican Sineti John Kennedy na Lindsey Graham ma ndị FBI nwere ike ịchọta ihe ọ bụla ga-eme ka ha gbanwee obi ha.
rows.reference: N’ajụjụ ga-eme na Sọnde, onye akụkọ “60 Minutes” Scott Pelley jụrụ ndị Ọmebe Iwu Repọblikan John Kennedy na Lindsey Graham ma FBI enwere ike bọlite ihe ọ bụla ga-eme ka ha gbanwee obi ha.

rows.source: Kennedy appeared more open than his colleague from South Carolina.
rows.output: Kennedy pụtara n'ihu karịa onye òtù ọlụlụ ya si South Carolina.
rows.reference: Kennedy meghere onwe ya karịa onye otu ya si South Carolina.

rows.source: "I mean, of course," said Kennedy.
rows.output: "Ọ dị mma, n'ezie," ka Kennedy kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ana m eche, ee,” Kennedy kwuru.

rows.source: "I said going into the hearing, I said, I've talked to Judge Kavanaugh.
rows.output: "Ekwuru m, na-abata n'isi ụlọ ikpe, ekwuru m, enweela m mkparịta ụka na Jọstis Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: “E kwuru m na nbanye na nnụrịta ụka ahụ, E kwuru m, A gwara m Ọka Ikpe Kavanaugh okwu.

rows.source: I called him after this happened, that allegation came out, said, 'Did you do it?'
rows.output: M kpọrọ ya mgbe ihe a mere, mgbe ebubo a pụtara, sị, 'Ị mere ya?'
rows.reference: Akpọrọ m ya ka nke a mechara, ka ebubo ahụ pụtara, kwuo sị, ‘Ị mere ya?

rows.source: He was resolute, determined, unequivocal."
rows.output: O juru, gbasie ike, n'ụzọ doro anya.
rows.reference: Ọ kụjaghị, ọ nwere mkpebi, na enweghị mgbagha.”

rows.source: Graham's vote, however, appears set in stone.
rows.output: ntuli aka Graham, Otú ọ dị, yiri ka edobere ya n'ọkụ.
rows.reference: Ntuli aka Graham, kosiladị, dịka edeela ya ede.

rows.source: "My mind's made up about Brett Kavanaugh and it would take a dynamite accusation," he said.
rows.output: Mkpụrụ obi m agwụla banyere Brett Kavanaugh ma ọ ga-achọ nkwupụta na-egbuke egbuke.
rows.reference: “Obi m ekpebiela gbasara Brett Kavanaugh, na ọ ga-ewe ebubo dasiri ike,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "Dr. Ford, I don't know what happened, but I know this: Brett denied it vigorously," Graham added, referring to Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.output: "Dọkịta Ford, amaghị m ihe mere, ma amaara m nke a: Brett jụrụ ya nke ukwuu," Graham gbakwụnyere, na-ezo aka na Christine Blasey Ford.
rows.reference: “Dr. Ford, Amaghị m ihe mere mana a ama m nke a: Brett gọnarịrị nke ukwuu,” Graham gbakwunyere, na-arụta Christine Blasey Ford aka.

rows.source: "And everybody she names couldn't verify it.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị onye ọ bụla ọ kpọrọ aha kwadoro ya.
rows.reference: “Na ndị niile ọkpọrọ aha enweghị onye kwetara ya.

rows.source: It's 36 years old.
rows.output: Ọ dị afọ iri atọ na isii.
rows.reference: Ọ gbaala afọ 36.

rows.source: I don't see anything new changing."
rows.output: Ahụghị m ihe ọ bụla ọhụrụ na-agbanwe."
rows.reference: Anaghị m ahụ ihe ọhụrụ na-agbanwe.”

rows.source: What is the Global Citizen Festival and Has it Done Anything to Decrease Poverty?
rows.output: Kedu ihe Global Citizen Festival bụ na ọ̀ mere ihe ọ bụla iji belata ịda ogbenye?
rows.reference: Gịnị bụ Mmemme Global Citizen, na Ọ nwela Ihe Ọ Bụla Ọ Mere Iji Belata Ụbịam?

rows.source: This Saturday New York will host the Global Citizen Festival, an annual music event which has a hugely impressive line-up of stars performing and an equally impressive mission; ending world poverty.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọdee a, New York ga-anabata emume Global Citizen Festival, ihe omume egwu kwa afọ nke nwere ndepụta kpakpando na-eme ihe na-akpali akpali ma nwee ọrụ dị egwu; ikpochapụ ịda ogbenye n'ụwa.
rows.reference: Satọde nke a New York ga-achịkọba Global Citizen Festival,emume ịgụ egwu a na-eme kwa afọ nke na-enwe ahịrị ndị ama ama na-atụ n’anya nke ukwuu na-eme ihe nkiri, yana ebumnobi dịkwa ịtụnanya; ịkwụsị ụbịam n’ụwa.

rows.source: Now in its seventh year, the Global Citizen Festival will see tens of thousands of people flock to Central Park's Great Lawn to not only enjoy acts such as Janet Jackson, Cardi B and Shawn Mendes, but also to raise awareness for the event's true goal of ending extreme poverty by 2030.
rows.output: Ugbu a n'ime afọ asaa ya, ememme ụmụ amaala zuru ụwa ọnụ ga-ahụ puku kwuru puku mmadụ na-abịa n'ogige Central Park ka ha nwee ọṅụ n'ọrụ dịka Janet Jackson, Cardi B na Shawn Mendes, ma na-ebuli ihe a na-achọsi ike nke mmemme ahụ bụ ịkwụsị ịda ogbenye dị oke njọ site na 2030.
rows.reference: Ugbu a n’afọ nke asaa ya, Global Citizen Festival ga-ahụ puku kwụrụ puku mmadụ ga-ezute na Ama Central Park, nke abụghị naanị inweta ọṅụ n’ihe nkiri ndị a dịka Janet Jackson, Cardi B, Shawn Mendes, ma ka ha kwalitekwa mmata ezigbo ebumnuche mmemme ịkwụsị ụbịam na 2030.

rows.source: The Global Citizen Festival, which stated in 2012, is an extension of the Global Poverty Project, an international advocacy group hoping to end poverty by increasing the number of people actively fighting against it.
rows.output: Ememe Ụwa, nke malitere na 2012, bụ ihe na-esote ọrụ Global Poverty Project, bụ otu ndị na-akwado mba ụwa na-achọ ịkwụsị ịda ogbenye site n'ịbawanye ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-alụ ọgụ megide ya.
rows.reference: Global Citizen Festival nke kwuputara na 2012, bụ alaka nke Global Poverty Project, otu nkwalite amụma mba ụwa nwere olile anya ịkwụsị ụbịam site na ịbawanye ọnụọgụ ndị na-alụso ya ọgụ.

rows.source: In order to receive a free ticket for the event (unless you were willing to pay for a VIP ticket), concertgoers had to complete a series of tasks, or "actions" such volunteering, emailing a world leader, making a phone call or any other meaningful ways to help raise awareness of their goal of ending poverty.
rows.output: Iji nweta tiketi n'efu maka mmemme ahụ (ma ọ bụrụ na ị na-achọghị ịkwụ ụgwọ maka tiketi VIP), ndị na-egwu egwu ga-emecha usoro ọrụ ma ọ bụ "omume" dị ka inye onyinye, izipu ozi-e nye onye ndu ụwa, ime oku ekwentị ma ọ bụ ihe ọ bụla ọzọ bara uru iji nyere aka mee ka ha mara ebumnuche ha nke ịkwụsị ịda ogbenye.
rows.reference: Ka ị were nweta tịketị n’efu maka mmemme ahụ (beluso ma ọ masịrị gị ịkwụ ụgwọ tịketị), ndị ga-abịa ihe nkiri a ga-arụ ụfọdụ ọrụ, ma ọ bụ ‘mee ihe’ dịka nwepụta onwe n’ọrụ, izigara onye isi obodo ozi ịntanetị, ịkpọ oku ekwentị ma ọ bụ ụzọ ọ bụla bara uru iji were kpalite mmata ebumnuche ha ịkwụsị ụbịam.

rows.source: But just how successful has Global Citizen been with 12 years left to achieve its goal?
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ otú Global Citizen siri mee nke ọma na afọ iri na abụọ fọdụrụ iji nweta ebumnuche ya?
rows.reference: Mana, kedu ka o si agara Global Citizen nke ọma ebe ha nwere naanị afọ 12 imejuputa ebumnuche ya?

rows.source: Is the idea of rewarding people with a free concert a genuine way to persuade people to demand a call for action, or just another case of so-called "clicktivism" - people feeling like they are making a true difference by signing an online petition or sending a tweet?
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ echiche nke inye ndị mmadụ egwu egwu n'efu ụzọ eziokwu iji mee ka ndị mmadụ chọọ ihe omume, ma ọ bụ naanị ihe atụ ọzọ nke a na-akpọ "clicktivism" - ndị mmadụ na-eche na ha na-eme nnukwu ihe site n'ịbanye na nkwekọrịta ịntanetị ma ọ bụ izipu tweet?
rows.reference: Echiche inye ndị mmadụ tịketị n’efu, a bụ ụzọ ziri ezi iji kwanye ndị mmadụ ka ha kpọọ oku mmepụta ihe, ka ọ bụ naanị ụzọ ọzọ ihe akpọrọ “kliktivizm” - ndị chere na ha nwere ihe pụrụ iche ha na-eme n’ezie site na ibinye aka na mkpesa ịntanetị ma ọ bụ zipu tweet?

rows.source: Since 2011, Global Citizen says it has recorded more than 19 million "actions" from its supporters, pushing for a host of different goals.
rows.output: N'afọ 2011, Global Citizen kwuru na o depụtara ihe karịrị nde 19 "omume" sitere n'aka ndị na-akwado ya, na-akwado ọtụtụ ebumnuche dị iche iche.
rows.reference: Kemgbe 2011, Global Citizen kwuru na ha enweela ”mmepụta ihe” nde 19 site n’aka ndị nkwado ya, na-akwa maka mmezu ebumnuche dị iche iche.

rows.source: It says that these actions have helped spur world leaders to announce commitments and policies equating to more than $37 billion that is set to affect the lives of more than 2.25 billion people by 2030.
rows.output: Ọ na-ekwu na ihe omume ndị a nyere aka kpalie ndị isi ụwa ka ha kwupụta nkwa na amụma na-eri ihe karịrị ijeri $37 nke ga-emetụta ndụ ihe karịrị ijeri mmadụ 2.25 site na 2030.
rows.reference: O kwuru na mmepụta ihe ndị a enyerela aka mee ndị na-achị achị na mba ụwa ka ha maa ọkwa nkwa yana amụma ruru ihe karịrị ijeri $37, nke ga-emetụta ndụ mmadụ karịrị ijeri 2.25 na 2030.

rows.source: In early 2018, the group cited 390 commitments and announcements stemming from its actions, at least $10 billion of which have already been disbursed or fundraised.
rows.output: N'isi 2018, otu ahụ kwuru ọrụ 390 na ọkwa sitere n'omume ya, opekata mpe ijeri $10 nke a na-ekesa ma ọ bụ na-akwado.
rows.reference: Na mbido 2018, otu ahụ rụtụrụ aka nkwa na ọkwa 390 nke malitere site na mmepụta ihe ya, opekempe ijeri $10 bụ nke ekesagoro ma ọ bụ tụta n’ego.

rows.source: The group estimates the secured funds have so far made a direct impact on nearly 649 million people across the world.
rows.output: Otu ahụ na-atụ anya na ego ndị e mere ka ha dị nchebe ejirila ihe dị ka nde mmadụ 649 n’ụwa niile mee ihe ozugbo.
rows.reference: Otu ahụ na-ama amụma n’ego ndị echekwabara emetụtala n’ahụ mmadụ ruru nde 649 n’ụwa gbaa gburugburu.

rows.source: Some of the key commitments include The Power of Nutrition, a U.K. based partnership of investors and implementers committed to "helping children grow to their full potential," promising to provide Rwanda with $35 million to help end malnutrition in the county after receiving more than 4,700 tweets from Global Citizens.
rows.output: Ụfọdụ n'ime nkwa ndị bụ isi gụnyere Ike nke nri, mmekorita nke ndị na-etinye ego na ndị na-emejuputa iwu nke dị na U.K., ndị kwenyere "inyere ụmụaka aka ito eto ruo ikike ha zuru oke," na-ekwe nkwa inye Rwanda nde $35 iji nyere aka kwụsị erighị ihe na-edozi ahụ n'obodo ahụ mgbe ha nwetara ihe karịrị tweet 4,700 sitere n'aka ndị obodo zuru ụwa ọnụ.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ nkwa ndị ekwere tinyere Power of Nutrition, mmekọrịta ndị ego nkwado dị na U.K yana ndị ntinye n’ọrụ wepụtara onwe ha “inyere ụmụaka aka itozu etozu ihe ha ga-abụ,” na-ekwe Rwanda nkwa nde $35 iji nyere ha aka kwụsị erighị nri na-edozi ahụ dị n’obodo ahụ ka ha nwetachara tweet karịrị 4,700 sitere na Global Citizen.

rows.source: "With support from the UK government, donors, national governments, and Global Citizens just like you, we can make the social injustice of undernutrition a footnote in history," The Power of Nutrition ambassador Tracey Ullman told the crowd during a live concert in London in April 2018.
rows.output: "N'ịkwado n'aka gọọmentị UK, ndị na-enye onyinye, gọọmentị mba, na Global Citizens dị ka gị, anyị nwere ike ime ka enweghị nri zuru oke bụrụ akụkụ akụkọ ihe mere eme," onye nnọchiteanya Power of Nutrition Tracey Ullman gwara ìgwè mmadụ n'oge egwu egwu dị ndụ na London na Eprel 2018.
rows.reference: “Na nkwado sitere na gọọmentị UK, ndị na-enye onyinye na gọọmentị mba ọzọ, na Global Citizen dịka gị, anyị ga-eme mmeremme ezighi ezi nke erizughị nri na-edozi ahụ ka ọ bụrụ ozi mgbakwunye na hịstrị.” Onye nnọchi anya Power of Nutrition Tracey Ullman gwara igwe mmadụ n’oge emume egwu na London na Eprel 2018.

rows.source: The group also said that after more than 5,000 actions were taken calling on the U.K. improve nutrition for mothers and children, the government announced funding for a project, the Power of Nutrition, that will reach 5 million women and children with nutrition interventions.
rows.output: Nke a bụkwa nke otu ahụ kwuru na mgbe ihe karịrị 5,000 omume e mere na-akpọ oku ka gọọmentị U.K. melite nri maka ndị nne na ụmụaka, gọọmentị kwupụtara ego maka ọrụ ahụ, ike nke nri, nke ga-erute nde ụmụ nwanyị na ụmụaka 5 na ntinye aka nri.
rows.reference: Otu ahụ kwukwara nke a ka emechara ihe mmepụta 5,000, na-akpọ U.K oku ka ha meziwanye nri ndozi ahụ maka ndị nne na ụmụaka, gọọmentị mara ọkwa inye ego maka ọrụ, Power of Nutrition, nke ga-eji enyemaka nri ndozi ahụ rute ụmụ-nwanyị na ụmụaka nde 5 aka.

rows.source: In response to one of the FAQs on its website asking "what makes you think we can end extreme poverty?"
rows.output: N'ịza ajụjụ a na webụsaịtị ha nke na-ajụ "gịnị mere i ji chee na anyị nwere ike kwụsị ịda ogbenye nke ukwuu?"
rows.reference: N’azịza otu n’ime FAQ dị na ịntanetị ya, na-ajụ, “kedu ihe mere iji chee na anyị nwere ike ịkwụsị oke ụbịam?”

rows.source: Global citizen replied: "It'll be a long and hard path - sometimes we will fall and fail.
rows.output: Onye obodo ụwa zara: "Ọ ga-abụ ụzọ ogologo na ike - mgbe ụfọdụ, anyị ga-ada na ịda mbà.
rows.reference: Global Citizen zara: “Ọ ga-abụ ụzọ tere aka ma sie ike - mgbe ụfọdụ anyị ga ada ma daa mba.

rows.source: But, like the great civil rights and anti-apartheid movements before us, we will succeed, because we are more powerful together.
rows.output: Ma, dị ka mmegharị ikike mmadụ na mmegide ịkpọasị dị ukwuu n'ihu anyị, anyị ga-aga nke ọma, n'ihi na anyị na-adị ike karịa mgbe anyị nọ ọnụ.
rows.reference: Mana, dị ka oke ndọrọndọrọ ikike dịịrị mmadụ yana mmegide ịkpa oke mere tupu anyị, anyị ga-emeri, n’ihi na anyị siri ike karịa ma ejikọọ ọnụ.

rows.source: Janet Jackson, the Weeknd, Shawn Mendes, Cardi B, Janelle Monáe are among some of the acts performing at this year's event in New York, which will be hosted by Deborra-Lee Furness and Hugh Jackman.
rows.output: Janet Jackson, The Weeknd, Shawn Mendes, Cardi B, Janelle Monáe bụ ụfọdụ n'ime ndị na-eme ihe nkiri na mmemme a n'afọ a na New York, nke Deborra-Lee Furness na Hugh Jackman ga-akwado.
rows.reference: Janet Jackson,The Weeknd, Shawn Mendes, Cardi B, Janelle Monáe bụ otu n’ime ndị ga-eme ihe nkiri na mmemme nke afọ a na New York, bụ nke Deborra-Lee Furness na Hugh Jackman ga-achịkọba.

rows.source: US could use Navy for "blockade" to hamper Russian energy exports - Interior Secretary
rows.output: US nwere ike iji ụgbọ mmiri nke ndị agha mmiri mee "igbochi" iji gbochie mbupụ mmanụ Rọshịa - Secretary nke ime obodo
rows.reference: US nwere ike iji Ndị Agha Mmiri maka “mgbachi” were gbochie nbufe ahịa Ike ndị Russia- Ọde Akwụkwọ Obodo

rows.source: Washington can "if necessary" resort to its Navy to prevent Russian energy hitting the markets, including in the Middle East, US Internal Secretary Ryan Zinke has revealed, as cited by Washington Examiner.
rows.output: N'ime ndị isi obodo "ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa" nwere ike iji ụgbọ mmiri ha gbochie mmanụ Rọshịa iru ahịa, gụnyere n'etiti ọwụwa anyanwụ, onye isi ala US nke ime obodo Ryan Zinke ekpughere, dị ka Washington Examiner siri kwuo.
rows.reference: Washington nwere ike “ma ọ dị mkpa” jiri Ndị Agha Mmiri ha nwere gbachie ike Russia ibanye ahịa, tinyere Middle East, Ọde Akwụkwọ US Ryan Zinke kwuputara, dịka arụtụrụ aka na Washington Examiner.

rows.source: Zinke alleged that Russia's engagement in Syria - notably, where it is operating at the invitation of the legitimate government - is a pretext to explore new energy markets.
rows.output: Zinke boro na Rọshịa na-etinye aka na Siria - karịsịa, ebe ọ na-arụ ọrụ n'oge ọchịchị kwesịrị ekwesị - bụ ihe mkpuchi iji nyochaa ahịa mmanụ ọhụrụ.
rows.reference: Zinke boro ebubo na itinye aka nke Russia na Syria - nke ama ama, bụ ebe ọ na-arụ ọrụ n’ihi akpọmoku nke gọọmentị ziri ezi - bụ ụzọ aghụghọ iji nyochaa ahịa ike ọhụrụ.

rows.source: "I believe the reason they are in the Middle East is they want to broker energy just like they do in eastern Europe, the southern belly of Europe," he has reportedly said.
rows.output: "Kweere m na ihe mere ha ji nọrọ n'Ọwụwa Anyanwụ bụ na ha chọrọ ịbụ onye ahịa ike dịka ha na-eme n'Ebe Ọwụwa Anyanwụ, n'afọ ndịda nke Europe," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ekwenyere m n’ihe kpatara ha jiri nọrọ na Middle East bụ ka ha zụọ ahịa ike dị ka ha na-eme na ọwụwa anyanwụ Europe, mgbada Europe,” o kwuru nke a.

rows.source: And, according to to the official, there are ways and means to tackle it.
rows.output: Ọzọkwa, dịka onye isi ọrụ si kwuo, e nwere ụzọ na ụzọ e si edozi ya.
rows.reference: Ma, dabere na onye ọrụ ahụ, enwere ụzọ na ka-esi agba ya mgba.

rows.source: "The United States has that ability, with our Navy, to make sure the sea lanes are open, and, if necessary, to blockade, to make sure that their energy does not go to market," he said.
rows.output: "Nke a bụ ikike nke United States, na ụgbọ mmiri anyị, iji hụ na okporo ụzọ mmiri dị mma, na, ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa, iji gbochie, iji hụ na mmanụ ha adịghị enweta ahịa," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “United States nwere ike, jiri Ndị Agha Mmiri anyị, hụ na okporo ụzọ mmiri anyị ghe oghe, ma ọ bụrụ na ọ dị mkpa, gbachie, iji hụ na ike ha abaghị ahịa.” o kwuru.

rows.source: Zinke was addressing the attendees of the event hosted by the Consumer Energy Alliance, a non-profit group which styles itself as the "voice of the energy consumer" in the US.
rows.output: Zinke na-ekwu okwu ndị bịara mmemme a na-akwado site na Consumer Energy Alliance, otu ọrụ ebere nke na-akpọ onwe ya "olu nke onye ahịa ike" na US.
rows.reference: Zinke na-agwa ndị bịara emume ndị Consumer Energy Alliance chịkọbara, otu anaghị achọ uru nke dobere onwe ya dịka “olu ndị na-eri ike” na US.

rows.source: He went to compare Washington's approaches to dealing with Russia and Iran, noting that they are effectively the same.
rows.output: Ọ gara igbochi ụzọ Washington si eme ihe banyere Russia na Iran, na-ekwu na ha bụ otu ihe ahụ n'ezie.
rows.reference: Ọ gara tulee usoro Washington ji emeso Russia na Iran omume, chọpụta na ha abụọ bụ otu.

rows.source: "The economic option on Iran and Russia is, more or less, leveraging and replacing fuels," he said, while referring to Russia as a "one trick pony" with an economy dependent on fossil fuels.
rows.output: "Ọchịchọ akụ na ụba n'ebe Iran na Russia nọ, n'ikpeazụ, bụ ịdabere na iji dochie mmanụ ọkụ."
rows.reference: “Nhọrọ akụnụba Iran na Russia bụ, dabere naanị, ịgbazinye na iweghachi mmanụ ọkụ ụgbọ ala,” o kwuru, ebe ọ na-arụtụ Russia aka dị ka “ọgba otu egwu” nwere akụnụba dabere na mmanụ ọkụ na unyi ekereụwa.

rows.source: The statements come as Trump administration has been on a mission to boost the export of its liquefied natural gas to Europe, replacing Russia, the far cheaper option for European consumers.
rows.output: Nkwupụta ndị a na-abịa n'oge ọchịchị Trump na-agbasi mbọ ike ịbawanye mbupụ gas nke mmiri mmiri ya na Europe, iji dochie Russia, nhọrọ dị ọnụ ala karịa maka ndị na-azụ ahịa Europe.
rows.reference: Nkwuputa ndị a pụtara ka ọchịchị Trump na-agbalị ịkwalite ibufe ahịa mmiri gaasị ọnatarachi ha na Europe, ịnọchi Russia, bụ nke ka dị ọnụala maka ndị na-eri ahịa nke Europe.

rows.source: For that effect, the Trump administration officials, including US President Donald Trump himself, try to persuade Germany to pull out of the "inappropriate" Nord Stream 2 pipeline project, which according to Trump, made Berlin Moscow's "captive."
rows.output: Maka nke ahụ, ndị ọrụ ọchịchị Trump, gụnyere onye isi ala US Donald Trump n'onwe ya, na-agbalị ime ka ndị Germany kwapụ na "enweghị mmasị" Nord Stream 2 pipeline ọrụ, nke, dịka Trump si kwuo, mere Berlin Moscow "captive."
rows.reference: Maka imezu nke a, ndị ọrụ ọchịchị Trump tinyere Onye Isi Ala US Donald Trump n’onwe ya, na-agbalị ịkwanye Germany ka ọ pụta na atụmatụ ọwa mmiri Nord Stream 2 “adịghị mma”, bụ nke dabere na Trump, mere Berlin “onye nke Moscow ji eji.

rows.source: Moscow has repeatedly stressed that the $11 billion Nord Stream 2 pipeline, which is set to double the existing pipeline capacity to 110 billion cubic meters, is a purely economic project.
rows.output: Moscow na-ekwughachi ugboro ugboro na $11 ijeri Nord Stream 2 pipeline, nke ga-abụ okporo ụzọ pipeline dị okpukpu abụọ nke 110 ijeri cubic mita, bụ ọrụ akụ na ụba kpam kpam.
rows.reference: Moscow ekwuola ugboro ugboro na ijeri $11 ọwa mmiri Nord Stream 2 ahụ, bụ nke emebere ka o bulie ike ọwa mmiri nke dị adị ruo ijeri 110 kubik mita, bụ naanị atụmatụ maka akụnụba.

rows.source: The Kremlin argues that Washington's fervent opposition to the project is simply driven by economic reasons and is an example of unfair competition.
rows.output: Kremlin na-ekwu na Washington na-emegide ọrụ ahụ nke ukwuu bụ naanị n'ihi ihe kpatara akụ na ụba, ma bụrụ ihe atụ nke asọmpi na-ezighị ezi.
rows.reference: Kremlin na-arụ ụka na oke mgbachi nke Washington n’atụmatụ ahụ bụ naanị n’ihi akụnụba bụ ihe kpatara ya ma bụrụ ọmụmatụ asompi n’adịghị mma.

rows.source: "I believe we share the view that energy cannot be a tool to exercise pressure and that consumers should be able to choose the suppliers," Russian Energy Minister Aleksandr Novak said following a meeting with US Energy Secretary Rick Perry in Moscow in September.
rows.output: "Ekwenyere m na ọ bụ na anyị na-ekerịta echiche ahụ na ume enweghị ike iji ya mee ihe n'ụzọ na-akụda mmụọ na ndị na-azụ ahịa kwesịrị inwe ikike ịhọrọ ndị na-ere ahịa ha," bụ ihe Minista ume nke Rọshịa Aleksandr Novak kwuru mgbe ọ zutere odeakwụkwọ US maka ume, Rick Perry, na Moscow n'ọnwa Septemba.
rows.reference: “Ekwenyere m na anyị na-ahụkọrịta na ike enweghị ike ịbụ ngwaọrụ eji eme nkwanye, ndị na-eri ahịa kwesịrị ịhọrọ onye mbunye ahịa ya,” Mịnịsta Ike nke Russia Aleksandr Novak kwuru, sotere nnọkọ ya na Ọde Akwụkwọ Ike nke US Rick Perry na Moscow na Septemba.

rows.source: The US stance has drawn backlash from Germany, which has reaffirmed its commitment to the project.
rows.output: Mmegide nke US emewo ka ndị Germany nwee iwe, ndị kwughachiri nkwa ha na oru ngo a.
rows.reference: Ọnọdụ US ebutela nkwụtọ si Germany, bụ nke kwuputakwara nkwado ha n’atụmatụ ahụ.

rows.source: Germany's leading organization for industry, the Federation of German Industries (BDI), has called on the US to stay away from the EU energy policy and the bilateral agreements between Berlin and Moscow.
rows.output: Ndị isi ụlọ ọrụ Germany, otu Federation of German Industries (BDI), agbaala ndị America ume ka ha ghara itinye aka na amụma ike EU na nkwekọrịta abụọ dị n'etiti Berlin na Moscow.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ na-achị na Germany maka ụlọ nrụpụta ihe, Federation of German Industries (BDI), akpọkuola US ka ha wepu aka na amụma ike nke Europe yana nkwekọrịta obodo na obodo dị n’etiti Berlin na Moscow.

rows.source: "I have a big problem when a third state interferes in our energy supply," Dieter Kempf, head of the Federation of German Industries (BDI) said following a recent meeting between German Chancellor Angela Merkel and Russian President Vladimir Putin.
rows.output: "Enwere m nsogbu mgbe steeti nke atọ na-etinye aka na inye anyị ọkụ," Dieter Kempf, onye isi otu Federation of German Industries (BDI) kwuru mgbe nzukọ n'oge na-adịbeghị anya n'etiti Chancellor German Chancellor Angela Merkel na President Russia Vladimir Putin gasịrị.
rows.reference: “Enwere m nnukwu nsogbu mgbe obodo nke atọ n’etinye anya na mbunye ahịa ike anyị,” Dieter Kempf onye isi Federation of German Industries (BDI) kwuru, sotere nnọkọ dị n’etiti German Chancellor Angela Merkel na Onye Isi Ala Vladmir Putin.

rows.source: Elizabeth Warren Will Take "Hard Look" At Running For President in 2020, Massachusetts Senator Says
rows.output: Elizabeth Warren ga-enyocha "nke siri ike" ịzọ ọkwa onyeisiala na 2020, onye omebe iwu Massachusetts kwuru.
rows.reference: Elizabeth Warren “Ga-elebe Anya Nke Ukwuu” Na Ịzọ Maka Onye Isi Ala na 2020, Onye Ọmebe Iwu Massachusetts Kwuru

rows.source: Massachusetts Senator Elizabeth Warren said on Saturday she would take a "hard look" at running for president following the midterm elections.
rows.output: Onye nnochite anya Massachusetts bụ Elizabeth Warren kwuru na Satọde na ọ ga-enyocha nke ọma ịzọ ọkwa onyeisiala mgbe emechara ntuli aka nke etiti oge.
rows.reference: Onye ọmebe iwu Massachusettes Elizabeth Warren kwuru na Satọde na ya “ga-elebe anya nke ukwuu” ịzọ maka onye isi ala, sotere ntuli aka ọkara ọchịchị.

rows.source: During a town hall in Holyoke, Massachusetts, Warren confirmed she'd consider running.
rows.output: N'oge ọgbakọ obodo dị na Holyoke, Massachusetts, Warren kwadoro na ọ ga-atụle ịzọ ọkwa.
rows.reference: N’oge nzụkọ obodo na Holyoke, Massachusetts, Warren kwuputakwara na ya ga-atule ịzọ ọkwa.

rows.source: "It's time for women to go to Washington and fix our broken government and that includes a woman at the top," she said, according to The Hill.
rows.output: "Oge eruola ka ụmụnwaanyị gaa n'Ụwa na-edozi ọchịchị anyị gbajiri agbaji na nke ahụ gụnyere nwanyị n'elu," o kwuru, dịka The Hill siri kwuo.
rows.reference: “O ruola oge ụmụ-nwanyị ga-aga na Washington were jee dozie gọọmentị anyị mebiri emebi, bụ nke tinyere ụmụ-nwanyị ịnọ n’isi.” o kwuru, dabere na The Hill.

rows.source: "After November 6, I will take a hard look at running for president."
rows.output: "Mgbe ọnwa Nọvemba 6 gasịrị, m ga-atụgharị uche nke ọma ma aga m agba ọsọ maka onyeisi oche."
rows.reference: “Nọvemba 6 gachaa, A ga-elebe anya nke ukwuu n’ịzọ maka onye isi ala.”

rows.source: Warren weighed in on President Donald Trump during the town hall, saying he was "taking this county in the wrong direction.
rows.output: Warren kwuru okwu banyere onye isi ala Donald Trump n'oge nnọkọ obodo, na-ekwu na ọ na-ewere obodo a "n'ụzọ na-ezighi ezi."
rows.reference: Warren tinyere ọnụ na Onye Isi Ala Donald Trump n’ime oge nzụkọ obodo ahụ, na-ekwu na ọ “na-eduba obodo a n’ụzọ adịghị mma.

rows.source: "I am worried down to my bones about what Donald Trump is doing to our democracy," she said.
rows.output: "Ọ na-ewute m n'ọkpụkpụ n'ihe Donald Trump na-eme na ọchịchị onye kwuo uche anyị," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Uche na-eche m ruo n’ọkpụkpụ banyere ihe Donald Trump na-eme ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya nke anyị,” o kwuru.

rows.source: Warren has been outspoken in her criticism of Trump and his Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Warren enweela olu n'okwu ya banyere Trump na onye a họpụtara na Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu ya bụ Brett Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Warren na-ekwuwapụta nkọcha ya maka Trump yana onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu ya, Brett Kavanaugh.

rows.source: In a tweet on Friday, Warren said "of course we need an FBI investigation before voting."
rows.output: N'okwu tweet na Fraịde, Warren kwuru, "n'ezie, anyị chọrọ nyocha FBI tupu anyị eme ntuli aka."
rows.reference: Na tweet Fraịde Warren kwuru ”n’ezie anyị chọrọ nyocha FBI tupu ntuli aka.”

rows.source: A poll released on Thursday, however, showed a majority of Warren's own constituents do not think she should run in 2020.
rows.output: N'abalị Tọzdee, otu nyocha e wepụtara gosiri na ọtụtụ ndị nọ n'okirikiri Warren ekwenyeghị na ọ ga-azọ ọkwa na 2020.
rows.reference: Nyocha ewepụtara na Tọsde, kosiladị, gosiri ọtụtụ ndị okpuru ọchịchị ntuli aka nke Warren echeghị na ọ kwesịrị ịzọ ọkwa na 2020.

rows.source: Fifty-eight percent of "likely" Massachusetts voters said the senator should not run, according to the Suffolk University Political Research Center/Boston Globe poll.
rows.output: Pasentị iri ise na asatọ nke ndị na-eme ntuli aka Massachusetts kwuru na ọ gaghị eme ntuli aka, dịka nyocha ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị Suffolk University Political Research Center/Boston Globe.
rows.reference: Pesentị Iri ise na asatọ nke “ndị nwere ike” ime ntuli aka nke Massachusetts kwuru na ọmebe iwu ahụ ekwesịghị ịzọ ọkwa, dabere na nyocha nke Suffolk University Poilitical Research Center/Boston Globe.

rows.source: Thirty-two percent supported such a run.
rows.output: Puku ijeri abụọ na iri atọ na abụọ n'ime iri ise na ise kwadoro ịgba ọsọ dị otú ahụ.
rows.reference: Pesentị Iri atọ na abụọ kwadoro yabụ ịzọ ọkwa.

rows.source: The poll showed more support for a run by former Governor Deval Patrick, with 38 percent supporting a potential run and 48 percent against it.
rows.output: Nnyocha ahụ gosiri na ọtụtụ ndị na-akwado ịgba ọsọ nke onye bụbu Gọvanọ Deval Patrick, ebe pasentị iri atọ na asatọ kwadoro ịgba ọsọ ahụ ma pasentị iri anọ na asatọ megide ya.
rows.reference: Nyocha ahụ gosiri nkwado karịa maka ịzọ ọkwa nke Governor Deval Patrick chịburu ọchịchị, nke nwere pesentị 38 na-akwado ya ịzọ ọkwa ebe pesentị 48 megidere ya.

rows.source: Other high profile Democratic names discussed in regard to a potential 2020 run include former Vice President Joe Biden and Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders.
rows.output: Ndị ọzọ ama ama a na-ekwu maka ntuli aka 2020 gụnyere onye bụbu osote onye isi ala Joe Biden na onye omebe iwu Bernie Sanders si Vermont.
rows.reference: Aha ndị Demokrat ndị ukwuu ekwutere banyere ịzọ ọkwa nke 2020 tinyere Osote Onye Isi Ala Joe Biden chịburu ọchịchị na Onye Ọmebe iwu Vermont Bernie Sanders.

rows.source: Biden said he would decide officially by January, the Associated Press reported.
rows.output: Biden kwuru na ya ga-ekpebi n'ọkwa osote onyeisiala n'ọnwa Jenụwarị, dị ka akụkọ Associated Press siri kwuo.
rows.reference: Biden kwuru na ya ga-eme mkpebi nke ya na Jenuarị, Associated Press kwuputara.

rows.source: Sarah Palin cites Track Palin's PTSD at Donald Trump rally
rows.output: Sarah Palin na-ekwu na Track Palin nwere PTSD na mgbakọ Donald Trump
rows.reference: Sarah Palin rụtụrụ aka na PTSD Track Palin na nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ Donald Trump.

rows.source: Track Palin, 26, spent a year in Iraq after enlisting on Sept.
rows.output: Ọkụ Palin dị afọ iri abụọ na isii, nọrọ otu afọ n’Ijipt mgbe o sonyeere na Septemba.
rows.reference: Track Palin, 26, nọrọ otu afọ na Iraq ka ọ banyechara na Sept.

rows.source: He was arrested and charged in a domestic violence incident on Monday night
rows.output: E jidere ya wee kpọba n'ụlọ ikpe n'ihe metụtara ime ihe ike n'ụlọ n'abalị Mọnde
rows.reference: Anwudoro ya wee gbaa ya akwụkwọ maka ime ihe ike n’ụlọ n’abalị Mọnde
