rows.source: "What my own son is going through, what he is going through coming back, I can relate to other families who feel ramifications of PTSD and some of the woundedness that our soldiers do return with," she told the audience at a rally for Donald Trump in Tulsa, Oklahoma.
rows.output: N'ihi na ihe nwa m nke m na-eme, ihe ọ na-aga n'ihu mgbe ọ na-alọghachi, m nwere ike jikọta ya na ezinụlọ ndị ọzọ na-enwe mmetụta nke PTSD na ụfọdụ mmerụ ahụ ndị agha anyị na-alọghachi na ya, "o kwuru n'ìgwè mmadụ na nnọkọ maka Donald Trump na Tulsa, Oklahoma.
rows.reference: “Ihe nwa m nwoke na-agabiga, ihe ọ na-agabiga na nlaghachi azụ, Enwere m ike inwe nghọta ezinụlọ ndị ọzọ n’ahụ nsonazụ PTSD yana ụfọdụ ihe mmerụ ahụ ndị agha anyị na-eji alata,” ọ gwara ndị nọ na nnọkọ ndọrọndọrọ a maka Donald Trump na Tulsa, Oklahoma.

rows.source: Palin called his arrest "the elephant in the room" and said of her son and other war veterans, "they come back a bit different, they come back hardened, they come back wondering if there is that respect for what it is that their fellow soldiers and airmen, and every other member of the military, has given to the country."
rows.output: Palin kpọrọ njide ya "anụ ọhịa nke dị n'ime ụlọ" ma kwuo banyere nwa ya nwoke na ndị agha ndị ọzọ lụrụ ọgụ, "ha na-alọghachi ntakịrị dị iche, ha na-alọghachi nke ọma, ha na-alọghachi na-eche ma ọ bụrụ na e nwere nkwanye ùgwù maka ihe ọ bụ na ndị ọzọ na-eme ka ndị agha na ndị agha na-eme ka ndị ọzọ na-eme ka ndị agha
rows.reference: Palin kpọrọ nwudo ya ‘enyi nọ n’ime ụlọ” wee kwuo maka nwa ya nwoke na ndị ọzọ gara agha, ha na-alaghachi azụ dị obere iche, ha na-alaghachi azụ nwee obi ike, ha na-alaghachi na-ajụ ma enwere nsọpụrụ enwere maka ndị agha ibe ya, ndị agha ikuku, na ndị ọ bụla nọ n’otu ndị agha, n’ihe ha nyegoro obodo ha.”

rows.source: He was arrested on Monday in Wasilla, Alaska, and charged with domestic violence assault on a female, interfering with a report of domestic violence and possession of a weapon while intoxicated, according to Dan Bennett, a spokesman for the Wasilla Police Department.
rows.output: E jidere ya n'ụbọchị Mọnde n'Wasilla, Alaska, ma bo ya ebubo nke ime ihe ike n'ụlọ, imebi akụkọ banyere ime ihe ike n'ụlọ, na inwe ngwa agha mgbe ọ na-aṅụbiga mmanya ókè, dịka Dan Bennett, onye na-ekwuchitere ndị uwe ojii Wasilla si kwuo.
rows.reference: Anwudoro ya na Mọnde na Wasilla, Alaska, wee gbaa ya akwụkwọ maka imeso nwanyị ihe ike n’ụlọ, mgbochi na mkpesa nke ime ihe ike n’ụlọ yana iji ngwa ọgụ ka oriri ihe na-egbu egbu, dabere na Dan Bennett, onye nkwuchite okwu ndị Wasilla Police Department.

rows.source: 18 states, D.C. support challenge to new asylum policy
rows.output: 18 steeti, D.C. na-akwado ihe ịma aka nke amụma ụlọ mgbaba ọhụrụ
rows.reference: Obodo 18, D.C na-akwado ịche aka mgba nke amụma mgbata ọsọ ndụ ọhụrụ

rows.source: Eighteen states and the District of Columbia are supporting a legal challenge to a new U.S. policy that denies asylum to victims fleeing gang or domestic violence.
rows.output: Iri na asatọ steeti na mpaghara Columbia nke District nke Columbia na-akwado ihe ịma aka iwu megide amụma U.S. ọhụrụ nke na-ajụ ịnabata ụlọikpe maka ndị na-agba ọsọ na-agba ọsọ na-achọghị ịnọrọ onwe ha.
rows.reference: Obodo iri na asatọ yana District of Colombia na-akwado ịche aka mgba n’ụzọ iwu nke amụma U.S ọhụrụ nke anaghị enye nchekwa maka ndị na-agbata ọsọ ndụ n’ihi otu ndị ike ma ọ bụ ihe ike ime ụlọ.

rows.source: Representatives from the 18 states and the district filed a friend-of-the-court brief Friday in Washington to support an asylum-seeker challenging the policy, NBC News reported.
rows.output: Ndị nnọchiteanya sitere na steeti iri na asatọ na mpaghara ahụ tinyere akwụkwọ mkparịta ụka n'ụlọ ikpe Fraịde na Washington iji kwado onye na-achọ ebe mgbaba na-ama aka n'iwu ahụ, dị ka NBC News siri kọọ.
rows.reference: Ndị nnọchi anya si obodo 18 ahụ na district gbara akwụkwọ ndị ọ metụtara inyere aka na Fraịde na Washington iji kwado onye mgbata ọsọ ndụ nke na-echere amụma ahụ aka mgba, NBC News kwuputara.

rows.source: The full name of the plaintiff in the Grace v. Sessions suit that the American Civil Liberties Union filed in August against the federal policy has not been revealed.
rows.output: Aha zuru oke nke onye gbara akwụkwọ n'okwu Grace v. Sessions nke otu American Civil Liberties Union gbara akwụkwọ n'ọnwa Ọgọst megide amụma gọọmentị etiti ka edobeghị anya.
rows.reference: Ekwuputabeghị aha ndepụta n’uju nke onye na-agba akwụkwọ n’okwu Grace v. Sessions nke American Civil Liberties Union gbara na Ọgọst megide amụma etiti obodo.

rows.source: She said her partner "and his violent gang member sons," abused her but U.S. officials denied her request for asylum July 20.
rows.output: O kwuru na onye òtù ya "na ụmụ ya ndị otu òtù na-eme ihe ike," tiri ya ihe, ma ndị ọrụ U.S. jụrụ arịrịọ ya maka ebe mgbaba na Julaị 20.
rows.reference: O kwuru na onye ya na ya bi “na ndị otu ike ụmụ ya nwoke” megburu ya, ma ndị ọrụ U.S gbachibidoro arịrịọ ya maka mgbata ọsọ ndụ na Julaị 20.

rows.source: She was detained in Texas.
rows.output: E jiwo n'ụlọ mkpọrọ na Texas.
rows.reference: Akpọchiri ya na Texas.

rows.source: The states' attorneys supporting Grace described El Salvador, Honduras and Guatemala, which produce a large number of applicants for U.S. asylum, as nations facing pervasive problems with gangs and domestic violence.
rows.output: Ndị ọka iwu steeti na-akwado Grace kọwara El Salvador, Honduras na Guatemala, bụ́ ndị na-emepụta nnukwu ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-achọ ebe mgbaba na U.S., dị ka mba ndị na-eche nsogbu siri ike ihu na òtù nzuzo na ime ihe ike n'ụlọ.
rows.reference: Ndị ọka iwu obodo nke na-akwado Grace kọwara na El Salvador, Honduras na Guatemala, mebere ọnụọgụ kacha na ndị na-etinye akwụkwọ maka mgbata ọsọ ndụ na U.S, dịka mba na-alụso ọgụ mbawanye otu ndị ike na ihe ike ime ụlọ.

rows.source: The new U.S. asylum policy reversed a 2014 decision by the Board of Immigrant Appeals that allowed undocumented immigrants fleeing domestic violence to apply for asylum.
rows.output: Iwu ụlọ mgbapụ ọhụrụ nke U.S. gbanwere mkpebi nke afọ 2014 nke Board of Immigrant Appeals kwere ka ndị na-enweghị akwụkwọ ikike si n'ụlọ ikpe na-arịọ maka mgbapụ.
rows.reference: Amụma ọhụrụ nke U.S megharịrị mkpebi 2014 nke Board of Immigrant Appeals mere na-anabata ndị mbịambịa ejighị akwụkwọ na-agba ọsọ ihe ike ime ụlọ itinye akwụkwọ mgbata ọsọ ndụ.

rows.source: District of Columbia Attorney General Karl Racine said in a statement Friday that the new policy "ignores decades of state, federal, and international law."
rows.output: Onye ọka iwu mpaghara Columbia, Karl Racine kwuru na nkwupụta Fraịde na amụma ọhụrụ a "na-echefu ọtụtụ iri afọ nke iwu steeti, gọọmentị etiti na mba ụwa."
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ọka Iwu District of Columbia Karl Racine kwuru na nkwuputa Fraịde na amụma ọhụrụ ahụ “n’eleghara anya iwu nke obodo, etiti obodo na mba ofesi nke afọ kwụrụ afọ.”

rows.source: "Federal law requires that all asylum claims be adjudicated on the particular facts and circumstances of the claim, and such a bar violates that principle," the friend-of-the court brief said.
rows.output: Iwu gọọmenti etiti chọrọ ka a na-ekpebi mkpesa ni ihe ndị a kapịrị ọnụ na ọnọdụ ndị metụtara mkpesa ahụ, na ihe dị n'elu na-emebi ụkpụrụ a.
rows.reference: “Iwu etiti obodo chọrọ na a ga-eme mkpebi na mkpesa ndị mgbata ọsọ ndụ ọ bụla n’ihe akaebe na ọnọdụ mkpesa ahụ, nke n’ụdị mgbachi ahụ na-emegide usoro iwu ahụ, “ịgba akwụkwọ ndị ọ metụtara inyere aka” kwuru.

rows.source: Attorneys further argued in the brief that the policy denying immigrants entry hurts the U.S. economy, saying they are more likely to become entrepreneurs and "supply necessary labor."
rows.output: Ndị ọkaiwu ahụ kwukwara na mkpesa ahụ na-ekwu na amụma na-egbochi ndị na-abụghị ụmụ amaala ịbata na U.S. na-emebi akụ na ụba ya, na-ekwu na ha nwere ike ịghọ ndị na-azụ ahịa na-enye "ọrụ dị mkpa."
rows.reference: Ndị ọka iwu gara n’ihu na-arụ ụka n’akwụkwọ ha gbara na amụma ahụ ịgbachi ndị mbịambịa ịbata na-emerụ akụnụba U.S ahụ, na-ekwu na ha na-abụkarị ndị nọrọ onwe ha azụ ahịa ma “na-enye ndị ọrụ ngo achọrọ.”

rows.source: Attorney General Jeff Sessions ordered immigration judges to no longer grant asylum to victims fleeing domestic abuse and gang violence in June.
rows.output: Onye ọka iwu Jeff Sessions nyere ndị ọka ikpe mbata na ọpụpụ iwu ka ha ghara inye ndị na-agba ọsọ mgbapụ n'ike na ime ihe ike òtù nzuzo n'ọnwa June.
rows.reference: Onye Isi Ọka Iwu Jeff Sessions nyere ndị ọka ikpe iwu gbasara ndị mbịambịa, ka ha ghara inyezi nchekwa maka ndị mgbata ọsọ ndụ na-agbanarị mmegbu ihe ike ime ụlọ na otu ndị ike na Juun.

rows.source: "Asylum is available for those who leave their home country because of persecution or fear on account of race, religion, nationality, or membership in a particular social group or political opinion," Sessions said in his June 11 announcement of the policy.
rows.output: "Enwere ebe mgbaba maka ndị na-apụ n'obodo ha n'ihi ịchụ nta ma ọ bụ egwu n'ihi agbụrụ, okpukperechi, mba, ma ọ bụ òtù ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị pụrụ iche ma ọ bụ echiche ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị," Sessions kwuru na ọkwa ya nke June 11 banyere iwu a.
rows.reference: “Nchekwa mgbata ọsọ ndụ dịịrị ndị na-ahapụ obodo ha n’ihi mkpagbu ma ọ bụ ụjọ n’ihi agbụrụ, okpukpe, obodo onye si, ma ọ bụ nsonye n’otu mmekọrịta ọha ma ọ bụ echiche gbasara ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị,” Sessions kwuru na ịma ọkwa amụma ya na Juun 11.

rows.source: Asylum was never meant to alleviate all problems -- even all serious problems -- that people face every day all over the world.
rows.output: N'ime ụlọikpe a, a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu na a na-ekwu
rows.reference: Emebeghị nchekwa mgbata ọsọ ndụ ka obeleta nsogbu niile enwere - ọbụlagodi nsogbu niile siri ike - nke ndị mmadụ n’ahụ n’ụwa niile.

rows.source: Desperate rescue efforts in Palu as death toll doubles in race to find survivors
rows.output: Mgbalị ịzọpụta ndị nọ n'ihe ize ndụ na Palu ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ na-amụba okpukpu abụọ n'ọsọ ịchọ ndị lanarịrịnụ.
rows.reference: Mbọ agwụ ike ịzọpụta ndị gbanarịrị ihe mberede na Palu dịka ọnụọgụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ na-agbago

rows.source: For survivors, the situation was increasingly dire.
rows.output: Maka ndị lanarịrị, ọnọdụ ahụ na-akawanye njọ nke ukwuu.
rows.reference: Maka ndị gbanarịrị ihe mberede, ọnọdụ ahụ na-esiwanye ike.

rows.source: "It feels very tense," said 35-year-old mother Risa Kusuma, comforting her feverish baby boy at an evacuation centre in the gutted city of Palu.
rows.output: "Ọ na-ewute nke ukwuu," ka nne dị afọ 35 Risa Kusuma kwuru, na-emesi obi obi ya na-ata ahụhụ n'ogige mgbaba n'obodo Palu nke ọkụ gbagburu.
rows.reference: “Ọ na-adị oke echiche,” Risa Kusuma kwuru, nne nke gbara afọ 35, na-agụgụ nwa nwoke ya na-amajiji n’ebe ndị gbapụrụ ọsọ n’obodo Palu mebiri emebi nọ.

rows.source: "Every minute an ambulance brings in bodies.
rows.output: "Oge ọ bụla, ụgbọ ihe mberede na-eweta ndị nwụrụ anwụ.
rows.reference: “Nkeji ọ bụla ụgbọ ala ihe mberede na-ebute ozu.

rows.source: Clean water is scarce."
rows.output: "Ọkụ mmiri dị ọcha adịghị mfe."
rows.reference: Mmiri dị ọcha dị ụkọ.”

rows.source: Residents were seen returning to their destroyed homes, picking through waterlogged belongings, trying to salvage anything they could find.
rows.output: Ndị bi ebe ahụ pụtara n'ụlọ ha mebiri emebi, na-ahọpụta ihe ha ji mmiri kpuchie, na-agbalị ịchekwa ihe ọ bụla ha nwere ike ịchọta.
rows.reference: Ahụrụ ndị bi n’obodo ka ha na-alaghachi n’ụlọ ha mebiri emebi, na-atụta ihe n’arịa ndị mmiri juru, na-agbalị ịzọpụta ihe ndị ọ bụla ha nwere ike.

rows.source: Hundreds of people were injured and hospitals, damaged by the magnitude 7.5 quake, were overwhelmed.
rows.output: Puku ndị mmadụ merụrụ ahụ́, ụlọ ọgwụ na-emebi emebi site na ala ọma jijiji nke dị oke egwu nke dị 7.5, juru ebe niile.
rows.reference: Narị kwụrụ narị mmadụ merụrụ ahụ na ụlọ ọgwụ nke ala ọmajiji ruru 7.5 mebiri, juputara.

rows.source: Some of the injured, including Dwi Haris, who suffered a broken back and shoulder, rested outside Palu's Army Hospital, where patients were being treated outdoors due to continuing strong aftershocks.
rows.output: Ụfọdụ n'ime ndị merụrụ ahụ́, gụnyere Dwi Haris, onye merụrụ azụ̀ na ubu, nọrọ n'èzí ụlọ ọgwụ ndị agha Palu, ebe ndị ọrịa na-ata ahụhụ n'èzí n'ihi na ọ ka na-enwe mmetụta siri ike.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndị merụrụ ahụ tinyere Dwi Haris, onye nke azụ na ubu ya gbajiri, nọ n’ihu ilo Palu Army Hospital ezu ike, ebe a na-elete ndị merụrụ ahụ n’ilo n’ihi ọmajiji siri ike ka na-aga n’ihu.

rows.source: Tears filled his eyes as he recounted feeling the violent earthquake shake the fifth-floor hotel room he shared with his wife and daughter.
rows.output: Iwe mmiri juru anya ya ka ọ na-akọwa inwe mmetụta nke ọgba aghara siri ike na-ama jijiji n'ọnụ ụlọ nke ise nke ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ ya na nwunye ya na nwa ya nwanyị na-ekerịta.
rows.reference: Anya mmiri juru ya anya ka ọ na-akọ ka ajọ ala ọmajiji ahụ siri kwaa elu ụlọ nke ise ụlọ nkwari akụ ya na nwunye ya na nwa ya nwanyị nọ.

rows.source: "There was no time to save ourselves.
rows.output: Enweghị oge iji zọpụta onwe anyị.
rows.reference: “Oghere adịghị ịzọtakwa onwe anyị.

rows.source: I was squeezed into the ruins of the wall, I think," Haris told Associated Press, adding that his family was in town for a wedding.
rows.output: Eji mgbidi gbajiri, echere m. Haris gwara Associated Press na ezinụlọ ya nọ n'obodo maka agbamakwụkwọ.
rows.reference: Echere m na afanyere m n’ime mgbawa dị n’ahụ aja, Harris gwara Associated Press, na-agbakwunye n’ezinụlọ ya batara n’obodo ịga agbamakwụkwọ.

rows.source: "I heard my wife cry for help, but then silence.
rows.output: "Ọ dị m ka nwunye m na-eti mkpu maka enyemaka, ma mgbe ahụ, ịgbachi nkịtị."
rows.reference: “A nụrụ m ka nwunye m bere akwa maka enyemaka, ọzọ bụ ịda jụụ.

rows.source: I don't know what happened to her and my child.
rows.output: Amaghị m ihe mere ya na nwa m.
rows.reference: Amaghị m ihe mere ya na nwa m.

rows.source: I hope they are safe."
rows.output: "Enwere m olileanya na ha dị mma."
rows.reference: A na m atụ anya na ha nọ nke ọma.”

rows.source: U.S. ambassador accuses China of 'bullying' with 'propaganda ads'
rows.output: Onye nnọchite anya U.S. na-akatọ China maka "ịkụ ọkpọ" na "ihe mgbasa ozi"
rows.reference: Onye nnọchite anya U.S na-ebo China Ebubo “mmegide” site na ‘mgbasa ozi asị’

rows.source: A week after an official Chinese newspaper ran a four-page ad in a U.S. daily touting the mutual benefits of U.S.-China trade, the U.S. ambassador to China accused Beijing of using the American press to spread propaganda.
rows.output: N'izu gara mgbe akwụkwọ akụkọ gọọmentị China bipụtara mgbasa ozi ibe anọ na akwụkwọ akụkọ U.S. na-ekwupụta uru abụọ nke azụmahịa US-China, onye ozi US na China boro Beijing ebubo na ha na-eji akwụkwọ akụkọ America gbasaa mgbasa ozi.
rows.reference: Otu izu akwụkwọ akụkọ China buchara ozi n’ibe akwụkwọ anọ n’akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi U.S na-ekwu maka elele mmekọrịta azụmahịa U.S.-China, onye nnọchite anya U.S na China boro Beijing ebubo iji ndị mgbasa ozi America were ebusa ozi asị.

rows.source: U.S. President Donald Trump last Wednesday referred to the China Daily's paid supplement in the Des Moines Register - the state of Iowa's biggest selling newspaper - after accusing China of seeking to meddle in the Nov. 6 U.S. congressional elections, a charge China denies.
rows.output: Onye isi ala U.S. Donald Trump kwuru n'ụbọchị Wenezde gara aga na China Daily na-akwụ ụgwọ, nke a na-ebipụta na akwụkwọ akụkọ Des Moines Register, bụ akwụkwọ akụkọ kacha ere na steeti Iowa, ka o kwupụtachara na China na-agbalị imetụta ntuli aka ụlọ omebe iwu U.S. nke a ga-eme na Nọvemba 6, nke China na-ekwupụtaghị.
rows.reference: U.S. Onye Isi Ala Donald Trump na Wenesde gara aga rụtụrụ aka na mgbakwunye akwụrụ ụgwọ nke China Daily na Des Moines Register - akwụkwọ akụkọ obodo Iowa kacha ere ahịa - ka o bochara China ebubo ịchọ itinye aka na ntuli aka ndị ọmebe iwu U.S na Nọvemba 6, ebubo nke China gọnarịrị.

rows.source: Trump's accusation that Beijing was trying to meddle in U.S. elections marked what U.S. officials told Reuters was a new phase in an escalating campaign by Washington to put pressure on China.
rows.output: Nkwuputa Trump na mba Beijing na-agbalị ịbanye n'ọchịchị ntuli aka nke U.S. bụ ihe na-egosi oge ọhụrụ n'ọgụ na-akawanye njọ nke ndị ọrụ U.S. gwara Reuters.
rows.reference: Ebubo Trump na Beijing na-agbalị itinye aka na ntuli aka U.S gosiri ihe ndị ọrụ U.S gwara ndị Reuters na ọ bụ agba nke ọhụrụ na mgbakiri ala Washington na-abawanye ịkwagide China.

rows.source: While it is normal for foreign governments to place advertisements to promote trade, Beijing and Washington are currently locked in an escalating trade war that has seen them level rounds of tariffs on each other's imports.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na ọ bụ ihe a na-emekarị ka gọọmentị mba ofesi tinye mgbasa ozi iji kwalite ahia, Beijing na Washington na-akwụsị ugbu a n'ọgụ ahia na-arịwanye elu nke hụworo ka ha na-ata ibe ha ụtụ isi n'imebi ibe ha.
rows.reference: Ebe ọ bụ ihe nkiti gọọmentị mba ofesi itinye mgbasa ozi iji kwalite ahịa, Beijing na Washington nọ na ndọrọndọrọ azụmahịa na-abawanye nke megoro ka ha tinye ụtụ ngwahịa na ahịa mbubadata ha.

rows.source: China's retaliatory tariffs early in the trade war were designed to hit exporters in states such as Iowa that supported Trump's Republican Party, Chinese and U.S. experts have said.
rows.output: Mba China malitere ịtụ ụtụ isi dị ka agha ahia, bu n'obi ịta ndị na-ebubata ihe n'obodo ndị dị ka Iowa nke kwadoro otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị Trump, ndị ọkachamara China na ndị America kwuru.
rows.reference: Ntinye ụtụ ngwahịa nke China mere na mbido agha azụmahịa ka emebere ka ọ metụta ndị na ebupu ahịa n’obodo dịka Iowa kwadoro otu ndọrọndọrọ Repọblikan nke Trump, ndị ọkammara China na U.S kwuru.

rows.source: Terry Branstad, the U.S. ambassador to China and the former longtime governor of Iowa, a major exporter of agricultural goods to China, said Beijing had hurt American workers, farmers and businesses.
rows.output: N'afọ 2019, ụlọ ọrụ na-ahụ maka ọrụ na-ahụ maka ọrụ na China, na-ekwu na Beijing emetụtala ndị ọrụ America, ndị ọrụ ugbo na azụmahịa.
rows.reference: Terry Branstad, onye nnọchite anya U.S na China bụkwa onye chịburu Iowa, onye mbupu ahịa nri ubi nke ukwuu na China, kwuru na China merụrụ ndị ọrụ, ndị ọrụ ugbo na azụmahịa nke America ahụ.

rows.source: China, Branstad wrote in an opinion piece in Sunday's Des Moines Register, "is now doubling down on that bullying by running propaganda ads in our own free press."
rows.output: N'afọ 2013, ụlọ ọrụ na-ahụ maka ọkụ eletrik nke China, Sinosun, malitere ịrụ ọrụ n'ụlọ ọrụ ọkụ eletrik nke Naijiria, Sapele Power Plc, nke nwere ikike nke megawatt 335, iji mee ka ọrụ ọkụ eletrik dị na steeti Delta.
rows.reference: China, Branstad dere n’echiche ya na Des Moines Register na Sọnde, “na-ekwusi ike maka mmegide ahụ site na itinye mgbasa ozi n’akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi anyị.”

rows.source: "In disseminating its propaganda, China's government is availing itself of America's cherished tradition of free speech and a free press by placing a paid advertisement in the Des Moines Register," Branstad wrote.
rows.output: "N'ịgbasa echiche ya, ọchịchị China na-eji omenala America nke nnwere onwe ikwu okwu na akwụkwọ akụkọ n'efu site n'itinye mgbasa ozi akwụghị ụgwọ na Des Moines Register," Branstad dere.
rows.reference: “N’ịgbasa ozi asị a, gọọmentị China na ewere oghere omenala America hụrụ n’anya bụ nke onye kwuo uche ya na mgbasa ozi enweghị mkpagbu were tinye mgbasa ozi akwụrụ ụgwọ na Des Moines Register.” Branstad dere.

rows.source: "In contrast, at the newsstand down the street here in Beijing, you will find limited dissenting voices and will not see any true reflection of the disparate opinions that the Chinese people may have on China's troubling economic trajectory, given that media is under the firm thumb of the Chinese Communist Party," he wrote.
rows.output: "N'ụzọ dị iche, n'ụlọ akwụkwọ akụkọ dị n'okporo ámá ebe a na Beijing, ị ga-ahụ olu ndị na-emegiderịta onwe ha na-erughịrị ma ị gaghị ahụ ezi ihe na-egosi echiche dị iche iche ndị China nwere banyere ụzọ akụ na ụba China na-aga n'ihu na-akpasu iwe, n'ihi na mgbasa ozi dị n'okpuru njikwa siri ike nke ndị otu Communist China."
rows.reference: “Ma ịtụlee ya n’ọdụ akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi dị n’okporo beijing ebe a, ịga ahụ na enwere obere olu ndịiche nke na ịghaghị ahụ ihe n’egosi n’ezie echiche di iche ndị China nwere ike nwee maka usoro akụnụba China nọ na nsogbu, ebe ọ bụ n’ụlọ mgbasa ozi nọ na njikwa nke China Communist Party,” ọ dere.

rows.source: He added that "one of China's most prominent newspapers dodged the offer to publish" his article, although he did not say which newspaper.
rows.output: Ọ gbakwara ume na "otu n'ime akwụkwọ akụkọ China kacha mara amara zutere ịbịanye aka na ya" n'agbanyeghị na o kwupụtaghị aha akwụkwọ akụkọ ahụ.
rows.reference: Ọ gbakwunyere na “otu n’ime akwụkwọ akụkọ ama ama na China zenarịrị ibiputa” ederede ya, n’agbanyeghị na o kwughị akwụkwọ akụkọ nke ọ bụ.

rows.source: Republicans Alienating Women Voters Ahead of Midterms With Kavanaugh Debacle, Analysts Warn
rows.output: Ndị Republican na-akpaghasị ndị na-eme ntuli aka ụmụ nwanyị tupu etiti oge na mgbagwoju anya Kavanaugh, ndị nyocha na-adọ aka ná ntị
rows.reference: Ndị Repọblikan Na-akpachapụ Ndị Ntuli Aka Ụmụ-nwanyị Tupu Ntuli Aka Ọkara Ọchịchị Maka Ọgbaghara Kavanaugh, Ndị Nyocha Dọrọ Aka na Ntị

rows.source: As many top Republicans stand-by and defend Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh in the face of several allegations of sexual assault, analyst have warned they will see a backlash, particularly from women, during the upcoming midterm elections.
rows.output: Ka ọtụtụ ndị Republican nọ n'elu na-eguzo ma na-achọsi ike maka nhọpụta Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu Brett Kavanaugh n'etiti ebubo mmetọ nwoke na nwanyị dị iche iche, ndị ọkachamara adọla aka na ntị na ha ga-ahụ azụ azụ, karịsịa site n'aka ụmụ nwanyị, n'oge ntuli aka nke etiti oge.
rows.reference: Dị ka ọtụtụ ndị isi Repọblikan kwụnyere ma kwuchitere Onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu Brett Kavanaugh n’ihu ebubo dị iche iche nke mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị, ndị nyocha adọọla aka na ntị na ha ga-ahụ ndapụta iwe ga-esite ọkachasị n’aka ụmụ-nwanyị, n’oge ntuli aka ọkara ọchịchị na-abịa.

rows.source: The emotions surrounding this have been extremely high, and most Republicans are on record already showing they wanted to go forward with a vote.
rows.output: Mmetụta ndị gbara nke a gburugburu dị oke elu, ma ọtụtụ ndị Republican edeela na ha chọrọ ka anyị gaa n'ihu na votu.
rows.reference: Mmetụta sochiri nke a dị elu nke ukwuu, na ọtụtụ ndị Repọblikan ka edekọbara na ha egosila na ha chọrọ ịga n’ihu mee ntuli aka.

rows.source: Those things can't be walked back," Grant Reeher, a professor of political science at Syracuse University's Maxwell School told The Hill for an article published Saturday.
rows.output: Ihe ndị ahụ apụghị ịlaghachi azụ," Grant Reeher, bụ onye prọfesọ sayensị ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na Syracuse University's Maxwell School kwuru na The Hill maka otu akụkọ e bipụtara na Satọde.
rows.reference: Enweghị ike iweghachi ihe ndị ahụ,” Grant Reeher, onye ọkammụta nke sayensị ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị na Syracuse University Maxwell School gwara The Hill maka ederede nke ebiputara na Satọde.

rows.source: Reeher said he doubts Senator Jeff Flake's (R-Arizona) last-minute push for an FBI investigation will be enough to placate angry voters.
rows.output: Reeher kwuru na o nwee obi abụọ na onye omebe iwu Jeff Flake (R-Arizona) na-akwali nyocha FBI n'ikpeazụ ga-ezuru ndị na-eme ntuli aka iwe.
rows.reference: Reeher kwuru na ya na-agbagha n’ọkwụkwa ikpeazụ nke Onye Ọmebe Iwu Jeff Flake (R-Arizona) mere maka nyocha FBI a ga-ezu iji wetuo iwe ndị ntuli aka.

rows.source: "Women are not going to forget what happened yesterday - they are not going to forget it tomorrow and not in November," Karine Jean-Pierre, a senior adviser and national spokeswoman for the progressive group MoveOn said on Friday, according to the Washington, D.C. newspaper.
rows.output: Ndị inyom agaghị echefu ihe mere ụnyaahụ—ha agaghị echefu ya echi ma ọ bụghị n’ọnwa Nọvemba,” ka Karine Jean-Pierre, onye ndụmọdụ na onye na-ekwuchitere mba nke otu ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị nke MoveOn kwuru na Fraịde, dịka akwụkwọ akụkọ Washington, D.C. siri kwuo.
rows.reference: “Ụmụ-nwanyị agaghị echefu ihe mere ụnyahụ - ha agaghị echefu echi niile ma Nọvemba, “ Karine Jean-Pierre, onye ndụmọdụ senịọ na onye nkwuchite okwu obodo maka otu ọganihu MoveOn kwuru na Fraịde, dabere na akwụkwọ akụkọ Washington, D.C.

rows.source: On Friday morning, protestors chanted "November is coming!" as they demonstrated in the hallway of the Senate as the Republicans controlling the Judiciary Committee chose to move forward with Kavanaugh's nomination despite the testimony of Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic reported.
rows.output: N'ụtụtụ Fraịde, ndị na-eme ngagharị iwe na-abụ "Ọktoba na-abịa!" ka ha na-egosi n'ọnụ ụlọ Senate ka ndị Republican na-achịkwa kọmitii ikpe ziri ezi kpebiri ịga n'ihu na nhọpụta Kavanaugh n'agbanyeghị okwu Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic kọrọ.
rows.reference: N’ụtụtụ Fraịde, ndị ngagharị iwe kwere ukwe “Nọvemba na-abịa!” ka ha na-agagharị ngagharị iwe n’ogologo ụzọ Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu ebe ndị Repọblikan ji Ọgbakọ Ọka Ikpe họrọ ịga n’ihu na nhọrọ Kavanaugh agbanyeghị nkwuputa Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, Mic kwuputara.

rows.source: "Democratic enthusiasm and motivation is going to be off the chart," Stu Rothenberg, a nonpartisan political analyst, told the news site.
rows.output: "Ịhụnanya na ịdị n'otu nke ndị mmadụ na-achị na-aga n'ihu na-aga n'ihu," Stu Rothenberg, onye nyocha ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na-enweghị otu, gwara saịtị akụkọ.
rows.reference: “Ịnụ ọkụ n’obi na mkpalite mmụọ nke Demokrat ga-apụ iche,” Stu Rothenberg, onye nyocha ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị enweghị otu o binyere gwara ndị akụkọ.

rows.source: "People are saying it's already been high; that's true.
rows.output: Ndị mmadụ na-ekwu na ọ dịla elu; nke ahụ bụ eziokwu.
rows.reference: “Ndị mmadụ na-ekwu na ọ dịla elu; nke a bụ eziokwu.

rows.source: But it could be higher, particularly among swing women voters in the suburbs and younger voters, 18- to 29-year-olds, who while they don't like the president, often don't vote."
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ ihe nwere ike ịdị elu, karịsịa n'etiti ndị na-eme ntuli aka ụmụnwaanyị na-ama jijiji n'ime ime obodo na ndị na-eto eto na-eto etiti afọ, 18 ruo 29, bụ́ ndị ọ bụ ezie na ha adịghị amasị onyeisi oche, na-echekarị na ha anaghị eme ntuli aka."
rows.reference: Mana ọ nwere ike ịgbagokwu ọkachasị n’etiti ụmụ-nwanyị n’enweghị otu ha binyere n’ime obodo yana ndị ntuli aka na-etolite etolite, gbara afọ 18- ruo 29-, bụ ndị ebe onye isi ala anaghị amasị, anaghị eme ntuli aka kwa mgbe.”

rows.source: Even before Ford's public testimony detailing her allegations of sexual assault against the Supreme Court nominee, analysts suggested a backlash could follow if Republicans pushed forward with the confirmation.
rows.output: Ọbụna tupu okwu ọha Ford kwupụtara ebubo mwakpo mmekọahụ megide onye a họpụtara n'ụlọ ikpe, ndị nyocha tụrụ aro na ọgbaghara nwere ike ịpụta ma ọ bụrụ na ndị Republican gara n'ihu na nkwenye ahụ.
rows.reference: Ọbụlagodi tupu nkwuputanke ọha Ford mere na-akọwa ebubo mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị megide onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe kachasị Elu, ndị nyocha na-atụ elo na ndapụta iwe nwere ike sote ma ọ bụrụ na ndị Repọblikan gaa n’ihu mee nkwado ahụ.

rows.source: "This has become a muddled mess for the GOP," said Michael Steele, former chairman of the Republican National Committee, early last week, according to NBC News.
rows.output: "Nke a agbala agha di n'ime ọgbaghara maka ndị GOP," ka Michael Steele, onye bụbu onyeisi oche nke Republican National Committee, n'isi izu gara aga, dịka NBC News siri kwuo.
rows.reference: “Nke a abụrụla ọgbaghara dịịrị GOP,” Michael Steele kwuru, onye isi chịburu Ọgbakọ Otu Repọblikan, na mbido izug ara aga, dabere na NBC News.

rows.source: "It's just not about the committee vote or the final vote or whether Kavanaugh is put on the bench, it's also about the way Republicans have handled this and how they have treated her," Guy Cecil, director of Priorities USA, a group that helps to elect Democrats, pointed out to the news channel.
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị ihe gbasara votu kọmitii ma ọ bụ votu ikpeazụ ma ọ bụ ma a ga-ahapụ Kavanaugh n'oche, ọ bụkwa maka otú ndị Republican si edozi ihe a na otú ha si emeso ya," Guy Cecil, onye nduzi nke Priorities USA, otu na-enyere aka ịhọpụta ndị Democrats, kwuru na netwọkụ akụkọ.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụghị naanị maka ntuli aka ndị ọgbakọ ma ọ bụ maka ntuli aka ikpeazụ ma ọ bụ ma etinyere Kavanaugh n’oche, ọ bụkwa maka otu ndị Repọblikan siri jikwaa ihe a ma ka ha siri meso ya omume,” Guy Cecil, onye isi Priorities USA, otu na-enyere aka ahọpụta ndị Demokrat, rụtụrụ ndị akụkọ aka.

rows.source: However, Americans appear to be somewhat split over who to believe in the wake of Ford's and Kavanaugh's testimonies, with slightly more siding with the latter.
rows.output: Ọbụna, ndị America na-egosi na ha kewara ekweta banyere onye ha ga-ekwere mgbe okwu Ford na Kavanaugh gasịrị, na ntakịrị karịa na-akwado nke ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, Ndị America dị ka ndị kewara ekewa n’onye ha ga-ekwenyere na ndapụta nkwuputa Ford na Kavanaugh, ebe ndị karịrị kwụnyere onye nke ikpeazụ.

rows.source: A new poll from YouGov shows that 41 percent of respondents definitely or probably believed Ford's testimony, while 35 percent said they definitely or probably believed Kavanaugh.
rows.output: Otu nyocha ọhụrụ sitere na YouGov na-egosi na 41 pasent nke ndị zaghachirinụ kwenyere n'ezie ma ọ bụ n'ezie na Ford na-agwa eziokwu, ebe pasent 35 kwuru na ha kwenyere n'ezie ma ọ bụ n'ezie na Kavanaugh.
rows.reference: Nyocha ọhụrụ sitere na YouGov gosiri na pesentị 41 ndị zara ajụjụ kwenyere kpamkpam ma ọ bụ kwenyetụrụ nkwuputa Ford, ebe pesentị 35 kwuru na ha kwenyere kpamkpam ma ọ bụ kwenyetụrụ Kavanaugh.

rows.source: Additionally, 38 percent said they thought Kavanaugh has probably or definitely lied during his testimony, while just 30 percent said the same about Ford.
rows.output: N'ikpeazụ, 38 pasentị kwuru na ha chere na Kavanaugh nwere ike ma ọ bụ n'ezie ụgha n'oge ikpe ya, ebe naanị 30 pasentị kwuru otu ihe ahụ banyere Ford.
rows.reference: Na mgbakwunye, pesentị 38 kwuru na ha chere na Kavanaugh eleghị anya sịrị asị ma ọ bụ sịa asị kpamkpam n’oge nkwuputa ya, ebe naanị pesentị 30 kwuru otu ihe ahụ maka Ford.

rows.source: After the push from Flake, the FBI is currently investigating the allegations brought forward by Ford as well as at least one other accuser, Deborah Ramirez, The Guardian reported.
rows.output: Mgbe ọkụ si Flake, ndị FBI na-enyocha ebubo ndị Ford wetara, yana opekata mpe onye mkpesa ọzọ, Deborah Ramirez, dị ka Guardian si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ka Flake mechara nkwanye, ndị FBI na-eme nyocha ugbu a n’ebubo Ford boro, yana opekempe otu onye ebubo ọzọ, Deborah Ramirez mere, The Guardian kwuputara.

rows.source: Ford testified before the Senate Judiciary Committee under oath last week that Kavanaugh drunkenly assaulted her at the age of 17.
rows.output: N'izu gara aga, Ford gbara akaebe n'ihu kọmitii ikpe ikpe Sineti n'okpuru iyi na-ekwu na ọ bụrụ na ọ bụ 17, Kavanaugh wakporo ya mgbe ọ ṅụchara mmanya.
rows.reference: Ford mere nkwuputa n’ihu Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu n’okpuru iyi n’izu gara aga na Kavanaugh dakporo ya n’anya mmanya mgbe ọ gbara afọ 17.

rows.source: Ramirez alleges that the Supreme Court nominee exposed his genitals to her while they attended a party during their time studying at Yale in the 1980s.
rows.output: Ramirez na-ekwu na onye a họpụtara na Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu kpugheere akụkụ ahụ ya nye ya mgbe ha nọ na nnọkọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ n'oge ha na-agụ akwụkwọ na Yale n'afọ 1980.
rows.reference: Ramirez boro ebubo n’onye nhọpụta Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị Elu ahụ gosiri ya ike ya mgbe ha na-eme ọgbakọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ n’oge ha na-agụ akwụkwọ na Yale n’ime 1980s.

rows.source: The Inventor of the World Wide Web Plans to Start a New Internet to Take on Google and Facebook
rows.output: Onye nrụpụta Webụ Wepụtara Ebumnobi Iwebata Intanet Ọhụrụ Iji Were Were Google na Facebook
rows.reference: Onye Mmepụta World Wide Web Na-ama Atụmatụ Ịmalite Ịntanetị Ọhụrụ Iji Sonyere Google na Facebook

rows.source: Tim Berners-Lee, the inventor of the World Wide Web, is launching a startup that seeks to rival Facebook, Amazon and Google.
rows.output: Tim Berners-Lee, onye chepụtara Webụsaịtị Ụwa, na-ewepụta mmalite nke na-achọ ịlụso Facebook, Amazon na Google ọgụ.
rows.reference: Tim Berners-Lee, onye mmepụta World Wide Web, na-amalite ụlọ ọrụ ọhụrụ nke ga-achụso Facebook, Amazon na Google.

rows.source: The technology legend's latest project, Inrupt, is a company that builds off of Berners-Lee's open source platform Solid.
rows.output: Onye nrụpụta teknụzụ ama ama ọhụrụ, Inrupt, bụ ụlọ ọrụ na-ewu na ikpo okwu Solid nke mepere emepe nke Berners-Lee.
rows.reference: Atụmatụ ọhụrụ ahụ nke ọkaibe teknụzụ, Inrupt, bụ ụlọ ọrụ na-agbakwasa ụkwụ na ngwanro ghe oghe Berners-Lee, Solid.

rows.source: Solid allows users to choose where their data is stored and what people are allowed to have access to what information.
rows.output: Ndị Solid na-enye ndị ọrụ ohere ịhọrọ ebe data ha na-echekwa na onye nwere ike ịnweta ozi.
rows.reference: Solid na-enye ndị ọrụ oghere ịhọrọ ebe ha ga-echekwa data ha yana ozi ndị mmadụ nwere ike nweta.

rows.source: In an exclusive interview with Fast Company, Berners-Lee joked that the intent behind Inrupt is "world domination."
rows.output: N'ajụjụ ọnụ pụrụ iche nke Fast Company, Berners-Lee chịrị ọchị na ebumnuche dị n'azụ Inrupt bụ "ịchị ụwa."
rows.reference: N’ajụjụ ọnụ pụrụ iche Fast Company mere, Berners-Lee mara njakịrị na ebumnuche ejiri mebe Inrupt bụ “ịchị mba ụwa.”

rows.source: "We have to do it now," he said of the startup.
rows.output: "Anyị ga-eme ya ugbu a," ka o kwuru banyere mmalite ahụ.
rows.reference: “Anyị ga-eme ya ugbu a,” o kwuru maka ụlọ ọhụrụ ahụ.

rows.source: "It's a historical moment."
rows.output: "Ọ bụ oge akụkọ ihe mere eme."
rows.reference: “Ọ bụ oge a ga-edebanye na akụkọ.”

rows.source: The app uses Solid's technology to allow people to create their own "personal online data store" or a POD.
rows.output: Ngwa a na-eji teknụzụ Solid eme ka ndị mmadụ nwee ike ịmepụta ebe nchekwa data nkeonwe nkeonwe ma ọ bụ POD.
rows.reference: Ngwa ahụ na-eji teknụzụ Solid enye ndị mmadụ oghere imepụta “ebe nchekwa data nkeonwe n’ịntanetị” ma ọ bụ POD.

rows.source: It can contain contact lists, to-do lists, calendar, music library and other personal and professional tools.
rows.output: Ọ nwere ike ịnwe ndepụta kọntaktị, ndepụta ihe ga-eme, kalenda, ụlọ akwụkwọ egwu, na ngwa ndị ọzọ nke onwe na nke ọkachamara.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere ike inwe ndepụta kọntaktị, ndepụta ihe omume, kalenda, ọba egwu yana ngwa nkeonwe na nke eji arụ ọrụ.

rows.source: It's like Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack and Spotify are all available on one browser and all at the same time.
rows.output: Ọ dị ka Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack na Spotify dị na otu ihe nchọgharị na ihe niile n'otu oge.
rows.reference: Ọ dị ka Google Drive, Microsoft Outlook, Slack na Spotify dị n’otu nchọgharị ma ha niile n’otu oge.

rows.source: What's unique about the personal online data store is that it is completely up to the user who can access what kind of information.
rows.output: Ihe pụrụ iche gbasara ụlọ nchekwa data nkeonwe n'ịntanetị bụ na ọ dị n'aka onye ọrụ ikpebi ụdị ozi ọ ga-enweta.
rows.reference: Ihe pụrụ iche na ebe nchekwa data nkeonwe n’ịntanetị bụ na ọ dịịrị naanị onye ji ya arụ ọrụ ịhọrọ onye ga-enweta ozi nke ọ bụla.

rows.source: The company calls it "personal empowerment through data."
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-akpọ ya "ike onwe onye site na data."
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-akpọ ya “ikike nkeonwe site na data.”

rows.source: The idea for Inrupt, according to the company's CEO John Bruce, is for the company to bring resources, process and appropriate skills to help make Solid available to everyone.
rows.output: Echiche maka Inrupt, dịka CEO ụlọ ọrụ John Bruce si kwuo, bụ ka ụlọ ọrụ ahụ weta akụrụngwa, usoro, na nka kwesịrị ekwesị iji nyere aka mee ka Solid dịrị onye ọ bụla.
rows.reference: Ebumnuche Inrupt, dabere na CEO John Bruce, bụ ka ụlọ ọrụ kpokọba, akụrụngwa, usoro na nka dabara daba iji nyere aka mee ka Solid rute onye ọ bụla.

rows.source: The company currently consists of Berners-Lee, Bruce, a security platform bought by IBM, some on-staff developers contracted to work on the project, and a community of volunteer coders.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ugbu a nwere Berners-Lee, Bruce, ikpo okwu nchekwa nke IBM zụtara, ụfọdụ ndị mmepe n'ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ na ọrụ ahụ, na obodo nke ndị na-eme koodu na-achọ mma.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ nwere naanị Berners-Lee, Bruce, ebe nchekwa IBM zụtara na ya, ndị ọrụ nrụpụta ewere n’ọrụ ịrụ n’atụmatụ ahụ yana ọgbakọ ndị koodu wepụtara onwe ha.

rows.source: Starting this week, technology developers around the world could create their own decentralized apps using the tools available on the Inrupt website.
rows.output: Ọ dị mma, malite n'izu a, ndị mmepe teknụzụ n'ụwa niile nwere ike ịmepụta ngwa nke ha na-enweghị isi na-eji ngwaọrụ ndị dị na webụsaịtị Inrupt.
rows.reference: Site n’izu a, ndị nrụpụta teknụzụ ụwa gbaa gburugburu ga-enwe ike mebe ngwa agaghị ekpokọba ọnụ nke ha site n’iji ngwa mebere na websaịtị Inrupt.

rows.source: Berners-Lee said that he and his team are not talking to "Facebook and Google about whether or not to introduce a complete change where all their business models are completely upended overnight.
rows.output: Berners-Lee kwuru na ya na ndị otu ya anaghị ekwu okwu "na Facebook na Google banyere ma ọ bụ na ha ga-eweta mgbanwe zuru oke ebe ụdị azụmahịa ha niile ga-agbanwe n'otu abalị.
rows.reference: Berners-Lee kwuru na ya ndị otu ya anaghị agwa ndị “Facebook na Google okwu banyere ma ha a ga-amalite ma ọ bụ hapụ mmalite mgbanwe kpamkpam ebe ụdịdị azụmahịa na-atụgharị ozugbo na ntabi anya.

rows.source: "We are not asking their permission."
rows.output: Anyị anaghị arịọ ikike ha.
rows.reference: “Anyị anaghị anata ha ikike.”

rows.source: In a post on Medium published on Saturday, Berners-Lee wrote that Inrupt's "mission is to provide commercial energy and an ecosystem to help protect the integrity and quality of the new web built on Solid."
rows.output: N'akwụkwọ ozi na Medium bipụtara na Satọde, Berners-Lee dere na Inrupt's "ọrụ bụ inye ike azụmahịa na gburugburu ebe obibi iji chebe ịdị nsọ na àgwà nke webụ ọhụrụ a na-ewu na Solid."
rows.reference: Na mbipụta emere na Medium na Satọde, Berners-Lee dere na “ebumnuche Inrupt bụ inye ike azụmahịa na gburugburu inyere aka chekwaa ntụkwasị obi na ịdị mma weebu ọhụrụ ahụ arụrụ na Solid.”

rows.source: In 1994, Berners-Lee transformed the Internet when he established the World Wide Web Consortium at Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
rows.output: N'afọ 1994, Berners-Lee gbanwere Ịntanetị mgbe o hiwere World Wide Web Consortium na Massachusetts Institute of Technology.
rows.reference: Na 1994, Berners-Lee gbanwere Ịntanetị mgbe ọ mepụtara World Wide Web Consortuim na Massachusetts Institue of Technology.

rows.source: In recent months, Berners-Lee has been an influential voice in the net neutrality debate.
rows.output: N'ọnwa ndị na-adịbeghị anya, Berners-Lee enweela mmetụta dị ukwuu n'okwu banyere nnwere onwe ịntanetị.
rows.reference: N’ọnwa ndị adịbeghị anya, Berners-Lee bụ olu na-ada ụda na arụmarụ ụka nnwere onwe ọrụ ịntanetị.

rows.source: Even while launching Inrupt, Berners-Lee will remain the Founder and Director of World Wide Web Consortium, the Web Foundation and the Open Data Institute.
rows.output: Ọbụna mgbe ha na-ewebata Inrupt, Berners-Lee ga-anọgide onye guzobere na onye nduzi nke World Wide Web Consortium, Web Foundation na Open Data Institute.
rows.reference: Ọbulagodi mgbe a na-ebuputa Inrupt, Berners-Lee ga-anọrọ dịka onye Mmepụta na Onye Isi nke World Wide Web Consortuim, Web Foundation na Open Data Institute.

rows.source: "I'm incredibly optimistic for this next era of the web," Berners-Lee added.
rows.output: "Enwere m obi ụtọ nke ukwuu maka oge ọzọ nke webụ a, " Berners-Lee gbakwụnyere.
rows.reference: “A na m enwe olile anya nke ukwuu maka oge na-abịa n’ihu nke weebu,” Berners-Lee gbakwunyere.

rows.source: Bernard Vann: WW1 Victoria Cross cleric celebrated
rows.output: Bernard Vann: Onye ụkọchukwu Victoria Cross nke WW1 ka a na-eme ememe
rows.reference: Bernard Vann: Emere emume onye ụkọchukwu Victoria Cross WW1

rows.source: The only Church of England cleric to win a Victoria Cross during World War One as a combatant has been celebrated in his hometown 100 years on.
rows.output: Onye ụkọchukwu England naanị ya meriri Cross Victoria n'oge Agha Ụwa Mbụ dịka onye agha ka a na-eme ememe n'obodo ya afọ 100 ka e mesịrị.
rows.reference: Emeela emume nke naanị ụkọchukwu Church of England nwetara mmeri Victoria Cross n’oge World War One dị ka onye agha n’obodo ya ka afọ gbara 100.

rows.source: Lt Col The Reverend Bernard Vann won the award on 29 September 1918 in the attack at Bellenglise and Lehaucourt.
rows.output: Onye isi ọrụ ọrụ Lt Col. Ụkọchukwu Bernard Vann nwetara ihe nrite ahụ na 29 Septemba 1918 maka mwakpo a na Bellenglise na Lehaucourt.
rows.reference: Lt Col Ụkọchukwu Bernard Vann nwetara awọdụ na 29, Septemba 1918 na mbuso agha emere na Bellenglise na Lehaucourt.

rows.source: However, he was killed by a sniper four days later and never knew he had won the highest British military honour.
rows.output: Ọbụna, e gburu ya site n'aka onye na-agba egbe ụbọchị anọ ka e mesịrị, ma ọ maghị na o meriri onye agha Bekee kacha elu.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, mgbọ ọkaibe n’ịgba egbe tụrụ ya ka ụbọchị anọ gachara na ọ maghị ncha ncha na etubere ya ugo ndị agha kachasị na Britain.

rows.source: A commemorative stone was unveiled by his two grandsons at a parade in Rushden, Northamptonshire, on Saturday.
rows.output: Wepụtara nkume ncheta site n'aka ụmụ ya nwoke abụọ n'oge ngagharị iwe na Rushden, Northamptonshire, na Satọde.
rows.reference: Ụmụ ụmụ ya ndị nwoke abụọ kpughere okwute iji na-eme ncheta ya na ngarube emere na Rushden, Northamptonshire, na Satọde.

rows.source: One of his grandsons, Michael Vann, said it was "brilliantly symbolic" the stone would be revealed exactly 100 years on from his grandfather's award-winning feat.
rows.output: Otu n'ime ụmụ nwa ya nwoke, Michael Vann, kwuru na ọ bụ "ihe nnọchianya mara mma" na a ga-ekpughe nkume ahụ kpọmkwem afọ 100 ka ihe ọ rụpụtara n'asọmpi ahụ gasịrị.
rows.reference: Otu n’ime nwa nwa ya Michael Vann, kwuru na ọ bụ “ihe nrịbama pụrụ iche nke ukwuu” na a ga-ekpughe okwute ahụ ka afọ gbara 100 kpọmkwem site na mgbe nna ya ochie kpara ike o jiri nweta awọdụ.

rows.source: According to the London Gazette, on 29 September 1918 Lt Col Vann led his battalion across the Canal de Saint-Quentin "through a very thick fog and under heavy fire from field and machine guns."
rows.output: N'ime akwụkwọ akụkọ London, na 29 Septemba 1918, Lt Col Vann duuru battalion ya n'ofe Canal de Saint-Quentin "site na uwe ojii na-egbuke egbuke ma n'okpuru ọkụ egbe ubi na igwe."
rows.reference: Dabere na London Gazette, na 29 Septemba 1918 Lt Col Vann kpọọrọ ndị otu agha ya gafee Canal de Saint-Quentin “n’etiti urukpuru ojii yana n’ime nnukwu ọkụ ọgbụgba sitere na ama yana egbe.”

rows.source: He later rushed up to the firing line and with the "greatest gallantry" led the line forward before rushing a field-gun single-handed and knocked out three of the detachment.
rows.output: Mgbe e mesịrị gawara n'ahịrị ọkụ ma duzie ahịrị ahụ n'ihu n'ihu, tupu ya agbapụ ọkụ ọkụ ma kpochapụ mmadụ atọ n'ime ndị otu ahụ.
rows.reference: Ọ mechara gbara ọsọ gbabanye na ndị na-akwa mgbọ ma “kpaa ike ọkpara” duru ahịrị na-aga ihu tupu ọ chụrụ egbe naanị ya were kụpụ mmadụ ndị agha atọ nọpụrụ iche.

rows.source: Lt Col Vann was killed by a German sniper on 4 October 1918 - just over a month before the war ended.
rows.output: Onye isi ọchịagha Vann e gburu ya site n'aka onye na-agba egbe German na 4 Ọktoba 1918 - ihe na-erughị ọnwa na ọkara tupu a kwụsị agha ahụ.
rows.reference: Onye ọkaibe n’ịgba egbe nke Germany gburu Lt Col Vann na 4 Oktoba 1918 - naanị otu ọnwa tupu agha akwụsị.

rows.source: Michael Vann, 72, said his grandfather's actions were "something that I know that I could never live up to but something which is humbling."
rows.output: Michael Vann, 72, kwuru na ihe nna nna ya mere "ihe nke m na-ama na m enweghị ike ime, ma ihe na-eme ka obi ruo m ala."
rows.reference: Michael Vann, 72 kwuru na omume nna ya ochie mere “bụ ihe ọ maara na ya agaghị emenwu ma ncha mana ọ bụ ihe na-eme mmadụ obi umeala.”

rows.source: He and his brother Dr James Vann also laid a wreath after the parade, which was led by the Brentwood Imperial Youth Band.
rows.output: Ọ na-akwado ya na nwanne ya bụ Dọkịta James Vann, tinyekwa okooko osisi mgbe emechara emume a, nke ndị otu ndị ntorobịa Brentwood Imperial duziri.
rows.reference: Ya na nwanne ya nwoke Dr James Vann tụkwasara ihe ifuru ncheta ka emechara ngarube ahụ, bụ nke Imperial Youth Band Brentwood duru na ya.

rows.source: Michael Vann said he was "feeling very honoured to play a part in the parade" and added "the valour of a genuine hero is being demonstrated by the support that is going to be given by a lot of people."
rows.output: Mikael Vann kwuru na ya na-enwe "mmetụta nke ukwuu na-efe ofufe igwu egwu na ememe" ma gbakwunye "ihe ịga nke ọma nke ezigbo dike na-egosi site n'ịkwado nke ọtụtụ ndị ga-enye."
rows.reference: Michael Vann kwuru na “obi dị ya mma nke ukwuu na nkwanyị ugwu isonye na ngarube ahụ” wee kwukwaa sị na “a na-egosi site na nkwado nke ndị mmadụ kwanyere ike nke dike n’ezie kpara.”

rows.source: MMA fans stayed up all night to watch Bellator 206, they got Peppa Pig instead
rows.output: Ndị na-akwado MMA nọrọ abalị niile ka ha kirie Bellator 206, ha nwetara Peppa Pig kama
rows.reference: Ndị nkwado MMA mụrụ anya abalị niile iji kiri Bellator 206, kama ha nwetara Peppa Pig

rows.source: Imagine this, you have stayed up all night to watch the a packed Bellator 206 only to be denied watching the main event.
rows.output: N'ikpeazụ, ị nọrọ abalị dum na-ekiri ihe ngosi a na-achịkọta 206 Bellator ka ị ghara ikiri ihe omume bụ isi.
rows.reference: Chegodi nke a, ịmụrụ anya abalị niile ka ikirie Bellator 206 juputara ejuputa, naanị ka agọnarị gị ikiri isi emume.

rows.source: The bill from San Jose contained 13 fights, including six on the main card and was being shown live through the night in the UK on Channel 5.
rows.output: Nkeji ọrụ nke San Jose nwere ọgụ iri na atọ, gụnyere isii na kaadị isi, a na-egosi ya ndụ n'abalị niile na UK na Channel 5.
rows.reference: Akwụkwọ ozi sitere San Jose nwere mgba 13, tinyere isii dị na isi kaadị wee na-egosi ya ka ọ na-eme abalị niile na Uk na Channel 5.

rows.source: At 6am, just as Gegard Mousasi and Rory MacDonald were preparing to face each other, viewers in the UK were left stunned when the coverage changed to Peppa Pig.
rows.output: N'elekere 6 nke ụtụtụ, n'oge a na-akwado ọgụ n'etiti Gegard Mousasi na Rory MacDonald, ndị na-ekiri na UK nwere ihe ijuanya mgbe ihe ngosi ahụ gbanwere na Peppa Pig.
rows.reference: N’elekere 6 ụtụtụ, ozugbo Gegard Mousasi na Rory MacDonald chọrọ icherịta onwe ha ihu n’ihu, ndị nkiri nọ UK nwere mgbagwoju anya ka nweta ahụ gbanwere bụrụ Peppa Pig.

rows.source: Some were unimpressed after they had stayed awake until the early hours especially for the fight.
rows.output: Ụfọdụ enweghị mmasị mgbe ha nọrọ n'isi ụtụtụ, karịsịa maka ọgụ ahụ.
rows.reference: Ọ masịghị ụfọdụ ka ha mụchagoro anya abalị ruo isi ụtụtụ tụmadị maka mgba ahụ.

rows.source: One fan on Twitter described the switch to the children's cartoon as "some sort of sick joke."
rows.output: Otu onye na-akwado ya na Twitter kọwara mgbanwe ahụ gaa na ihe nkiri ụmụaka dị ka "ụdị ụjọ."
rows.reference: Otu onye nkwado na Twitter kọwara mgbanwe banye n’ihe nkiri ụmụaka ahụ ka “nnukwu njakịrị atọghị ọchị.”

rows.source: "It's government regulation that at 6 a.m. that content was not suitable so they had to switch to children's programming, " said Dave Schwartz, Bellator senior vice president of marketing and communication, when asked about the transmission.
rows.output: "Ọchịchị na-achịkwa na n'elekere isii nke ụtụtụ na ọdịnaya ahụ adịghị mma ka ha ga-agbanwe gaa na mmemme ụmụaka," ka Dave Schwartz, onye isi osote onye isi oche nke Bellator na-ekwu maka ahịa na nkwukọrịta, mgbe a jụrụ ya banyere mgbasa ozi ahụ.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụ iwu gọọmentị na ka ọ kụrụ elekere 6 ụtụtụ na ihe nkiri ahụ adịghị mma maka ụmụaka, ya mere ha jiri banye n’ihe mmemme ụmụaka,” Dave Schwartz kwuru, senịọ na-esote onye isi maka ahịa na mgbasa ozi Bellator, mgbe ajụrụ maka ngosi ihe nkiri ahụ.

rows.source: ""Peppa the pig," yes."
rows.output: "Nwa Peppa nke ezi," ee."
rows.reference: “”Peppa the Pig,” ee.”

rows.source: Bellator company president Scott Coker said that they are going to work on their scheduling to include UK viewers in the future.
rows.output: Onye isi ụlọ ọrụ Bellator, Scott Coker, kwuru na ha ga-arụ ọrụ na nhazi oge ha iji tinye ndị na-ekiri UK n'ọdịnihu.
rows.reference: Onye isi ụlọ ọrụ Bellator, Scott Coker kwuru na ha ga-arụ ọrụ na nhazi ha ka ewere gbakwunye ndị nkiri UK n’ọdịnihu.

rows.source: "I think that when I think about the replay, I think that we can probably work it out," Coker said.
rows.output: "Ekwenyere m na mgbe m na-eche banyere replay, ekwenyere m na na anyị nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ na ya," Coker kwuru.
rows.reference: “A na m eche mgbe m na-eche maka mmegharị ya, A na m eche na anyị nwere ike eleghị anya dozie ya,” Coker kwuru.

rows.source: "But it's six in the morning on a Sunday there and we won't be able to work this out until Sunday our time, Monday their time.
rows.output: "Ma ọ bụ ụtụtụ Sọnde n'ebe ahụ ma anyị agaghị enwe ike dozie nke a ruo mgbe Sọnde oge anyị, ụbọchị Mọnde oge ha.
rows.reference: “Mana ọ bụ elekere nke isii n’ụtụtụ Sọnde ebe ahụ na anyị enweghị ike idozi ya ruo Sọnde nke anyị, Mọnde nke ha.

rows.source: But we are working on it.
rows.output: Ma na-arụ ọrụ na ya.
rows.reference: Mana anyị na-arụ ọrụ na ya.

rows.source: Believe me, when it switched over there were a lot of texts going back and forth and they all were not friendly.
rows.output: Kwere m, mgbe ọ gbanwere, e nwere ọtụtụ ederede na-aga azụ na azụ, ha niile adịghị enwe obiọma.
rows.reference: Kwenyere m, mgbe ọ gbanwere ebe ahụ, enwere ọtụtụ ederede gara ihu na azụ nke na ha niile abụghị nke enyi na enyi.

rows.source: We were trying to fix it, we thought it was a technical glitch.
rows.output: Anyị na-agbalị idozi ya, anyị chere na ọ bụ mmejọ teknụzụ.
rows.reference: Anyị nọ na-agbalị idozi ya, anyị chere na ọ bụ mmebi siri na teknụzụ.

rows.source: But it wasn't, it was a governmental issue.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụghị, ọ bụ okwu gọọmentị.
rows.reference: Mana ọ bụghị, ọ bụ okwu gbasara ndị gọọmentị.

rows.source: I can promise you the next time it's not going to happen.
rows.output: M nwere ike kwe nkwa na oge ọzọ, ọ gaghị eme.
rows.reference: A ga m ekwe gị nkwa na ọ gaghị eme mgbe ọzọ.

rows.source: We'll keep it down to five fights instead of six - like we normally do - and we tried to overdeliver for the fans and we just went over.
rows.output: Anyị ga-eme ka ọ bụrụ ọgụ ise kama isii - dị ka anyị na-eme mgbe niile - anyị gbalịrị ịnye ihe karịrị maka ndị na-akwado ya ma anyị gara n'ihu.
rows.reference: Anyị ga-ewetu ya ka ọ bụrụ mgba ise kama isii - dịka anyị na-emekarị - na anyị na-agba mbọ inyezu ndị nkwado ihe ha chọrọ were gafezie.

rows.source: It's an unfortunate situation."
rows.output: Ọ dị njọ.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ ọnọdụ mwute.”

rows.source: Desert Island Discs: Tom Daley felt 'inferior' over sexuality
rows.output: N'ime Island Desert Discs: Tom Daley chere "n'okpuru" banyere mmekọahụ ya
rows.reference: Desert Island Discs: Ọ metụtara Tom Daley ka “onye adịghị mma “ n’ihe gbasara ụdị mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị

rows.source: Olympic diver Tom Daley says he grew up feeling inferior to everyone because of his sexuality - but that gave him the motivation to become a success.
rows.output: Onye na-eme ihe n'ime mmiri Olympic, Tom Daley, kwuru na o tolitere na-eche na ọ bụ onye kacha nta n'ihi na ọ bụ onye na-ahụ n'anya, ma nke a nyeere ya aka inweta ihe ịga nke ọma.
rows.reference: Onye na-amanye na mmiri nke Olympic Tom Daley kwuru na ya toputara na mmetụta na ya adịghị mma na-ebe onye ọ bụla nọ n’ihi ụdị mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị ya- mana nke ahụ nyere ya mkpali ịbụ onye mere nke ọma.

rows.source: The 24-year-old said he did not realise until he went to secondary school that "not everyone is like me."
rows.output: Otu nwoke dị afọ iri abụọ na anọ kwuru na ọ maghị na ọ bụghị onye ọ bụla dị ka ya ruo mgbe ọ gara ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị.
rows.reference: Nwata ahụ gbara afọ 24 kwuru na ya amataghị ruo mgbe ọ gara skuul sekọndịrị na “ọ bụghị onye ọ bụla dị ka ya.”

rows.source: Speaking on the first Radio 4 Desert Island Discs presented by Lauren Laverne, he said he spoke out about gay rights to give others "hope."
rows.output: N'okwu a na-ekwu maka ihe ngosi Radio 4 Desert Island Discs nke Lauren Laverne kwuru, o kwuru na o kwuputara ikike nwoke idina nwoke iji nye ndị ọzọ "olileanya."
rows.reference: Mgbe ọ na-ekwu okwu na Radio 4 Desert Island Discs nke izizi, nke Lauren Laverne gosipụtara, o kwuru na ya kwuputara gbasara ikike ndị na-enwe mmekọrịta nwoke na nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị na nwanyị iji nye ndị ọzọ “olile anya.”

rows.source: He also said becoming a parent made him care less about winning the Olympics.
rows.output: O kwukwara na ịbụ nna emeela ka ọ ghara inwe mmasị n'ịmeri asọmpi Olimpiks.
rows.reference: O kwukwara na ịbụ nna mere ya o tinyechaghị mmụọ n’imeri na Olympics.

rows.source: The regular presenter of the long-running show, Kirsty Young, has taken a number of months off because of illness.
rows.output: Onye na-egosi ihe ngosi ahụ na-aga n'ihu, bụ́ Kirsty Young, ewepụla ọtụtụ ọnwa n'ihi ọrịa.
rows.reference: Onye ngosi ihe mmemme ahụ kwa mgbe nke megoro ogologo oge, Kirsty Young, enwerela ọnwa ole ma ole n’ihi ahụ ọnwụnwụ.

rows.source: Appearing as a castaway on Laverne's first programme, Daley said he felt "less than" everyone else growing up because "it wasn't socially acceptable to like boys and girls."
rows.output: Ọ na-eme ka onye a na-achụpụ n'ime mmadụ na mmemme mbụ nke Laverne, Daley kwuru na ọ na-enwe mmetụta "pere mpe karịa" onye ọ bụla ọzọ tolitere n'ihi na "ọ bụghị ihe a na-anabata ịhụ n'anya ụmụ nwoke na ụmụ nwanyị."
rows.reference: Na-apụta dịka onye ajụrụ ajụ n’ihe mmemme izizi nke Laverne, Daley kwuru na ọ metụtara ya dịka “onye erughị” ka ndị ọzọ mgbe ọ na-etolite etolite n’ihi “anabataghị na mmekọrịta ọha inwe mmasị na nwoke na nwanyị.”

rows.source: He said: "To this day, those feelings of feeling less than, and feeling different, have been the real things that have given me the power and strength to be able to succeed."
rows.output: O kwuru: "N'ime ụbọchị a, mmetụta nke ịdị ala na ịdị iche adịla ka ihe ndị e nyere m ike na ike iji nwee ike ịga nke ọma."
rows.reference: O kwuru: “Ruo taa, mmetụta ahụ nke na emetụta ka onye erughị eru, na mmetụta ịdị iche, bụ ihe ndị nyere m ike iji mee nke ọma.”

rows.source: He wanted to prove that he was "something," he said, so that he did not disappoint everyone when they eventually found out about his sexuality.
rows.output: Ọ chọrọ igosi na ọ bụ "ihe," ka o kwuru, ka o wee ghara ịkụda onye ọ bụla mgbe ha chọpụtara banyere mmekọahụ ya n'ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: Ọ chọro ka ya gosi na ya bụ “ihe”, o kwuru, ka ya ghara ịgbawa mmadụ niile obi mgbe ha ga-achọpụta gbasara ụdị mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị ya.

rows.source: The two-time bronze Olympic medallist has become a high-profile LGBT campaigner and used his appearance at this year's Commonwealth Games in Australia to appeal for more countries to decriminalise homosexuality.
rows.output: Onye mmeri ọla abụọ nke ọla bronze n'egwuregwu Olympic, aghọwo onye na-akwado LGBT nke a ma ama, o jikwa ọdịdị ya na egwuregwu Commonwealth n'afọ a na Australia mee ka ọ na-achọ ka mba ndị ọzọ kwụsị ịkatọ mmekọ nwoke na nwanyị.
rows.reference: Onye mmeri ọla nchara ugboro abụọ na Olympics abụrụla onye ndọrọndọrọ LGBT gbagotere, ma were mpụta ya na Commonwealth Games na Australia were rịọ ka ọtụtụ mba ndị ọzọ wepu ịda iwu dị na mmekọrịta nwoke na nwoke ma ọ bụ nwanyị na nwanyị.

rows.source: He said he spoke out because he felt lucky to be able to live openly without ramifications and wanted to give others "hope."
rows.output: O kwuru na o kwuru okwu n'ihi na o chere na o nwere ihu ọma ibi ndu n'ihu n'enweghị ihe ọ bụla, ma chọọ inye ndị ọzọ "olileanya."
rows.reference: O kwuru na ya kwuputara okwu n’ihi na ọ chere na ya nwere chiọma inwe ike na-ebi ndụ ghe oghe na-enweghị ndapụta ọ bụla ma chọọ inye ndị ọzọ “olile anya.”

rows.source: The three-time world champion said falling in love with a man - US film-maker Dustin Lance Black, who he met in 2013 - "caught me by surprise."
rows.output: Onye mmeri ụwa ugboro atọ kwuru na ịhụ n'anya nwoke - onye na-ese ihe nkiri US bụ Dustin Lance Black, onye ọ zutere na 2013 - "gbara m ụjọ."
rows.reference: Onye mmeri ugboro atọ ahụ n’ụwa kwuru na ịhụ nwoke n’anya - onye na-eme ihe nkiri US, Dustin Lance Black, bụ onye nke ya zutere na 2013 - “mere ya na ntụmadị.”

rows.source: Daley married the Oscar winner, who is 20 years his senior, last year but he said the age gap had never been an issue.
rows.output: Daley lụrụ onye meriri Oscar, onye dị afọ iri abụọ karịa ya, n’afọ gara aga mana o kwuru na oghere afọ ahụ amabeghị.
rows.reference: Daley lụrụ onye ahụ were mmeri Oscar, bụ onye jiri afọ 20 were tọọ ya, n’afọ gara aga mana o kwuru na ndịiche dị n’afọ ha enwebeghị mgbe ọ pụtara okwu.

rows.source: "When you go through so much at such a young age" - he went to his first Olympics aged 14 and his father died of cancer three years later - he said that it was hard to find someone the same age who had experienced similar highs and lows.
rows.output: "Mgbe ị na-aga site n'ọtụtụ ihe na otu afọ dị otú ahụ" - ọ gara n'egwuregwu Olympic mbụ ya dị afọ 14, nna ya nwụrụ n'ihi ọrịa kansa afọ atọ ka e mesịrị - o kwuru na ọ siri ike ịchọta onye nọ n'otu afọ ahụ nke nwetara elu na ala yiri ya.
rows.reference: “Mgbe ịgabigara ọtụtụ ihe n’oge ịbụ nwata” - ọ gara Olympics ya nke izizi ka ọgbara afọ 14, nna ya nwụrụ n’ihi ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ ka afọ atọ gachara - o kwuru na o siri ike ịhụ onye ya na ya gbara otu afọ nke nwegoro ụdị ahụmihe dị elu ma dịkwa ala ka ya.

rows.source: The couple became parents in June, to a son called Robert Ray Black-Daley, and Daley said his "whole perspective" had changed.
rows.output: Di na nwunye ahụ ghọrọ nne na nna na June, nwa nwoke aha ya bụ Robert Ray Black-Daley, Daley wee sị na echiche ya "gbanwere kpamkpam."
rows.reference: Mmadụ abụọ ahụ bụrụ nna nwa nwoke akpọrọ Robert Ray Black-Daley na Juun- nke na Daley kwuru na “ka ya si ahụta ihe” gbanwere.

rows.source: "If you had asked me last year, it was all about 'I need to win a gold medal'," he said.
rows.output: "Ọ bụrụ na ị jụrụ m n'afọ gara aga, ọ bụ ihe niile gbasara 'Achọrọ m imeri ihe nrite ọla edo'."
rows.reference: “Ọ bụrụ na ịjụrụ m n’afọ gara aga, ọ bụ naanị gbasara “Inwe mmeri ọla edo’. o kwuru.

rows.source: "You know what, there are bigger things than Olympic gold medals.
rows.output: "Ị maara ihe, e nwere ihe ndị ka ukwuu karịa ọla edo Olympic.
rows.reference: “Ọ kwa ịma, na-enwere ihe ndị karịrị ọla edo Olympics.

rows.source: My Olympic gold medal is Robbie."
rows.output: Onye mmeri ọla m bụ Robbie."
rows.reference: Ọla edo m bụ Robbie.”

rows.source: His son has the same name as his father Robert, who died in 2011 aged 40 after being diagnosed with brain cancer.
rows.output: Nwa ya nwere otu aha ahụ dị ka nna ya bụ́ Robert, onye nwụrụ n’afọ 2011 mgbe ọ dị afọ iri anọ ka a chọpụtara na ọ na-arịa ọrịa ụbụrụ.
rows.reference: Nwa ya nwoke nwere otu aha dị ka nna ya Robert, bụ onye nwụrụ na 2011 ka ọgbara afọ 40, ka achọpụtara na ọ nwere ọrịa mkpụrụ akụ nke ụbụrụ.

rows.source: Daley said his dad did not accept he was going to die and one of the last things he had asked was if they had their tickets yet for London 2012 - as he wanted to be on the front row.
rows.output: Daley kwuru na nna ya adịghị anabata na ọ ga-anwụ, na otu n’ime ihe ikpeazụ ọ rịọrọ bụ ma ha nwere tiketi ha maka London 2012 – ebe ọ chọrọ ịnọ n’ahịrị nke mbụ.
rows.reference: Daley kwuru na nna ya ekwetaghị na ọ ga-anwụ, na otu n’ime ihe ikpeazụ ọ jụrụ bụ ma ha gbatala tịketị ha maka London 2012 - dịka ọ chọrọ ịnọ n’ịhu ihu.

rows.source: "I couldn't say to him 'you're not going to be around to be on the front row dad'," he said.
rows.output: "Agaghị m asị ya 'ị gaghị anọ ebe a ka ị bụrụ n'ihu n'ihu papa'," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Enweghị m ike ịgwa ya na ọ gaghị anọ ndụ ịnọ n’ihu ihu’.” o kwuru.

rows.source: "I was holding his hand as he stopped breathing and it wasn't until he'd actually stopped breathing and he was dead that I finally acknowledged he wasn't invincible," he said.
rows.output: "Ana m mma ya na aka ya ka ọ kwụsị ịkpọ ọchị, na ọ bụghị ruo mgbe ọ kwụsịrị ịkpọ ọchị n'ezie na ọ nwụrụ anwụ ka m kwetara na ọ bụghị onye a na-apụghị imeri emeri."
rows.reference: “Eji m ya aka ka ọ kwụsịrị iku ume na ọ bụ mgbe ọ kwụsịrị iku ume n’ezie ma nwụọ ka M kwetara na ọ bụghị anwụ anwụ,” o kwuru.

rows.source: The following year Daley competed at the 2012 Olympics and won bronze.
rows.output: N'afọ na-abịa, Daley sonyere n'egwuregwu Olympic nke afọ 2012 wee nweta nrite ọla.
rows.reference: N’afọ na-esote ya, Daley sọrọ mpi na 2012 Olympics were rite ọla nchara.

rows.source: "I just knew that this is what I had dreamt of my whole life - to dive in front of a home crowd at an Olympic Games, there was no better feeling," he said.
rows.output: "Enwere m ntụkwasị obi na nke a bụ ihe m na-achọsi ike ná ndụ m - ịwụli elu n'ihu ìgwè mmadụ n'ụlọ na asọmpi Olympic, enweghị mmetụta ka mma," ka o kwuru.
rows.reference: “A maara m na nke a bụ ihe m rọgoro na nrọ ndụ m niile - ịmanye na mmiri n’ihu igwe mmadụ ndị ụlọ m na Olympics Game, enweghị mmetụta karịrị ya,” o kwuru.

rows.source: It also inspired his first song choice - Proud by Heather Small - which had resonated with him in the build up to the Olympics and still gave him goosebumps.
rows.output: Ọ dịkwa ya ka ọ na-akpali abụ mbụ ya - Obi ike nke Heather Small - nke kpalitere ya n'oge a na-ewu ewu maka Olympics ma ka na-enye ya mmetụta dị ka ọ dịghị mgbe.
rows.reference: Ọ kpalitere nhọrọ egwu ya izizi - Proud site na Heather Small - bụ nke metụtara ya n’oge nkwadobe nke Olympics ma na-enyekwa ya akpata oyi.

rows.source: Desert Island Discs is on BBC Radio 4 on Sunday at 11:15 BST.
rows.output: N'ime ndị na-akwado ihe nkiri bụ na BBC Radio 4 na Sunday na 11:15 BST.
rows.reference: Desert Island Discs dị na BBC Radio 4 na Sọnde na 11:15 BST.

rows.source: Out-of-form Mickelson benched on Ryder Cup Saturday
rows.output: Onye na-egwu egwu Mickelson nọrọ n'elu bench na Satọde Ryder Cup
rows.reference: Ahapụrụ Mickelson ahụ ezuchaghị oke n’oche na Ryder Cup na Satọde

rows.source: American Phil Mickelson will set a record on Sunday when he plays his 47th Ryder Cup match, but he will have to turn his form around to avoid it being an unhappy milestone.
rows.output: Onye America bụ Phil Mickelson ga-edobe ndekọ na Sọnde mgbe ọ na-egwu egwuregwu Ryder Cup nke iri anọ na asaa ya, mana ọ ga-achọ imeziwanye ụdị ya ka ọ ghara ime emume na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Onye America Phil Mickelson ga-etinye ndekọ na Sọnde mgbe ọ ga-akụ egwuregwu Ryder Cup nke ugboro 47 ya, mana ọ ga-atụgharị ụdị ya iji zenarị ịbụ ihe mmezu agaghị enye anụrị.

rows.source: Mickelson, playing in the biennial event for a record 12th time, was benched by captain Jim Furyk for Saturday's fourballs and foursomes.
rows.output: Mickelson, na-egwu egwu n'asọmpi a na-eme kwa afọ maka ndekọ 12, bụ onye isi Jim Furyk na-egwuri egwu n'asọmpi anọ na asatọ nke Satọde.
rows.reference: Kaptịn Jim Furyk nọchiri Mickelson, ịkụ n’ihe mmemme a na-eme otu ugboro n’afọ abụọ nke ugboro 12 ya, na Satọde maka bọọlụ otu mmadụ abụọ na agba mmadụ anọ.

rows.source: Instead of being at the center of the action, as he so often has been for the United States, the five-times major winner split his day between being a cheerleader and working on his game on the range in the hope of rectifying what ails him.
rows.output: N'adịghị ka ọ na-adị mgbe ọ na-anọ n'etiti ihe omume, dị ka ọ na-emekarị maka United States, onye mmeri n'ọkwa dị elu ugboro ise kewara ụbọchị ya n'etiti ịgba egwu na ịrụ ọrụ n'ọhịa n'olileanya nke idozi ihe ọjọọ ya.
rows.reference: Kama ịnọ n’etiti ihe na-eme, ka o si anọbu maka ndị United States, onye mmeri ugboro ise ahụ kere ụbọchị ya ịbụ onye na-akụ aka ma na-edozikwa egwuregwu ya n’ama ahụ n’olile anya imezi ihe na-arịa ya.

rows.source: Never the straightest of drivers even at the peak of his career, the 48-year-old is not an ideal fit for the tight Le Golf National course, where the long rough routinely punishes errant shots.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị mgbe onye na-anya ụgbọ ala kacha mma, ọbụna n'oge ọrụ ya kacha elu, ụbọchị 48 bụ onye na-adịghị mma maka ụzọ Le Golf National siri ike, ebe ọkpụkpụ dị ogologo na-emebi ihe ndọpụ uche mgbe niile.
rows.reference: Ọ nwebeghị mgbe ọ bụ onye na-akụ ihe gara larịị ọbụlagodi mgbe ọ nọ n’isi ọrụ egwuregwu ya, nwoke a gbara afọ 48 adabaghị n’ụdị ama Le Golf National kpara mkpa, ebe ama ahụ toro ogologo na-ata ọkụkụ etoghi ogologo ahụhụ.

rows.source: And if the course on its own is not daunting enough, Mickelson, in the ninth match on Sunday, faces accurate British Open champion Francesco Molinari, who has teamed up with rookie Tommy Fleetwood to win all four of their matches this week.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ọdịdị n'onwe ya adịghị egwu nke ukwuu, Mickelson, na egwuregwu nke itoolu na Sọnde, na-eche ihu onye mmeri British Open nke ziri ezi, Francesco Molinari, onye ya na onye rookie Tommy Fleetwood na-emeri egwuregwu anọ niile n'izu a.
rows.reference: Na ọ bụrụgodi na ama ahụ anaghị atụ egwu n’onwe ya, Mickelson, na egwuregwu nke itoolu na Sọnde ga-ezute onye mmeri British Open Francesco Molinari na-akụ nke ọma, bụ onye ya na onye ọhụrụ Tommy Fleetwood jikọrọ ọnụ merie egwuregwu anọ ha niile n’izu a.

rows.source: If the Americans, four points down starting the 12 singles matches, get off to a hot start, Mickelson's match could prove absolutely crucial.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ndị America, na-eso isi anọ na-amalite egwuregwu iri na abụọ, na-amalite nke ọma, egwuregwu Mickelson nwere ike bụrụ ihe dị mkpa n'ezie.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na ndị America, jiri akara anọ n’akpụ n’azụ malite egwuregwu 12 agba nke otu onye, bido n’ọkụ ọkụ, egwuregwu Mickelson nwere ike ịdị oke mkpa.

rows.source: Furyk expressed confidence in his man, not that he could say much else.
rows.output: Furyk kwuputara obi ike n'ime nwoke ya, ọbụna na o nweghị ike ikwu ihe ọzọ.
rows.reference: Furyk kwuputara ntụkwasị obi na onye nke ya, ọ bụghị na ọ nwere ihe ọzọ ọ nwere ike ikwu.

rows.source: "He fully understood the role that he had today, gave me a pat on the back and put his arm around me and said he would be ready tomorrow," Furyk said.
rows.output: "Ọ dị ya mma n'ọrụ ọ na-arụ taa, nyere m mgbatị azụ, tinye m aka n'ubu ma kwuo na ọ ga-adị njikere echi," Furyk kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ họtara ọrụ ọ nwere taa nke ọma, tie m aka n’azụ were konye m aka wee sị, ọ ga-adị nkwadebe echi,” Furyk kwuru.

rows.source: "He's got a lot of confidence in himself.
rows.output: "O nwere okwukwe nke ukwuu n'ime onwe ya.
rows.reference: “Ọ nwere nnukwu ntụkwasị obi n’onwe ya.

rows.source: He's a Hall of Famer and he's added so much to these teams in the past, and this week.
rows.output: Ọ bụ Ụlọ Nzukọ Ọchịchị na ọ gbakwunyere nke ukwuu n'ime otu ndị a n'oge gara aga, na n'izu a.
rows.reference: Ọ bụ onye nọ na Hall of Fame, na o tinyekwala ọtụtụ ihe na ndị otu a n’oge gara aga na n’izu a.

rows.source: I probably didn't envision him playing two matches.
rows.output: M ga-eme ka ọ na-egwu egwuregwu abụọ.
rows.reference: Eleghị anya atụghị m anya na ọ ga-akụ egwuregwu abụọ.

rows.source: I envisioned more, but that's the way it worked out and that's the way we thought we had to go.
rows.output: M tụrụ anya ihe ndị ọzọ, ma nke ahụ bụ otú o si mee ma nke ahụ bụ otú anyị chere na anyị ga-eme.
rows.reference: Atụrụ m anya karịa, mana ọ bụ otu a ka o siri dapụta ma bụrụkwa otu anyị chere na anyị ga-esi gaa.

rows.source: He wants to be out there, just like everyone else."
rows.output: Ọ na-achọ ịnọ ebe ahụ, dị ka onye ọ bụla ọzọ."
rows.reference: Ọ chọrọ ịnọ n’ihu ebe ahụ, dị ka onye ọ bụla.”

rows.source: Mickelson will pass Nick Faldo's record for the most Ryder Cup matches played on Sunday.
rows.output: Mickelson ga-agafe ndekọ Nick Faldo maka egwuregwu Ryder Cup kacha nke a ga-egwu na Sọnde.
rows.reference: Mickelson ga-agafe ndekọ Nick Faldo maka egwuregwu Ryder Cup kacha na Sọnde.

rows.source: It could mark the end of a Ryder Cup career that has never quite matched the heights of his individual record.
rows.output: Ọ nwere ike bụrụ njedebe nke ọrụ Ryder Cup nke a na-ahụtụbeghị ka ọ dabara na elu nke ndekọ ya nke onwe ya.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere ike bụrụ ngwucha ọrụ egwuregwu Ryder Cup ya bụ nke na-erughị elu ndekọ nkeonwe ya.

rows.source: Mickelson has 18 wins, 20 losses and seven halves, though Furyk said his presence brought some intangibles to the team.
rows.output: Mickelson nwere mmeri iri na asatọ, mfu iri abụọ na asaa, na ọkara asaa, ọ bụ ezie na Furyk kwuru na ọnụnọ ya wetara ụfọdụ ihe na-adịghị ahụkebe n'òtù ahụ.
rows.reference: Mickelson nwere mmeri 18, mmefu 20 na onye laba onye laba asaa, agbanyeghị na Furyk kwuru ọnụnọ ya butere ihe enweghi ike nkọwa n’otu ahụ.

rows.source: "He's funny, he's sarcastic, witty, likes to poke fun at people, and he's a great guy to have in the team room," he explained.
rows.output: "Ọ dị ịtụnanya, ọ na-egosipụta iwe, na-egbuke egbuke, na-enwe mmasị ịkwa ndị mmadụ emo, ọ bụkwa ezigbo nwoke ka ị nwee n'ime ụlọ otu," o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ na-akpa ọchị, na-eme akaja, na-ekwu okwu ọchị, ọ na-amasị ya ịkpa ndị mmadụ ọchị, ọ bụ ezigbo mmadụ inwe n’ime ụlọ ndị otu a,” ọ kọwara.

rows.source: "I think the younger players had fun having a go at him, as well, this week, which was fun to see.
rows.output: "Ekwenyere m na ndi egwu na-eto eto nwere anụrị ịnwale ya, nke ọma, n'izu a, nke na-atọ ụtọ ịhụ."
rows.reference: “Echere m na ndị egwuregwu ndị obere nwere obi anụrị ịkpasu ya n’izu a, bụ ihe nyere obi anụrị ịhụ.

rows.source: He provides a lot more than just play."
rows.output: Ọ na-enye ọtụtụ ihe karịa naanị egwuregwu.
rows.reference: Ọ na-enye ihe karịrị naanị ịkụ egwuregwu.”

rows.source: Europe captain Thomas Bjorn knows big lead can soon disappear
rows.output: Onye isi Europe, Thomas Bjorn maara na nnukwu ụzọ isi na-efunahụ ngwa ngwa
rows.reference: Kaptịn Europe Thomas Bjorn maara na iji nnukwu akara buru ụzọ nwere ike fuo n’oge adịghị anya

rows.source: Thomas Bjorn, the European captain, knows from experience that a sizeable lead heading into the last-day singles in the Ryder Cup can easily turn into an uncomfortable ride.
rows.output: Onyeisi Europe, Thomas Bjorn, maara site n'ahụmahụ ya na ụzọ dị ukwuu na-aga n'asọmpi ikpeazụ n'ụbọchị ikpeazụ nke iko Ryder nwere ike ịgbanwe ngwa ngwa ka ọ bụrụ njem na-adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Thomas Bjorn, kaptịn Europe, maara site na ahụmihe na iji nnukwu akara buru ụzọ na-abanye agba nke otu onye n’ụbọchị nke ikpeazụ na Ryder Cup nwere ike tugharịa bụrụ ụgbọ agaghị atọ ụtọ.

rows.source: The Dane made his debut in the 1997 match at Valderrama, where a side captained by Seve Ballesteros held a five-point advantage over the Americans but only just got over the finishing line with their noses in front by the narrowest of margins, winning 14½-13½.
rows.output: Onye Dane mere ọkwa mbụ ya na egwuregwu 1997 na Valderrama, ebe otu nke Seve Ballesteros na-achị nwere uru isi ise n'elu ndị America mana ha jisiri ike gafee ahịrị ngwụcha na imi ha n'ihu site na obere oke, na-emeri 14½-13½.
rows.reference: Onye Denmark ahụ pụtara izizi na egwuregwu 1997 na Valderrama, ebe akụkụ nke Seven Ballesteros bụ Captain jiri akara ise gafee ndị America mana ha nwere ike ịgafe ebe ngwucha naanị na imi ha dị n’ihu site na ntakịrị oghere, were merie 14½-13½.

rows.source: "You keep reminding yourself that we had a big lead at Valderrama; we had a big lead at Brookline, where we lost, and at Valderrama, where we won, but only just," said Bjorn, pictured, after watching the Class of 2018 win 5-3 both on Friday and yesterday to lead 10-6 at Le Golf National.
rows.output: "I na-echetara onwe gị na anyị nwere nnukwu ụzọ na Valderrama; anyị nwere nnukwu ụzọ na Brookline, ebe anyị tụfuru, na Valderrama, ebe anyị meriri, ma ọ dị nnọọ ntakịrị," ka Bjorn kwuru, ka e si na foto ya pụta, mgbe ọ na-ekiri Class nke 2018 imeri 5-3 na Fraịde na ụnyaahụ iji duzie 10-6 na Le Golf National.
rows.reference: “Ị ga-agba mbọ ichetere onwe gị n’iji nnukwu akara aga na Valderrama; anyị ji nnukwu akara aga na Brookline, ebe emeriri anyi, na Valderrama ebe anyị meriri mana ọ bụ ntakịrị ihe,” Bjorn kwuru, esetere ka elelechara mgbe Klaasị 2018 meriri 5-3 na Fraịde yana ụnyahụ, iji 10-6 aga na Le Golf National.

rows.source: So history will show me and everybody on that team that this is not over.
rows.output: Ya mere, akụkọ ihe mere eme ga-egosi mụ na onye ọ bụla nọ n'òtù ahụ na nke a abụghị njedebe.
rows.reference: Yabụ na hịstrị ga-egosi m na onye ọ bụla n’otu ahụ na nke a agwụbeghị.

rows.source: You go full bore tomorrow.
rows.output: Izu ohi ebe a na-aga n'ọdịnihu.
rows.reference: Ị ga-agbalị si ike echi.

rows.source: Get out there and do all the right things.
rows.output: Pụọ ebe ahụ mee ihe niile ziri ezi.
rows.reference: Pụọ ebe ahụ mee ihe niile kwesịrị ekwesị.

rows.source: This is not over till you've got the points on the board.
rows.output: Nke a abụghị ihe zuru ezu ruo mgbe ị nwetara isi ihe na bọọdụ.
rows.reference: Nke a agwụbeghị ruo mgbe inwetara akara ahụ na bọdụ.

rows.source: We have a goal, and that is to try to win this trophy, and that's where the focus stays.
rows.output: Anyị nwere ebumnuche, na nke ahụ bụ ịgbalị imeri iko a, na nke ahụ bụ ebe uche na-anọ.
rows.reference: Anyị nwere ebumnuche, bụ ka anyị gbalịa nweta iko mmeri a, ya bụ ebe ahụ ka anya anyị tụkwasara.

rows.source: I've said all along, I focus on the 12 players that are in our side, but we are so well aware of what's standing across on the other side - the greatest players in the world."
rows.output: Achọpụtala m n'oge gara aga, m na-elekwasị anya na ndị egwuregwu iri na abụọ nọ n'òtù anyị, ma anyị maara nke ọma ihe dị n'akụkụ nke ọzọ - ndị egwuregwu kachasị ukwuu n'ụwa."
rows.reference: Ekwubuola m kemgbe na, A na m elekwasa anya na ndị egwuregwu 12 nọ n’akụkụ anyị, mana anyị maara nke ọma ihe kwụ n’akụkụ nke ọzọ - ndị egwuregwu kachasị na mba ụwa.”

rows.source: Delighted how his players have performed on a tough golf course, Bjorn added: "I would never get ahead of myself in this.
rows.output: Ọ na-amasị m otú ndị egwuregwu m si na-eme n'ogige gọọlfụ siri ike, Bjorn gbakwụnyere: "Agaghị m enwekwu okwukwe n'onwe m n'ime nke a.
rows.reference: N’obi anụrị ka ndị egwuregwu ya siri mee na ama gọlfụ siri ike, Bjorn gbakwunyere: “Agaghị m agbanarị onwe m n’ọsọ na nke a.

rows.source: Tomorrow's a different beast.
rows.output: Echi bụ anụ ọhịa dị iche.
rows.reference: Echi bụ ajọ anụ dị iche.

rows.source: Tomorrow is the individual performances that come forward, and that is a different thing to do.
rows.output: Ọdịnihu bụ ihe ngosi onye ọ bụla na-abịa n'ihu, na nke ahụ bụ ihe dị iche iche ime.
rows.reference: Echi bụ mmemme otu onye nke na-abịa n’ihu, na nke ahụ bụ ihe dị iche ime.

rows.source: It's great to be out there with a partner when things are going good, but when you're out there individually, then you're tested to the full of your capacity as a golfer.
rows.output: Ọ dị mma ịnọ ebe ahụ na onye mmekọ mgbe ihe na-aga nke ọma, ma mgbe ị nọ ebe ahụ naanị ya, mgbe ahụ, a na-enyocha gị ruo n'ókè ikike gị dị ka onye na-agba chaa chaa.
rows.reference: Ọ dị mma inwe onye mmekọrịta n’ihu ebe ahụ mgbe ihe na-aga nke ọma, mana mgbe ịnọ naanị gị n’ihu ebe ahụ, mgbe ahụ ka a ga-anwale gị n’uju dịka onye na-akụ gọlfụ.

rows.source: That's the message that you need to get across to players, is get the best out of yourself tomorrow.
rows.output: Nke ahụ bụ ozi ị ga-ekwurịta okwu na ndị egwuregwu, bụ inweta ihe kacha mma n'ime onwe gị echi.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ bụ ozi ịkwesịrị ime ka ndị na-eme egwuregwu mara, bụ wepụta n’ime onwe gị nke kacha mma echi.

rows.source: Now, you leave your partner behind and he has to go and get the best out of himself, as well."
rows.output: Ugbu a, hapụ onye òtù gị ka ọ nọrọ n'azụ ma ọ ga-aga nweta ihe kacha mma n'ime ya, n'otu oge ahụ.
rows.reference: Ugbu a, ịhapụrụ onye mmekọrịta gị n’azụ ọ ga-agakwa wepụta onwe ya nke kacha mma.”

rows.source: In contrast to Bjorn, opposite number Jim Furyk will be looking for his players to perform better individually than they did as partners, the exceptions being Jordan Spieth and Justin Thomas, who picked up three points out of four.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị iche na Bjorn, Jim Furyk ga-achọ ka ndị egwuregwu ya rụọ ọrụ nke ọma n'onwe ha karịa ka ha mere dị ka ndị mmekọ, naanị ihe ndị a na-ewepụ bụ Jordan Spieth na Justin Thomas, ndị nwetara isi atọ n'ime anọ.
rows.reference: Na ndịiche Bjorn, nọmba ncherịta ihu nke Jim Furyk ga-achọ ka ndị egwuregwu ya mee nke ọma n’onwe ha karịa ka ha nwere onye mmekọrịta, ewezuga Jordan Spieth na Justin Thomas bụ ndị nwetere akara atọ n’ime anọ.

rows.source: Furyk himself has been on both ends of those big last-day turnarounds, having been part of the winning team at Brookline before ending up a loser as Europe pulled off the "Miracle at Medinah."
rows.output: Furyk n'onwe ya enweela oke na ala nke ndị ahụ buru ibu, nke emere n'ụbọchị ikpeazụ, ebe ọ bụ akụkụ nke otu mmeri na Brookline tupu ọ ghọọ onye meriri na Europe mgbe ha mere "Mmiri n'ime Medinah."
rows.reference: Furyk n’onwe ya anọrọla na ngwucha nnukwu ụbọchị ntugharị ahụ, ka o osochara n’otu meriri na Brookline tupu ọ bụrụ onye emeriri ka Europe mere ihe ebube “Miracle at Medinah.”

rows.source: "I remember every damn word of it," he said in reply to being asked how Ben Crenshaw, the captain in 1999, had rallied his players heading into the last day.
rows.output: "Ana m mụọ okwu ọ bụla nke ọma," ka o kwuru n'azịza ajụjụ a jụrụ ka Ben Crenshaw, onye isi na 1999, siri kpalie ndị egwuregwu ya n'ụbọchị ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: “Echetara m okwu ya niile,” ọ zara ka ajụrụ ya ka Ben Crenshaw kaptịn 1999 siri chịkọba ndị otu ya n’ịbanye ụbọchị ikpeazụ.

rows.source: "We have 12 important matches tomorrow, but you'd like to get off to that fast start like you saw at Brookline, like you saw at Medinah.
rows.output: Anyị nwere egwuregwu iri na abụọ dị mkpa echi, mana ị ga-achọ ịpụ ngwa ngwa ka ị hụrụ na Brookline, ka ị hụrụ na Medinah.
