rows.reference: “Anyị nwere egwuregwu 12 dị mkpa echi niile, mana ọ ga-adị mma ịmalite n’ike dịka ịhụrụ na Brookline, dịka ịhụrụ na Medinah.

rows.source: When that momentum gets going one way, it puts a lot of pressure on those middle matches.
rows.output: Mgbe mmegharị ahụ na-aga n'ihu otu ụzọ, ọ na-etinye nnukwu nrụgide na egwuregwu ndị dị n'etiti.
rows.reference: Mgbe ọ gabara otu ụzọ n’ike, ọ na-akwanye nnukwu nkwanye na egwuregwu ndị etiti ahụ.

rows.source: We set up our line-up accordingly and put the guys out in the fashion that we felt like, you know, we're trying to make some magic tomorrow."
rows.output: Anyị haziri usoro anyị dịka ọ dị ma tinye ndị nwoke ahụ n'ụzọ ahụ anyị chere na anyị na-agbalị ime ụfọdụ anwansi echi.
rows.reference: Anyị na-ahazi ahịrị anyị ka ọ kwesịrị ma tinye ndị nke anyị n’ụdị masịrị anyị, ịma, anyị na-agbalị ime ihe anwansi echi niile.”

rows.source: Thomas has been handed the task of trying to lead the fightback and faces Rory McIlroy in the top match, with Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood and Ian Poulter the other Europeans in the top half of the order.
rows.output: Thomas enyere ọrụ ịgbalị iduzi mgbake ahụ ma chere Rory McIlroy ihu na egwuregwu kachasị elu, ebe Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood na Ian Poulter bụ ndị Europe ndị ọzọ nọ na ọkara elu nke usoro ahụ.
rows.reference: Enyela Thomas ọrụ ịgbalị ibu ụzọ na mgba ahụ wee cherịta Rory McIlroy ihu n’isi egwuregwu ahụ, yana Paul Casey, Justin Rose, Jon Rahm, Tommy Fleetwood na Ian Poulter na ndị Europe ndị ọzọ nọ na mgbago usoro ahụ.

rows.source: "I went with this group of guys in this order because I think it covers all the way through," said Bjorn of his singles selections.
rows.output: "Agara mụ na otu ndị a nwoke a n'usoro a n'ihi na echere m na ọ na-ekpuchi ụzọ niile site na mmalite ruo ọgwụgwụ."
rows.reference: “Ejiri m otu ụmụ nwoke ndị a were gaa n’ihi na E chere m na enwetechara m ihe niile,” Bjorn kwuru maka nhọrọ agba nke otu onye ya.

rows.source: Germany's new warship postponed yet again
rows.output: Egwu ọgbara ọhụrụ nke Germany ka agbagoro ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ebugharịrị ngwa ọgụ ọhụrụ Germany ọzọkwa

rows.source: German Navy's newest frigate should have been commissioned in 2014 to replace ageing Cold War-era warships, but it won't be there until at least the next year due to faulty systems and snowballing cost, local media reported.
rows.output: N'afọ 2014, a ga-akpọrọ ụgbọ mmiri ọhụrụ nke ndị agha mmiri German, nke ga-anọchi ụgbọ mmiri ochie nke oge agha oyi, mana ọ gaghị abịa ruo opekata mpe afọ na-esote n'ihi nsogbu usoro na ọnụ ahịa na-abawanye, ka akwụkwọ akụkọ mpaghara si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ekwesịrị itinye n’ọrụ Frigate ọhụrụ nke Ndị Agha Mmiri nke Germany na 2014 iji nọchie ngwa ọgụ oge Cold War kabagoro nka, mana ọ gaghị anọ ebe ahụ ruo opekempe afọ na-abịa n’ihi sistem adịghị mma yana ọnụahịa dị oke ọnụ, ụlọ mgbasa ozi nke obodo kwuputara.

rows.source: Commissioning of the "Rheinland-Pfalz," the lead ship of the brand new Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates, has now been postponed until the first half of 2019, according to Die Zeit newspaper citing a military spokesman.
rows.output: N'ikpeazụ, ebuga nke "Rheinland-Pfalz," ụgbọ mmiri ndu nke ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri Baden-Wuerttemberg ọhụrụ, a na-akwaga ugbu a na mbụ ọkara nke 2019, dị ka akwụkwọ akụkọ Die Zeit si kwuo na-ekwu okwu ndị agha.
rows.reference: Ebugharịala itinye n’ọrụ nke “Rheinland-Pfalz,” isi ụgbọ nke Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigate ọhụrụ ka o ruo ọkara afọ mbu nke 2019, dabere na akwụkwọ akụkọ Die Zeit, na-arụtụ onye nkwuchite okwu ndị agha aka.

rows.source: The vessel should have joined the Navy in 2014, but the troubling post-delivery issues plagued the fate of the ambitious project.
rows.output: Ụgbọ mmiri ahụ kwesịrị ịbanye n'ụgbọ mmiri n'afọ 2014, ma nsogbu ndị na-enwe mgbe ha na-ewu ụlọ emebiela ọdịnihu nke ọrụ a na-achọsi ike.
rows.reference: Ụgbọ ahụ kwesịrị isonye Ndị Agha Mmiri na 2014, mana ihe nsogbu mbute ya sochiri oke atụmatụ ahụ.

rows.source: The four Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels the Navy ordered back in 2007 will come as replacement to the ageing Bremen-class frigates.
rows.output: Ndị ụgbọ mmiri anọ nke Baden-Wuerttemberg klas nke ụgbọ mmiri ahụ nyere iwu na 2007 ga-abịa dị ka ndị ga-anọchi ụgbọ mmiri Bremen klas na-eto eto.
rows.reference: Ụgbọ Baden-Wuerttemberg-class anọ Ndị Agha Mmiri tụrụ ahịa ya na 2007 ga-abịa dịka nnọchi anya Bremen-class frigate kabagoro nka.

rows.source: It is understood they will feature a powerful cannon, an array of anti-aircraft and anti-ship missiles as well as some stealth technologies, such as reduced radar, infrared and acoustic signatures.
rows.output: Ọ dị ka ha ga-egosi ngwa agha siri ike, ngwugwu nke ngwa agha megide ụgbọ elu na ụgbọ mmiri, yana ụfọdụ teknụzụ nzuzo, dị ka mbelata radar, infrared na akara ụda.
rows.reference: Emere ka aghọta na ha ga-enwe isi egbe siri ike nke ukwuu, ngwa ọgụ ụgbọ elu dị iche iche na ogbunigwe ụgbọ mmiri yana ụfọdụ teknụzụ nzuzo, dị ka radar eweturu ewetu, infrared na ndakọrịta ụda.

rows.source: Other important features include longer maintenance periods - it should be possible to deploy the newest frigates for up to two years away from home ports.
rows.output: Ihe ndị ọzọ dị mkpa gụnyere oge mmezi ogologo oge - ekwesịrị inwe ike ịkwado ndị ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri kacha ọhụrụ maka ihe ruru afọ abụọ pụọ n'ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri.
rows.reference: Nrụọrụ ndị ọzọ dị mkpa tinyere oge nrụkwa ya tere aka - ọ kwesịrị na ọ ga-ekwe omume itinye n’ọrụ frigate ndị ọhụrụ ahụ ihe ruru afọ abụọ pụọ na ọdụ ụgbọ mmiri.

rows.source: However, continuous delays mean that the cutting-edge warships - said to allow Germany to project power overseas - will already become outdated by the time they enter service, Die Zeit notes.
rows.output: Ọbụna, igbu oge na-aga n'ihu pụtara na agha ọhụrụ ndị a, nke a na-ekwu na ha ga-enye Germany ohere ịpụta ìhè ná mba ọzọ, ga-abụ ndị agadi tupu ha abanye n'ọrụ, Die Zeit na-ekwu.
rows.reference: Kosiladị, igbu oge niile a pụtara na ngwa ọgụ ahụ pụrụ iche - nke ekwuru na ọ ga-enye Germany oghere igosi ike na mba ofesi -ga-abụ ihe megoro ochie mgbe ha ga-amalite ọrụ, Die Zelt tụrụ aka.

rows.source: The ill-fated F125 frigate made headlines last year, when the German Navy officially refused to commission the vessel and returned it to Blohm & Voss shipyard in Hamburg.
rows.output: Nke a na-akpali akpali F125 frigate nwetara aha ikpeazụ n'afọ gara aga, mgbe ndị agha mmiri German jụrụ ịnakwere ụgbọ ahụ n'ọrụ ma laghachi na ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri Blohm & Voss na Hamburg.
rows.reference: Frigate F125 ahụ juputara na nsogbu pụtara n’isi akụkọ n’afọ gara aga mgbe Ndị Agha Mmiri nke Germany jụrụ itinye ụgbọ ahụ n’ọrụ wee bughachi ya na ọdụ nrụpụta ụgbọ mmiri Blohm & Voss dị na Hamburg.

rows.source: This was the first time the Navy has returned a ship to a shipbuilder after delivery.
rows.output: Nke a bụ oge mbụ ndị agha mmiri lọghachiri ụgbọ mmiri n'ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri mgbe e nyefere ya.
rows.reference: Nke a bụ nke mbụ Ndị Agha Mmiri na-ebughachi ụgbọ mmiri azụ na ndị rụpụtara ya ka ebutechara ya.

rows.source: Little was known about the reasons behind the return, but German media cited a number of crucial "software and hardware defects" that made the warship useless if deployed on a combat mission.
rows.output: Obereghị ihe mere ịlaghachi azụ, mana mgbasa ozi German kwuru ọtụtụ ihe dị mkpa "software na hardware defects" nke mere na ụgbọ agha ahụ enweghị ike iji ma ọ bụrụ na ebugara ya n'ọrụ agha.
rows.reference: Ntakịrị ka amatara maka ihe kpatara eji bughachi ya, mana ndị ụlọ mgbasa ozi Germany rụtụrụ aka ọnụọgụ ihe ole ma ole “mmebi ngwanro na ngwaike “ dị oke mkpa, nke mere na ngwa ọgụ ahụ abaghị uru ma ọ bụrụ na-ebupu ya ka ọ gaa agha.

rows.source: Software deficiencies were particularly important as the Baden-Wuerttemberg-class vessels will be operated by a crew of some 120 sailors - just half of the manpower on older Bremen class frigates.
rows.output: Mkpebi sọftụwia dị ịrịba ama karịsịa ka ndị ụgbọ mmiri Baden-Wuerttemberg ga-esi na ndị ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri dị ihe dị ka 120 na-arụ ọrụ - naanị ọkara nke ndị ọrụ nke ndị ọrụ ụgbọ mmiri Bremen ochie.
rows.reference: Ezughị oke ngwanro dị oke mkpa ebe ọ bụ ndị na-akwọ ụgbọ mmiri 120 ga-akwọ Baden-Wuerttemberg-class ahụ - naanị ọkara mmadụ na-akwọ Bremen class frigate ndị ochie.

rows.source: Also, it emerged that the ship is dramatically overweight which reduces its performance and limits the Navy's ability to add future upgrades.
rows.output: Ọzọkwa, ọ pụtara ìhè na ụgbọ mmiri ahụ na-ebu ibu nke ukwuu nke na-ebelata arụmọrụ ya ma na-egbochi ikike ndị agha mmiri ịgbakwunye mmelite n'ọdịnihu.
rows.reference: Ọzọkwa, ọ pụtakwara na ụgbọ mmiri ahụ buru oke ibu nke weturu ike ọrụ ya ma gbachie ndị Agha Mmiri ịgbakwunye ihe nkwalite n’ọdịnihu.

rows.source: The 7,000-ton "Rheinland-Pfalz" is believed to be twice as heavy as similar-class ships used by the Germans in the Second World War.
rows.output: Ụgbọ mmiri 7,000-ton "Rheinland-Pfalz" na-ewere na ọ dị okpukpu abụọ ibu ka ụgbọ mmiri klaasị yiri nke ndị Jamanị ji n'oge Agha Ụwa nke Abụọ.
rows.reference: Ekwenyere na 7,000-ton “Rheinland-Pfalz jiri ugboro abụọ karịa ibu ụdị ụgbọ mmiri ndị yana ya n’otu klaasị nke ndị Germany jiri na Second World War.

rows.source: Aside from faulty hardware, the price tag of the entire project - including the training of the crew - is also becoming an issue.
rows.output: Na mgbakwunye na ngwaọrụ na-adịghị mma, ọnụ ahịa akara nke ọrụ niile - gụnyere ọzụzụ nke ndị ọrụ - na-aghọkwa nsogbu.
rows.reference: Ewezuga ngwaike adịghị mma, ọnụego atụmatụ ọrụ ahụ niile - tinyere ịzụpụta ndị ga-akwọ ya - na-apụtakwa okwu.

rows.source: It is said to have reached staggering €3.1billion ($3.6bn) - up from initial €2.2 billion.
rows.output: Ekwuru na ọ ruru ihe dị ịtụnanya nke nde euro 3.1 ($3.6bn) - site na mbido nde euro 2.2.
rows.reference: Ekwuru na oruola ihe mmaja ijeri €3.1 (ijeri $3.6) - gbagoo site na ijeri €2.2 izizi.

rows.source: Problems gripping the newest frigates become especially of importance in light of recent warnings that Germany's naval power is shrinking.
rows.output: Ihe ndị na-akpata nsogbu n'ime ụgbọ mmiri ọhụrụ a na-akpata nchegbu nke ukwuu n'ihi ịdọ aka ná ntị na nso nso a na ike mmiri Germany na-ebelata.
rows.reference: Nsogbu jidere frigate ọhụrụ ndị ahụ pụbara oke mkpa n’ihi ịdọ aka ntị emere n’oge adịghị anya na ike Ndị Agha Mmiri nke Germany na-ebeleta.

rows.source: Earlier this year, Hans-Peter Bartels, chief of the German parliament's defense committee, acknowledged the Navy is actually "running out of deployment-capable ships."
rows.output: N'oge gara aga n'afọ a, Hans-Peter Bartels, onye isi ndị otu ndị omeiwu nchekwa nke Jamanị, kwetara na ụgbọ mmiri ndị agha mmiri na-achọ "na-agba ọsọ n'ụgbọ mmiri ndị nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ."
rows.reference: Na mbido afọ a, Hans-Peter Bartels, onye isi ọgbakọ nchekwa ndị ọmebe iwu nke Germany, kwuputara na n’ezie Ndị Agha Mmiri “enwezughịzi ụgbọ mmiri enwere ike zipu n’ọrụ.”

rows.source: The official said the issue has snowballed over time, because old ships were decommissioned but no replacement vessels were provided.
rows.output: Onye isi ahụ kwuru na okwu a abawanyela n’oge, n’ihi na a kwụsịrị ụgbọ mmiri ochie, na-enweghịkwa ụgbọ mmiri ndị ọzọ dochie ha.
rows.reference: Onye ọrụ ahụ kwuru na okwu ahụ abawanyela ọsọọsọ ka n’oge na-aga, n’ihi na ewepụrụ ụgbọ mmiri ndị ochie n’ọrụ mana enweghị ụgbọ ewepụtara iji nọchie ha.

rows.source: He lamented that none of the of the Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates were able to join the Navy.
rows.output: O kwuputara na ọ nweghị nke nke Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigates nwere ike isonyere ndị agha mmiri.
rows.reference: O bekuru mbeku na ọ nweghị Baden-Wuerttemberg-class frigate nke nwere ike isonye Ndị Agha Mmiri.

rows.source: National Trust eavesdrops on secret life of bats
rows.output: Ndị National Trust na-ekiri ndụ nzuzo nke bats
rows.reference: National Trust tinyere ntị na ndụ nzuzo nke ụsụ

rows.source: New research being carried out at an estate in the Scottish Highlands aims to reveal how bats use the landscape in their hunt for food.
rows.output: Nnyocha ọhụrụ na-eme na ala dị n'Ugwu Scotland na-achọ ịkọwa ka ụmụ oke si eji ala na-achọ nri.
rows.reference: Nyocha ọhụrụ a an-eme n’otu ogige dị na Scottish Highlands chọrọ igosipụta otu ụsụ siri eji gburgburu ahụ akpa nri.

rows.source: It is hoped the findings will shed new light on the behaviour of the unique flying mammals and help guide future conservation activities.
rows.output: Enwere olile anya na ihe ndị a ga-akpọ ìhè ọhụrụ n'ihe banyere àgwà nke ndị na-efe efe pụrụ iche ma nyere aka duzie ọrụ nchekwa n'ọdịnihu.
rows.reference: A na-atụ anya na nchọpụta ahụ ga-agbakwasa ihie na omume ụmụ-anụmanụ a na-anụ ara pụrụ iche were nyere aka n’ihazi ọrụ nchekwa ọdịnihu.

rows.source: The study by scientists at the National Trust for Scotland will follow common and soprano pipistrelles as well as brown long-eared and Daubenton bats at Inverewe Gardens in Wester Ross.
rows.output: Nnyocha nke ndị ọkà mmụta sayensị na National Trust for Scotland ga-eso ụdị pipistrelle a na-ahụkarị na soprano, yana ndị bat brown long-eared na Daubenton na Inverewe Gardens na Wester Ross.
rows.reference: Mmụta ahụ ndị nyocha sayensị National Trust for Scotland na-eme ga-esoro ụsụ pipistrelles ama ama na soprano pipistrelles yana brown long-eared na Daubenton na Inverewe Gardens dị na Wester Ross.

rows.source: Special recorders will be placed at key locations around the property to track bat activities throughout the season.
rows.output: A ga-ewepụta ndekọ pụrụ iche n'ebe dị mkpa gburugburu ihe onwunwe ahụ iji soro ọrụ nke anụ ọhịa bat n'oge oge.
rows.reference: A ga-edebe igwe ndekọ pụrụ iche n’akụkụ ebe dị mkpa n’okirikiri ogige ahụ iji sochie omume ụsụ ndị a n’ime oge niile.

rows.source: NHS staff and volunteers will also carry out mobile surveys using hand-held detectors.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ na ndị otu afọ ofufo NHS ga-eme nyocha ndị na-aga ebe ahụ na-eji ndị na-achọpụta aka.
rows.reference: Ndị ọrụ NHS na ndị wepụtara onwe ha ga-emekwa nyocha mkpagharị site na n’iji igwe nchọpụta a na-eji n’aka.

rows.source: Expert sound analysis of all recordings will ascertain the frequency of the bat calls and which species are doing what.
rows.output: Nnyocha nke ọma nke ụda nke ihe ndekọ niile ga-ekpebi ugboro nke oku bat na ụdị ndị na-eme ihe dị iche iche.
rows.reference: Nyocha ụda nke ọkammara nke ndekọ niile ga-egosi ugboro ole ụsụ n’akpọ oku na ihe ụdị nke ọ bụla na-eme.

rows.source: A habitat map and report will then be produced to create a detailed landscape-scale picture of their behaviour.
rows.output: Maapụ ebe obibi na akụkọ ga-esi na ya pụta iji mepụta ihe oyiyi zuru ezu, nke nwere nnukwu ala nke omume ha.
rows.reference: A ga-emepụta mapụ ebe obibi na ndekọba iji mebe ihe eserese gburugburu nke omume ha n’uju.

rows.source: Rob Dewar, nature conservation adviser for NTS, hopes the results will reveal which areas of habitat are most important to the bats and how they are used by each of the species.
rows.output: Rob Dewar, onye ndụmọdụ nchekwa okike maka NTS, na-atụ anya na nsonaazụ ga-ekpughe ebe ndị dị mkpa nke ebe obibi maka ndị bat na otu esi eji ha eme ihe site n'aka ụdị ọ bụla.
rows.reference: Rob Dewar, onye ndụmọdụ banyere nchekwa ekereụwa maka NTS, nwere olile anya na nsonazụ ndị a ga-egosi akụkụ ebe obibi ahụ kacha dị ụsụ mkpa na ka ụdị nke ọ bụla si eji ya eme ihe.

rows.source: This information will help determine the benefits of habitat management work such as meadow creation and how best to maintain woodlands for bats and other associated species.
rows.output: Nke a ga-enyere aka ikpebi uru ọrụ njikwa ebe obibi dị ka imepụta ubi na otu esi edobe ọhịa maka ụmụ oke na ụdị ndị ọzọ metụtara ya.
rows.reference: Ozi nke a ga-enyere aka ime mkpebi n’uru ọrụ njikwa ebe obibi dị ka mmepụta ala ahịhịa yana otu kacha mma iji chekwaa ala osisi maka ụsụ na ụdị ndị ọzọ metụtara ha.

rows.source: Bat populations in Scotland and across the UK have declined considerably over the past century.
rows.output: Ndị bat na Scotland na n'ofe UK agbadala nke ukwuu n'ime narị afọ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ ụsụ na Scotland yana UK agbadaala nke ukwuu n’ime afọ iri gara aga.

rows.source: They are under threat from building and development work that affects roosts and loss of habitat.
rows.output: Ha na-eyi egwu site n'iwu ụlọ na ọrụ mmepe nke na-emetụta ebe a na-ehi ụra na ọnwụ ebe obibi.
rows.reference: Ha nọ n’ihe iyi egwu sitere na ọrụ ịrụ ụlọ na mmepe nke na-emetụta ebe ụra na ofufu ebe obibi.

rows.source: Wind turbines and lighting can also pose a risk, as can flypapers and some chemical treatments of building materials, as well as attacks by pet cats.
rows.output: Igbo: A na-enwekwa ihe ize ndụ site na igwe ikuku na ọkụ, dị ka nke flypapers na ụfọdụ kemịkalụ na-achịkwa ihe owuwu, yana mwakpo nke nwamba nkeonwe.
rows.reference: Turbine Ikuku na inye ihie nwere ike ibute ihe ize ndụ, yana flypaper na ụfọdụ kemikal nchekwa ngwaọrụ eji arụ ụlọ, yana kwa mbuso agha sitere na nwamba na-ebi n’ụlọ.

rows.source: Bats are not actually blind.
rows.output: Ndị nnụnụ abụghị ndị na-adịghị ahụ anya n'ezie.
rows.reference: N’ezie ụsụ ekpughị isi.

rows.source: However, due to their nocturnal hunting habits their ears are more useful than their eyes when it comes to catching prey.
rows.output: Ọbụna, n'ihi àgwà ha na-achụ nta n'abalị, ntị ha bara uru karịa anya ha mgbe ọ na-abịa n'ịkụ azụ.
rows.reference: Kosiladị, n’ihi omume ịkpa nri n’abalị, ntị ha dị mkpa karịa anya ha mgbe oruru n’inwude anụ oriri.

rows.source: They use a sophisticated echo-location technique to pinpoint bugs and obstacles in their flight path.
rows.output: Ha na-eji usoro ịchọta ebe dị mgbagwoju anya chọpụta ahụhụ na ihe mgbochi n'ụzọ ha.
rows.reference: Ha na-eji usoro nchọpụta ndaghachi ụda were nweta ahụhụ na ihe mgbachi dị n’ụzọ ofufe ha.

rows.source: The NTS, which is responsible for the care of more than 270 historical buildings, 38 important gardens and 76,000 hectares of land around the country, takes bats very seriously.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ NTS, nke na-ahụ maka nlekọta ihe karịrị ụlọ akụkọ ihe mere eme 270, ogige ndị dị mkpa 38, na hectare 76,000 nke ala gburugburu obodo ahụ, na-ewere ụmụ oke n'obi.
rows.reference: NTS, bụ ndị ọ dị n’aka ilekọta ihe karịrị ụlọ ochie 270, ubi 38 dị mkpa na hectare ala 76,000 n’okirikiri obodo, kpọrọ ụsụ oke mkpa.

rows.source: It has ten trained experts, who regularly carry out surveys, roost inspections and sometimes rescues.
rows.output: O nwere ndị ọkachamara iri nwere ọzụzụ, ndị na-eme nyocha mgbe nile, nyocha n'ụlọ, na mgbe ụfọdụ, ha na-azọpụta.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere ndị ọkammara iri azụrụ azụ bụ ndị na-eme nyocha kwa mgbe, na-enyocha ebe ụra ma mee nzọpụta mgbe ụfọdụ.

rows.source: The organisation has even set up Scotland's first and only dedicated bat reserve at Threave estate in Dumfries and Galloway, which is home to eight of Scotland's ten bat species.
rows.output: Otu a haziri ahaziri ahazi nke Scotland naanị na ebe nchekwa bat na Threave estate na Dumfries na Galloway, bụ nke nwere ụdị bat iri n'ime ụdị bat iri nke Scotland.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ edobela ebe pụrụ iche na Scotland izizi ewepụtara maka ụsụ n’ogige Threave dị na Dumfries na Galloway, bụ be ụdị ụsụ asatọ n’ime iri enwere na Scotland bi.

rows.source: Estate manager David Thompson says the estate is the ideal territory for them.
rows.output: Onye njikwa ụlọ David Thompson na-ekwu na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ bụ ógbè kacha mma maka ha.
rows.reference: Onye njikwa ogige ahụ David Thompson kwuru na ogige ahụ bụ ebe kacha mma maka ha.

rows.source: "Here at Threave we have a great area for bats," he said.
rows.output: "N'ime Threave, anyị nwere ebe dị mma maka bats," o kwuru.
rows.reference: “Na Threaves ebe a, anyị nwere akụkụ mara mma maka ụsụ,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "We've got the old buildings, lots of veteran trees and all the good habitat.
rows.output: Anyị nwere ụlọ ndị ochie, ọtụtụ osisi ndị agha na ebe obibi niile dị mma.
rows.reference: “Anyị nwere ụlọ ochie, osisi kagoro nka na ebe obibi niile dị mma.

rows.source: But there is much about bats that is still unknown, so the work we do here and at other properties will help us understand more about what they need to thrive."
rows.output: Ma a na-amakarị banyere ụmụ oke, yabụ na ọrụ anyị na-eme ebe a na n'ụlọ ndị ọzọ ga-enyere anyị aka ịghọta nke ọma ihe ha chọrọ iji nwee ọganihu."
rows.reference: Mana a ka nwere ọtụtụ ihe gbasara ụsụ amatabeghị, ya mere na ọrụ anyị na-arụ ebe a yana n’ogige ụlọ ndị ọzọ ga-enyere anyị aka ịghọta karịa banyere ihe ha chọrọ iji n’ebi nke ọma.”

rows.source: He stresses the importance of checking for bats before carrying out maintenance within properties as it is possible unwitting destruction of a single maternity roost could kill up to 400 females and young, possibly wiping out an entire local population.

rows.output: Onye ọkpọ Portugal na Juventus chere ebubo na o rata otu nwanyị America, aha ya bụ Kathryn Mayorga, n'ime ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na Las Vegas n'afọ 2009.

rows.source: Ronaldo's lawyers are preparing to sue Der Spiegel over the allegations, which they have called "an inadmissible reporting of suspicions in the area of privacy," according to Reuters.
rows.output: Ndị ọkaiwu Ronaldo na-akwado ịgba akwụkwọ megide Der Spiegel maka ebubo ndị a, nke ha kpọrọ "akụkọ na-enweghị ikike banyere nchegbu na mpaghara nzuzo," dịka Reuters siri kwuo.
rows.reference: Ndị ọka iwu Ronaldo na-akwadobe ịgba Der Spiegel akwụkwọ n’ihi ebubo ahụ, bụ nke ha kpọrọ “akụkọ agaghị anabata maka nyocha banyere ndụ nzuzo,” dabere na Reuters.

rows.source: Lawyer Christian Schertz said the player would seek compensation for "moral damages in an amount corresponding to the gravity of the infringement, which is probably one of the most serious violations of personal rights in recent years."
rows.output: Onye ọka iwu Christian Schertz kwuru na onye ọkpụkpọ ahụ ga-achọ "mgbaghara maka mmebi nke mmụọ n'ọnụ ọgụgụ na-egosi oke mmebi ahụ, nke bụ otu n'ime mmebi nke ikike onwe onye kacha njọ n'ime afọ ndị na-adịbeghị anya."
rows.reference: Onye ọka iwu Christian Schertz kwuru na onye egwuregwu ahụ ga-anara ego iti aka n’obi maka “ mmebi ụkpụrụ n’ọnụego dabara n’ihe emebiri, bụ eleghị anya otu n’ime ịda iwu kachasị nke ikike nkeonwe n’afọ adịghị anya.”

rows.source: The alleged incident is said to have taken place in June 2009 at a suite at the Palms Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas.
rows.output: Ihe a na-ebo ebubo na-ekwu na ọ dị na June 2009 n'otu ụlọ ọrụ dị n'otu ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ Palms na Las Vegas.
rows.reference: Ekwuru na ihe ebubo ahụ mere na Juun 2009 n’ime ụlọ Palms Hotel and Casino dị na Las Vegas.

rows.source: After meeting in a nightclub, Ronaldo and Mayorga reportedly went back to the player's room, where he allegedly anally raped her, according to papers filed at Clark County District Court in Nevada.
rows.output: Mgbe ha zutere n'otu ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ, a na-ekwu na Ronaldo na Mayorga laghachiri n'ọnụ ụlọ onye ọkpụkpọ ahụ, ebe a na-ebo ya ebubo na ọ tara ya n'azụ, dịka akwụkwọ ndị e debere n'ụlọikpe Clark County dị na Nevada.
rows.reference: Ka ha zutechara n’ụlọ ịgba egwu, Ronaldo na Mayorga laghachiri azụ n’ime ụlọ onye egwuregwu ahụ, ebe ọ dakporo ya n’ike site na ike, dabere na akwụkwọ agbara na Clark County District Court dị na Nevada.

rows.source: Mayorga claims Ronaldo fell to his knees after the alleged incident and told her he was "99 percent" a "good guy" let down by the "one percent."
rows.output: Mayorga na-ekwu na Ronaldo dara n'ikpere ya mgbe ihe a na-ebo ebubo mere, ma gwa ya na ya "99 pasent" bụ "onye dị mma" merụrụ ahụ site na "otu pasent."
rows.reference: Mayorga kwuputara na Ronaldo mere nsekpu ala ka ọ mechara ihe ebubo ahụ were gwa ya na ọ bụ “pesentị 99” “ezigbo mmadụ” “ otu pesentị mechuru ihu.”

rows.source: The documents claim that Ronaldo confirmed the pair had sex, but that it was consensual.
rows.output: akwụkwọ ndị ahụ na-ekwu na Ronaldo kwadoro na di na nwunye ahụ nwere mmekọahụ, mana na ọ bụ nke a nabatara.
rows.reference: Akwụkwọ ahụ na-ekwuputa na Ronaldo kwenyere na ha nwere mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị mana onye ọ bụla kwenyere.

rows.source: Mayorga also claims she went to the police and had photographs taken of her injuries at a hospital, but later agreed to an out-of-court settlement because she felt "terrified of retaliation" and was worried about "being publicly humiliated."
rows.output: Mgbe ahụ, Mayorga kwuru na ya gara n'ụlọ ọrụ ndị uwe ojii wee mee foto mmerụ ahụ ya n'ụlọ ọgwụ, ma mesịa kweta n'ụlọ ikpe n'èzí ụlọ ikpe n'ihi na ọ na-atụ egwu "ịbọ ọbọ" ma na-echegbu onwe ya maka "ịkpasu iwe n'ihu ọha."
rows.reference: Mayorga kwuputakwara na ya gara na ndị uwe ojii na esetere foto mmerụ ahụ ya n’ụlọ ọgwụ, mana emechara ya kwenye ikpebi n’agaghị ụlọ ikpe n’ihi “n’ujo mmegwara tụrụ ya” na “echiche chebere ya maka imebọ ya n’ọhaeze.”

rows.source: The 34-year-old says she is now seeking to overturn the settlement as she continues to be traumatized by the alleged incident.
rows.output: Onye dị afọ 34 na-ekwu na ọ na-achọ ugbu a ịtụgharị nkwekọrịta ahụ ka ọ na-aga n'ihu na-ata ahụhụ n'ihi ihe a na-ebo ebubo.
rows.reference: Nwata nwanyị a gbara afọ 34 kwuru na ya-chọrọ ka atụgharịa mkpezi ahụ ebe ọ ka na-enwe ihe mgbu sitere n’ihe ebubo ahụ.

rows.source: Ronaldo was on the verge of joining Real Madrid from Manchester United at the time of the alleged assault, and this summer moved to Italian giants Juve in a €100 million deal.
rows.output: Ronaldo nọ n'ọnụ ọnụ ịbanye na Real Madrid n'aka Manchester United n'oge ebubo mwakpo a, o mekwara gaa na ndị Juu na-achị achị n'oge okpomọkụ a na nkwekọrịta nde €100.
rows.reference: Ronaldo na-achọ ka ọ banye Real Madrid site na Manchester United oge ndakpo ahụ mere, na n’oge okpomọkụ a, ọ gara nnukwu otu Italy, Juve na nkwekọrịta nde €100.

rows.source: Brexit: UK 'would forever regret' losing carmakers
rows.output: Brexit: UK "ga-echeta mgbe nile" maka ịla n'iyi ndị na-eme ụgbọ ala
rows.reference: Brexit: UK “ga na-enwe nwute dịrị gaba ma ndị na-arụ ụgbọ ala funari ha

rows.source: The UK "would regret it forever" if it lost its status as a world leader in car manufacturing after Brexit, Business Secretary Greg Clark has said.
rows.output:
Ọ dị mma, nke a bụ ntụgharị asụsụ Igbo maka ederede bekee e nyere: 

Ọ bụrụ na UK "ga-akwa ụta ruo mgbe ebighị ebi" ma ọ bụrụ na ọ tufuru ọkwa ya dị ka onye ndu ụwa na-emepụta ụgbọ ala mgbe Brexit gasịrị, Onye na-ahụ maka azụmahịa Greg Clark kwuru.
rows.reference: UK “ga-enwe nwute dịịrị gaba” ma ọ bụrụ na o tufuo ọkwa ya dị ka onye ọchịchị n’ịrụpụta ụgbọ ala n’ụwa ma Brexit gachaa, Ọde Akwụkwọ Azụmahịa Greg Clark kwuru.

rows.source: He added it was "concerning" that Toyota UK had told the BBC that if Britain left the EU without a deal it would temporarily halt production at its factory in Burnaston, near Derby.
rows.output: Ọ gbakwụnyere na ọ bụ "ihe na-echegbu onwe ya" na Toyota UK gwara BBC na ọ bụrụ na Britain hapụrụ EU na-enweghị nkwekọrịta, na ọ ga-akwụsị mmepụta nwa oge na ụlọ ọrụ ya dị na Burnaston, nso Derby.
rows.reference: Ọ gbakwunyere na ọ bụ ihe “na-atụ uche” na Toyota UK gwara BBC na ọ bụrụ na Britain apụọ na EU na-enweghị nkwekọrịta, na ha ga-akwụsị nwa oge ịrụpụta ihe n’ụlọ nrụpụta dị na Burnaston, n’akụkụ Derby.

rows.source: "We need a deal," Mr Clark said.
rows.output: Anyị chọrọ nkwekọrịta," Mazị Clark kwuru.
rows.reference: “Anyị chọrọ nkwekọrịta,” Mr Clark kwuru.

rows.source: The Japanese carmaker said the impact of border delays in the event of a no-deal Brexit could cost jobs.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ụgbọ ala Japan kwuru na mmetụta nke igbu oge ókè-ala n'ọnọdụ Brexit na-enweghị nkwekọrịta nwere ike ịkpata ọrụ efu.
rows.reference: Onye ọrụ ụgbọ ala nke Japan ahụ kwuru na ndapụta nke igbu oge n’oke ala ma ọ bụrụ na enweghị nkwekọrịta Brexit nwere ike napụ ọrụ.

rows.source: The Burnaston plant - which makes Toyota's Auris and Avensis - produced nearly 150,000 cars last year of which 90% were exported to the rest of the European Union.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ Burnaston - nke na-eme Toyota's Auris na Avensis - mere ihe dị ka 150,000 ụgbọ ala n'afọ gara aga nke 90% n'ime ha ebugara ndị ọzọ nke European Union.
rows.reference: Ụlọ nrụpụta nke Burnaston - bụ nke na-arụpụta Toyota Auris na Avensis - rụpụtara ihe ruru ụgbọ ala 150,000 n’afọ gara aga nke ebupuru 90% ya na mba European Union ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: "My view is that if Britain crashes out of the EU at the end of March we will see production stops in our factory," said Marvin Cooke, Toyota's managing director at Burnaston.
rows.output: "Ọhụụ m bụ na ọ bụrụ na Britain dara n'ime EU na njedebe nke March, anyị ga-ahụ nkwụsị nke mmepụta na ụlọ ọrụ anyị," ka Marvin Cooke, onye isi njikwa Toyota na Burnaston kwuru.
rows.reference: “Echiche m bụ na ọ bụrụ na Britain apụọ na EU na ngwucha Maachị, anyị ga-ahụ na nrụpụta kwụsịrị n’ụlọ nrụpụta anyị” Marvin Cooke onye isi njikwa Toyota na Burnaston kwuru.

rows.source: Other UK car manufacturers have raised fears about leaving the EU without agreement on how cross-border trade will function, including Honda, BMW and Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.output: Ndị na-emepụta ụgbọ ala UK ndị ọzọ ekwupụtala nchegbu banyere ịpụ na EU na-enweghị nkwekọrịta banyere otu esi eme ahia oke ala, gụnyere Honda, BMW na Jaguar Land Rover.
rows.reference: Ndị ọzọ na-arụpụta ụgbọ ala na UK na-atụ egwu banyere ịhapụ EU na-enweghị nkwekọrịta ka azụmahịa na-agafe oke ala ga-esi rụọ ọrụ, tinyere Honda, BMW na Jaguar Land Rover.

rows.source: BMW, for example, says it will close its Mini plant in Oxford for a month following Brexit.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ị ga-eme ihe atụ, BMW na-ekwu na ọ ga-emechi ụlọ ọrụ Mini ya na Oxford maka otu ọnwa n'ihi Brexit.
rows.reference: BMW, maka ọmụmatụ, kwuru na ya ga-emechi Obere ụlọ nrụpụta ya dị na Oxford maka otu ọnwa ma emechaa Brexit.

rows.source: The main concerns relate to what carmakers say are supply chain risks in the event of a no-deal Brexit.
rows.output: Isi ihe na-echegbu onwe ha bụ ihe ndị na-eme ụgbọ ala na-ekwu na ihe ize ndụ nke eriri nri n'ọnọdụ Brexit na-enweghị nkwekọrịta.
rows.reference: Mkpatụta kacha gbasara ihe ndị na-arụ ụgbọ ala kwuru bụ n’ihe egwu mbunye ahịa ma ọ bụrụ na enwetaghị nkwekọrịta.

rows.source: Toyota's production line is run on a "just-in-time" basis, with parts arriving every 37 minutes from suppliers in both the UK and the EU for cars made to order.
rows.output: N'ahịrị ụlọ ọrụ Toyota, a na-arụ ọrụ na "naanị n'oge", ebe akụkụ na-abata kwa nkeji iri atọ na asaa site n'aka ndị na-eweta ya na UK na EU maka ụgbọ ala ndị a na-eme n'usoro iwu.
rows.reference: A na-eme nrụpụta na Toyota n’ahiri usoro “ọ bịa ozugbo”, ebe akụkụ ụgbọ ala na-eji nkeji 37 nwere esi n’aka ndị mbunye ahịa abịa, ma UK na EU maka ụgbọ ala atụrụ ahịa ya.

rows.source: If the UK leaves the EU without a deal on 29 March, there could be disruption at the border which the industry says could lead to delays and shortages of parts.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na UK hapụ EU na-enweghị nkwekọrịta na 29 Maachị, enwere ike ịnwe nsogbu na ókèala nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ na-ekwu na ọ nwere ike ibute igbu oge na enweghị akụkụ.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na UK ahapụ EU n’enwetaghị nkwekọrịta na Maachị 29, enwere ike inwe ọgbaghara n’oke ala bụ nke ụlọ nrụpụta kwuru na ọ nwere ike bute igbu oge yana ezughị ezu akụkụ ụgbọ ala.

rows.source: It would be impossible for Toyota to hold more than a day's worth of inventory at its Derbyshire plant, the company said, and so production would be stopped.
rows.output: Ọ ga-abụ ihe na-agaghị ekwe omume maka Toyota ịnọgide na-echekwa ngwaahịa maka otu ụbọchị n'ọrụ ha na Derbyshire, ụlọ ọrụ ahụ kwuru, ya mere, mmepụta ga-akwụsị.
rows.reference: Ọ gaghị ekwe omume na Toyota ga-ahapụ ngwaahịa  karịrị nke otu ụbọchị n’ụlọ nrụpụta ha dị na Derbyshire, ụlọ ọrụ ahụ kwuru, yamere na nrụpụta ga-akwụsị.

rows.source: Mr Clark said Theresa May's Chequers plan for future relations with the EU is "precisely calibrated to avoid those checks at the border."
rows.output: Ọkàikpe Clark kwuru na atụmatụ Chequers nke Theresa May maka mmekọrịta n'ọdịnihu na EU "dị n'ụdị kpọmkwem iji zere nyocha na ókè."
rows.reference: Mr Clark kwuru na atụmatụ Chequers nke Theresa May maka mmekọrịta ha na EU n’ọdịnihu bụ “nke emebere ka ọ zenarị nyocha niile ahụ n’oke ala.”

rows.source: "We need to have a deal. We want to have the best deal that will allow as I say not just the success at present to be enjoyed but for us to grasp this opportunity," he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.
rows.output: Anyị chọrọ inwe nkwekọrịta. Anyị chọrọ inwe nkwekọrịta kacha mma nke ga-ekwe ka, dị ka m na-ekwu, ọ bụghị naanị ihe ịga nke ọma ugbu a ka a ga-anụ ụtọ, kama ka anyị jide ohere a."
rows.reference: “Anyị chọrọ inwe nkwekọrịta.   Anyị chọrọ inwe nkwekọrịta kacha mma ga-enye anyị oghere dịka m na-ekwu, nke abụghị naanị inweta ọganihu ugbu a ma ka anyị jidekwa oghere a,” ọ gwara ihe mmemme BBC Radio 4 Today.

rows.source: "The evidence from not just Toyota but other manufacturers is that we need to absolutely be able to continue what has been a highly successful set of supply chains."
rows.output: "Ihe akaebe sitere na ọ bụghị naanị Toyota kamakwa ndị nrụpụta ndị ọzọ na-egosi na anyị chọrọ ịnọgide na-enwe usoro nnyefe nke na-aga nke ọma nke ukwuu."
rows.reference: “Akaebe sitere n’abụghị naanị Toyota ma ndị ọzọ na-eme nrụpụta bụ na ekwesịrị ịga n’ihu soro usoro mbunye ahịa nke na-aga nke ọma kpamkpam.”

rows.source: Toyota was unable to say how long production would be stopped, but in the longer term, warned that added costs would reduce the plant's competitiveness and eventually cost jobs.
rows.output: Ejighị Toyota ike ikwu ogologo oge mmepụta ga-akwụsị, mana n'oge dị ogologo, ọ dọrọ aka ná ntị na ego ndị ọzọ ga-ebelata asọmpi ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ma n'ikpeazụ, ọ ga-efu ọrụ.
rows.reference: Toyota enweghị ike ikwu ogologo oge ole a ga-akwụsị ime nrụpụta, mana n’ote aka, ha na-adọ aka na ntị mgbakwunye ọnụego ga-ebelata ike asompi ya na emechaa a ga-anapụ ọrụ.

rows.source: Peter Tsouvallaris, who has worked at Burnaston for 24 years and is the Unite union convenor at the plant, said his members are increasingly concerned: "In my experience once these jobs go they never come back.
rows.output: Pita Tsouvallaris, onye rụrụ ọrụ na Burnaston afọ iri abụọ na anọ ma bụrụ onye isi otu ndị ọrụ na-ahụ maka ụlọ ọrụ, kwuru na ndị otu ya na-echegbu onwe ha nke ukwuu: "N'ahụmahụ m, ozugbo efunahụ ọrụ ndị a, ha na-alọghachi.
rows.reference: Peter Tsouvallaris, bụ onye rụgoro ọrụ na Burnaston afọ 24, bụrụkwa onye nchịkọba otu ndị ọrụ n’ụlọ nrụpụta ahụ, kwuru na ndị otu ya na-atụ uche nke ukwuu: “N’ahụmihe m, ozugbo ọrụ ndị a lara, ha anaghị alaghachi azụ.

rows.source: A government spokesperson said: "We have put forward a precise and credible plan for our future relationship with the EU."
rows.output: Onye na-ekwuchitere gọọmentị kwuru: "Anyị ewepụtala atụmatụ kpọmkwem na nke a pụrụ ịdabere na ya maka mmekọrịta anyị n'ọdịnihu na EU."
rows.reference: Otu onye nkwuchite okwu gọọmentị kwuru:  “Anyị eweputala atụmatụ doro anya were ntụkwasị obi maka mmekọrịta anyị na EU n’ọdịnihu.

rows.source: Trump meeting with Rosenstein may be delayed again, says White House
rows.output: Mgbakọ Trump na nkeji nkeji nwere ike ịkwụsị ọzọ, na-ekwu White House
rows.reference: Enwere ike budaa oge nzụkọ Trump na Rosenstein ọzọ, White House kwuru

rows.source: Donald Trump's high-stakes meeting with deputy attorney general Rod Rosenstein could be "pushed back another week" as the fight over supreme court nominee Brett Kavanaugh continues, the White House said on Sunday.
rows.output: N'ime nzukọ dị elu nke Donald Trump na osote onye ọka iwu Rod Rosenstein nwere ike "ịkwaga ọzọ izu" ka a na-alụ ọgụ maka onye a họpụtara na ụlọikpe kacha elu Brett Kavanaugh, White House kwuru na Sunday.
rows.reference: Enwere ike ibuda nzụkọ ahụ dị oke mkpa nke Donald Trump na osote onye isi ọka ikpe Rod Rosenstein nwere “izu ọzọ na-abịa” ebe mgba maka onye nhọpụta ụlọ ikpe kachasị elu Brett Kavanaugh na-aga n’ihu, White House kwuru na Sọnde.

rows.source: Rosenstein oversees the work of special counsel Robert Mueller, who is investigating Russian election interference, links between Trump aides and Russia and potential obstruction of justice by the president.
rows.output: Ọrụ nke onye ọka iwu pụrụ iche Robert Mueller, onye na-enyocha mmetụta Russia na ntuli aka, njikọ dị n'etiti ndị enyemaka Trump na Russia na ikekwe igbochi ikpe ziri ezi nke onyeisiala.
rows.reference: Rosenstein na-ahụ maka ọrụ pụrụ iche Robert Mueller bụ onye na-eme nyocha ntinye aka ndị Russia na ntuli aka, njikọ dị n’etiti ndị inyeaka Trump na Russia yana mgbachi nke inweta ikpe nkwumọtọ sitere na onye isi ala.

rows.source: Whether or not Trump will fire the deputy attorney general, and thereby endanger Mueller's independence, has fuelled Washington gossip for months.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ na Trump ga-achụpụ onye ọka iwu nke abụọ, na n'ụzọ ahụ na-etinye ihe ize ndụ na nnwere onwe nke Mueller, ọ na-akwado mkparịta ụka Washington kemgbe ọtụtụ ọnwa.
rows.reference: Ma Trump a ga-achụ ka ọ ga-ahapụ osote onye isi ọka ikpe ahụ, n’ihi ya tinye nnwere onwe Mueller n’ihe egwu, mụnyere ọkụ na asịrị Washington n’ọtụtụ ọnwa.

rows.source: Earlier this month, the New York Times reported that Rosenstein discussed wearing a wire to record conversations with Trump and the possibility of removing the president via the 25th amendment.
rows.output: N'ọnwa gara aga, New York Times kọrọ na ọ rịọrọ ka e tinye eriri ndekọ mkparịta ụka ya na Trump na ihe gbasara iwepụ onyeisiala site n'usoro nke 25.
rows.reference: Na mbido ọnwa a, New York Times kwuputara na Rosenstein kwuru maka iyi eriri okwu iji dekọba nrụrịta ụka Trump na iwepu onye isi ala site n’ụzọ mmegharị 25th.

rows.source: Rosenstein denied the report.
rows.output: Rosenstein gọnarịrị akụkọ ahụ.
rows.reference: Rosenstein gọnarịrị akụkọ a.

rows.source: But last Monday he went to the White House, amid reports he was about to resign.
rows.output: Ma n'izu gara aga, ọ gara n'ụlọ onye isi ala, n'etiti akụkọ na ọ na-achọ ịgba arụkwaghịm.
rows.reference: Mana Mọnde gara aga ọ gara na White House, n’etiti mkpesa na ọ chọrọ irutu.

rows.source: Instead, a meeting with Trump, who was then at the United Nations in New York, was announced for Thursday.
rows.output: N'ezie, e kwuputara nzukọ na Trump, onye nọ na United Nations na New York, maka Tọzdee.
rows.reference: Kama, ekwuputere nzụkọ n’etiti Trump, onye nke nọ na United Nations na New York maka Tọsde.

rows.source: Trump said he would "prefer not" to fire Rosenstein but then the meeting was delayed to avoid a clash with the Senate judiciary committee hearing in which Kavanaugh and one of the women who have accused him of sexual misconduct, Dr Christine Blasey Ford, both testified.
rows.output: Ọchịchị Trump kwuru na ya "ga-amasị ya ka ọ ghara" ịchụpụ (Rosenstein) mana emesịa, nzukọ ahụ kwụsịrị iji zere esemokwu na ọgbakọ ndị omebe iwu Sineti ebe (Kavanaugh) na otu n'ime ụmụ nwanyị ndị na-ekwu na ya na-eme ihe ọjọọ, Dr. Christine Blasey Ford, kwuru okwu.
rows.reference: Trump kwuru na “ọ gaghị amasị” ya ịchụ Rosentein mana mgbe ahụ egbuturu oge nzụkọ ahụ iji zere ịkụkọta n’ọnụnụ ọgbakọ ndị ọkaikpe Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu nke Kavanaugh na otu n’ime ụmụ nwanyị ndị boro ya ebubo nke omume arụrụ ala, Dk Christine Blasey Ford, ha abụọ nyere akaebe.

rows.source: On Friday, Trump ordered a one-week FBI investigation of claims against Kavanaugh, further delaying a full Senate vote.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Fraịde, Trump nyere iwu nyocha FBI nke otu izu banyere ebubo eboro Kavanaugh, na-eme ka a kwụsị ibu ụzọ họpụta ya n'ụlọomeiwu sineti.
rows.reference: Na Fraịde, Trump tiri iwu nke nyocha FBI n’otu-izu maka ebubo chere Kavanaugh, nke gbukwuru oge nke ntuli aka Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu n’uju.

rows.source: Trump's press secretary, Sarah Sanders, appeared on Fox News Sunday.
rows.output: Onye odeakwụkwọ mgbasa ozi Trump, Sarah Sanders, pụtara na Fox News Sunday.
rows.reference: Ọdee Akwụkwọ mgbasa ozi nke Trump, Sarah Sanders, pụtara na Fox News na Sọnde.

rows.source: Asked about the Rosenstein meeting, she said: "A date for that hasn't been set, it could be this week, I could see that pushing back another week given all of the other things that are going on with the supreme court.
rows.output: N'ajụjụ gbasara nzukọ ahụ nke Rosenstein, o kwuru: "Ụbọchị maka nke ahụ emebeghị, ọ nwere ike ịbụ n'izu a, enwere m ike ịhụ nke ahụ na-eme ka ọ bụrụ izu ọzọ nyere ihe niile na-eme na ụlọikpe kacha elu."
rows.reference: Ajụrụ ya maka nzụkọ Rosentein, o kwuru: “Atọọla ụbọchị maka nke ahụ, ọ nwere ike ịbụ n’izu na abịa, m na ahụ ka nke ahụ laghachiri otu izu n’ihi ihe niile na eme ugbu a na ụlọ ikpe kachasị n’obodo.

rows.source: But we'll see and I always like to keep the press updated."
rows.output: Ma anyị ga-ahụ, ma m na-amasị mgbe niile imelite ndị nta akụkọ."
rows.reference: Mana anyị ga-ahụ, ọ na amasị m oge niile ịme ka ndị mgbasa ozi mara ihe na eme ozugbo.”

rows.source: Some reporters would contest that assertion: Sanders has not held a White House press briefing since 10 September.
rows.output: Ụfọdụ ndị nta akụkọ ga-ama aka n'okwu a: Sanders akwadoghị nnọkọ ụlọ ọcha kemgbe 10 Septemba.
rows.reference: Ụfọdụ ndi nta akụkọ ga-adọkpụ ngozusike ahụ: Sanders emebeghị nchịkọta akụkọ nke White House kemgbe Septemba 10.

rows.source: Host Chris Wallace asked why.
rows.output: Onye ọbịa Chris Wallace jụrụ ihe kpatara ya.
rows.reference: Onye nlekọta Chris Wallace jụrụ ihe kpatara ya.

rows.source: Sanders said the scarcity of briefings was not due to a distaste for TV reporters "grandstanding," although she said: "I won't disagree with the fact that they grandstand."
rows.output: Otu onye isi ụlọ ọrụ Sanders kwuru na ụkọ nke nnọkọ ndị nta akụkọ abụghị n'ihi enweghị mmasị n'ebe ndị nta akụkọ TV na-eme "ịgba egwu," n'agbanyeghị na o kwuru, sị: "Agaghị m ekwenye na eziokwu na ha na-eme egwuregwu."
rows.reference: Sanders kwuru na ụkọ nchịkọta akụkọ bụ n’ihi nleda anya maka “nnukwu ọchụchọ nlebanye anya” nke ndị nta akụkọ TV,” agbanyeghi na o kwuru: “Agaghị m ekwenye n’ezie ha na ha na achọ oke nlebanye anya.”

rows.source: She then suggested direct contact between Trump and the press will increase.
rows.output: Mgbe ahụ, o kwuru na kọntaktị kpọmkwem n'etiti Trump na mgbasa ozi ga-abawanye.
rows.reference: Ọ tụnyere nkwukọrịta ozugbo n’etiti Trump na ndị mgbasa ozi ga-agbagote.

rows.source: "The president does more Q&A sessions than any president has prior to him," she said, adding without citing evidence: "We've looked at those numbers."
rows.output: Onye isi ala na-eme ọtụtụ oge ajụjụ na azịza karịa onye isi ala ọ bụla n'oge gara aga, ka o kwuru, na-ekwu na-enweghị ịkpọ aha ihe akaebe: "Anyị ewepụtala ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị ahụ."
rows.reference: “Onye isi ala na enwe oge njụrịkọta ajụjụ ọnụ karịa onye isi ala ọ bụla bịara tupu ya,” o kwuru, tinye na arụtụghị aka n’ihe akaebe: “Anyị elenyela anya na nọmba ndị a.”

rows.source: Briefings will still happen, Sanders said, but "if the press has the chance to ask the president of the United States questions directly, that's infinitely better than talking to me.
rows.output: Ụfọdụ ndị na-ekwu okwu ga-eme, Sanders kwuru, mana "ọ bụrụ na ndị nta akụkọ nwere ohere ịjụ onye isi ala United States ajụjụ ozugbo, nke ahụ ka mma karịa ikwu okwu na m."
rows.reference: Nchịkọta akụkọ ga na eme, Sanders kwuru, mana “ọ bụrụ na ndị mgbasa ozi nwee ohere ịjụ onye isi ala nke United States ajụjụ ozugbo, nke ahụ ka ịgwa m okwu mma karịa.

rows.source: We try to do that a lot and you've seen us do that a lot over the last few weeks and that's going to take the place of a press briefing when you can talk to the president of the United States."
rows.output: Anyị na-agbalị ime nke ahụ mgbe niile ma ị hụla anyị na-eme nke ahụ n’izu ole na ole gara aga na nke ahụ ga-ewere ọnọdụ nke nnọkọ ndị nta akụkọ mgbe ị nwere ike ịgwa onye isi ala United States okwu.
rows.reference: Anyị na anwa ịme nke ahụ ọtụtụ oge, unu ahụla ka anyị mere nke ahụ n’izu ole ma ole gara aga, nke ahụ ga-anọchikwa nchịkọta akụkọ mgbe ị nwere ike ịgwa onye isi ala nke United States okwu.”

rows.source: Trump regularly takes questions when leaving the White House or participating in open sessions or press conferences with visiting dignitaries.
rows.output: Mgbe ọ na-apụ n'ụlọ ọcha ma ọ bụ na-etinye aka na nnọkọ mepere emepe ma ọ bụ mkparịta ụka ndị nta akụkọ na ndị ama ama, ọ na-aza ajụjụ mgbe niile.
rows.reference: Trump kwa oge na aza ajụjụ mgbe ọ na ahapụ White House ma ọ bụ sonye n’oge njụajụjụ ma ọ bụ ọgbakọ ndị mgbasa ozi mgbe enwere ndị mbịambịa ndị ọchịchị.

rows.source: Solo press conferences are rare.
rows.output: Nnọọkwa ọgbakọ ndị nta akụkọ naanị ya na-adịkarị ụkọ.
rows.reference: Ọgbakọ mgbasa ozi naanị ya anaghị adịkebe.

rows.source: In New York this week the president perhaps demonstrated why, making a freewheeling and at times bizarre appearance before gathered reporters.
rows.output: N'izu a na New York, onyeisiala eleghị anya gosipụtara ihe kpatara ya, site n'ime ihe ngosi na-enweghị isi na mgbe ụfọdụ na-adịghị mma n'ihu ndị nta akụkọ gbakọtara.
rows.reference: Na New York n’izu a onye isi ala ikekwe kọwara ihe kpatara ya, na eme mpụta na adịghị mma, oge ụfọdụ mpụta jọrọ njọ n’ihu ndị nta akụkọ.

rows.source: Health secretary writes to EU workers at NHS Scotland over Brexit fears
rows.output: Onye na-ahụ maka ahụike dere akwụkwọ ozi nye ndị ọrụ EU na NHS Scotland n'ihi egwu Brexit
rows.reference: Ọde Akwụkwọ Ahụike degara ndị ọrụ EU akwụkwọ na NHS Scotland maka ihe egwu Brexit

rows.source: The Health Secretary has written to EU staff working in Scotland's NHS to express the country's gratitude and wish for them to stay on post-Brexit.
rows.output: Onye isi ala ahụike ezipụla ozi ozi na ndị ọrụ EU na-arụ ọrụ na NHS Scotland iji gosi ekele obodo ahụ na ọchịchọ ha ka ha nọrọ n'ọkwa mgbe Brexit gasịrị.
rows.reference: Ọde Akwụkwọ Ahụike edegala akwụkwọ maka ndị ọrụ EU na arụ ọrụ na NHS nke Scotland iji gosi ekele nke obodo ahụ ma rịọ ka ha nọrọ mgbe Brexit gachara.

rows.source: Jeane Freeman MSP sent a letter with less than six months to go until the UK withdraws from the EU.
rows.output: Onye omeiwu Jeane Freeman zigara akwụkwọ ozi n'ime ọnwa isii gara aga tupu UK apụ n'otu EU.
rows.reference: Jeane Freeman MSP zigara leta n’ime ọnwa isiii iji ruo mgbe ndị UK ga-apụ na EU.

rows.source: The Scottish Government has already committed to meet the cost of settled status applications for EU citizens working in its devolved public services.
rows.output: Gọọmenti Scotland ekwela nkwa na ha ga-akwụ ụgwọ maka itinye akwụkwọ maka ọnọdụ kwụsiri ike maka ụmụ amaala EU na-arụ ọrụ na ọrụ ọha na eze ya na-ekewapụ.
rows.reference: Gọọmentị ndị Scotland ewepụtala onwe ha iji kpuchie ụgwọ nke akwụkwọ anamachọihe ọkwa ndị bigoro n’obodo maka ndị amaala EU n’ọrụ ọhaneze ya ekewara ekewa.

rows.source: In her letter, Ms Freeman wrote: "Over the summer, negotiations between the UK and EU on withdrawal have continued, heading towards expected decisions this autumn.
rows.output: N'akwụkwọ ozi ya, Oriakụ Freeman dere: "N'oge okpomọkụ, mkparịta ụka dị n'etiti UK na EU banyere ịpụpụ agabigawo, na-aga n'ihu n'ịhazi mkpebi n'oge mgbụsị akwụkwọ."
rows.reference: Na leta ya, Nwada Freeman dere: “N’oge ọkọchị, ụbụbọ n’etiti UK na EU na nsepụ aka agaala n’ihu, na aga irute mkpebi atụrụ anya n’ọtọm a.

rows.source: But the UK Government has also been stepping up its preparations for a possible no-deal scenario.
rows.output: Ma, Gọọmenti UK na-akwadokwa nkà ihe ọmụma ya maka ọnọdụ na-enweghị nkwekọrịta.
rows.reference: Mana Gọọmentị UK na ewelitekwa nkwadobe ya maka ọnọdụ enweghị nkwekọrịta ọ bụla.

rows.source: I know this must be a very unsettling time for all of you.
rows.output: Amaara m nke a ga-akwụsị unu niile.
rows.reference: Ama m na nke a ga-abụ oge mgbakasị ahụ maka unu niille.

rows.source: That is why I wanted to reiterate now how much I value the contribution of every member of staff, regardless of their nationality.
rows.output: Nke ahụ bụ ihe mere m ji chọọ ịmaliteghachi ugbu a otú m si eche banyere onyinye nke onye ọ bụla n’ime ndị ọrụ niile, n’agbanyeghị obodo ha si.
rows.reference: Ya kpatara m ji chọọ ikwuputegharị ugbu a nnukwu ugwu m na akwanyere ndị ọrụ niile maka enyemaka ha, agbanyeghị obodo ha.

rows.source: Colleagues from across the EU, and beyond, bring valuable experience and skills that strengthen and improve the work of the health service, and benefit the patients and communities we serve.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ ibe si n'ofe EU, na n'ofe, na-eweta ahụmahụ na nkà bara uru nke na-eme ka ọrụ ahụike dịkwuo ike ma mma, na-eritekwa uru ndị ọrịa na obodo anyị na-eje ozi.
rows.reference: Ndị ibe m si n’ofe EU, ma gafere, na eweta ahụmịhe na nka dị mkpa na agbatị ma melite ọrụ nke ọrụ ahụike, ma nyere ndị ọrịa na ogbe anyị na arụrụ ọrụ aka.

rows.source: Scotland is absolutely your home and we very much want you to stay here."
rows.output: Ndị Scotland bụ n'ezie ebe gị ma anyị na-achọsi ike ka ị nọrọ ebe a.
rows.reference: Scotland bụ be gị n’ezie, anyị chọrọ ka unu nọrọ ebe a.”

rows.source: Christion Abercrombie Undergoes Emergency Surgery After Suffering Head Injury
rows.output: Christion Abercrombie mere ọgwụgwọ mberede mgbe ọ merụrụ ahụ n'isi
rows.reference: Christion Abercrombie Na Agabiga Ịwa Ahụ Mberede Ka Ọ Nwechara Mmerụ Ahụ N’isi

rows.source: Tennessee State Tigers linebacker Christion Abercrombie underwent emergency surgery after suffering a head injury in Saturday's 31-27 defeat to the Vanderbilt Commodores, the Tennessean's Mike Organ reported.
rows.output: Onye egwuregwu bọọlụ Tennessee State bụ Christion Abercrombie mere ọgwụgwọ mberede mgbe ọ merụrụ ahụ n'isi n'oge mmeri 31-27 na Satọdee megide ndị Commodores nke Vanderbilt, onye Tennessean Mike Organ kọrọ.
rows.reference: Onye azụ nke Tennessee State Tigers Christion Abercrombie mere ịwa ahụ mberede ka ọ nwechara mmerụ ahụ n’ihi na mmeri 31-27 n’aka Vanderbilt Commodores, Mike Organ nke Tennessee kpesara.

rows.source: Tennessee State head coach Rod Reed told reporters the injury happened shortly before halftime.
rows.output: Onye isi nchịkwa Tennessee State Rod Reed gwara ndị nta akụkọ na mmerụ ahụ mere obere oge tupu etiti oge.
rows.reference: Onye isi ndu Tennessee State bụ Rod Reed gwara ndị nta akụkọ na ahụ mmerụ ahụ mere obere oge ka agachara ọkara oge egwuregwu.

rows.source: "He came to the sideline and just kind of collapsed there," Reed said.
rows.output: "Ọ bịarutere n'akụkụ wee daa n'ebe ahụ kpamkpam," ka Reed kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ bịara n’akụkụ wee tụsa ebe ahụ, “Reed kwuru.

rows.source: Trainers and medical personnel gave Abercrombie oxygen on the sideline before placing him on a stretcher and taking him back for further evaluation.
rows.output: Ndị nkuzi na ndị ọrụ ahụike nyere Abercrombie oxygen n'akụkụ ebe a na-egwu egwu tupu ha etinye ya n'àkwà na ibuga ya n'azụ maka nyocha ọzọ.
rows.reference: Ndị ọzụzụ na ndị ahụike nyere Abercrombie oxygen n’akụkụ ahụ tupu edowe ya n’ihe ndọkpụrụ wee buru ya laghachi maka nyocha ndị ọzọ.

rows.source: An official from Tennessee State told Chris Harris of WSMV in Nashville, Tennessee, that Abercrombie was out of surgery at Vanderbilt Medical Center.
rows.output: Onye ọrụ sitere na Tennessee State gwara Chris Harris nke WSMV na Nashville, Tennessee, na Abercrombie si na ọgwụgwọ na Medical Center nke Vanderbilt.
rows.reference: Otu onye ọrụ si na Tennessee State gwara Chris Harris nke WSMV dị na Nashville, Tennessee, na Abercrombie apụtala n’ụlọ ịwa ahụ na Vanderbilt Medical Center.

rows.source: Harris added that there are "no details on type/extent of injury yet" and Tennessee State is trying to figure out when the injury occurred.
rows.output: Harris gbakwunyere na enweghị nkọwa banyere ụdị/ogo mmerụ ahụ ma ọ bụ mgbe ọ mere.
rows.reference: Harris tinyere na “enwebeghị nkọwapụta n’ụdịrị/ogo nke ahụ mmerụ ahụ” na ndị Tennessee State na anwa ịmata mgbe ahụ mmerụ ahụ mere.

rows.source: Abercrombie, a redshirt sophomore, is in his first season with Tennessee State after transferring from Illinois.
rows.output: Abercrombie, onye na-egwu egwu na-acha uhie uhie, nọ na oge mbụ ya na Tennessee State ka ọ gbasịrị na Illinois.
rows.reference: Abercrombie, onye nke abụọ na kọleji na eyi uwe ọbara ọbara, nọ n’afọ nke izizi ya na Tennessee State ka o sichara Illinois gafete.

rows.source: He had five total tackles Saturday before exiting the game, which brought his season total to 18 tackles.
rows.output: N'ụbọchị Satọdee, o nwere ngụkọta nke ise tupu ọ pụọ n'egwuregwu ahụ, nke mere ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ya n'oge a bụrụ iri na asatọ.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere mgbakọta mgbochi ise na Satọde tupu ọ pụọ n’egwuregwu ahụ, nke wetere mgbakọ afọ asọmpi ya na mgbochi 18.

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK
rows.output: Ndị na-azụ ahịa si mba ọzọ ga-akwụ ụgwọ ụtụ isi stampụ dị elu mgbe ha zụtara ihe onwunwe na UK
rows.reference: A ga-agba ndị azụmahịa ofesi ụgwọ ọrụ stampụ ka dị elu mgbe ha zụtara akụ n’ime UK

rows.source: Foreign buyers will be charged higher stamp duty when they buy a property in the UK with the extra cash used to help the homeless under new Tory plans
rows.output: Ndị na-azụ ahịa si mba ọzọ ga-akwụ ụgwọ stampụ dị elu mgbe ha zụrụ ụlọ na UK, ebe ego a ga-eji enyere ndị na-enweghị ebe obibi aka n'okpuru atụmatụ Tory ọhụrụ.
rows.reference: A ga-agba ndị azụmahịa ofesi ụgwọ ọrụ stampụ ka dị elu mgbe ha zụtara akụ n’ime UK ma jiri ego ahụ mara n’elu wee nyere ndị na enweghị ụlọ aka n’okpuru atụmatụ Tory

rows.source: The move will neutralise the success of Corbyn's drive to attract young voters
rows.output: Mgbanwe a ga-akpaghasị ihe ịga nke ọma nke mbọ Corbyn na-adọta ndị ntuli aka na-eto eto
rows.reference: Omume ahụ ga-emebi ọganihu nke agbamume Corbyn ịdọta ndị ntuli aka na etolite

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on those who are not paying tax in the UK
rows.output: Ụtụ isi stampụ ga-akwụ ụgwọ ndị na-adịghị akwụ ụgwọ ụtụ isi na UK
rows.reference: A ga-agba ụgwọ mwelite ọrụ stampụ n’isi ndị na anaghị akwụ ụgwọ ụtụ isi na UK

rows.source: The Treasury expects it raise up to £120 million a year- to help the homeless
rows.output: Otu Ego na-atụ anya na ọ ga-ebuli ihe ruru nde £120 n'otu afọ - iji nyere ndị na-enweghị ebe obibi aka
rows.reference: Ụlọ Akụ na atụ anya ka ọ gbagote nde £120 kwa afọ - iji nyere ndị na enweghị ụlọ aka

rows.source: Foreign buyers are set to be charged a higher stamp duty rate when they buy property in the UK - with the extra cash used to help the homeless, Theresa May will announce today.
rows.output: Ndị na-azụ ahịa si mba ọzọ ga-akwụ ụgwọ ụtụ isi dị elu mgbe ha zụrụ ihe onwunwe na UK - ebe ego ọzọ a ga-eji nyere ndị na-enweghị ebe obibi aka, Theresa May ga-ekwupụta taa.
rows.reference: A na achọ ịgba ndị azụmahịa ofesi ụgwọ ọrụ stampụ dị elu mgbe ha zụtara akụ n’ime UK - a ga-eji ego mara n’elu wee nyere ndị na enweghị ụlọ aka, Theresa May ga-ekwupute nke a taa.

rows.source: The move will be seen as an attempt to neutralise the success of Jeremy Corbyn's drive to attract young voters with pledges to provide more affordable housing and target high earners.
rows.output: Mgbanwe a ga-ewere dị ka mbọ iji wepụ ihe ịga nke ọma nke ịzọ ọkwa Jeremy Corbyn ịdọta ndị ntuli aka na-eto eto na nkwa inye ụlọ obibi dị ọnụ ala na ilekwasị anya na ndị na-enweta ego dị elu.
rows.reference: A ga-ahụta nke ahụ ka ọnwụnwa iji mebie ọganihu nke agbamume Jeremy Corbyn iji dọta ndị ntuli aka na etolite eto site na iji nkwa ịnyekwu ụlọ dị ọnụ ala ma chụwa ndị na erite nnukwu ụgwọ ọnwa.

rows.source: The stamp duty rise will be levied on individuals and firms not paying tax in the UK, with the extra money boosting the Government's drive to combat rough sleeping.
rows.output: Ụtụ isi stampụ ga-akwụ ụgwọ na ndị mmadụ na ụlọ ọrụ na-enwetaghị ụtụ isi na UK, na ego ọzọ ga-akwado mbọ gọọmentị na-agba ịlụso ụra n'èzí ọgụ.
rows.reference: A ga-agba ụgwọ ọrụ stampụ n’isi ndị mmadụ na ụlọ ọrụ ndị na anaghị akwụ ụgwọ ụtụ isi na UK, ego mara n’elu ga-ebuwanye mbọ Gọọmentị iji luso enweghị ụlọ agha.

rows.source: The surcharge - which is in addition to the present stamp duty, including the higher levels introduced two years ago on second homes and buy-to-lets - could be as much as three per cent.
rows.output: Ụgwọ ọzọ a - nke dị n'elu ụtụ stampụ dị ugbu a, gụnyere ọkwa dị elu ndị e webatara afọ abụọ gara aga na ụlọ nke abụọ na ụlọ ịkwụ ụgwọ - nwere ike ịbụ ihe ruru pasentị atọ.
rows.reference: Mgbakwunye ụgwọ ahụ - nke bụ mgbakwunye n’ọrụ stampụ dị ugbu a, gụnyere ọkwa ndị dị elu ebubatara n’afọ abụọ gara aga n’ụlọ nke abụọ yana ịzụta-maka-ịgbazinye - nwere ike irucha pasentị atọ.

rows.source: The Treasury expects the move to raise up to £120 million a year.
rows.output: Ụlọ Ọrụ Ọchịchị na-atụ anya na mmegharị ahụ ga-ebuli ihe ruru nde £120 kwa afọ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ Akụ na atụ anya ka ọ gbagote nde £120 kwa afọ.

rows.source: An estimated 13 per cent of new-build London properties are bought by non-UK residents, driving up prices and making it harder for first-time buyers to get a foot on the housing ladder.
rows.output: N'ihe dị ka pasentị iri na atọ nke ụlọ ọhụrụ London na-azụta ndị na-abụghị ndị bi na UK, na-ebuli ọnụ ahịa ma na-eme ka ọ na-esiri ndị na-azụ ụlọ mbụ ike ịnweta ụkwụ n'ọkwa ụlọ.
rows.reference: Ekpebiri na pasentị 13 bụ ndị na abụghị ndị bi na UK na azụta akụ ndị London arụrụ ọhụrụ, na ebugo ụgwọ ma na eme ka o sie ike maka ndị na eme nzụta izizi ha iji nweta ọganihu n’nzọụkwụ obibi ụlọ.

rows.source: Many wealthy areas of the country - particularly in the capital - have become "ghost towns" because of the high number of foreign buyers who spend most of their time out of the country.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ mpaghara ọgaranya na mba ahụ - karịsịa na isi obodo - aghọwo "obodo ndị mmụọ" n'ihi ọnụ ọgụgụ dị elu nke ndị na-azụ ahịa si mba ọzọ bụ ndị na-eji oge buru ibu n'èzí obodo ahụ.
rows.reference: Imirikiti mpaghara ndị nwere ego n’obodo ahụ - karịchara n’isi ala - nwere “ime obodo tọgbọ nkịtị” n’ihi ọnụọgụ nke ndị nzụta ofesi dị elu, ndị na anọ ọtụtụ oge ha na mpụga nke obodo ahụ.

rows.source: The new policy comes just weeks after Boris Johnson called for a stamp duty cut to help more young people own their first home.
rows.output: N'ime ọnwa ole na ole mgbe Boris Johnson gwara ka ewepụrụ ụtụ isi stampụ iji nyere ọtụtụ ndị na-eto eto aka inwe ụlọ mbụ ha.
rows.reference: Iwu ọhụrụ ahụ na abịa n’izu ole ma ole ka Boris Johnson kpọchara oku maka mgbubi n’ọrụ stampụ iji nyere ndị ntorobịa aka ịnwe ụlọ izizi nke ha.

rows.source: He accused big construction firms of keeping property prices high by snapping up land but not using it, and urged Mrs May to abandon quotas on affordable homes to fix Britain's "housing disgrace."
rows.output: O boro ụlọ ọrụ owuwu buru ibu na ha na-ebuli ọnụ ahịa ihe onwunwe elu site n’inye ala mana ha anaghị eji ya, ma gwa Misis May ka o leghara oke ụlọ dị ọnụ ala anya ka o wee dozie “ihere ụlọ obibi” Britain.
rows.reference: O boro ndị nnukwu ụlọ ọrụ nrụpụta ebubo maka idowe akụ n’ọnụego dị elu site na ịnapụ ala mana ha anaghị eji ya, ma rịọ Nwada May ka ọ hapụ oke n’ụlọ ndị dị ọnụ ala iji dozie “ihere ụlọ obibi” nke Britain.

rows.source: Mr Corbyn has announced an eye-catching series of proposed housing reforms, including rent controls and an end to "no-fault" evictions.
rows.output: Ọkammụta Corbyn ekwupụtala usoro mgbanwe ụlọ na-adọrọ mmasị, gụnyere njikwa ụgwọ na njedebe nke "n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi" ịchụpụ.
rows.reference: Maazị Corbyn ekwuputela usoro mmezi ụlọ obibi na adọta ntinye uche, gụnyere njikwa ụgwọ ụlọ yana nkwụsị nke nchụpụ “abụghị ụta mmadụ”.

rows.source: He also wants to give councils greater powers to build new homes.
rows.output: Ọ na-achọkwa inye kansụl ike karịa ka ha wuo ụlọ ọhụrụ.
rows.reference: Ọ chọkwara ịnyekwu ndị kansụl ikike iji rụpụta ụlọ ọhụrụ.

rows.source: Mrs May said: "Last year I said I would dedicate my premiership to restoring the British dream - that life should be better for each new generation.
rows.output: Nwunye May kwuru: "N'afọ gara aga, akwukwara m na-ekwu na m ga-achọpụta n'ọchịchị m iji weghachi nrọ Britain - na ndụ kwesịrị ịdị mma maka ọgbọ ọ bụla ọhụrụ."
rows.reference: Nwada May kwuru: “Afọ gara aga m kwuru m ga-ewepụta ọchịchị m iji weghachite nrọ Britain - ndụ ahụ kwesịrị ka mma maka agbụrụ ọhụrụ ọ bụla.

rows.source: And that means fixing our broken housing market.
rows.output: Ọ na-egosi idozi ahịa ụlọ anyị gbajiri agbaji.
rows.reference: Ma nke ahụ pụtara idozi ahịa ụlọ obibi anyị mebiri emebi.

rows.source: Britain will always be open to people who want to live, work and build a life here.
rows.output: Ndị Britain ga-anọgide na-emeghe nye ndị chọrọ ibi, rụọ ọrụ na wuo ndụ ebe a.
rows.reference: Britain ga-ekpughere oge niile maka ndị mmadụ chọrọ ibi, rụọ ọrụ ma bido ndụ ebe a.

rows.source: However, it cannot be right that it is as easy for individuals who don't live in the UK, as well as foreign-based companies, to buy homes as hard-working British residents.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị mma ka ọ dịrị mfe ka ndị na-adịghị ebi n'UK na ụlọ ọrụ mba ofesi nweta ụlọ ka ndị bi na Britain na-arụsi ọrụ ike.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, ọ nweghị ike ịdị mma na ọ dị mfe maka ndị mmadụ na ebighi n’ime UK, yanakwa ụlọ ọrụ ndị ofesi, iji zụta ụlọ ka ndị obibi Britain na arụsị ọrụ ike.

rows.source: For too many people the dream of home ownership has become all too distant, and the indignity of rough sleeping remains all too real."
rows.output: Maka ọtụtụ ndị, nrọ nke inwe ụlọ agaghị adị anya, na ihere nke ịrahụ ụra n'èzí ka dị ezigbo eziokwu."
rows.reference: Maka ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ, nrọ nke ịnwe ụlọ nke ha bụzị ihe ọ nọ nso eru aka, mmetọ nke enweghị ebe obibi bụzị ihe dị ire.”

rows.source: Jack Ross: 'My ultimate ambition is to manage Scotland'
rows.output: Jack Ross: 'Ebumnuche m kacha elu bụ ijikwa Scotland'
rows.reference: Jack Ross: ‘Ọchịchọ m kachasị bụ ijikwa Scotland’

rows.source: Sunderland boss Jack Ross says his "ultimate ambition" is to become the Scotland manager at some stage.
rows.output: Onye njikwa Sunderland, Jack Ross, kwuru na ọchịchọ ya kacha bụrụ onye njikwa otu mba Scotland n'oge ụfọdụ.
rows.reference: Onye isi nke Sunderland Jack Ross kwuru na “ọchịchọ ya kachasị” bụ ịbụrụ onye ndu Scotland otu oge.

rows.source: The Scot, 42, is relishing the challenge of reviving the North-East club, who currently sit third place in League One, three points off the top.
rows.output: Onye Scotland dị afọ iri anọ na abụọ na-atụ anya ịmaliteghachi klọb nke North-East, ebe otu ahụ nọ ugbu a n'ọkwa nke atọ na League One, nke dị kilomita atọ n'elu.
rows.reference: Onye Scotland ahụ, 42, na enwe obi ụtọ maka mgba nke iweghachite otu asọmpi North-East, ndị nọ ugbu a n’ọkwa atọ na League One, akara atọ n’okpuru nke isi.

rows.source: He moved to the Stadium of Light this summer after guiding St Mirren back to the Scottish Premiership last season.
rows.output: Ọ gbapụrụ na Stadium of Light n'oge okpomọkụ a mgbe ọ na-eduzi St Mirren laghachi na Scottish Premiership n'oge ikpeazụ.
rows.reference: Ọ gara na Stadium of Light n’ọkọchị a ka o duchara St Mirren laghachite na Scottish Premiership n’afọ asọmpi gara aga.

rows.source: "I wanted to play for my country as a player.
rows.output: "Agbalịrị m ịgba egwu maka obodo m dị ka onye ọkpụkpọ."
rows.reference: “Achọburu m ịgbara obodo m bọọlụ ka m bụ onye egwu.

rows.source: I got a B cap and that was it," Ross told BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
rows.output: M nwetara B cap na nke ahụ bụ ya," Ross gwara BBC Scotland's Sportsound.
rows.reference: Enwetara m cap B nke ahụ bụ ya,” Ross gwara Sportsound nke BBC Scotland.

rows.source: "But I grew up watching Scotland at Hampden a lot with my dad as a kid, and it is always something that has drawn me back.
rows.output: Ma mụrụ m na-ekiri Scotland na Hampden a otutu mgbe m bụ nwata, na ọ bụ ihe na-adọrọ m mgbe niile.
rows.reference: “Mana etolitere m na elele Scotland na Hampden ọtụtụ oge, mụ na nna m ka m bụ nwata, ọ bụ ihe na adọghachi m oge niile.

rows.source: That opportunity would only come, though, if I am successful in club management."
rows.output: Nke ahụ ga-abịa nanị, ma ọ bụrụ na m ga-aga nke ọma n'ịchịkwa klọb.
rows.reference: Ohere ahụ ga-abịa, agbanyeghị, ọ bụrụ na m mee nke ọma na njikwa otu egwuregwu.”

rows.source: Ross's predecessors as Sunderland manager include Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet and Paulo Di Canio.
rows.output: Ndị bu ndị bu ọchịchị Ross na Sunderland gụnyere Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gus Poyet na Paulo Di Canio.
rows.reference: Ndị bịara tupu Ross ka onye ndu Sunderland gụnyere Dick Advocaat, David Moyes, Sam Allardyce, Martin O'Neill, Roy Keane, Gue Poyet na Paulo Di Canio.

rows.source: The former Alloa Athletic boss says he felt no trepidation in following such established names at such a big club, having previously rejected overtures from Barnsley and Ipswich Town.
rows.output: Onye bụbu onye njikwa Alloa Athletic kwuru na o nwere mmetụta nke ukwuu n'ịgbaso aha ndị a ma ama n'otu nnukwu klọb, ebe ọ jụrụ ịkpọ oku site na Barnsley na Ipswich Town.
rows.reference: Onye isi nke Alloa Athletic gara aga kwuru na ọ naghị enwe ụjọ n’isochi aha ndị ahụ ama ama n’ụdịrị nnukwu otu ahụ, ka ọ jụchara arịrịọ ndị si na Barnsley na Ipswich Town.

rows.source: "Success for me at the moment will be gauged by 'can I return this club to the Premier League?'
rows.output: "Ịga nke ọma maka m ugbu a ga-adabere n' 'm nwere ike ịlaghachi n'òtù a n'asọmpi Premier?'
rows.reference: “Ọganihu maka m n’oge a ka a ga-atụ site na “enwere m ike idughachi otu a na Premier League?’

rows.source: Because of the structure and facilities at this club, it undoubtedly belongs in the Premier League," he said.
rows.output: N'ihi nhazi na ihe eji eme ihe n'ogige a, o doro anya na ọ gbọrọ otu n'ime otu Premier League.
rows.reference: N’ihi nyiwe na ụlọ nke otu a, na enweghị mgbagha kwesịrị ịnọ na Premier League,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "It is not an easy task to get it there, but I would probably only view myself as being successful here if I can get the club back there."
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị mfe ịrụ ọrụ iji nweta ya ebe ahụ, ma eleghị anya, agaghị m aghọta onwe m dị ka onye na-eme nke ọma ebe a ma ọ bụrụ na m nwere ike ị nweta ụlọ ọgbakọ ahụ ebe ahụ."
rows.reference: “Ọ bụghị ọrụ dị mfe iji laghachi ebe ahụ, mana enwere naanị ike ịhụta onwe m ka onye mere nke ọma ebe a ma ọ bụrụ na m nwere ike idughachi otu ahụ ebe ahụ.”

rows.source: Ross is only three years into his management career, after a period as assistant boss at Dumbarton and a 15-month spell on Hearts' coaching staff.
rows.output: Ross dị naanị afọ atọ n'ọrụ njikwa ya, mgbe oge dị ka onye enyemaka onye isi na Dumbarton na ọnwa iri na ise na ndị ọrụ nchịkwa nke Hearts.
rows.reference: Ross nọ naanị afọ atọ n’ọrụ njikwa ya, ka obere oge gachara ka onye enyemaka na Dumbarton yana ọnụnọ ọnwa 15 n’otu ndị ọrụ Hearts.

rows.source: He then helped Alloa recover from relegation to the third tier, and transformed St Mirren from the brink of relegation to Championship title winners the following season.
rows.output: Mgbe ahụ, o nyere Alloa aka ịgbake site na mbelata na ọkwa nke atọ, ma gbanwee St Mirren site na nsogbu ịbelata na ndị mmeri asọmpi n'afọ na-esote.
rows.reference: Ọ gara nyere Alloa aka ịlaghachite na mgbatu ha gara n’ọkwa nke atọ, ma tụgharịa St Mirren site n’isi nke mgbatu gaa na mmeri iko Championship n’afọ asọmpi sotere.

rows.source: And Ross says he feels more comfortable now than he ever did during his playing career at Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren and Hamilton Academical.
rows.output: Ọ na-ekwu na ọ na-enwekwu obi ụtọ ugbu a karịa ka ọ na-enwe n'oge ọrụ ya na Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren na Hamilton Academical.
rows.reference: Ma Ross kwuru na ọ nwere obi ume ala ugbu a karia ka ọ nwere n’oge onye egwu ya na Clyde, Hartlepool, Falkirk, St Mirren na Hamilton Academical.

rows.source: "It was probably a real crossroads," he recalled, of taking charge of Alloa.
rows.output: "Ọ dị ka ọ bụ ebe a na-ahụ maka ịgbanwe ndụ," ka o chetara, banyere ịnara ọrụ Alloa.
rows.reference: “Ọ nwere ike ịbụ ezi njikọ,” ọ chetere, ịweghara ikike na Alloa.

rows.source: "I genuinely did believe management was the right fit for me, more so than playing.
rows.output: "N'ezie, ekwenyere m na njikwa bụ nhọrọ ziri ezi maka m, karịsịa karịa ịgba egwu.
rows.reference: “Ekwenyere n’ezie na njikwa bụ ihe ziri m nke ọma, karịa ịgba agba.

rows.source: It sounds bizarre because I did okay, made a reasonable living out of it, and enjoyed some reasonable highs.
rows.output: Ọ dị ịtụnanya n'ihi na m mere nke ọma, nweta ndụ na-eju afọ n'ime ya, ma nwee ụfọdụ elu na-eju afọ.
rows.reference: Ọ dara ka ihe ọjọọ n’ihi na m mere nke ọma, ebiri ezigbo ndụ na ya, ma nwee ọhụụ ụfọdụ ihe ndị elu dị mma.

rows.source: But playing can be tough.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ na-egwu egwu nwere ike isi ike.
rows.reference: Mana ịgba agba na esi ike.

rows.source: There are a lot of things you have to get through on a weekly basis.
rows.output: Enwere ọtụtụ ihe ị ga-aga n'ihu na ya kwa izu.
rows.reference: Enwere ọtụtụ ihe ị ga-agafere kwa izu.

rows.source: I still go through that in terms of the stresses and pressure of the job but management just feels right.
rows.output: Ọ ka na-aga n'ụzọ ahụ n'ihe gbasara nrụgide na nrụgide ọrụ mana ọ na-adị m ka njikwa dị mma.
rows.reference: M ka na agafe nke ahụ n’okwu nke nsogbu na ndagide nke ọrụ ahụ mana njikwa dị mma n’anya.

rows.source: I always wanted to manage and now I am doing it, it feels the most comfortable I have been in my own skin throughout my entire adult life."
rows.output: Ọ na-adị m mgbe niile ịbụ onye na-ahụ maka ihe na ugbu a, m na-eme ya, ọ na-adị m ka m dị n'ime uwe m kacha mma n'oge ndụ m dị ka okenye."
rows.reference: Bido na mbụ achọrọ m ịme njikwa, ugbu a ana m eme ya, ọ kachasị enye m mmetụta obi ume ala, abụ m onwe m na ndụ okenye m niile.”

rows.source: You can listen to the full interview on Sportsound on Sunday, 30 September, on Radio Scotland between 12:00 and 13:00 BST
rows.output: Ị nwere ike ige ihe ngosi ahụ dum na Sportsound na Sọnde, 30 Septemba, na Redio Scotland n'etiti elekere iri na abụọ na elekere iri na atọ nke ụtụtụ BST
rows.reference: Ị nwere ike ịge njụajụjụ ọnụ ahụ n’uju na Sportsound na Sọnde, Septemba 30, na Radio Scotland n’oge 12:00 na 13:00 BST

rows.source: Perfect time for a pint is 5.30pm on a Saturday, survey finds
rows.output: Oge zuru oke maka otu iko na-eme n'elekere ise nke iri atọ na puku abalị Satọdee, nyocha chọtara
rows.reference: Oge kachasị mma maka pint bụ 5:30 mgbede na Satọde, nyocha kwuru

rows.source: The summer heatwave has boosted takings for Britain's struggling pubs but heaped more pressure on restaurant chains.
rows.output: Iju oyi a na-ekpo ọkụ emewo ka ego na-abata n'ụlọ mmanya ndị na-agbasi mbọ ike na Britain, ma o welitere ibu ọrụ ọzọ n'ahịrị ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ.
rows.reference: Okpomọkụ ọkọchị etipuola ego maka ụlọ mmanya ndị Britain ndị na aghọ ada mana dosakwuo nsogbu n’elu ndị azụmahịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ.

rows.source: Pub and bar groups saw sales rise 2.7 per cent in July - but takings in restaurants were down 4.8 per cent, figures revealed.
rows.output: Otu ndi na-ere mmanya na ụlọ mmanya hụrụ na ọnụ ahịa ha na-arị elu pasentị 2.7 n'ọnwa Julaị - mana, ego ha na-enweta n'ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ dara pasentị 4.8, akwụkwọ si kwuo.
rows.reference: Otu ndị ụlọ mmanya hụrụ ka ahịa rịgoro pasentị 2.7 na Julaị - mana nrite n’ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ dara pasentị 4.8, ọnụọgụ gosiri.

rows.source: Peter Martin, of business consultancy CGA, which compiled the figures, said: "Continued sunshine and England's longer than expected participation in the World Cup meant July followed a similar pattern to the previous month of June, when pubs were up 2.8 per cent, except that restaurants were hit even harder.
rows.output: Pita Martin, nke ụlọ ọrụ ndụmọdụ azụmahịa CGA, bụ́ ndị chịkọtara ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị ahụ, kwuru: "Ụbọchị anwụ na-acha na-aga n'ihu na ntinye aka England na iko mba ụwa karịa ka a tụrụ anya ya n'ọnwa Julaị soro ụkpụrụ yiri nke ọnwa Jun, mgbe ụlọ mmanya ruru 2.8 pasent, ma e wezụga na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ ka
rows.reference: Peter Martin, nke ndị ndụmọdụ azụmahịa CGA, nke kpokọrọ ọnụọgụ ahụ, kwuru: “Anyanwụ ka dị yana nsonye England na World Cup toro ogologo ole atụrụ anya pụtara na Julaị sochiri otu usoro ka ọnwa nke Juun gara aga, mgbe ụlọ mmanya rịgoro pasentị 2.8, belụsọ na ndị ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ nwere nnukwu nhịahụ.

rows.source: The fall of 1.8 per cent in restaurant trading in June just got worse in July.
rows.output: Mbelata nke 1.8 pasent na azụmahịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na June ka njọ na Julaị.
rows.reference: Nrịda nke pasentị 1.8 n’azụmahịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na Juun kawanyere njọ na Julai.

rows.source: Drink-led pubs and bars performed by far the strongest with like-for-likes up more than restaurants were down.
rows.output: Ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ mmanya ndị na-ere mmanya rụrụ ọrụ kacha mma, na ndị dị ka ọnụ ọgụgụ ha gbagoro karịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ, ndị na-adaba.
rows.reference: Ụlọ mmanya kachasị mee nke ọma otu yitere ihe dị ka otu ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ si gbadaa.

rows.source: Food-led pubs also suffered in the sun, although not as dramatically as the restaurant operators.
rows.output: Ụlọ mmanya ndị na-eri nri nwekwara nsogbu na anyanwụ, ọ bụ ezie na ọ bụghị nke ukwuu dị ka ndị na-arụ ọrụ ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ mmanya na ere nri tara ahụhụ n’anyanwụ, mana ọbụghị ka nke ndị na azụ ahịa ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ.

rows.source: It seems people just wanted to go out for a drink.
rows.output: Ọ dị ka ndị mmadụ na-achọsi ike ịpụ n'èzí ka ha ṅụọ mmanya.
rows.reference: Ọ dị ka ndị mmadụ chọrọ ịpụ ṅwụọ mmanya.

rows.source: Across managed pubs and bars drink sales were up 6.6 per cent for the month, with food down three per cent."
rows.output: N'ofe ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ mmanya ndị a na-achịkwa, ahịa mmanya mụbara pasentị 6.6 maka ọnwa ahụ, ebe nri ala pasentị atọ."
rows.reference: N’ofe ụlọ mmanya ndị a na ejikwa ọrịre mmanya rịgoro pasentị 6.6 maka ọnwa ahụ, ebe nri rịdara pasenti atọ.”

rows.source: Paul Newman, of leisure and hospitality analysts RSM said: "These results continue the trend we've seen since the end of April.
rows.output: Paul Newman, onye nyocha oge ntụrụndụ na ọbịa RSM kwuru: "Nsonaazụ ndị a na-aga n'ihu na usoro anyị hụrụ kemgbe njedebe nke Eprel.
rows.reference: Paul Newman, nke ntụrụndụ na nlekọta onye nyocha RSM kwuru: “Nsonaazụ ndị a sochiri usoro ahụ anyị hụrụ kemgbe ngwụcha nke Eprel.

rows.source: Weather and the impact of major social or sporting events remain the biggest factors when it comes to sales in the out-of-home market.
rows.output: Ihe ihu igwe na mmetụta nke nnukwu mmemme mmekọrịta mmadụ na ibe ya ma ọ bụ egwuregwu bụ ihe kacha mkpa mgbe ọ na-abịa na ahịa n'èzí ụlọ.
rows.reference: Ihuigwe na mmetụta nke mmemme mmerịkọta ma ọ bụ egwuregwu ndị dị ukwuu ka bụkwa nnukwu mmetụta mgbe ọ bịara n’ọrịre n’ahịa ndị apụrụ n’ụlọ.

rows.source: It comes as no surprise that restaurant groups continue to struggle, albeit a sales drop of 4.8 per cent year-on-year will be particularly painful on top of ongoing cost pressures.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị ihe ijuanya na otu ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na-aga n'ihu na-agbasi mbọ ike, n'agbanyeghị na mbelata ire ere nke pasent 4.8 kwa afọ na afọ gara aga ga-adị oke egwu n'ihi nrụgide ọnụahịa na-aga n'ihu.
rows.reference: Ọ naghị abịa ka ihe ntụnanya na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ gara n’ihu na aghọ ada, agbanyeghị nrịda ọrịre nke pasentị 4.8 kwa afọ kwa afọ ga-abụ ihe nnukwu mgbu n’elu ndagide ụgwọ na aga ugbu a.

rows.source: The long hot summer could not have come at a worse time for food-led operators and time will tell whether the more moderate temperatures we've experienced in August will provide some much-needed respite."
rows.output: Ihe mgbu na-ekpo ọkụ nke ọkọchị enweghị ike ịbịa n'oge na-adịghị mma maka ndị na-ahụ maka nri na oge ga-agwa anyị ma ọnọdụ okpomọkụ dị ntakịrị anyị nwetara na Ọgọst ga-enye ụfọdụ ihe na-eme ka ọ dịkwuo mma.
rows.reference: Okpomọkụ ogologo ọkọchị ahụ enweghị ike ịbịa n’oge jọrọ njọ maka ndị na ere nri, mana oge ga-ekwu ma temprechọ dịtụ mma enwere na Ọgọst a ga-eweta ụfọdụ ezumike achọrọ.”

rows.source: Total sales growth across pub and restaurants, including new openings, was 2.7 per cent in July, reflecting the slow down in brand roll-outs.
rows.output: Mmụba nke ire ere n'ozuzu n'ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ, gụnyere mmeghe ọhụrụ, bụ pasentị 2.7 na Julaị, na-egosipụta nkwụsị nke mgbasawanye nke ika.
rows.reference: Mgbakọta ntolite ọrịre n’ofe ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ, gụnyere ndị mepere ọhụrụ, bụ pasentị 2.7 na Julaị, na egosi mgbatu na mbupute azụmahịa ọhụrụ.

rows.source: The Coffer Peach Tracker industry sales monitor for the UK pub, bar and restaurant sector collects and analyses performance data from 47 operating groups, with a combined turnover of over £9 billion, and is the established industry benchmark.
rows.output: Otu nleba anya ụlọ ọrụ Coffer Peach Tracker maka ụlọ mmanya, ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ nke UK na-anakọta na nyochaa data arụmọrụ sitere na otu 47 na-arụ ọrụ, nwere mkpokọta ntụgharị karịa ijeri £9, ma bụrụkwa ihe nrịbama ụlọ ọrụ guzosiri ike.
rows.reference: Nyocha azụmahịa ụlọ ọrụ Coffer Peach Tracker maka ụlọ mmanya UK, ngalaba ụlọ mmanya na ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na anakọta ma nyochaa data arụmọrụ site na otu nrụọrụ 47, site na ịnwe ọmụrụnwa ekpokọtara gafere ijeri £9, nke ahụ bụ akara ụlọ ọrụ atọrọ.

rows.source: One in five children have secret social media accounts that they hide from their parents
rows.output: Otu n'ime ụmụaka ise ahụ nwere akaụntụ mgbasa ozi nzuzo nke ha na-ehi ụra n'aka nne na nna ha
rows.reference: Otu n’ime ụmụaka ise nwere akaụntụ ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze ezoro ezo nke ha na ezonarị nne na nna ha

rows.source: One in five children - some as young as 11 - have secret social media accounts that they hide from their parents and teachers, survey reveals
rows.output: Otu n'ime ụmụaka ise - ụfọdụ dị ka afọ 11 - nwere akaụntụ mgbasa ozi nzuzo nke ha na-ehi ụra n'aka nne na nna na ndị nkuzi, nyocha kpughere
rows.reference: Otu n’ime ụmụaka ise - ụfọdụ erubeghị afọ 11 - nwere akaụntụ ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze ha na ezonarị nne na nna na ndị nkuzi ha, nyocha gosiri

rows.source: Survey of 20,000 secondary school pupils revealed growth in "fake Insta" pages
rows.output: Nnyocha nke 20,000 ụmụ akwụkwọ sekọndrị gosiri mmụba nke ibe "fake Insta"
rows.reference: Nyocha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndịrị 20,000 gosiri ntolite n’ibe “Insta adịgboroja”

rows.source: The news has heightened fears that sexual content is being posted
rows.output: Ihe ndekọ ahụ emeela ka egwu na-akawanye njọ na a na-ebipụta ihe gbasara mmekọahụ.
rows.reference: Akụkọ ahụ agbalitela ụjọ na a na ebisa ọdịnaya mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị

rows.source: Twenty per cent of pupils said they have a "main" account to show parents
rows.output: Puku iri abụọ n'ime iri n'ime ụmụ akwụkwọ kwuru na ha nwere "isi" akaụntụ igosi ndị nne na nna
rows.reference: Pasentị iri abụọ nke ụmụ akwụkwọ kwuru na ha nwere “isi” akaụntụ iji gosi nne na nna

rows.source: One in five children - some as young as 11 - are creating social media accounts that they keep secret from adults.
rows.output: Otu n'ime ụmụaka ise - ụfọdụ dị ka afọ 11 - na-emepụta akaụntụ mgbasa ozi ọha na eze nke ha na-ezochi ndị okenye.
rows.reference: Otu n’ime ụmụaka ise - ụfọdụ na erubeghị afọ 11 - na emepụta akaụntụ ebe mmerịkọta ọhaneze nke ha na ezonarị ndị okenye.
