rows.source: A survey of 20,000 secondary school pupils revealed a rapid growth in "fake Insta" accounts - a reference to photo-sharing site Instagram.
rows.output: Nnyocha nke ndị ọkụ 20,000 nke ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndrị gosiri na e nwere uto ngwa ngwa n'akwụkwọ "fake Insta" - nke na-ezo aka na webụsaịtị ịkekọrịta foto Instagram.
rows.reference: Nyocha nke ụmụ akwụkwọ ụlọ akwụkwọ sekọndịrị 20,000 gosiri ntolite ngwangwa n’akaụntụ “Insta adịgboroja” - nrụtụ aka na saịtị nkekọrịta-foto Instagram.

rows.source: The news has heightened fears that sexual content is being posted.
rows.output: Ọdịnaya ọdịnaya nke na-eme ka ụjọ na-atụ na a na-ebipụta ọdịnaya mmekọahụ.
rows.reference: Akụkọ ahụ agbalitela ụjọ na a na ebisa ọdịnaya mmekọrịta nwoke na nwanyị.

rows.source: Twenty per cent of pupils said they operate a sanitised "main" account to show parents, while also having private ones.
rows.output: Puku iri abụọ n'ime iri n'ime ụmụ akwụkwọ kwuru na ha na-arụ ọrụ aka "isi" nke a na-ehicha iji gosi ndị mụrụ ha, ebe ha na-enwekwa nkeonwe.
rows.reference: Pasentị iri abụọ nke ụmụ akwụkwọ kwuru na ha na ejikwa “isi” akaụntụ dị ọcha iji gosi nne na nna, ma na enwekwa nke nzuzo.

rows.source: One mother who stumbled across her 13-year-old's daughter's secret site found a teenager urging others to "rape me."
rows.output: Nne otu onye na-achọpụta na nwa ya nwanyị dị afọ 13 nwere ebe nzuzo chọtara otu nwa agbọghọ na-agba ndị ọzọ ume ka ha "wakpo m."
rows.reference: Otu nne dakwutere saịtị nzuzo nke nwa nwanyị ya dị afọ 13 hụrụ ka otu nwa agbọghọ na akwa ndị ọzọ ka ha “nwakpuo ya.”

rows.source: The research, by Digital Awareness UK and the Headmasters" and Headmistresses" Conference (HMC) of independent schools, found 40 per cent of 11 to 18-year-olds had two profiles, with half of those admitting to keeping private accounts.
rows.output: Nnyocha ahụ, nke Digital Awareness UK na nzukọ ndị isi ụlọ akwụkwọ (HMC) mere, chọpụtara na 40% n'ime ụmụaka dị afọ 11 ruo 18 nwere akaụntụ abụọ, ebe ọkara n'ime ha kwetara na ha na-edobe akaụntụ nzuzo.
rows.reference: Nyocha ahụ, si n’aka Digital Awareness UK yana Headmasters” and Headmistresses” Conference (HMC) nke ụlọ akwụkwọ ndị nnwere onwe, hụrụ pasentị 40 nke ndị afọ 11 ruo 18 nwere profaịlụ abụọ, n’ebe ọkara kwenyere na ha nwere akaụntụ nzuzo.

rows.source: HMC chief Mike Buchanan said: "It's disturbing so many teenagers are tempted into creating online spaces where parents and teachers cannot find them."
rows.output: Onye isi HMC Mike Buchanan kwuru: "Ọ na-ewute na ọtụtụ ndị na-eto eto na-enwe mmasị ịmepụta oghere n'ịntanetị ebe ndị nne na nna na ndị nkuzi enweghị ike ịchọta ha."
rows.reference: Onye isi HMC Mike Buchanan kwuru: “Ọ na atụ ụjọ na ọtụtụ ndị ntorobịa na anwa ịmepụta oghere n’ịntanetị ebe ndị nne na nna na ndị nkuzi enweghị ike ịchọta ha.”

rows.source: Eilidh Doyle will be "voice for athletes" on Scottish Athletics board
rows.output: Eilidh Doyle ga-abụ "olu maka ndị na-eme egwuregwu" na board Scottish Athletics
rows.reference: Eilidh Doyle ga-abụ “olu ndị asọmpi” na oche Ndị Asọmpi Scotland

rows.source: Eilidh Doyle has been elected to the board of Scottish Athletics as a non-executive director at the governing body's annual general meeting.
rows.output: Eilidh Doyle họọrọ n'ime ndị otu bọọdụ Scottish Athletics dịka onye nduzi na-adịghị arụ ọrụ na nzukọ ọgbakọ ha kwa afọ.
rows.reference: Ahọpụtala Eilidh Doyle n’otu ndị isi oche nke Ndị Asọmpi Scotland ka onye nduzi na abụghị onye isi na nzụkọ ọgbakọ kwa afọ nke otu nchịkwa.

rows.source: Doyle is Scotland's most decorated track and field athlete and chairman Ian Beattie described the move as a great opportunity for those guiding the sport to benefit from her wide-ranging experience at international level over the past decade.
rows.output: Doyle bụ onye Scotland kacha eme ememme n'ọsọ ụzọ na ogige, na onyeisi oche Ian Beattie kọwara mmegharị ahụ dị ka ohere dị mma maka ndị na-eduzi egwuregwu ahụ iji nweta ahụmahụ dị iche iche ya na ọkwa mba ụwa n'ime afọ iri gara aga.
rows.reference: Doyle bụ onye asọmpi nke Scotland kachasị nweta ihe nrite, onye isi Ian Beattle kọwara mmereme ahụ ka nnukwu ohere maka ndị ahụ na edu egwuregwu ahụ iji nwete elele n’ahụmịhe ya gbasara agbasa n’ọkwa ofesi gafere afọ iri gara aga.

rows.source: "Eilidh has massive respect across the Scottish, UK and world athletics community and we are sure athletics in Scotland would benefit hugely by bringing her on to the board," Beattie said.
rows.output: "Eilidh nwere nnukwu nkwanye ùgwù n'etiti ndị Scotland, UK na obodo ịgba ọsọ ụwa, anyị na-ekwenyekwa na ịgba ọsọ na Scotland ga-aba uru nke ukwuu site n'ịkpọghachi ya n'òtù ndị isi."
rows.reference: “Eilidh nwere nsọpụrụ buru ibu n’ofe ogbe ndị asọmpi Scotland, UK na ụwa gburugburu, doro anyị anya na asọmpi na Scotland ga-enweta nnukwu elele site na ịwebata ya n’oche ha,” Beattie kwuru.

rows.source: Doyle said: "I am keen to act as a voice for athletes and I am hoping I can really contribute and help guide the sport in Scotland."
rows.output: Doyle kwuru: "Ana m mmasị ịrụ ọrụ dị ka olu maka ndị na-eme egwuregwu ma na-atụ anya na m nwere ike inye aka nke ukwuu ma duzie egwuregwu na Scotland."
rows.reference: Doyle kwuru: “Enwere m mmasị ịrụ ọrụ ka olu ndị asọmpi, m na atụ anya na m nwere ike ịnyere aka n’ezie ma nyere aka duzie egwuregwu n’ime Scotland.”

rows.source: The American, who won the 200 metres and 400 metres at the 1996 Games in Atlanta among his total of four Olympic golds and is now a regular BBC pundit, was left unable to walk after suffering a transient ischemic attack.
rows.output: Onye America ahụ, onye meriri 200 mita na 400 mita n'egwuregwu Olympic nke afọ 1996 n'Atlanta n'etiti ọla edo Olympic ya niile, ma bụrụ onye na-enyocha BBC mgbe niile, enweghị ike ịga ije mgbe ọ nwesịrị ọrịa ischemic nke na-adịte aka.
rows.reference: Onye America, meriri mita 200 na mita 400 na Egwuregwu 1996 na Atlanta n’ime mgbakọta nke ọla-edo Olympic ano ya, ugbu a bụ onye ọkachamara BBC, enwenwughi ike ịga ije ka ọ nwechara mbuso agha transient ischemic.

rows.source: He wrote on Twitter: "A month ago today I suffered a stroke.
rows.output: O dere na Twitter: "Otu ọnwa gara aga taa, enwere m ọrịa strok.
rows.reference: Ọ dere na Twitter: “Otu ọnwa gara aga taa enwere m ọrịa mkpọnwụ ahụ.

rows.source: I could not walk.
rows.output: Anaghị m eje ije.
rows.reference: Enwenwughi ike ịga ije.

rows.source: Doctors said only time will tell if I will recover or to what degree.
rows.output: Ndị dọkịta kwuru na naanị oge ga-egosi ma m ga-agbake ma ọ bụ ruo n'ókè nke ihe mgbu.
rows.reference: Ndị dọkịnta kwuru naanị oge ga-ekwu na m enwere ike ịlaghachite ma ọ bụ kedu oke m ga-eru.

rows.source: Its been grueling work but made a full recovery, re-learned how to walk and today doing agility drills!
rows.output: Ọrụ ahụ siri ike ma ọ dị mma, mụtara ịga ije ọzọ, taa na-eme mgbatị mgbatị!
rows.reference: Ọ bụ nnukwu ọrụ mana alaghachitere m n’uju, mụgharịa otu esi aga ije ma taa m na eme ọrụ siri ike!

rows.source: Thanks for the messages of encouragement!"
rows.output: Daalụ maka ozi ndị na-agba ume!
rows.reference: Daalụ maka ozi nke nkasị obi!”

rows.source: Breast pump advert comparing mothers to cows divides opinion online
rows.output: Mgbasa ozi igwe ọmụmụ ara na-ekewa echiche n'ịntanetị
rows.reference: Mgbasa ozi ihe mgbapụta mmiri ara na atụle ndị nne yana ehi kewara echiche n’ịntanetị

rows.source: A breast pump company has divided opinion online with an advert that compares nursing mothers to cows being milked.
rows.output: Otu ụlọ ọrụ na-ebu ara ehi emeela ka echiche dị iche iche n'ịntanetị site na mgbasa ozi na-atụnyere ndị na-azụ ụmụ na ọkụkọ na-akụ.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ ihe mgbapụta mmiri ara ekewaala echiche n’ịntanetị site na iji mgbasa ozi na atụle ndị nne yana ehi a na amị ara ha.

rows.source: To mark the launch of what is said to be the "world's first silent wearable breast bump," consumer tech company Elvie released a tongue-in-cheek music video-inspired advert to showcase the freedom the new pump gives to expressing mothers.
rows.output: Iji megharịa mwepụta nke ihe a na-ekwu na ọ bụ "ụwa mbụ na-adịghị ụda na-eyi akpụkpọ anụ," ụlọ ọrụ teknụzụ na-azụ ahịa Elvie wepụtara ihe nkiri egwu egwu na-atọ ọchị iji gosi nnwere onwe nke igwe ọhụrụ ahụ na-enye ndị nne na-anụ ọkụ n'obi.
rows.reference: Iji kapụta mbido nke ihe ekwuru ga-abụ “ihe mgbapụta mmiri ara a na eyi eyi zoro ezo nke izizi n’ụwa,” ụlọ ọrụ teknụzụ ndi ahia Elvie buputere mgbasa ozi vidiyo na egwu na atọ ọchi iji gosipụta nnwere onwe ihe mgbapụta ọhụrụ ahụ na enye ndi nne.

rows.source: Four real mothers dance in a hay-filled barn of cows to a track that includes lyrics like: "Yes, I milk myself, but you don't see no tail" and "In case you hadn't noticed these are not udders, they're my boobs."
rows.output: Mmadụ anọ na-eme ihe n'ime ụlọ ahụ nwere ahịhịa nke ehi na-eme egwu nke nwere egwu dị ka: "Ee, m na-eme mmiri ara ehi onwe m, mana ị hụghị ọdụ ọ bụla" na "N'ọnọdụ ị hụbeghị na ọ bụghị udders, ọ bụ boobs m."
rows.reference: Ezigbo ndị nne anọ gbara egwu n’ọba ehi nke nri ehi juru n’egwu nwere okwu ndị dị ka: “Ee, m na amịpụta mmiri ara m, mana ị gaghị ahụ ọdụdụ ọ bụla ”Ọ bụrụ na ị chọpụtabeghị ndị a abụghị ara ehi, ndị a bụ ara m.”

rows.source: The chorus continues: "Pump it out, pump it out, I'm feeding them babies, pump it out, pump it out, I'm milking my ladies."
rows.output: Nke a na-aga n'ihu: "Kwachaa ya, kwachaa ya, Ana m-eri nwa, kwachaa ya, kwachaa ya, Ana m-eri ndị m nwanyị."
rows.reference: Isi egwu gara n’ihu: “Gbapụta ya, gbapụta ya, m na enye ụmụ ntakịrị nri, gbapụta ya, gbapụta ya, ụmụ nwanyị m, m na amịpụta mmiri ara.”

rows.source: However, the advert, which has been published on the firm's Facebook page, has caused controversy online.
rows.output: Ọbụna mgbasa ozi ahụ, nke e bipụtara na ibe Facebook nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ, ewepụtala esemokwu n'ịntanetị.
rows.reference: Kaosiladị, mgbasa ozi ahụ, nke ebiputegoro n’ibe Facebook nke ụlọ ọrụ ahụ, ebutela nsogbu n’ịntanetị.

rows.source: With 77,000 views and hundreds of comments, the video has received mixed reactions from viewers, with many saying it makes light of the "horrors" of the dairy industry.
rows.output: N'ime 77,000, vidiyo a enwetala mmeghachi omume dị iche iche site n'aka ndị na-ekiri ya, ọtụtụ ndị na-ekwu na ọ na-eme ka "ajọ ihe" nke ụlọ ọrụ mmiri ara ehi na-akpa ọchị.
rows.reference: Ọ nwere nlele 77,000 yana narị ọnụọgụ nke okwu ntụkwasa, vidio ahụ enwetala ndapụta dị iche iche n’aka ndị nlele, ebe imirikiti na ekwu na ọ na eme ka “ihe egwu” nke ụlọ ọrụ mmiri ara ehi dị mfe n’anya.

rows.source: "Very poor decision using cows to advertise this product.
rows.output: "O nwere nghọta dị oke njọ iji ehi na-akwalite ngwaahịa a.
rows.reference: “Nnukwu ajọ mkpebi iji ehi wee gbasaa ozi ngwaahịa a.

rows.source: Like us they need to get pregnant and give birth in order to produce milk, except their babies are stolen from them within days of giving birth," one wrote.
rows.output: Dị ka anyị, ha chọrọ ịtụrụ ime na ịmụ nwa iji mụọ nwa, ewezuga na a na-awakpo ụmụ ha n’ime ụbọchị ole na ole ka ha mụsịrị nwa.
rows.reference: Dị ka anyị ha ga-adị ime wee mụọ nwa iji mepụta mmiri ara, naanị na a na ezuru ụmụ ha n’ime ụbọchị ole ma ole ka ha mụchara nwa,” otu onye dere.

rows.source: The Elvie breast pump fits discreetly inside a nursing bra (Elvie/Mother)
rows.output: Ihe mkpofu mmiri ara Elvie dabara nke ọma n'ime uwe nne (Elvie/Mother)
rows.reference: Ihe mgbapụta mmiri ara Elvie ahụ na ezo n’ime bra nwanyị na elekọta nwa (Elvie/Mother)

rows.source: Another commented: "Understandably traumatic for both mother and baby.
rows.output: Otu onye kwuru: "N'ezie, ọrịa ahụ́ na-akpata maka nne na nwa ahụ abụọ.
rows.reference: Ọzọ dere: “Ihe nnukwu ụjọ aghọtara maka nne yana nwa.

rows.source: But yeah why not use them to advertise a breast pump for mothers who get to keep their babies?"
rows.output: Ma a na-ekwu ihe mere ha ga-eji na-ekwurịta okwu banyere iji ha na-ekwurịta okwu banyere iji ha na-ekwurịta okwu banyere iji ha na-ekwurịta okwu banyere iji ha na-ekwurịta okwu banyere iji ha na-ekwurịta okwu banyere iji ha na-ekwurịta okwu banyere iji ha na-ekwurịta okwu banyere iji ha na-ekwurịta okwu banyere iji ha na-ekwurịta okwu banyere
rows.reference: Mana ee gịnị kpatara na ejighi ha iji gbasaa ozi ihe mgbapụta mmiri ara maka ndị nne nwere ohere idowe ụmụ ha?”

rows.source: Someone else added: "Such an out of touch advert."
rows.output: Otu onye ọzọ gbakwunyere: "Atụmatụ mgbasa ozi dị otú a adịghị njikọ na eziokwu."
rows.reference: Otu onye ọzọ tinyekwara” “Ụdịrị mgbasa ozi na enweghị isi.”

rows.source: Others defended the advert, with one woman admitting that she found the song "hilarious."
rows.output: Ndị ọzọ gbachitere mgbasa ozi ahụ, otu nwanyị kwetara na abụ ahụ "dị egwu."
rows.reference: Ndị ọzọ kwuchitere mgbasa ozi ahụ, otu nwanyị kwenyere na egwu ahụ tọrọ ya “ọchị.”

rows.source: "I think this is a genus idea.
rows.output: Ekwenyere m na nke a bụ echiche nke ọgbọ.
rows.reference: “Echere m na nke a bụ alo mara oke mma.

rows.source: I would've had one if I was still breastfeeding.
rows.output: Ọ gaara m enwe otu ma ọ bụrụ na m ka na-aṅụ ara.
rows.reference: Enwere m ike ịzụta otu ọ bụrụ na m na enye nwa ara.

rows.source: Pumping made me feel exactly like a cow.
rows.output: Ikpọkọta mere ka m nwee mmetụta dị ka ehi.
rows.reference: Mgbapụta mere m dị ka ehi kpọmkwem.

rows.source: The advert is a little mad but I took it for what it was.
rows.output: Mkpesa ahụ bụ ntakịrị ara mana ewere m ya maka ihe ọ bụ.
rows.reference: Mgbasa ozi ahụ bụtụ ihe isi mgbaka mana enwere ya ka ọ dị.

rows.source: This is a genius product," one wrote.
rows.output: Nke a bụ ngwaahịa nke ọma n'ezie," otu onye dere.
rows.reference: Nke a bụ ngwaahịa nnukwu ọgụgụ isi,” otu onye dere.

rows.source: Another commented: "This is a fun advert aimed at mums who pump (often in their workplaces or toilets) and feel like "cows."
rows.output: Otu onye kwuru: "Nke a bụ mgbasa ozi na-atọ ụtọ nke e bu n'obi maka ndị nne na-eme mmiri ara ehi (na-emekarị n'ọfịs ha ma ọ bụ ụlọ mposi) ma na-eche na ha dị ka "ezì."
rows.reference: Ọzọ dere: “Nke a bụ mgbasa ozi ọhụụ ezubere maka ndi nne na eme mgbapụta (oge ụfọdụ n’ebe ọrụ ma ọ bụ ụlọ mposi ha) na ahụta onwe ha ka “ehi.”

rows.source: This is not an advert praising or judging the dairy industry."
rows.output: Nke a abụghị mgbasa ozi na-eto ma ọ bụ na-eme mkpesa ụlọ ọrụ mmiri ara ehi.
rows.reference: Nke a abụghị mgbasa ozi na eto ma ọ bụ na ama ụlọ ọrụ mmiri ara ikpe.”

rows.source: At the end of the video the group of women reveal they've all been dancing with the discreet pumps tucked in their bras.
rows.output: N'ọgwụgwụ vidiyo ahụ, otu ndị inyom kpughere na ha niile na-agba egwu na obere igbe na-akpụ akpụ nke zoro ezo n'ime bras ha.
rows.reference: Na ngwụcha nke vidio ahụ otu nke ụmụ nwanyị ahụ gosiri na ha na agba egwu kemgbe mana enwere ihe mgbapụta zoro ezo n’ime bra ha.

rows.source: The concept behind the campaign is based on the insight that many women who breast-pump say they feel like cows.
rows.output: Echiche dị n'azụ mkpọsa ahụ gbadoro ụkwụ na nghọta ahụ bụ na ọtụtụ ụmụ nwanyị ndị na-eme mmiri ara ehi na-ekwu na ha na-adị ha ka ehi.
rows.reference: Nghọta nke kwadobere mgbasa ozi ahụ dabere na nghọta na imirikiti ụmụ nwanyị na agbapụta mmiri ara kwuru na ha na ahụta onwe ha ka ehi.

rows.source: The Elvie Pump however, is completely silent, has no wires or tubes and fits discreetly inside a nursing bra, giving women the freedom to move, hold their babies, and even go out while pumping.
rows.output: Elvie Pump, nke dị ọcha kpamkpam, enweghị eriri ma ọ bụ tubes, dabara nke ọma n'ime bra na-azụ nwa, na-enye ụmụ nwanyị ohere ịkwaga, jide ụmụ ha, ma ọbụna pụọ mgbe ha na-eme ihe.
rows.reference: Ihe Mgbapụta Elvie kaosiladị, zoro ezo kpamkpam, ọ nwere eriri ma ọ bụ okpoko ma zobaa n’ime bra onye na elekọta nwa, na enye ụmụ nwanyị ogere ịgagharị, jide nwa ha, ma pụọ ka ha na agbapụta mmiri ara.

rows.source: Ana Balarin, partner and ECD at Mother commented: "The Elvie Pump is such a revolutionary product that it deserved a bold and provocative launch.
rows.output: Ana Balarin, onye mmekọ na ECD na Nne, kwuru: "Pump Elvie bụ ngwaọrụ na-emebi emebi nke ọma na ọ chọrọ nnukwu mmalite na ihe na-akpali akpali.
rows.reference: Ana Balarin, onye mmeko na ECD na Mother kwukwasara: “Ihe Mgbaputa Elvie bụ ụdị nnukwu ngwaahịa ọhụrụ kwesịrị mbupute na akpalite mmụọ.

rows.source: By drawing a parallel between expressing women and dairy cows we wanted to put breast pumping and all its challenges in the spotlight, while demonstrating in an entertaining and relatable way the incredible sense of freedom that the new pump will bring.
rows.output: Site n'itinye ihe yiri n'etiti ịkọwa ụmụ nwanyị na ehi na-eri nri, anyị chọrọ ịkọba ịgba ara na ihe ịma aka niile ọ na-eweta, na-egosipụta n'ụzọ na-atọ ụtọ na nke a na-apụghị ịgbagha agbagha nnwere onwe dị egwu nke igwe ọhụrụ ga-eweta.
rows.reference: Site na igosi ndịiche n’etiti ụmụ nwanyị na elekọta nwa yana ehi na amịpụta mmiri ara anyị chọrọ itinye mgbapụta mmiri ara yana aka mgba ya niile na mgbado anya, na egosipụtakwa ya ụzọ na enye ọhụụ ma bụrụ nke gaa eru ụlọ, mmetụta nke nnwere onwe dị ukwuu nke ihe mgbapụta ọhụrụ ahụ ga-ewete.

rows.source: This is not the first time the Elvie pump has made the headlines.
rows.output: Nke a abụghị oge mbụ Elvie pump pụtara n'isi akụkọ.
rows.reference: Nke a abụghị izizi ihe mgbapụta Elvie mere ihe mkpọtụ.

rows.source: During London Fashion Week, a mother of two appeared on the catwalk for designer Marta Jakubowski while using the product.
rows.output: N'oge izu ejiji London, otu nne nwere ụmụ abụọ pụtara n'elu ikpo okwu maka onye nrụpụta Marta Jakubowski mgbe ọ na-eji ngwaahịa ahụ.
rows.reference: N’oge Izu Ekike London, nne ụmụaka abụọ pụtara na warawara ụzọ ịga ije maka onye ọmenka Marta Jakubowski ka ọ na eji ngwaahịa ahụ.

rows.source: Hundreds of Migrant Children Quietly Moved to a Tent Camp on the Texas Border
rows.output: Nnukwu ụmụaka ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ na-akwagharị n'ụlọ mgbaba tent na ókèala Texas
rows.reference: Narị Kwụrụ Narị nke Ụmụaka Gbabatara N’obodo Nwayọ Gara na Ogige Akanya na Oke Ala Texas

rows.source: The number of detained migrant children has spiked even though monthly border crossings have remained relatively unchanged, in part because harsh rhetoric and policies introduced by the Trump administration have made it harder to place children with sponsors.
rows.output: Ọnụ ọgụgụ ụmụaka ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ndị a na-ejide na-abawanye n'agbanyeghị na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-agafe ókèala kwa ọnwa adịghị agbanwe agbanwe, n'otu akụkụ n'ihi okwu siri ike na amụma ndị ọchịchị Trump webatara nke mere ka ọ sie ike itinye ụmụaka n'aka ndị na-elekọta ha.
rows.reference: Ọnụọgụ nke ụmụaka ndị gbabatara n’obodo ejidere ejide agbagoola na agbanyeghị na ngafe oke ala kwa ọnwa agbanwebeghị nke ukwuu, n’ihi nkwupụta ike na iwu nke nchịkwa Trump webatara emeela ka o sikwuo ike idowe ụmụaka n’aka ndị nkwado.

rows.source: Traditionally, most sponsors have been undocumented immigrants themselves, and have feared jeopardizing their own ability to remain in the country by stepping forward to claim a child.
rows.output: N'oge gara aga, ọtụtụ ndị na-akwado ya bụ ndị na-akwaga mba ọzọ na-enweghị akwụkwọ, ma ha na-atụ egwu imebi ikike ha ịnọ na mba ahụ site n'ịbata n'ihu ịkpọrọ nwa.
rows.reference: N’ọdịnala, imirikiti ndị nkwado bubu ndị mgbabata n’onwe ha enweghị ndekọ, ha nwere ụjọ imebi ikike nke ha iji nọrọ n’obodo ahụ site na ịbịa ihu iji zọrọ otu nwa.

rows.source: The risk increased in June, when federal authorities announced that potential sponsors and other adult members of their households would have to submit fingerprints, and that the data would be shared with immigration authorities.
rows.output: Ihe egwu ahụ mụbara na June, mgbe ndị ọchịchị etiti kwupụtara na ndị nwere ike ịbụ ndị nkwado na ndị ọzọ toro eto nke ezinụlọ ha ga-enyefe mkpịsị aka, na data ga-ekekọrịta na ndị ọrụ mbata na ọpụpụ.
rows.reference: Ihe egwu ahu gbagoro na Juun, mgbe ndị ikike etiti obodo kwuputere na ndị nkwado nwere ike ịbịa na ndị okenye nke ezinụlọ ha ndị ọzọ ga-enyefe mbisa mkpịsị aka, na a ga-ekekọrịta data ha n’etiti ndị ikike mbata na ọpụpụ.

rows.source: Last week, Matthew Albence, a senior official with Immigration and Customs Enforcement, testified before Congress that the agency had arrested dozens of people who applied to sponsor unaccompanied minors.
rows.output: N'izu gara aga, Matthew Albence, onye isi ọrụ na Immigration and Customs Enforcement, gbara ndị Congress aka na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ejidela ọtụtụ mmadụ ndị rịọrọ ka ha bụrụ ndị na-elekọta ụmụaka na-enweghị nne na nna.
rows.reference: Izu gara aga, Matthew Albence, otu onye isi na Mmanye Mbata na Ọpụpụ na Kọstọms, kwuru n’ihu Kọngress na ụlọ ọrụ ahụ ejidela ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ ndị tinyere akwụkwọ ka ha bụrụ ndị nkwado maka ụmụ ntakịrị na enweghị ndị so ha.

rows.source: The agency later confirmed that 70 percent of those arrested did not have prior criminal records.
rows.output: Ụlọ ọrụ ahụ mechara kwupụta na pasentị iri asaa n'ime ndị a nwụchiri enweghị akwụkwọ ndekọ mpụ gara aga.
rows.reference: Ụlọ ọrụ mechara kwenye na pasentị 70 nke ndị ahụ ejidere enwebughi ndekọ omekome na mbụ.

rows.source: "Close to 80 percent of the individuals that are either sponsors or household members of sponsors are here in the country illegally, and a large chunk of those are criminal aliens.
rows.output: N'akụkụ pasentị iri asatọ n'ime otu narị nke ndị mmadụ na-akwado ma ọ bụ ndị ezinụlọ ha na-akwado nọ ebe a n'obodo ahụ n'ụzọ iwu na-akwadoghị, na nnukwu akụkụ n'ime ha bụ ndị omekome.
rows.reference: “Ihe rutere pasentị 80 nke ndị mmadụ bụ ndị nkwado ma ọ bụ onye otu ezinụlọ nke ndị nkwado nọ n’obodo a n’ụzọ gabigara iwu, ọtụtụ n’ime ndị ahụ bụ ndị mbịambịa gabigara iwu.

rows.source: So we are continuing to pursue those individuals," Mr. Albence said.
rows.output: Ya mere, anyị na-aga n'ihu na-achụso ndị mmadụ ahụ," Maazị Albence kwuru.
rows.reference: Yabụ anyị na aga n’ihu na achụ ndị mmadụ ahụ,” Maazị Albence kwuru.

rows.source: Seeking to process the children more quickly, officials introduced new rules that will require some of them to appear in court within a month of being detained, rather than after 60 days, which was the previous standard, according to shelter workers.
rows.output: N'ịgbalị ịhazi ụmụaka ngwa ngwa, ndị isi kwupụtara iwu ọhụrụ nke ga-eme ka ụfọdụ n'ime ha pụta n'ụlọ ikpe n'ime otu ọnwa nke ijide ha, kama mgbe ụbọchị iri isii gachara, nke bụ ụkpụrụ gara aga, dịka ndị ọrụ ebe mgbaba si kwuo.
rows.reference: Ịchọ ịhazi ụmụaka ahụ ọsọ ọsọ karịa, ndị ọrụ webatara iwu ọhụrụ ga-achọ ka ụfọdụ ha gosi n’ụlọ ikpe n’ime otu ọnwa nke ejidere ha, karịa ka ụbọchị 60 gachara, nke bubu ọkọlọtọ dịbu adị, site n’aka ndị ọrụ ebe obibi.

rows.source: Many will appear via video conference call, rather than in person, to plead their case for legal status to an immigration judge.
rows.output: Ọtụtụ ga-apụta site na oku vidiyo, kama ịnọ n'ebe ahụ, ka ha mee ihe ha na-ekwu maka ọnọdụ iwu na onye ikpe mbata na ọpụpụ.
rows.reference: Imirikiti ga-egosi site na oku nzụkọ vidio, kama n’onwe, iji rịọ okwu ha maka ọkwa iwu n’ihu ọkaikpe mbata na ọpụpụ.

rows.source: Those who are deemed ineligible for relief will be swiftly deported.
rows.output: Ndị a na-ewere na ha adịghị mma maka enyemaka ga-enwetara nnapụta ozugbo.
rows.reference: A ga-ebupu ndị ahụtara ka ndị na etozughi maka ihe elele ozugbo.

rows.source: The longer that children remain in custody, the more likely they are to become anxious or depressed, which can lead to violent outbursts or escape attempts, according to shelter workers and reports that have emerged from the system in recent months.
rows.output: N'ime ụmụaka, ka ha nọrọ n'ụlọ mkpọrọ, ka ha na-enwekwu ike ịda mbà n'obi ma ọ bụ mwute, nke nwere ike ibute iwe iwe ma ọ bụ mgbalị ịgbapụ, dịka ndị ọrụ ebe mgbaba na akụkọ ndị pụtara ìhè n'usoro n'ọnwa ndị na-adịbeghị anya.
rows.reference: Ka ụmụaka ahụ na anọte aka na njide, ka ha nwekwara ike ịnwekwu obi mmaja ma ọ bụ obi mmapụ, nke nwere ike ibute ngosipụta iwe ọkụ ma ọ bụ ọnwụnwa mgbapụ, site n’aka ndị ọrụ ebe obibi yana mkpesa pụtara na sistemụ ahụ n’ọnwa nso nso a.

rows.source: Advocates said those concerns are heightened at a larger facility like Tornillo, where signs that a child is struggling are more likely to be overlooked, because of its size.
rows.output: Ndị na-akwado ya kwuru na nchegbu ndị a na-abawanye n'ụlọ ọrụ buru ibu dị ka Tornillo, ebe ihe ịrịba ama na nwatakịrị na-agbasi mbọ ike nwere ike ịla n'iyi n'ihi nha ya.
rows.reference: Ndị nkwuchite kwuru na echiche ndị ahụ na agbalite na nnukwu ụlọ dị ka Tornillo, ebe mgbama na nwata na enwe nhịahụ na ka enwe nleghara anya karịa, n’ihi nha ya.

rows.source: They added that moving children to the tent city without providing enough time to prepare them emotionally or to say goodbye to friends could compound trauma that many are already struggling with.
rows.output: Ha gbakwara na ịkwaga ụmụaka n'obodo tent na-enweghị inye ha oge zuru ezu iji kwado ha ma ọ bụ ikwu ndewo n'enyemaka ndị enyi ha nwere ike ime ka mgbu ndị ọtụtụ n'ime ha na-enwe.
rows.reference: Ha tinyere na ibuga ụmụaka n’obodo akanya ahụ na enyeghi oge zuru oke iji kwadobe mmụọ ha ma ọ bụ iji kelee ndị enyi ha nwere ike ibuwanye mmaja ọtụtụ n’ime ha na enwe ugbu a.

rows.source: Syria tells US, French and Turkish 'occupying forces' to withdraw immediately
rows.output: Syria na-agwa ndị agha US, French na Turkish ka ha pụọ ​​ozugbo
rows.reference: Syria gwara ‘ndị agha nọ n’obodo ha’ nke US, French na Turkey mebere ka ha pụọ ozugbo

rows.source: Addressing the UN General Assembly, Foreign Minister Walid al-Moualem also called on Syrian refugees to come home, even though the country's war is now in its eighth year.
rows.output: N'ịgbakọ ọgbakọ mba ụwa, Mịnịsta na-ahụ maka ihe gbasara mba ofesi Walid al-Moualem gwakwara ndị na-agbapụ n'ọgba aghara na Syria ka ha laghachi n'ụlọ, n'agbanyeghị na mba ahụ nọ n'afọ nke asatọ nke agha.
rows.reference: Ikwu okwu n’ihu Mgbakọ Ezumezu UN, Minista Ofesi Walid al-Moualem kpọkwara ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ na Syria ka ha laghachite, agbanyeghị na ọgụ nke obodo ahụ nọ n’afọ asatọ ya.

rows.source: Moualem, who also serves as deputy prime minister, said the foreign forces were on Syrian soil illegally, under the pretext of fighting terrorism, and "will be dealt with accordingly."
rows.output: Moualem, onye na-eje ozi na-ahụ maka osote onye isi ala, kwuru na ndị agha mba ọzọ nọ n'ala Siria n'ụzọ iwu na-akwadoghị, n'okpuru ihe a na-ekwu na ha na-alụ ọgụ na-eyi ọha egwu, na "a ga-emeso ha dịka o kwesịrị."
rows.reference: Moualem, onye na arụkwa ọrụ ka osote praịm minista, kwuru na ndị agha ofesi ahụ nọ n’ala Syrian n’ụzọ gabigara iwu, n’okpuru nzuzo nke iluso ndị alụọ alaa ọgụ, na “a ga-emeso ha omume otu ekwesịrị.”

rows.source: "They must withdraw immediately and without any conditions," he told the assembly.
rows.output: "Ha ga-ewepụ ozugbo na-enweghị ọnọdụ ọ bụla," o kwuru n'ọgbakọ ahụ.
rows.reference: “Ha ga-apụrịrị ozugbo na enweghị ọnọdụ ọ bụla,” ọ gwara ọgbakọ ahụ.

rows.source: Moualem insisted that the "war on terror is almost over" in Syria, where more than 360,000 people have died since 2011, with millions more uprooted from their homes.
rows.output: Moualem kwusiri ike na "agha megide ụjọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ gwụchaa" na Siria, ebe ihe karịrị mmadụ 360,000 anwụọla kemgbe afọ 2011, na nde mmadụ ọzọ chụpụrụ n'ụlọ ha.
rows.reference: Moualem kwusiri ike na “ọgụ nke ihe ụjọ agwụchaala” na Syria, ebe ihe karịrị ndị mmadụ 360,000 anwụọla na 2011, ebe ọnụọgụ nde ka achụpụrụ n’ụlọ ha.

rows.source: He said Damascus would continue "fighting this sacred battle until we purge all Syrian territories" of both terror groups and "any illegal foreign presence."
rows.output: O kwuru, Damaskọs ga-aga n'ihu “na-alụ ọgụ agha nsọ a ruo mgbe anyị kpochapụrụ ógbè ndị Syria niile” nke otu abụọ ahụ na “ọnụnọ mba ọzọ ọ bụla na-akwadoghị iwu.”
rows.reference: O kwuru Damascus ga-aga n’ihu “ịlụ ọgụ a ruo mgbe anyị chụpụrụ ndị alụọ ọlaa Syria niile” maka otu abụọ nke ndị ụjọ yana “ọnụnọ ofesi ọ bụla gabigara iwu.”

rows.source: The United States has some 2,000 troops in Syria, mainly training and advising both Kurdish forces and Syrian Arabs opposed to President Bashar al-Assad.
rows.output: Ụlọ Ọchịchị United States nwere ihe dị ka ndị agha 2,000 na Syria, bụ́ ndị na-azụ na ndụmọdụ ma ndị agha Kurdish na ndị Arab na-emegide Onye isi ala Bashar al-Assad.
rows.reference: United States nwere ndị agha 2,000 n’ime Syria, bụkarị maka ọzụzụ na ịnye ndụmọdụ maka ndị agha Kurdish yana Syrian Arabs na agba Onye Isi Ala Bashar al-Assad mgba.

rows.source: France has more than 1,000 troops on the ground in the war-wracked country.
rows.output: Ọ dịkarịa ala ndị agha France 1,000 nọ n'ala ahụ nke agha mebiri emebi.
rows.reference: France nwere karịa ndị agha 1,000 n’ala n’obodo ahụ ọgụ mebichagoro.

rows.source: On the issue of refugees, Moualem said the conditions were fine for them to return, and he blamed "some western countries" for "spreading irrational fears" that prompted refugees to stay away.
rows.output: N'ihe gbasara ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ, Moualem kwuru na ọnọdụ dị mma maka ha ịlaghachi, ma ọ kwara "ụfọdụ mba ọdịda anyanwụ" maka "ịgbasa egwu na-ezighị ezi" nke mere ka ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ pụọ.
rows.reference: N’okwu maka ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ, Moualem kwuru ọnọdụ ndị ahụ dị mma maka ha ịlaghachite, wee tinye ụta n’isi “ụfọdụ obodo ọdịda anyanwụ” maka “ịfesa ụjọ na enweghị isi” nke manyere ndị gbara ọsọ ndụ ịnọte aka.

rows.source: "We have called upon the international community and humanitarian organizations to facilitate these returns," he said.
rows.output: "Anyị ekwela ka ọha mmadụ mba ụwa na òtù na-ahụ maka ọdịmma mmadụ na-akwado nke a."
rows.reference: “Anyị akpọọla ogbe ndị ofesi yana ọgbakọ ndị enyemaka mmadụ iji bido nlaghachite ndị a,” o kwuru.

rows.source: "They are politicizing what should be a purely humanitarian issue."
rows.output: "Ha na-etinye ihe na-abụghị nke ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị."
rows.reference: “Ha ji ihe kwesịrị ịbụ naanị nsogbu enyemaka mmadụ eme ndọrọndọrọ.”

rows.source: The United States and the European Union have warned that there will be no reconstruction aid for Syria until there is a political agreement between Assad and the opposition to end the war.
rows.output: Ndị Ọchịchị U.S. na EU na-adọ aka ná ntị na a gaghị enwe enyemaka iji wughachi Siria ruo mgbe a ga-enwe nkwekọrịta ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị n'etiti Assad na ndị mmegide iji kwụsị agha ahụ.
rows.reference: United States na European Union adọọla aka na ntị na agaghị enwe enyemaka nrụgharị maka Syria ruo mgbe enwere nkwekọrịta ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị n’etiti Assad yana ndị mbuso agha iji kwụsị ọgụ ahụ.

rows.source: UN diplomats say a recent agreement between Russia and Turkey to set up a buffer zone in the last major rebel stronghold of Idlib has created an opportunity to press ahead with political talks.
rows.output: Ndị nnọchiteanya UN na-ekwu na nkwekọrịta na-adịbeghị anya n'etiti Russia na Turkey iji guzobe mpaghara nchekwa na mpaghara ikpeazụ nke ndị nnupụisi na-achị bụ Idlib emewo ka ohere dịrị iji gaa n'ihu na mkparịta ụka ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị.
rows.reference: Ndị nnọchite UN kwuru na nkwekọrịta nso nso a n’etiti Russia na Turkey iji tọọ mpaghara nchekwa n’ebe ndị mbuso agha ikpeazụ ka siri ike dị na Idlib nọ emepụtala ohere ij wee na achụ okwu ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị.

rows.source: The Russian-Turkish deal averted a large-scale assault by Russian-backed Syrian forces on the province, where three million people live.
rows.output: Nkwekọrịta Rọshịa-Tọrọk kwụsịrị mwakpo buru ibu nke ndị agha Siria nke Rọshịa na-akwado na mpaghara ahụ, ebe nde mmadụ atọ bi.
rows.reference: Mkpebi Russian-Turkish ahụ kwụsịrị nnukwu nluso agha nke ndị agha Syria ndị Russia na akwadobe na mpaghara ahụ, ebe ọnụọgụ nde 3 ndị mmadu bi.

rows.source: Moualem however stressed that the agreement had "clear deadlines" and expressed hope that military action will target jihadists including fighters from the Al-Qaeda-linked Nusra Front, who "will be eradicated."
rows.output: Moualem kwuru na nkwekọrịta ahụ nwere "oge doro anya" ma kwupụta olileanya na a ga-elekwasị anya n'ịlụ ọgụ megide ndị jihadists gụnyere ndị agha sitere na Nusra Front nke jikọtara ya na Al-Qaeda, bụ ndị "ga-akwatu."
rows.reference: Moualem kaosiladị kwụsịrị ike na nkwekọrịta ahụ nwere “oge njedebe ndị doro anya” ma kwupute olile anya na mmereme ndị agha ga-achụba ndị jihadist gụnyere ndị ọgụ si na Nusra Front jikọrọ al-Qaeda, ndị “ ga-ekpochapụ.”

rows.source: UN envoy Staffan de Mistura is hoping to soon convene the first meetings of a new committee comprised of government and opposition members to draft a post-war constitution for Syria and pave the way to elections.
rows.output: Onye nnọchite anya UN Staffan de Mistura na-atụ anya imepe nnọkọ mbụ nke otu ọhụrụ nke ndị otu gọọmentị na ndị mmegide ga-eso dee iwu mgbe agha gasịrị maka Siria ma mee ka ụzọ maka ntuli aka.
rows.reference: Onye ozi UN Staffan de Mistura na atụ anya ịme nzụkọ izizi ndị ahụ nke ọgbakọ ọhụrụ emepụtara n’ime ndị gọọmentị na ndị otu mbuso agha iji depụta akwụkwọ iwu osote ọgụ maka Syria ma dozie ụzọ maka ntuli aka.

rows.source: Moualem laid out conditions for the Syrian government's participation in the committee, saying the panel's work should be restricted "to reviewing the articles of the current constitution," and warned against interference.
rows.output: Moualem tọrọ ntọala maka itinye aka na gọọmentị Siria n'ime kọmiti ahụ, na-ekwu na ọrụ kọmiti ahụ kwesịrị igbochi "ịlele isiakwụkwọ nke iwu dị ugbu a," ma dọọ aka ná ntị megide ịbanye n'ọrụ.
rows.reference: Moualem tụsara ọnọdụ maka nsonye gọọmentị Syria n’ọgbakọ ahụ, na ekwu na ọrụ ọgbakọ ahụ kwesịrị ka amachie ya na “inyocha edemede nke akwụkwọ iwu dị ugbu a,” ma dọọ aka na ntị maka itinye aka.

rows.source: Why Trump Will Win a Second Term
rows.output: Gịnị mere Trump ga-eji merie oche nke abụọ
rows.reference: Ihe Kpatara Na Trump Ga-emeri Agba Nke Abụọ

rows.source: By that logic, Mr. Trump would win re-election in 2020 unless, as many liberal viewers are probably hoping, impeachment and scandal end his presidency prematurely.
rows.output: N'ụzọ ahụ, Maazị Trump ga-emeri ntuli aka 2020 ma ọ bụrụ na, dị ka ọtụtụ ndị na-ele anya n'aka ekpe nwere ike ịnọgide na-atụ anya, a ga-achụpụ ya n'ọkwa ọchịchị tupu oge ya eruo.
rows.reference: Site na echiche ahụ, Maazị Trump ga-emeri nhọpụtagharị na 2020 belụsọ na, ebe imirikiti ndị nghọta ezi uche nwere ike ị na atụ anya, mwepu n’oche na agwa ọjọọ ga-akwụsị ọchịchị ya n’oge.

rows.source: In what would no doubt be "The most dramatic finale of a presidency ever!"
rows.output: N'ime ihe nke ga-abụ "Iyi kacha n'atụghị egwu nke ọchịchị n'ọgwụgwụ!"
rows.reference: N’ihe ga-abụ na enweghị mgbagha “Ngwụcha ikpeazụ nke onye isi ala kachasị dị egwu!”

rows.source: As of now, there are no signs of viewer fatigue.
rows.output: N'ezie, enweghị ihe ịrịba ama nke ike ọgwụgwụ onye na-ekiri.
rows.reference: Ugbu a, enweghị mgbama nke ike ọgwụgwụ nke nlele.

rows.source: Since 2014, prime-time ratings have more than doubled to 1.05 million at CNN and nearly tripled to 1.6 million at MSNBC.
rows.output: N'afọ 2014, ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị na-ekiri oge kacha mma abawanyela ihe karịrị nde mmadụ 1.05 na CNN, ma ọ fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ okpukpu atọ ruo nde mmadụ 1.6 na MSNBC.
rows.reference: Kemgbe 2014, ogo oge-mgbasa ozi kachasị agbagoola mkpị ruru nde 1.05 na CNN ebe ọ fọdụrụ ntakịrị ka ọ gbagoo mkpị atọ na nde 1.6 na MSNBC.

rows.source: Fox News has an average of 2.4 million prime-time viewers, up from 1.7 million four years ago, according to Nielsen, and MSNBC's "The Rachel Maddow Show" has topped cable ratings with as many as 3.5 million viewers on major news nights.
rows.output: N'afọ 2017, ọchịchị ahụ wepụrụ ihe karịrị ijeri $ 1.5 n'ụlọọgwụ, ụlọ ọgwụ na ụlọ ọrụ ahụike ndị ọzọ, ma nyekwa iwu ka e wepụta ego ndị ọzọ ijeri $ 1 iji kwado ụlọ ọrụ ndị a n'afọ ndị na-abịa.
rows.reference: Fox News nwere ndị nlele oge mgbasa ozi kachasị bụ nde 2.4, gbagoro nde 1.7 n’afọ anọ gara aga, ka Nielsen si kọwaa, na MSNBC “The Rachel Maddow Show” anọrọla n’isi ogo kebụl site na iji ndị nlele nde 3.5 n’abalị akụkọ ndị dị oke mkpa mere.

rows.source: "This is a fire that people are being drawn to because it's not something we understand," said Neal Baer, show runner of the ABC drama "Designated Survivor," about a cabinet secretary who becomes president after an attack destroys the Capitol.
rows.output: "Nke a bụ ọkụ nke ndị mmadụ na-adọta n'ihi na ọ bụghị ihe anyị ghọtara," ka Neal Baer, onye na-ahazi ihe nkiri ABC "Designated Survivor," kwuru, banyere onye odeakwụkwọ kabinet nke ghọrọ onye isi ala mgbe mwakpo na-emebi Capitol.
rows.reference: “Nke a bụ ọkụ a na adọta ndị mmadụ na ya n’ihi ọ bụ ihe anyị na aghọta,” Neal Baer kwuru, onye ọmenka nke ejije ABC bụ “Designated Survivor,” bụ maka ọde akwụkwọ kabinet bụrụ onye isi ala ka mbuso agha mebichara Capitol.

rows.source: Nell Scovell, a veteran comedy writer and author of "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," has another theory.
rows.output: Nell Scovell, onye na-ede ihe nkiri na onye dere akwukwo "Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," nwere echiche ozo.
rows.reference: Nell Scovell, ọdee ihe ọchị ama ama yana ọdee akwụkwọ nke “Just the Funny Parts: And a Few Hard Truths About Sneaking Into the Hollywood Boys" Club," nwere echiche ọzọ.

rows.source: She remembers a cab ride in Boston before the 2016 election.
rows.output: Ọ na-echeta njem ụgbọ ala na Boston tupu ntuli aka nke afọ 2016.
rows.reference: Ọ chetara ọnyịnya ụgbọ ala na Boston tupu nhọpụta 2016.

rows.source: The driver told her he would be voting for Mr. Trump.
rows.output: Onye ọkwọ ụgbọ ala ahụ gwara ya na ọ ga-eme ntuli aka maka Maazị Trump.
rows.reference: Ọkwọ ụgbọ ahụ gwara ya na ọ ga-atụnyere Maazị Trump.

rows.source: Why? she asked.
rows.output: Gịnị kpatara? o jụrụ.
rows.reference: Maka gịnị? ọ jụrụ.

rows.source: "He said, "Because he makes me laugh,"" Ms. Scovell told me.
rows.output: "O kwuru, "N'ihi na ọ na-eme m ọchị,"" Ms. Scovell gwara m.
rows.reference: “O kwuru, “N’ihi ọ na eme ka m chịa ọchị,”” Nwada Scovell gwara m.

rows.source: There is entertainment value in the chaos.
rows.output: Ọ dị ihe na-atọ ụtọ n'ọgba aghara ahụ.
rows.reference: Enwere uru ntụrụndụ n’ọgbaghara ahụ.

rows.source: Of course, unlike anything else on TV, the story lines coming out of Washington could determine the future of Roe v. Wade, whether immigrant families can reunite and the health of the global economy.
rows.output: N'ezie, dị iche na ihe ọ bụla ọzọ na TV, ahịrị akụkọ na-esi Washington pụta nwere ike ikpebi ọdịnihu nke Roe v. Wade, ma ezinụlọ mbata nwere ike ịgbakọta ọnụ, na ahụike akụ na ụba zuru ụwa ọnụ.
rows.reference: N’ezie, nke na adịghị ka ihe ọzọ na Igwe onyonyoo, akụkọ ndị si na Washington apụta ga-ekpebi ọdịnihu nke Roe v. Wade, ma ndị ezinụlọ ndị gbabatara n’obodo nwere ike ijikọtagharị yana ọdịmma nke akụnụba ụwa.

rows.source: Tuning out is a luxury only the most privileged viewers can afford.
rows.output: Iwepu bụ ihe naanị ndị na-ekiri nwere akụ na ụba nwere ike ịzụta.
rows.reference: Iwepu uche bụ okomoko naanị ndị nlele ji ego nwere ike ịmenwu.

rows.source: And yet, it goes beyond being an informed citizen when you find yourself on hour six of watching a panel of experts debate Bob Woodward's use of "deep background" sourcing for his book "Fear," Paul Manafort's $15,000 ostrich-leather bomber jacket ("a garment thick with hubris," The Washington Post said) and the implications of Stormy Daniels's lurid descriptions of Mr. Trump's, um, anatomy.
rows.output: Ọbụna, ọ na-aga n'ihu karịa ịbụ onye ọchịchị nwere ọgụgụ isi mgbe ị na-ahụ onwe gị na awa isii na-ekiri otu ndị ọkachamara na-ekwu okwu banyere iji Bob Woodward "omimi ndabere" maka akwụkwọ ya "Ọnwụ," Paul Manafort's $15,000 ostrich-leather bomber jacket ("ihe eji eme ihe dị arọ nke ọma," The Washington Post kwuru) na ihe ọ pụtara.
rows.reference: Mana ka ọ dị ugbu a, ọ gafere ịbụ onye amaala ma ihe na eme mgbe ị chọtara onwe gị n’elekere isii nke ị na elele ogwe ndị ọkachamara rụrịta ụka maka ojiji Bob Woodward nke isi “okirikiri miri emi” maka akwụkwọ ya “Fear,” uwe ahụ bọmba akpụkpụ ostrich nke Paul Manafort bụ $15,000 (“uwe juputara na hubris,” The Washington Post kwuru) yana ndapụta nke nkọwapụta Stormy Daniels maka anụahụ Maazị Trump jọrọ njọ.

rows.source: I, for one, will never look at Super Mario the same way again.
rows.output: M, nke ọ bụla, agaghị m ele Super Mario anya otu ihe ọzọ.
rows.reference: M, agaghị ele Super Mario anya otu m si ahụbu ya ọzọ.

rows.source: "Part of what he's doing that makes it feel like a reality show is that he is feeding you something every night," said Brent Montgomery, chief executive of Wheelhouse Entertainment and the creator of "Pawn Stars," about the Trump show's rotating cast and daily plot twists (picking a fight with the N.F.L., praising Kim Jong-un).
rows.output: "Otu n'ime ihe ọ na-eme nke na-eme ka ọ dị ka ihe ngosi eziokwu bụ na ọ na-enye gị ihe ọ bụla abalị," ka Brent Montgomery, onye isi oche nke Wheelhouse Entertainment na onye okike nke "Pawn Stars," kwuru banyere ihe ngosi Trump na-agbanwe agbanwe na ihe na-eme kwa ụbọchị (ịlụ ọgụ na N.F.L., na-eto Kim Jong-un).
rows.reference: “Akụkụ nke ihe ọ na eme nke na eme ka ọ dị ka ihe ngosi ntụrụndụ bụ na ọ na enye gị otu ihe kwa abalị,” Brent Montgomery kwuru, onye isi oche nke Wheelhouse Entertainment yana onye mmepụta nke “Pawn Stars”, maka ihe ngosi nke Trump na agbanwe ndị nka yana ntụgharị akụkọ kwa ụbọchị (iluso N.F.L. ọgụ, ito Kim Jong-un).

rows.source: You can't afford to miss one episode or you're left behind.
rows.output: Ị gaghị akwụsị otu ihe omume ma ọ bụ na ị ga-ahapụ n'azụ.
rows.reference: Ị kwesịrị ịghara otu nsotanso ma ọ bụ aghara gị.

rows.source: When I reached Mr. Fleiss this week, it was a sunny 80 degrees outside his home on the north shore of Kauai, but he was holed up inside watching MSNBC while recording CNN.
rows.output: Mgbe m rutere Mr. Fleiss n'izu a, ọ dị mma 80 degrees n'èzí ụlọ ya n'akụkụ ugwu nke Kauai, ma ọ nọ n'ime ya na-ekiri MSNBC ebe ọ na-edekọ CNN.
rows.reference: Mgbe m nwetara Maazị Fleiss n’izu a, anyanwụ nọ na acha digri 80 na ilo be ya dị n’akụkụ osimiri nke ugwu nke Kauai, mana ọ n’ime ụlọ na elele MSNBC ebe ọ na edekọ CNN.

rows.source: He couldn't peel himself away, not with Brett Kavanaugh set to face the Senate Judiciary Committee and the future of the Supreme Court hanging in the balance.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị mgbe ọ ga-ekewa onwe ya, ọbụna na Brett Kavanaugh ga-eche ihu Senate Judiciary Committee na ọdịnihu nke Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu na-ese n'elu mmiri.
rows.reference: Ọ nwenwughi ike ịdọpụ onwe ya, ọbụghị ka Brett Kavanaugh chọrọ izute Ọgbakọ Ndị Ikpe nke Nzụkọ Ọmeiwu yana ọdịnihu nke Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị kodoro n’ikuku.

rows.source: "I remember when we were doing all those crazy shows back in the day and people said, "This is the beginning of the end of Western civilization,"" Mr. Fleiss told me.
rows.output: "Ana m mụta mgbe anyị na-eme ihe ngosi ndị ahụ na-adịghị mma n'oge ahụ, ndị mmadụ kwuru, "Nke a bụ mmalite njedebe nke obodo ọdịda anyanwụ."
rows.reference: “M chetara mgbe anyị na eme ihe ngosi nzuzu ndị ahụ niile n’oge ochie, ndị mmadụ kwuru, “Nke a bụ mbido nke njedebe mmepe ndị ọdịda anyanwụ,”” Maazị Fleiss gwara m.

rows.source: "I thought it was sort of a joke, but it turns out they were right."
rows.output: "Nụrụ m na ọ bụ ụdị ọchị, ma ọ tụgharịrị na ha nọ n'ezigbo ihe."
rows.reference: “M chere na ọ bụ njakịrị, mana ọ pụtara na ha ziri ezi.”

rows.source: Amy Chozick, a writer at large for The Times covering business, politics and media, is the author of the memoir "Chasing Hillary."
rows.output: Amy Chozick, onye edemede na-ede akwụkwọ maka The Times, na-ekpuchi azụmahịa, ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị na mgbasa ozi, bụ onye edemede nke akwụkwọ akụkọ "Chasing Hillary."
rows.reference: Amy Chozick, ọdee akwụkwọ maka The Times na ekpuchi azụmahịa, ndọrọndọrọ na mgbasa ozi, bụ ọdee akwụkwọ nke ihe ncheta “Chasing Hillary.”

rows.source: Outside money floods into tightest midterm election House races
rows.output: Mgbasa ozi ego na-efesa n'ọsọ ndị omebe iwu nke etiti
rows.reference: Ewepuga nsọbanye ego n’agbamọsọ nhọpụta etiti afọ kachasị sie ike maka House

rows.source: It's not surprising that Pennsylvania's 17th is seeing a flood of cash, thanks to a realignment of a congressional districts that landed two incumbents in a race for the same seat.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị ihe ijuanya na Pennsylvania's 17th na-ahụ nnukwu ego na-abata, n'ihi nhazi nke mpaghara ndị omeiwu nke tinyere ndị na-achịbu abụọ n'ọsọ maka oche otu.
rows.reference: Ọ bụghị ihe ntụnanya na Pennsylvannia nke 17th na ahụ nsọbanye ego, ekele dịịrị nhazigharị nke ogige ndị kọngress nwetara mmadụ abụọ nọ n’ọchịchị ka ha banye n’ọsọ maka otu oche ahụ.

rows.source: This recently redrawn suburban Pittsburg district pits Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - who won his seat in another district in a special election last spring.
rows.output: Nke a na-emegharị nso nso a mpaghara ndịda Pittsburg na-egosi onye omebe iwu Democrat Rep. Conor Lamb - onye meriri oche ya na mpaghara ọzọ na ntuli aka pụrụ iche ikpeazụ n'oge opupu ihe ubi.
rows.reference: Ogige ime obodo Pittsburg esegharịrị nso nso a dowere Rep. Demokrats Conor Lamb - onye meriri oche ya n’ogige ọzọ na nhọpụta pụrụ iche emere na spring gara aga.

rows.source: Lamb is running against another incumbent, Republican Keith Rothfus, who currently represents the old Pennsylvania 12th district, which overlaps heavily with the new 17th.
rows.output: Mgbọrọgwụ na-agba ọsọ megide onye ọzọ na-achị achị, Keith Rothfus Republican, onye na-anọchite anya mpaghara Pennsylvania ochie 12, nke na-ejikọta nke ukwuu na nke 17 ọhụrụ.
rows.reference: Lamb na azọcha ya onye ọzọ nọkwa n’ọchịchị, Repọblikan Keith Rothfus, onye nke na anọchite ogige Pennsylvania 12th ugbu a, nke na amachi nnukwu n’elu 17th ọhụrụ.

rows.source: The maps were redrawn after the Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled in January that the old districts were unconstitutionally gerrymandered in Republicans' favor.
rows.output: Mpaghara ahụ gbanwere mgbe Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu nke Pennsylvania kpebiri na January na mpaghara ochie ahụ gbagọrọ agbagọ n'usoro iwu n'ụzọ na-akwado ndị Republican.
rows.reference: Esegharịrị maapụ ndị ahụ ka Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị nke Pennsylvania mara ikpe na Jenụwarị na ekewapụrụ ogige ndị ochie ahụ n’ụzọ gabigara iwu obodo iji menyere ndị Repoblikan.

rows.source: The race in the new 17th has touched off a campaign finance slugfest between the major party finance arms, the Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) and the National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).
rows.output: Ogige n'ime ọhịa nke iri na asaa emewo ka ọgụ ego malite n'etiti ngalaba ego nke otu ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị abụọ ahụ bụ, Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) na National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).
rows.reference: Agbamọsọ ahụ dị na 17th ọhụrụ ebidola nsọbanye ego mgbasa ozi n’etiti ndi nkwado ego ndọrọndọrọ ndi kachasi, nke Democratic Campaign Congressional Committee (DCCC) yana National Republican Campaign Committee (NRCC).

rows.source: Lamb became a familiar name in Pennsylvania after a narrow win in a widely watched in March special election for Pennsylvania's 18th Congressional District.
rows.output: Lamb ghọrọ aha a maara nke ọma na Pennsylvania mgbe mmeri dị gịrịgịrị na ntuli aka pụrụ iche nke March maka mpaghara Pennsylvania nke 18th Congressional District.
rows.reference: Lamb bụrụ aha ama ama na Pennsylvania ka ọ nwechara ntakịrị mmeri na nhọpụta pụrụ iche emere na Machị nke ọtụtụ ndị mmadụ lelere maka Ogige Kọngress Pennsylvania nke 18th.

rows.source: That seat had been held by a Republican for over a decade, and President Donald Trump won the district by 20 points.
rows.output: Oche ahụ nọ na ndị Republican kemgbe ọtụtụ afọ, onyeisiala Donald Trump meriri mpaghara ahụ site na isi iri abụọ.
rows.reference: Onye Repọblikan ji oche ahụ kemgbe afọ iri, Onye Isi Ala Donald Trump ji akara 20 wee merie ogige ahụ.

rows.source: Political pundits have given Democrats a slight edge.
rows.output: Ndị ọkachamara n'ihe gbasara ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị enyela ndị Democrats obere uru.
rows.reference: Ndị ọkachamara ndọrọndọrọ enyela ndị Demọkrats obere nzọụkwụ n’ihu.

rows.source: U.S. Weighed Penalizing El Salvador Over Support for China, Then Backed Off
rows.output: Ndị U.S. na-atụle ịmanye ntaramahụhụ na El Salvador maka nkwado ya maka China, wee kwụsị
rows.reference: U.S. Echere Ịnye El Salvador Ntaramahụhụ Maka Ịkwado China, Wee Kwụsị

rows.source: Diplomats noted that the Dominican Republic and Panama had already recognized Beijing, with little pushback from Washington.
rows.output: Ndị nnọchiteanya ahụ kwuru na Dominican Republic na Panama ewerela China n'ọrụ, na enweghị nnukwu mmegide sitere n'aka Washington.
rows.reference: Ndị nnọchite anya rịbara ama na Dominican Republic na Panama akwadola Beijing, enwere obere mgbochi si na Washington.

rows.source: Mr. Trump had a warm meeting with President Juan Carlos Varela of Panama in June 2017 and had a hotel in Panama until partners evicted the Trump Organization's management team.
rows.output: Ọkachamara Trump nwere nzukọ na-ekpo ọkụ na Onye isi ala Juan Carlos Varela nke Panama na June 2017 na o nwere ụlọ oriri na ọṅụṅụ na Panama ruo mgbe ndị mmekọ chụpụrụ otu ndị njikwa ụlọ ọrụ Trump.
rows.reference: Maazị Trump nwere nzụkọ dị mma n’etiti Onye Isi Ala Juan Carlos Varela nke Panama na Juun 2017 ma banye n’ụlọ nkwari akụ na Panama ruo mgbe ndị mmekọ chụpụrụ otu njikwa nke Ọgbakọ Trump.

rows.source: State Department officials decided to call back the American chiefs of diplomatic missions from El Salvador, the Dominican Republic and Panama over the "recent decisions to no longer recognize Taiwan," Heather Nauert, the department's spokeswoman, said in a statement early this month.
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ Ụlọ Ọrụ Steeti kpebiri ịkpọghachi ndị isi ụlọ ọrụ ndị nnọchi anya America na El Salvador, Dominican Republic na Panama n'ihi "mkpebi ndị na-adịbeghị anya ịkwụsị ịmata Taiwan," ka Heather Nauert, onye na-ekwuchitere ụlọ ọrụ ahụ kwuru n'okwu a n'isi ọnwa a.
rows.reference: Ndị ụlọ ọrụ Ngalaba Steeti kpebiri ịkpọghachite ndị isi njem nnọchite anya ndị America si El Salvador, Dominican Republic na Panama maka “mkpebi nso nso iji kwụsị ịkwado Taiwan,” Heather Nauert, onye okwu okwu nke ngalaba ahụ, kwuru na nkwupute na mbido ọnwa a.

rows.source: But penalties were only considered against El Salvador, which received an estimated $140 million in American aid in 2017, including for narcotics controls, development and economic support.
rows.output: Ma ọ bụ naanị ntaramahụhụ ka a na-atụle megide El Salvador, nke nwetara ihe dị ka nde $140 na enyemaka America na 2017, gụnyere maka ọgwụ na-egbochi, mmepe na nkwado akụ na ụba.
rows.reference: Mana atụlere ntaramahụhụ naanị maka El Salvador, nke nwetara ihe rutere ọnụọgụ nde $140 n’enyemaka si n’aka America na 2017, gụnyere njikwa ọgwụ ike, nkwado ntolite na akụnụba.

rows.source: The proposed penalties, which included cuts to financial aid and targeted visa restrictions, would have been painful for the Central American country and its high unemployment and murder rates.
rows.output: Ntuziaka ndị a tụrụ aro, nke gụnyere mbelata ego enyemaka ego na mmachi visa, gaara adị egwu maka obodo America etiti na ọnụ ọgụgụ enweghị ọrụ dị elu na ọnụ ọgụgụ igbu ọchụ.
rows.reference: Ntaramahụhụ ndị ahụ atụnyere, nke gụnyere mgbubi n’enyemaka ego yana mmachi visa ndị a ga-ezube iche, kwesịrị ịbụ ihe nhịahụ maka obodo Central America ahụ yana ogo enweghị ọrụ na igbu mmadụ ya.

rows.source: As internal meetings progressed, North American and Central American officials postponed a high-level conference focused on security and economic prosperity to follow up a similar gathering last year that was seen as a step forward in efforts to prevent migrants from heading to the United States.
rows.output: Ka ọ na-erule ugbu a, ndị ọrụ sitere na North America na Central America kwụsịrị nzukọ dị elu nke lekwasịrị anya na nchekwa na ọganihu akụ na ụba iji soro nzukọ yiri nke ahụ n'afọ gara aga nke a na-ewere dị ka ihe ọzọ na mbọ iji gbochie ndị na-achọ ịbanye na United States.
rows.reference: Ka nzụkọ ime ụlọ gara n’ihu, ndị ọrụ North America na Central America bugharịrị ọgbakọ ogo-dị-elu gbadoro anya na nchedo na ntolite akụnụba iji sochie otu mgbakọta ụdịrị ahụ n’afọ gara aga nke ahụrụ ka nzọụkwụ n’ọganihu na mbọ iji gbochie ndị mgbabata n’obodo na ịga na United States.

rows.source: But by mid-September, top administration officials made clear that they wanted the conference to go forward, effectively ending any consideration of penalties for El Salvador.
rows.output: Ma ozugbo n'etiti ọnwa Septemba, ndị isi ọchịchị kacha elu gosipụtara na ha chọrọ ka ogbako ahụ gaa n'ihu, nke mere ka a kwụsị iche echiche banyere ntaramahụhụ maka El Salvador.
rows.reference: Mana tupu etiti-Septemba, ndị ọrụ nchịkwa dị elu mere ka o doo anya na ha chọrọ ka nzụkọ ahụ gaa n’ihu, na akwụsị ntụle ọ bụla maka ntaramahụhụ maka El Salvador ozugbo.

rows.source: Vice President Mike Pence is now slated to address the conference, now scheduled for mid-October, in a signal of the import the administration places on the gathering, the diplomats said.
rows.output: Onye isi ala bụ Mike Pence ga-ekwu okwu na nzukọ ahụ, nke a ga-eme na etiti Ọktoba, dị ka ihe ịrịba ama nke mkpa ọ dị n'ọgbakọ ahụ, ndị nnọchi anya ahụ kwuru.
rows.reference: Atọrọ ka Osote Onye Isi Ala Mike Pence zute ọgbakọ ahụ, nke atọrọ ugbu a na etiti-Ọktoba, na mgbama nke mkpa nke nchịkwa ahụ dowere na nzụkọ ndị ahụ, ndị nnọchite anya ahụ kwuru.

rows.source: And the three American envoys quietly returned to El Salvador, Panama and the Dominican Republic with no new tough messages or punishments from Washington.
rows.output: Ọ dị mma, ndị nnọchiteanya America atọ ahụ laghachiri n'udo na El Salvador, Panama, na Dominican Republic na-enweghị ozi ọhụrụ siri ike ma ọ bụ ntaramahụhụ sitere na Washington.
rows.reference: Ndị ozi America atọ ahụ jiri nwayọ laghachi El Salvador, Panama na Dominican Republic na enweghị ozi ike ma ọ bụ ntaramahụhụ ọhụrụ si na Washington.

rows.source: A White House spokesman for Mr. Bolton declined to comment on the details of the debate that were described by the three American officials, including two diplomats, who agreed to discuss the internal deliberations on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: Onye na-ekwuchitere Ụlọ White House maka Maazị Bolton ajụrụ ịgwa okwu banyere nkọwa nke arụmụka ahụ nke ndị ọrụ America atọ kọwara, gụnyere ndị nnọchi anya abụọ, bụ ndị kwetara ikwu banyere mkparịta ụka n'ime ụlọ n'okpuru ọnọdụ aha na-amaghị.
rows.reference: Onye nkwuchite White House maka Maazị Bolton jụrụ ikwu okwu na nkọwapụta nke nrụrịta ụka ahụ nke ndị ọrụ America atọ ahụ kọwara, gụnyere ndị nnọchite anya abụọ, ndị kwenyere ịkparịta arụmarụ ndị ime ụlọ ahụ n’ọnọdụ nke nzuzo.

rows.source: Their accounts were corroborated by an outside analyst who is close to the administration and also spoke on the condition of anonymity.
rows.output: Nkwenye ha nke ndị ọkachamara nọ n'èzí nyere, onye na-akwado ọchịchị ma na-ekwu okwu n'amaghị aha.
rows.reference: Onye nyocha mpụga kwadoro akụkọ ha, onye nọ nso na nchịkwa ahụ ma kwukwaa okwu n’ọnọdụ nke nzuzo.

rows.source: Study History
rows.output: Mụọ akụkọ ihe mere eme
rows.reference: Ndekọ Mmụta

rows.source: The next shoe to drop could be the special counsel Robert Mueller's report on Mr. Trump's possible obstruction of justice, of which there now is very substantial evidence in the public record.
rows.output: Onye ọzọ na-akụtu nwere ike ịbụ akụkọ pụrụ iche Robert Mueller banyere ihe Maazị Trump nwere ike igbochi ikpe ziri ezi, nke enwere ihe akaebe dị ukwuu n'akwụkwọ ndekọ ọha ugbu a.
rows.reference: Akpụkpụ ụkwụ na esote a ga-edowe nwere ike ịbụ mkpesa nke kansụl pụrụ iche nke Robert Mueller maka ọmụme ndachi nke akwụmọtọ n’aka Maazị Trump, nke enwere ihe akaebe doro anya dị na ndekọ ọhaneze.

rows.source: Mr. Mueller is reportedly also turning his investigation to whether Mr. Trump's campaign colluded with Russia in its attack on our elections.
rows.output: Nna-ukwu Mueller na-ekwu na ọ na-enyocha ma mkpọsa Mr. Trump ọ̀ na-emekọ ihe na Rọ́ṣíà n'oge mwakpo ha wakporo ntuli aka anyị.
rows.reference: Ekpesara na Maazị Mueller na atụgharịkwa ka nyocha ya bụrụ ma ndị mgbasa ozi Maazị Trump na Russia ejikọrọ aka na mbuso agha ya na ntuli aka anyị.

rows.source: Should Congress change hands, Mr. Trump will find himself facing accountability in that body, just as he prepares to go again before the voters, and perhaps eventually a jury of his peers.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na ndị omeiwu gbanwee akụkụ, Maazị Trump ga-ahụ onwe ya na-eche ịza ajụjụ n'ime ahụ, ka ọ na-akwado ịga ọzọ n'ihu ndị ntuli aka, ma eleghị anya n'ikpe nke ndị ọgbọ ya.
rows.reference: Kọngress ahụ ekwesịrị ịgbanwe aka, Maazị Trump ga-ahụ onwe ya na eche ajụjụ na nke ahụ, ka ọ na akwadobe ịga ọzọ n’ihu ndị ntuli aka, ma ikekwe emechaa n’ihu ndị ọkaikpe nke ndị ọgbọ ya.

rows.source: That is a lot of ifs, and I do not mean to suggest that Mr. Trump's fall is inevitable - nor that of his equivalents in Europe.
rows.output: Nke ahụ bụ ọtụtụ ma ọ bụrụ, anaghị m ekwu na m na-atụ aro na ọdịda Maazị Trump bụ ihe a na-apụghị izere ezere - ma ọ bụ nke ndị ha nhata na Europe.
rows.reference: Nke ahụ bụ ọtụtụ enwee ike, ọ bụghị na m chọrọ ịtụnye na ọdịda Maazị Trump ga-abịarịrị - ma ọ bụ nke ndị otu ya na Europe.

rows.source: There are choices to be made by all of us on both sides of the Atlantic that will affect how prolonged the struggle may be.
rows.output: Enwere nhọrọ ndị a ga-eme site n'aka anyị niile n'akụkụ abụọ nke Oké Osimiri Atlantic nke ga-emetụta ka ogologo oge agha ahụ ga-adị.
rows.reference: Enwere mkpebi anyị niile ga-eme n’akụkụ abụọ nke Atlantik ga-emetụta ogologo oge ole mgba ahụ ga-abụ.

rows.source: In 1938, German officers were ready to stage a coup d"état against Hitler, if only the West had resisted him and backed the Czechoslovaks at Munich.
rows.output: N'afọ 1938, ndị ọrụ German dị njikere ịkwatu Hitler, ma ọ bụrụ na naanị ndị ọdịda anyanwụ na-emegide ya ma kwado ndị Czechoslovak na Munich.
rows.reference: Na 1938, ndị ọrụ Germany dị njikere ịnapụ ọchịchị n’aka Hitler, ọ bụrụ na Ọdịda Anyanwụ gbochiri ya ma kwadobe ndị Czechoslovaks na Munich.

rows.source: We failed, and missed an opportunity to avoid the years of carnage that ensued.
rows.output: Anyị dara, anyị tụfurukwa ohere ịzere ọgbaghara ndị ga-eme n’afọ ndị na-abịa.
rows.reference: Anyị dara, ma ghara ohere iji zere afọ nke nnukwu mbibi merenụ.

rows.source: The course of history pivots around such inflection points, and democracy's inexorable march is accelerated or delayed.
rows.output: Mgbanwe nke akụkọ ihe mere eme na-adabere na isi ihe ndị dị otú ahụ, na ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na-aga n'ihu na-aga n'ihu ma ọ bụ na-egbu oge.
rows.reference: Usoro nke akụkọ ala na agbagharị n’ụdịrị isi mgbanwe ahụ, ọgụga ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya na anaghị akwụsị akwụsị ga-aga n’ihu ma ọ bụ gbutu oge.

rows.source: Americans face several of these inflection points now.
rows.output: Ndị America na-eche ọtụtụ n'ime isi ihe ndị a ihu ugbu a.
rows.reference: Ndị America na eche ọtụtụ isi mgbanwe ugbu a.

rows.source: What will we do if Mr. Trump fires Deputy Attorney General Rod Rosenstein, the man who controls the fate of Mr. Mueller's investigation?
rows.output: Gịnị ka anyị ga-eme ma Maazị Trump chụpụ Maazị Rod Rosenstein, onye na-ahụ maka ọdịnihu nyocha Maazị Mueller?
rows.reference: Gịnị ka anyị ga-eme ma ọ bụrụ na Maazị Trump chụọ Osote Ọkaiwu Obodo General Rod Rosenstein, nwoke na ejikwa akaraka nke nyocha Maazị Mueller?

rows.source: Rosenstein has been in hot water ever since this paper reported that, last year, he suggested secretly recording the president and speculated about his being unfit for office.
rows.output: Ọkụ na-ekpo ọkụ n'ime mmiri nke ọ na-anọ na ya kemgbe akwụkwọ akụkọ a kọrọ na n'afọ gara aga, o kwuru na ya ga-edebe onyeisi oche na nzuzo ma na-eche banyere ịdị mma ya n'ọkwa ahụ.
rows.reference: Rosenstein anọrọla na nnukwu nsogbu kemgbe akwụkwọ a kpesara nke ahụ, afọ gara aga, ọ tụnyere ịdekọ onye isi ala na nzuzo ma boo ebubo na ọ dịghị mma maka ụlọ ọrụ.

rows.source: Mr. Rosenstein says The Times's account is inaccurate.
rows.output: Ọkammụta Rosenstein na-ekwu na akụkọ Times adịghị mma.
rows.reference: Maazị Rosentein kwuru akụkọ nke The Times ezighi ezi.

rows.source: "How will we respond if the newly requested F.B.I. investigation of Brett Kavanaugh is not full or fair - or if he is confirmed to the Supreme Court despite credible accusations of sexual assault and dishonest testimony?
rows.output: Kedu ka anyị ga-esi zaghachi ma ọ bụrụ na nyocha F.B.I. ọhụrụ banyere Brett Kavanaugh adịghị zuru oke ma ọ bụ nke ziri ezi—ma ọ bụ ma a kwadoro ya n'Ụlọikpe Kasị Elu n'agbanyeghị ebubo eboro ya nke mmetọ mmekọahụ na ikwu okwu ụgha?
rows.reference: “Kedu otu anyị ga-esi zaghachi ma ọ bụrụ na nnyocha F.B.I ọhụrụ arịrịọ maka Brett Kavanaugh emeghị n’uju ma ọ bụ dị mma - ma ọ bụ ọ bụrụ na etinye ya na Ụlọ Ikpe Kachasị agbanyeghị ebubo nke nwakpo nwanyị doro anya yana ihe akaebe na ezighi ezi?

rows.source: And above all, will we vote in the midterms for a Congress that will hold Mr. Trump accountable?
rows.output: Na n'elu nke a, ọ ga-abụ na anyị ga-eme ntuli aka na nkeji iri na ise maka ọgbakọ nke ga-aza ajụjụ Maazị Trump?
rows.reference: N’isi ihe niile, anyị ga-eme ntuli aka n’etiti afọ maka Kọngress nke ga-ejide Maazị Trump n’ọrụ?

rows.source: If we fail those tests, democracy will be in for a long winter.
rows.output: Ọ bụrụ na anyị emeghị nke ọma n'ule ndị ahụ, ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya ga-abata n'oge oyi ogologo.
rows.reference: Ọ bụrụ na anyị daa nnwale ndị ahụ, ọchịchị onye kwuo uche ya ga-akwadobe maka oge njụmoyi toro ogologo.

rows.source: But I believe we will not fail, because of the lesson I learned in Prague.
rows.output: Ma na-ekweta na anyị agaghị ada, n’ihi nkuzi m mụtara na Prague.
rows.reference: Mana ekwenyere m na anyị agaghị ada, n’ihi ihe ndị mụtara na Prague.

rows.source: My mother was a Czechoslovak Jew who was deported to Auschwitz by the same Nazi regime that once occupied my ambassadorial home.
rows.output: Nne m bụ ndị Juu Czechoslovakia bụ ndị e chụpụrụ n’Auschwitz site n’aka otu ọchịchị Nazi ahụ ji mee ka ụlọ nnọchite anya m bụrụ nke ha.
rows.reference: Nne m bụ onye Czechslovak Jew onye nke achụpụrụ na Auschwitz n’otu aka ndị ọchịchị Nazi ahụ nọchiri ụlọ ebe nnọchite m.

rows.source: She survived, immigrated to America and, 60 years later, sent me off to light Sabbath candles on that table bearing the swastika.
rows.output: Ọ dịghị mgbe ọ nwụrụ, kwaga America ma, afọ iri isii ka e mesịrị, o zigara m pụọ ịgbanye kandụl Sabbath n’ụlọ ahụ nke nwere ihe ịrịba ama.
rows.reference: Ọ dị ndụ, gbabata na America ma, ka afọ 60 gachara, zipuru m gaa kandụl Sabbath ọkụ n’elu tebul ahụ bụ swastika.

rows.source: With that as my heritage, how can I not be an optimist about our future?"
rows.output: N'ịbụ nke ahụ dị ka ihe nketa m, kedu ka m ga-esi ghara ịbụ onye ọkachamara n'atụmanya maka ọdịnihu anyị?
rows.reference: Ka nke ahụ bụ ọdịbendị m, kedu otu m ga-esi nwee ezigbo olile anya maka ọdịnihu anyị?”

rows.source: Norman Eisen, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, is the chairman of Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington and the author of "The Last Palace: Europe's Turbulent Century in Five Lives and One Legendary House."
rows.output: N'ụzọ dị iche, Norman Eisen, bụ onye nyocha nke dị elu na Ụlọ Ọrụ Brookings, bụ onyeisi oche nke Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington na onye edemede nke "The Last Palace: Europe's Turbulent Century in Five Lives and One Legendary House."
rows.reference: Norman Eisen, otu okenye na Ewumewu Brookings, bụ onye isi oche nke Ndị Amaala maka Ọrụ na Omume na Washington yana ọdee akwụkwọ nke “The Last Palace: Narị Afọ Ọgbaghara nke Europe na Five Lives and One Legendary House.”

rows.source: Rangers' Graham Dorrans optimistic ahead of Rapid Vienna clash
rows.output: Ndị Rangers' Graham Dorrans na-enwe nchekwube tupu ọgụ megide Rapid Vienna
rows.reference: Graham Dorrans nke Rangers nwere ezigbo olile anya maka asọmpi Rapid Vienna

rows.source: Rangers host Rapid Vienna on Thursday, knowing that victory over the Austrians, following the impressive draw in Spain against Villarreal earlier this month, will put them in a strong position to qualify from Group G of the Europa League.
rows.output: Ndị Rangers na-anabata Rapid Vienna na Tọzdee, na-amata na mmeri megide ndị Austria, na-esochi egwuregwu na-atọ ụtọ na Spain megide Villarreal n'ọnwa gara aga, ga-etinye ha n'ọnọdụ siri ike iji nweta oghere na Group G nke asọmpi Europa League.
rows.reference: Ndị Rangers na anabata Rapid Vienna na Tọsde, mara na mmeri n’elu ndị Austria ahụ, sotere egwu onye laba onye laba mara mma agbara na Spain n’etiti Villareal na mbido ọnwa a, ga-etinye ha n’ọnọdụ siri ike iji tozue pụta na Otu G nke Europa League.

rows.source: A knee injury prevented midfielder Graham Dorrans from making his first appearance of the season until the 2-2 draw with Villarreal but he believes Rangers can use that result as a springboard to greater things.
rows.output: Mmerụ ikpere gbochiri onye etiti egwuregwu Graham Dorrans ịbụ onye mbụ ga-egwu n'oge a ruo mgbe ha dọọrọ aka ná ntị na Villarreal, ma o kwenyere na Rangers nwere ike iji nsonaazụ ahụ dị ka ihe na-akpali akpali maka ihe ndị ka ukwuu.
rows.reference: Ahụ mmerụ n’ikpere gbochiri onye etiti Graham Dorrans n’ime mpụta izizi nke afọ asọmpi ahụ ruo mgbe egwuregwu 2-2 dị n’etiti Villareal mana ọ kwenyere Rangers nwere ike iji nsonaazụ ahụ dị ka nzọụkwụ iji mee ihe ndị dị egwu.

rows.source: "It was a good point for us because Villarreal are a good side," said the 31-year-old.
rows.output: "Ọ dị mma n'ihi na Villarreal bụ otu dị mma," ka onye dị afọ 31 kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụ ezigbo akara maka anyị n’ihi Villareal bụ ezigbo akụkụ,” nke onye afọ 31 ahụ kwuru.

rows.source: "We went into the game believing we could get something and came away with a point.
rows.output: Anyị banyere n'egwuregwu ahụ na-ekwere na anyị nwere ike nweta ihe ọ bụla ma si na ya pụta na otu isi.
rows.reference: “Anyị banyere egwuregwu ahụ kwete na anyị nwere ike ịnwete ihe ma jiri otu akara wee pụta.

rows.source: Maybe we could have nicked it in the end but, overall, a draw was probably a fair result.
rows.output: Ma eleghị anya, anyị nwere ike ịtụfu ya n'ikpeazụ, mana, n'ozuzu, eserese bụ ikekwe nsonaazụ ziri ezi.
rows.reference: Ikekwe anyị kwesịrị ịnweta mmeri na ngwụcha mana, na nchịkọta, onye laba onye laba bụkwa nsonaazụ dị mma.

rows.source: They were probably better in the first half and we came out in the second half and were the better side.
rows.output: Ha nwere ike ime nke ọma na nkeji nke mbụ, anyị wee pụta na nkeji nke abụọ wee bụrụ akụkụ ka mma.
rows.reference: Ọ dị ka ha aka mma n’ọkara nke izizi, ma anyị pụtara n’ọkara nke abụọ ma bụrụ akụkụ ka mma.

rows.source: Going into Thursday, it's another big European night.
rows.output: N'abalị Tọzdee, ọ bụ abalị Europe ọzọ dị mkpa.
rows.reference: Ịbanye Tọsde, ọ bụ nnukwu abalị Europe ọzọ.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can get three points but that will be tough game because they had a good result in their last game but, with the crowd behind us, I'm sure we can push on and get a positive result.
rows.output: N'ezie, anyị nwere ike nweta isi atọ mana nke ahụ ga-adị egwu n'ihi na ha nwere ezigbo nsonaazụ n'egwuregwu ikpeazụ ha mana, na ìgwè mmadụ na-akwado anyị, ejighị m n'aka na anyị nwere ike ịkwado ma nweta nsonaazụ dị mma.
rows.reference: N’olile anya, anyị nwere ike ịnweta akara atọ mana ọ ga-esi ike n’ihi ha nwetara nsonaazụ mara mma n’egwuregwu ikpeazụ ha mana, ndị igwe mmadụ nọnyere anyị, adị m njikere na anyị nwere ike ịga n’ihu ma nweta nsonaazụ mara mma.

rows.source: Last year was definitely tough, between everything that happened with my injuries and the changes at the club itself but there's a feelgood factor about the place now.
rows.output: N'afọ gara aga siri ike n'ezie, n'etiti ihe ni ihe mere na mmerụ ahụ m na mgbanwe ndị dị na klọb n'onwe ya mana e nwere ihe na-eme ka obi dị ụtọ banyere ebe ahụ ugbu a.
rows.reference: Afọ ikpeazụ siri nnukwu ike, n’ime ihe niile mere ma ahụ mmerụ m yana mgbanwe n’otu asọmpi ahụ n’onwe ya mana enwere ezi mmụọ gbasara ebe ahụ ugbu a.

rows.source: The squad's good and the boys are really enjoying it; the training's good.
rows.output: Ndị otu ahụ dị mma ma ndị nwoke na-anụ ụtọ ya nke ukwuu; ọzụzụ ahụ dị mma.
rows.reference: Otu egwuregwu ahụ dị mma, ndị otu m nwoke na enwe ọhụụ ya; ọzụzụ dị mma.

rows.source: Hopefully, we can push on now, put last season behind us and be successful."
rows.output: Ọ ga-amasị anyị ịga n'ihu, hapụ oge ikpeazụ n'azụ anyị, ma nwee ihe ịga nke ọma."
rows.reference: N’olile anya, anyị nwere ike ịkwara gaba n’ihu ugbu a, tinye afọ asọmpi gara n’azụ anyị ma mee nke ọma.”

rows.source: Women are losing sleep over this retirement savings fear
rows.output: Ndị inyom na-akwa ákwá maka ụjọ a na-echekwa ezumike nka.
rows.reference: Ụmụ nwanyị na agbakasị ahụ n’ihi ụjọ ego nchekwa oge ezumike nka

rows.source: Despite the fact that survey participants had a clear idea of how they wanted to be cared for, few people were talking to their family members about it.
rows.output: N'agbanyeghị na ndị sonyere na nyocha ahụ nwere echiche doro anya banyere otú ha chọrọ ka e si elekọta ha, ụmụ mmadụ ole na ole na-ekwu okwu na ndị òtù ezinụlọ ha banyere ya.
rows.reference: Agbanyeghị n’eziokwu ndị sonyere na nyocha ahụ nwere alo doro anya otu ha siri chọọ ka elekọta ha, ndị mmadụ ole ma ole nọ na agwa ndị otu ezinụlọ okwu maka ya.

rows.source: About half of the individuals in the Nationwide study said they were speaking with their spouses about the cost of long-term care.
rows.output: N'ime ndị mmadụ n'otu n'otu n'ime ọmụmụ ihe mba ahụ, ihe dị ka ọkara kwuru na ha na ndị nwunye ha na-ekwurịta banyere ego nke nlekọta ogologo oge.
rows.reference: Ihe dị ka okara nke ndị mmadụ ahụ na mmụta Nationwide emere kwuru na ha na agwa di ma ọ bụ nwunye ha okwu gbasara ụgwọ nke nlekọta ogologo oge.

rows.source: Only 10 percent said they spoke with their kids about it.
rows.output: Naanị pasentị iri n'ime iri na abụọ kwuru na ha na-ekwu okwu na ụmụ ha banyere ya.
rows.reference: Naanị pasentị 10 kwuru na ha gwara ụmụaka ha maka ya.

rows.source: "People want a family member to care for them, but they aren't taking the steps to have the conversation," said Holly Snyder, vice president of Nationwide's life insurance business.
rows.output: "Ndi mmadu chọrọ onye ezinụlọ ka na-elekọta ha, ma ha anaghị ewere usoro iji nwee mkparịta ụka ahụ," ka Holly Snyder, osote onye isi oche nke azụmahịa mkpuchi ndụ nke mba niile kwuru.
rows.reference: “Ndị mmadụ chọrọ ka onye otu ezinụlọ ha lekọta ha, mana ha anaghị eme ihe ọ bụla iji kpaa nkata ahụ,” Holly Snyder kwuru, osote onye isi nke azụmahịa nchekwa ndụ nke Nationwide.

rows.source: Here's where to begin.
rows.output: Nke a bụ ebe ị ga-amalite.
rows.reference: Nke a bụ ebe ị ga-ebido.

rows.source: Talk to your spouse and the kids: You can't prepare your family to provide care if you don't make your wishes known well ahead of time.
rows.output: Kparịta ụka na nwunye gị na ụmụaka: Ị nweghị ike ịkwado ezinụlọ gị ịnye nlekọta ma ọ bụrụ na ị naghị ekwupụta ọchịchọ gị nke ọma tupu oge eruo.
rows.reference: Gwa nwunye ma ọ bụ dị gị yana ụmụaka: Ị nweghị ike ịkwadobe ezinụlọ gị iji nye nlekọta ma ọ bụrụ na i kwuputeghi ihe ndị ị chọrọ n’oge.

rows.source: Work with your advisor and your family to discuss where and how to receive care, as those choices can be a significant factor in determining the cost.
rows.output: Na-arụ ọrụ na onye ndụmọdụ gị na ezinụlọ gị ka ị kparịta ụka ebe na otú ị ga-esi nweta nlekọta, n'ihi na nhọrọ ndị a nwere ike ịbụ ihe dị mkpa na-ekpebi ọnụ ahịa.
rows.reference: Gị na onye ndụmọdụ gị na ezinụlọ gị rụkọta ọrụ iji kpakọrịta ebe yana otu a ga-esi nweta nlekọta, ebe nhọrọ ndị ahụ nwere ike ịbụ ihe ndị dị mkpa na ikpebi ụgwọ ya.

rows.source: Bring in your financial advisor: Your advisor can also help you come up with a way to pay for those expenses.
rows.output: Weta onye ndụmọdụ ego gị: Onye ndụmọdụ gị nwekwara ike inyere gị aka ịmepụta ụzọ ị ga-esi kwụọ ụgwọ ndị ahụ.
rows.reference: Webata onye ndụmọdụ ego gị: Onye ndụmọdụ nwekwara ike ịnyere gị aka ịtụnye ụzọ iji kwụọ ụgwọ maka mmefu ego ndị ahụ.

rows.source: Your funding choices for long-term care can include a traditional long-term care insurance policy, a hybrid cash-value life insurance policy to help cover these expenses or self-insuring with your own wealth - as long as you have the money.
rows.output: Ntọala gị maka nlekọta ogologo oge nwere ike ịgụnye amụma nlekọta nlekọta ogologo oge ọdịnala, amụma ndụ bara uru nke na-enyere aka kpuchie mmefu ndị a ma ọ bụ na-azụ onwe gị na akụ̀ na ụba gị - ma ọ bụrụhaala na ị nwere ego.
rows.reference: Nhọrọ ego gị maka nlekọta ogologo oge nwere ike ịgụnye iwu nchekwa nlekọta ogologo oge dị adị, iwu nchekwa ndụ uru-ego achịkọtara ọnụ iji nyere gị aka kpuchie mmefu ego ndị a ma ọ bụ nchekwa-onwe site na iji akụ nke gị - ma ị nwee ego ahụ.

rows.source: Hammer out your legal documents: Head off legal battles at the pass.
rows.output: Kpọkọta akwụkwọ iwu gị: Gaa n'ihu n'ọgụ iwu n'ọnụ ụzọ.
rows.reference: Kpaa maka akwụkwọ iwu gị: Kpebie nsogbu iwu n’ohere ahụ.

rows.source: Get a health-care proxy in place so that you designate a trusted individual to oversee your medical care and ensure that professionals comply with your wishes in case you're unable to communicate.
rows.output: Nweta onye na-ahụ maka ahụike n'ọnọdụ ka ị nye onye ị tụkwasịrị obi ikike ijikwa nlekọta ahụike gị ma hụ na ndị ọkachamara na-erube isi n'ọchịchọ gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị gaghị enwe ike ikwu okwu.
rows.reference: Dowe ihe nnọchite nlekọta-ahụike na njikere ka ị nwee ike ịkenye ya mmadụ atụkwasịrị obi iji hụ maka nlekọta ahụike gị ma gbaa mbọ hụ ndị ọkachamara mezuru na mmasị gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị nweghị ike ikwukọrịta okwu.

rows.source: Also, consider a power of attorney for your finances.
rows.output: Ọzọkwa, tụlee otu iwu nke ịkpọga ihe gbasara ego gị.
rows.reference: Ọzọkwa, tụlee ikike nke ọkaiwu maka ego gị.

rows.source: You would select a trusted person to make financial decisions for you and ensure your bills get paid if you're incapacitated.
rows.output: Ị ga-ahọrọ onye a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi ka o mee mkpebi ego maka gị ma hụ na a na-akwụ ụgwọ gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị teta.
rows.reference: Ị ga-ahọpụta otu onye atụkwasịrị obi iji meere gị mkpebi ego ma hụ na akwụrụ ụgwọ gị ma ọ bụrụ na ị nweghị ike.

rows.source: Don't forget the small details: Imagine that your elderly parent has a medical emergency and is on the way to the hospital.
rows.output: Echefula obere nkọwa: Chee echiche na nne ma ọ bụ nna gị toro eto nwere ihe mberede ahụike ma na-aga n'ụlọ ọgwụ.
rows.reference: Echefuna obere ihe: Chee echiche na nne na nna gị kara nka nwere ihe mberede ahụike ma nọrọ n’ụzọ na aga n’ụlọ ọgwụ.

rows.source: Would you be able to answer questions on medications and allergies?
rows.output: Ị nwere ike ịza ajụjụ gbasara ọgwụ na mmegbu?
rows.reference: Ị ga-enwe ike ịza ajụjụ maka ọgwụ na ihe ndị ha na ezere?

rows.source: Spell out those details in a written plan so that you're ready.
rows.output: Kọwapụta nkọwa ndị ahụ n'ime atụmatụ edere ka ị dị njikere.
rows.reference: Kwupute nkọwapụta ndị a n’atụmatụ edere ede ka ị nwee dị njikere.

rows.source: "It's not just the financials that are in play, but who are the doctors?" asked Martin.
rows.output: "Ọ dịghị onye na-ekwu maka ego ka ukwuu, ma onye bụ ndị dọkịta?" jụrụ Martin.
rows.reference: “Ọ bụghị naanị ego ka a na ekwu maka ya, mana kedu ndị bụ dọkịnta ya?” Martin jụrụ.

rows.source: "What are the medications?
rows.output: Gịnị bụ ọgwụ ndị ahụ?
rows.reference: “Gịnị hụ ọgwụ ndị ahụ?

rows.source: Who will care for the dog?
rows.output: Ònye ga-ahụ maka nkịta ahụ?
rows.reference: Onye ga-elekọta nkịta?

rows.source: Have that plan in place."
rows.output: Nwee atụmatụ ahụ n'ọnọdụ."
rows.reference: Hazie atụmatụ ahụ."

rows.source: Man shot multiple times with air rifle in Ilfracombe
rows.output: Mmadụ gbapụrụ ọtụtụ oge na egbe ikuku n'Ilfracombe
rows.reference: Eji egbe ikuku gbaa otu nwoke ọtụtụ oge na llfracombe

rows.source: A man has been shot multiple times with an air rifle as he walked home from a night out.
rows.output: Mmadụ e gburu ugboro ugboro n'oge na-adịbeghị anya site n'ịgba égbè ikuku ka ọ na-ala n'ụlọ site n'abalị.
rows.reference: Ejirila egbe ikuku wee gbaa otu nwoke ọtụtụ oge ka o ji ụkwụ alaghachi ụlọ ka ọ pụchara n’abalị.

rows.source: The victim, in his 40s, was in the Oxford Grove area of Ilfracombe, Devon, when he was shot in the chest, abdomen and hand.
rows.output: Onye ihe metụtara, n'afọ iri anọ ya, nọ n'ógbè Oxford Grove nke Ilfracombe, Devon, mgbe a gbagburu ya n'obi, afọ na aka.
rows.reference: Onye ọ metụtara, nọ n’afọ 40, nọ n’ogige Oxford Grove nke llfracombe, Devon, mgbe agbara ya egbe n’obi, afọ yana aka.

rows.source: Officers described the shooting, which took place at about 02:30 BST, as a "random act."
rows.output: Ndị ọrụ kọwara ogbunigwe ahụ, nke mere ihe dịka elekere 02:30 nke ụtụtụ, dị ka "omume enweghị usoro."
rows.reference: Ndị uwe ojii kọwara ọgbụgba egbe ahụ, nke mere n’ihe dị ka 02:30 BST, ka “omume na enweghị kpatara ya.”

rows.source: The victim did not see his attacker.
rows.output: Onye ahụ a tara ahụhụ ahụghị onye wakporo ya.
rows.reference: Onye ihe ahụ metụtara ahụghị onye makporo ya.

rows.source: His injuries are not life-threatening and police have appealed for witnesses.
rows.output: Mmerụ ahụ ya adịghị njọ nke ukwuu, ndị uwe ojii ekwela arịrịọ ndị akaebe.
rows.reference: Ahụ mmerụ ya abụghị ihe ga-egbu ya, ndị uwe ojii arịọla maka ndị akaebe.

rows.source: Earthquakes and tsunamis in Indonesia
rows.output: Mgbawa ala na tsunami na Indonesia
rows.reference: Ala ọmajiji na tsunami na Indonesia

rows.source: At least 384 people have been killed by a powerful earthquake and tsunami that hit the Indonesian city of Palu on Friday, officials said, with the death toll expected to rise.
rows.output: N'ụzọ dịkarịa ala, mmadụ 384 ka e gburu site na ọdachi ala ọma jijiji na tsunami siri ike kụrụ obodo Palu nke Indonesia na Fraịde, ndị ọrụ kwuru, na ọnụ ọgụgụ ndị nwụrụ nwere ike ịrị elu.
rows.reference: Opekata mpe ndị mmadụ 384 nwụrụ ka nnukwu ala ọmajiji na tsunami dara n’obodo Palu nke Indonesia na Fraịde, ndị ọrụ kwuru, atụrụ anya na ọnụọgụ ndị nwụrụ anwụ ga-agbakọ.

rows.source: With communications knocked out, relief officials have not been able to get any information from Donggala regency, an area north of Palu that is closer to the epicenter of the 7.5 magnitude quake.
rows.output: N'ịgbalị na nkwukọrịta na-adịghị mma, ndị isi enyemaka enweghị ike ịnweta ozi ọ bụla sitere na mpaghara Donggala, nke dị n'ebe ugwu nke Palu, nke dị nso n'ebe ihe ahụ mere nke 7.5.
rows.reference: Ka akụpụrụ ụzọ nkwukọrịta, ndị ọrụ enyemaka enwebeghị ike ịnweta ozi ọ bụla n’aka ala ọchịchị Donggala, mpaghara ugwu nke Palu nọketere nso na etiti nke ala ọmajiji 7.5 ahụ.

rows.source: In Palu, more than 16,000 people were evacuated after the disaster struck.
rows.output: N'ime Palu, karịrị mmadụ 16,000 ebugara n'ụlọ nchekwa mgbe ihe mberede ahụ mere.
